name: A la Sevda
description:
Hier kochst du mit Sevda. Ihre Rezepte, so wie sie sie auf Instagram zeigt. Jetzt alle an einem Ort.

Über 120 Rezepte. Türkische Klassiker wie Börek, Köfte, Pide und Dolma. Dazu Pasta, Hähnchen, Suppen und Desserts für jeden Tag.

VIDEO UND REZEPT ZUSAMMEN
Du siehst Sevda beim Kochen. Daneben stehen die Zutaten und die Schritte. Du musst nichts mitschreiben.

GENAUE MENGEN
Jede Zutat steht mit Menge da. So, wie Sevda sie angibt.

KOCHMODUS MIT VORLESEN
Ein Schritt pro Seite, groß und gut lesbar. Der Bildschirm bleibt an. Die App liest dir jeden Schritt vor. Steht im Schritt eine Zeit, startest du mit einem Tippen den Timer.

FRAG MITTEN IM KOCHEN
Du hast eine Frage zum Rezept? Der Küchenassistent kennt das Rezept, das du gerade offen hast. Er antwortet sofort.

EINKAUFSLISTE
Zutaten mit einem Tippen auf die Liste. Was in mehreren Rezepten vorkommt, wird zusammengezählt.

SPEICHERN UND PLANEN
Speichere deine Lieblingsrezepte. Plane deine Woche. Schreib dir Notizen zu jedem Rezept.

AUF DEUTSCH UND TÜRKISCH
Die ganze App gibt es auf Deutsch und auf Türkisch.

DAS ABO
Drei Rezepte kannst du gleich ausprobieren. Mit dem Abo öffnest du alle Rezepte, das Vorlesen und den Küchenassistenten. Es gibt ein Monatsabo und ein Jahresabo. Das Jahresabo kannst du 7 Tage gratis testen. Die Preise siehst du vor dem Kauf in der App. Das Abo verlängert sich automatisch. Du kannst es jederzeit in den Einstellungen deines App-Store-Kontos kündigen.

name: AKWAAD Explore
description:
AKWAAD Explore is Ghana's premier lifestyle and discovery platform — built for locals, visitors and the diaspora who want to experience the very best of Ghana. Whether you are looking for the best jollof in Osu, planning your Detty December itinerary, searching for hidden beaches, discovering upcoming concerts or finding verified local businesses, AKWAAD Explore has everything in one place.
MEET KUUKS — YOUR PERSONAL GHANAIAN AI GUIDE
Kuuks is not a chatbot. She is a warm, knowledgeable Ghanaian woman who knows every corner of Ghana. Ask her anything — she plans full day itineraries with GHS budget guidance, recommends the best restaurants near you, identifies Ghanaian dishes from photos, gives real local directions and knows Ghana's festivals, culture and current events better than anyone.
DISCOVER NEARBY
Powered by real Google Maps data. 16 category filters including Food, Cafes, Shopping, Beaches, Hotels, Art and more. Tap any category and see the nearest places ordered by distance. Every listing shows real photos, ratings, opening hours and directions.
XPLORE EVENTS
Concerts. Festivals. Comedy shows. Theatre. Sports. Nightlife. Art exhibitions. Cinema. Browse all events happening across Ghana in a beautiful poster grid. Get personalised recommendations based on your interests. Never miss a moment in Ghana.
CAMPUS XPLORE
Built for Ghana's students. Discover food spots, events, hangout places and student-friendly businesses on and around your campus. Your campus life, fully unlocked.
EXPLORE GHANA LIKE NEVER BEFORE
The Explore tab curates the best of Ghana daily — Premium Picks from verified top businesses, Hot This Week for trending spots, Upcoming Events, Featured Zone showcasing new brands and launches, Neighbourhood Picks near you and seasonal cultural banners celebrating Ghana's rich calendar of holidays and festivals.
SEASONAL CULTURE
AKWAAD Explore celebrates Ghana with you — from Independence Day to Homowo, Kwahu Easter to Detty December. The app comes alive with every Ghanaian cultural moment.

KEY FEATURES

• Ask Kuuks — AI concierge with 14-day conversation memory
• Discover Nearby — Real Google Maps data, 16 category filters, Load More pagination
• Xplore Events — 3x3 poster grid, Near You, Recommended, Coming Up by month
• Campus Xplore — Dedicated discovery space for Ghana's students
• Explore Tab — Premium Picks, Hot This Week, Featured Zone, Upcoming Events
• Saved Places — Bookmark any location with reminder options
• My Trips — Save itineraries from Kuuks or plan your own
• Seasonal Banners — Celebrating Ghana's full cultural calendar
• Free Forever — No subscription, no hidden fees for users
FREE TO DOWNLOAD. FREE FOREVER.
AKWAAD Explore is completely free for all users. No subscription. No hidden fees. Download and start discovering Ghana today.
Built with pride in Ghana by EDSAE Limited. 
website: akwaadexplore.com

name: AreaHearth
description:
Plan paint purchases from the rooms you measure. Enter length, width and height in metres, subtract openings, and choose whether to include the ceiling. Set the product coverage, number of coats and reserve percentage to calculate net area and litres. Save and edit rooms, search your estimates and compare a combined purchase total rounded up to litres. Export local records as JSON. Estimates use your assumptions; always check the paint label and actual surface conditions.

No account, ads or purchases. Records stay on this device. Export before deleting the app.

name: Aurea: Vær, UV og stjerner
description:
Aurea samler været, UV-indeksen og stjernehimmelen i én vakker app. Ingen reklame, ingen konto og ingen sporing.

VÆR DU KAN STOLE PÅ
• Varsel fra Yr/MET og flere værmodeller samlet til ett klart bilde – og du ser når meteorologene er uenige.
• Nedbør de neste to timene fra radar og modeller.
• Temperatur målt av private værstasjoner rundt deg, sammenlignet med varselet.
• Time for time, dagene fremover og en trend for 30 dager. Trykk på en dag for hele dagen.
• Alt i stedets egen tid – også når du sjekker været på reise.

FAREVARSLER
• Offisielle farevarsler fra Meteorologisk institutt vises øverst når det gjelder deg (Norge).

UV, LUFT OG SOL
• UV-indeks nå og gjennom dagen, med råd om solkrem.
• Luftkvalitet og pollen, soloppgang og solnedgang.

STJERNEHIMMEL
• Se hvor godt stjernene sees i kveld – skyer, måneskinn og når det er mørkt nok.
• Stjernekamera: hold telefonen mot himmelen og se stjerner, stjernebilder, Melkeveien og månen.
• Planeter og romstasjonen ISS: når og hvor de står på himmelen, og neste synlige overflygning.
• Nordlysvarsel for din posisjon.

KART OG DIREKTEBILDER
• Radar, satellitt (også Amerika og Asia) og lyn i kartet.
• Direktebilder fra kameraer i nærheten.

UT PÅ REISE
• Legg inn en tur og få nedtelling, bilde fra stedet og været ved ankomst. Mens du er på tur blir reisemålet hovedvær.

LAGET FOR DEG
• Widgeter og klokkeskive for Apple Watch, inkludert en egen UV-widget.
• Favoritter, reiser og innstillinger synkroniseres via iCloud.
• Vakker, rolig grafikk som følger været og tiden på døgnet.

Data: MET Norge/Yr, Open-Meteo (ECMWF, DWD ICON, NOAA GFS), Netatmo, EUMETSAT, NASA GIBS, RainViewer, NOAA SWPC, Celestrak og flere. Se personvernerklæringen for detaljer.

name: BlendTally
description:
Keep workshop mixtures repeatable. Save named recipes with base and additive parts, enter a target mass, and see the mass needed for each component. Record batches with notes, revisit their proportions and review total mixed mass. Search recipes, edit them without changing past batches, and export your records as JSON. Ratios are by mass; follow the material supplier’s instructions.

No account, ads or purchases. Your records stay on this device. Export a backup before removing the app.

name: BriefAnchor
description:
Keep meeting decisions connected to the work that follows. Save dated briefs with agendas and decisions, then add actions with an owner and due date. Filter the action queue by open or completed status, identify overdue work and mark actions complete or reopen them. Review decisions and action progress together in a handoff summary. Edit records, search meetings and export local records as JSON. This is a private device notebook, without team synchronization or scheduled notifications.

No account, ads or purchases. Records stay on this device. Export before deleting the app.

name: ChurchLog Admin: Church Staff
description:
ChurchLog Admin is the app for the people who serve a church: pastors, department and small-group leaders, the new-family team and finance staff. Members use the "ChurchLog" app, staff use this one, and both see the same church data.

Note: your church must be using ChurchLog. Verify your mobile number and the app opens the areas your church has given you. If your church is new to ChurchLog, you can apply to register it in the app.

HOME & INBOX
Join requests, visit requests and expense approvals wait in one place, and this Sunday's to-dos (attendance check, small-group reports, open serving spots) are on one screen.

MEMBERS, FAMILIES & NEW FAMILIES
See members by small group, their families and contact details within your area, and call in one tap. Follow new families from the registration card through weekly follow-up to graduation and small-group placement.

ATTENDANCE
Set up QR and automatic check-in, see attendance and who has been away for a while, and record or correct attendance for someone.

SMALL-GROUP REPORTS & VISITS
Write and read small-group meeting reports, and plan and record pastoral visits.

NEWS & MESSAGES
Post announcements, events, bulletins and sign-up forms, and reach members by app notification or text message.

MINISTRY TEAMS & SERVING
Recruit team members, build serving rotations and notify them. You get an alert when a spot opens up.

FINANCE
Offering entry and confirmation, the ledger, expense requests and approvals, bank reconciliation, month-end and year-end closing, and donation receipts. It shows what to do next for your role first.

Choose text size, language (English / Korean) and Face ID app lock as you like.

name: CrateRelay
description:
Keep track of every box during a home or studio move. Name a box, assign its destination, list one item per line and mark fragile contents. Move boxes from open to packed to delivered, with the option to reset a status when plans change. Search names, destinations and contents, filter by stage and browse a destination-by-destination manifest. Delivery counts update from your real records. Edit details, keep notes and export your packing records as JSON. This app is a private checklist; it does not book shipping or track carriers.

No account, ads or purchases. Records stay on this device. Export before deleting the app.

name: CycleCanvas
description: Build a repeatable path through recurring work. Write routines with one step per line, then start a session with its own snapshot. Check steps as you work, save notes and finish only after every step is checked. Editing or deleting a routine leaves existing sessions intact. Keep active work separate from completed history, search routines and export records as JSON. Useful for studio preparation, desk resets and personal backup checks.\n\nNo account, ads or purchases. Records stay on this device. Export before deleting the app.

name: EA Master: TOGAF® Prep
description:
EA Master giúp bạn tự học và luyện thi chứng chỉ TOGAF® Enterprise Architecture Foundation (TOGAF® Standard, 10th Edition) trong 30 ngày. Ứng dụng dành cho Solution Architect và kỹ sư IT muốn nắm chắc Enterprise Architecture: giao diện tiếng Việt, giữ nguyên thuật ngữ tiếng Anh, học hoàn toàn offline.

GIÁO TRÌNH 30 NGÀY
• 30 bài học chi tiết, mỗi ngày 60–90 phút: mục tiêu, lý thuyết, khái niệm chính, ví dụ thực tế, case study Solution Architecture, bảng so sánh và mẹo làm bài.
• Lộ trình 4 tuần: khái niệm nền tảng → ADM (Preliminary, Phase A–H, Requirements Management) → kỹ thuật, áp dụng ADM và Architecture Governance → Architecture Content và luyện đề.

TỪ VỰNG & EXAM KEYWORDS
• 454 thuật ngữ Anh – Việt có phiên âm IPA, phát âm, định nghĩa, ví dụ và lỗi hay nhầm.
• 234 thẻ Exam Keywords giúp nhận diện nhanh câu hỏi thuộc phase hay domain nào.
• Flashcard lật 3D, vuốt để đánh dấu đã thuộc/chưa thuộc, ôn tập ngắt quãng (Spaced Repetition) với lịch “Due Today”.
• 5 chế độ học: Learn, Review, Match, Multiple Choice, Type Answer.

LUYỆN THI
• 460 câu hỏi tự biên soạn, có bản dịch tiếng Việt và giải thích cho từng đáp án.
• Bài kiểm tra mỗi ngày, 4 bài ôn tập theo tuần và 2 đề thi thử 40 câu / 60 phút theo cấu trúc đề Foundation.
• Giao diện thi thật: đồng hồ đếm ngược, đánh dấu câu, bảng điều hướng, tự nộp khi hết giờ.
• Đề thích ứng ưu tiên câu bạn từng sai và kiến thức yếu.

THEO DÕI TIẾN ĐỘ
• Dashboard, chuỗi ngày học, mục tiêu phút mỗi ngày, biểu đồ theo tuần và độ chính xác theo nhóm kiến thức.
• Sổ tay câu sai tự động; chỉ số sẵn sàng thi (chỉ số học tập nội bộ, không bảo đảm kết quả thi).
• ADM Map tương tác và bảng so sánh các khái niệm dễ nhầm.

RIÊNG TƯ
Không tài khoản, không quảng cáo, không thu thập dữ liệu. Mọi tiến độ lưu trên thiết bị của bạn.

TOGAF® là nhãn hiệu đã đăng ký của The Open Group. EA Master là ứng dụng học tập độc lập, không liên kết, không được tài trợ hay xác nhận bởi The Open Group. Câu hỏi luyện tập được tự biên soạn, không phải đề thi chính thức.

name: Fib
description:
One rare word. One true meaning. The rest are fibs.

Fib is a bluffing word game. Every round shows an obscure word and several meanings. One comes from a real dictionary. The others are fibs, written on your iPhone by Apple Intelligence or by your friends. Tap the one you believe, hold to lock in, and watch the needle read it: each fib is scribbled out and torn off, and the truth gets stamped.

WHAT IT DOES
- Today's word: one rare word a day, the same word on every phone, with a streak for every day you spot it.
- Play with friends: three to eight players pass one iPhone round the room. A shutter drops between turns so nobody sees anyone else's answer.
- Write your own fibs: type a meaning the way you would text it. Fib tidies it into dictionary voice, so your handwriting can't give you away. You approve it before it goes in.
- The machine plays too: it writes its own fibs, scores a point for every vote they win, and can top the table.
- Hidden votes and a dramatic read: every fib is unmasked with its author and everyone it fooled.
- Your roll: every word you meet, whether you spotted it, and the exact fib that got you.
- Share today's verdict as a card that shows the word and your trace, never the answer.
- Purist mode: play with real definitions borrowed from other rare words instead of written fibs.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Everything runs on your iPhone. No account, no sign-in, no ads, no analytics. Fib keeps no account and sends nothing anywhere, so it plays at a party with no signal.

GOOD TO KNOW
- Written fibs need an iPhone with Apple Intelligence turned on. Every other iPhone plays the same game with real definitions borrowed from other words.
- True meanings come from WordNet 3.1, Princeton University.
- The morning nudge asks for notification permission only when you turn it on.

FREE AND UNLOCKED
Today's word is free every day, and so is one party game a day. A single one-off purchase unlocks unlimited party games. No subscription.

name: First Rodeo Racing
description:
Closer to your horses. Closer to the stable.

First Rodeo Racing brings the stable closer for existing FRR members. Follow your horses between race days and stay connected to the community behind them.

MY STABLE
Find your horses and recorded ownership connections in one place. Catch published updates and see the next confirmed start for your stable.

RACE-DAY HUBS
Follow race details, post times, jockey and trainer information, recorded results, and silks or replay links when FRR adds them. Open the horse’s conversation right from its race-day hub. Add a confirmed race to your iPhone calendar using a form you control.

FOLLOW THE JOURNEY
Explore horse profiles, training reports, workouts, race previews, recaps and stable announcements. Browse published photos and open posted video links. Each horse’s timeline brings its updates and recorded races together.

YOUR FRR COMMUNITY
Join General Stable Chat and conversations inside horse profiles. Reply to a message, add a reaction and take part in FRR polls. Replies to your messages appear in your activity screen. Report concerns, block authors and manage your conversations with FRR’s moderation tools.

STABLE EVENTS
Discover published barn visits and race-day gatherings. Choose Going or Maybe, change your response or withdraw your RSVP. Check event details for deadlines, capacity and any changes before traveling.

RACING, EXPLAINED
Tap highlighted racing terms for an explanation, or search the Racing 101 guide.

YOUR ACCOUNT
Manage your profile and password, recover account access, contact FRR and request account deletion from within the app.

An existing FRR account is required. Ownership information and investor conversations require FRR verification. FRR reviews ownership connections. Content and event availability depend on what FRR has published.

All post times and event times appear in fixed Eastern Standard Time (EST, UTC−5), year-round. Race records reflect information entered by FRR and may not cover each horse’s full career.

name: Frutopica
description:
Welcome to Frutopica, a floating island high above the clouds where every fruit has a face and every season brings a new surprise.

SWAP, MATCH & POP
Line up three or more juicy fruits to clear them. Match four or five to make glowing suns, fluttering butterflies and dazzling rainbows, then set them off for huge cascades. Clear hay bales, ice, muddy soil and many more farmyard obstacles along the way.

FOUR MAGICAL SEASONS
Travel from blossom-pink spring to snowy winter. Every season has its own fruit, its own animals and its own chapter of the story.

BEAT THE BOSS LEVELS
Queen Buzzbelle, Yuki the Yeti and their friends are causing trouble on the farm. Beat them on special boss levels and win them over.

MAKE PIP'S HOME COZY
Every level you win grows sprouts. Use them to fix up and decorate eight charming places, from a jam kitchen and a four-season treehouse to a snowy lodge and a lakeside boathouse, then move things around to make each one your own.

PLAY WITH FRIENDS
Add friends with a code, send each other lives and cheers, and chat with stickers and ready-made phrases.

THOUSANDS OF LEVELS TO EXPLORE
Daily quests, a lucky wheel, treasure chases, trophies and a fruit album to fill keep every day fresh.

Frutopica is free to play. It contains ads, and some optional items can be bought with real money. You can turn off in-app purchases in your device's settings.

Questions or ideas? We'd love to hear from you at frutopica.net/support.html

name: Gamelles 4000
description:
Des midis végétariens qui tiennent au corps, sans réfléchir chaque matin.

Gamelles 4000, c'est 1 150 recettes de midi, la plupart entre 700 et 1 000 kcal avec 30 à 50 g de protéines, plus 200 collations. Pensé pour ceux qui cuisinent leur gamelle pour le bureau ou l'atelier : rapide, pas cher, et souvent préparable le dimanche.

CHERCHE OU DEMANDE
Une seule barre : tape « feta », ou demande « un truc chaud en 15 min ». L'idée du jour s'adapte à ton objectif.

TA SEMAINE EN UN GESTE
Remplis la semaine au hasard, en version maligne (le moins de courses possible), petit budget, sans réchauffer ou batch. Les plats partagent leurs ingrédients et rien ne se perd.

DES COURSES RANGÉES PAR RAYON
La liste se remplit toute seule, avec les quantités, les paquets à prendre et un prix estimé. Ton frigo et ton placard sont déjà déduits.

LE BATCH DU DIMANCHE
Un seul plan de cuisine pour toute la semaine, dans l'ordre, avec les minuteurs. Et une affiche A4 du menu pour le frigo.

TON OBJECTIF
Équilibre, Actif (prise de muscle), Marathonien, Sèche ou Perte de poids : calories et protéines du jour, part plus grosse les jours d'entraînement, collations avant et après l'effort.

APPLE SANTÉ
Enregistre ta part dans Santé d'un toucher, comme un repas avec le nom du plat : calories, protéines, glucides, lipides, fibres, sucres et sel. Tes applis de suivi qui lisent Santé les retrouvent.

RAPPELS ET MODE CUISINE
Le batch du dimanche, les courses, le plat de ce midi. En cuisine, l'écran reste allumé et les minuteurs sonnent même téléphone verrouillé.

SUR TON IPHONE ET TON MAC
Avec la synchro iCloud, ta semaine, tes favoris et ton carnet te suivent.

RIEN NE SORT DE TON APPAREIL
Pas de compte, pas de publicité, pas de pistage. Tes données restent chez toi.

Calories, macros et prix sont estimés d'après des moyennes par ingrédient : un repère, pas un avis médical.

name: Harry's Haircenter
description:
Welkom bij Harrys Haircenter. Houd je salon binnen handbereik en plan eenvoudig je volgende bezoek.

Maak een afspraak via de online afsprakenpagina van de salon. Je kunt ook je digitale stempelpas bekijken en zelf je stempels bijhouden.

Open de app wanneer je wilt, controleer je pas en ga direct naar de afsprakenpagina van Harrys Haircenter.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Hatchmark
description:
Hatchmark is a day planner that you make from blocks. It works like a paper planner page that you design.

A paper planner has one layout for every person. Your day is different. In Hatchmark you put the blocks that you need on the page, in the order that you want. Each day gives you a new copy of that page.

THREE BLOCKS

• Checkbox row: a row of boxes with a target, for example 10 sales calls or 8 glasses of water. Add a stretch goal for the days when you do more.
• List: lines for your tasks. Each line can have a checkbox, a number and a checklist of steps.
• Notes: one free text field.

YOUR PAGE, YOUR LAYOUT

• Tap Arrange and drag the blocks into rows and columns.
• Put blocks side by side, for example five checkbox rows across the page.
• Start from the Work day template or the Home template, or start with a blank page.
• A change to the layout applies to today and to later days. Past days keep their layout.

MADE FOR A FULL DAY

• A success line: complete your top three tasks, and the line turns green.
• Carry over: the open lines of a list move to the next day. Use it for the things that you wait on.
• A progress bar shows how much of the day is done.
• Go back to a past day to see what you did.

ONE PLANNER FOR EACH RESPONSIBILITY

Work, home, church, a side project. Each planner has its own layout and its own days. On iPad and Mac, the list of planners stays on the screen.

IPHONE, IPAD AND MAC

Hatchmark is a native app on each device. Your planners sync through your own iCloud account.

PRIVATE

Hatchmark has no account, no ads and no analytics. Your planners stay on your devices and in your iCloud account. We cannot see them.

AI ASSISTANTS ON THE MAC

With Hatchmark Pro, the Mac app can let an AI assistant such as Claude read your pages and fill them in. The connection stays on your Mac. It is off until you turn it on.

FREE AND PRO

The free plan gives you one planner and the last 7 days.

Hatchmark Pro gives you:
• Many planners
• All your past days
• AI assistants on the Mac

Hatchmark Pro is a monthly subscription or a one-time lifetime purchase. The monthly subscription renews each month until you cancel it. Your Apple Account pays at the confirmation of the purchase. You can cancel in the settings of your Apple Account at least 24 hours before the end of the period.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://alpinehills.au/hatchmark/privacy/

name: IFR Flash Card Quest
description:
Read the clearance. Build the brief. Explain the decision.

IFR Flash Card Quest is an independent U.S. instrument-airplane study app combining original study questions with structured clearance and procedure interpretation.

CLEARANCE LAB
Work through eight originally authored fictional briefings. Complete five briefing/readback fields and three connected decisions in each case. Compare selected and expected answers, read source-backed explanations and save a local learning note. Cases cover assigned versus expected instructions, amendments, timed and distance holds, approach minimums, lost communications and alternate-weather assumptions.

STUDY AND TEST
100 original practice questions across ten IFR topics, explanations and FAA/eCFR links. Bookmark questions and revisit missed answers. Practice tests contain60 distinct questions with120minutes. Shuffle without losing selected answers. Resume a test with its original deadline and review submitted results.

ON-DEVICE RECORDS
Briefing notes, bookmarks and test history stay on your device. No account or cloud upload.

PURCHASES AND ADS
The paid download includes all learning content and bottom-banner advertising subject to authorization. Optional one-time Remove Ads removes advertising only; no subscription or separate content unlock. Restore with the same Apple Account through bottom Ad-free options. Apple displays local prices.

Independent educational aid, not FAA-endorsed or an actual FAA question bank. No pass guarantee, endorsement or flight-proficiency assessment. Fictional diagrams are not real charts, are not to scale and must not be used for navigation. No live weather, flight-planning or navigation service. Use current official publications and qualified instruction for real operations.

name: Lemon Test
description:
Lemon Test giúp bạn luyện IELTS và theo dõi hành trình học tập ngay trên điện thoại.

LUYỆN TẬP BỐN KỸ NĂNG
• Reading: luyện đọc hiểu với nhiều dạng câu hỏi.
• Listening: luyện nghe và làm bài với nội dung âm thanh.
• Writing: luyện viết và xem phản hồi AI theo các tiêu chí đánh giá.
• Speaking: ghi âm câu trả lời và xem phản hồi để cải thiện kỹ năng nói.

THI THỬ THEO THỜI GIAN
Chọn đề trong thư viện, luyện tập linh hoạt hoặc làm bài thi thử có tính giờ.

HỌC VÀ ÔN TỪ VỰNG
Học từ vựng theo bộ từ, theo dõi số từ đã học và ôn tập bằng phương pháp lặp lại ngắt quãng.

THEO DÕI TIẾN ĐỘ
Xem lịch sử học tập, kết quả luyện tập, mục tiêu và chuỗi ngày học để duy trì thói quen mỗi ngày.

GIAO DIỆN VIỆT VÀ ANH
Lựa chọn ngôn ngữ phù hợp với cách học của bạn.

Phản hồi và band điểm do AI cung cấp chỉ mang tính tham khảo, không phải kết quả IELTS chính thức.

Lemon Test là nền tảng luyện tập độc lập, không liên kết với các tổ chức sở hữu hoặc tổ chức kỳ thi IELTS.

name: LexiSplice
description:
Bring order to everyday text. Save a named snippet with its original input and editable transformation choices. Trim line edges, remove blank lines, change letter case, remove duplicate lines and sort naturally. Preview and copy the result without changing the saved source. Search names and source text, review character changes and duplicate removal, then export your records as JSON. Useful for supply lists, reading notes and reusable text. Letter case and sorting follow the selected language.

No account, ads or purchases. Records stay on this device. Export before deleting the app.

name: LineMark Desk
description:
LineMark Desk keeps dialogue, voice-over, and narration lines on this device. Capture the line text, assign a character, add a scene or episode remark, and optional tone tags, then move each entry through Draft, Polish, and Ready.

The Drafts tab highlights lines still being shaped. Lines lists the full library with search and filters for character or scene. Cast manages character names and shows how many lines each holds. Open a line to edit text, add a short rewrite note, change status, or delete. About explains how to use the app, in-app Privacy & Support, support email, and erase all local data after two confirmations.

What you can do:
• Drafts — focus on lines in Draft or Polish, with quick status moves
• Lines — browse and search the full library by character, scene, or text
• Line detail — edit the line, add rewrite notes, change status, or delete
• Cast — manage characters and see line counts
• About — how to use, in-app Privacy & Support, erase local library (two-step confirm)

Core features work offline on this device. No account, ads, subscriptions, or in-app purchases. Your line library stays on the device. This app does not record video or act as a teleprompter camera.

Built for writers and creators who catch a strong line and need a simple local place to polish it.

name: Mentory Hub Pro - Cursos
description:
O Mentory Hub Pro - Cursos é o aplicativo da área de membros para alunos de mentorias e cursos que usam a plataforma Mentory Hub Pro.

Entre com o e-mail e a senha que você recebeu da sua mentoria ou na compra do curso e tenha todas as suas aulas no celular:

• Seus cursos organizados por módulos, com o progresso de cada aula
• Player com controle de velocidade, continuação de onde parou e próxima aula automática
• Materiais em PDF para ler na tela
• Certificados dos cursos concluídos
• Notificações de aula nova, de acesso perto de vencer e lembretes para continuar estudando (você escolhe quais receber)
• A marca da sua mentoria em todo o app

O acesso é liberado pela sua mentoria ou pela compra do curso, fora do aplicativo. Não há compras dentro do app.

name: MetallLearn – Metalltechnik
description:
MetallLearn erklärt Metalltechnik so, dass sie hängen bleibt: mit interaktiven Schaubildern, Rechnern, einem Tabellenbuch zum Anfassen, Simulationen und einem Quiz, das sich merkt, was du noch üben musst. Für alle, die Metalltechnik lernen oder ihr Wissen auffrischen wollen – in Ausbildung, Beruf oder beim Quereinstieg.

LEKTIONEN MIT SCHAUBILD
172 Lektionen in 20 Themen – von Werkstoffen, Wärmebehandlung und Technischem Zeichnen über Toleranzen, Messtechnik, Drehen, Fräsen, Schleifen und CNC bis zu Fügen, Maschinenelementen, Pneumatik & Hydraulik, Steuerungstechnik, Instandhaltung und Qualität. Formeln mit echten Brüchen, Rechenbeispiele und Kernaussagen auf einen Blick.

ÜBER 45 RECHNER
• Zerspanung: Drehzahl, Schnittdaten Drehen, Fräsen und Bohren, Schnittkraft, Hauptnutzungszeit, Rautiefe, Kegel, Teilkopf
• ISO-Passungen mit Passungsbild, Allgemeintoleranzen, Maßkette
• Gewinde, Kernloch, Durchgangslöcher, Anziehdrehmoment, Festigkeitsklassen
• Biegen, Abwicklung, Schneidkraft, Masse von Halbzeugen und Stahlbauprofilen
• Getriebe, Zahnräder, Spannung, Wärmeausdehnung, Kolbenkraft, Luftverbrauch, Härteumrechnung

TABELLENBUCH ZUM ANFASSEN
Rund 70 durchsuchbare Tabellen: Werkstoffe, Profile, Grundtoleranzen und Grundabmaße, Gewinde, Schrauben, Schnittwerte, Form- und Lagetoleranzen, Schweißsymbole, ISO-1219-Schaltzeichen, G- und M-Funktionen und mehr – mit Sprung in den passenden Rechner.

WERKSTATT
• CNC-Simulator Fräsen und Drehen mit G-Code-Editor
• 24 Pneumatik-, Elektropneumatik- und Hydraulikschaltungen zum Ausprobieren, dazu Experimente
• Messschieber-, Messschrauben- und Messuhr-Trainer
• Passungen, Eisen-Kohlenstoff-Diagramm, Zugversuch, Biegen, Getriebe und GRAFCET interaktiv
• 40 Fehlersuchen und 40 Aufgaben im Zeichnungs-Trainer
• 30 3D-Modelle zum Drehen und Zerlegen – vom Messschieber über Lager und Getriebe bis zum Wegeventil

QUIZ, DAS MITDENKT
• 650 Fragen mit Erklärung und Denkanstoß
• Falsch beantwortete Fragen kommen nach 1, 3 und 7 Tagen wieder
• Schwächen-Training, Prüfungssimulation, Karteikarten und Frage des Tages
• Tagesziel mit Serie und Widget

KOSTENLOS STARTEN – ALLES MIT PRO
MetallLearn ist kostenlos. Aus jedem Bereich kannst du einen Teil ausprobieren; Arbeitssicherheit und die Sicherheitsseiten sind immer frei. Mit MetallLearn Pro schaltest du alle Inhalte frei – als einmaliger Kauf, kein Abo, mit Familienfreigabe.

Ohne Werbung, ohne Anmeldung, funktioniert offline. Für iPhone und iPad.

Hinweis: Angaben ohne Gewähr. Maßgeblich sind die gültigen Normen, Vorschriften und Herstellerangaben; die App ersetzt keine Fachausbildung.

name: Minvoice: invoices & VAT
description:
Minvoice keeps track of your invoices: the ones you send and the ones you have to pay. The app is made for Belgium, with Belgian VAT rates and Peppol built in.

FOR FREELANCERS AND SMALL BUSINESSES
• Invoices, quotes, credit notes, purchase orders and delivery notes
• Every invoice gets a payment QR code that works with every Belgian banking app
• Send and receive via Peppol
• Scan receipts and purchase invoices with your camera
• Customers, products, time tracking and recurring invoices
• Overview of revenue, outstanding amounts and VAT

AT HOME
• Scan or upload the bills you have to pay
• A reminder before the due date, so you stop paying late fees
• An alert when you are about to pay the same bill twice
• Separate folders, for example for your parents, that you can share

FOR ACCOUNTANTS
• Your clients give you access to their folder, so you no longer have to chase receipts

You can delete your account and all your data yourself at any time in Settings.

name: Monstigo
description:
The floor gives way under your boots. A double jump lands you on the pressure plate and the gate swings open. On the other side, a guard raises his weapon. Can you time the parry?

Cross seven dark landscapes in Monstigo’s campaign. Decipher runes, duck beneath obstacles and leap over spinning blades. A closing wall keeps you moving in escape stages. In boss fights, take a moment to read your opponent’s next move.

Start as the Vampire Warrior and unlock four more heroes. Name each one, choose weapons and boots, and find cape pieces in chests. Pick a cape color to go with your hero’s hair and jewelry. Equip up to three unlocked abilities before a round. Freeze an enemy in place or send a wave of fire through a group.

Invite a friend to an arena duel or race their ghost on the same escape course. First to the finish wins. If you both fall, the player who survived longer wins. Your profiles show your wins and losses.

Choose English, German, French, Spanish, Arabic or Tunisian Arabic in the game settings.

Use Sign in with Apple on iPhone or iPad. To continue your adventure on another device, approve the link on the device you already play on. Gold and diamonds are available as optional in-app purchases.

name: MotifMark
description:
MotifMark is a local notebook for melody motifs and riffs. When a phrase pops into your head, capture a title plus key, tempo (BPM), mood, and optional lyric or fingering notes — without opening a DAW.

The Active tab lists motifs you are still shaping. Library shows every riff with search and filters for key or mood. Projects groups motifs under song or practice buckets. Open a motif to edit fields, add a short work log, mark Keep working or Shelve, or delete. About explains how to use the app, in-app Privacy & Support, support email, and erase all local data after two confirmations.

What you can do:
• Active — focus on motifs still in progress, with quick Keep working / Shelve
• Library — browse and search all riffs by key, mood, or title
• Motif detail — edit notes, review work logs, change status, or delete
• Projects — organize motifs into song or practice groups
• About — how to use, in-app Privacy & Support, erase local library (two-step confirm)

Core features work offline on this device. No account, ads, subscriptions, or in-app purchases. Your motif library stays on the device. This app does not record audio or tune instruments.

Built for songwriters and players who need a fast text cue for a riff before it fades.

name: Murmur: messages and calls
description:
Murmur is a messenger to write to and call the people close to you, share your moments and follow what is happening around you. With internet, your messages leave at once, wherever your contact is. Without internet, nearby Murmur phones pass them on over Bluetooth, from one phone to the next, until they reach the right person.

Messages and calls
• Text, voice messages, photos, videos, documents and location, one to one or in groups of up to 64 people.
• Your conversations and your one-to-one calls are end-to-end encrypted: our servers and the phones that carry a message only see unreadable content.
• Voice and video calls. On the same Wi-Fi, they work even without internet. Group calls with internet.
• Reactions, replies, forwarding, messages edited or deleted for everyone, disappearing, view-once or scheduled messages, polls, stickers and two-player games.
• Nobody can message you privately without your consent: you accept every contact.

Even without a network
Internet down, network overloaded, data plan used up: your messages, voice notes and photos travel over Bluetooth between nearby Murmur phones. If nobody is in range, the message waits, then moves on as soon as it meets another Murmur phone. You can see which phones it went through.

Échos
Murmur’s public feed: videos, photos and texts to scroll through full screen. Like, comment, share, reply with a video and follow the accounts you enjoy. Sponsored échos are marked as such.

Lives
Join a live, write in the chat, ask your questions and vote in polls.

The map
Find your contacts and the Murmur members around you. While the app is open and you are visible (the starting setting), your contacts see you to within about 50 m and other members to within about 250 m. Ghost mode makes you invisible in one tap: your location is no longer sent.

Iris, your assistant
Iris sums up a long voice message or a conversation, answers your questions about a message, suggests replies and reads aloud. You can also talk with her live. Iris needs internet, and nothing is sent to her without your consent.

Certified accounts and communities
Institutions, media, NGOs, businesses and communities can request a certified badge. Every application is reviewed by the Murmur team. A member of a verified community? Find its announcements and its groups in one place.

Karats
Karats are Murmur’s currency. You buy them in the app and use them to send gifts to creators, sponsor an écho, feature your listing in the business directory and pay for interpreter minutes during calls.

Also
• Alert and SOS: in one gesture, warn your loved ones or the Murmur phones around you, with your location. Murmur does not replace emergency services.
• Lock the app or a single conversation, and protect your conversations from screenshots.
• Up to 4 devices linked to your account, encrypted backup of your conversations.
• On-device message translation between French and English (iOS 18 or later).
• App available in English, French, Swahili, Portuguese, Spanish, Lingala, Kikongo and Tshiluba.
• Report content or block someone in one gesture, from the écho, the comment or the profile.

No phone number or email address needed: a first name, a @username and a password are all it takes to start. Murmur is for people aged 16 and over.

name: negatter（ネガッター）
description:
negatter（ネガッター）は、言えない文句を吐き出す、文字だけのSNSです。ポジティブな投稿は禁止。
登録なし・匿名で、すぐに使えます。

■ 念仏と供養
ほかの人の愚痴をタップすると「念仏」を唱えられます。念仏がたまると、その投稿は「供養」されてタイムラインから消えていきます。

■ アプリならではの機能
・自分の投稿に念仏が唱えられたとき、供養されたとき、級が上がったときに、通知でお知らせします
・通知は種類ごとにオン・オフできます
・念仏を唱えると、手に振動が伝わります

■ 安心して使うために
・脅し・個人情報・宣伝などは、投稿の前に自動でチェックします
・すべての投稿から通報でき、運営が確認します
・相手をブロックすると、おたがいの投稿が表示されなくなります
・書かれた本人は、登録しなくても削除を依頼できます

name: Onigiri Smash
description:
Drag back, let go, SMASH!

Onigiri Smash is a physics game where cute rice balls take down wobbly towers of bento boxes, jelly, porcelain and more.

STICKY YANK
Hold while your onigiri flies and it turns sticky. It grabs the blocks it touches - let go and it yanks them right out of the tower. Pull out the right piece and watch the whole thing come down.

GROW YOUR SMASHING POWER
- 6 upgrades: Heavier Onigiri, More Onigiri, Coin Multiplier, Boom Onigiri, Sticky Rice and the Auto Launcher
- 7 onigiri friends, each with a trait: fast, bouncy, heavy, extra sticky, lucky and more
- 5 areas from the Wooden Yard to the Sky Castle
- 20 goals to chase, Rebirth with Rice Stars for a permanent coin boost

MADE FOR YOUR PHONE
- Plays offline - no account, no sign-in
- Your progress is saved on your device
- Feel every hit with vibration
- Play in portrait or landscape
- Short rounds you can play anywhere, plus a daily gift and coins your Auto Launcher earns while you are away

name: Oracle 60: AI Answer Ball
description:
Think of a question. Shake. Watch the answer float up from the deep.

Oracle 60 is a glossy oracle ball that feels real: shake your iPhone, hear the liquid, and see the answer rise through the glass. Or ask the AI oracle anything and get a short answer that fits your question.

SHAKE IT LIKE THE REAL THING
• Shake your iPhone or double-tap the ball
• The answer rises through dark liquid and drifts as you tilt the phone
• A soft shaking sound that stays quiet in silent mode

ASK THE AI ORACLE
• Ask by voice or type your question
• The AI answers by the meaning of your question, in a few words
• Plain facts get a straight answer; the future gets a mysterious one
• Your first 3 AI questions are free

THREE MOODS
• Classic: yes, no, maybe and everything in between
• Philosophical: calm, thoughtful one-liners
• AI: answers to your actual question

ENGLISH AND UKRAINIAN
The whole app speaks English and Ukrainian and picks your phone's language by itself.

PRIVATE AND SIMPLE
• No account, no ads, no tracking
• Classic and Philosophical work offline
• AI questions are sent to our server and the AI provider only to get the answer, and are not stored

PRICE
Oracle 60 is free to download. Classic and Philosophical modes are free. The AI oracle includes 3 free questions; after that, a one-time purchase of $0.99 unlocks it for good, with up to 50 AI questions a day.

Oracle 60 is for entertainment. Its answers are not medical, legal or financial advice.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://oracle60-api.andrey-st-light.workers.dev/privacy

name: PackTrail Packing Board
description:
Build a packing list that belongs to each trip.

Create a trip with dates and an optional destination. Add items with quantities, categories, bags and notes, then check them off as you pack. Show only items left to pack or filter by bag. Preview a text summary before sharing it.

Create your own reusable templates or save a trip as a template. Each new trip gets its own unpacked copy, so later edits and checked items stay independent. Archive trips and restore them when needed.

PackTrail organizes your own lists. It does not provide bookings, weather, location tracking or online travel recommendations.

Core records are stored locally, with no app account, ads or analytics SDK. The app includes a read-only online-destination configuration feature. On launch and return to the foreground, an enabled valid HTTPS destination may open automatically through the system. When unavailable, the app falls back to local features. About provides status, refresh and manual-open controls. External websites have their own data practices.

name: PDF Corner
description:
PDF Corner is a PDF editor for iPhone and iPad by IT CORNER LTD. Open, edit, sign, convert and protect your PDFs. Everything is processed on your device: no account, no sign-in and no uploads.

EDIT
- Replace existing text in many PDFs, or add new text in installed fonts
- Add notes, rectangles, ellipses and highlights
- Move, resize, rotate, replace or delete images
- Autosave with undo and redo

SIGN
- Draw your signature or freehand ink with your finger or Apple Pencil

ORGANISE
- Add, duplicate, reorder, rotate, extract and delete pages
- Merge PDFs, create blank PDFs and turn photos into a PDF
- Scan paper documents with the camera
- Work on up to six documents at once in tabs

CONVERT
- PDF to Word (DOCX), PNG, JPEG or plain text
- On-device text recognition (OCR) and searchable PDF export

PROTECT
- Password-protect PDFs with opening and permission passwords
- Add text watermarks such as CONFIDENTIAL

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
PDF Corner works fully offline. Your documents stay on your device and are never sent to our servers.

FREE AND PRO
PDF Corner is free to download and every editing tool is included. Free exports carry a small PDF Corner logo and link, and PDF to Word conversion is limited to 5 conversions. PDF Corner Pro, an optional yearly auto-renewable subscription, removes the branding and the Word conversion limit.

Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel it in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://itcorneronline.com/privacy
Support: support@itcorneronline.com

name: PhaseCaden
description:
Give repeated work a clear rhythm. Build routines with up to twelve named phases and adjust each duration. Run the saved sequence, see the current phase and remaining time, pause, resume and recover after relaunch. Timing advances from elapsed time, including background time. Finish saves the actual duration; review complete and partial runs in history and per-routine totals. Editing a routine preserves the active run snapshot. No background alarms or notifications.

Your records stay on this device. Sharing is initiated by you. No account, advertising or purchases are required.

name: PlanBeaver: 3D Furniture CAD
description:
PlanBeaver designs furniture in 3D and turns it into everything you need in the workshop: cut list, sheet layout, drilling plan and assembly steps. For people who build things themselves – shelves, cabinets, tables and boxes from wood, plus steel tube frames and parts for the 3D printer. Made for iPad, works on iPhone too – completely offline, no account, no ads.

FROM MODEL TO CUT LIST
• Cut list with edge banding, mitres and grain direction
• Sheet layout for every material in its usual sheet size
• Drilling plan per panel, assembly steps with pictures, weight, cost and shopping list
• Workshop mode: tick off parts as you cut, print labels to stick on
• Workshop sheet as PDF with views, dimensions and all lists

WIZARDS FOR WHAT PEOPLE REALLY BUILD
• Cabinets and shelves: shelves, dividers, doors with cup hinges, drawers, plinth, grooved back, dowels or screws for the whole carcass
• Tables: top, legs, aprons – with dowels or mortise and tenon
• Drawers that fit the opening and the slides
• Frames from tube or profile with mitres, a lower frame and foot plates
Every wizard shows a preview and can be rebuilt later with new sizes.

AS EASY AS BUILDING BLOCKS
• Add panels, battens, profiles and basic shapes, drag the handles, type in sizes
• Calculate right in the size field: "600-2*18", "3/4 in" or your own variables
• Holes cut whatever they touch – right away
• Draw on a face: hand hole, socket or sink cutout straight into the part
• Keep dimensions in the model – they follow when parts grow

CHECK BEFORE YOU CUT
• "Will the shelves sag?" – estimated deflection with a suggested thickness
• Motion test: open doors and drawers and see where they hit

SKETCH FIRST, BUILD LATER
• A notebook in every project: draw with a pen or finger, photo as background, notes and checklists
• Hold the pen still at the end of a line – it becomes a straight line, a rectangle or a circle
• Type dimensions: "width = 800" becomes a project variable
• "To 3D" turns the sketch into a part in the model

FOR METAL AND 3D PRINTING TOO
• Saw list with mitre angles and bar plan for metal profiles
• DXF cut outlines for laser, plasma and CNC – sheet metal unfolded with bend lines
• Threads, screw holes, nut traps, print check with overhangs, export as 3MF, STL and OBJ

HELP THAT ANSWERS
Built-in help with full-text search explains every feature in workshop language. Type "mitre" and find the answer – even with a typo.

YOUR DATA STAYS WITH YOU
PlanBeaver needs no internet access. There is no account, no tracking and no advertising. Projects stay on your device; share them as a file.

START FREE, UNLOCK ONCE
Planning, all wizards, the cut list and all checks are free – for up to 3 projects, with unlimited ideas in the notebook. Try Premium free for 14 days: exports, sheet layout and bar plan, workshop helpers (workshop mode, drilling plan, assembly steps, costs, shopping list) and unlimited projects. Then buy it once – no subscription.

Languages: German and English. Units: mm, cm, m and inches.
Privacy: https://planbeaver.app/privacy/#en

name: PM Master: PMP® Prep
description:
Tự học và luyện thi PMP® theo PMP Examination Content Outline áp dụng từ tháng 7/2026 — hoàn toàn offline, không cần tài khoản.

GIÁO TRÌNH 30 NGÀY BẰNG TIẾNG VIỆT
• Lý thuyết, giải thích chi tiết, ví dụ thực tế, case study dự án IT, bảng so sánh, mẹo thi và tóm tắt cho từng ngày.
• Bám sát 3 domain People 33% · Process 41% · Business Environment 26%, đủ 26 task và enabler của ECO 2026.
• Predictive, Agile và Hybrid được lồng ghép xuyên suốt; cập nhật AI, Sustainability, Ethics, Value Delivery.

TỪ VỰNG & EXAM KEYWORDS
• Từ điển Anh–Việt 550+ thuật ngữ quản lý dự án với IPA, phát âm, định nghĩa, ví dụ.
• 300+ Exam Keywords và trigger words (FIRST, NEXT, BEST, EXCEPT…) kèm gợi ý nhận diện và bẫy thường gặp.
• Flashcard lật/vuốt với Spaced Repetition (Again/Hard/Good/Easy) và 7 chế độ học từ vựng.

LUYỆN TẬP THEO TƯ DUY PMI
• 150+ tình huống dự án công nghệ, 350+ câu Daily/Weekly Quiz.
• Mỗi câu có bản dịch, giải thích từng phương án đúng/sai và lập luận theo tư duy PMI.
• Smart Practice thích ứng theo task yếu, luyện theo domain, theo Predictive/Agile/Hybrid, theo dạng câu hỏi mới.
• Bài tập EVM (CPI, SPI, EAC, ETC, VAC, TCPI) và Critical Path sinh tự động, lời giải từng bước.

THI THỬ 180 CÂU / 240 PHÚT
• 2 đề độc lập mô phỏng cấu trúc mới: case study, graphic-based, multiple response, matching, drag-and-drop, point-and-click, pull-down.
• Hai lần nghỉ 10 phút, khóa phần đã qua, đánh dấu câu, bảng điều hướng, gạch bỏ phương án.
• Phân tích kết quả theo domain, task, approach, dạng câu và kế hoạch ôn tập.

THEO DÕI TIẾN ĐỘ
• Dashboard, streak, thời gian học, Mistake Book, thống kê và Readiness Indicator (chỉ số nội bộ).
• Hướng dẫn điều kiện dự thi và hồ sơ PMP.

Ứng dụng độc lập, không liên kết hay được PMI chứng thực. PMI, PMP và PMBOK là nhãn hiệu đã đăng ký của Project Management Institute, Inc. Câu hỏi là nội dung tự biên soạn, không phải câu hỏi thi thật.

name: Presion MTB
description:
Presión MTB propone una presión de partida para la rueda delantera y la trasera, en psi y en bar.

Tiene en cuenta el peso de hoy, el de la bici, el ancho de cada cubierta, el ancho interno de la llanta, si ruedas con cámara, tubeless o inserto, la carcasa, la modalidad y el terreno. Si lo pides, lee la temperatura del lugar y te dice qué marcar en la bomba de casa para llegar a esa presión en el sendero.

Puedes guardar tus bicis, tu perfil (peso, estatura y edad) y el historial de cada salida: lugar, temperatura y la presión que terminaste usando.

Los datos se quedan en el teléfono. Puedes exportarlos e importarlos. La cifra es un punto de partida: afínala de a medio psi y respeta el máximo de la cubierta y de la llanta.

name: Prime Solo Test
description:
Rediscover the timeless board puzzle that has captivated minds for generations! Peg Solitaire (also known as Solo Test or Marble Solitaire) returns in a handcrafted, modern and beautifully responsive edition designed specifically for iOS.

Your objective is simple yet profoundly challenging: jump pegs over adjacent ones to capture them, clearing the board until only one peg remains—ideally right at the center!

KEY FEATURES:

• INTELLIGENT SOLVER & SMART HINTS
Never get permanently stuck. Our built-in solver algorithm analyzes your board state in real-time to suggest optimal moves. Tap the hint again to execute it automatically.

• UNLIMITED UNDO
Experiment with bold strategies without fear. Step back as many moves as you want to discover winning branching paths.

• LUXURIOUS VISUAL THEMES
Choose from Blue, Green and Red color palettes, featuring a clean ivory stone board surface and luminous crystal glass marble pegs.

• TACTILE HAPTIC FEEDBACK
Feel every strategic jump and click with fine-tuned iOS Taptic Engine feedback that makes the board feel genuinely physical.

• RANKING SYSTEM
Measure your strategic genius by how many pegs remain when no moves are left:
- 1 Peg: Scholar (Pinnacle of Mastery!)
- 2 Pegs: Brilliant
- 3 Pegs: Astute
- 4 Pegs: Accomplished
- 5 Pegs: Balanced
- 6 Pegs: Novice
- 7 Pegs: Apprentice
- 8 Pegs: Curious Explorer
- 9+ Pegs: Rising Beginner

• IN-DEPTH PLAYER STATS & TIMER
Track total games played, your best peg score, single-peg master victories and fastest clear times.

• 100% OFFLINE
No internet required. Zero data collection.

Sharpen your focus, plan your leaps and see if you can achieve the flawless single-peg victory. Download now and earn the title of Scholar!

name: ProofCrate
description:
Turn recurring checks into a reliable routine. Create a named procedure with one step per line, then start a run that keeps its own snapshot. Check steps as you go, add notes and finish only when every step is checked. Editing or deleting a procedure leaves existing runs intact. Browse active runs and completed reports, search procedures and export records as JSON.

No account, ads or purchases. Your records stay on this device. Export a backup before removing the app.

name: QuestionSparkVault
description:
Some issues deserve to be taken seriously, not just flashed through one's mind. QuestionParkVault is a quiet place to collect questions that have not been figured out yet, observations that are temporarily incomprehensible, and topics that you have been wanting to talk to but haven't spoken yet.
Write it down in one sentence, add some background information, and then put it down. When a new idea arises, add another thought and mark its weight in your mind. Over time, the application will gradually take on a curious shape: which themes repeatedly appear, how often you actually sit down and think about them, and how deep these thoughts have gone.
There is no information flow to brush here, nor is there any progress to track. It's just a notebook for thinking, waiting for your next question.

name: QuoteSprig
description:
Build considered estimates for freelance projects. Enter hours, hourly rate, expenses, contingency and your own tax percentage. Review the subtotal, tax amount and total calculated with decimal arithmetic. Subtotal and tax are rounded separately to two decimal places. Choose USD, EUR, GBP, BRL, JPY or KRW; currency totals remain separate and are never converted. Track draft, sent and accepted estimates, search by project or client and export your records as JSON. Status changes are manual; nothing is sent to clients. This is an estimating tool, not an invoice, accounting system or tax advice.

No account, ads or purchases. Records stay on this device. Export before deleting the app.

name: Rally: Live Ping Pong Scorer
description:
Live scoring for your next ping pong game.

Rally watches the table through your iPhone camera and keeps the score as you play. Prop up the phone, let Rally find the table, choose who serves first, and start your game.

Play to 11 or 21 and choose how often the service changes. Follow the score, whose serve it is and the ball's trace. Show or hide the scoreboard and the ball trace to suit your setup.

You stay in control. Rally scores every point as it happens. If there is ever a discrepancy, enable voice mode and say "net," "redo," "switch server" or "switch point," or tap Fix score to correct the score with buttons.

Everything runs on your iPhone. Rally has no account, no ads and no tracking, and it does not record or upload video or audio. Works best on iPhone 13 or newer. Keep the phone steady with a clear view of the table and follow the setup guide. Rally calls a winner at a two-point lead and keeps counting until you start a new game.

name: Ralph's Quiz: Daily Trivia
description:
Ten questions. Every day. Bragging rights.

Ralph's Quiz is a daily pub quiz for you and your friends. A fresh quiz unlocks at midnight UK time, and everyone in the world gets the same ten questions. Play it once, see how you did, then see how you compare.

YOUR QUIZMASTER ASKS THE QUESTIONS
Meet Ralph's quizmaster. He asks every question out loud, just like the pub, and you tap your answer. There's no countdown and no rush. Speed never changes your score.

NO SPOILERS UNTIL THE END
You don't find out what you got right until all ten are done. Then your score and every answer arrive together, each with a short explanation, so you always learn something new.

LEAGUES WITH YOUR FRIENDS
Start a private league in seconds and invite friends, family or the office with a six-letter code or a link. See who came first today, this week and of all time. Equal scores share a place, so nobody loses on a technicality.

QUESTIONS WORTH ARGUING ABOUT
Thousands of hand-checked questions across general knowledge, history, geography, science and nature, film and TV, music, sport, food and drink, literature and art, politics and world affairs, and technology and pop culture. Some days are gentle, some are tough, and no two days feel the same.

KEEP YOUR STREAK GOING
Play every day to build your streak. Set a daily reminder for the time that suits you, and share your result with a tap.

FAIR AND PRIVATE
• Free to play, with no ads
• No tracking and no analytics
• Sign in with Apple, so we never see your password or email
• Delete your account and everything in it from the app at any time

Grab your mates, start a league and find out who really knows their stuff.

name: RatioBench
description:
Scale your own formulas without rewriting every ingredient.

Create a named formula with two or more ingredients, choose grams, milliliters or parts, then calculate a target total or a multiplier. Review original and scaled amounts, choose display precision, save a calculation snapshot and share a clear ingredient list.

Saved formulas support search, editing and duplication. History retains the original formula used for each saved calculation.

One unit is used throughout a formula. RatioBench does not convert mass to volume and is intended for general calculations, not medical or safety-critical use.

Core records are stored locally, with no app account, ads or analytics SDK. The app includes a read-only online-destination configuration feature. On launch and return to the foreground, an enabled valid HTTPS destination may open automatically through the system. When unavailable, the app falls back to local features. About provides status, refresh and manual-open controls. External websites have their own data practices.

name: Recon
description:
Recon 은 인텍플러스 임직원을 위한 회의 녹음·회의록 앱입니다. 회사 Microsoft 계정으로 로그인해 사용합니다.

■ 끊기지 않는 녹음
· 화면을 끄거나 잠가도, 다른 앱으로 옮겨도 녹음이 계속됩니다.
· 통화나 다른 앱이 마이크를 가져가면 그 구간을 멈춤으로 남기고, 끝나면 자동으로 이어 녹음합니다.
· 녹음은 약 2분 단위 조각으로 휴대폰에 먼저 저장됩니다. 망이 끊겨도 조각을 보관했다가 연결되면 다시 보냅니다.

■ 받아쓰기와 회의록 초안
· 올라간 녹음은 글로 받아써지고, 화자별로 나뉘어 표시됩니다.
· 받아쓴 글을 바탕으로 요약·결정 사항·실행 항목을 담은 회의록 초안이 만들어집니다.
· 초안은 앱에서 고친 뒤 본인 Confluence 공간에 게시합니다.

■ 진행 알림
· 업로드, 처리 단계, 초안 준비를 회의 하나에 알림 하나로 알려 드립니다.

■ 이용 안내
· 회사가 발급한 계정으로만 로그인할 수 있으며, 앱에서 계정을 만들 수 없습니다.
· 녹음 전 참석자에게 녹음 사실을 알리십시오. 사외 회의는 상대방의 동의를 받아야 합니다.

name: Resvori
description:
Resvori bringt dich zu deinem nächsten Lieblingsort – vom schnellen Imbiss bis zum Restaurant für die große Feier.

ENTDECKEN
• Restaurants, Imbisse, Cafés und Bars in deiner Nähe finden
• Nach Küche, Datum und Personenzahl filtern
• Neueröffnungen entdecken
• Nur verifizierte Lokale und echte Bewertungen von Gästen

TISCH RESERVIEREN
• In wenigen Sekunden reservieren – kostenlos
• Bestätigung per Mitteilung und E-Mail
• Alle Buchungen an einem Ort, einfach ändern oder stornieren

FEIER PLANEN
• Geburtstag, Hochzeit oder Firmenfeier anfragen
• Persönliche Angebote direkt vom Lokal erhalten und vergleichen
• Mit dem Lokal chatten, Anzahlung sicher online bezahlen

Resvori ist für Gäste kostenlos. Dein Vertragspartner ist immer das Lokal selbst.

Anmeldung mit E-Mail, Google oder „Mit Apple anmelden“. Dein Konto kannst du jederzeit im Konto-Bereich löschen.

Du hast ein Lokal? Lade die App „Resvori Partner“.

Fragen oder Feedback? Schreib uns an info@resvori.com.

name: ReturnPocket
description:
Keep return windows and your own follow-up records in one place.

Add an item, merchant and the return deadline supplied by that merchant. See overdue items, items due soon and later deadlines. Record Requested, Sent back or Completed, add a dated note, and correct statuses while keeping history.

Search by item or merchant, filter by status and archive finished records. Restore an item when you need to follow up again. Optional amounts remain separate in their original currencies.

ReturnPocket is a manual organizer. It does not check store policies or shipping, send background deadline notifications, contact merchants or request refunds.

Core records are stored locally, with no app account, ads or analytics SDK. The app includes a read-only online-destination configuration feature. On launch and return to the foreground, an enabled valid HTTPS destination may open automatically through the system. When unavailable, the app falls back to local features. About provides status, refresh and manual-open controls. External websites have their own data practices.

name: RevolucionaTR
description:
RevolucionaTR es la app de los clientes de Roger Sans y su equipo de Revoluciona tu Rendimiento. Tu entrenador prepara tu plan y tú lo sigues desde el móvil: qué entrenar hoy, qué comer, tus hábitos y tus revisiones, todo en un mismo sitio.

Para usar RevolucionaTR necesitas ser cliente de Revoluciona tu Rendimiento: tu entrenador te envía la invitación.

TU DÍA, DE UN VISTAZO
• Ve lo que te toca hoy: entreno, comidas, hábitos y revisiones pendientes.
• Recordatorios para que no se te pase nada.

ENTRENA CON TU PLAN
• Tus entrenos con vídeos de cada ejercicio, series, repeticiones, pesos y descansos.
• Registra lo que haces y mira cómo progresas semana a semana.
• Tu entrenador ve tus resultados y ajusta el plan.

NUTRICIÓN SIN COMPLICACIONES
• Tu plan de comidas y tus objetivos de calorías y macros.
• Recetas con foto, ingredientes y pasos.
• Registra lo que comes en segundos, también fotografiando la etiqueta del producto.

HÁBITOS Y REVISIONES
• Marca tus hábitos diarios y mantén la racha.
• Responde las revisiones de tu entrenador: peso, medidas, fotos de progreso, sensaciones y más.

TU PROGRESO, CLARO
• Peso, medidas y fotos de progreso con gráficas fáciles de leer.
• Conecta Apple Salud para sumar pasos, actividad, sueño y frecuencia cardiaca.

SIEMPRE EN CONTACTO
• Chatea con tu entrenador y su equipo, con fotos, notas de voz, notas de vídeo y archivos.
• Únete a la comunidad y a los retos de Revoluciona tu Rendimiento.
• También en tu Apple Watch: mensajes, series y descansos sin sacar el móvil.

TUS DATOS, BAJO TU CONTROL
Tus datos de salud solo los ves tú y tu equipo de entrenadores, y nunca se usan para publicidad. Puedes descargarlos o borrar tu cuenta cuando quieras desde la app.

name: Roostwing
description:
Climb onto your dragon and take to the skies!

Roostwing is a 3D flying shooter. Steer with one finger, lock onto foes and breathe fire to clear four floating skies, each guarded by a giant boss.

EASY TO FLY
- Drag anywhere on the screen to steer. Let go and your dragon flies straight
- Aim at a foe: it locks on and your dragon breathes fire by itself
- Hold BOOST to speed up. Follow the golden rings to find your first foes

FOUR SKIES, FOUR BOSSES
- Meadow Isles - STORMBACK
- Ember Reach - PYREWORM, a giant sky serpent
- Frost Spires - GLACIER WARDEN and its ice shield
- Thunder Crown - TEMPEST KING
Defeat enough sky foes to wake the gate guardian, beat it and fly through the gate.

GROW YOUR DRAGON
- Level up during a flight and pick one of three cards
- Spend gems in the Roost on Wing Strength, Flame Heart, Ironscale and Deep Lungs
- Unlock new breaths: Fan Breath and Spark Lance
- Four dragons to fly: Verdant, Ember Wyrm, Frost Drake and Storm Wyvern, each with its own strength
- Earn up to three stars in every sky: clear it, take no knockouts and beat the par time

MADE FOR YOUR PHONE AND TABLET
- No ads
- Plays offline - no account, no sign-in
- Your progress is saved on your device
- Feel the hits through vibration
- Play in portrait or landscape on iPhone and iPad

name: SHKLearn – Heizung & Sanitär
description:
SHKLearn erklärt Sanitär-, Heizungs- und Klimatechnik so, dass sie hängen bleibt: mit Anlagenschemata zum Durchspielen, Rechnern für die Praxis und einem Quiz, das sich merkt, was du noch üben musst. Für Anlagenmechaniker SHK in der Ausbildung, Fachkräfte und Quereinsteiger der Haustechnik.

LEKTIONEN VON TRINKWASSER BIS WÄRMEPUMPE
148 Lektionen in 17 Themen: Grundlagen & Physik, Werkstoffe & Rohrverbindungen, Trinkwasserinstallation, Trinkwasserhygiene, Abwasser, Sanitär & Bad, Heizungstechnik, Hydraulik & Pumpen, Wärmeerzeuger, Abgas, Gasinstallation, Solarthermie, Lüftung & Klima, Regelungstechnik, Elektrotechnik für SHK, Arbeitssicherheit und Kundendienst. Jede Lektion mit Beispielen, Merksatz und Kernpunkten.

ANLAGEN ZUM DURCHSPIELEN
• 24 interaktive Anlagenschemata: Heizkreis, Beimischschaltung, hydraulische Weiche, Wärmepumpe mit Puffer, Kältekreis, Brennwertgerät, Solaranlage, Zirkulation, Systemtrenner, Rückstau mit Hebeanlage, Gasinstallation, Wohnraumlüftung und mehr
• Strömung und Temperaturen sichtbar, Pumpen, Ventile und Mischer bedienbar, geführter Rundgang und Aufgaben
• 12 Simulationen mit Schiebereglern: Heizkurve, Pumpenkennlinie, hydraulischer Abgleich, COP, Ausdehnungsgefäß, Taupunkt, Legionellen-Temperaturzonen
• 45 Fehlersuchen: Kundenmeldung lesen, Messwerte prüfen, Ursache finden

QUIZ, DAS MITDENKT
• 469 Fragen mit Erklärung und Denkanstoß
• Falsch beantwortete Fragen kommen nach 1, 3 und 7 Tagen wieder
• Schwächen-Training, Prüfungssimulation, Karteikarten und Frage des Tages

RECHNEN & NACHSCHLAGEN
• Über 45 Rechner: Rohrdimension, Druckverlust, Spitzenvolumenstrom, Heizlast, Heizkörperleistung, Ausdehnungsgefäß, Pumpe, Abgasverlust, Taupunkt, Schmutzwasserabfluss, Gefälle und mehr
• Formelsammlung mit Formeln zum Umstellen, Rechenaufgaben mit Lösungsweg
• 29 Tabellen: Rohrmaße, Stoffwerte, Flüssigkeitskategorien, Anschlusswerte, Symbole, Abkürzungen, Regelwerke im Überblick

3D-MODELLE
28 Bauteile zum Drehen und Zerlegen – vom Thermostatventil über Umwälzpumpe und Ausdehnungsgefäß bis zur Brennwerttherme.

SICHERHEIT IMMER FREI
Verhalten bei Gasgeruch, Kohlenmonoxid, Heißarbeiten, Trinkwasserhygiene, Kältemittel, Asbest und Erste Hilfe sind immer kostenlos.

KOSTENLOS STARTEN – ALLES MIT PRO
SHKLearn ist kostenlos. Aus jedem Bereich kannst du einen Teil ausprobieren. Mit SHKLearn Pro schaltest du alle Inhalte frei – als einmaliger Kauf, kein Abo.

Ohne Werbung, ohne Anmeldung, funktioniert offline. Für iPhone und iPad.

Hinweis: Angaben ohne Gewähr. Maßgeblich sind die gültigen Normen, Vorschriften und Herstellerangaben; die App ersetzt keine Fachausbildung.

name: SHOWPAD
description:
# SHOWPAD – Your Audio. Your Control.

SHOWPAD is jouw centrale bediening voor audio tijdens shows, presentaties en live-evenementen.

Met SHOWPAD beheer en speel je jouw audiobestanden overzichtelijk af. Organiseer je audio in mappen en gebruik de afzonderlijke muziekblokken om snel toegang te krijgen tot je tracks.

### BELANGRIJKSTE FUNCTIES

• **Audio organiseren** – Beheer je audiobestanden in overzichtelijke mappen.

• **Direct afspelen** – Start je gewenste audiocue vanuit het hoofdscherm.

• **Flexibele bediening** – Gebruik de afspeelknoppen voor volledige controle.

• **Volume regelen** – Pas het hoofdvolume eenvoudig aan.

• **Fade-out** – Stel zelf de gewenste fade-outduur in.

• **Cue-instellingen** – Bepaal wat er gebeurt wanneer je een audioblok één of twee keer indrukt.

• **Overzichtelijke interface** – Alle belangrijke audiobedieningen binnen handbereik.

• **Playlist Rider** – Een instelbare functie voor je audio-afspeelworkflow.

### ONTWORPEN VOOR LIVE GEBRUIK

Of je nu een presentatie verzorgt, een evenement organiseert of muziek tijdens een show bedient: SHOWPAD brengt jouw audiocues samen op één overzichtelijke plek.

**SHOWPAD – Jouw audio. Jouw controle.**

name: SiamNub15 Online
description:
เรียงตัวเลข 1-15 แบบ Real-time 1v1
ทั้งสองฝั่งจะได้รับกระดานเริ่มต้นชุดเดียวกัน 100% ที่การันตีว่าแก้ได้จริง ใครเรียง 1-15 เสร็จก่อนเป็นผู้ชนะทันที!

name: Slicemark
description:
See how fast the supply of each major coin is growing, and what new coins mean for your share.

• Yearly supply growth for the largest coins, grouped from flat to fast
• New supply as it arrives, valued at today's prices
• Coin pages with supply charts and a five-year look ahead
• Up to four coins compared side by side
• Your holdings as a slice of each supply, kept on your device

Market data is shown for reference only and does not constitute investment, financial or trading advice.

name: SparkMark
description:
SparkMark helps you catch creative sparks before they disappear. Add a short title, optional note, tags, and a source remark, then keep each idea moving through Inbox, Developing, Parked, and Done on this device.

The Inbox tab shows fresh captures waiting for a next step. Board groups sparks by stage so you can promote, park, or finish an idea with one tap and optionally log a short progress note. Tags lets you browse by label and jump back into any spark. Open a spark for edits, stage changes, progress history, or delete. About explains how to use the app, in-app Privacy & Support, support email, and erase all local data after two confirmations.

What you can do:
• Inbox — capture new sparks and clear the ones ready to stage
• Board — review Developing, Parked, and Done, with quick stage moves
• Spark detail — edit fields, add progress notes, change stage, or delete
• Tags — manage labels and filter sparks
• About — how to use, in-app Privacy & Support, erase local library (two-step confirm)

Core features work offline on this device. No account, ads, subscriptions, or in-app purchases. Your spark library stays on the device.

Built for people who get ideas at odd hours and want a simple local board instead of scattered notes.

name: Subota: Captions & Prompter
description:
Subota does three things you'd normally need three different apps for: it creates subtitles for your video, edits the video itself, and works as a teleprompter while you film.

■ SUBTITLES THAT WRITE THEMSELVES — OFFLINE

Speech recognition runs entirely on your iPhone. No sign-up, no paying per minute, no waiting for a server — and no internet at all. Your video never leaves your phone.

Ukrainian, English, Polish, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese and Russian, plus automatic language detection. You can also get subtitles straight in English — the translation runs offline too.

Every word is timed by the audio, so karaoke highlighting matches the speech. Hint names and terms with a dictionary; words the model isn't sure about are underlined, so you know what to check.

Copy the finished text or save it as an .srt subtitle file.

The recognition model (about 181 MB) downloads once. After that, it's offline for good.

■ STYLE THAT ACTUALLY STANDS OUT

17 ready-made styles in one tap — each card shows your own word: karaoke, TikTok, single word, neon, poster, newspaper, chalk and more.

55 fonts, 38 of them with Cyrillic: Montserrat, Oswald, Russo One, Caveat, Playfair Display, Lobster, Marck Script and more. Keep your favourites with a heart.

23 animations, including six that follow the speech word by word: karaoke, word-by-word, single word on screen, highlight box, word bounce, progress underline.

Colour, outline, background box, size, tilt, spacing, position — all adjustable, and your own style saves in one tap.

Text BEHIND the person: the silhouette of whoever is in the frame covers the caption, as if the text stood behind them. Background behind the person: dim it, replace it with a colour or your own picture. All computed on the phone.

A safe-zone frame shows where captions won't hide under the TikTok, Reels or Shorts buttons.

■ VIDEO EDITOR

A timeline like in pro editors: scroll under the white line, split, trim, reorder clips, add more videos. Transitions between clips: fade through black, flash, zoom.

11 ready-made looks — Cinema, Warm sun, Vintage, Drama, B&W and more — plus manual colour and light sliders. Save your own look.

Speed, rotation, frame for any social network. Horizontal video becomes vertical: whole on a blurred background, or cropped — pick the part of the frame with a box.

Handles HDR video from the iPhone camera correctly.

■ TELEPROMPTER

Film with your script next to the lens: your eyes go to the camera, not down. A 3-2-1 countdown, the text scrolls with the recording, and the video opens straight in subtitles. Speed, size and opacity your way.

■ SUBOTA PRO SUBSCRIPTION

The first 14 days are free. Without Pro everything works: recognition, styles, editor, teleprompter, .srt. Pro removes the "Subota" watermark from videos and lifts the limit of two saved teleprompter scripts.

■ GOOD TO KNOW

• Works offline — internet is needed once, to download the recognition model.
• No sign-up, no accounts.
• No ads.
• No data collection: video, audio and subtitles stay on your phone.
• Finished videos are saved to Photos.

■ SUBSCRIPTION, TERMS & PRIVACY

Subota Pro is a monthly auto-renewable subscription. Cancel anytime in your Apple ID settings → Subscriptions.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://subota.pages.dev

name: TempoDock
description:
Plan a week that fits your capacity. Add tasks with time estimates, priorities and a weekday. Compare each day’s planned work with your chosen daily capacity, spot overloaded days and move tasks where they fit. Complete tasks to free planned capacity, filter the work queue and review completed minutes. Your plan is reusable: change days and reopen tasks when needed. Export records as JSON.

No account, ads or purchases. Your records stay on this device. Export a backup before removing the app.

name: Threadmarks
description:
'- Save from the share menu. Choose Threadmark from the iPhone share menu, or paste a post link directly into the app.
- Organize your way. File posts in folders, add multiple tags, and edit the title and text of any saved card.
- Find what you saved. Search by title, text, author, or tag, or browse your folders and tags.
- Revisit a save. Switch between Preview and Compact views, open a card to read the full saved text, or go back to the original post on Threads.

name: TodooCam！土豆电子拍立得！
description:
TodooCam 把手机变成一台电子拍立得。用复古取景器拍下日常，感受快门反馈，等相纸缓缓吐出，再把喜欢的照片送到手边。

【拍下眼前】
在手机上取景拍摄。拟物相机界面、快门反馈和吐片动画，让照片在按下快门后慢慢揭晓。

【连接土豆片】
通过蓝牙配对土豆片（Todoo Card），把照片传到卡片上显影。拍摄可以独立使用，传图需要搭配土豆片硬件。

【一张电子相纸，反复显影】
土豆片的六色电子纸可以反复更新照片。显影后无需保持手机连接，最后一张照片会留在卡片上。

【换一种方式记录日常】
切换相机模式，拍下眼前的画面，或从相册里重温旧时光。

name: Tráp Vàng: Sổ Tích Chỉ
description:
Tráp Vàng là cuốn sổ tích lũy vàng dành cho gia đình Việt. Ghi lại từng chỉ vàng đã mua, theo dõi tài sản và biết chính xác lãi hay lỗ nếu bán lại theo giá thu mua hôm nay.

Không chỉ là nơi lưu giữ những món vàng, Tráp Vàng còn giúp bạn xây dựng thói quen tích lũy, quản lý mục tiêu gia đình và gìn giữ thành quả qua từng năm.

QUẢN LÝ GIA SẢN VÀNG

- Theo dõi tổng số chỉ, vốn gốc, giá trị tài sản và phần trăm lãi lỗ thực tế.
- Lưu từng món vàng với loại vàng, tiệm mua, ngày mua, đơn giá và ghi chú.
- Xem biểu đồ Dòng Chảy Gia Sản theo số lượng vàng tích lũy và giá vốn.
- Gộp 10 chỉ vàng lẻ thành một cây vàng, giữ nguyên lịch sử các món vàng.
- Ghi nhận giao dịch bán và theo dõi tổng lợi nhuận đã chốt.

HÒA VỐN VÀ LÃI LỖ THỰC TẾ

- So sánh giá thu mua và giá bán ra giữa các tiệm vàng.
- Tính điểm hòa vốn dựa trên giá vốn và chênh lệch mua bán.
- Biết số tiền thực nhận nếu bán vàng theo giá thu mua tham chiếu.
- Mô phỏng lợi nhuận với các mức giá vàng giả định.

HŨ LỘC VÀ MỤC TIÊU TÍCH LŨY

- Tạo nhiều hũ mục tiêu cho gia đình.
- Đặt mục tiêu theo số chỉ vàng mong muốn.
- Theo dõi tiến độ tích lũy bằng thanh tiến trình.
- Thêm vàng nhanh trực tiếp vào từng hũ.

QUÉT HÓA ĐƠN TIỆM VÀNG

- Chụp hoặc chọn ảnh hóa đơn có sẵn.
- Tự nhận dạng thông tin như tiệm vàng, loại vàng, trọng lượng và đơn giá.
- Xử lý nhận dạng chữ ngay trên thiết bị.
- Không gửi ảnh hóa đơn lên máy chủ.

VĂN HÓA TÍCH LỘC

- Đếm ngược ngày Vía Thần Tài.
- Lắc Xăm tài lộc mang tính giải trí.
- Đèn Lồng Tích Lộc ghi nhận những tháng có mua vàng.
- Nhắc nhở tích lũy định kỳ theo ngày bạn lựa chọn.
- Tạo thiệp chứng nhận tặng vàng và chia sẻ thành quả tích sản gia đình.

RIÊNG TƯ LÀ ƯU TIÊN

- Không cần đăng ký tài khoản hoặc đăng nhập.
- Dữ liệu được lưu trực tiếp trên thiết bị.
- Không quảng cáo, không theo dõi người dùng.
- Không đồng bộ dữ liệu lên máy chủ hoặc iCloud.
- Khóa ứng dụng bằng Face ID hoặc mật mã.
- Ẩn số dư và tự làm mờ khi úp điện thoại xuống bàn.

TRẢI NGHIỆM TÍCH LŨY ĐẶC BIỆT

- Giao diện Tráp Sơn Mài và Giấy Dó mang nét văn hóa Việt.
- Ba chất liệu tráp có thể thay đổi miễn phí.
- Widget màn hình chính và màn hình khóa.
- Live Activity và Dynamic Island theo dõi giá vàng và lãi thực nếu bán ngay.
- Danh hiệu gia chủ và linh vật mở khóa theo số vàng tích lũy.

TÍCH CHỈ BỀN BỈ - GIỮ TRỌN TINH HOA GIA SẢN VIỆT QUA TỪNG THẾ HỆ.

Tráp Vàng miễn phí sử dụng. Không mua bán vàng, không giữ vàng hộ và không liên kết với ngân hàng hay tiệm vàng.

Giá vàng được tham khảo từ bảng niêm yết công khai của Bảo Tín Minh Châu và PNJ. Tráp Vàng không liên kết với các tiệm vàng này.

Giá vàng chỉ mang tính tham khảo, có thể thay đổi theo thời điểm và địa điểm giao dịch.

name: Triamu
description:
今日の写真を選ぶと、めくって読める写真日記ができあがります。散歩で見つけた風景や何気ない一日を、撮った順に並べたり、自由に組み替えたり。写真とひと言で、その日を一冊に残せます。

■ 写真を選んで、ページを編む
その日に撮った写真から、Triamu がページを組みます。写真の並びや紙面の雰囲気を変え、ページごとに文章を添えられます。一冊4ページまで無料で作成でき、JPEG画像として保存・共有できます。

■ 歩いた道と、撮った場所をふりかえる
散歩を記録すると、時間や歩いた道をふりかえれます。iPhoneでは歩数も記録できます。撮った場所は自分だけの地図へ。日記に載せる絵地図は、歩いた道や目印を線と文字で描きます。散歩を記録せず、写真だけで日記を作ることもできます。

■ カレンダーから、その日をひらく
日記はカレンダーから探せます。「日々の日記」では表紙から一冊を選び、仕上がったページをめくって読み返せます。iPadでは、紙面と操作欄を横に並べて編集できます。

■ Triamu Pro（買い切り）
5〜20ページの日記を作り、1冊をページ順のままPDFにして共有できます。紙面の写真をレタッチ。露出や色温度を整え、粒子やハレーションを加えられます。9種類のプリセットは仕上がりを見比べて選べます。誌面の写真を切り替えながら調整をコピーし、自作プリセットも保存できます。「月のベタ焼き」などのふりかえり、ひと月分をまとめた冊子PDF、ご自身のiCloudを使ったiPhone・iPad間の同期も使えます。

name: TumbleDial: Wrist Physics Toy
seller_name: Shenzhen Quanjing Digital Intelligence Technology Co., Ltd.
description:
Raise your wrist to check the time, then tilt it: balls, coins and tiles roll with real gravity, bump into the case, pile up and scatter again.

TumbleDial is a little physics toy for Apple Watch. It reads the watch's motion sensors, so everything rolls whichever way you tilt. Photoreal 3D materials, lighting and shadows make the screen feel like a shallow tray full of tiny objects.

10 PHOTOREAL THEMES — TURN THE DIGITAL CROWN TO SWITCH
Tennis · Basketball · Soccer · Billiards · Glass marbles · Diamonds · Gold bars · Coins · Dice · Mahjong

HOW TO PLAY
• Tilt your wrist: things roll downhill
• Tap: flick nearby things away
• Shake: scramble everything
• Feel a gentle tap when they hit the case (optional)
• Long-press: brightness, Always On look, invert gravity, high quality

TIME AT A GLANCE
A big time and date sit on top. Lower your wrist and it pauses and dims to save battery. Add the complication to any watch face to open it with one tap.

GOOD TO KNOW
• watchOS doesn't allow third-party watch faces, so TumbleDial is an app and does not replace your watch face. To keep it on screen: Settings › General › Return to Clock › TumbleDial › After 1 hour.
• Apple Watch only (watchOS 11 or later); runs entirely on the watch.
• No internet, no account, no ads, no data collected.

name: Ugoku Metronome
description:
A metronome that draws the rhythm while it plays. The visuals run on the same clock as the sound, so each beat and subdivision appears on screen at the moment you hear it.

RHYTHM
