• Tempo from 20 to 300 BPM: step with + and –, type a value, or tap it in
• 1 to 16 beats per bar
• Subdivisions: quarters, 8ths, triplets, 16ths
• Accent per beat: strong, normal, soft or off. Click only on 2 and 4, or group 7 beats as 2+2+3
• Presets: 4/4, 3/4, 8ths, 16ths, triplets, shuffle, swung 16ths, 2 & 4, 3:2, 4:3, 5:4

GROOVE
• Swing from 50% to 75% on 8ths or 16ths, shown as a percentage and as the delay of the off-beat in ms
• Polyrhythm: split the same bar into a second number of pulses (up to 16) and play both layers together
• Push / pull: move each layer earlier or later by up to 150 ms
• Five sounds (Click, Beep, Block, Noise, Low) and a volume for each layer

PRACTICE
• Gap click: mute bars on a fixed pattern (play some bars, mute some bars) or at random, to check whether you hold the tempo without the click
• Tempo ramp: change the BPM by a set amount every few bars, up or down, and stop at a target tempo

FOUR VISUALS (swipe to switch)
• Rings: one bar per turn. Shows where two rhythms meet
• Roll: one beat, zoomed in. Read swing and offset in ms
• Flow: upcoming notes move toward a "now" line and sound when they reach it
• Count: the beat number, large enough to read from across a room
"Expand" hides the controls and fills the screen with the visual.

ON IPHONE AND IPAD
• Keeps playing with the screen locked or the app in the background. Start and stop from the Lock Screen or Control Center
• Plays even with the Silent switch on
• Keeps the screen awake while playing
• Works without a network connection
• No account and no ads
• Opens with the settings you used last
• Share your current setting as a link
• English and Japanese, switchable in the app

name: Voltdrop: Reflex Tap
description:
Tap exactly. Beat the clock. Evolve your phone.

Voltdrop is a fast reflex game that fits in a single thumb. Each task tells you how many times to tap: hit the number exactly, wait when it says wait, and finish before the timer drains. One tap too many and your phone cracks.

QUICK TO LEARN, HARD TO MASTER
• 30 tasks per run, and every task gets a little faster
• Math cues like 2+3 or 2×3: work out the answer, then tap it
• Memory tasks: remember the star number and tap it later
• Flash cues that disappear before you can count them
• TAP PHONE steps that switch the target mid-task
• A boss task waiting at number 30

EVOLVE YOUR PHONE
Every clean run charges your phone. A full charge upgrades it from an old brick to a newer model. Make a mistake and it cracks and drops back a model. Arm a Crack Shield to block your first mistake.

COME BACK EVERY DAY
• Daily bonus with a growing streak
• Daily run: one life, no shields, pure skill
• Unlimited retries, no energy bars, no waiting

SHARE YOUR BEST
Turn your score into a card and challenge your friends.

VOLTDROP VIP
A one-time purchase, no subscription:
• No pop-up ads
• Free continues
• Exclusive Gold Edition phone

Available in 11 languages. Easy to pick up, short runs, great for quick breaks.

name: Vuezio
description:
Vuezio puts your security cameras and digital signage in your pocket.

Vuezio runs on a Windows PC or Mac as the host: it records your cameras and drives your signage screens. This app is the viewer. Connect it to your Vuezio host and see what your cameras see, wherever you are on your network.

LIVE CAMERAS
Watch every camera connected to your Vuezio host, live, on iPhone or iPad. Tap a camera to see it full screen.

YOUR SCREENS
See what each of your signage screens is showing right now, the same layout your customers see.

RECORDING ALERTS
If a camera that should be recording stops, the viewer tells you. You never find out after the fact that footage is missing.

PAIRED AND ENCRYPTED
Pair this device once with a 6-digit code shown only inside your host's Settings, never on a public screen. After that, every connection is encrypted, and your host's key is never sent over Wi-Fi.

NO ACCOUNT, NO CLOUD
Vuezio talks directly to your own host. No sign-up, no cloud service in the middle, and your video stays on your own equipment.

FREE
The viewer is free. Plans for screens and cameras are purchased on the host.

Requires a Vuezio host running on Windows (Microsoft Store) or Mac (Mac App Store).

name: Windexs-Психолог
description: Windexs-Психолог — приложение для самонаблюдения и повседневных практик. Пройдите короткие опросники о сне, тревожности, самооценке и выгорании. Результаты сохраняются на устройстве. В приложении также есть подборки медитаций, поддерживающие фразы и ссылки на материалы о психологическом благополучии. Опросники предназначены для самонаблюдения и не ставят диагнозов.

name: WireCairn
description:
Plan cuts for wire, rods and other linear stock. Enter stock length, cut width and the required lengths in millimetres. WireCairn builds a first-fit decreasing cutting plan, shows each stock bar, remaining offcuts and total cut loss. Save, edit, search and delete projects, compare material yield and share a cutting list. The heuristic does not guarantee the smallest possible stock requirement. Check measurements and safe equipment use before cutting.

Your records stay on this device. Sharing is initiated by you. No account, advertising or purchases are required.

name: Английский в Иноклубе
description:
Иноклуб – логичный и последовательный самоучитель, который содержит понятные объяснения правил, озвученную лексику, автоматически проверяемые упражнения, тексты, аудио, видео, диалоги с ИИ и многое другое.
К разработке учебных материалов и упражнений Иноклуба мы привлекаем лучших методистов и преподавателей, которые имеют профессиональные знания и огромный опыт обучения иностранным языкам. 
Мы не ставим задачу сделать из вас ходячий словарь или грамматический справочник. В каждом уроке вы оказываетесь в разговорной ситуации: учитесь выражать свои мысли, используя наиболее употребительную лексику. 
Иноклуб создан для того, чтобы каждый день вы видели свой прогресс в изучении языка: после каждого урока список ваших разговорных навыков пополняется, а все письменные задания сохраняются в языковом портфолио. 

После регистрации в Иноклубе вам будут доступны все первые уроки тем всех уровней. Для получения доступа к остальным урокам вам необходимо приобрести курс или подписку.

Разработанные курсы:

Английский язык 
• Курс разговорного английского языка для начинающих с нуля (уровень Beginner A0)
• Курс разговорного английского языка для начинающих (уровень Elementary A1)
• Курс разговорного английского языка для продолжающих (уровень Pre-Intermediate A2)
• Курс разговорного английского языка для продвинутых (уровень Intermediate B1)
• Курс делового английского языка для работы (уровень Intermediate B1)
• Курс подготовки к ЕГЭ по английскому языку
• Развлекательный курс по английскому языку с рубриками Reading in English, English with Songs, вебинары, Wordsearch

Немецкий язык
• Курс разговорного немецкого языка для начинающих с нуля (уровень Grundstufe 1 A0)
• Курс разговорного немецкого языка для начинающих (уровень Grundstufe 1 A1)
• Курс разговорного немецкого языка для продолжающих (уровень Grundstufe 2 A2)

Французский язык
• Курс разговорного французского языка для начинающих с нуля (уровень Débutant A0)
• Курс разговорного французского языка для начинающих (уровень Débutant A1)

Испанский язык
• Курс разговорного испанского языка для начинающих (уровень Elemental A1)
• Курс разговорного испанского языка для продолжающих (уровень Pre-Intermedio A2)

Латинский язык:
• Курс латинского языка для начинающих с нуля

В каждый курс входит
- подборка активной лексики с озвучкой и упражнениями для запоминания, 
- объяснение грамматики с упражнениями для тренировки,
- тексты и видео для иллюстраций речевых ситуаций и упражнения для развития навыков чтения и восприятия на слух,
- творческие упражнения (монологи и диалоги), которые можно выполнить устно и письменно и отправить преподавателю за дополнительную плату.

Примерное время, необходимое для прохождения одного курса (уровня), составляет от 4 до 24 недель.
Подробное содержание каждого курса (какие темы входят, какая грамматика изучается, сколько уроков и упражнений) представлено на сайте.

Как проходит обучение
В каждом уроке вы изучаете небольшую порцию нового материала (слова, грамматику, правила чтения) с подробными и понятными объяснениями.
После объяснений вы развиваете лексические и грамматические навыки, а также умения говорения и аудирования с помощью автоматических упражнений.
После тренировки вы учитесь свободной речи - на основе материала урока готовите устное или письменное задание, которое проверяет преподаватель за дополнительную плату (по желанию).

name: אוצרא
description:
אוצרא היא הוצאת ספרים דיגיטלית. אנחנו מחפשים את הסיפורים שאף אחד לא הביא לעברית של היום, כותבים אותם מחדש בעברית של עכשיו, ונותנים לכל ספר כריכה שעושה חשק.

מתחילים מסרטון
כל ספר נפתח ברגע אחד ממנו. סרטון קצר, ו„להמשיך לקרוא” לוקח אתכם ישר למשפט הבא.

קוראים בנוח
עמוד נקי, אות גדולה, רקע של נייר, ספיה או לילה. הספר זוכר איפה עצרתם, בטלפון, בטאבלט ובמחשב.

ספרים שעושים בהם משהו
בספרי היצירה צובעים לפי מספרים, מציירים, כותבים ומחפשים — בתוך הספר עצמו, עם האצבע או העט. מה שעשיתם נשמר.

קוראים בנחת
מוזיקה שקטה מתחת לעמוד, הפסקה שאתם קוראים מוארת, והאגודל מזיז את הדף לאט. מרימים אותו, והדף עוצר.

גם בלי אינטרנט
מורידים ספר וקוראים בטיסה, בחוף או בחדר בלי קליטה.

חבורה
קוראים יחד עם חברים או המשפחה, ומשאירים הערות שרק החבורה רואה.

הפרק הראשון של כל ספר פתוח לכולם, בלי הרשמה. נכנסים עם המייל, בלי סיסמה.

name: 유럽하이
description:
한국어로 안내하는 유럽 현지 가이드를 만나는 곳, 유럽하이.

코스가 아니라 사람을 보고 고르세요. 가이드의 사진과 소개, 함께한 사람 수와 후기를 보고 나와 맞는 가이드와 투어를 고를 수 있어요. 도시와 가이드는 계속 늘어나고 있어요.

■ 지금 만날 수 있는 투어
· 스페인 바르셀로나: 사그라다 파밀리아·까사 바트요·구엘 공원을 걷는 가우디 투어, 고딕 지구·벙커 전망대 야경 투어
· 스페인 세비야: 도시·건축 투어, 야경과 타파스, 론다·그라나다 근교 여행
· 대부분 최대 11~15명의 소규모로 진행해요

■ 앱에서 할 수 있는 것
· 가이드 보고 고르기: 도시와 분류별로 투어를 보고, 가이드 소개와 후기를 확인해요
· 바로 예약·결제: 날짜와 인원을 고르고 카드로 결제해요. 입장권이 필요한 투어는 입장권까지 함께 결제할 수 있어요
· 내 여행 한눈에: 만나는 시간과 장소, 지도, 투어까지 남은 날을 확인해요
· 가이드와 메시지: 예약 전에는 상품 문의로, 예약 뒤에는 대화방에서 가이드와 이야기해요
· 알림: 예약이 확정되거나 문의에 답장이 오면 알려 드려요
· 커뮤니티: 맛집, 안전·소매치기, 교통·숙소, 워홀, 중고거래까지 유럽에 사는 사람과 여행하는 사람이 함께 나누는 정보. 같이 다닐 동행도 찾을 수 있어요

■ 알아 두세요
· 투어마다 판매자, 포함 사항, 취소·환불 규정이 표시돼요. 예약하기 전에 꼭 확인해 주세요.
· 문의: support@euha.app

name: 方寸
description:
方寸把該處理的事和想為自己做的事，放在同一個畫面的四個格子裡。

・限時雜事：有期限的事。右邊的點越深越急，到期當天早上會提醒你。
・每日功課：每天想持續投入的事，例如運動、學語言。
・有空研究：沒有期限，有空再查、再想。
・閒暇喜好：讓自己開心的事。

簡單的操作
・點中間按鈕朝向哪一格，就新增到哪一格。
・長按拖曳，可以排序或換到別的格子。
・按住中間按鈕拖動，調整四格的大小，版面會記住。
・往左滑刪除，刪錯了可以馬上復原。

桌面小工具
在主畫面放上方寸，一眼看到雜事和每日功課；點雜事旁的圓圈就能完成，不用打開 app。

隱私
不需要註冊帳號，不收集任何資料。資料只存在你的裝置和你自己的 iCloud。

name: 时序-语音日程提醒
description:
时序，一款专注简洁的日程 & 待办提醒工具。
【核心亮点】
·语音快速创建日程：自然说话自动识别时间、事项，一键生成任务
·强提醒能力：闹钟式通知、自定义提醒，不错过重要安排
·本地离线优先：所有数据保存在本机，不上传云端，隐私可控
·多视图管理：日视图、周视图、月视图，时间线清晰查看全部计划

name: Inferno Voyage Wars
description:
Build a three-person crew and decide how to spend each turn's three action points. A Strike costs one point, a crew skill costs two, and each member can act once per turn. Focus an enemy with a Striker, choose an ally for a Guardian's shield, or send healing where your crew needs it.

Daily login rewards provide recruitment tickets for twelve original seafarers. New recruits expand your roster; duplicate contracts become Gold. Save a formation and train crew members up to level five before choosing a preset rival crew on the ladder.

Wins award Gold and a star. Reaching three stars advances your rank, while defeat reduces stars within the current rank. Your collection, levels, balances and saved formation carry into the next challenge. On the seventh login day, the reward includes an unowned crew member while your collection is incomplete, or extra Gold once the roster is complete.

name: Task Assassin
description:
Task Assassin is a calm daily list with a few things regular to-do apps often skip.

VOICE NOTES
Open a task and record a voice note. On a shared task, the other person can play it, and the app also turns it into text so it is easy to skim.

SHARED CHORES
Sign in with your email (a 6-digit code, no password, and no Apple ID) only if you want to share. Assign a chore to someone in your People list, or invite them by email or text. The task shows up on their phone. Either of you can mark it done, change the day or the details, or add a voice note. They only see the tasks you share with them, not the rest of your list. You can use the whole app without signing in. Your own tasks stay on your device.

LOCK SCREEN ALERTS
Turn on the bell and Task Assassin sends a notification to your lock screen at the time you choose. Every alert has Snooze and Done buttons, and tapping one opens that task. Pick a sound for when the app is open, and pick a snooze time of 5, 10, 15, 30, or 60 minutes. The app icon badge shows what is due today and what is overdue.

DRIVE ESTIMATES
Type an address or a place name on a task, then open Apple Maps directions. The app can also show a drive estimate in minutes and miles from where you are.

THE LOG
Choose a day or a week and see what is done, what is still open, and the minutes, with a breakdown by subject. Built for someone who needs to show what they did.

YOUR DAY
Open the app and you see today: the date, how many tasks are done, and what is left. Type a task and tap Quick to put it on today, To-do to keep it with no day, or Calendar to pick a day. Paste a list and each line becomes its own task.

MAKE EACH TASK FIT
- Subjects: Home, Work, Self, and Shared are built in. Rename Other, or add up to 40 of your own, like Garden or a project. Filter the list by subject.
- Alert: none, in 30 minutes, or a clock time.
- Repeat every day, with an optional end date.
- Time to take, set in 15 minute steps.
- Details, and a note of how long a late task has been put off.

SEE THE REST OF YOUR WEEK
- Calendar: a month, week, day, and year view, plus search across every task.
- Quick: a jot list for things with no day yet. Give one a day later and it moves to your list.

ALREADY USING TASK ASSASSIN IN SAFARI?
Copy your tasks from the website version and use Import from Safari in the app. Tasks are merged without duplicates.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No ads and no tracking. Your own tasks are not uploaded unless you share them. To delete your account, open Settings and tap Delete my account. Read the privacy policy at vowful-mesa-5kht.here.now/privacy.

name: 日本拳法
description:
『日本拳法』は、日本拳法の魅力を楽しめる横スクロール型2D対戦格闘ゲームです。

突き、蹴り、投げ、寝技を駆使して相手と対戦。多彩な攻撃と防御を組み合わせ、勝利を目指しましょう。

【ゲームの特徴】

■ 迫力の2D格闘アクション
日本拳法ならではの突きや蹴り、組み技を取り入れた対戦を楽しめます。

■ 多彩な技
突き、蹴り、回し蹴り、投げ技、寝技など、さまざまな技を駆使して戦います。

■ CPU対戦
コンピューターを相手に、自分の戦い方を磨くことができます。

■ トーナメント戦
強敵との対戦を勝ち抜き、選手権の頂点を目指しましょう。

■ 多彩な試合会場
道場での試合に加え、金網に囲まれたリングでの迫力ある対戦も楽しめます。

日本拳法の技と駆け引きを、スマートフォンで体験してください！

name: Formação AI
description:
O app da Formação AI leva seus cursos para o celular. Entre com a sua conta de aluno e continue estudando de onde parou, no site ou no app: o progresso é o mesmo nos dois.

O QUE VOCÊ ENCONTRA NO APP

• Início: continue a última aula com um toque e veja quantos dias seguidos você estudou.
• Trilhas: navegue pelas trilhas de aprendizagem e veja o andamento de cada curso.
• Aulas em vídeo: assista às aulas em tela cheia, leia o conteúdo de apoio e baixe os anexos.
• Focos: siga os focos de estudo definidos pela sua turma.
• Perfil: seus dados de acesso e as organizações de que você faz parte.

PARA QUEM JÁ É ALUNO

O app é para quem já tem acesso aos cursos da Formação AI ou da Formação DEV. A conta é criada e o acesso é comprado no site. Ainda não é aluno? Conheça os cursos em www.formacao.dev.

Dúvidas? Escreva para suporte@cod3r.com.br.

name: ¡Fakeado! Fallas de València
description:
¡Fakeado! Fallas es el juego de preguntas y faroles sobre las Fallas de València, para jugar en el casal, en familia o con la comisión.

CÓMO SE JUEGA
Sale una pregunta fallera con una respuesta real: «La falla más alta de la historia medía ___ metros». Cada jugador escribe en su móvil una respuesta falsa que parezca verdad. Se mezclan todas con la verdadera y cada uno vota cuál es la real. Ganas puntos por acertar y por cada fallero que cae en tu mentira. ¡Fakeado!

TODO EL MUNDO FALLERO
• Historia, plantà, cremà, mascletà, Ofrenda, Crida y Nit del Foc.
• Indumentaria, pólvora, ninots, música, bunyols y parlem valencià.
• Todas las Falleras Mayores de Valencia desde 1931 y los primeros premios de Sección Especial desde 1942.
• Hemeroteca para consultar Falleras Mayores, Infantiles y palmarés.

EN CASTELLANO O EN VALENCIÀ
Elige el idioma en la pantalla de inicio: cambian los textos y las más de 600 preguntas.

LA MEUA FALLA
Mete los cargos de tu comisión y vuestras propias preguntas: saldrán en las partidas que crees desde tu móvil.

PARA PEQUES Y MAYORES
• Modo Peques: los niños eligen entre tres mentiras, sin escribir.
• Las preguntas se adaptan a la edad del jugador más pequeño.
• Música de dolçaina y tabalet, el Himne Regional y mascletà cuando alguien se come una mentira.
• Premio de casal al ganador: ¡una de bunyols para los mayores y un xupito de xocolata para los peques! (se puede desactivar)

VARIOS MÓVILES, UNA PARTIDA
Uno crea la sala y los demás entran con un código de 6 letras. También podéis usar una tablet como pantalla grande, o jugar pasando un solo móvil.

SIN ANUNCIOS NI REGISTRO
Solo un apodo. Partidas privadas con código.

La versión gratis trae una selección de preguntas. Con un único pago de 0,99 € desbloqueas todas, y quien se une a tu sala juega con ellas sin pagar.

name: ¡Fakeado! Juego en familia
description:
¡Fakeado! es el juego de preguntas donde no gana quien más sabe, sino quien mejor miente.

CÓMO SE JUEGA
Sale una pregunta con una respuesta real sorprendente: «El pulpo tiene ___ corazones». Cada jugador escribe en su móvil una respuesta falsa que parezca verdad. Después se mezclan todas con la verdadera y cada uno vota cuál cree que es la real. Ganas puntos por acertar y, sobre todo, por cada persona que cae en tu mentira. ¡Fakeado!

PENSADO PARA PADRES E HIJOS
• Un niño de 8 años puede ganar a sus padres: mentir bien cuenta más que saber.
• Modo Peques (6 a 8 años): eligen entre tres mentiras, sin tener que escribir.
• Las preguntas se adaptan a la edad del jugador más pequeño.
• Tras cada pregunta, un dato curioso: se aprende sin darse cuenta.

VARIOS MÓVILES, UNA SOLA PARTIDA
• Uno crea la sala y los demás se unen con un código de 6 letras.
• Usa una tablet o el ordenador como pantalla grande para que todos vean las respuestas.
• ¿Solo hay un móvil? Jugad pasándolo por turnos.

SEGURO PARA LA FAMILIA
• Sin anuncios, sin chat y sin registro: solo un apodo.
• Las partidas son privadas, solo entra quien tiene el código.
• Filtro de palabrotas en las respuestas.

CONTENIDO
Cientos de preguntas verificadas sobre animales, cuerpo humano, espacio, historia, inventos, comida, deportes, geografía, ciencia, palabras, España y cosas que parecen mentira pero son verdad.

La versión gratis incluye una selección de preguntas. Con un único pago de 0,99 € desbloqueas todas, y quienes se unan a tus partidas juegan con ellas sin pagar nada. Sin suscripciones.

name: 100 Days: Goal Grid
description:
Set the Goal. Track the Habits. Own the Outcome.

100 Days gives every goal its own 100 days. It's a calm habit tracker and journal built around one idea: a 10 × 10 grid for each goal. Tick today's habits and a square fills in. Miss one and it's outlined, never red. Day 100 is always in view.

START ANY DAY
Add a goal whenever you're ready. It starts at day 1 and gets a full 100. With Plus, run several at once, even when the others are already halfway there.

TEN SECONDS A DAY
Today puts every running goal's habits on one list. Tap to tick. Plan a rest day ahead and your streak stays intact. A daily reminder nudges you if you want one.

TRACK THE NUMBERS TOO
Weight, steps, sleep, water, blood pressure, glucose, mood, pages read, run pace, money saved, or anything you count. Choose from 80 ready-made measures, set a target for day 100, and watch the chart move. With Plus, Apple Health fills them in for you on iPhone and iPad.

KEEP A JOURNAL
Progress photos, short clips, voice notes and notes, filed to the goal on screen. Tap any square on the grid to look back at that day.

MILESTONES
Days 7, 21, 50, 75 and 100 each get a short recap: days done, best streak, your photos, and how each habit went.

IPHONE, IPAD AND MAC
A real Mac app with a sidebar and keyboard shortcuts. One purchase covers every device. With Plus, iCloud sync keeps them in step.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account. No ads. No analytics.
• Your days stay on your devices, and in your own private iCloud if you use sync.
• Apple Health is read only, and Health data never leaves your device.
• Lock the app with Face ID or Touch ID.
• Export everything, photos included, to one backup file at any time.

100 DAYS PLUS
Free runs one goal at a time, with everything in it. Plus runs every goal side by side, each on its own 100 days, and adds iCloud sync between iPhone, iPad and Mac, Apple Health filling your measures, and four more colour schemes.

Plus is $4.99 a month or $39.99 a year (with a 7-day free trial for new subscribers), or $99.99 once for Lifetime. Prices may vary by country. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and you can manage or cancel them in your Apple Account settings. If Plus ends, nothing is deleted: extra goals pause and carry on when it's back.

Cobalt, light and dark, is free; Ember, Moss, Iris and Graphite come with Plus.

Privacy: https://a100days.com/privacy
Terms of Use: https://a100days.com/terms

name: 3704 Music Player
description:
3704 Music Player giúp bạn nghe các tệp nhạc có sẵn trên iPhone hoặc Mac. Nhập nhạc từ Tệp hoặc Finder, sắp xếp thư viện và tạo danh sách phát theo ý mình.

• Tìm kiếm theo tên bài hát, đánh dấu Yêu thích và nghe lại từ mục Phát gần đây.
• Quản lý hàng đợi Sắp phát, phát ngẫu nhiên, lặp một bài hoặc lặp cả danh sách.
• Điều chỉnh âm thanh với Equalizer 20 dải, Preamp và các bộ thiết lập có thể lưu. Xem phổ tần theo thời gian thực khi phát.
• Chọn Mandala, Mắt Phật Tây Tạng hoặc Thanh tịnh với chế độ Sáng và Tối.

Ứng dụng phát các tệp nhạc bạn tự thêm. Trên iPhone, bạn có thể điều khiển nhạc từ màn hình khóa và Trung tâm điều khiển.

name: 5 Wins: Daily Power Tasks
description:
Five tasks. Every day. Win the day.

In 1918 Ivy Lee gave the president of Bethlehem Steel one piece of advice: every evening, write down the most important tasks for tomorrow, rank them, and work through them in order. The story goes that he was paid $25,000 for it.

5 Wins turns that method into one calm screen.

THE RULES
• Pick exactly 5 wins for the day. There is no 6th slot.
• Finish all 5 and you win the day.
• Miss one and the day is lost. No partial credit, no guilt. Tomorrow's a clean slate.
• Plan tomorrow tonight. It takes a minute before bed.

WHAT'S INSIDE
• A huge 3/5 score you can read from across the room
• A gentle "Now" marker on your most important open win
• Evening planning: carry each unfinished win to tomorrow or let it go
• Home Screen widgets: tick off wins right from the widget
• Lock Screen widgets: your score and your next win
• History: a calendar of won and lost days, your streak, best streak and win rate
• Share card for the days you win
• Two reminders a day at most, one in the morning, one in the evening
• CSV export, dark mode, three app icons
• English and Polish

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account. No sign-up. No tracking. No analytics. Your wins stay on your iPhone.

PAY ONCE
One price, everything included. No subscription, no in-app purchases, no ads. Ever.

Do less. Win more.

name: 66Works
description:
손님 문의에 답하느라 일손을 멈추지 마세요. 66Works는 예약, 줄서기, 손님 문의 응대를 한 화면에 모은 사장님용 앱이에요.

■ 예약
손님이 가게 페이지에서 남긴 예약 요청이 달력에 자동으로 쌓여요. 확정과 취소는 버튼 한 번이에요. 문자 버튼을 누르면 손님 언어로 쓴 문구가 채워진 채 메시지 창이 열려요.

■ 웨이팅(줄서기)
가게에 QR을 붙이면 손님이 직접 줄을 서요. 차례가 되면 호출 버튼 한 번으로 불러요.

■ AI 시드 응대
사장님이 입력한 가격표·영업시간·위치를 바탕으로 AI 시드가 손님 질문에 먼저 답해요. 글 채팅과 웹 페이지 음성 통화를 지원하고, 예약 요청과 메모는 정리해서 사장님께 넘겨요. 외국인 손님에게는 그 나라 말로 답해요. AI가 답한다는 사실은 손님에게 표시돼요.

■ 새 예약 알림
새 예약이 들어오면 폰으로 알려드려요. 가게를 비워도 놓치지 않아요.

■ 서비스와 통계
쓰고 있는 서비스를 한눈에 보고, 예약 통계와 한 줄 조언을 확인해요.

■ 시작하는 법
66works.com에서 가게를 만든 뒤, 받은 아이디로 이 앱에 로그인하세요. 약정이 없고 언제든 해지할 수 있어요. 요금제는 웹사이트에서 관리하며 앱 안에서 결제하지 않아요.

문의: support@66works.com

name: Academic PDFWorks
description:
Academic PDFWorks; avukatlar, akademisyenler, öğrenciler ve belgeyle çalışan herkes için PDF, OCR, UYAP (UDF), Word ve ses araçlarını tek uygulamada toplar. Her şey telefonunuzda yapılır: dosyalarınız hiçbir sunucuya gönderilmez, hesap ve reklam yoktur.

ARANABİLİR PDF (OCR)
• Taranmış PDF'leri, fotoğrafları ve kamerayla taradığınız belgeleri aranabilir, kopyalanabilir PDF yapar.
• Türkçe ve İngilizce metin tanıma; dil kendiliğinden bulunur.
• PDF'ler ve görüntüler listedeki sırayla tek PDF olur.

HER ŞEYİ DÖNÜŞTÜR
• PDF, görüntü (JPG, PNG, iPhone HEIC, WEBP, TIFF), TXT, Word (DOCX) ve UYAP Doküman Editörü (UDF) dosyalarını ekleyin, çıktıyı seçin; gerisini uygulama yapar.
• UDF ve Word belgeleri kendi sayfa düzeniyle PDF'e çevrilir; UDF'ten Word'e çevirirken satırlar UYAP'taki gibi kırılır.
• PDF sayfalarını görüntüye, görüntüleri ve metinleri PDF'e çevirir.

SIKIŞTIR / OPTİMİZE ET
• PDF'leri kalite kaybı olmadan optimize eder ya da seçtiğiniz çözünürlükte küçültür.
• Taranmış kitaplarda Hızlı Açılış: yazı sayfaları siyah-beyaz olur, dosya çok daha hızlı açılır.
• Klasörleri alt klasörleriyle birlikte işler.

PDF BİRLEŞTİR, BÖL, ŞİFRE KALDIR
• Kayıpsızdır: sayfalar yeniden sıkıştırılmaz, yer imleri korunur.
• Sayfaları önizlemeden seçerek ya da aralık yazarak bölün.
• Kopyalama, yazdırma ve düzenleme kısıtlamalarını kaldırır; açılış şifresini biliyorsanız onunla açar.

SESİ METNE ÇEVİR
• Ses kayıtlarını ve WhatsApp sesli mesajlarını yazıya döker, konuşmacıları ayırır (Konuşmacı 1, 2…).
• Tamamen telefonda çalışır. İlk kullanımda yazıya dökme modelleri (yaklaşık 600 MB) bir kez indirilir.

SES VE VİDEO SIKIŞTIR / DÖNÜŞTÜR
• Büyük ses ve video kayıtlarını anlaşılırlığı bozmadan küçültür ya da MP4, MOV, M4A, OPUS, WAV, FLAC biçimlerine çevirir.

PDF BİLGİ & FONT KONTROLÜ
• Tez ve dergi gönderimlerinde istenen "tüm yazı tipleri gömülü mü?" denetimini yapar, belge bilgilerini gösterir.

Asıl dosyalarınıza dokunulmaz; çıktılar Dosyalar uygulamasında iPhone'umda › Academic PDFWorks klasörüne kaydedilir.

UYAP, T.C. Adalet Bakanlığı'nın sistemidir; Academic PDFWorks Bakanlıkla ya da UYAP ile bağlantılı değildir.

name: Across the Grain
description:
Course Stick keeps each pile on this iPhone.

Three courses sit on the pile. The sticker has to lie across the grain before a board can stay. A board stays only when its moisture is within one point of the board beside it. Turning the sticker with the grain lifts that course back to the bunk. A gap wider than one point sends the board back too.

When every course is full and across the grain, the sentence is Flat. Otherwise it names the first course that still needs the sticker or another board.

Name a pile, rename it, delete one, and share that one sentence.

Piles stay on this iPhone. There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: Actually Going
description:
A group planning a trip together usually stalls in the group chat. Ideas get buried, nobody knows what the group agreed on, and the call to sort it out never happens.

This app turns open ideas into a plan without that call, and gives each booking to one named person.

How it works
- The organizer starts a trip in about 40 seconds: the cities, the dates, the choices still open, the things to book with who books each, and a checklist.
- Friends join from one invite link with only a name. Nobody needs an account.
- Anyone adds an idea. It goes into the plan once a second friend backs it and nobody proposes a rival within 72 hours.
- When two backed ideas collide, such as two hotels in one city, the group votes between the two. A tie goes to a coin flip, so no single person decides.
- Whoever owns a booking taps "I booked it" when it is done. Each friend ticks off their own checklist, with visa and entry items for the country they travel from.
- When nothing is open, the organizer locks the plan. If the lock-by date comes first, the plan locks on its own.

Made for trips with no signal
The locked plan is a day-by-day itinerary that opens offline, and each day saves to Photos as one picture. 

What it leaves out
It has no chat, no recommendations, no map, and no money. It does not track prices, budgets, or who owes whom.

An account is optional. Sign in with your email to get your trips back on another device. To report or block another member, open Who's going.

name: AdonaiSync
description:
AdonaiSync ayuda a los equipos de alabanza a tocar juntos. Una persona hace de líder: elige la canción, cambia el tono y desplaza la letra. Los músicos que están cerca ven la misma canción en sus propios dispositivos.

PARA ENSAYOS Y CULTOS
• El líder comparte la canción y los músicos conectados la reciben al instante.
• Los dispositivos se conectan directamente entre sí cuando están cerca, sin cuentas ni servidores.
• El tono que elige el líder se aplica a todo el equipo.
• Cada músico mantiene su capo, su instrumento y su tamaño de letra.
• El músico puede desplazar la letra a mano cuando lo necesita.
• Playlist para el culto: el líder ordena las canciones que vienen.

LETRAS Y ACORDES
• Acordes en notación internacional (C, D, E) o latina (Do, Re, Mi), a elección de cada músico.
• Escribe tus canciones con los acordes entre corchetes, por ejemplo [G]Luz, o con los acordes sobre la letra.
• Importa tus canciones desde archivos de texto, ChordPro o respaldos de tu cancionero anterior.
• Cambia de canción con los botones o deslizando sobre la letra.
• Favoritas, listas para cada culto, búsqueda e índice de la A a la Z.
• Guía de acordes para guitarra, piano, acordeón, bajo de 4 y 5 cuerdas, vientos y cuerdas; guía de voces y estructura de la canción para batería.

TAMBIÉN CON UN SOLO DISPOSITIVO
Ensaya a solas con tu biblioteca, sin líder ni conexión.

TU CONTENIDO
AdonaiSync no incluye canciones de terceros. Cada equipo añade o importa las canciones que tiene derecho a usar. Tus canciones se guardan en tu dispositivo; no hay cuentas, anuncios ni analítica.

name: Ads Manager Campaign Planner
description:
Plan your next product ad, from choosing what to feature to setting a daily budget. Ads Manager: Campaign Planner gives you an offline workspace to preview ad creatives, organize drafts, and keep your plans on your iPhone or iPad.
- Plan campaigns — Create, edit, and archive drafts. Find saved plans by product, category, or status.
- Preview product ads — Browse a built-in sample catalog, choose a product, preview its ad, and set a daily budget in USD.
- Explore performance reports — Use clearly labeled sample data to compare revenue and spend, review return on ad spend (ROAS), and see a category breakdown.
- Export reports — Save sample reports as CSV files for use in a spreadsheet.
Open the app and start planning right away. No account or internet connection is required. Campaign drafts are saved on your device for future editing.

name: AeroGlyph
description:
AeroGlyph – Sky Painter is an original airplane drawing puzzle. You pilot a small propeller plane that leaves a trail of color across an open sky. Every challenge is a dotted sketch. Follow the glowing checkpoint, stay close to the line, and paint the shape before the clock runs out.

This is not a shooter, a lane runner, or a flying obstacle course. The plane is a brush. The sky is the paper. You draw the picture yourself.

HOW TO PLAY
Drag anywhere on the sky. The plane glides toward your finger at a limited speed and turns to face the way it is moving. It never jumps to the touch.

A glowing marker shows the next point. Paint the checkpoints in order. Flying straight to the last dot does not finish the artwork. An accuracy meter watches how close you stay to the sketch. Easy paintings forgive a wider line. Later paintings ask for a steadier hand.

Bright paint sparks sit along some paths. Catching one adds points and briefly brightens the trail. Sparks are bonuses. The painting is finished by tracing the shape, not by collecting them.

Dark storm clouds drift across the canvas. Touching one washes paint off the brush, costs one of your three charges, and gives you a short moment to recover. Lose every charge, or let the clock hit zero, and the artwork stays unfinished.

Clear every checkpoint in time, with enough accuracy and a charge remaining, to frame the painting. One star means a valid finish. Two stars mean a clean line. Three stars mean excellent accuracy with time still on the clock.

THIRTY SKY PAINTINGS
The first ten are simple studies: a line, triangle, square, diamond, heart, star, spiral, crescent, arrow, and flower.

The next ten ask for more: twin hearts, a butterfly, a cloud, a rocket, a crown, lightning, a ribbon, an airplane sketch, a sunburst, and a pair of loops.

The last ten are gallery pieces: a woven star, a phoenix, a compass rose, a folded dragon curve, a double spiral, a celestial flower, a winged crest, a constellation, a royal seal, and a sky mural.

Each level is a different path. Finishing one opens the next. You can replay any unlocked painting to improve the score, the accuracy, or the stars.

YOUR STUDIO
The Cloud Gallery is a museum of framed sketches, not a numbered path on a map. Finished work is shown in color. Locked canvases stay covered. Badges record real flights: a first finished painting, a three-star piece, ten paintings, thirty stars, forty sparks, three finishes with every paint charge left, a line at 92 percent accuracy or better, and the complete gallery of thirty.

Artist Studio is a wooden easel. Turn sound, music, and haptics on or off. Choose a rainbow, ocean, sunset, emerald, or violet trail and see it on the plane before you fly. The color you pick is the color the plane paints in the level. Replay the short flying lesson any time. Reset clears paintings, scores, stars, badges, and the flight log, and asks before it does. Sound, music, haptics, and the trail stay unless you choose to reset those too.

There is no account, no ads, no purchases.

name: Aha Stories
description:
Take a few minutes for a story, a moment of reflection, and one small thing you can do today.

READ SOMETHING THAT FITS YOUR DAY
Open Today for a short story, or explore 86 stories across eight themes including confidence, resilience, kindness, and gratitude. Pick how you feel, search by keyword, or come back to where you left off.

TURN A STORY INTO A SMALL ACTION
Answer a reflection prompt with a quick choice or a private note. Try a tiny real-world challenge, then check in on how it went. Selected stories have a short continuation and a related next read.

KEEP WHAT STAYS WITH YOU
Bookmark stories and quotes, revisit your journal, or send a story or quote card to someone. Add a Home Screen or Lock Screen widget to jump back into your reading or check in on a challenge.

Read and reflect offline, with no account required. Daily reminders are optional.

name: Ai Essay Writer & Citations
description:
AI Essay Writer & Citations writes essays, literature reviews, research papers and thesis chapters, and cites only real sources you can open.

MOST AI WRITING TOOLS INVENT REFERENCES. THIS ONE DOES NOT.
Paste your reading list and the draft cites from that list and nothing else. Give it no references and it marks every claim that needs one instead of making a citation up. Every paper it finds has a live DOI, so your supervisor can click it.

FIND REAL PAPERS
Search over 250 million papers indexed by OpenAlex, free, inside the app. Add what you need to your reference list and the draft works from it.

25 ACADEMIC DOCUMENT TYPES
Academic essay, research paper, argumentative essay, case study, literature review, annotated bibliography, article critique, research proposal, grant proposal, methodology section, lab report, dissertation chapter, abstract, peer review report, statement of purpose and more, each with guided questions for that form.

CITATION STYLES
APA 7th, MLA 9th, Chicago 17th, Harvard, IEEE and Vancouver.

SEE THE PLAN BEFORE THE DRAFT
The outline comes first, with the word budget split across sections. Rename, reorder or remove sections while it is still cheap to change, then write from the plan you approved.

UPLOAD A PAPER AND GET IT EXPLAINED
Bring a paper you were assigned. Get it broken down section by section: what it is, the question it asks, how they did it and what they found. Works with PDF, Word and a photo of a page.

ASK HOW RESEARCH ACTUALLY WORKS
A method you have not used, a statistic you cannot read, a citation rule you keep getting wrong. Ask in plain language and get an answer scoped to your subject.

A THESIS STATEMENT IN SECONDS
Describe your topic and your view, and pick from several clear thesis statements.

EXPORT IS FREE
Leave with your own work: PDF, Word or plain text. Reference lists export as BibTeX or RIS for Zotero, Mendeley or EndNote. No subscription needed to get your document out.

ELEVEN LANGUAGES
Write in English, Spanish, French, Portuguese, German, Turkish, Indonesian, Arabic, Hindi, Bengali or Chinese. The app itself is translated into all of them.

USE IT HONESTLY
Every draft shows how many claims still need a source and comes with an AI-use statement you can include. Drafts are a starting point: check your institution's policy on AI assistance before you submit.

PRIVACY
No account, no email, no sign-up. Your drafts and history stay on your iPhone, and you can delete your data from inside the app. To write anything, what you type and any file you attach is sent to our server, which uses OpenAI to generate the answer.

FREE TO TRY, UNLIMITED BY SUBSCRIPTION
Free uses are included to try every feature. Unlimited unlocks unlimited drafts (including Medium and Long), paper analyses, questions and thesis statements. Weekly, monthly or yearly; the yearly plan starts with a 3-day free trial for new subscribers.

Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the period ends. Manage or cancel in your App Store account settings. Any unused part of a free trial ends when you buy a subscription.

description:

name: AI Risk Management: Riskledge
description:
Riskledge teaches managers how to get work done with AI responsibly. Follow a fictional company, Harbourline Logistics, through ten folders: accountability and roles, the AI register, risk scoring, the NIST AI Risk Management Framework, the EU AI Act, management systems, privacy questions, vendor checks, policies and incidents, and the one-page board report.

Learn by doing. Every folder has a work scenario and hands-on labs: build a RACI sheet, fill an AI register, find shadow AI in an expense list, move a control slider and watch the risk move on a heat map, sort activities into the framework functions, size a review sample, score vendors, test a pilot against its threshold, and watch an override-rate chart for a real alarm. Each lab ends with a question computed from what you built, and every equation is shown next to the situation it describes.

Honest and checkable. Every statement carries a source record you can open in a full-width sheet, with the stored record available offline. Dated cards say what to verify. The EU AI Act dates were read from the Official Journal texts on 2026-11-17, including the 2026 amendment, and the app tells you to check the current text.

What you get:
- 10 folders, 21 labs, 190 questions plus a 20-question mixed check
- Short sessions, a gentle replay of missed questions, no streak pressure
- Sources from NIST, EU institutions, regulators, universities and standards bodies, with links verified on 2026-11-17
- Text size from 85% to 200%, VoiceOver labels, works offline, no account

Free with ads. An optional monthly subscription ($3.99 per month after a 7-day free trial) only removes ads; you can also watch an optional video for a credit. Cancel anytime in your account settings; cancellation takes effect at the next billing cycle.

For adults (18+). Riskledge gives no legal advice and does not certify compliance with any law or standard. All organisations and people are fictional; numbers in labs are illustrative unless a source is cited. Content as of 2026-11-17.

Terms of Use: https://equalinformation.com/terms-riskledge.html

name: AI Tavli
description:
AI Tavli brings the three Greek backgammon games to your phone, played by Greek rules against the strongest computer opponent there is for them, or a friend on the same device. It is a game and nothing else: no ads, no in-app purchases, no account, no data collection, and it asks for no permissions at all. Switch on airplane mode and it plays exactly the same.

THE THREE GAMES
• Portes – the Greek cousin of backgammon: hits, the bar, no doubling cube.
• Plakoto – no hitting; land on a lone piece to pin it in place, and win outright by pinning the opponent's mother piece.
• Fevga – both players run the same way; a single piece blocks a point, and the six-prime rule keeps the game honest.
Matches follow the traditional rotation Portes → Plakoto → Fevga, first to 3, 5, 7 or any length you like. Doubles (a win before the loser bears off) count two points.

AN OPPONENT FOR EVERY TABLE
The computer is a neural network that taught itself Portes, Plakoto and Fevga by playing tens of millions of games of each, and it is the strongest opponent you will find for the Greek games. Choose its level for each side: Easy already plays better than most people and will test anyone short of an expert; Normal is the network at full strength, moving instantly; Hard thinks ahead over every possible dice roll and plays at a level few human players reach. Set either side to Human and play a friend on the same device, or let two computer players play each other. Your record against each level, overall and for each of the three games, is kept on your phone.

MADE FOR THE TABLE
• Board, pieces and dice at the proportions of a real wooden tavli set, on a felt tablecloth.
• Large, high-contrast dice and text, easy on the eyes.
• Drag a piece and see every legal landing point; the app enforces the rules, including the obligation to play both dice.
• Undo a move or reset the whole turn before you end it; resign a lost game, single or double.
• Change the players, animation speed, language or sound in Settings without leaving the match.
• A match in progress is saved on your device and resumes where you left it.
• Portrait or landscape, phones and tablets.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No ads. No in-app purchases. No account or sign-in. No analytics, no crash reporting, no tracking of any kind. The app requests no permissions – not even internet access – and is fully playable in airplane mode. Nothing ever leaves your device.

name: Air Care Home
description:
Air Care Home connects you with your heating and air conditioning company.

Sign in with the email address your company has on file, and everything about your home's comfort system is in one place:

• My Upcoming Appointments: see your visits for the next 30 days, with arrival windows.
• Schedule My Appointment: book a repair, a tune-up, or an estimate for a new system.
• Service Records: every visit, invoice and estimate. Pay invoices by card, and approve or decline estimates right in the app.
• Service Reports: see what your technician checked and recorded at each visit.
• My Equipment: your system's details, warranty dates and a System Health score.
• Order My AC Filters: reorder the filters on file for your home, or ask your company to identify your size.
• Quincy, your AI helper: ask any heating or cooling question in plain English. Quincy can explain an invoice or estimate line by line and give you an honest, neutral take, keeping it separate from the company's offer. Quincy never pressures and is happy to say when something can wait.

Your service records belong to you. If you have used more than one company that uses Air Care Home, you can view the service history from each one.

Air Care Home requires an account with a participating heating and cooling company.

name: AKATANUKI
description:
AKATANUKI is what's next, first — an online publication covering what's about to matter, with verified release dates, prices and where to buy.

Footwear, always — but also the clothing, the houses, the timepieces, and the machines. If the culture is moving in it, wearing it or watching it, it's in.

The website is home base. The app is the daily habit — sneaker drops the second they go live, car and watch debuts the day they're revealed, and the full feed across every beat with none of the noise.

• Every confirmed date and retail price, converted to where you actually are. No more 11AM ET math.
• Bookmark stories and drops into your own list. Your archive, your taste — nothing algorithmic about it.

An independent publication. Every product links to a real page — dead links come off. Prices and dates checked against official sources. Not affiliated with the brands covered. All brand names belong to their owners.

Turn on notifications and the app tells you the moment a new story goes up.

name: Alcove
description:
Alcove keeps your day in one calm place.

Plan what must be done and what should be done. Build habits you can keep. Focus with a Pomodoro timer or stopwatch. Take a few quiet minutes with a meditation timer. Keep short notes and tag what matters.

Everything works without an account, and your data stays on your iPhone.

ALCOVE PLUS (optional)
- Every accent colour
- Profile icons
- Your History for focus and meditation
- Sync between your devices

name: Alım Var
description:
Kamuda iş mi arıyorsun? Alım Var, kamu personel alım ilanlarını tek bir yerde toplar, sana uygun olanları ayırır ve yeni bir ilan çıktığında haber verir.

BÜTÜN KAMU İLANLARI TEK YERDE
• Memur (A ve B grubu), sözleşmeli personel (4/B, KİT, kurumsal), kamu işçisi, akademik ve askerî alımlar
• İlanlar resmî kaynaktan saatte bir güncellenir
• Kurum, unvan ya da il ile ara; ilan türüne ve ile göre filtrele

SANA UYGUN OLANLAR
• Öğrenim durumunu, KPSS puanlarını ve ilini bir kez gir
• Her ilanda "Uygunsun", "Kontrol et" ya da "Uygun değil" etiketi ve nedenini gör
• "Sadece bana uygun olanlar" ile başvuramayacağın ilanları listenden çıkar
  (ör. doktora isteyen öğretim üyesi kadroları lisans mezunlarına gösterilmez)

HİÇBİR İLANI KAÇIRMA
• Sana uygun yeni bir ilan çıkınca bildirim al
• İlanı kaydet; son başvurudan bir gün önce hatırlatalım
• Son başvuruya kalan gün sayısı her ilanda görünür

ÜCRETSİZ VE ÜYELİKSİZ

Cumhurbaşkanlığı Strateji ve Bütçe Başkanlığı'nın resmî kamu personeli alım ilanları sitesinden (kamuilan.sbb.gov.tr) derlenir. Başvurular ilanı yayımlayan kurumun belirttiği resmî kanaldan yapılır; başvuru şartlarını her zaman resmî ilan metninden teyit et.

name: Almagest: Learn the Night Sky
description:
Most people can find the Big Dipper and stop there. Almagest teaches you the whole night sky in a few minutes a day, and brings every constellation back right before you would forget it.

Your sky starts in fog. Tell Almagest where you are and it opens on a constellation that is up tonight. Learn it and the fog lifts outward, one neighbor at a time, until all 88 constellations are yours.

LEARN IT ONCE, KEEP IT FOR YEARS
Every constellation, star and planet has its own schedule. Remember it and the next review comes later: the next day, then a week, then months apart. A few minutes a day keeps the whole sky clear.

EVERY QUESTION IS RECALL
Find Orion on the sky. Name a constellation from its stars. Name its brightest star, or the constellation a star belongs to. Tell which world Titan orbits. No reading lists: recall is what makes it stick. Every question works with VoiceOver too.

88 CONSTELLATIONS AND THEIR STARS
All 88 constellations in their modern IAU figures, more than 90 named stars, and a short story for every constellation: the myth behind it, or who put it in the sky and why.

THE PLANETS AND THEIR MOONS
The solar system has a scene of its own: the planets in order and to scale, Pluto, and 16 moons from Io to Charon.

TONIGHT'S SKY
Hold up your phone and Almagest shows the sky it points at, from where you stand. Tap what you see to name it, and see which planets are up tonight and when they rise and set.

DAILY PUZZLE
A new constellation to name from its stars every day, in five guesses, with a hint after each miss. Free, and your result is one tap to share.

MADE FOR THE DARK
Red night mode turns every screen red on black, so your eyes stay used to the dark. Tonight's sky turns it on by itself.

REMINDERS AT DUSK
If you like, a reminder on evenings when stars are due for review, when a planet is back in the evening sky, or when a meteor shower peaks. Worked out on your phone: your location never leaves it.

ON ALL YOUR DEVICES
Your progress syncs through your own iCloud between iPhone and iPad. No account, and everything works offline.

FREE AND PRO
Your first five constellations and their stars are free, with every question and review, for as long as you like. So are the daily puzzle and the Sun. Almagest Pro opens all 88 constellations, the planets and their moons, and every constellation in Tonight's sky. Pro is a monthly or yearly subscription, or a one-time Lifetime purchase. No ads. Pro works with Family Sharing.

Star positions from ESA's Hipparcos mission, constellations from the International Astronomical Union, orbits from NASA/JPL. In English and Swedish.

name: AloGo Remote
description:
AloGo Remote giúp bạn điều khiển máy tính Windows từ xa ngay trên iPhone và iPad — hỗ trợ người thân, khách hàng, hay tự vào máy của mình ở nhà, ở văn phòng.

KẾT NỐI TRONG VÀI GIÂY
• Nhập ID 9 số và mật khẩu hiện trên AloGo của máy tính là kết nối — không cần cấu hình mạng, không cần mở cổng.
• Lưu các máy hay dùng, lần sau chạm một lần là vào.
• Tự kết nối lại khi mạng 4G / Wi-Fi chập chờn hoặc khi bạn quay lại ứng dụng.

ĐIỀU KHIỂN THOẢI MÁI TRÊN MÀN HÌNH CẢM ỨNG
• Chế độ chuột (bàn di chuột) và chạm trực tiếp.
• Phóng to bằng hai ngón, hai ngón kéo để cuộn.
• Bàn phím đầy đủ cùng các phím đặc biệt: Ctrl, Alt, Win, F1–F12, Ctrl+Alt+Del.
• Chọn màn hình khi máy tính có nhiều màn hình; nghe âm thanh của máy tính.

AN TOÀN
• Hình ảnh, phím bấm, tệp được mã hóa đầu cuối 256-bit (ChaCha20-Poly1305); máy chủ chỉ chuyển tiếp, không xem được nội dung.
• Mật khẩu không bao giờ gửi qua mạng (xác thực SPAKE2).
• Thiết bị nhập sai mật khẩu nhiều lần sẽ bị tạm chặn.
• Máy chủ đặt tại Việt Nam.

CÁCH DÙNG
1. Cài AloGo cho Windows trên máy tính cần điều khiển (tải tại AloGo.io.vn).
2. Mở AloGo Remote trên iPhone / iPad, nhập ID và mật khẩu của máy tính.
3. Bấm Kết nối.

AloGo được phát triển tại Việt Nam.

name: Alpine Snow: Powder Forecast
description:
Alpine Snow puts every major weather model side by side for ski areas across the western United States, the Northeast, Alaska and western Canada, and shows how far the models agree.

The Powder Finder ranks every place by the snow coming: the total, the range from the lowest model to the highest, and the next ten days at a glance. Filter by region, or search for a mountain by name.

Open a place and the answer comes first: how much snow by 9 AM, in the next 24 hours and in the next five days, each with its range. Switch between the base, mid-mountain and summit, and tap any day to see what each model says.

Measured snow comes from the nearest SNOTEL or CDEC station, so you can compare the forecast with what fell.

Trail maps draw every run and lift from OpenStreetMap on real terrain. Tap a run for its length, vertical drop and steepness. They are not the resorts' own maps, so check with the resort for closures.

Record your day with the phone in your pocket. Alpine Snow names each lift and run you ride, adds up your runs and vertical, and draws the day on the trail map, with a Live Activity on the Lock Screen. You can also bring in a GPX or FIT file from another app or a GPS watch. Your days stay on your phone.

A place you have opened keeps its last forecast, so it still opens with no signal.

No account, no ads and no tracking.

Alpine Snow is part of the Alpine Recreation Suite from Peach & Madison.

name: Alruedo: alquiler de carros
description:
Alruedo es el alquiler de carros entre personas en Venezuela.

SI QUIERES ALQUILAR
- Busca carros por ciudad y fechas, con fotos reales y precio por día.
- Dueños y clientes pasan una verificación de cédula.

SOPORTE
Escríbenos por WhatsApp al 0422 399 2190 y te respondemos personas, no un robot.

Alruedo no es una aseguradora ni parte del contrato de alquiler: es la plataforma que une a dueños y clientes y cuida el dinero.

name: AltarGlow
description:
AltarGlow puts your whole church in your pocket. Find your church, join with its code, and stay close to your church family all week, not just on Sunday.

AltarGlow is for churches that have joined AltarGlow. Ask your church for its code to get started. One account works for every church you belong to.

STAY INFORMED
- Announcements from your church
- Sermons, and the live stream of the service wherever you are
- The church calendar, with countdowns to the big days
- Birthdays and wedding anniversaries in your church family

GROW IN FAITH
- A daily devotional to start your morning
- Fasting and prayer programmes your church is running
- Send prayer requests and pray for one another
- Your church's library of resources

BE PART OF IT
- Check in on Sunday by scanning the code at the door, or online when you join the stream
- Home cells: find your group and see when it meets
- A space for the youth and teens
- Follow your church's projects
- Profile of the week: get to know the people you worship with

SOLOMON'S TEMPLE
Bible quiz nights for the whole church. Play live on your phone while the questions show on the big screen, answer fast, and climb the leaderboard. Great for youth fellowship, family nights and Sunday school.

FOR PASTORS AND CHURCH LEADERS
- Preach mode: prepare your sermon and preach from a clear pulpit view
- Plan services and share the order of service
- Post announcements and keep your members up to date from your phone

YOUR PRIVACY
Only members of your church see its content, and your church can choose to approve each new member before they join.

name: Amharic Notes
description:
Speak Amharic and watch your words appear as text, as you talk.

Amharic Notes turns Amharic speech into written Amharic with an AI speech model that runs entirely on your iPhone. After a one-time download of the model, everything works offline: in Airplane Mode, with no signal, anywhere. Amharic Notes never uploads your voice or your notes, there is no account to create, and there are no ads or tracking.

LIVE AMHARIC DICTATION
• The text appears while you speak, in Ge'ez script
• Keeps recording with the screen locked; pause and resume from the Lock Screen
• Silent gaps are skipped, so recordings stay short
• Punctuation from the model
• Spoken numbers become digits

FIX ANY WORD IN A TAP
• Tap a word to see suggestions from a 110,000-word Amharic dictionary
• Or say the word again and it's replaced
• Possible misspellings are underlined
• Add names and special terms to My words, and they're used for corrections and suggestions
• Edit the whole text freely whenever you like
• A built-in guide shows every feature step by step

YOUR NOTES, ORGANISED
• Every note keeps its audio; play it back and each word lights up as it's spoken
• Folders and search

description:
Draw your bow, read the wind and let the arrow fly. Apex Arrow is an archery game where real physics decides every shot: gravity pulls the arrow down, the wind pushes it off line, and you only get so many arrows per level. Pick the right one, find the arc, hit the target.

AN ARCHERY GAME THAT MAKES YOU THINK
Every level is a small archery puzzle, a bow puzzle where the wind is part of the problem. A gust from the left, a wall in front of the target, a handful of arrows in the quiver. Aim high and let the wind carry it, or smash the wall first and shoot straight through. No timers and no lives to lose. Miss, read the flag again, and take the next shot.

SEVEN ARROWS, SEVEN WAYS TO WIN
• STANDARD: the balanced shot for clean bullseyes
• BROADHEAD: breaks a wall in one hit, but the wind fights it hardest
• FLIGHT: fast and light, made for long-range targets
• CURVE: bends around cover; tap mid-flight to flip the curve
• FIREPOT: an explosive arrow that bursts on the road
• POWER: punches through anything in its path
• FIREBRAND: a fire arrow that sets the whole road alight

DEFEND THE CASTLE
Between chapters, raiders march on your tower. Runners, scouts, brutes and champions come in packs, and only your bow holds the wall. It is castle defense played with a bow and arrow: aim at the front of the pack, drop a firepot on the crowd, and survive every wave.

CONQUER THE REALM
Forty-eight provinces, seven rival houses and one map to win. Clear chapters to claim land, push back invasions, and break each chapter boss to keep what you took. Your kingdom grows acre by acre as your archery improves.

A NEW CHALLENGE EVERY DAY

• A ranked ladder against rival archers, and championship zones
• Upgrade every arrow with mastery shards

The ladder includes simulated rivals so the board is never empty.

• Short puzzle levels for a quick break, and a long road for long sessions
• A moonlit fantasy world

Apex Arrow is free to play. Optional in-app purchases include arrow packs, a 24-hour Day Pass, a one-time Ad-Free upgrade and the Arrow Pass for the current season. The game also shows ads; watching an optional video can earn extra arrows.

Whether you came for a calm arrow shooting game, a tricky physics puzzle or a bow and arrow battle to defend your castle, every level is winnable. The wind just wants you to prove it.

name: Arise Check-in
description:
Arise Check-in is a daily check-in for a loved one who lives alone, and an easy way to stay connected with the family who looks out for them.

If a check-in is missed, Arise asks "Are you OK?" first. If there's still no answer, your support circle hears about it, one person at a time, by app notification, text and email, until someone says they're on it.

For your loved one
- One big "I'm OK" button, and a large-text option
- Reply YES or NO to a text or email, or answer a phone call, if that's easier

Arise Check-in is about daily human contact. It is not an emergency service, does not call 911 and works alongside a medical alert device, not in place of one. In an emergency, call 911. name: AtmosMark
description:
Dear friend,

Places leave a feeling that fades fast. AtmosMark is a pocket notebook for that feeling — for writers, filmmakers, and mood-board makers who need to pin down how a room, street, or corner reads before the impression slips away.

1. Capture a scene in sensory fragments
Give the place a title, then jot a short scene note and free-text scraps for light, sound, scent, touch, and a mood tag up to 40 characters. Title stays within 80 characters; scene notes and sense lines can run a few hundred. You are writing what you notice, not recording audio or snapping photos.

2. Keep working or shelve the mood
Entries you are still shaping stay Active. When a mood is ready to park, Shelve it. Either move can take an optional progress log of up to 500 characters — a one-line “still shaping the alley” note — or you can skip the note and shelve in one tap.

3. Search and filter the full library
Library holds every entry. Type into search to match title, scene note, sense fields, or mood. Flip All / Active / Shelved to narrow the shelf. On a short wide screen the results sit in two columns so you can scan faster.

4. Browse by sense tag
Senses gathers Light, Sound, Scent, Touch, and Mood labels with counts. Open a tag to jump straight back into the matching atmospheres.

5. Detail, edit, and clear
Open any card to reread the fragments, add another progress log, edit fields, change Active / Shelved, or delete. About carries a short how-to, Privacy, Support mail to vitalisonditi@icloud.com, and Erase all local data after two confirmations.

The look is quiet: soft garden wash behind white cards, teal actions, and Active / Shelved chips that read at a glance. In landscape, Keep working and Shelve sit side by side on Active cards. Everything works offline on this device. No account, no ads, nothing to buy. Your atmosphere library stays on the phone.

Warmly,
AtmosMark

SAVE A LOOK AND USE IT AGAIN

EXPORT AND SHARE
Export photos as JPEG, HEIC, or PNG. Export video as MP4 or save a frame. Save a file, share through iOS, or add a copy to Photos when you choose.

ON-DEVICE EDITING
AuraArtsy runs on iPhone with iOS 17 or later and is available in English and Simplified Chinese. You choose which photos and videos to import. Portrait, subject, and sky detection run on your iPhone.
