description:
Automarkus brings your dealership’s vehicle photo workflow to iPhone and iPad. Sign in with your existing Automarkus dealership account to capture originals, prepare an enhancement and review the finished photos.

THREE WAYS TO START
• Guided capture: follow a 32-photo vehicle checklist.
• Upload from phone: choose existing images with the system Photos picker.
• Free capture: photograph any angles in any order, with up to 80 photos per session.

KEEP YOUR WORK TOGETHER
Save capture drafts on your device and return to them later. Select photos from your dealership’s connected website inventory or upload the originals you choose.

REVIEW BEFORE PROCESSING
Choose from the backgrounds and quality levels available to your account. Uploading originals is free. Review the processing quote and approve the maximum credit hold before an enhancement begins. Processing uses your existing dealership account balance.

COMPARE AND EXPORT
Follow project progress, compare originals with results, mark photos reviewed, and organize export names and order. Save selected results to Photos or share through the iOS share sheet. Check vehicle details and visible condition before publishing any AI-enhanced image.

DEALERSHIP ACCESS REQUIRED
An existing Automarkus dealership account is required. Account access and available features are managed by your dealership administrator. Internet access is required for sign-in, uploads and AI processing; local capture drafts are saved on your device.

name: automative
description:
Automative brings the car market into one app. Buy a new car, find a great used one, rent for a week or trade in your current car — all from your phone.

NEW & USED CARS
Browse cars from dealers, showrooms and private sellers. Every listing shows the year, mileage, fuel type, transmission and location, with clear cash prices and financing options.

RENT A CAR IN MINUTES
Choose your area and rental dates, pick your preferred pick-up and drop-off time and location, and see the cars available for you.

SEARCH BY AREA
Set a location on the map, choose a search radius from 5 km and up, and see the cars around you — from Doha and Lusail to Al Wakrah and beyond.

SMART FILTERS
Narrow down by new, used or for rent, sort by newest first, and filter by year, mileage, fuel and transmission to find the right car faster.

COMPARE CARS
Put cars side by side and compare their specs and prices before you decide.

INSTALMENT CALCULATOR
Enter the car price and your down payment and instantly see your estimated monthly payment, total interest and total cost.

TRADE IN
Thinking of upgrading? Start a trade-in for your current car right from the app.

DEALERS & SHOWROOMS
Explore trusted dealers and showrooms across Qatar and see what they have in stock.

SELL YOUR CAR
List your car in a few steps and reach buyers across Qatar.

CAR NEWS
Stay up to date with the latest car news and launches.

Download Automative and find your next car today.

name: Aventuras na Bíblia
description:
GAME IN PORTUGUESE: all texts and narration are in Brazilian Portuguese.

Every night Grandpa reads a Bible story, and Joel, a little shepherd boy, and Nuvem, his lamb, dream they are there: in the Garden of Eden, on Noah's ark, in Egypt, in Bethlehem... and even above the clouds!

Aventuras na Bíblia ("Adventures in the Bible") is a platform game for kids and families. Each level tells a Bible story, in order from Genesis to Revelation, with the Bible reference for each story.

WHAT'S INSIDE
• 103 levels in 8 parts, from Creation to Noah's ark, Joseph, Moses, David and the giant, and the Good News.
• Joel runs and jumps. Nuvem is small: she squeezes through holes, digs and climbs on Joel's head.
• Collect bread, find hidden scrolls and open secret levels.
• 40 missions where Nuvem runs on her own.
• Play together: two iPhones on the same Wi-Fi, one as Joel and the other as Nuvem. Parts 7 and 8 need two iPhones.
• Bosses are won without violence: the serpent runs away, the bear calms down, the wolf and the lion become friends.
• No weapons, no blood. God appears as light, and Jesus is mentioned in the texts but never drawn.
• Works offline.

PART 1 IS FREE
All of Part 1 is free (10 levels). The full game opens the other seven parts, with 93 more levels, as a one-time purchase: no subscription, no ads. The purchase is behind a question for adults and is shared with your family through Family Sharing. When playing together, only one of the two iPhones needs the full game.

PRIVACY
The game collects no data. No ads, no accounts, no chat and no analytics. Progress is saved only on the device.

Narration made with Kokoro-82M (Apache 2.0).

name: AwesomeReads
description:
Ese libro que te recomendaron, el que dejaste a medias y el que queréis leer en el club. En AwesomeReads cada uno tiene su sitio.

Tu biblioteca, a tu ritmo. Separa lo que estás leyendo, lo que ya leíste y lo que quieres leer después. Valora tus lecturas y elige si quieres publicar las reseñas que ya tienes.

Encuentra tu próxima lectura. Busca por título o autor, o escanea el ISBN de un libro que tengas en la mano. Explora recomendaciones y guarda las que te apetezcan para más adelante.

Haz sitio para el club. Crea un club de lectura o únete por invitación. Propón títulos, votad qué leer y acordad cuándo reuniros. Si alguien acaba el libro antes, podéis seguir comentándolo en el club.

¿Ya tienes un historial de lectura? Importa el CSV de Goodreads o StoryGraph y revisa las coincidencias antes de continuar.

name: Azkaar: Shia Duas & Tasbih
description:
Azkaar helps you keep your daily azkaar, duas, Quran and amal according to Fiqh-e-Jafaria, in Urdu, English and Arabic.

THE WHOLE QURAN
• Every surah in Arabic with Urdu (Jawadi, Najafi) and English translations, even offline
• Read 50 ayat a day, as Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (a.s.) advised, with your streak and reading log
• Keep favourite surahs and add surahs like Yaseen or Waqiah to your daily routine

NAHJ AL-BALAGHA
• All the sermons, letters and sayings of Imam Ali (a.s.), in Arabic with Urdu and English
• A saying of the day, search, and mark what you have read

YOUR DAILY ROUTINE
• Build a routine of azkaar and recite with a tasbeeh counter that remembers your count
• Weekday zikr is added on the right day, like Surah al-Waqiah on Shab-e-Juma
• Your own reminders for any dua, surah or task, and a progress ring for the day

DUAS AND ZIYARAT
• Ziyarat-e-Ashura, Dua Kumail and more, each opening with its fazilat and reference
• A clear start to the text, numbered parts and how many times to recite each
• Amaal for each Islamic month, like Rajab and Sha'ban

AMAL AND NAMAZ, STEP BY STEP
• Namaz-e-Jafar-e-Tayyar, Namaz-e-Ghufaila, Namaz-e-Wahshat and other amal
• Every surah and tasbih as its own step, with counts
• Keep your place over several days

HADITH OF THE DAY
• A hadith of the 14 Masoomeen (a.s.) every day, in Arabic, Urdu and English, with its Shia reference
• Share it as an image

JA'FARI NAMAZ TIMES
• Namaz times for your city using the Ja'fari method
• Countdown to the next namaz
• A daily namaz card to share with family

QURAN KHATAM TOGETHER
• Start a khatam for a loved one and invite family with a code or QR
• Everyone takes a siparah and marks it read

ALSO
• Salawat counter
• Qibla direction
• Kids section with the 14 Masoomeen (a.s.)
• Islamic date with wiladat and shahadat days
• Search sorted by Quran, duas, ziyarat and amaal
• Get your account back on a new phone with your email
• Export your history or delete your account any time

Free, with no ads.

name: BacAir
description:
BacAir is the companion app for buildings whose air conditioners are connected to an AmbiAutomation BACnet gateway. It shows the air-conditioning units of your installation, floor by floor and room by room.

What you can see
• Your rooms, grouped by floor, as configured for your installation
• For each air conditioner: on/off state and set temperature
• Room temperature, where your AC system reports it
• Fan speed and swing setting (display only)
• Whether your gateway is connected, reconnecting or unavailable, and when the values shown are the last known status

Control
BacAir includes on/off and set-temperature controls (18–30 °C, one AC at a time). The app sends a change only while your gateway is connected and shows it as awaiting confirmation until the gateway confirms it. Remote control is switched on by AmbiAutomation from its cloud service; until it is switched on, tapping a control shows "AC control is not enabled yet" and nothing is changed. Fan speed, swing, mode and controlling all ACs at once are not available in this version.

Also in the app
• Rename rooms on your phone (names are kept on this phone only)
• Light, dark or system theme
• A clear notice when your phone is offline

What you need
• An AmbiAutomation BACnet gateway installed in your building
• A BacAir account set up for you by AmbiAutomation. There is no sign-up in the app. At your first sign-in you choose your own password.

Privacy and security
• The app contains no advertising, analytics or crash-reporting software
• All traffic between the app and the service is encrypted (HTTPS/TLS)
• You see only the air conditioners of the installation your account is linked to

Support: support@ambimat.com
BacAir is made by AmbiAutomation, a business unit of Ambimat Electronics.

name: Ball Bounce Trillionaire
description:
Start with three free blocks and one bouncing ball. Earn game money when the ball hits a block. Merge matching blocks, add more balls, and decide when to invest in upgrades and when to save your way to $1 trillion.

In Timed Race, see how quickly you can reach the goal. The timer counts active play and saves your best finish on your device. In Casual, play at your own pace with a separate save and optional away earnings.

Watch your balance and income change on a chart as you try different layouts and upgrade strategies. Play offline on iPhone and iPad. All upgrades use money earned in the game.

name: Ball Knowledge: Chain Trivia
description:
Think you know ball? Prove it.

Ball Knowledge is the football chain game you play with your friends. Start with a team. The next player names someone who played for it. Then link that player to something new: another team, his college, his jersey number or his draft class. Every answer keeps the chain alive. Miss, repeat, or run out the clock and it's a strike. Last one standing wins.

PLAY YOUR WAY
• Live games with up to 6 friends. Share a 4-digit code and everyone plays from their own phone.
• 1v1 challenges with a running head-to-head record.
• Practice against bots any time, from Easy to Hard.

REAL BALL KNOWLEDGE
• 30,000+ real players going back to 1920, from superstars to practice-squad legends.
• Deep cuts: name a guy everyone forgot about and the whole lobby hears it.
• Challenge a bad call and let the group vote.

YOUR RULES
• Pick the era, difficulty, turn clock, strikes and more.
• Rematch with one tap and keep the same crew.

THE DAILY
• One puzzle for everyone, every day. Get from a team to a player in as few links as you can.
• Scored like golf: birdies, pars, bogeys. Keep your streak alive.

BRAGGING RIGHTS
• Badges from Bronze to Opal.
• Weekly leaderboards, friend profiles and head-to-head records.

Not affiliated with or endorsed by the NFL, any team or any player. Player names and stats are public facts.

name: BandUp: IELTS Prep
description:
BandUp helps you prepare for the IELTS test with practice that follows the official test format, then shows you exactly why each answer is right or wrong.

60+ FULL PRACTICE TESTS
• 21 Listening tests, 21 Academic Reading tests, 20 General Training Reading tests, plus 57 Writing tasks and 57 Speaking topics
• Listening recordings in the official format: narrator, time to read the questions, then the recording

OFFICIAL TEST FORMAT
• Listening: 4 parts, 40 questions, form and note completion, maps, multiple choice and matching
• Exam mode works like the computer-delivered test: all four Listening parts play once, back to back, then 2 minutes to check your answers
• Academic and General Training Reading: 3 passages or sections, 40 questions, matching headings, True/False/Not Given, summary completion and more
• Writing test with one 60-minute clock for Task 1 and Task 2
• Official-style instructions and word limits ("ONE WORD AND/OR A NUMBER")
• Full tests, single parts, or shuffled sections
• Leave mid-test and pick up later: your answers and remaining time are saved

UNDERSTAND EVERY ANSWER
• Why the answer is correct, with the exact evidence sentence
• Keyword mapping: how the question paraphrases the text
• Trap analysis for every wrong option
• A strategy tip for each question type

WRITING & SPEAKING FEEDBACK
• Task 1 (Academic chart or General Training letter) and Task 2 essays
• Speaking Parts 1–3 with speech transcription (on-device when supported)
• Estimated band scores across the four official criteria, with specific suggestions
• On devices with Apple Intelligence, an on-device AI examiner adds deeper feedback; your writing never leaves your device

STRATEGY PLAYBOOK
• Part-by-part methods for every section, with minute-by-minute time plans
• A live time coach that paces you through each part
• Technique cards for every Reading and Listening question type

TRAIN SMARTER
• Practice, Exam, Speed and Untimed modes
• British, Australian, New Zealand, Canadian and Irish accents in the Listening recordings
• Listening keeps playing with the screen locked
• Vocabulary Vault: paraphrases you miss are saved automatically and reviewed with spaced repetition
• Weak-spot analytics show which question types cost you marks, with one-tap drills
• Progress dashboard with band trajectory and readiness for your target score

EVERYWHERE YOU STUDY
• iPhone, iPad (split-screen passage and questions), Mac and Apple Watch (vocabulary and progress)

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no ads, no tracking. Progress syncs privately through your own iCloud.

BandUp is free.

Band scores are practice estimates. Tests are original or adapted from openly licensed sources and are not official IELTS materials. IELTS is a registered trademark of the British Council, IDP: IELTS Australia and Cambridge University Press & Assessment. BandUp is not affiliated with, endorsed by or approved by these organisations.

name: Bare Academy
description:
Bare Academy is a free learning app for students. Join courses, watch video lessons, read books and study offline, all in one place.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Browse a growing catalogue of courses and enroll for free
• Watch video lessons and pick up where you left off
• Read books and course documents
• Download lessons to watch offline without internet
• Keep track of your progress
• Update your profile and manage your account

FREE FOR EVERY STUDENT
Every course in the app is free. There are no purchases and no subscriptions.

YOUR ACCOUNT, YOUR CONTROL
Create an account with your phone number and email. You can sign out, remove saved sign-in details, or permanently delete your account and data from your profile at any time.

SUPPORT
Need help? Message our team on WhatsApp straight from the app.

Privacy Policy: https://bareacadamy.com/privacy
Terms of Use: https://bareacadamy.com/terms

name: Bash Practice
description:
Bash Practice is a pocket reference and quiz app for people who are new to the command line or want to refresh the bash commands they use every day.

LEARN 68 COMMON COMMANDS AND OPERATORS
• Ten categories: getting help, files and folders, viewing files, text processing, pipes and redirection, permissions and users, processes and jobs, variables and scripting, system and archives, and networking
• Search by name, another spelling, or description
• Each command has a summary, its syntax, worked examples, and tips, and shows whether it is a shell builtin, a program, or an operator
• Copy any example to the clipboard
• Mark commands as learned

PRACTICE WITH QUIZZES
• Multiple choice, or type the command yourself
• Typed answers are case-sensitive, just as bash is, and other spellings bash accepts count, such as . for source
• 5 to 30 questions per quiz
• Quiz on every command, the ones you have not learned, the ones that need review, or a single category
• See the right answer and an example after each question
• Finish with your score and a list of the commands to review

PRACTICE PIPELINES
• Pick the Pipeline: choose the pipeline that does a task
• Build the Pipeline: tap commands into order, with one decoy to leave out
• 14 pipeline tasks, 10 per round, with an explanation after each answer

TRACK YOUR PROGRESS
• Commands learned, overall and by category
• Quiz accuracy and a Needs Review list of the commands you miss most
• Reset all progress when you want to start over

LOCAL AND SIMPLE
No account, advertising, or analytics. The app does not connect to the internet and asks for no permissions. Answers are checked on your device; the app does not run bash commands or connect to a shell or server. Works on iPhone and iPad.

Your learned commands and quiz history stay on your device. They can be included in iCloud Backup or a computer backup, if you have backups turned on.

Found a bug or want a feature? Send feedback from the More options menu.

Bash Practice is free, with no in-app purchases.

Bash Practice is an independent study aid and is not affiliated with the GNU Project or the Free Software Foundation.

name: BAUKASTEN: Block Puzzle
description:
BAUKASTEN is a block puzzle made only of circles, squares and triangles.

■ FIVE MODES
Marathon, Sprint (40 lines), Ultra (120 seconds), Daily and Zen practice. Rules fit on one screen — start a run any time.

■ THREE WAYS TO PLAY
· On-screen deck: D-pad to move and rotate, A rotates, B hard drops, SELECT holds, START pauses. Hold a direction to repeat.
· Keyboard: arrow keys are enough for a full game, space hard drops, holding repeats.
· Bluetooth gamepad: pair it in iOS Settings and it is picked up automatically — D-pad, A / B / X and Menu all work.

■ SIX THEMES
Paper, Ink, Cobalt, Rust, Retro and Signal. Every theme recomputes text and mark contrast, so dark palettes stay legible. Each piece carries its own geometric mark, so colour is never the only signal.

■ MOTION, ONLY WHERE IT MATTERS
Off / Classic / Impact: landing flash, hard-drop trail and line-clear sweep. Presentation only — timing and rules never change.

■ YOUR DATA STAYS HERE
No account, no ads, no in-app purchases, no analytics SDK, no network requests. Best score, streak and the last seven days live in local storage and disappear when you delete the app.

■ DETAILS
Ghost landing guide, hold slot, combo bonuses, level speed-up, VoiceOver board actions and semantic labels on every control.

BAUKASTEN is German for "building box". The interface follows Bauhaus rules: no rounded corners, no shadows, no gradients — just black rules, paper tones and primary colours.

iPhone, iOS 17 or later. Switch between English and Simplified Chinese inside the app.

name: Bayyin
description:
Bayyin helps you review food ingredients and halal-related labels. Photograph an ingredient list to flag ingredients worth checking, scan or enter a barcode to look up products in Open Food Facts, and look for printed certifier names on packaging. Save your findings, use two local household profiles with Bayyin Duo, and exchange lists between phones by sharing a file. Available in English and Arabic with Light, Dark, and System appearance.

Bayyin helps you decide what to verify. A printed certifier name does not establish that a product is certified. Product details may be incomplete or outdated. Barcode data comes from Open Food Facts and its community contributors.

name: BaZi Star
description:
A little star fell out of the sky, and it chose you.

BaZi Star is a cozy little galaxy where you live on your own planet with a star who talks with you, remembers what matters to you, and helps you think things through the old Chinese way.

YOUR STAR
• Talk by voice or text, any time. Your star remembers your people, your plans and the small things you mentioned once.
• It checks in with a note every morning: the weather where you are, what to wear, what today is good for, and where to go gently.
• Dress it up, name it, and make the planet your home.

YOUR BAZI CHART
• BaZi ("eight characters") is the traditional Chinese chart drawn from the year, month, day and hour you were born.
• See your four pillars, your five elements, and your day sign — are you the Ocean, the Candle, the Tall Tree?
• Every character comes with its meaning in plain English. No jargon.

ASK BEFORE YOU DECIDE
• New job or stay? Move now or wait? This one or that one?
• Your star reads your chart and the chart of this very moment, looks at your life and the world right now, and tells you which way it leans — with the best time, what to watch for, and a first step.
• A reading to help you think. The choice is always yours.

YOU & SOMEONE
• A friend, a partner, a crush, a coworker: see how the two of you line up this week, and what to do together.
• Send them the card. They can add their birthday and read it from their side, no sign-up needed.

A SMALL, KIND GALAXY
• Visit your friends' planets, leave notes and little presents, and start a circle to chat together.
• Bring a friend and you both get extra talking time.

GOOD TO KNOW
• Your star is an AI companion. It is not a person and it is not a professional. Readings are for reflection and fun.
• No account needed. You can read, correct and erase everything your star remembers about you at any time.
• No ads. No tracking.

Privacy Policy: https://starcircle.expo.app/legal/privacy.html
Terms of Use: https://starcircle.expo.app/legal/terms.html

name: Belt Wrap
description:
Belt Wrap names the drive whose wrap is under 120 degrees.

Wrap comes from the two pulleys and the center. Drag the small pulley. If the wrap is under 120 degrees, the shortest drive is named. A pulley pair that does not fit is not stored. Changing the center does not rewrite the small pulley. The last drive stays.

A sound stays on the iPhone and does not change the pulley. Share the call when you choose to. There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: Best in Town Pizza Castor Ave
description:
Order from Best In Town Pizza, the brick oven pizza and seafood shop at Castor & Rhawn in Northeast Philadelphia. 100% beef products, no pork, halal.

Browse the full menu, build your order your way, and have it ready for pickup or delivered to your door.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
– Browse the whole menu: pizza, gourmet and Sicilian pizza, stuffed pizza, strombolis, calzones, cheesesteaks, hoagies, burgers, wraps, wings, salads, pasta and Italian platters
– Order steamed seafood platters: shrimp, snow crab clusters, lobster tail, Dungeness crab, mussels and clams, served with corn, broccoli and potatoes
– Pick your pizza size and toppings, with the price updating as you go
– Grab everyday, lunch and family specials, plus buy 4 plain pizzas and get the 5th free
– Order catering trays for parties, events and office lunches (half tray serves 8, full tray serves 16)
– Choose pickup or delivery
– Pay by card in the app
– Track your order and get a notification when it's ready

ABOUT BEST IN TOWN PIZZA 
"If you want the best, forget the rest!" Fresh brick oven pizza, fried and steamed seafood, and hot sandwiches at 7971 Castor Ave, Philadelphia, PA 19152 (corner of Rhawn & Castor).

Open Monday to Thursday 11 AM to 11 PM, Friday and Saturday 11 AM to midnight, and Sunday 12 PM to 10 PM.

Questions about an order? Call us at (215) 725-0400 or (215) 725-0488.

name: Biathlon: Ski & Shoot
description:
The gun goes off and the whole field pushes into the first corner. Tap in rhythm for every push, tuck in behind a rival and attack on the climb. Then the range: bring your pulse down, hold your breath, mind the wind, five targets. Every miss costs a penalty loop.

Twelve venues, every stadium different: from a fjord with a stave church past a glacier with a gondola to a night race under floodlights. Under stone bridges, past horse sleighs and TV cameras. Split times and gaps appear just like on a TV broadcast.

- Sprint and mass start, prone and standing
- World Cup tour with stars at every venue
- A full season with championships, a finale and the hunt for the crystal globe
- Family duel: a relay for 2 to 4 players on one phone
- Workshop: spend prize money on better skis, poles, suit and rifle stock, and pick the right wax
- Your own athlete with name, nation and colors

Pay once, get everything. No ads, no tracking, no in-app purchases. Part of the No Hooks series.

name: Bible Cinema: Stories & Guide
description:
The Bible, as cinema. Every word straight from Scripture.

Bible Cinema tells the Bible in order, from Genesis onward, as short cinematic episodes you can watch in a minute or two. The narration is the Bible text itself, the Berean Standard Bible, word for word. Nothing added, no made-up dialogue, and the verse reference is always on screen.

WATCH IN ORDER
• Short vertical episodes, one story at a time, like a series.
• Pick up where you left off. Today always shows your next episode.
• New episodes every week.

CHECK EVERY WORD
• Open Read to see the full chapter. The verses you just heard are highlighted.
• Adjustable text size, easy to read.

ASK GRACE, YOUR AI GUIDE
• After each story, ask Grace your questions about it.
• Grace answers from Scripture and shows the verses with every answer. Every verse is checked word for word against the BSB.
• Grace is an AI, not a pastor. She stays out of denominational and political debates and points you to your church.
• You decide what Grace remembers, and you can delete it any time.

BUILD A DAILY HABIT
• Light a candle each day you watch. Miss a day? A weekly grace day keeps your candle lit.
• A gentle daily reminder at the time you choose. No guilt, no spam.
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets with your next story and a verse.

FOR FAMILIES
• Watch together and create kid profiles. Mature passages are skipped for kids.
• Hard stories are told honestly, with a heads-up before mature passages.
• Bedtime mode: listen with the screen dimmed and a sleep timer.

HONEST AND FREE TO START
• No account needed. No ads.
• Your first 10 stories are free, then one free episode every day.
• Premium unlocks every episode right away and more time with Grace.
• No weekly plans. No paywall before you've watched a single story.
• Can't afford it? Write to us and ask for a scholarship.

ABOUT THE VIDEOS
Images and video are created with AI. Every narrated word in the stories is from the Berean Standard Bible. The BSB is a modern, faithful English translation in the public domain, so anyone can check every word. Grace's answers are written by AI and can make mistakes, so the verses are always shown for you to check.

SUBSCRIPTION
Bible Cinema Premium is an optional auto-renewing subscription: Monthly, Yearly (with a 7-day free trial for eligible new subscribers) or Family Yearly (with a 7-day free trial, shared with up to 6 people through Family Sharing). Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel it in your App Store account settings. Any unused part of a free trial ends when you buy a subscription.

Terms of Use: https://api-production-12d66c3a.up.railway.app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://api-production-12d66c3a.up.railway.app/privacy
Support: bible.cinema.app@gmail.com

name: Birdie Run Run
description:
One tired little bird. Endless power lines. A very hungry alley cat.

Birdie Run Run is a one-tap endless runner that looks like a child drew it in crayon and moves like stop motion.

HOW TO PLAY
- Tap to jump off the wire
- Tap again to flap
- Flapping is tiring, so grab seeds to keep your energy up

WATCH OUT
- Crows sitting on the line
- Live sections of wire that zap
- Wires that snap if you land too hard
- The alley cat. When it chases you, jump for the coffee or you will not make the gap

COFFEE MAKES A SUPER BIRDIE
Grab a coffee and Birdie turns into a caped hero who flaps for free and knocks crows off the line.

200+ LOOKS TO UNLOCK
11 birds and 20 outfits each. Buy them with seeds in the shop, or crack eggs from the prize machine to win a random look.

RUN INTO THE NIGHT
Go far enough and the sun sets, the moon rises and the stars come out.

Free to play with ads. Optional seed packs are available as in-app purchases.

name: Birthday Reminder - No Ads
description:
Birthday Reminder shows who's next, how many days are left and how old they turn. It reminds you ahead of time and again on the day. The core app is free, with no ads and no limit on how many dates you add.

What's free
• Birthdays, anniversaries, memorials and date types you name yourself
• Dates with or without the year
• Each row shows the days left and the age they turn, such as "in 3 days" and "turns 70"
• Up to 3 reminders per date: on the day, or 1, 2, 3, 7 or 14 days before, at a time you pick
• Home Screen widgets in three sizes, and Lock Screen widgets
• Import birthdays from the contacts you pick
• iCloud sync, so your list moves with you to a new iPhone
• Export a backup file or a spreadsheet, and import it again
• An emoji or a photo for each person
• Search, a filter by type, and mute for one person's reminders
• One-time events count down, then show "days ago" once they pass

Memorials
Memorial reminders use plain wording, such as "Remembering Dad today". They never say "Happy".

Privacy
There's no account to create, and the app has no ads or tracking. Your dates stay on your iPhone and in your own iCloud. The App Store privacy label reads "Data Not Collected."

Plus, $4.99 one time
Plus adds 8 accent themes, 4 app icons, 8 widget styles and 5 reminder sounds. It only changes how the app looks and sounds, so every feature above stays free. You pay once, there's no subscription, and Family Sharing is on.

Support
Write to benarikutai@gmail.com. We reply within 2 business days.

name: Bizmo.Loop
description:
Bizmo.Loop is your organization's app for chat, calls and workflows. One-to-one and group chats, announcement channels, voice and video calls, calendar and tasks in one place.

CHAT
• One-to-one, group and channel chats with replies, mentions, reactions and threads
• Share photos, videos, documents and voice messages
• Read receipts, typing indicators, pinning and archive
• Turn a date and time in a message into a calendar event with one tap

CALLS
• Voice and video calls, group calls
• Incoming calls on the iPhone call screen, even when the app is closed
• Join meetings with a link

WORKFLOW
• Calendar with agenda, day, week and month views; respond to invitations
• Tasks and follow-ups
• Approval requests, shift handovers and reminders

EVERYWHERE
• Reply, mark as read and mute right from notifications
• Apple Watch app, Home Screen widgets and share extension
• iPhone and iPad

SECURITY
• Sign in with your organization account through Bizmo.ID
• Messages are stored encrypted; data stays in Türkiye
• Screen hiding in the app switcher and privacy mode

Your organization's Bizmo account is required to use Bizmo.Loop. The app interface is in Turkish.

name: BKIADGCO
description: This application focuses on a simple and convenient user experience. It adopts an intuitive interface design and a clear structural layout, providing practical and easy-to-operate functions to facilitate users' daily use and browsing of relevant information. The application includes a variety of functional modules, covering information display, classified view, data processing, chart presentation, calendar layout and related auxiliary functions.

name: Black Engineer News
description:
Black Engineer News brings the reporting of US Black Engineer & Information Technology magazine to your iPhone. Read the latest stories on engineering and technology careers, STEM education, and the people and institutions shaping the future of the technical workforce.

Follow coverage of the BEYA STEM Conference, HBCU engineering programs, professional development, and career opportunities across industry, government, and academia — updated continuously from blackengineer.com.

Browse by section, search the latest headlines, save stories to read later, and pick up where you left off offline with the most recent headlines cached on your device. Tap any story to read the full article.

Black Engineer News is published by Career Communications Group, Inc., the voice of STEM diversity publishing for more than three decades.

name: BlackWhiteDigitalPaint
description: BlackWhiteDigitalPaint is an offline, single-player black-and-white nonogram game. Each row has a set of numbers to its left, and each column has a set above it, indicating the lengths of consecutive filled-in (blackened) segments. Players fill in the appropriate cells and mark those that should remain empty with an "X," gradually revealing a pixel-art image within the grid.

name: BLE Beacon Sender
description:
BLE Beacon turns an iPhone or iPad into a Bluetooth beacon. It sends one fixed ID, and receivers nearby recognize it. For example for presence in a smart home, or to see if a device is there.

Works best with an old iPhone: plug it in, open the app, done. It starts sending on its own.

• One button: start or stop sending.
• Fixed ID: stays the same as long as the app is installed. Enter it in your receiver once.
• Shows up in beacon finder apps on Android and iPhone as an iBeacon, with the same ID.
• Give it your own name, like "Kitchen iPhone". Bluetooth scanner apps show that name.
• Sends automatically whenever the app is open, also after a restart.
• On a charger it shows a calm, dark clock and keeps sending. Turn it sideways for a big clock. At night it glows dim red.
• Signal Check: with a second iPhone you can see how strong the signal is and how far it reaches.
• History: when was it sending, and why did it stop?
• For iPhone and iPad on iOS 15 and later, in German and English.

No ads, no account, no data collected. It needs no internet, only Bluetooth.

Good to know: in the background or on the Lock Screen, iOS limits sending and many receivers won't see the ID. Keep the app open. On a charger the screen stays on.

name: Blip: Quick Texts
description:
Blip turns the messages you send every day into tiles on your iPhone. Tap one, and Messages opens with the person and the words already filled in. All that's left is Send.

On my way. Leaving work now. Home in 20. Landed, call you soon. Instead of opening Messages, finding the person and typing the same words again, keep them one tap away.

PICK YOUR PEOPLE
Choose the people you text most with Apple's contact picker. Blip receives only the number or email you tap, never your whole address book.

SAVE YOUR USUAL MESSAGES
Start from suggestions or write your own. Each person and message becomes a Blip.

TAP TO SEND
Tap a Blip in the app or on the Home Screen widget. Messages opens ready to go, and nothing is sent until you tap Send.

PIN YOUR FAVORITES
Pin the Blips you use most to the top of Home and to the widget, in small, medium and large sizes. Blip shows when you last sent each one.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no analytics, no ads, no tracking and no servers. Your people and messages stay on your iPhone.

Blip sends through Apple's Messages app, so it needs an iPhone that can send messages.

name: BlissWave Collection
description:
BlissWave Collection es tu tienda de joyería en oro laminado 14k y aromas para el hogar.

En la app puedes:
• Ver toda la colección: cadenas, pulseras, aretes, anillos y sets.
• Descubrir las piezas nuevas en cuanto llegan.
• Conocer nuestros difusores, velas y cajas de regalo.
• Armar tu pedido y enviarlo en pocos pasos.
• Escribirnos por WhatsApp para cualquier duda.

Piezas bonitas y a buen precio para que te sientas bien todos los días.

name: BLOCK UP! - Brick Breaker
description:
BLOCK UP! is a brick breaker that keeps climbing upward.
Move your bar freely in every direction, bounce the ball, smash bricks and see how high you can go!

- EASY CONTROLS
Tap where you want the bar to go, or just drag it. The bar moves up and down as well as left and right, giving classic brick breaking a fresh feel.

- FROM THE SKY TO OUTER SPACE
Blue sky, floating ruins, a thunderstorm, outer space and an unknown world.
Every stage brings new scenery, new music and new hazards like lightning, meteors and mischievous monsters.
Climb high enough and a secret stage may be waiting...

- GIANT BOSS BATTLES
Huge bosses appear as you climb. Dodge their charges, falling rocks, fire breath and teleport barrages, then strike the core when it opens!

- POWER-UPS AND COMBOS
- Multi-Ball: more balls at once
- Fire Ball: burns through bricks
- Elec Ball: shocks nearby bricks
- Laser Bar: fire lasers from your bar
- Wide Bar: a longer bar
- Shield: saves a falling ball once
- Smash: pierces through bricks
Break bricks in a row to build combos. The speed rises every 1000 m.

- WORLD RANKING
Post your high score to the world ranking and compete with players everywhere. A marker shows your best height so you always know when a new record is close.

- COLLECT SKINS
Earn coins as you play and unlock new bars and balls. Skins are cosmetic only, so nobody gets an unfair advantage.

- THREE LIVES
You get three lives. If you lose them all, you can watch an ad once per run to continue.

NOTES
- Free to play with ads.
- Optional in-app purchases (Remove Ads and some skins). None are needed to progress.
- The world ranking requires an internet connection.

name: Bloody Nights
description:
Bloody Nights puts the classic vampires-versus-villagers party game on a single phone. The phone is the narrator, so everybody plays.

HOW IT WORKS
• Enter the names in seating order, 5–16 players.
• The phone goes round the table and everyone secretly sees their role.
• At night the phone goes round again. Vampires bite, the Doctor protects, the Seer questions someone. Players with no night action solve quick math questions. Everyone gets the same kind of screen and every turn has a minimum time, so nobody can tell who did what.
• In the morning, whoever holds the phone reads the report out loud. Argue, then vote by show of hands; the player with the most votes is hanged.
• The village wins by catching every vampire. The vampires win once they match everyone else in numbers. The Jester wins alone if the village hangs them.

ROLES
Villager, Vampire, Doctor, Seer, Hunter, and the Jester who wants to be hanged.

FEATURES
• Ready-made setups for every group size, or pick the roles yourself
• Settings: discussion timer, reveal roles on death, tie rule and more
• No internet, no account, no ads; no data collected
• English, Spanish and Turkish

name: BloomTask: Cute To-Do & Focus
description:
BloomTask turns your to-do list into a cozy little world. Every task you finish feeds your companion, earns coins and helps them grow. No streaks, no guilt — just gentle progress.

FRIENDLY FOR ADHD & BUSY BRAINS
• Tiny steps make getting started easier
• Gentle nudges instead of pressure
• A focus timer with a friend by your side
• Instant rewards for every little win

MEET YOUR COMPANION
Start with Sakura, a dreamy cherry blossom in a tiny pot. With BloomTask Plus you can also adopt Momo the curious cat, Coco the calm capybara and Mochi the cheerful bunny. Pet them, play with them and see their happy reactions.

TASKS MADE GENTLE
• Quick add in seconds: today, tomorrow or someday
• Break big tasks into small steps
• Priorities, categories, due times and soft reminders
• Repeating tasks for your routines
• Swipe to finish, snooze or reschedule

REWARDS THAT FEEL GOOD
• Earn XP and coins for every finished task and step
• Watch your companion level up from Baby to Special
• A daily bloom that fills as you go — every task counts

A LITTLE WORLD THAT GROWS WITH YOU
• Decorate your Cozy Bedroom with plants, rugs and cushions
• Unlock more worlds and decorations with Plus

FOCUS TOGETHER
• A calm focus timer with your companion by your side
• Live Activity and Dynamic Island support
• Earn bonus rewards for focused time

ALWAYS WITHIN REACH
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets
• Tick off tasks right from the widget
• iPhone and iPad, synced with your private iCloud
• English, Türkçe, 日本語, 한국어 and 简体中文

DESIGNED TO BE KIND
BloomTask is made for real life: forgiving, soft and encouraging. It's for anyone who prefers small steps. Your data stays on your device and in your private iCloud — no accounts, no ads, no tracking.

BLOOMTASK PLUS
Unlock Momo, Coco and Mochi, rare outfits, five extra worlds with every premium decoration, extra repeat options and weekly insights. Choose monthly or yearly; prices are shown in the app in your currency. The subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel any time in your Apple Account settings. If Plus ends, nothing is deleted.

Terms of Use: https://tarikcinetci.github.io/BloomTask-legal/terms.html
Privacy Policy: https://tarikcinetci.github.io/BloomTask-legal/privacy.html

name: Bodyladder: Calisthenics
description:
Bodyladder is a calisthenics skill tree. It shows where you are, what to train today and what opens next, from your first wall push-up to a muscle-up or a freestanding handstand.

How it works
Answer five quick questions, one per branch, to find your starting point. Or skip them and start from the first step.
Each step is one exercise with a clear target, like 3 sets of 8 or 3 holds of 30 seconds. Hit the target and the next step opens.
Your workout for today is put together from your current steps: 3 to 5 exercises with sets, reps and a rest timer. Log what you did and you are done.
Too hard? Go back a step anytime. There are no streaks to lose and no penalties for a missed day.

Five branches, 47 steps
Push-ups: from wall push-ups to one-arm push-ups
Pull-ups: from a dead hang to a muscle-up
Core: from dead bugs to an L-sit and toes to bar
Legs: from box squats to pistol squats
Handstand: from a pike hold to a 30-second freestanding handstand

Every step comes with a drawing of the key position, technique cues, common mistakes, and an easier and a harder option.
Every step and its target are set in advance and are the same for everyone. Nothing is generated on the fly.

No account, no internet
Bodyladder works without sign-up and without a connection. Your workouts and history stay on your phone. Export them to a single file and import them back anytime.

The price, up front
The push-ups and pull-ups branches are free forever, with every step, workout, timer and your history. Core, legs and handstand are part of Bodyladder Pro. You see the price on the first screen, before any questions, and the payment screen opens only when you tap a locked branch.

Who it is not for
Bodyladder has no videos, no meal plans and no calorie counting. It is a map of bodyweight skills and a log of your training.

Bodyladder Pro: yearly subscription (renews automatically, cancel anytime in your App Store settings) or one-time lifetime purchase.
Terms: https://mordansoft.com/legal/bodyladder/terms.html
Privacy: https://mordansoft.com/legal/bodyladder/privacy.html

Bodyladder is a training guide, not a medical device, and does not diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any medical condition. Consult a healthcare professional before starting a new exercise program, especially if you have an injury or a medical condition.

name: Bolt Star
description:
Bolt Star checks a flange star.

Tap the next bolt. The star is 1, 5, 3, 7, 2, 6, 4, 8. A bolt tapped out of turn is not stored. The first bolt stays, and the last flange stays.

Share an English flange list. A brought-in note stays on the iPhone and is not part of the star. There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: Book Hostage
description:
Book Hostage keeps track of the books you lend, the books you borrow, and the friends who have had your copy of The Secret History since spring.

Add your shelf in minutes. Snap a cover, scan the barcode, type an ISBN, or import a spreadsheet. Book details and covers come from Open Library, so you're not typing titles by hand.

Lend in two taps. Pick the book, pick the friend, pick a due date. Book Hostage remembers who has what, and sends a friendly nudge when a return date comes around. No awkward texts required.

Borrow with manners. Browse your friends' shelves, ask to borrow a book, ask for more time when life happens, and mark it returned when it's back where it belongs.
Track loans outside the app. Lent a book to your aunt who will never download anything? Log it anyway. Only you see it.

Every copy keeps a Book Wall. When a book comes back, leave a note for the next reader. Over time, your copy collects its own little history of everyone who read it.

Also inside:
• Your library in a grid of covers or a tidy list, filtered by genre and status
• A Want to Read list, and recommendations from friends
• What you're reading now, with your page and private notes (share it with friends only if you want to)
• Search that covers your shelf and your friends' shelves at once
• Push notifications for requests, due dates and returns
• Invite friends with your own link

Private by default. Your shelf is visible only to friends you accept. No ads, no selling your data, no tracking across other apps. You can delete your account and everything in it from Settings at any time.

Book Hostage is made by Rue & Raven LLC, a small independent studio in North Carolina.

Terms: https://bookhostage.com/terms Privacy: https://bookhostage.com/privacy Questions: support@bookhostage.com

name: Bore Plate
description:
Bore Plate checks an orifice plate.

Drag one bore. The plate is named when that bore leaves 0.20 to 0.75 of the pipe. Changing the pipe does not rewrite stored bores. A bore thinner than 8 mm is not stored, and the last plate stays.

Share an English plate list. A photo stays on the iPhone and is not part of the bore. There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: Bothell Huskies
description:
Bothell Huskies families use this app to see every practice and game for their player's team, answer Going or Not going, and talk with the coach and the other parents, all in one place.

This is the Bothell Huskies basketball club's own app, for its players, their parents and its coaches. The club runs teams from 5th/6th grade through 8th grade, and the app keeps each team's practices and games in one list with the time and the gym, and tells families the moment something moves.

Parents answer Going or Not going for each practice and game, so the coach knows who to expect before walking into the gym. Each team has its own Announcements channel and team chat, and parents can message a coach directly instead of hunting for a phone number.

When a game is streamed from the sideline, family members who cannot be there watch it live, and the game stays in the app afterward to watch again. Coaches can share plays and drills for players to look at between sessions.

Accounts come from the club: families join through the invite their coach or the club sends. There is nothing to browse outside Bothell Huskies and no public directory of players.

name: Boxwren
description:
Moving house is calmer when you know what is inside every carton before you open a single flap. Boxwren helps you organize rooms, pack boxes quickly, print scannable QR labels, and stay on schedule for moving day—all privately on your device.

Build a simple floor plan of your new home using draggable, resizable room blocks, or switch to a straightforward room list whenever you prefer. Every room displays a live count of packed versus total boxes so you can see progress at a glance.

Label a box in under ten seconds: Boxwren assigns sequential codes (BX-001, BX-002, and onward), lets you add items individually or paste a multi-line list that splits automatically into items with quantities, attach an optional photo, choose a box size, and mark tags such as Fragile, Open First, Heavy, or Valuables.

Print QR labels directly from your iPhone or iPad as 6-per-page sticker sheets or 1-large-per-page labels, or share the PDF with anyone helping you pack. Scan a label inside Boxwren—or point the built-in Camera app—to jump straight to that box's contents. Manual code entry is always available if a camera is unavailable.

Search across box codes, item names, destination rooms, and tags in one field. View Open First essentials, Fragile cartons, Heavy boxes, or export a large-type Load List PDF grouped by room for your moving crew.

Stay ahead of deadlines with an editable move-day checklist covering utilities, address changes, keys, and cleaning, with due dates calculated from your move date and optional on-device reminders.

Your inventory stays on your iPhone and iPad with no accounts, no tracking, and no cloud lock-in. Export your data as JSON or CSV anytime, or erase everything with one confirmation.

name: Brain Breaker
description:
Brain Breaker — сборник логических игр для всех возрастов. Без интернета, без рекламы, без регистрации.

• Сдвиг блоков — выведите красный блок из затора
• Лабиринт-квест — ключи, двери, телепорты и стражи
• Переправа — волк, коза, капуста и другие классические задачи
• Точки — окружите точки соперника: против компьютера или вдвоём на одном телефоне
• Пробирки — переливайте цвета, пока каждая пробирка не станет одного цвета
• Маршрут — проведите одну линию через все клетки по порядку чисел

Сотни уровней от простых до по-настоящему сложных, подсказки, звёзды за прохождение. Прогресс хранится только на вашем устройстве. Хотите новую игру или улучшение — напишите прямо из приложения.

name: Brass Pan
description:
Brass Pan is for the person standing at a mail slot with one parcel. You write its name, slide the brass rider until it stays on the ounces, and put it on the shelf. You drag that parcel onto the pan, turn the collar until it stays on a slot limit, and read how many ounces are under or over that limit. You pull the felt latch down until it catches, and the slip keeps the ounces, the limit, and the time on this iPhone.

Brass Pan does not weigh a real parcel, connect to a scale, or send the parcel. It does not create a file, and it does not ask you to sign in. Nothing is sent off the phone. The next time you open it, the same parcel and the same slip are still there.

name: Breaker Tag
description:
Breaker Tag keeps a breaker cover’s name, and the load on each slot, on this iPhone.

The cover starts shut, and every slot inside is blank. Write the name that belongs on the cover, then drag the lip up to open it. Open a slot, stamp the amps printed on that breaker — 15, 20, or 30 — and write the load it feeds. Drag the handle down. That load is listed as dark, with the time the handle was pulled.

Open In the dark later to see which tagged slot is off. Tagged slots stay on this iPhone. Nothing is uploaded and nothing is shared.

Breaker Tag does not measure current, move a real breaker, or decide whether a circuit is safe.

name: BrickStep
description:
BrickStep is a native iPad viewer for LDraw, MPD, and BrickLink Studio model files.

Open a model and inspect it in an interactive 3D viewport. Move through the building sequence, rotate and zoom around the model, select individual parts, and review the parts needed for each step.

FEATURES

• Open local .io, .ldr, and .mpd model files
• Navigate building steps with a slider, buttons, keyboard arrows, or autoplay
• Orbit with one finger, pinch to zoom, and use two fingers to pan
• Switch between Normal, Transparent, and Desaturated display modes
• Select parts and highlight matching part instances
• Review a searchable bill of materials for the full model or the current step
• Export the bill of materials as CSV
• Use isometric, front, back, side, and top camera presets
• Capture the current view and share it through the system share sheet
• Connect an external LDraw parts library for detailed model geometry
• Keep recent model bookmarks and step favorites on the device

BrickStep performs model parsing and view preparation on the device. No account is required, and the app does not include advertising, analytics, or cross-app tracking.

Studio instruction page layouts, callouts, and custom instruction graphics are not rendered. Step order and added parts are derived from the embedded LDraw data.

The app interface is currently available in English.

BrickStep is an independent product and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the LEGO Group, BrickLink, or the LDraw organization.

name: Bridge Isles: Cozy Builder
description:
A cat wants to sunbathe on the other bank. A fox is off to visit a friend. A cow is heading to the greener grass across the river. All they need is a bridge — and you get to build it.

Drag from one dot to another to lay a plank. Tap Go, and watch them walk across. If the bridge sags, creaks and splashes into the water, that's fine: everyone swims back, and you tweak it and try again.

• 40 HANDCRAFTED LEVELS, 5 ISLAND GROUPS
Starter Cove, Windmill Meadows, Stone Valley, River Mouth and Harbor Town. Each group brings something new: triangles that stop the wobble, stone that can only push, ropes that hang a bridge from tall towers, boats that need room to pass, little islands in the middle of the river, old bridges to reuse and heavy carts to carry.

• SEE THE FORCES
While the bridge holds the load, every piece glows: blue when it's pulled, orange when it's pushed, yellow when it bends. You'll understand why a bridge works without a single formula.

• NO RUSH, NO PRESSURE
No timers, no lives, no energy. No answers are shown either — the fun is figuring it out yourself.

• THREE STARS PER LEVEL
Get across, use no more pieces than suggested, and make it on the first try. Come back any time to do better.

• FAIR AND CLEAN
The first island group (8 levels) is free. One purchase unlocks everything, including all future islands. No ads. No subscriptions. No data collected.

• PAINTED LOOK, SOFT SOUNDS
Hand-painted banks and skies, water that mirrors your bridge, creaking wood and gentle haptics.

Plays in portrait and landscape, on iPhone and iPad, fully offline.

name: Bridges: Hashi Puzzle
description:
Connect every island into one network, using exactly as many bridges as each island's number.

Bridges (also known as Hashi or Hashiwokakero) is a classic logic puzzle. Bridges run straight across the water, never cross each other, and at most two link the same pair of islands. Read the numbers, place the bridges that must be there, and watch the archipelago come together. Every level, daily and quick-play puzzle has exactly one solution, reachable by logic alone.

A JOURNEY ACROSS 12 ARCHIPELAGOS
• 360 levels, from a gentle 7 × 7 lagoon to a 20 × 25 open-sea expedition
• Earn up to 3 stars on every level; each archipelago unlocks the next

PLAY YOUR WAY
• Daily puzzle: one 12 × 12 puzzle a day for everyone, with a streak and a month calendar
• Quick play: 7 × 7 to 25 × 25, four levels (Easy, Medium, Hard, Expert), endless new puzzles
• Enter a puzzle code to play a puzzle from a friend or a book

HELPFUL, NOT INTRUSIVE
• Drag from island to island, or tap the water between them: 1 bridge, 2 bridges, none
• Finished islands dim, overfull ones turn red; tap an island to see its connected group
• 3 hints per game (watch an ad for more when they run out); each hint names the technique and explains why
• "Check" points out wrong bridges; stuck? Show the solution (that game gets no stars)
• Solving tips: eight techniques with worked examples, plus an interactive tutorial
• Undo and redo without limit; pinch to zoom on big boards

STARS AND PROGRESS
• 3 stars: solved without hints and under the target time
• Statistics for every board size and level, 12 achievements

ON EVERY SCREEN
• Phones and tablets, with layouts made for each: tab bar on phones, sidebar and side panel on tablets and desktop
• Keyboard and right click on Mac
• Dark design, English and Vietnamese

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account needed
• Never an ad while you solve. Remove ads for good with a one-time purchase, no subscription (the Mac version has no ads)
• Works fully offline; your progress stays on your device

name: BTM Dispatch
description:
BTM Dispatch is the dispatcher's app for carriers that run on Box Truck Manage. Work for one carrier or several, all from one account.

BOARD
See the live load board built from broker postings, as soon as loads arrive. Use filters to narrow the board, open a load for its details and freight, and bid with the truck and driver of your choice. Before anything goes out you can preview the bid email.

BIDS
Follow every bid in one list. Switch between Everyone, Me and Drivers to see all bids, your own, or the bids your drivers sent from the BTM Driver app.

INBOX
Broker replies arrive as conversations. Read them and answer from your phone.

PERFORMANCE
See your profit for the month, a calendar of your days, and the loads you booked on each day.

WORKSPACES
One BTM Dispatch account can hold several carriers, called workspaces. To add one, open Profile in your carrier's Box Truck Manage on the web and show the link code, then scan it with the app. You can also type the short code instead. Switch workspaces from the name at the top of the screen, and remove one in Profile at any time.

YOUR DATA AND YOUR CARRIER
Bids go out as email from the mailbox your carrier connected to your Box Truck Manage user, sent by the carrier's own servers. Loads, bids, emails and performance come directly from your carrier's servers. The camera is used only to scan the link code on your screen; the picture is not uploaded or stored. The app does not use your location, contacts or photos, and shows no ads. You can change your password, sign out or delete your account in Profile.

BTM Dispatch is free. To use it you need a Box Truck Manage user at a carrier that uses Box Truck Manage.

name: Bucko The Dino
description:
Need a pick-me-up? Meet Bucko the Dino, Your Burnout Buddy.
 
Bucko is a small, nerdy dinosaur with a desk, big round glasses and a strong opinion about meetings. Tell him how your day is going and he points you to a room that fits your mood, or wander the whole office yourself.
 
40 ROOMS, ALL OPEN
• Quick arcade games: Bucko Claw, Reply-All Apocalypse, Notification Ninja, Leave at 5, Look Busy, Mute!, Parking Lot, Elevator Rush, Corporate Ladder, Resume Rush, Punch Clock, Type It Up, Smash Room, and the Dino-Tron 3000, a retro computer that plays Solitaire with Bucko's own deck.
• One of Those Days: race the rush-hour commute, save the Wi-Fi, or throw laptops into a dumpster fire.
• Venting and comedy: The Firing Room, Resignation Station, Just Say No, Jargon Bingo, Wheel of Excuses, Scream Jar, Grand Theft Lunch, and Office Dex, which turns coworkers into collectible cards.
• Cozy corners: the Sensory Room with ten calming toys, Sticker Book, Pixel Lightbox, Zen Garden, Bucko's Aquarium, Gerald the plant, Lunch Break and Pizza Party.
 
DJ BUCKO SINGS YOU A SONG
The request line is open. Pick a beat (Rock, Pop, Dance, Country, R&B, Hip Hop, Acoustic or Random), tell Bucko how you feel, then let him surprise you or choose what your song is about: payday, endless meetings, the boss, a beach far away. He says a few words, sings it just for you, and signs off. Send the song to a friend.
 
STARS, CHALLENGES AND ACHIEVEMENTS
Timed rooms have three stars to chase, and there are 31 achievements to unlock.
 
MADE FOR THE FOLD
Designed for iPhone Duo, open or half-folded, and at home on iPhone and iPad.
 
PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Fully offline. No account, no sign-in, no ads, no in-app purchases.
• Nothing you type, draw or shout leaves your device.
• The Scream Jar listens to how loud you are and records nothing.
 
SHARE THE MOOD
Send a Bucko card, an excuse from the Wheel of Excuses or an Office Dex card to a friend who needs one.
 
Bucko the Dino is a game, for entertainment purposes only. It is not medical or mental health advice.

name: Buildexa
description:
Manage builder inquiries, customers, bookings, payments, and sales operations in one place.

Buildexa is a comprehensive property sales and inquiry management application designed to help builders and real estate teams manage their day-to-day sales operations efficiently.
With Buildexa, your sales team can manage customer inquiries, properties, bookings, payments, and customer information from a single platform.
Key Features
-> Property & Site Management
Manage projects, sites, buildings, floors, units, and availability in an organized manner.
-> Customer Management
Maintain customer information and easily access customer-related inquiries, bookings, and activities.
-> Inquiry Management
Create and manage customer inquiries, capture requirements, track unit preferences, and follow up with prospects.
-> Unit & Inventory Management
View available and booked units, manage unit information, and keep track of property inventory.
-> Booking Management
Manage property bookings with unit-wise pricing, booking status, token/advance amounts, and payment information.
-> Payment Management
Track payments, pending amounts, payment status, and booking-related financial information.

Access sales and operational reports to monitor business activities and make informed decisions.

Manage managers and sales users with role-based permissions, site assignments, and controlled data visibility.

Use WhatsApp-based communication and notifications to help sales teams stay connected with customers.

Buildexa is designed for convenient use across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices, including mobile WebView environments.

Administrators can control what different team members can view and manage, helping businesses maintain appropriate access to operational data.

About Buildexa
Buildexa is developed by Trixon Tech Private Limited, providing technology solutions designed to simplify business and property sales operations.

name: BuildIt: Build and Race
description:
Build it. Send it. Prove it.

buildit is a machine-building game where your design does the driving. Put together an engine, frame, wheels and mechanical parts, then watch your creation tackle the track with real physics.

START IN THE GARAGE
Choose a ready-made machine or build your own. Connect and customize parts, try different engines and tires, experiment with suspension, and save your favorite builds. Optional tutorials show you the tools through hands-on building.

WATCH YOUR IDEAS MOVE
Send your machine over slopes, gaps, rough surfaces and water. Grip, weight, gearing and construction all affect what happens. A failed run is another clue for your next design.

TAKE ON A CHALLENGE
Try the Daily challenge, compare verified results in the rankings, or share an asynchronous challenge with friends. Return to the same design after a race and keep improving it.

MAKE YOUR OWN TRACK
Shape roads, paint surfaces and add physical obstacles in the track editor. Test your course with your own machine before sharing it.

REVISIT THE RACE
Watch recorded runs and compare machines. Use the replay tools to look at what worked and what needs another try.

Online features, including shared challenges and rankings, require an internet connection. Available features may depend on your device.

name: Caelum: Guía del Cielo
description:
Caelum turns the sky into a place you can understand.

POINT & DISCOVER
Raise your iPhone to the sky and Caelum shows where you’re looking and what’s there: planets, stars and constellations, mapped to your location.

YOUR GUIDE TO THE UNIVERSE
Explore planet, star, nebula and galaxy profiles with real images from NASA, ESA/Hubble and ESO. Choose who tells the story: a child-friendly guide, a presenter or an astrophysicist.

ASK THE PROFESSOR
Why is Mars red? How long does it take to reach the Moon? Type or dictate a question and the professor will answer.

TONIGHT & WHAT’S NEXT
Moon phases, visible planets, meteor showers and eclipses, with dates and where to see them.

LIVE
See the Sun in real time from space observatories, Earth from the Space Station, and get alerts when a space agency streams a launch.

THE HISTORY OF ASTRONOMY
From Stonehenge to the James Webb telescope: 35 moments that changed what we know about the universe.

CAELUM PREMIUM (one-time purchase, no subscription)
• All three guides: child-friendly, presenter and astrophysicist
• Complete profiles for nebulae and galaxies
• Be there: stand on Mars in a real 360° panorama and see the latest Perseverance rover photos
• The Space Station live on a 3D globe

No ads. Available in 15 languages.

name: Cake Packer
description:
Every order at the cake shop is a stack of boxes, and every box has to be filled to the last space.

Cake Packer is a calm packing puzzle. Drag cakes and pastries from one shared tray into the cake boxes, tap a cake to turn it, and fit everything in. When a box is exactly full, its lid drops and a ribbon bow pops. Close every box and the order is delivered.

The twist: one tray feeds every box of the order. A cake you use in the first box is not there for the third, so the whole order is one puzzle and you plan across the boxes.

If you like to organize, tidy and fit things until they click into place, this is your game.

What you get
- 60 packing orders in two streets, from a single cake box to a tall stack of five
- Strawberry shortcake, swiss rolls, brownies, Battenberg, cheesecake, red velvet and more: every cake is a different shape that you can turn but not flip
- Party Rush orders with a move limit, every fifth level from level 11
- Free, unlimited Undo. No timer, no lives, no waiting
- Hints and Fill a Box when you want a hand; coins come from playing
- Works offline

Ads and purchases
Cake Packer is free to play. Optional rewarded videos can double your coins or help you out, and short ads may appear between some levels. In-app purchases are optional: Remove Ads, a Starter Pack and coin packs.

A few minutes between other things, or a long evening. Pack it, stack it, deliver it.

name: Calc Provind
description:
La Calculadora de Materiales PROVIND te ayuda a calcular de forma rápida y sencilla las cantidades de materiales drywall que necesitas para tu proyecto. Está pensada para profesionales, instaladores, distribuidores, contratistas, docentes y estudiantes del sistema constructivo en seco.

SISTEMAS INCLUIDOS
• Tumbados: Gypsum, Gypsum F47 y Modular
• Paredes: Una Cara y Doble Cara
• Revestimientos: Revoque en Seco y Perfil F60
• Exterior: Sistema Aquapanel
• Acabados: Empaste y Pintura

CÓMO FUNCIONA
Ingresa el área en m², elige las opciones de tu obra (formato de lana de vidrio, distancia entre perfiles o stud a medida) y obtén al instante la lista de materiales: placas, perfiles, tornillos, masilla, cinta y más.

COMPARTE TU CÁLCULO
Comparte el resultado como un recibo con fecha por WhatsApp, correo u otras apps, con tus contactos o con tu distribuidor PROVIND de confianza para cotizar de inmediato.

FUNCIONA SIN INTERNET
Realiza tus cálculos en cualquier lugar, incluso en obra y sin conexión.

DISEÑADA PARA TI
• Busca y filtra los sistemas por categoría
• Elige cómo ver los resultados: lista, tarjetas o recibo
• Modo claro y oscuro
• Disponible para iPhone y iPad

IMPORTANTE
* Los resultados son un estimado basado en prácticas de instalación recomendadas por profesionales del drywall. Las cantidades pueden variar según las condiciones y características de cada obra.
* El cálculo de tumbados no incluye material para cuelgas o tirantes.

Visita nuestra web y redes sociales para más información.
