name: Callacy
description:
CallACY brings your business calls, bookings, sales outreach, customer conversations and daily operations together in one app. Turn inquiries into confirmed appointments, follow up on opportunities and keep work moving without juggling multiple tools.

**AI CALL HANDLING & AUTOMATED FRONT DESK**

• Handle incoming calls with AI agents that answer questions, capture caller details and take action.

• Choose AI Answers First or Ring Me First, so AI can step in when you miss a call.

• Transfer live conversations to a person when a human touch is needed.

• Review call activity and manage multiple AI agents for different roles.

**BOOKINGS & APPOINTMENTS**

• Let AI book appointments using your business's availability and services.

• View and manage appointments from your calendar.

• Handle appointment changes, confirmations and reminders.

• Set business coverage zones and service areas for mobile, fixed-location and remote work.

**OUTBOUND SALES, POWER DIALER & CAMPAIGNS**

• Run one-time or recurring outbound calling campaigns.

• Reach leads with a power dialer and AI-driven sales conversations.

• Set campaign goals for booking appointments, quote follow-ups, re-engagement, welfare checks and payment reminders.

• Manage leads and follow-up activity in one place.

**QUOTES, INVOICES & PRICING**

• Create and send professional quotes and invoices.

• Build a service catalogue with rates, durations and pricing rules.

• Configure discounts, tax settings and assisted or automated quoting.

• Keep customer and billing information organised.

**MESSAGING, FOLLOW-UPS & AUTOMATION**

• Manage customer communications across supported messaging channels.

• Send confirmations, reminders and follow-up messages.

• Create and manage social media posts and respond to messages through supported connected channels.

• Keep track of customer interactions, tasks and business activity.

**ONE PLACE TO RUN YOUR BUSINESS**

Access your dashboard, AI agents, calendar, calls, customers, quotes and invoices in the same mobile workspace. Whether you operate a trade service, local business, agency or growing sales team, CallACY helps you respond faster, stay organised and create more opportunities.

Features and channel availability may vary by business configuration and connected services.

name: Camtionary: Camera Dictionary
description:
Camtionary is a dictionary you point at the page.

Open the app, aim the camera at what you're reading, and tap a word. Its definition slides up straight away, with how it's said, an example, and words like it. No typing, no losing your place.

THE MEANING THAT FITS
Many words mean several things. On iPhones with Apple Intelligence, Camtionary reads the sentence around the word and puts the meaning that fits it first, so "spleen" in Moby-Dick opens on bad temper, not the organ. Swipe to see the other meanings.

MADE FOR READING
• Tap a word, or press and slide your finger to pick the right one.
• The page freezes while you choose, so the words hold still.
• Words split across two lines are joined back together.
• Hear any word said aloud.
• A torch, and pinch to zoom up to 5×, for small print and dim rooms.

KEEP YOUR WORDS BY BOOK
Photograph a book's cover, or type its title, and the words you look up are saved under it. The current book is always shown at the top of the camera, and changing it takes one tap. Export your words as a spreadsheet (CSV) any time.

WHEN THE DICTIONARY DOESN'T KNOW
Names, places and newer words come from Wikipedia and Wiktionary, and one tap searches Google for anything else.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Reading the page happens on your iPhone: what the camera sees and the sentences around a word are never sent anywhere, and the dictionary works offline. Only the word you look up is sent to Wikipedia and Wiktionary, and you can turn that off in Settings. There's no account and nothing to sign up for.

FREE, WITH A ONE-TIME UPGRADE
Every feature is free, with 10 lookups a day: your words kept with the sentence you found them in, sorted by book, liked and searched. Camtionary Pro is a single purchase, not a subscription, that removes the daily limit.

The dictionary is English only, and works offline.

name: Candy Cattie
description:
Help Candy Cattie gather tasty desserts, solve fun matching puzzles, and rebuild her lovely sweet garden kingdom!

Welcome to the whimsical sweet world of Candy Cattie! This cute single-player collection puzzle game features unique tap-and-place gameplay.

Come along with Candy Cattie, an adorable orange kitty chef wearing a strawberry chef hat, on a wonderful dessert journey across flower-filled meadows and candy trails. Tap to pick sweet treats and drop them into containers. Put three identical treats into one container, and they will disappear! Finish level goals, collect baking materials, and unlock more lovely scenery.

 Key Features

- Unique Tap & Place Mechanic: No swapping! Simply tap to grab treats and place them into containers.
- Three-of-a-kind Clear: Stack three identical sweets in the same container to eliminate them.
- Collect Dessert Ingredients: Collect strawberries, cakes, lollipops, macarons and more yummy treats.
- Restore the Sweet Garden: Beat levels to unlock zones and decorate your dream candy garden.
- Lovely Kitty Protagonist: Help the little cat chef bake and explore the sweet wonderland.
- Easy & Relaxing: Simple rules, suitable for players of all ages.
- Vibrant Cute Art Style: Bright, warm visuals with lovely dessert and garden scenes.

If you love cute cat characters, relaxing matching puzzles and sweet collection games, Candy Cattie is made for you!
Download now and begin your sugary adventure with Candy Cattie!

name: Cap Iron
description:
Cap Iron keeps each hand plane on this iPhone.

Four faces sit along the sole. The cap iron has to rest one step behind the edge before the edge may come out one step and leave a shaving. Covering the edge blocks it. Sitting two steps back lifts the shaving. Running the edge out before the cap is set leaves the edge where it was. Running it out a second step springs it back.

When every face is cutting, the sentence is Set. Otherwise it names the first face that still needs the cap or the edge.

Name a plane, rename it, delete one, and share that one sentence.

Planes stay on this iPhone. There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: Caption Storm: Photo Captions
description:
Caption Storm turns any photo into ready-to-post captions in seconds. Pick a photo and get six captions, each in a different style, plus alt text and hashtags, so you can choose the one that fits.

SIX STYLES FOR EVERY PHOTO
• Witty: clever wordplay or a light joke
• Aesthetic: calm, poetic and visual
• Heartfelt: warm and personal
• Short & Punchy: a few bold words
• Story: the moment behind the photo
• Question: invites comments

MADE FOR WHERE YOU POST
Choose Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, X, or Any, and Caption Storm adjusts length, emoji and the number of hashtags. Add an optional note like "my sister's graduation" for captions that fit the moment.

ALT TEXT INCLUDED
Every photo also gets a plain, objective description you can paste as alt text, so people who use screen readers can enjoy your posts too.

REWRITE ANY CAPTION
Ask for a new idea, or make any caption shorter, longer, funnier or more professional, or add or remove emoji.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Caption Storm works with Apple Intelligence and writes every caption entirely on your device. Your photos are never uploaded. The photo picker gives the app only the photos you choose, so no photo-library permission is needed. No account, no tracking, no ads, and it works offline.

MADE FOR iPHONE, iPAD AND MAC
• Choose a photo, drag one in, paste it, or open it from Files
• Copy or share any caption with one tap
• Save favorites and revisit past photos in History
• Write captions from Shortcuts, right from the share sheet
• Beautiful Liquid Glass design

REQUIREMENTS
Caption Storm works with Apple Intelligence on iPhone 15 Pro or later, and on iPad and Mac models with an M1 chip or later, running iOS, iPadOS or macOS 26 or later, with Apple Intelligence turned on in Settings. On iOS, iPadOS and macOS 27, captions are written while looking at the photo itself. Apple Intelligence features may not be available in all languages or regions.

AI can make mistakes. Always make sure your caption fits your photo before you post.

Apple Intelligence is a trademark of Apple Inc.

name: Car Washer: Detailing Shop
description:
Turn mud-covered cars into spotless, shining rides! In Car Washer: Detailing Shop you run your own detailing garage, finish every customer's work order and grow your business step by step.

HOW TO PLAY
• Pick a tool below, touch the car and drag your finger.
• Foam first, then scrub, rinse with the pressure washer and dry.
• Finish every service on the work order, DELIVER the car on time and collect your tip.

16 TOOLS, LOTS OF JOBS
Foam cannon, sponge, rotary brush, pressure washer, wheel brush, glass spray and squeegee, spot remover, air blower, polisher, tire shine, vacuum cleaner and headlight kit… Every tool has its own job: work in the right order and both quality and tips go up.

EVERY CAR IS DIFFERENT
From yellow taxis to wedding cars, police cruisers to fire trucks, all kinds of cars and customers are waiting. Muddy, buggy, bird droppings, construction dust… Picky customers won't accept unfinished work, rushed customers are on the clock, and the wedding car has to be flawless.

GROW YOUR BUSINESS
• Buy new tools with your earnings and upgrade them.
• Equip your shop and hire a helper.
• Complete daily missions and sign weekly contracts.
• Win loyal customers and collect mastery badges.
• Level up and open branches by the coast, in the mountains, at the harbor and in the city.
• Spin the lucky wheel every day for surprise rewards.

FEATURES
• Satisfying foam, water, dirt and shine effects
• Headlight polishing and interior cleaning mini-games
• Rainy days, discount days and dust storms
• English and Turkish
• Cloud backup keeps your progress safe

Car Washer: Detailing Shop is free to play. It contains optional in-app purchases and ads; the "No Ads" pack removes the ads between cars.

name: Carboo
description:
Carboo is an AI assistant that does the work for you on its own cloud computer.

Tell it what you need in plain words. It researches the web, compares options, writes documents, builds slides and spreadsheets, and works in websites for you — then hands you the finished result.

WHAT IT CAN DO
• Research: read many sources and give you a clear answer with links
• Documents, slides and spreadsheets: real Word, PowerPoint and Excel files you can download and edit
• Work in a browser: fill in forms, collect information, compare prices
• Everyday help: plan your week, draft messages, summarize long articles
• Connect your apps: email, calendar, notes and more, so it can work with your own information

YOU STAY IN CHARGE
• It asks before doing anything important, like sending an email
• Watch it work live on its cloud computer, and take over any time
• Get a notification when a task is done or needs your answer

Sign in with Apple, Google or your email. Start free.

name: Card Scanner: Value Tracker
description:
Point your camera at a trading card and get the exact card, its printing, and what it sells for now. Pokemon, sports cards, Magic, Yu-Gi-Oh, graded slabs and sealed product. No ads, no account, and no free trial that turns into a charge.

THE EXACT CARD, OR A PLAIN "NOT SURE"
Card Scanner reads the set, number, year and printing from your photo. When a card was printed more than one way (1st Edition, Shadowless, reverse holo, refractors and parallels), it shows each one with what to look for and its own price, so you never pay or sell at the wrong one. When a photo is unclear it says "not sure" and shows the cards it could be, instead of guessing.

PRICES YOU CAN CHECK
For Pokemon, Magic and Yu-Gi-Oh you get what near mint copies actually sold for on TCGplayer. For sports cards, rare printings and worn cards you get current eBay listings for that exact card, with near mint, played and damaged copies priced apart, and a clear warning when there are too few listings to trust. Every price shows where it came from, and you can open the listings behind it.

ASK ABOUT ANY CARD, OUT LOUD
Hold up a card and ask: is this a first edition, is it real, how should I store it, is it worth grading. The answer looks at your photos and the prices and is read back to you.

WORTH GRADING?
See what the card lists for at PSA 10, 9 and 8 next to today's grading fees, and check any PSA slab by its cert number.

FOR COLLECTORS
Your collection with totals and price history, a set tracker, a trade checker, binder pages (up to 9 cards from one photo), price alerts when a card you hunt lists at or under your price, a collection PDF, spreadsheet export, and import from other apps. Everything is saved on your phone, with backup and restore.

FREE AND PRO
Free: 200 scans a month, typed search, prices, set lists, your collection and exports.
Pro: up to 60 scans a day, binder pages, grading check, price alerts and asking about any card. Monthly, yearly, or a one-time lifetime price. Subscriptions renew until you cancel in Settings.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy: https://plainworkgroups.duckdns.org/privacy/cards

name: CareerEvidence
description:
Prepare for a development review with a clear record of what you contributed, which role criteria it supports, and which sources you have permission to share.

Start with a fictional support lead’s escalation pilot. The pilot audit supports an operational improvement. A private peer observation supports a coaching claim in the employee’s notebook. Switch to the manager’s copy to see which claim can travel with a citation and which still needs shareable evidence.

Capture your own contribution, add role criteria, and record dated source references. Decide which sources are private, which can be shared with your manager, and which belong in this particular dossier. Read the exact text before you save a revision or export it to Files.

Record what you and your manager each agreed to do next. Return to those commitments at your next one-to-one. Issued revisions preserve what the evidence supported at the time.

CareerEvidence works locally on iPhone and iPad. You choose where to export a file. Saving a revision does not send it to anyone.

name: carLocker: Car Maintenance Log
description:
When was the last oil change? Is the inspection due? Where did you put the registration? carLocker answers all of it from one place on your iPhone, so the small jobs of owning a car stop living in your head, a glovebox or a pile of receipts.

It is made for the ordinary owner of one car first. Add yours in under a minute, tell carLocker what needs doing and when, and it reminds you. If you own several cars, it grows into a garage.

THE JOBS YOU ACTUALLY HAVE
• Oil change, brake fluid, timing belt or anything you name yourself
• Inspection and road tax dates
• Tire swap in spring and fall
• Insurance renewal before it quietly lapses
• Finding the registration, ownership proof or warranty when someone asks

REMINDERS THAT FOLLOW YOUR DRIVING
Set a service by months, by distance, or both, and the one that comes first wins. Log your odometer now and then and carLocker works out how fast you really drive, so a reminder for "every 5,000 miles" arrives when you are close, not when a calendar guesses. Insurance renewal and tire swap dates remind you ahead of time too.

TIRES, PAPERS AND PROBLEMS
• Keep each tire set with its size, tread depth, rims and storage place, and see how far each set has gone
• Scan paper with your camera, or add photos and PDFs
• Log every noise, warning light and repair with date, cost and receipts, and link a fix to its issue

WHEN IT IS TIME TO SELL
Mark the car as sold and export its whole history as a PDF (Pro): services, fixes, mileage and tires. A buyer sees proof, and you see what the car cost you to own.

IF YOU LIKE NUMBERS
• Insights shows cost of ownership, and what is coming up in the next 90 days
• The optional value tracker is your own estimate: you set the start value, yearly depreciation and floor. It is not a market valuation
• Several cars? Each gets its own page, and the Vault gathers values, insurance and key papers behind Face ID

YOURS ALONE
• No account, no ads, no tracking
• Works offline, and your data stays on your iPhone
• Back up to a file with an optional password, restore it on a new iPhone, or export to CSV
• Kilometers or miles, light or dark

CARLOCKER PRO
Start free with one car, fully documented, including issue and fix history, mileage log, one photo, one document and one Pro module of your choice: service, insurance, value tracker or tire seasons. Backup and export are always free. Upgrade to carLocker Pro for unlimited cars, photos and documents, and every module.

• Pro is an auto-renewing subscription, billed monthly or yearly. The price and billing period are shown in the app before you subscribe.
• A 1-week free trial is included. When the trial ends, your subscription converts to a paid subscription unless you cancel at least 24 hours before it ends.
• Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase.
• The subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the period ends.
• Manage or cancel your subscription any time in your Apple Account settings after purchase.
• Purchases are handled by Apple and RevenueCat using a random customer ID.

Privacy Policy: https://linuswestling.github.io/carLockerPolicy/privacy/
Terms of Use: https://linuswestling.github.io/carLockerPolicy/terms/

name: Cart Hour
description:
Cart Hour is for the person at the board for this hour. You write one short cart, dial its length from one to eight minutes, and put it on the rack. You slide that cart into an open quarter of this hour. The hour shows how many minutes are lined up and how many of the sixty are still open. You open that slot, hold the pinch roller until the cart counts as aired, and the log keeps the time on this iPhone.

Cart Hour does not play audio, connect to a transmitter, or schedule another hour. It does not create a file, and it does not ask you to sign in. Nothing is sent off the phone. The next time you open it, the same hour, the same cart, and the minutes still open are still there.

name: cast timer
description:
Cast Timer turns the television you already own into a countdown everyone in
the room can read.

Set a time on your iPhone, send it to your Chromecast, and the TV shows big,
high-contrast digits that are legible from across a room. Your phone becomes
the remote control.

WHY IT IS DIFFERENT

The television keeps its own time. Once the countdown starts, your phone can
lock, sleep or go in a pocket and the TV carries on without it. No frozen
digits, no drift, no need to keep the screen awake.

MADE FOR SHARED ROOMS

• Cooking — put the timer where everyone can see it instead of squinting at a phone
• Workouts and intervals — read the clock from the other side of the room
• Children's screen time — nobody argues with the TV
• Study and focus sessions — a visible clock keeps a group on track
• Meetings and talks — keep time without staring at a laptop

HOW IT WORKS

• Tap the cast button and pick your Chromecast
• Dial in minutes and seconds, or use the 1, 5, 10, 15 and 25 minute presets
• Start, pause, resume and reset from your phone; the TV follows immediately
• Colour tells you the state at a glance: green running, amber paused, red when
  time is up
• Optional beeps count down the final ten seconds and sound when time is up —
  switch them off from your phone whenever you like

The countdown runs on your phone too, so Cast Timer still works as an ordinary
timer when no TV is nearby.

PRIVACY

No accounts. No advertising. No analytics. Cast Timer collects nothing about
you. The only thing it remembers is whether you want the TV to make a sound.

REQUIREMENTS

A Google Chromecast, or a TV with Chromecast built in, on the same Wi-Fi
network as your iPhone.

name: CastShield: TV Video Caster
description:
CastShield is a web video caster that sends videos from your favorite websites to your TV: movies, shows, live news and sports streams. And it blocks the pop-ups, redirects and fake buttons that usually come with them.

Browse to a page, press play, and CastShield finds the video. Tap Cast This Video, pick your TV, and your phone becomes the remote, even when it's locked.

SUPPORTED TVS AND DEVICES
• Chromecast, Google TV and TVs with Chromecast built-in
• Samsung, LG, Sony and other DLNA smart TVs
• Roku streaming sticks and Roku TVs
• Apple TV and AirPlay TVs
• Fire TV and other smart TVs through their web browser, with a simple pairing code
• Finds your TVs on your Wi-Fi automatically and keeps the list up to date

*Having trouble with your TV? Tap Contact Support in Settings and include your TV's brand and model.

SUPPORTED MEDIA
• HLS live streams (M3U8), including live sports and news
• MP4 videos
• IPTV and M3U playlists
• Videos and photos from your iPhone
• Subtitles in any language the video offers

BLOCKS THE JUNK
• Built-in blocking for ads, trackers, pop-ups and redirect tricks
• Turn blocking off for any site you trust
• Private tabs that leave no history behind

YOUR PHONE IS THE REMOTE
• Play, pause, seek and skip, even from the Lock Screen
• Live Activity and Dynamic Island controls
• Volume control, playback speed and sleep timer
• Up Next queue with autoplay and Next Episode detection
• Continue Watching picks up where you left off
• Picks the best-quality stream automatically

SUBTITLES DONE RIGHT
• Off by default, one tap to turn on
• Search for subtitles and fix timing that's out of sync
• Set the size, color and background

MORE
• Siri and Shortcuts support, plus a Home Screen widget
• Face ID lock for the app or for private tabs
• Light and dark mode

No account. No tracking. No data collected.

CastShield is not affiliated with Google, Roku, Samsung, LG, Sony, Amazon or Apple. Only cast content you have the right to watch.

name: Cat Blocks: Happy Rows
description:
Cat Blocks is a cozy block puzzle with seven different cat shapes. Move and rotate the falling cats to fill a horizontal row and clear it. The pace increases as you clear more rows.

• Seven cat shapes with poses that turn as you rotate them.
• Four difficulty levels with different chances of getting a long cat.
• Hold a cat and use the ghost preview to plan your next move.
• Press and hold the movement buttons or swipe directly on the board.
• Save your best score and unfinished game. Leaving the app automatically pauses play.
• Choose English or Simplified Chinese.
• No account, ads or in-app purchases. Play entirely offline.

name: Çatpat: Learn English & YDS
description:
Çatpat teaches English to Turkish speakers, a little every day, like a game. Everything in the app is free: no paid packs, no subscription, no ads and no lives. No account needed either. Lessons and explanations are in Turkish.

WHAT'S INSIDE

• Everyday English (A1–B2): 1,400+ words on a 185-unit learning path, each with pronunciation, Turkish meaning and an example sentence.
• Grammar lessons with short explanations: present simple, past simple, present perfect, passive voice, if clauses and more.
• A Turkish explanation for every wrong answer.
• YDS and YÖKDİL preparation: academic vocabulary, cloze tests, sentence completion, translation and reading questions, plus 5 timed 80-question YDS mock exams in the real exam order.
• TOEFL and IELTS practice, Business English and a 10-minute placement test.

REAL-LIFE DIALOGUES

• 24 two-person dialogues from A1 to B1: at a café, a hotel, the doctor, a job interview.
• Pick what to say, learn in Turkish why a wrong reply doesn't fit, then say your line into the microphone.

SPEAK, LISTEN, READ

• Speaking practice with the iPhone's speech recognition: say the word or sentence and see right away whether it was understood.
• Hear every word in normal and slow speed with the iPhone's English voices.
• 12 short graded stories with comprehension questions.

SMART REVIEW AND GAMES

• Spaced repetition brings words back just before you forget them. Mistake notebook, weak words and your own word lists.
• Word of the Day (five letters, six guesses), Match, 60 Seconds, Scramble, Word Rain, Hangman, Word Search, Dictation, Sentence Builder and Translate & Type (type the English into letter blanks that fill as you go).

MOTIVATION

• Daily reminder at a time you choose. If you already practised that day, it stays quiet.
• Daily goal and streak with streak freezes, daily quests, a dress-up crocodile, a word album and section bosses.
• Weekly leagues in groups of 30, link duels with friends, badges, stars and XP. Light and dark theme.

PRIVACY

Your progress stays on your phone. We never ask for an email, phone number or real name. Leagues and duels are optional and only show the nickname you pick; you can report a nickname or block a player. Delete all your data with one tap.

name: Caustica
description:
Draw with sunlight!

Caustica is a cheerful, beautiful puzzle game about light and water. Slide glass lenses and ripple stones across a sunny pool to bend the sunlight on the sand below until it matches the target. Get it right and the light bursts into a golden painting, and a koi made of light swims out of it!

RAISE A POND FULL OF FRIENDS
Every few pools you meet a new creature: Pip the Turtle, Lily Frog, Momo the Axolotl, a golden koi, a blue dragonfly, a moon snail, fireflies, a fluffy duckling and more. Choose who swims in your pond in My Pond.

SO SATISFYING
Drag the glass to move its light, turn the gold knob to focus it into a brilliant point. Lights snap gently into place, and every solve explodes into sparkles, stars and music.

POOLS OF EVERY SHAPE
Oval, kidney, twin and octagon pools across gardens, temples, moonlit baths, teak pavilions, terracotta courts and winter snow.

110 POOLS + A DAILY PUZZLE
Eleven chapters that grow from a single sunbeam to tricky pictures, plus a new Daily Pool every day, the same for everyone. Keep your streak going!

A LIVING SOUNDSCAPE
Water laps, glass sings as you get closer, brush strokes pluck notes, and ten pieces of gentle music play in harp, koto, marimba and bell.

RELAXING, NEVER RUSHED
No timers. No ads. No in-app purchases. No tracking. No account. Plays fully offline on iPhone and iPad.

Made with love by SynRyzen Games.

name: CDL Prep: Test & Pre-Trip
description:
Unofficial app: it is not affiliated with and does not represent FMCSA, any state licensing agency or other government body. We wrote the questions and inspection checklists ourselves from the facts in state CDL manuals and federal rules (49 CFR). Official information: https://www.fmcsa.dot.gov/cdl

Get your commercial driver's license step by step, in English, in Spanish, or both.

ALL 8 KNOWLEDGE TESTS
• General Knowledge, Air Brakes and Combination Vehicles
• Endorsements: Hazardous Materials, Tanker, Doubles/Triples, Passenger and School Bus
• 840 questions with explanations and the manual pages they are based on
• Practice tests in the 80% format, mistake review and a readiness score

PRE-TRIP INSPECTION TRAINER
• Class A tractor-trailer, Class B truck, passenger bus and school bus
• Every zone: engine, cab, lights, front, sides, wheels, coupling, trailer, passenger area
• For each item, what to check and what to say to the examiner
• "Say it aloud" mode and an inspection exam with random zones, like the examiner picks

BRAKE CHECK
• Air brake in-cab check and hydraulic brake check, step by step
• What should happen at each step and why a mistake fails the test

AUDIO MODE
• Question, a pause to think, then the answer and why

MY PATH TO CDL

ENGLISH AND SPANISH

name: Chain Sag
description:
Chain Sag names the span whose sag over length is under 0.02.

Drag the sag on the chart. If the ratio is under 0.02, the tightest span is named. A sag under 1 mm is not stored. Changing the length does not rewrite the sag. The last span stays.

A mark stays on the iPhone and does not change the sag. Share the call when you choose to. There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: Chalk Snap
description:
Chalk Snap keeps one snapped line on this iPhone.

The line starts in the reel. Write the name that belongs on the wall. Pull the hook to the right until it stays, and read the inches. Pull the chalk line up off the wall and let it snap flat. The wall is marked that way, with the time it snapped.

Open Marks kept here later to see that line. Snapped lines stay on this iPhone. Nothing is uploaded and nothing is shared.

Chalk Snap does not mark a real wall and does not measure a room.

name: Chamelleon
description:
Can you outsmart the radar?

Chamelleon is a colorful hide-and-seek puzzle game. A sweeping radar scans an endless honeycomb board, and the only way to survive is to stand on a tile that matches your own color — blend in, or get caught!

HOW TO PLAY
• Draw a path with your finger to move your chameleon across the board.
• Your color changes every few radar turns — watch the warning and find a matching tile in time.
• Collect the requested fruits in the right order. Step on the wrong one and your harvest resets to zero!
• Never stand still for more than 10 seconds, or the radar will spot you.
• Chain 10 correct fruits in a row for a juicy bonus.

FOUR GAME MODES
• Central Radar — a rotating beam sweeps from the center of the board.
• Radar Scanner — a moving band scans the board from side to side.
• Moving Walls — the playable area keeps shrinking around you.
• Maze — navigate a tight labyrinth while staying hidden.

SURPRISE EVENTS
Every round throws new challenges your way: a faster radar, a reversed beam, a jungle full of hiding trees, pits to avoid, sticky glue tiles, kangaroo jumps, multicolor safe zones, and ghost-busting walls.

Unlock badges, beat your best score, and challenge your friends and family to top your results. Simple to learn, surprisingly tense to master — perfect for a quick game or a long session!

Chamelleon is part of the SYNAPS6 Games family of fun, family-friendly games.

name: Change Order AI: Estimate PDF
description:
Stop losing $5,000+ a year to verbal "while you're here" extras. Speak for 15 seconds on the job site, snap up to 3 photos, and get an itemized, client-signed Change Order PDF before you pick up a tool.

Built for general contractors, plumbers, electricians, HVAC techs, remodelers, and handymen who do not have time to type contracts on a ladder or in a basement.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Speak & Snap on Site: Hold to record a quick voice memo in English or Spanish and attach up to 3 job-site photos of unforeseen damage or extra work.
2. AI Builds Your Formal Quote: Automatically translates field slang or Spanish voice notes into polite, objective commercial English scope language with separated Labor, Material, Equipment, and Permit line items.
3. Client Signs & Lock PDF: Review deterministic subtotal, markup, sales tax, and schedule impact, have the client sign directly on your iPhone screen, and export a branded, tamper-proof US Letter PDF.

KEY FEATURES FOR CONTRACTORS
• Bilingual Voice-to-English Contract AI: Speak naturally in English or Spanish; generate clear, client-ready English scope clauses.
• Real Contract Balance Ledger: Automatically tracks Original Contract + Prior Change Orders + This Change Order = New Revised Total, plus Schedule Impact in business days.
• Legal Freeze After Signature: Once a client signs on screen, the Change Order locks permanently with signer name and timestamp so terms cannot be altered later.
• Job-Site Photo Evidence: Embed up to 3 site photos directly into the PDF to document concealed pipe corrosion, rot, or code-required upgrades.
• Works Offline on Site: Poor basement or rural signal? Audio and photos save locally and queue for one-tap AI extraction once signal returns—plus full manual line-item entry anytime.
• Branded Vector PDF Export: Includes your company name, license number, logo, itemized cost table, financial summary, evidence photos, and client signature. Share instantly via Messages, WhatsApp, or email.

BUILT FOR EVERY TRADE
General Contracting • Plumbing • Electrical • HVAC • Remodeling • Roofing • Carpentry • Handyman Services

SUBSCRIPTION & FREE DRAFT
Try AI drafting free with 5 watermarked Change Order generations. Unlock unlimited client signatures and clean, unwatermarked PDF exports with Pro: Annual with a 7-day free trial, or Monthly with a 3-day free trial.

name: Charge Window
description:
Charge Window answers one question: what time should your Hyundai, Kia or Genesis start charging?

Lithium-ion batteries age faster when they sit at a high charge. Plug in at 9 pm and the car can be full by 1 am — and then wait at 90 or 100% for six hours. Charge Window works out the latest safe time to start instead, so the car reaches your target just before you leave.

HOW IT WORKS
• Enter the current charge, your target and when you leave.
• Charge Window shows the start time, updating as you adjust.
• Enter that time as the start of the car's scheduled (off-peak) charging — on the car's screen, or in the manufacturer's app if you have it — and set it to charge only in that window. The car starts on its own.
• Keep the car's charging limit at your target, and its AC charging current the same as in the app.

WHY YOU NEED IT
Your car's built-in scheduler starts charging when your off-peak window opens and stops at your target. It doesn't work out when to start so that charging ends right at your departure — and neither does the manufacturer's app, which sets the same schedule. Charge Window does that sum for you.

It is especially useful where the manufacturer's connected app isn't available — not all countries have it, and without it the car's own screen is the only way to schedule a charge. In several other markets, connected services arrived only for newer cars, leaving earlier ones without them.

AN ESTIMATE YOU CAN TRUST
• Uses the slower of your wall charger and the car's onboard charger.
• Accounts for the slowdown above 90%, when charging tapers.
• Adjusts for battery health and age.
• Rounds in the safe direction, and finishes early by a margin you choose.
• Warns when charging will run outside your cheap-rate hours.

ALSO
• Live Activity: follow the charge on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island.
• CarPlay: see the start time on the car's screen and adjust the charge level and departure from the driver's seat.
• Apple Watch: set the charge level with the Digital Crown and see the start time at a glance, even when your phone is out of reach.
• Siri: "When should I start charging in Charge Window?"
• iPhone, iPad and iPhone Duo layouts, light and dark mode.
• 14 languages: English, Arabic, Chinese (Simplified), Dutch, French, German, Hebrew, Hindi, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Norwegian, Portuguese (Brazil) and Spanish.

WHICH CARS
Charge Window is built around the scheduled-charging system in Hyundai, Kia and Genesis electric cars — the E-GMP models such as the IONIQ 5, IONIQ 6, IONIQ 9, EV6, EV9 and GV60, and others that use the same off-peak menu, such as the EV3, Kona Electric and Niro EV. It includes battery and charger data for 33 of them. Other brands schedule charging differently; a custom setting calculates a start time for any EV, but the steps on the car will differ.

No account, no tracking, no data leaves your device.

Charge Window is not affiliated with or endorsed by Hyundai, Kia or Genesis.

name: ChargeRecord
description:
ChargeRecord is a recordkeeping app for HVAC/R technicians and shops. Log refrigerant charges, recoveries, top-offs, and leak inspections from the job. Logs save on the phone when there is no signal and sync when the phone reconnects.

Each log ties to the appliance and the cylinder it came from. ChargeRecord keeps leak-rate records for equipment with a full charge on file, using the annualizing or 365-day rolling-average method described in 40 CFR 84.102, and can alert you when a unit is approaching or over its leak-rate threshold.

When an inspector, customer, or owner asks, the shop can download an Audit Pack PDF of its own records, covering refrigerant events, recovery totals, leak rates, cylinder custody, leak inspections, and repair cases. Commercial customers can use a read-only view to see and download records for their own equipment. Corrections keep the original: a mistake is voided with a reason and remains in the history.

ChargeRecord is built around the AIM Act HFC leak-rate and recordkeeping rules in 40 CFR Part 84 Subpart C. It also supports recordkeeping for ODS refrigerants under 40 CFR Part 82 Subpart F. It is an independent recordkeeping tool, not affiliated with the U.S. EPA, and is not legal advice. Under 40 CFR 84.106, the equipment owner or operator remains responsible for leak-rate calculations and repairs.

Access is invite-only. Sign in with the email address your shop invited. There is no checkout or in-app purchase in this app.

name: Cheat Codes & Unlock Tracker
description:
The arrow sequence, the challenge that unlocks it, and how far you've got, on the phone next to your controller. For GTA 6 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.

Unofficial app. Cheat Deck is not affiliated with, endorsed or sponsored by Rockstar Games or Take-Two Interactive. All trademarks belong to their respective owners.

Free with ads: at most one full-screen ad per session, never while a code is on screen. A one-time in-app purchase removes the ads.

THE CODES
When a sequence is known, it shows as large arrows with the entry steps for your console. The game is new and many sequences haven't been found yet: those codes are listed as Not found yet, and we add them in updates as sources confirm them. So far 20 of the 61 cheats have a known sequence, 12 of them confirmed by every source we checked. Search by what a cheat does or browse by category: player, combat, vehicles, world, screen filters. Star the ones you use and they sit at the top as favorites.

WHAT'S LEFT TO UNLOCK
In this game a code has to be earned before it works. Cheat Deck shows the challenge behind each one and keeps your count, 37/100 style, so you know what to do next session instead of guessing.

100% CHECKLISTS
The game's 100% completion list as a checklist you tick off while you play, with counts for the items that come in sets, next to every unlock challenge. Your progress is saved on this iPhone or iPad only. No account, no sign-in.

STRAIGHT ANSWERS
• Unverified means sources disagree on that sequence, or only one source has it. Codes nobody has found yet say Not found yet instead of a made-up sequence.
• If a code doesn't work for you, one tap reports it: the code, your console and the app version, nothing personal.
• While a cheat is active, the game turns off trophies/achievements and saving. Every code screen says so.

Works offline.

Privacy: https://cheatdeck.french-web.com/privacy
Terms of use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Cheese Run: Hill Escape
description:
The cheese has escaped – and the whole village is running after it!

Steer a runaway wheel of cheese down an endless grassy hill. Dodge rocks, logs, bushes and hay bales, jump the ramps, grab cheese wedges and power-ups, and stay ahead of the crowd chasing you. Every crash slows you down, and the crowd only needs one chance.

• One-thumb steering – drag left and right to carve down the hill
• Endless downhill run that gets faster and busier the further you go
• Sheep on the loose, angry farmers diving in from the fences, mud and crowded slopes
• Turbo, shield and magnet power-ups
• A crowd of chasers that all run, leap and dive in their own way
• Daily, weekly and all-time leaderboards
• Low-poly look, synthesized music and sound effects

Cheese Run is free to play with ads. A one-time Remove Ads purchase turns off the video ads shown after runs, and lets you continue a run without watching a video.

Terms of use: https://mobtive.com/games/cheese-run/terms

name: Chess Night Game
description:
Chess Night is a chess board in your pocket, with no ads, no accounts and no tracking. Choose Easy, Normal or Hard, and one of twelve computer opponents sits down across from you. Each one plays at its own level, from Pip, who is still learning how the knight moves, to Odette, the champion of the park tables.

TWELVE OPPONENTS, THREE LEVELS
- Easy: four opponents who miss things and leave pieces hanging. Good for beginners and for learning the game.
- Normal: four opponents who see trades through and punish loose pieces.
- Hard: four opponents who calculate several moves ahead, play the endgame well and don't give much away.
- Your opponent is picked at random each game, so you never know quite who you'll get.
- Rematch the same opponent with the colors swapped, or start fresh.

REAL CHESS, EVERY RULE
- Castling, en passant and pawn promotion, with your choice of piece.
- Check, checkmate and stalemate, plus automatic draws by threefold repetition, the fifty-move rule and too few pieces to checkmate.
- Play White, Black, or let the app pick.
- A full move list in standard chess notation.
- How to Play explains how every piece moves, the special moves and the draws.

EASY TO SEE, EASY TO PLAY
- Tap a piece to see where it can go: dots mark empty squares and rings mark captures.
- The last move and a king in check are always highlighted.
- Pieces are outlined so they stand out on light and dark squares.
- Built for VoiceOver: every square reads its name and piece, and every move is announced in plain words, such as "knight from g1 to f3".
- Supports larger text, Reduce Motion and haptics.

PLAYS ANYWHERE
- Works fully offline.
- Your game saves automatically, so you can stop and pick up where you left off.
- No ads, no in-app purchases, no sign-up, no data collected.

name: Chess Quest: Calculation
description:
Chess Quest is a calculation trainer for players who want to get stronger over the board, not faster at tapping.

A JOURNEY THROUGH YOUR LIBRARY
Your exercises become a beautifully illustrated map. Each milestone is a real level, and the road ahead opens as you work through your collection.

SOLVE ON A REAL BOARD
Drag or tap the pieces. Legal moves, promotions, castling and en passant all work as they should. Play the whole line, not just the first move.

DEEP CALCULATION
For serious positions, the board locks. Set a thinking time, write down your candidate moves and variations, commit to one answer, then compare it with the solution.

ALTERNATIVE MOVES ARE CHECKED, NOT PUNISHED
If your move differs from the stored solution, the built-in Stockfish engine checks it. An equally strong move counts as correct.

MISTAKES COME BACK
Missed puzzles return on a spaced schedule: after 1, 3, 7, 16, 35 and 80 days.

SEE WHAT TO WORK ON
The coach sorts your misses into six kinds of error, using only what you recorded: your written lines, your clock and your own notes. It does not guess.

BRING YOUR OWN EXERCISES
Chess Quest includes a small pack of original sample puzzles. To train from a book you own, convert it with the free desktop tool and import the exercise file from Files.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account. No ads. No tracking. Everything stays on your device.

OPEN SOURCE
Chess Quest is free software under the GNU GPL v3. Source code: github.com/realJimJin/chess-quest

name: Chinese Calendar: Tong Shu
description:
Chinese Calendar: Tong Shu is a clear, modern Chinese lunar calendar and almanac for iPhone. Open it to see today's lunar date, the signs of the year and the day, the nearest solar term and festival, and what the traditional almanac prints for the day.

A CALENDAR FIRST
• Lunar date for any day from 1901 to 2099, with leap months.
• Month grid with the lunar day, solar terms and festivals in every cell.
• The 24 solar terms with the exact time each one begins.
• Traditional festivals: Lunar New Year, Lantern Festival, Dragon Boat, Qixi, Mid-Autumn, Double Ninth, Laba and more, with the number of days to the next one.
• Year, month and day in the sixty-year cycle (stems and branches) and the animal sign of the year.

THREE WAYS TO COUNT THE LUNAR MONTH
A lunar month begins on the day of the new moon in local time, so the same date can fall on different days in different countries. Choose the calendar you follow:
• China, Hong Kong, Taiwan (UTC+8)
• Vietnam (UTC+7)
• Korea (UTC+9)
Example: in 2027 Lunar New Year is 6 February in China, while Seollal in Korea is 7 February.

THE DAY IN THE TONG SHU
For each day the app shows what the traditional almanac lists:
• Suitable and Avoid: weddings, moving house, opening a business, travel, renovation and other occasions.
• The twelve day officers (Jian-Chu) and the yellow or black path.
• The sign that clashes with the day and the direction to mind.
• The twelve two-hour periods and the directions of the day on a compass.
Every Chinese term comes with a translation, and you can show the original characters next to it.

PICK A DAY
Planning a wedding, a move or an opening? Choose the occasion and the app lists the days the almanac marks as suitable in the next 30 to 365 days. Show weekends only, add your birth-year sign to leave out clashing days, and save the days you like.

WIDGETS
Today's lunar date, festival and day notes on your Home Screen and Lock Screen: small, medium and three Lock Screen sizes.

CHECKED CALCULATIONS
Everything is calculated on your iPhone and works offline. Lunar dates and solar terms are checked day by day against the calendar tables published by the Hong Kong Observatory.

PRIVATE
No account, no ads, no tracking. Nothing leaves your device.

The almanac is a record of calendar tradition, shown for cultural reference. It is not advice of any kind.

PREMIUM
Free: the full almanac of today, the month grid, solar terms, festivals and all widgets. Premium opens the day notes, hours and directions for any date and the complete day finder list.
• A yearly subscription with a 3-day free trial, or a one-time lifetime purchase.
• Payment is charged to your Apple Account. The subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it in your Apple Account settings.

name: Cinder Arcade
description:
Cinder Arcade is ten original games made in the spirit of the early arcade and console era: quick to learn, hard to put down, and tuned for touch.

THREE GAMES FREE, FOREVER • Cindertilt: a flap-and-joust arena. Flap high, strike from above. Two players can share a keyboard. • Hollow Fleet: a formation shooter. Clear wave after wave from behind your shields. • Hedge Hop: a road-and-river crossing. Dodge the traffic, ride the logs, get everyone home.

ONE PURCHASE UNLOCKS SEVEN MORE • Driftfield: a rock-field shooter in open space. • Last Lights: missile defense. Keep the towns' lights on. • Cinder Catch: a catch-everything reflex game. • Gorge Run: a river shooter. Watch your fuel. • Vinevault: a jungle treasure run across 64 screens. • Keyward: a key-and-keep quest. • Corebite: a shell-breaking duel.

MADE TO PLAY, NOT TO SELL TO YOU • No ads. No subscription. No tracking. No account. • Works completely offline. Everything is in the app. • One-time purchase, yours for good, and restorable on your other devices.

BUILT FOR TOUCH • On-screen stick and buttons sized for thumbs, on iPhone and iPad. • Also plays with a keyboard or a game controller.

name: City Hop
description:
How well do you know the world? City Hop is a retro geography game in glorious 8-bit style. A city name pops up, the clock starts ticking, and you fly or sail across the world map to find it. The faster you get there, the more points you score. Keep a streak going for multipliers, hit the jackpot city for double points, and find all 10 for a perfect-trip bonus.

FLY OR SAIL
Take to the skies in a hot-air balloon, helicopter, zeppelin, biplane, seaplane or jet. Or set sail and hop between the world's great port cities.

255 CITIES, 4 LEVELS
- Easy: famous cities everyone has heard of
- Medium: adds the world's capitals
- Hard: adds big cities from every continent
- Expert: no country names to help you

TODAY'S TRIP
Every day a new trip of 10 cities, the same for every player in the world. One try, one score. How do you compare?

COLLECT 255 POSTCARDS
Every city you find adds a hand-drawn pixel postcard of its landmark to your album. Tap any postcard to see where the city is on the map.

CLIMB THE RANKS
Start as a cadet and work your way up through seven pilot ranks. The higher ranks only count cities found on the harder levels. Only a full album makes you a Legend.

GAME CENTER
Leaderboards for every level in both modes, plus a daily board for Today's Trip.

RETRO, BUT FRIENDLY
- Chiptune music and arcade sound effects
- An arcade attract mode when you leave the menu alone
- Play in English, Dutch, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese or Swedish
- No account needed

City Hop is free to play with ads between games. A single one-time purchase removes all ads for good.

name: Cırtdan: Meşə Qaçışı
description:
Boyu kiçik, ağlı böyük Cırtdan yenə yoldadır! Div onun arxasınca düşüb, meşə isə maneələrlə doludur.

name: Clearspoke: Speaking Coach
description:
Clearspoke helps you speak more clearly in meetings, presentations and impromptu answers — one short rep at a time.

Pick a scenario, record a 30-second to 5-minute take, and get a clear report built from your own audio:
• Fillers — "um", "uh", restarts like "we we", and habit words like "basically", with each one linked to the moment in your recording
• Pace — your words per minute overall and across the take, against a target band you choose
• Pauses — which ones landed at natural breaks and which fell mid-sentence
• Timing — how close you came to your target length
• Vocal variety — loudness and pitch range, with honest caveats

Then you get one thing that worked, one thing to focus on and a short drill. Tap Try Again to retry the same prompt and see both takes side by side.

PRACTICE THE MOMENTS THAT MATTER
35 built-in prompts across meeting updates, executive summaries, impromptu questions, explaining a concept, presentation openings and closings, stakeholder Q&A and professional disagreement. Or write your own.

EVIDENCE, NOT VAGUE SCORES
Every coaching note points to a measurement or a moment you can replay. Clearspoke never claims to measure confidence, charisma or emotion, and it never scores your accent.

CORRECT ANYTHING
Speech recognition isn't perfect. Tap any word to replay it, confirm or dismiss a filler, or edit the transcript — your metrics update instantly.

TRACK PROGRESS
See filler rate, pace and speaking minutes over your recent sessions, compared like for like by practice type. No streaks, no guilt.

LEARN IN TWO MINUTES
Ten short lessons — the deliberate pause, point first, pace with purpose, answering tough questions and more — each linked to a practice prompt.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Transcription runs on your iPhone
• No account, no ads, no analytics, no tracking
• Recordings and transcripts stay on your device unless you export them
• Delete any take, or everything, at any time

Optional: on supported iPhones with Apple Intelligence, turn on on-device structure feedback for comments on your opening, main point, evidence and ending.

Clearspoke is a practice tool, not speech therapy. It is not affiliated with any speaking organization.

name: Cleat Hitch
description:
Cleat Hitch keeps one dock hitch on this iPhone.

The dock starts with the line still coiled. Name the boat, then choose port or starboard. Drag the coil onto the cleat. Drag the line to the right once for each turn, up to two. Drag the tail down until it locks. The boat is fast, with the side, the two turns, and the time it was made.

Open Boats kept here later to see that boat. Made-fast boats stay on this iPhone. Nothing is uploaded and nothing is shared.

Cleat Hitch does not handle a real line, measure a load, or decide whether a boat is secure.

name: Clicks and Movies
description:

name: Clipbae
description:
Clipbae is a shared clipboard for your own devices. Copy on your phone and it is waiting on your Mac, and the other way round. iPhone to Android works too.

HOW IT WORKS
• Pair once: scan the QR code your Mac or other phone shows, check both show the same six-digit code, and you're done. No account needed.
• Copy on one device, paste on the others.
• Send from any app: select, tap Share, then Clipbae.
• Your last 10 clips from every device stay for a day, so you can pick any of them up anywhere.
• Clear on one device and they're gone from all.

ON IPHONE
Open Clipbae and the latest clip is already on your clipboard. iOS only lets an app receive while it's open.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Every clip, image and file is encrypted with AES-256-GCM on the device that sends it. The key comes from your pairing code and never leaves your devices, so we can't read your clips. No ads, no tracking.

FREE
Two devices, 100 clips to start and then 10 a day, text and links.

CLIPBAE PRO, PAID ONCE
• Unlimited clips
• Up to 12 devices
• Screenshots, photos and files up to 25 MB (images up to 10 MB on iPhone)
• Your last 100 clips for a week, with search

Founding price for the first 500 buyers. No subscription, nothing to renew. One purchase covers every device in your group.

Clipbae for Mac: clipbae.app

name: Clipjar: Recipe Book
description:
Pay once, no subscription. Free for up to 15 recipes; one purchase unlocks unlimited recipes on iPhone, iPad and Mac.

Recipes worth keeping end up everywhere: a bookmark to a blog that may not be there in five years, a page torn from a magazine, an email from your mother, a card in a tin. Clipjar gathers them into one collection that lives on your device and in your own iCloud.

SAVE FROM ANYWHERE
Share a recipe page from Safari, or paste or drop a link, and Clipjar reads the recipe — ingredients, method, times and yield — into a clean card you can cook from, with a link back to the site it came from. Photograph an index card or a cookbook page and the text is read on your device; the card's photo stays with the recipe, handwriting and all. Open a PDF, a saved web page or a text file from any app, paste a recipe from an email, or type out the one that only exists in your head.

Whatever you give it, Clipjar keeps something. When it can't find a recipe, it saves the text for you to tidy up, so a recipe is never lost to an error message. Every recipe keeps a link back to where it came from and the date you saved it, so if the site changes, you still have the version you cooked.

SORTED AS YOU ADD THEM
Breakfast, soups, pasta, mains, desserts and more: each recipe is filed into its course the moment it arrives. Move one with a tap if you know better.

COOK FROM IT
Cook mode shows one step at a time in large type, keeps the screen awake, and lets you swipe from step to step with a floury hand. Every "bake for 25 minutes" is a timer you start with a tap — run several at once, and hear the alert even with your phone locked.

SCALE IT PROPERLY
Halve it, double it, or scale to the number of servings you need. Amounts stay as fractions a cook can measure: a third of a cup tripled is 1 cup, not 0.99, and half a tablespoon becomes 1½ teaspoons.

FIND IT AGAIN
Search titles, ingredients and tags. Mark favourites with a swipe.

SHARE IT
Send a recipe to a friend as a link. If they have Clipjar, it lands straight in their collection. A recipe from a website goes with full credit, and your friend's Clipjar fetches it from the original site.

PLAN THE WEEK
Add recipes to the week ahead and get one shopping list with the amounts combined — two recipes that each need a cup of flour become 2 cups of flour. Halve a recipe in the plan and the list buys half.

YOURS TO KEEP
There is no Clipjar account and no Clipjar server. The app collects no data, and goes online only to download a recipe link you hand it (or the original page of a recipe shared with you), straight from that site; your collection syncs between your devices through your own iCloud. Export any recipe to Markdown or PDF at any time, whether or not you have unlocked the app — your recipes are never held hostage.

ONE PURCHASE, EVERY DEVICE
Clipjar is free for up to 15 recipes, so you can see how it handles the sites you actually use. A single one-time purchase removes the limit on iPhone, iPad and Mac. No subscription, no ads.

name: Close Trace
description:
Close Trace names an open nozzle seam.

Trace the rim. If the end is more than 4 mm from the start, that seam is named. A stroke under 8 mm is not stored. The last seam stays.

Share an English seam list. A brought-in note stays on the iPhone and is not part of the seam. There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: Clown Screams
description:
Clown Screams es un juego de terror y supervivencia para un jugador. Desciendes por una red de alcantarillas que no termina, piso tras piso, mientras algo con máscara de payaso te sigue en la oscuridad.

CUANDO TE DETIENES, TE ENCUENTRA
Cada piso es un laberinto distinto con su propio reto: cierra válvulas antes de que suba el agua, cruza pasillos llenos de globos sin hacer ruido o escapa antes de que estalle la bomba. Resuelve los mecanismos, encuentra el pozo y lánzate al siguiente nivel.

EL PAYASO
Mide unos 2.5 metros, tiene cuatro brazos y una máscara de porcelana cuarteada. Escucha. Si revientas un globo, sabrá dónde estás. Si te alcanza, pierdes una vida y vuelves al inicio del piso.

SOBREVIVE
• Usa la linterna, pero cuida tu resistencia al correr.
• Escóndete en los refugios cuando lo oigas cerca.
• Marca las paredes con tiza para no perderte.
• Cada diez pisos llegas a una cámara de descanso y recuperas tus vidas.

TAMBIÉN
• Pisos generados sin fin y 10 tipos de reto.
• Vista en primera o tercera persona.
• Medallas, rangos y un archivo con la historia de las alcantarillas.
• Guardado automático: continúa tu descenso cuando quieras.
• Controles táctiles y compatibilidad con mando.
• Incluye anuncios, nunca durante la exploración. Los anuncios para revivir o recuperar una vida son opcionales.

Contiene terror y sustos repentinos.

name: COACH UP IAS

name: Codexese
description:
Codexese turns your message into a page of an old manuscript. Page looks like it came from a medieval book nobody can read: strange letters, parchment, flowers on the margins. But it is not random. Every word you wrote is there, and Codexese can read it back.

Send the page to a friend by any messenger, mail or social network. Your friend opens it in Codexese and the words come back, exactly as you wrote them.

IS IT SECRET? NO.

Codexese does not encrypt anything. It is not a lock and not a safe. Anybody who has Codexese can read your page in one second. Please do not use it for passwords, bank numbers or real secrets.

So why use it? Because it is fun. Your message looks like a page from a very old book. And one more thing: the page is a picture of made-up letters, not normal text. Computer programs that collect text from posts and chats, like AI bots, are made to read normal letters. They see a pretty old picture, not your words. A person who wants to read it just needs Codexese.

HOW IT WORKS

- Write a short message. The page is made right away, while you type.
- Tap the eye and watch your words come through the old script.
- Share the picture or save it to Photos.
- To read a page, open the picture in Codexese, or share it to Codexese right from Photos.

One page holds about 180 words. Codexese does not let you write more than fits, so every page can be read back. Each page is checked before you can share it.

GOOD TO KNOW

- No account, no server, no ads, no tracking. Everything happens on your iPhone or iPad.
- Send the picture at full size. Some messengers make pictures smaller, and a page with small letters may not read back.
- Works on iPhone, iPad and Mac.

The script is inspired by the Voynich manuscript, a real book from the 15th century that nobody could read until today.

name: ColorPip – Offline ColorPicker
description:
ColorPip is a fully offline color picker and palette tool for creators, designers and developers.
All processing runs locally on your device — your photos never get uploaded to any server. No account required, no cloud sync.

WHAT YOU CAN DO

• Build and save multiple named color palettes locally

• Copy any color code in one tap

Perfect for designers, developers, social creators and Etsy sellers who need exact color codes on the go.

No subscriptions, no hidden fees, no in-app purchases.
Pay once to download, unlock all features forever.

Works offline. Your privacy stays protected.

name: ColourSpec: Colour Picker
description:
ColourSpec reads the exact colour of any point in a photo and checks whether it is big enough to print. Made for designers, printers, advertising, renovation and online shops.

◆ Eyedropper
Drag with one finger to pick a colour. A loupe shows every pixel; pinch to zoom up to 40×. Sample 1 pixel, 3×3 or 5×5 average.

◆ Every colour value
HEX, RGB, CMYK, HSB, HSL and LAB, plus a colour name. Tap to copy.

◆ Pin multiple points
Pin up to 30 numbered points on a photo to see every colour at a glance.

◆ Main colours
Automatically finds the 6 main colours in a photo and their share.

◆ Photo specs
Size in pixels, megapixels, aspect ratio, format, file size, DPI and colour profile.

◆ Print size check
• Best quality (300 DPI) and maximum size (150 DPI)
• Photo sizes 3R to 20R
• Paper A6 to A0
• Posters, X-banners, roll-up banners and banners
• Hoardings and billboards
• Custom sizes (cm / m / in)
Tap any size to preview the crop on the photo.

◆ Export
Send specs by email (with the marked photo) or WhatsApp, or copy them all.

◆ Saved colours
Save colours you use often; copy or share any time.

◆ Privacy
Photos are processed only on your iPhone and never uploaded. No ads, no tracking, no in-app purchases. One-off purchase.

Available in English, 繁體中文 and 简体中文.

Note: colours are read from the photo in sRGB; CMYK is a standard conversion and printed results vary by printer and paper.

name: Colregs Trainer: Nav Lights
description:
IMPORTANT: on iPhone, all of Colregs Trainer is open for 21 days from first launch, with no sign-up and no payment details; nothing is charged when it ends. After that, the free version keeps the first 20 navigation-light cards with their review schedule; the other decks, the mock exam and progress by deck require the full-access subscription, monthly or yearly, at the price shown in the app before any purchase.

Most navigation-light apps show you a picture and a quiz. Colregs Trainer makes you remember. Every card comes back just before you would forget it, and the ones you miss come back sooner — that is spaced repetition, the method behind durable learning.

HOW IT WORKS
Each day the app tells you how many cards are due. Answer in your head, reveal the answer, then grade yourself: Missed, Hard, Good or Easy. Each button shows when the card will return, so you choose knowing the consequence.

WHAT'S INSIDE
• 36 night scenes: vessels seen from ahead, astern, port or starboard, drawn from the rules themselves — dots of light in the dark, as at sea
• 9 day shapes: balls, cones, diamonds and the cylinder
• 12 sound signals, with the context that gives them their meaning
• 11 IALA marks, Region A and Region B: lateral, cardinal, isolated danger, safe water, special
• 16 encounters: who keeps out of the way, and why (Rules 13 to 18)
• Mock exam: 20 questions in 20 minutes, scored by topic, without touching your review schedule
• Progress by deck: never seen, learning, known

Offline, no account, no ads, no tracking. Available in 27 languages.

A training tool: it replaces neither official instruction nor the text of COLREG 72 or the IALA buoyage system. The explanations are our own and the illustrations are computed; no third-party text or image is reproduced. Not affiliated with the IMO, IALA or any examining body.

Full access is an auto-renewing subscription, monthly or yearly. Payment is charged to your Apple ID when you confirm the purchase. The subscription renews automatically at the same price and for the same length unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period; manage or cancel it in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

Privacy policy: https://sogerg.github.io/colregs-trainer-legal/

name: Comptoir•io
description:
Comptoir.io rassemble l'actualité de centaines de sites francophones et vous laisse choisir ce que vous voulez lire.

Composez vos propres écrans
Créez autant d'écrans que vous voulez, chacun avec ses thèmes (presse généraliste, hi-tech, sport, économie, cinéma, science, intelligence artificielle, bons plans…), ses sources et sa quantité d'articles. Un curseur par thème garde seulement les sources les plus importantes quand vous voulez aller à l'essentiel.

Un flux toujours à jour
Le fil se rafraîchit en direct et vous indique combien de nouvelles actualités sont arrivées depuis votre dernière visite.

Un lecteur confortable

Les bons plans du jour
Les meilleures offres sélectionnées et commentées par Conseil de Geek, avec prix, remise et note, filtrables par réduction, prix et note.

Quatre affichages
Grandes ou moyennes images, lignes aérées ou compactes, en thème clair ou sombre.

Sans compte, ou avec
Comptoir.io fonctionne immédiatement, sans inscription. Avec un compte gratuit, retrouvez vos écrans, vos favoris et votre historique sur l'iPhone et sur comptoir.io.

Widgets
Ajoutez sur votre écran d'accueil l'article le plus lu de l'heure en presse, en hi-tech et en bons plans.

Comptoir.io est gratuit et sans publicité.

name: Computer Vision: Pixelwright
description:
Computer vision for your phone, taught the way you would explain it to a friend. Nine stages take you from a pinhole camera to Vision Transformers, and every stage starts with something real: a friend who shrinks as you step back, a street photo you can sharpen, a skyline you stitch into a panorama.

What you do
- Slide a 3 by 3 magnifier over a picture and watch the convolution run live on your phone's graphics chip, with the nine multiplications shown for the pixel you tap.
- See edges as shadows at object boundaries, then find corners and vote with RANSAC to stitch two photos.
- Train a tiny CNN on circles, squares and triangles and see exactly what each learned filter responds to.
- Build a layer stack and watch the picture shrink and the parameter bill grow.
- Draw a box and get its IoU, suppress duplicate detections, and watch average precision appear.
- Colour in a street scene to score pixel accuracy against mean IoU, and learn why one can hide failures.
- Cut a picture into patches like a Vision Transformer and tap one to see where it looks.
- Nudge a stop sign with a tiny sticker and find the smallest change that flips a classifier; swap a cow's background and catch a shortcut.

How it teaches
Each lab begins with a real situation, gives you controls, and only then shows the equation, as a description of what you just did. Tap any symbol to find it in the picture. Quiz questions are computed from your own setup, and every numeric answer is recomputed by independent code. 214 checked questions, 18 labs, unit checks of six questions, an optional final mock test, and a calm replay list for anything you miss.

Sources
Claims are cited to courses and papers (Stanford CS231n, MIT 6.8300, CMU 16-385 and 16-720, UC Berkeley C280, Szeliski, ResNet, Faster R-CNN, U-Net, ViT, CLIP and more) and each opens in a window inside the app. All pictures are rendered by the app itself. Written and source-checked by our team; not reviewed by an external expert. Not affiliated with any university.

Good to know
Works offline, no account. Free, with ads between sessions only; an optional ad-free monthly subscription ($3.99, 7-day free trial) removes them, and watching a short video earns a credit for the optional mock test. Cancel anytime; cancellation takes effect at the next billing cycle. Text size A- and A+ from 85 to 200 percent. Content as of 2026-11-17.

Terms of Use: https://equalinformation.com/terms-pixelwright.html

name: Comunidad Cristiana Cochabamba
description:

Comunidad Cristiana Cochabamba · Cochabamba, Bolivia · iglesiaccc.org

name: Confer GPS
description:
Confer GPS es la app para los clientes de Confer GPS: ve tus vehículos en el mapa en tiempo real, recibe avisos y actúa rápido si algo pasa.

• Mapa en vivo: dónde está cada unidad, a qué velocidad va, si tiene el motor encendido y su recorrido del día.
• Avisos al instante en tu iPhone: encendido y apagado, exceso de velocidad, entrada y salida de tus zonas, desconexión del GPS y alarmas.
• Apagado de motor a distancia (si lo contrataste): con confirmación y aviso cuando el motor ya se apagó. Por seguridad, el GPS solo apaga a menos de 20 km/h.
• Botón de robo: en un toque nos avisa, te da un link de ubicación en vivo para el 911 y, si lo tienes, te deja apagar el motor.
• Entra con Face ID, sin escribir tu contraseña.
• Comparte la ubicación de una unidad por unas horas con quien tú quieras.
• Zonas: tu bodega, tus clientes o tus rutas, con aviso al entrar o salir.
• Reportes de viajes, kilómetros, paradas y horas de motor.
• Mi cuenta: tu plan y tus pagos, los vencimientos de verificación, seguro, refrendo y licencia, y tus documentos (póliza, tarjeta de circulación) siempre a la mano.
• Atajos desde el ícono: Me robaron, Apagar / encender y Mi cuenta.
• ¿Olvidaste tu contraseña? Te llega un código y la cambias tú solo.

Necesitas una cuenta de Confer GPS: te la damos al instalar tu GPS. ¿Todavía no eres cliente? Conoce los planes y pruébalo gratis en confergps.com.

name: Confer PTT
description:
Confer PTT convierte tu iPhone en un radio de dos vías (como Nextel o un walkie-talkie) para tu familia o tu equipo de trabajo.

• Aprieta el botón y habla: todos los de tu grupo te oyen al instante, en cualquier parte donde haya internet.
• Suena con el cel bloqueado: con la radio de tu iPhone oyes y contestas sin desbloquear.
• Timbrarle a alguien: le suena fuerte para que conteste.
• Privado: habla con una sola persona. Canales para separar pláticas (Casa, Viaje, Trabajo).
• Sabes quién lo recibió y quién lo escuchó.
• Si no oíste un mensaje queda guardado para escucharlo después.
• Sin señal: lo que grabas se manda solo en cuanto vuelve el internet.
• Escoge el tono con el que llegan los mensajes, o solo vibrar.
• Funciona con el Botón de Acción y con Siri ("Radio Mamá en Confer PTT").

Tu grupo es privado: solo entra quien tú invitas con su link. Para familias es gratis. Para negocios hay plan con más personas, canales, mapa del equipo, bitácora y alerta a todos.

name: Contacto Detenido
description:
Contacto Detenido ayuda a las familias de personas detenidas por ICE a mantenerse en contacto, en español y sin complicaciones.

Busca el centro donde está tu familiar y la app te muestra, en un solo lugar:

• Llamadas y mensajes: cómo ponerle saldo para que te pueda llamar o mandarte mensajes por la tablet del centro, con el botón directo a la página oficial del proveedor.
• Dinero: cómo depositarle dinero para la tienda (comisaría) según las reglas de ese centro.
• Cartas: la forma correcta de escribir la dirección, con botón para copiarla.
• Visitas: reglas y horarios básicos.
• Teléfono del centro para preguntar por tu familiar y el número para dejarle un mensaje urgente.
• Enlace al localizador de ICE si no sabes en qué centro está.

Importante: los detenidos no pueden recibir llamadas. Esta app te explica cómo hacer que él te pueda llamar.

Los pagos se hacen siempre en la página oficial de cada proveedor; la app no maneja tu dinero ni pide tus datos. No necesitas crear cuenta.

Si además quieres sacarlo con un habeas corpus, la app te lleva a Habeas Fácil.

Contacto Detenido es información general tomada de las páginas oficiales de ICE y de cada centro. No está afiliada a ICE, al gobierno ni a ningún centro o proveedor. Las reglas pueden cambiar: confirma por teléfono antes de enviar dinero o viajar.

SAVE FROM ANYWHERE

name: Cosplay Build Planner
description:
Know what is still missing before the convention.
Name your costume, list the pieces and instantly see how ready it is and what the rest will cost.
One calm planner for every piece, every expense and everything you need to pack. No account needed.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Name your costume and add the event date if you have one.
2. Start with five pieces (wig, outfit, prop, shoes, accessories) and rename, remove or add your own.
3. See your readiness ring and a budget forecast right away.
4. Tap a piece as you go: not started, in progress, ready.

KNOW WHAT STILL NEEDS WORK
- Readiness counts ready pieces out of all pieces, each counted the same. An empty list says "Add your first piece", never 100%.
- Pieces that still need work come first, with where each one comes from: own, buy, make or rent.
- Notes and reference pictures for every piece.

TRACK EVERY COSTUME EXPENSE
- Enter an estimate, an actual cost, both or neither.

description:
CostumeForge is your personal AI-assisted maker companion for DIY cosplay, armor building, Halloween costumes, and theatrical prop making.

name: Couples Recap

PRIVATE BY DESIGN

- Photos are looked through on your iPhone, not on a server.

name: Court Piece Rang Online
description:
Court Piece, also known as Rang, is the classic four-player team card game. Choose your rang (the trump suit), work with your partner and win tricks to take the match.

PLAY YOUR WAY
• Multiplayer: join a quick match, with bots filling any empty seats
• Play with Friends: create a private table and share the code
• Single Player: play with a bot partner across five tables, from Dubai to Pakistan, with opponents getting tougher at each one

TWO GAME MODES
• Single Sar: every trick counts for the team that wins it
• Double Sar: win two tricks in a row with the same player to collect the whole pile
• Optional Ace Rule for Double Sar, for players who want an extra challenge

CHOOSE YOUR MATCH LENGTH
Play up to 3, 5 or 9 rounds on single-player and private tables. Longer matches pay a bigger win bonus. Quick matches are up to 5 rounds.

GO FOR THE BIG WINS
Win a hand for 1 point or a Court for 2. A Goon Court or Bavney ends the match on the spot.

SMART BOTS
Bots remember the cards played and play for the pile, and your bot partner always plays at full strength. Bot seats are clearly labelled, so you always know who you're playing with.

CHAT AT THE TABLE
Send quick phrases and emotes during play. There is no free typing, so the table stays friendly.

MAKE IT YOURS
Earn coins and gems, then spend them on table felts, avatars and chat packs. These change how the game looks, not how it plays.

FAIR COINS
Your table deposit comes back at the end of every match you finish, win or lose, and winners get a bonus from the game. Leaving a match early forfeits your deposit. Coins and gems are for use in the game only and can't be exchanged for cash or prizes.

New to Rang? How to Play in the main menu explains the rules.

name: Courtside: Tennis & Pickleball
description:
Keep score without breaking your rhythm. Courtside turns your Apple Watch into the court: your opponent's half on top, yours at the bottom, the net across the middle. Tap a half to give that side the point, or say it to Siri and keep your hands on the racket. Share the match live and friends can follow it point by point.

TENNIS
• Points in big type on each side of the net: 15, 30, 40, AD
• Games and sets on a small scoreboard in the service boxes
• Deuce or no-ad, tiebreaks at 6–6 with the serve rotating correctly
• Best of one, three or five sets, with an optional 10-point match tiebreak
• Break point, set point and match point called out on the net

PICKLEBALL
• Side-out scoring, with doubles server numbers from the 0-0-2 start
• The score call on the net before every serve: 7-4-2
• Side out, second server, game point and match point called out
• Games to 11, 15 or 21, won by two; one game or best of three
• Singles or doubles, and optional rally scoring

ALWAYS KNOW WHO SERVES
A yellow ball marks the server and the side they serve from: deuce or ad in tennis, right or left in pickleball.

HANDS FREE
• Score with Siri: raise your wrist and say "My point in Courtside" or "Their point in Courtside", and Siri answers with the new score. "Undo in Courtside" and "What's the score in Courtside" work too
• Speak Score calls the score out loud after every point, through the watch speaker or AirPods: "Thirty fifteen", "Your game, you lead 4 3", or the pickleball call "Side out, 0 4 1"
• Score your own point with a double tap of finger and thumb on Apple Watch Series 9 and later and Ultra 2 and later
• Different haptics for a point, a game, a set, a side out and a change of ends

COURTSIDE LIVE
• Turn on Share Live and the watch shows a 6-digit code, a QR code and a link. Anyone with one of them can follow the match as you play
• Followers see the court, the score and who serves, on an iPhone, another Apple Watch or any web browser at livecourtside.app
• Sharing a match is free, and so is following one

THE IPHONE APP
• Follow a match or a whole tournament by code or link
• Put a match on your Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island with a Live Activity
• Host a tournament: you get one code, players type it on their watch to join, and every court appears live on one board. Put the board on a TV at the club
• Remove a court from the board or close the tournament to new matches

MADE FOR PLAYING
• A reminder to change ends when the rules call for it
• Undo any point from the controls, one swipe away
• Each match runs as a tennis or pickleball workout, so the score stays on screen and the session is saved to the Health app
• Matches you end go to History on the watch, where you can name it and set its date

SEVEN COURTS
Tennis on blue hard court, red clay, striped grass, or blue with a green surround. Pickleball on blue, green, or navy with an orange kitchen. Change courts any time, even mid-match.

HOSTING TOURNAMENTS
Scoring, sharing a match, joining a tournament and following are free. Only the host pays for a tournament board, in the iPhone app:
• Tournament Pass: one tournament, open to new matches for 7 days. $4.99, paid once
• Club plan: unlimited tournaments, $9.99 a month or $29.99 a year, with the first week free
The Club plan renews automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Payment is charged to your Apple Account, and you can manage or cancel the plan in your Apple Account settings.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking. Your matches stay on your watch, and workouts go only to the Health app. When you share live, the score and any names you typed go to our server for anyone with the code to see, and the server deletes them after 7 days.

name: CreatorPrompt Teleprompter
description:
CreatorPrompt is a simple teleprompter camera for anyone who talks to the camera. Write or paste your script, open the prompter and record a vertical video while your words scroll right next to the front camera lens. Look at the lens, read naturally and keep eye contact with your audience.
