TELEPROMPTER THAT STAYS OUT OF YOUR VIDEO
• Smooth auto-scrolling script over the live camera

SIMPLE SCRIPT EDITOR

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account and no sign-in

Great for short vertical videos, product demos, course lessons, vlogs, presentations, announcements and speeches.

FREE AND PRO
Your first 3 videos saved to Photos are free. Rehearsing, discarding and failed saves never use a free video. CreatorPrompt Pro is a one-time purchase that unlocks unlimited recordings for life. No subscription.

TEAM

name: CrowninTech
description:
星象运势：本命盘 + 每日星象，今日宜忌一屏看完

星象运势，十二宫本命盘与每日星象全部在你自己手机上算好，打开就看。
出生日期和城市填一次，十二宫、行星落位、上升星座与天顶一次排准。

【怎么用】

• 今日：今天该注意什么，一屏看完
• 星盘：十二宫本命盘、行星落位与上升星座
• 日历：按月回看与前瞻每日星象
• 档案：出生信息录一次，本机保存
• 设置：主题、强调色、隐私政策与意见反馈

【本命盘怎么算】

填入出生日期、出生城市，有出生时辰也可以填上。
星象运势会用内置的天文算法排出十二宫、每颗行星的落位星座与宫位，
再按出生时刻和城市换算出上升星座、天顶与主星守护。
整张盘不上传，全在你自己设备上算。

【今日怎么用】

每天一屏：宜做与宜避、幸运色、能量提醒，
都是按当天的星象位置在本地推算的。
想看更远的日子，翻日历页按月排。

【档案怎么用】

可以为家人和自己各建一个档案，随时切换、编辑或删除。
出生信息只存在这台设备上，不上传、不同步、不注册账号。
删除档案或卸载 App，相关记录一并清除。

【隐私】

不登录、没有账号、不申请任何系统权限（不碰相机、相册、定位、通讯录、通知）。
你填的出生日期、出生时辰与出生城市只存在自己的设备上，
可以在档案页单独删，也可以在设置里一次性清除。
不接入第三方 SDK，无广告、无崩溃上报，不收集任何类别的用户数据。

联网只有一类，全部指向开发者自建服务器：首启时发一条安装来源统计，用来判断这次安装
归属哪个推广渠道。请求里只有一个随机设备标识与设备参数，不含姓名、邮箱、电话、位置、
照片，也不含剪贴板内容；除此之外全程离线。

【适合谁】

想知道自己本命盘长什么样、上升星座到底是哪一个、
今天要不要往前冲一冲的人。

版本 1.0

name: CuffMemo - Watch Voice Notes

Whether you are capturing a 3-hour boardroom discussion or a 30-second thought on a walk, CuffMemo records reliably, transfers safely to your iPhone, and turns speech into searchable transcripts and structured minutes.

TWO MODES FOR EVERY MOMENT
• Meeting Mode: Engineered for long sessions. Audio is written in rolling 3-minute ADTS segments with crash recovery and background audio support. Every segment is verified with SHA-256 on your iPhone before your Watch clears local space—so nothing gets lost in sync.
• Idea Mode: Quick single-segment capture (up to 5 minutes) for fleeting thoughts. Your original audio and verbatim transcript always come first; optional AI titles and summaries live on a separate layer you can toggle off anytime.

INSTANT WRIST & IPHONE CAPTURE
• Launch directly from the Apple Watch Action Button, Control Center, Watch Face Complications, Smart Stack, Double Tap, or Siri.

ON-DEVICE TRANSCRIPTION & PLAYBACK

ACTIONABLE MINUTES & SYSTEM INTEGRATION
• Generate structured meeting minutes with an overview, key decisions, open questions, and action items with owners and due dates.
• Sync minutes and action items back to your Apple Watch to check off tasks right from your wrist.
• Automatically match meeting titles and attendees with Apple Calendar, and send confirmed action items to Apple Reminders.

PRIVACY BY DEFAULT

Your key stays in the system Keychain, audio files are never uploaded, and transcript text is only sent after your explicit per-service consent—which you can revoke anytime.

name: Cutout Casts

Casts is a calm, friendly podcast player for iPhone, iPad and Mac. No ads, no algorithm, no account to create. Just the shows you love, ready when you are.

FIND ANY SHOW BY NAME
Type a show, host or topic, typos and all, and Casts finds it. Browse popular shows in News, Tech, Sports, Entertainment, Science, Business, Stories and Culture, or paste a show's website or feed address.

LISTEN NOW
Every new episode in one place. Switch between Unplayed, Started and Saved, and pick up exactly where you left off.

UP NEXT
Line up what you want to hear. Reorder with a drag, play an episode next, and let Casts move on to the next one automatically.

A PLAYER THAT GETS OUT OF THE WAY
• Chapters, with artwork and links when shows include them
• Playback speeds from 0.8× to 2×

NEW-EPISODE ALERTS
Turn on alerts for the shows you can't miss, with the show's artwork in the notification.

HOME SCREEN WIDGET
See what's playing and what's up next, and play, pause or skip right from your Home Screen.

YOURS, EVERYWHERE
Your shows, Up next and listening progress stay in step across iPhone, iPad and Mac through your own private iCloud. Choose a desk color, and match it across every Cutout app.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No ads, no tracking, no account. We don't collect your data.

SUBSCRIPTION

name: CXHD Plus
description: CXHD Plus Compare records side-by-side to distinguish between bank transactions, recognized expenses, and refundable deposits. You can review the sequence of payments, verify the funds that need to be set aside pending the receipt of a refund, and identify dates where charges occurred on both sides along the rental timeline. Consolidated payments can be broken down into rent and deposits, with deposits recorded as received—either in full or in installments—or applied toward outstanding bills. Each handover is settled independently, with subsequent bills listed as separate entries. When a review is required, you can locate original settlements by property, date, bill, or bank reference number, and compare the expenses and cash flows across different handovers.

name: Cyprus Stay Countdown
description:
Cyprus Immigration Companion helps you keep track of your time in Cyprus, your residence permit expiry date, and the documents you need for renewal.
- Permit countdown. Enter the dates on your residence permit card to see how much time you have before it expires.
- Renewal reminders. Get reminders 90, 60, and 30 days before your permit expires.
- Travel day tracker. Record your arrivals and departures, see how many days you’ve used in a rolling 180-day period, and estimate how a planned return may affect your remaining days.
- Document checklist. Check off each renewal document as you prepare it.
Access is arranged through Veronica Tanova. Travel calculations are estimates for planning.

name: Cytolum
description:
A quiet world is waiting to be understood.

Begin with a luminous Core and a fragile supply of crystals. Create autonomous workers, discover their roles, and learn how to keep a living cell alive.

Every choice has a cost. Gather resources, construct pathways through the membrane, and prepare your defenders before invaders arrive. Grow neurons and give each circuit one purpose, turning a collection of small workers into a system that can sustain itself.

The first release includes two playable Phases:
• Awakening — discover the cell and survive its first invasion.
• First Signal — develop your colony, explore neural automation, and face increasingly demanding battles.

FEATURES
• Autonomous workers with fluid motion and physical cargo.
• Resource gathering, construction, defense and neural circuits.
• Deterministic liquid currents in a luminous, atmospheric world.
• Ambient music and soft interaction sounds.
• Adjustable game speed from 1× to 4×.
• Optional Apple or Google sign-in for unlocked Phases and milestone sync, or guest play with progress saved on your device.

Cytolum has no ads, in-app purchases or subscriptions. Phase 3 is planned and is marked Coming soon on Home.

Join the developer and community on Discord to share ideas, discoveries and bug reports.

name: D-Day Countdown & Day Counter
description:
How many days until your wedding, your trip or your exam? How many days since you met, moved in or quit smoking? D-Day Countdown answers in one glance.

A clean, simple day counter for every date that matters. Add an event, pick a date, and the count updates by itself every day.

COUNT DOWN AND COUNT UP
• Days until any date: "13 days left"
• Days since any date: "1,008 days together"
• Show the count in days, weeks, months or years, or as D-Day (D-13, D-Day, D+100)
• Count the first day as day 1 for love and relationship anniversaries
• Repeat every year or every month: birthdays, anniversaries, paydays
• Pin the events you care about most to the top

REMINDERS THAT HELP, NOT NAG
• Get notified on the day, or 1, 3 or 7 days before, at the time you choose
• Milestone reminders for count-ups: every 100 days and every year

BEAUTIFUL AND YOURS
• Cover photos from your gallery or from built-in themes
• List, compact, cards or grid view
• Light and dark mode, accent colors and alternate app icons
• Share any countdown as a picture for your story or chat

FOR EVERY BIG DAY
Wedding countdown, vacation countdown, birthday countdown, Christmas and New Year, exams and deadlines, due date and baby's age, retirement, concerts, a new job. Count up from the day you met, your sober days, days without smoking, or a new habit.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account and no sign-up. Your events and photos stay on your phone.

PREMIUM
A one-time purchase or a yearly subscription removes ads and unlocks every accent color and app icon. The yearly plan renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period; manage it in your App Store account settings.

Add your first countdown in a few seconds and never lose track of the days that matter.

name: Daily Words: Build Vocabulary
description:
Build your vocabulary, one day at a time.

Practice with clear flashcards, save words you want to learn, and track your progress from Practicing to Mastered. Discover 1,600 curated words across Intermediate, Advanced, Expert, and Insane levels, including study vocabulary and delightfully obscure words.

Included free:
• 100 starter suggestions
• Up to 50 saved words, including your own
• Flashcard practice and daily word discovery
• Daily completion, streak tiles, and progress sharing
• Optional dictionary lookup or manual definitions

Upgrade once to Daily Words Pro for all 1,600 suggestions, unlimited saved words, multiple-choice quizzes, detailed stats, and White and Sepia themes.

Your built-in word bank, saved words, and practice work offline. Optional lookups require an internet connection and use FreeDictionaryAPI.com, with definitions from Wiktionary under CC BY-SA 4.0.

No account. No ads. No subscription. Words and progress stay on your device unless you choose to share them; optional dictionary lookup sends only the entered word and the associated network request to the lookup service. Device backups may be managed by Apple.

name: Dance Class NJ
description:
WELCOME TO Dance Class

The Dance Class app allows you to manage your account with ease, register for classes, and special events. You'll also receive important notifications about class changes, closings, registration openings, special announcements, and upcoming events.

The Dance Class app is an easy-to-use, on-the-go way to access everything Dance Class has to offer right from your smartphone.

name: Dark Video
description:
Dark Video é a plataforma para criar canais sem aparecer e vídeos que vendem, do nicho ao vídeo pronto.

PARA CANAIS QUE MONETIZAM
• Buscador de nichos: veja canais novos que já atingiram os requisitos de monetização, com números e os vídeos que mais renderam.
• Canais de referência e vídeos em alta para escolher o tema antes de produzir.
• Quadro de ideias para organizar os próximos vídeos.
• Produção por etapas: roteiro, narração, cenas com IA, montagem, capa, título, descrição e capítulos. Você aprova cada etapa.

PARA VÍDEOS DE PRODUTO
• Informe o produto e o seu link de afiliado.
• Escolha quem apresenta: o seu clone, um avatar ou só o produto.
• Receba roteiros prontos de vídeo curto, um projeto por vídeo.

NO APLICATIVO
• Peça o vídeo por texto ou falando no microfone.
• Acompanhe cada projeto, etapa por etapa, e peça ajustes.
• Envie fotos e vídeos do aparelho para os seus projetos.
• Baixe os vídeos prontos e compartilhe.
• Veja o calendário de postagens dos seus vídeos.

Para usar o aplicativo é preciso ter uma conta Dark Video.

name: DARWIN Ops
description:
DARWIN Ops provides a simple and intuitive interface for capturing field observations, exception notes, material remarks, and follow-up checkpoints, then reviewing how work closes over time. It also includes practical planning gauges for warehouse and floor operations, covering volume, turnaround windows, staffing headroom, and related throughput estimates. All records are stored locally on the device for convenient access and management.

The app offers an orderly workspace with Timeline, Board, Gauges, Sites, and Desk. Users can browse, add, edit, filter, and maintain entries; attach optional field shots from the camera or photo library; tag sites, stages, priorities, and themes; and review closure rates, recurring themes, and upcoming checkpoints in structured summary views. Supports local data storage with no account required, making it easy to organise and revisit operational notes on iPhone.

name: DashScan: Car Warning Lights
description:
A warning light just popped up on your dashboard? Snap a photo with DashScan AI and know within seconds what it means, whether it is safe to keep driving, and what repairs typically cost.

- Instant AI dashboard warning light scanner
- Clear safety verdict: Stop Driving vs. Service Soon
- Estimated repair cost range & step-by-step advice
- Built-in offline guide to common warning symbols.

Subscriptions auto-renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage anytime in Apple Account Settings.
Terms of Use: https://lumespec.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://lumespec.com/privacy

name: DASVI: Party Games
description:
DASVI is a pocket party: nine quick games that get any group talking, laughing and guessing.

Pass the phone, swipe through the cards and let the questions do the work. No setup, no accounts, just friends.

THE GAMES
• Would You Rather: two impossible choices. Pick one and defend it.
• 2 Truths & 1 Lie: can your friends spot the lie?
• Who's More Likely: everyone points, and the most fingers has to explain.
• Never Have I Ever: hands up if you've done it.
• Mind Reader: guess what your friend will say.
• Truth or Dare: spin the bottle.
• Story Building: one word each, one story together.
• Bomb: name things from a category before it blows.
• Reaction Duel: tap first when the screen turns white.

MADE FOR GROUPS
• Hundreds of questions across Party, Love and Deep topics
• Questions you've already played come back less often
• English and Georgian
• Made for one phone passed around the table

PLAY YOUR WAY
• Pick the topics that fit your group
• Optional drinking mode for adults 18+, off by default. Any drink counts, water too.

Try every game free for 7 days. After that, unlock DASVI with a single one-time payment: no subscription, and no ads once unlocked.

name: Day by Day with God
description:
Read a Bible passage and a reflection by Carl Olof Rosenius each day. Day by Day with God contains the English translation by Maj-Len Henriksson, based on the seventeenth edition published by Luthersk Litteratur-Mission.

• Open directly to today’s devotion.
• Share the daily devotion.
• Read offline. The full year of devotions is included in the app.

name: Daylark Notes: Symptom Journal
description:
Daylark Notes is a perimenopause symptom tracker and private journal for recording what you notice, when it happens. Add check-ins for hot flashes, night sweats, brain fog, mood or sleep. Record period days and spotting on a separate calendar.

• Log symptoms with a date, time and intensity. Make multiple check-ins in a day, add an entry for a past date, and pin the symptoms you use most.
• Record sleep quality and the times you wake up. Add optional mood and notes to a check-in.
• Review dated history and counts for a range you choose. Open a source day to see the entries behind a count.
• Keep questions and a private note for your next visit. Choose which sections to include, preview a one-page visit summary, and save or share it as a PDF.
• Keep your journal on your device. No account is required. Create a manual backup file or restore it from a location you choose.

Daylark Notes is for personal recordkeeping. It is not medical advice. It is not a medical device and does not diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any medical condition. Consult a qualified clinician for medical advice.

Terms of Use: https://mandaglobalvn.com/daylark-notes/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://mandaglobalvn.com/daylark-notes/privacy/

name: DBlocks
description:
DBlocks is a relaxing yet addictive block puzzle. Drag the pieces onto the 8×8 grid, fill whole rows or columns to clear them, and chain clears together to build big combos.

HOW TO PLAY
• Drag pieces onto the grid
• Complete a row or a column to clear it
• Clear several in a row to build a combo and multiply your score
• The game ends when no piece fits — plan ahead!

FEATURES
• Simple to learn, hard to put down
• Combo system that rewards smart moves
• 60-second duels: same blocks for both players, highest score wins
• World and country rankings
• Add friends and challenge them
• Play as a guest, or sign in with Apple or Google to keep your progress on every device
• Day and night themes, haptics and sound

name: Deep Bite: Eat & Evolve
description:
Deep Bite is a 3D underwater arcade game about a small fish with a big appetite. The rule is simple: eat anyone smaller than you, and swim away from anyone bigger. You are what you eat.

YOU ARE WHAT YOU EAT
Everything you swallow changes you. Some prey make you glow, so you carry your own light into the dark. Others grow spikes on your back, and a predator that bites you will spit you right out. Your colour mixes from your meals like paint, and the right mix of traits unlocks secret combinations.

A NEW SEA EVERY DIVE
Each dive generates a new map: new terrain, a new abyss, wrecks and shells in new places. Find sunken ships and open their treasure chests. Go deeper, into the dark, and the ruins of Atlantis are waiting, their runes glowing in the abyss.

SHARKS DO NOT FORGIVE
While you are small, a shark sees you as a snack. Dash to break away, use Flare to blind a hunter, and reach a shell shelter: the shell saves your progress, so losing a life sends you back to the shell instead of back to the start.

DIVER LEVEL AND THE REWARD ROAD
Every point you score becomes XP. Diver levels unlock permanent perks along the reward road: extra dashes, a wider mouth, a bigger start, extra lives, a faster Flare, and new zones.

THREE ZONES
• Warm Reef: corals, fry and Atlantis in the abyss. Open from the start.
• Ice Fjord: ice spires, a ship frozen in ice and the Ice Shark. Opens at level 5.
• Fire Vents: lava cracks, black smokers and the Fire Shark. Opens at level 10.
Every zone has its own goals: grow, hunt a predator and become the terror of the zone.

DAILY CHALLENGES
Three easy and two medium challenges every day, and a hard one every three days, with XP, pearls and achievements.

EVOLVE AND COLLECT
Earn awards to unlock new forms of your fish, pick a form before the next dive, and fill in the bestiary with every new species you meet.

FAIR TO PLAY
The game is free. There is nothing to buy, and lives are never sold for money.
There are no banners and no ads between dives. A short video plays only when you tap for it: one more life after you get eaten, double XP for a dive, or swapping a challenge.
No accounts and no sign-up. Your progress stays on your device.

Made for phones in landscape: joystick on the left, Dash and Flare on the right. Playable in English and Russian.

Made by Nova Sidera.

name: DELEG8
description:
Bring your day together with DELEG8, your personal AI work companion.

Talk or type to your pixel agent. Keep a clear conversation, see which tools are
being used, and review the agent’s reply in one place.

Organize tasks, work with your team’s files, join meetings, and connect supported
mail and calendar accounts. Your agent can help find information, prepare drafts
and keep work moving. Actions that send messages or require a decision ask for
confirmation.

Customize your pixel agent’s look, work style and accessories. Use English or
Arabic, and switch between light and dark themes.

Some features require a connected third-party account, permission from your
workspace administrator or an active internet connection. Desktop terminal control
is available in the separate DELEG8 desktop companion, with explicit local approval.

Powered by YouVerse Technologies.

name: Democracia: People's Voice
description:
Give the people their voice back. Democracia explains Spain's new laws, decrees and regulations in a few words and lets you vote: «In favor», «Against» or «Blank (I accept any result)». The more people vote, the harder it is for politicians to ignore.

An unofficial citizen initiative: results have no legal value and do not replace any official vote.

WHERE IT WORKS: the laws are Spain's (from the BOE, its official gazette) and in Spanish. Outside Spain you see your country's elections if they are on the international list; in «You» you can switch to Spain or to all countries.

TODAY, IN FOUR TABS
• Coming up: what the government approved that isn't published yet, so you can weigh in first.
• Recently approved: everything published in the last month.
• Most controversial: what people talk about most on social media.
• Affects you: the laws that touch the most people (taxes, pensions, housing…).

EACH LAW, TOP TO BOTTOM
• Its dates and the official text, linked to the source.
• An AI summary to a neutral template («In a few words», «Who it affects», «What changes»), with arguments for and against given equal weight. It can contain mistakes: that's why the official text comes first.
• Who approved it: in Spain's Congress, which parties voted for, against or abstained, and with how many votes; for a government decree, that day's government and its parties. And who proposed it, when on record. Nothing uncertain is shown.
• At the end you vote: one vote per law, final.
• «Share» sends a link so others can vote on it, never how you voted.

THE VOICE OF THE PEOPLE
• Votes verified with ID and face scan next to the total. Only verified votes count: one real person, one vote.

LAWS AND SEARCH
• Thousands of Spanish laws in force, old ones included, in Laws, Decrees and Rules. Sort by most recent, passed by the narrowest margin, affecting us the most or most voted, and filter by topic.
• Search by name, number or Spanish nickname («ley mordaza», «4/2015»), with suggestions as you type.

ELECTIONS
• For Spain's general election, published polls (CIS and polling average) with the Democracia count below, party by party. Ours is not a scientific poll: it only counts verified votes from the app.
• A party poll and, once candidates are confirmed, your constituency's ballot in random order, with their program. Also «Nobody represents me / I disagree with the current electoral system».

YOUR VOTE, PROTECTED
• Your vote doesn't carry your name, your iPhone or your account. Not even we can see who voted for what.
• Protected with cryptography and checked so nobody votes twice: one per topic per Apple Account, only from a real iPhone or iPad.
• A receipt to check on the public board that your vote was counted.
• No profile: no name, email or phone number. Just a 6-digit PIN that stays on your iPhone.
• Optional verification: your e-passport chip (or Spanish DNI) plus a face scan with a liveness check. Your photo and face never leave the iPhone; your name, number and date of birth are not stored.

ADS AND PRO
• A banner and, after you vote, with your vote already counted, a full-screen ad. You never have to watch an ad to vote, and the ad receives nothing about how you voted.
• Democracia Pro removes all ads, with a 7-day trial; the App Store shows the monthly or yearly price in your currency. It renews automatically until you cancel in your Apple Account. Being Pro doesn't change your vote or the count.

GOOD TO KNOW
• Spanish public sources: BOE, Council of Ministers and Congress.
• Verification needs an iPhone (NFC); on iPad you vote with the same Apple Account.
• Requires internet. In English, Spanish, Portuguese, German, French and Italian.

Every vote adds to something that belongs to all of us. Download Democracia and have your say.

Terms of use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy policy: https://cdpoma.github.io/democracia/privacidad.html

name: Demon Slash War: Blaze
description:
Little boat. Big harbor.

Cast off in our app, a cozy 3D gathering and delivery game. Sail a bright little tug through turquoise water, lift floating treasures into a visible cargo stack, and bring each haul back to the glowing pier.

GATHER A LITTLE TREASURE
Rescue driftwood, sea greens, pearl shells and smooth sea glass from four cargo fields. Every piece appears aboard your boat. A heavier stack changes how you cruise, and fresh sea greens reward a thoughtful return trip.

BUILD A HOME FOR EVERY VOYAGE
Earn supply tickets through deliveries. Improve your cargo racks, engine, gathering boom, freshness chest and tide rudder. Restore five island facilities and watch the real 3D harbor grow around you. Light the beacon tower to complete your harbor's big goal, then keep the neighborhood supplied.

SAIL YOUR OWN WAY
Steer with a touch helm, gather with a tap and use a short boost when you need it. Rotate the perspective camera, plot cargo fields on the full harbor chart and choose friendly requests from the dispatch board. Read changing tides, collect discoveries and keep your best voyages in a local captain's logbook.

A WARM WELCOME, EVERY TIME
Enjoy original synthesized harbor sounds, gentle tactile feedback and a free recovery tow that protects your cargo. Landscape play starts directly in the harbor, with help available whenever you want it.

name: Dengo: Roots and Languages
description:
Learn Kurdish: Kurmanji, Sorani, Zazaki, Hawrami. Plus Georgian, Laz, Armenian, Circassian and more. Type a word, see it in 14 languages, hear a real voice.

• Offline dictionary: 127,000 words in Kurmanji, Sorani, Zazaki, Hawrami, Georgian, Laz, Adyghe, Kabardian, Armenian, Albanian, Macedonian, Tatar, Uyghur and Kabyle
• One Kurdish word in four dialects, side by side. Search in English, Turkish or the language itself; accents optional
• Real voices: native speakers say the words, and talking characters say them to you
• Short lessons that feel like play: listen, tap, get it right
• Read every script: Latin, Arabic, Georgian, Armenian and Cyrillic
• Dengo Radio, stories and scenes: listen anywhere, even offline
• A few minutes a day: smart review and streaks bring words back before you forget

Missing a word? Ask online, and the answer joins the dictionary for everyone.

No account, no sign-up. The dictionary and A1 are free. Dengo Plus unlocks A2–B1, every reading and an ad-free experience.

Dengo Plus (optional subscription): every A2 and B1 lesson, unit, reading and book, with no ads. Monthly or yearly; the yearly plan can start with a free trial for new subscribers. Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation. The subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel in your Apple ID settings.

Privacy Policy: https://onehelsing.github.io/dengo/privacy/

name: Derby Race Night
description:
Derby Race Night runs your kids' gravity car race, from weigh-in to trophies, on one iPad or iPhone. It's made for the volunteer at the finish-line table: every screen explains itself, and nothing needs the internet.

BEFORE THE RACE
• Set up a derby in a minute: its name, 2 to 8 lanes, your dens or groups, and the awards you'll give.
• Paste your racers from a spreadsheet, type them in, or copy last year's.
• Weigh-in: type each car's weight and see at once whether it's within your limit. Check length, width, and wheels and axles against your own rules. A car that fails is marked "Needs fix" until it passes. Add a photo of each car.

RACE NIGHT
• Fair heats, built for you: every car runs once in every lane and meets as many different opponents as possible.
• Tap each lane's place as the cars cross the line, or type times from a stopwatch or a timer's display. Save, and the next heat is up.
• "On deck" shows the next heats, so helpers can stage the cars.
• A late arrival, a car that has to go home, a lane jump, a wrong result: add the car, withdraw it, re-run the heat or fix any past heat. The schedule and the standings follow at once.
• Every tap is saved as you go. If the battery dies, open the app again and you're back on the same heat.

THE HALL TV
• Connect a TV or a projector over AirPlay or an HDMI adapter. The room sees who's on the track, each finish and the live leaderboard, in a big-screen layout of its own, not a mirror of your screen.

STANDINGS AND TIES
• Live standings for every den and overall, with each lane's result.
• Ties for a trophy or a place in the final are spotted for you. A run-off heat swaps the cars' lanes so it stays fair.
• A final for the top cars from each group decides the overall champions.

AWARDS
• Speed trophies are worked out for you. Add design awards like "Most creative" and "Best paint job".
• Every child gets an award: the app shows who doesn't have one yet and suggests awards to close the gap.
• Announcer mode reveals 3rd, 2nd and then 1st on the hall TV, with a drumroll.

AFTER THE RACE
• Print or share a results PDF, a certificate for every child, and spreadsheet files of the whole night.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no sign-in, no ads, no tracking. Children's names and photos stay on your device unless you back them up to your own iCloud.
• Back up your derbies to your own iCloud with one tap, and download them on a new iPad or after a reinstall. Nothing moves unless you tap.

FREE TO TRY
• Every feature is free for races of up to 8 cars, so you can try a practice race at home first.
• One purchase, "Full race", unlocks any number of cars for every derby you run. No subscription.

Derby Race Night works for pinewood-style car races run by scout packs, church clubs, schools and families. It's an independent app, not affiliated with or endorsed by any scouting or church organization.

name: Derby Rivals: Horse Racing
description:
Build a stable, pick your five and outsmart your rivals in Derby Rivals, the horse racing card game where every race is a battle of judgement.

PICK YOUR FIVE
Every meeting is five head-to-head races. Choose which horse runs where, and read the conditions: firm or heavy going, sprint or staying distance, turf or dirt. The right horse in the right race wins it.

WATCH EVERY RACE UNFOLD
Races play out on 3D courses inspired by famous tracks, run in both directions. Follow the field on the mini map, hear a British race caller call it live, then relive the finish in super slow motion.

BUILD A RACING DYNASTY
• Buy, sell and train horses to sharpen their stats
• Retire your champions to stud and breed the next generation
• Claim promising runners from rival stables
• Watch horses age, retire and earn a place in your Hall of Fame

MASTER THE MEETING
• Gear up before each race
• Tip the winner of each race and earn bonus Guineas
• Open packs to find rare horses
• Check the Daily Sale for bargains
• Earn Rosettes and climb from local meetings to the biggest events

PLAY ANYWHERE
Derby Rivals plays fully offline. No account, no waiting, just racing.

Derby Rivals uses in-game currency only. Optional in-app purchases are available.

name: Deskwise: Desktop Browser
description:
Deskwise opens the full desktop version of websites on your iPhone, the one you use on a computer, and makes it comfortable to use on a phone.

Built for consultants, contractors, freelancers and anyone who works in web portals that only feel right on a laptop.

THE DESKTOP SITE, FOR REAL
• A complete desktop identity: desktop width, desktop browser, no "touch phone" signals, so sites stop pushing their mobile version or a "get our app" page
• Every site remembers its own choice: desktop or mobile, width, text size
• Stay in the browser: pages can't throw you into the App Store or another app; a banner lets you open it if you want
• Pop-up sign-in windows open as tabs, so web sign-ins and multi-factor approval work

WORKSPACES (PRO)
• One workspace per client, company or account, each with its own cookies and sign-ins
• Keep the same web app open with different accounts, side by side, never mixed
• Lock any workspace with Face ID

DESK TOOLS (PRO)
• Trackpad pointer with hover, for menus that only open under a mouse
• One-tap right-click for context menus
• Shortcut keys: Esc, Tab, arrows, Page Up/Down
• Desktop widths from 1024 to 1920 px, and other browser identities when a site requires one

MORE
• Work-app launcher on the start page, each app opening in the right workspace
• Tabs with session restore, private tabs, bookmarks, history, downloads to Files, find in page, QR scanner, full screen
• Page assistant (Pro): summarize or explain a dense page with Apple's on-device model (iOS 26, Apple Intelligence devices). The page never leaves your iPhone
• Meeting mode (Pro): keeps the screen awake through long calls

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No ads. No trackers. No account. Your pages, passwords and cookies stay on your iPhone. Deskwise has no servers that see your browsing.

HONEST LIMITS
Deskwise uses Apple's WebKit, like every iPhone browser. iOS doesn't allow web notifications in browsers like this, screen sharing from the phone, or calls continuing in the background. Your organization's sign-in, device and security policies always apply: if your company requires a managed device or its official app, Deskwise won't bypass that. Website compatibility can change at any time.

DESKWISE PRO
Free: desktop mode on every site, tabs, private browsing, the app guard, bookmarks, history and downloads.
Pro unlocks workspaces, desk tools, custom widths and identities, the page assistant and meeting mode. Choose a yearly plan (with a free trial for new subscribers), a monthly plan, or a one-time lifetime purchase.
Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period; your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the period ends. Manage or cancel anytime in Settings › Apple Account › Subscriptions. Any unused part of a free trial is forfeited when you buy a subscription.

name: Devine la date
description:
Devine la date – Le quiz d'Histoire qui teste vos connaissances !

Un événement historique s'affiche : un titre, un court descriptif… et à vous de retrouver l'année où il s'est produit ! De la préhistoire à nos jours, testez et affûtez votre culture générale, dans une course contre vos propres records.

QUATRE FAÇONS DE JOUER

• Expert : aucune proposition. Vous saisissez vous-même l'année (avant ou après J.-C.). Votre score est l'écart entre votre réponse et la vraie date : plus il est faible, mieux c'est. Trouvez l'année exacte pour décrocher un gros bonus!
• Série sans fautes : enchaînez le plus de bonnes réponses possible sans jamais vous tromper. Vous démarrez avec 5 énergies ; chaque erreur en coûte une. Rechargez en patientant 2 heures ou en regardant une courte vidéo. Votre plus longue série est gardée en mémoire : saurez-vous la battre ?

VOS RECORDS, VOS PARTAGES
Chaque mode conserve votre meilleur score. Fier de votre performance ? Partagez-la sur Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, X ou WhatsApp avec une image récapitulative, prête à publier.

PENSÉ POUR TOUT LE MONDE
• Entièrement en français, sans compte ni inscription.
• Clavier numérique intégré, mentions « avant / après J.-C. ».
• Thème clair ou sombre.
• Sons et musiques d'ambiance (désactivables dans les réglages).
• Fonctionne hors connexion : tout le contenu est embarqué.
• Réglages de confidentialité accessibles à tout moment.

POUR QUI ?

Élèves et étudiants qui révisent leurs repères chronologiques, passionnés d'Histoire, amateurs de quiz et de trivia, ou simples curieux : Devine la date transforme la frise du temps en jeu.

Alors, en quelle année ? À vous de deviner !

Un jeu simple, addictif et instructif pour réviser l'Histoire en famille ou entre amis, à tout âge !

FAT FINGER? UNDO.

THE CLOSER, THE RICHER
The nearer the foam dies to your toes, the more everything is worth. Let it stop a hair away for a KISS, chain kisses to push your Nerve up to x9, and feel time slow down when it gets really, really close. Your closest call is measured to a tenth of a millimetre. For bragging purposes.

GREED HAS A WEIGHT

A SEA WITH MOODS
Six kinds of waves, each announced before it breaks, so every soggy sock is entirely your fault. Lazy Ripples. Creepers that never seem to stop. Twins that come back for seconds. And the King wave, which chases you up the whole beach. Sometimes the sea drains away and a Golden Conch glitters on the bare sand. It is a trap. Go anyway.

FROM MORNING TO NIGHT
Last long enough and the day turns: Noon, Golden Hour, Dusk, then a Night of glowing foam. After that comes Day 2. Few socks have seen it.

PLENTY TO UNLOCK
31 socks, hats, footprint trails and beaches, all earned by playing. Missions, 24 achievements, 12 messages in bottles, and the Daily Tide: one sea a day, the same for everyone.

NO CATCH (EXCEPT THE WAVES)
• No ads. No in-app purchases. No account.
• Collects no data. The game never goes online.
• Plays offline: on a plane, in the subway, on an actual beach.
• Soggy? Hold to go again, instantly.
• Left-handed mode, reduced motion, English and French.

Every picture is drawn by code and every sound is synthesized on your device.

No socks were harmed in the making of this game. Several got wet.

name: DuAmigo: Find a Gaming Partner

Looking for a gaming partner you click with? No LFG posts, no swiping, no random lobbies. Tell us about yourself in two sentences and pick the hours you play; we find someone who fits, you just show up and play.

- The game doesn't matter, as long as you click: write two sentences about yourself, and we match you with someone who fits you and plays at the same hours. The suggestion shows why you two fit and what you could play together.

GAMES
League of Legends, Valorant, Counter-Strike 2, Minecraft Bedrock, World of Warcraft: Forever, Euro Truck Simulator 2, Dead by Daylight, ARC Raiders, PEAK, Valheim, Project Zomboid, Baldur's Gate 3, Sons of the Forest, It Takes Two and Split Fiction. - No chat, feed or voice in the app. You make the plan here and talk in the game.

Dunamis reúne en un solo lugar todo lo que tu equipo habla, decide y tiene pendiente. Cada proyecto tiene sus conversaciones, su wiki, sus tareas, su calendario y sus archivos, y todo se conecta con una mención.

name: Dungeon Cracker
description:
Find the guardian – claim the treasure!

As a hero of the adventurers' guild you enter dungeon after dungeon. Somewhere stands a treasure chest, guarded by exactly one monster. The guild scouts left clues: who lurks next to the barrel, who is two rows above whom, who has a room all to itself. Place every monster on the right square – exactly one in each row and column. Whoever ends up as the only monster with the chest is the guardian. Defeat it and open the treasure!

LOGIC, NOT LUCK
• Every puzzle has exactly one solution and can be solved without guessing – computer-checked
• Mark X like in sudoku, also by swiping
• The “?” on every card explains exactly what a clue means and shows the matching squares
• Hints in three steps: a nudge, the matching squares, the solution with the reason
• Guided tutorial in the first dungeon – learn by playing

100 DUNGEONS IN 5 REGIONS
• From Whisperwood through Mistmoor, Frostpeaks and the Emberlands to the Shadowrealm
• From easy (5×5) to master (7×7)
• Goblins, slimes, ghosts, golems, imps, mimics, drakes and many more
• World map with stars for every dungeon

YOUR HERO
• Warrior, mage or ranger – with a name, a look and their own skills
• Up to level 30 with guild titles from Guild Apprentice to Legend
• Skills like Clairvoyance, Battle Cry or Master Thief help with tricky puzzles

NEW EVERY DAY
• Daily dungeon: a new puzzle every day, with a streak bonus
• Endless mode: fresh dungeons in easy, medium or hard

FAIR
• Free, playable offline, no ads, no data collection
• No lives, no energy, no waiting
• Gold, gear and looks can be earned by playing; optional packs in the shop
• German and English, for iPhone and the foldable iPhone

name: DuoFrame: Couple Pose Camera
description:
Pose like a photographer — without knowing how.

DuoFrame is a pose-coaching camera for couples. Point it at the two of you, pick a pose, and a live white outline shows you exactly how to stand. DuoFrame checks your framing, light and faces in real time and auto-snaps the moment the shot looks great.

WHY DUOFRAME
• Live pose guide — step into the on-screen outline, no guesswork
• Real-time coaching — one clear tip at a time (step back, level the phone, turn to the light)
• Auto-snap — it captures when the composition scores high
• Dozens of poses — couple, pre-wedding, family, solo and friends, including full-body and wide scenic shots
• Golden-hour light — see the best time and sun direction for warm photos
• Shoot Plans — save the poses you want and tick them off on the day
• Film looks — finish your shot with a tasteful filter, then save or share

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
All pose, face and framing analysis runs on your iPhone with Apple's Vision framework. Your photos never leave the device — there's no account and no sign-in. The only time DuoFrame uses the network is the optional golden-hour forecast for your location.

Free to use. Point, pose, and get photos you'll actually want to keep.

name: Easy Buddy Checklist

Make everyday shopping and organizing easier with Easy Buddy Checklist!

Spend less time making lists and more time getting things done.

Easy Buddy Checklist — create a checklist in seconds!

name: Echoes of Earth 2026
description: Echoes of Earth 2026: your complete companion for India's greenest music festival. See what's live right now on the Home screen with live countdowns, browse the day-by-day timetable across every stage, and filter sets by live, upcoming or past. Explore the full lineup, discover new music, and build My Line Up and My Schedule so you never miss the artists you love. Get instant answers from the in-app Copilot, your festival assistant, which can tell you what's on right now, where a stage is, or where to find food. Customise the app with calendar, language and notification settings, find FAQs and accessibility information, and log in to save your schedule and wristband.

name: Edge: Focus on tasks at hand
description:
Edge is a calm to-do list for iPhone. No clutter, no accounts, no colours shouting for attention — just your tasks in clear black and white.

PULL, TAP, HOLD, SWIPE
• Pull down to add a task
• Tap a task to finish it
• Hold a task to see its details, sub-tasks and reminder
• Swipe up to see what you've completed

FOCUS
Pick a few tasks, choose how long, and start. Watch the minutes count down, or choose the Edge timer: a line around the screen that shrinks as time passes. Edge tells you when time's up.

REMINDERS
Give a task a time and your iPhone reminds you. Overdue tasks move to the top so nothing slips.

MADE WITH ASSISTIVE ACCESS IN MIND
Edge runs full screen in iOS Assistive Access, with large text, simple gestures and nothing hidden behind menus.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your tasks never leave your phone. Edge collects no data, has no account and makes no network connections.

name: Edios Comlink
description:
Edios Comlink is an offline-first pre-arrival EMS communication, ER bay staging, and Apple Watch timer companion built for high-contrast, glove-friendly field use and training.

Capture structured MIST and SBAR handoffs in seconds, generate a concise 15-second radio patch readout, share or print a clean ER pre-staging card, and keep arrival ETA and reassessment intervals synced on your wrist—with zero accounts, zero network traffic, and zero data collection.

KEY FEATURES
• Glove-Friendly MIST / SBAR Pre-Arrival Builder: Large 52pt+ tap steppers and 1-tap scenario presets capture mechanism, findings, vitals, and field actions while auto-computing Shock Index (HR / SBP, flagging >= 0.90), MAP, GCS (3–15), and qSOFA (0–3).
• 15-Second Radio Patch & Native Share / Print Cards: Instantly formats a concise spoken patch script alongside native iOS/iPadOS/macOS Share, AirDrop, and AirPrint / Save-to-PDF ER handoff cards.
• 6 Receiving Bay Pre-Staging Checklists & Live ETA: Track a 3–30 minute live arrival countdown mapped to Level 1 Trauma / MTP, STEMI Cath Lab, Stroke CT + Last Known Well (LKW) Clock, Pediatric Length/Weight Zone, Sepsis Bundle, and Airway / Anaphylaxis staging checklists.
• Golden-Hour Reference Calculators: Deterministic GCS (E+V+M) matrix, Shock Index & MAP, Adult & Pediatric Rule of Nines (100% balanced), Parkland Burn Formula (4 mL × kg × %TBSA, 50% first 8h), and 9 color-coded Pediatric Length/Weight Reference Zones (46–149 cm) for airway and bay equipment tray staging.
• Standalone Apple Watch Companion & Offline Siri Shortcuts: OLED black watchOS app with 2-min, 3-min, and 5-min haptic check timers, live wrist ETA and MIST summary glance, and Digital Crown ETA adjustment synced via WatchConnectivity and App Group.
• Ephemeral-First Privacy: Zero patient-name or DOB fields, 1-tap "New Run / Clear" reset between runs, no ads, no subscriptions, no HealthKit or microphone permissions, and Data Not Collected.

REFERENCE NOTICE
Pre-arrival EMS logistics, SBAR/MIST handoff communication, ER bay staging checklist, and training reference tool only. Provides standardized reference formulas and staging cues—not autonomous clinical orders. Always follow local EMS protocols and receiving facility direction.

name: EdiosCalmLine
description:
Edios CalmLine is a 100% offline stress-regulation, tactical breathing, and Crisis Intervention Team (CIT) communication reference designed for peace officers and first responders on iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Apple Watch.

STEP-DOWN PULSE & TACTICAL BREATHING
• Configurable heart-rate awareness threshold (120–160 BPM, default 140 BPM) with opt-in foreground in-RAM Apple Health reading and an interactive offline training slider.
• Guided 4-4-4-4 Tactical Box Breathing and 4-6 Sympathetic Downshift cadences with tactile haptics.
• Earpiece whisper cues boot strictly muted every launch and speak offline only when explicitly armed.
• Optional Low-Glare Patrol Night toggle for comfortable dark-cabin readability.

PROPORTIONAL FORCE & STEP-DOWN RETURN LOOP
• Clear 5-stage visual reference (Presence → Verbal CIT → Control → Stabilize → Step-Down Return) emphasizing immediate de-escalation once active risk recedes.
• Interactive 4-point post-control airway and recovery awareness checklist.

6 OFFLINE CIT QUICK-CARDS + CALM VISUAL CARD MODE
• High-contrast verbal de-escalation talk tracks, posture cues, and avoid-phrases across 6 field scenarios: Unarmed Emotional Distress, Autism / Sensory Overload, Hearing Impairment / Non-Verbal, Acute Agitation, Domestic Calm-Down, and Youth / Juvenile Crisis.
• One-tap full-screen Calm Visual Card displays gentle, high-contrast reassuring text for non-verbal or sensory-overloaded communication with zero flash or sound.

APPLE WATCH COMPANION & SIRI SHORTCUTS
• Standalone OLED True-Black Apple Watch app with Digital Crown alert-threshold control, wrist-haptic breathing pacer, and quick-glance CIT cards synced via WatchConnectivity.
• Optional one-tap post-shift mindful session logging directly to your private Apple Health timeline.

BUILT FOR PRIVACY — DATA NOT COLLECTED
• Paid upfront with zero subscriptions, zero ads, zero accounts, and zero external network calls.
• All readings are evaluated strictly in volatile device memory and are never transmitted or stored externally.

Reference Notice: Edios CalmLine is a stress-regulation, tactical breathing, and CIT communication training reference only. It is not a clinical tool and does not replace department policy or EMS care.

name: EdiosVerto
description:
Edios Verto is a 100% offline ergonomic posture and workplace lifting studio engineered for safety coordinators, industrial engineers, facility supervisors, and occupational educators.

Designed as a fast, tactile precision field instrument that delivers biomechanical clarity in under 10 seconds with zero network dependency, Edios Verto evaluates RULA, REBA, the Revised NIOSH Lifting Equation, L5/S1 Lumbar Disc Compression, and ISO 11226 shift fatigue entirely on your device.

KEY CAPABILITIES
• Interactive 19-Keypoint Posture Studio: Adjust lumbar trunk flexion, cervical neck flexion, shoulder abduction, elbow flexion, wrist deviation, knee stance, and axial torso twist using zone-colored goniometer sliders, live dot-product vector readouts, and an optional neutral-target comparison ghost overlay.
• Privacy-First by Design: Switch seamlessly between Face-Redacted and Skeleton-Only views. Optionally load a local PNG/JPG reference image into memory as a visual alignment underlay—processed 100% on-device with zero camera permissions and zero uploads.
• 4 Real-World Workstation Presets: Load Warehouse Pallet Lift, Assembly Bench Reach, Sit-Stand Workstation, or Caregiver Patient/Load Transfer with one tap, or customize every parameter in Metric (kg/cm) or Imperial (lb/in) units.
• NIOSH Lifting Envelope & Lumbar Solver: Visualize horizontal reach (H), vertical origin (V), and lift travel (D), inspect all six NIOSH multipliers (HM, VM, DM, AM, FM, CM) with automatic bottleneck flagging, compare Recommended Weight Limit (RWL) and Lifting Index (LI), and track estimated L5/S1 disc compression against the 3,400 N action limit.
• ISO 11226 Shift Fatigue & Recovery Dial: Plot strictly monotonic 30–300 minute fatigue accumulation curves and run a built-in circular countdown micro-break timer.
• Hierarchy of Controls & Native Audit Export: Benchmark projected risk reductions, review prioritized engineering, ergonomic assist, and administrative controls, print or save formatted PDF reports via AirPrint/macOS Print, share CSV or .json assessment capsules, and reopen saved .json audits anytime.

EDUCATIONAL SAFETY NOTICE
Educational ergonomics and workplace safety planning reference based on published RULA, REBA, NIOSH Lifting Equation, and ISO 11226 formulas. Not a medical device, clinical diagnosis, or substitute for a Certified Professional Ergonomist (CPE) or occupational health evaluation.

name: Edit Suite Basic: Video Editor
description:
Edit Suite Basic is a video editor that does the basics well and stays out of your way. Put your clips on a timeline, cut and trim them, blend the cuts, add music and a title, and export. That is the whole app.

No watermark. No account. No AI. Nothing leaves your phone until you share it.

CUT AND TRIM
• A timeline with filmstrips and waveforms under a fixed playhead
• Split at the playhead, trim with the edge grips, long-press and drag to reorder
• Edges snap to the playhead and to other clips, with a tick you can feel
• Duplicate, rotate and delete clips
• Undo and redo every step

BLEND YOUR CUTS
• Crossfade or fade through black on any cut
• Fade in from black at the start and out to black at the end

SOUND
• Detach a clip's audio and move it on its own lane
• Add music from Files
• Volume, mute and speed for every clip, from 0.25× to 4× with the pitch kept
• Fade audio clips in and out

TITLES
• Type a line of text and put it at the top, in the middle or at the bottom
• Set its size and drag it to the right moment; it fades in and out

ANY SHAPE
• 16:9, 9:16, 1:1 or 4:5, or the shape of your first clip
• Fit your clips inside the frame, or let them fill it

EXPORT
• 720p, 1080p or 4K, as an .mp4
• Share it anywhere, or save it to Photos

YOURS
• Every edit is saved as you go; open a project later and carry on
• You pick your videos yourself; the app never sees the rest of your library
• Works offline and collects no data

In English and Dutch. Questions? See editsuite.jurrejan.com/support

name: EFRISBuddy

• Invoice a walk-in customer or a customer with a TIN. Customer TINs are checked with EFRIS before you continue.

name: Elevate Education

name: Enso Sudoku: Calm Puzzles
description:
Enso Sudoku is a calm, ad-free Sudoku for iPhone and iPad. Pay once, play offline, and never see an ad.

PUZZLES FOR EVERY MOOD
Choose how you want to feel, not just how hard you want to try. Each level has its own pace, from a gentle Drift through Ease, Flow and Focus to a demanding Deep Focus.

A MOMENT TO SETTLE

KIND TO YOU
- No timers pressing on you unless you want them
- No punishment for a wrong digit: mistakes are noted, never held against you

BEAUTIFUL AND READABLE
Rice Paper for daylight and Night Garden for the evening. Large text, VoiceOver, high contrast and keyboard support are built in.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No ads, no accounts, no analytics and no tracking. Enso Sudoku works fully offline and collects no data.

One price. Nothing else to buy.

name: Epic CoinFlip
description:
Epic CoinFlip is a coin toss with no ceiling.

Tap the quarter for an ordinary flip. It spins, rings off the walnut table and settles heads or tails.

Or hold your finger down and let it charge. The longer you hold, the higher it goes. Let go and the coin launches over a night-time island, up through the clouds, into orbit, past the Moon and the planets, out of the Milky Way, across the cosmic web and beyond the observable universe. Then it falls all the way back down and lands.

• One continuous shot, from a tabletop to trillions of light-years away
• A live altitude readout names every realm the coin passes through
• A real US quarter: George Washington on heads, the 2006 Nevada state quarter on tails, recreated from US Mint proof images
• Fair results: every outcome comes from your iPhone's system random number generator the moment you let go
• Sound and haptics for every flip, bounce and sonic boom
• No ads, no accounts, no tracking. Works offline.

Use it to settle an argument, pick who goes first, or just to find out how far a quarter can go.

Credits: Earth night-lights and cloud textures by Solar System Scope (CC BY 4.0). Earth and Moon imagery courtesy of NASA. Coin designs from the United States Mint.

name: Epistles

MULTIPLE ACCOUNTS, ONE EXPERIENCE

LOCAL-FIRST SYNC

• Multi-account professionals juggling work and personal mail

name: Esak Alüminyum

name: EVCellSense: EV Battery Health
description:
See inside your electric car's battery.

EVCellSense connects to an inexpensive Bluetooth OBD-II adapter plugged in under your dashboard and reads the battery data your car's own battery controller keeps: state of health, charge, every cell voltage and pack temperatures.

WORKS WITH
• Nissan Leaf, 2011 onward, including the Leaf Plus (all 96 cell pairs, SOH, Hx and Ah)
• Hyundai and Kia: Kona Electric, Niro EV, Soul EV, Ioniq Electric, Ioniq 5, Ioniq 6, EV6, EV9
• Chevrolet Bolt EV and Bolt EUV (2017–2023), Opel Ampera-e
• Volkswagen ID.3, ID.4, ID.5, ID. Buzz, and Skoda Enyaq, Cupra Born, Audi Q4 e-tron
• Volkswagen e-Golf (2015–2020)
• Toyota Prius hybrid, 2004–2015 (beta): all 14 block voltages and resistances

WHAT YOU GET
• Battery health: state of health, Hx and capacity, where your car reports them
• Every cell: voltages for all cells, the spread between highest and lowest, and the cell that stands out
• Temperatures from every pack sensor, with the hottest reading remembered
• 12 V battery voltage, and the car's quick-charge and normal-charge counts
• Automatic history: a reading is saved each time you connect, with charts of health and capacity over months and years, and a forecast of where they're heading
• Battery report: a one-page PDF with health, cells, temperatures and history, ready to share with a buyer or seller when a used EV changes hands
• Recalls: enter your VIN to check NHTSA's recall list for your car
• Garage: more than one EV, or reading a friend's? Each car keeps its own history, VIN, recalls and odometer, so readings never mix
• Logs: record every reading while the app is open during a drive or a charge, and open the file in Excel, Numbers or Google Sheets
• Check my adapter: a plain-English check of whether your adapter and car are talking properly
• Demo mode: try every screen without a car

FREE TO TRY, ONE PRICE TO OWN
Download free to connect, check that your adapter works with your car, and see live charge, pack voltage and the 12 V battery, plus demo mode. A single $9.99 purchase unlocks battery health, every cell, history, the PDF report, recalls and logs. No subscription. Readings are saved from your first connection, so your history is already there when you unlock.

READ-ONLY AND PRIVATE
EVCellSense only reads. It never clears codes, resets anything or changes a setting in your car. Everything stays on your iPhone: no account, no ads and no tracking. It goes online only for the App Store purchase and, when you tap Check recalls, to send your VIN to NHTSA.

WHAT YOU NEED
A Bluetooth LE ("BLE" or "Bluetooth 4.0") OBD-II adapter, such as the Veepeak OBDCheck BLE+, OBDLink CX or Vgate iCar Pro BLE. Classic Bluetooth adapters, the kind that pair with a PIN like 1234, can't work with any iPhone app.

GOOD TO KNOW
• Not every car reports every value. Chevrolet and Volkswagen don't report a state-of-health percentage, so EVCellSense shows capacity or cell data instead of guessing one.
• Readings come from your car and public community research. They aren't a substitute for a dealer's diagnosis.
• EVCellSense isn't made by, endorsed by or affiliated with any carmaker.

name: Facetwick Brain Bench
description:
Facetwick Brain Bench is a quiet single-player collection of three hand-made logic games that share one gem-cut art style and a slow, deliberate pace. Pick a bench, play a round, step away, come back later. Progress is saved on your iPhone between sessions.

Three games sit on the bench, each with its own feel:

Facet Split — drag across a numbered grid to cut it into rectangles. Each rectangle must contain exactly one number, and that number must equal its area. The wrong cut snaps back; the right cut locks in with a soft chime. Puzzles grow from four pieces to tight, interlocking layouts you have to plan two or three moves ahead.

Gem Mosaic — crystals arrive stacked on the left. Tap the front of a stack and it flies to a matching cell in the currently glowing row, or waits in a small tray if nothing fits. Fill every cell and the finished picture reveals itself. The tray is the pressure: fill it with the wrong order and the run stalls.

Shard Stacker — a calm no-fail clicker. Tap or swipe the messy stack to align its slabs. Aligned slabs become crystal bars that ship to a vault and pay stars. Stars buy upgrades and helpers that make the next pass smoother. No timers, no failure state, no way to lose a run.

Daily puzzles rotate across all three games. Stars earned anywhere spend anywhere on themes, boosters, charms, and vault upgrades. A journal keeps every run you finish so you can revisit a mosaic or a cut layout later.

name: FitUp - Outfit Planner
description:
FitUp is a personal stylist app that picks your outfit every day from the clothes you already own. Open it and today's outfit is waiting, matched to your weather, your plans and your taste. No scrolling, no shopping, no deciding.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Photograph your clothes. Snap your tops, bottoms and jackets, or choose photos from your library. Several in a row is fine.
2. AI reads each piece: type, colours, pattern, cut, fabric, warmth, how dressy it is and whether it can handle rain. No typing, no tagging, no forms.
3. Open the app. Today's outfit is on the home screen with zero taps, built for today's forecast where you are.
4. Tap "Wearing this", or "Another" for a different look.

WHAT YOU GET
• A daily outfit from your own closet. Every piece is something you own, so you can wear it right now.
• Weather-aware outfits. FitUp checks your local forecast (high, low, feels-like, rain and wind) and dresses you for it, down to the jacket.
• A vibe for every occasion: Casual, Smart casual, Work, Sporty, Going out or Cozy. Set one for each day of the week, or change it on the spot.
• Fresh combinations. FitUp remembers what you wore and avoids repeating the same top and bottom within a week.
• Swap one piece. Like the outfit but not the jacket? Change just that.
• A reason for every outfit: one line on why it works today.
• A digital closet that fills itself in. Your wardrobe, sorted into tops, bottoms and outerwear, with details you can correct in a tap.
• Outfit history. See what you wore on any day.
• Your taste, your rules. Tell FitUp the styles you like (minimalist, streetwear, classic, vintage, athleisure and more), the fit you prefer, your dress code and the colours you avoid.
• Light and dark mode. Celsius or Fahrenheit.

WHO IT'S FOR
• Anyone who stands at the closet asking "what should I wear today?"
• People who own plenty of clothes but keep wearing the same five things.
• Anyone who wants fewer decisions in the morning and more of their wardrobe actually worn.
• People who want an AI stylist and outfit planner that works with their real clothes, not a shopping feed.

WHAT FITUP IS NOT
No ads. No shopping links. No social feed. No streaks or badges. FitUp does one job: it gets you dressed.

HOW TO USE IT

2. Tap your two cards: your chance of winning appears straight away.
3. Tap the flop, turn and river as they're dealt: your odds update after each one, with a final reveal on the river.
4. When a player folds, tap their counter: your odds update for the players still in.
5. Tap Fold or New hand to start the next hand.

WHAT YOU'LL SEE

• The name of your hand, plus any draws you're chasing (flush draw, straight draw, gutshot)

BUILT FOR LEARNING

FlopSense shows the numbers; what you do with them is up to you. It assumes the other players could be holding any cards. There's no betting, no money and no online play.

name: FlossTrail
description:
Know where your needle goes next.

FlossTrail helps cross-stitchers and chart designers turn full-cross patterns into practical thread routes. Compare estimated thread use, back travel and finishing counts, then follow the route one needle move at a time on iPhone or iPad.

FROM CHART TO STITCHING

1. Bring in your pattern
Start with the editable Wildflower study example, import a CSV chart, or load a PNG grid. Confirm the rows, columns and grid area, then review recognized colors. Paint individual cells, fill rectangles, merge colors and correct uncertain cells before planning.

2. Match your fabric and thread
Choose Aida or evenweave fabric. Set the fabric count, stitch over one or two threads on evenweave, and choose your working strand count. See the size of each cross in millimeters. Set separate starting and finishing tails, plus any extra allowance you want to include.

3. Set your route rules
Select a thread color and lock a legal starting hole. Mark no-cross rectangles to protect open areas, and set a maximum back-travel length. Connections that touch or pass through a no-cross area require a separate working length, with its own tail allowance.

4. Compare the trade-offs
Generate verified candidate routes for each color. Sort by estimated working-thread length or by fewer finishes. Compare front stitches, back travel, tails, extra allowance and the longest float. See why a route starts another length and how that choice changes the total.

5. Check both sides
Switch between front, mirrored back and overlay views while keeping the original row and column identities. Inspect individual moves, try a different cross direction, prioritize a stitch or request a new working length. Choose to complete each cross individually or use continuous row-and-return stitching.

6. Follow each needle move
Open Stitch along for a clear starting hole, target hole and direction arrow. Complete moves, undo the last move or review another part of the route. Progress is saved separately for each exact route, so you can return to the next unfinished move.

7. Keep and share your work
Organize multiple projects with notes, copies and archives. Save chart versions with their original settings and routes. Preview numbered front-and-back PDF plans, share CSV thread ledgers, and export or restore a complete local backup.

THREAD ESTIMATES YOU CAN CHECK
See working-thread length at your selected strand count and its single-strand equivalent. Record thread on hand separately for each color and strand count. Estimates include front stitches, all back moves and your chosen allowances; actual use can vary with tension and finishing technique.

LOCAL BY DESIGN
Pattern processing, route generation, project storage and exports run on your device. No account or cloud connection is required. Sharing happens through the system share sheet when you choose it.

Designed for full-cross charts. PNG import works with regular, flat-color grids and requires color confirmation before route planning. Each candidate is checked against your chart, starting hole, back-travel limit and no-cross areas.
