name: Frameo.Fit
description:
Frameo.Fit is the on-site companion for installers working with the FRAMEO kitchen system.

JOBS
• See your installation jobs at a glance and open all details on site
• Document your work with photos added straight to the job
• Report defects with photos and notes so nothing gets lost

ROOM MEASUREMENT
• Scan a room with the LiDAR sensor of a supported iPhone or iPad
• Get a floor plan and 3D model that feeds directly into kitchen planning

ASSEMBLY INSTRUCTIONS
• Animated, step-by-step 3D instructions for base, tall and wall cabinets, worktops, drawers and hinged doors
• Instructions for the complete kitchen of a job, built from its actual plan
• Every step lists the parts and tools you need

MADE FOR THE SITE
• Keeps working without a connection and syncs when you are back online
• Available in eight languages

An account from your FRAMEO partner is required to sign in.

name: FretPal: Tuner & Metronome
description:
FretPal is a tuner, metronome and reference tone in one simple app. Tuning is always free, with no ads on the tuner screen and no subscription.

TUNER
• Guitar (standard, drop D, half step down), bass, ukulele, violin, viola, cello and chromatic mode
• Bağlama (saz): short and long neck; bağlama, bozuk, misket and müstezat tunings. Each string shows both its bağlama name and its real pitch
• Auto string detection, or tap a string to tune only that one
• Octave-safe: if the note is far from the string, FretPal tells you instead of saying "tighten", so you don't break a string
• Reference pitch adjustable from 415 to 466 Hz (A4)
• Reads to within about 1–2 cents with a clear single note

METRONOME
• 20–300 BPM, tap tempo, 8 time signatures, three sounds
• Sample-accurate timing that doesn't drift
• Keeps playing when you leave the app or lock the screen
• Visual beat with delay adjustment for Bluetooth headphones

REFERENCE TONE
• Plays continuously until you stop it; pick any note or a string of your tuning

FRETPAL PRO (one-time purchase, no subscription)
• Subdivisions: eighths, triplets, sixteenths
• Speed trainer: raise the tempo automatically every few bars
• Saved tempos and practice time log
• No ads
You can also try Pro free for 24 hours by watching a short ad.

PRIVACY
The microphone is used only while the tuner is on. Sound is analyzed on your device and is never recorded or sent. No account, no sign-up.

name: frfr: ask me anything
description:
frfr is the anonymous q&a app for ur friends.

share ur frfr link on snapchat, instagram or anywhere. friends tap it and ask u anything, anonymously. u pick which questions to answer, then post ur answer as a story card that matches ur look.

how it works
• get ur link: pick a username and a look for ur link page
• share it: one tap to snapchat, instagram stories, x and more
• get questions: they land in ur inbox, anonymous unless the sender chooses to use their name
• answer & post: answers live on ur profile and can be shared as a story card

ur profile, ur way
• photo, banner, bio and wallpapers
• follow friends and see their answers
• see who viewed ur profile

safety comes first
• every message goes through a content filter before it reaches u
• report or block anyone from any message or profile
• muted words, pause new messages, and a strict filter (always on for teens)
• teens get extra protections: their location and gender are never shown to anyone
• frfr is for people 13 and older
• we never invent fake questions. official messages say "frfr team"

frfr+ (optional subscription)
• see who viewed u
• sender hints: real clues about anonymous messages, like the device or the app they came from. hints never reveal an anonymous sender's name
• priority messages pinned to the top of their inbox
• premium wallpapers and app icons

frfr+ weekly is $7.99 per week (U.S. price) and renews automatically until u cancel. payment is charged to ur Apple ID at confirmation of purchase. it renews unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and ur account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the period ends. manage or cancel anytime in ur Apple ID account settings.

terms: https://frfrapp.co/terms
privacy: https://frfrapp.co/privacy
safety: https://frfrapp.co/safety

name: Front Row Play
description:
Front Row Play is a free weekly pro football lineup game from Front Row Sports. Pick real players, earn points from what they actually do on the field, and see how you stack up against your family and friends.

HOW IT WORKS
- Build a lineup of 10 starters: QB, RB, two WRs, TE, K, DL, LB, CB and S, plus up to 3 players on your bench.
- Your first 7 days are free. Grab any player you want from the portal.
- After that, players cost points. Better players cost more, and prices update every week.
- Sell a player back to the portal anytime and get back exactly what you paid.
- Points land in your account after Monday night's game. No points are ever taken away.

LEVEL UP
Everyone starts at Level 1. Every 100 points you earn moves you up a level, and spending points never lowers it, so your progress always counts.

PLAY WITH FRIENDS
- Create a private league and share its invite code.
- Add friends with their friend code and see their lineups.
- League standings rank everyone by points earned this season.

SEE HOW EVERY POINT IS EARNED
Each player card shows his price, his points week by week and exactly how he scored them, from touchdowns to first downs to tackles.

MADE FOR IPHONE AND IPAD
A clean, fast design on iPhone and a full iPad layout with a sidebar, in light and dark mode.

ONE ACCOUNT
Sign in with Apple or with email. It's the same account you use in Front Row Sports.

Free to play. No ads, no in-app purchases and no tracking. Points have no cash value and can't be bought, sold or traded for prizes.

Front Row Play is an independent app. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by any league, team or players' association. Team names and logos belong to their owners and are used only to identify teams.

name: Full Send: MTB, Gravel & Road
description:
Mountain bike trail maps, bike parks and gravel and road routes, anywhere on Earth. Full Send finds somewhere new to ride, plans the route, records the ride and shows it back to you.

BIKE PARKS AND FAMOUS RIDES
644 mountain bike parks and trail centres in 26 countries, each with its trails by grade on the map, season dates and the park's own link. 230 famous MTB, gravel and road rides, from rail trails to multi-day epics, each with its route, distance and climb.

PLAN
A bike route planner for mountain, gravel and road riding: tap the map to build a route. See the distance, climbing and an elevation profile before you leave. Trip times use the speed of your ride mode. Load GPX files, export your route as GPX and send it to the device you ride with. GPX export is free.

RIDE WITH A LIVE DASH
Seven ride modes, each with its own dash: Trail, Enduro, Downhill, E-MTB, Gravel, Bikepacking and Road. Downhill counts runs and vertical. Enduro times your stages. Road puts speed first. Turn cues show on the dash, and you can leave the phone in your pack and look at the ride afterwards.

RECORD
A GPS bike ride tracker: start a recording and Full Send keeps going with the screen off. A notification stays up the whole time, so you always know it is running. Your track, distance, time, climbing and top speed are saved on your phone.

MAPS FOR THE BACKCOUNTRY
A topographic map with contours, rain radar and weather along your route. Download a map region to use where there is no signal.

BUILT TO BE HONEST
Where a land manager's published data mentions bikes on a section, Full Send shows that source and the date it was last checked. Where there is no source, the section reads Unknown. Sections a source lists as closed to bikes are marked. This is information, not permission: rules change, so always follow local rules and signs on the day. Demo screens use sample data and are labelled Sample.

FREE AND PRO
Free includes the map, bike park trail lists, the live dash, GPX and FIT export, one offline region and up to 5 saved rides. Full Send Pro adds unlimited ride history, route planning, turn-by-turn, satellite imagery, weather overlays and unlimited offline maps.

Full Send uses map data from OpenStreetMap contributors.


Questions: Josh Lees, support@ridefullsend.com

Full Send Pro is an auto-renewing subscription, monthly or yearly, with a free trial for new riders. Payment is charged to your Apple ID when you confirm, and it renews unless you turn it off at least 24 hours before the period ends. Manage or cancel it in your Apple ID settings.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy: https://ridefullsend.com/privacy.html

name: Fun Fun Tabletop
description:
The games you played in the alley after school, now on your phone!

Fun Fun Tabletop is a collection of classic Korean playground games for kids and grown-ups alike. Walk the neighborhood path and unlock five games one by one.

■ Five games, ten levels each
• Red Light, Green Light: tap to sneak forward and freeze the moment the tagger turns around.
• Dalgona: trace the candy shape at just the right speed. Too fast and it cracks!
• Jump Rope: tap right on the beat as the rope comes down.
• Odd or Even: are there an odd or even number of marbles under the cup?
• Marbles: pull back, let go and knock the marbles out of the ring.

■ Play together
• Face-to-face duel: lay one phone between you and play the same game at the same time.
• Take turns: pass one phone back and forth and compare scores.
• Nearby play: connect with a friend's phone in the same room. No internet or account needed.

■ Something new every day
• Today's challenge and challenge runs
• Collect stars to dress up your marble

■ Made with kids in mind
• Ads appear only on the menu and result screens, child-directed and non-personalized, rated G.
• Purchases and outside links sit behind a grown-up check.
• No accounts, no chat, no personal information.

Available in English, Korean and Spanish.

name: Fun Fun Tabletop 2
description:
The second Fun Fun Tabletop collection! Play five traditional Korean games in the lanes of an autumn village.

■ Five games, ten levels each
• Ttakji Flip: slam your tile at the right moment to flip your friend's over.
• Stone Topple: aim your throw and knock the standing stone down.
• Hopscotch: hop square by square, skipping the one with the stone.
• Jegi Kick: keep the jegi up in the air, kick after kick.
• Tug of War: pull on the beat with all your might!

■ Play together
• Face-to-face duel: lay one phone between you and play the same game at the same time.
• Take turns: pass one phone back and forth and compare scores.
• Nearby play: connect with a friend's phone in the same room. No internet or account needed.

■ Something new every day
• Today's challenge and challenge runs
• Collect stars to dress up your marble

■ Made with kids in mind
• Ads appear only on the menu and result screens, child-directed and non-personalized, rated G.
• Purchases and outside links sit behind a grown-up check.
• No accounts, no chat, no personal information.

Available in English, Korean and Spanish.

name: Futoshiki: Logic Number Puzzle
description:
Futoshiki is a number puzzle from Japan. Fill every row and column with the numbers 1 to N, each one exactly once. Between some cells there is a greater-than or less-than sign, and it tells you which of the two numbers is bigger. That is the whole rule.

The first puzzles are tiny 3x3 grids where the signs alone give you the answer. Later grids grow to 7x7 and need longer chains of reasoning. Every puzzle has exactly one solution, so you never have to guess.

• 330 puzzles, from 3x3 up to 7x7
• Pencil marks for candidates
• Undo and restart at any time
• Broken rules light up right away
• No timer, no lives
• Your progress is saved on the device
• Remove ads with a one-time purchase

Privacy: anonymous usage statistics help us improve the app. Ads are shown through Google AdMob. Support: effy.sohn@gmail.com

name: Game Night Games Pack
description:
Game Night puts four complete games in one app, with no ads, no accounts and no tracking. Pick a game from the menu, play against computer players on Easy, Normal or Hard, and switch to another game whenever you like. Every game saves as you play, so you can leave one mid-hand, play something else and come back to it later.

TEN UP
Rummy in ten phases. Collect sets, runs and colors, lay down your phase, then hit on the table to go out first. Play all ten phases or a shorter random game, against 1 to 5 computer players.

POKER NIGHT
Six poker games with play chips: Texas Hold'em (No-Limit), Omaha and Omaha Hi-Lo (Pot-Limit), Five-Card Draw, Seven-Card Stud and Razz (Fixed-Limit), or Dealer's Choice for a different game every hand. Your current hand is always named for you, and side pots and split pots are handled by the real rules. Up to 5 opponents, drawn from 25 regulars with their own playing styles.

CHESS NIGHT
Play one of twelve computer opponents, from beginner to champion, or pass the phone to a friend. Undo, a move list, a running score against each level, and a board that turns for two players. Every rule is built in: castling, en passant, promotion, and draws by repetition, the 50-move rule and insufficient material.

TRICK NIGHT
Spades, Hearts, Euchre, Pinochle and Two-Handed Pinochle. Team up with a computer partner across the table, with Nil and Blind Nil, shooting the moon, going alone and full Pinochle meld. Suggested bids and a Suggest button for passing cards help while you learn.

EASY TO GET AROUND
- One menu for all four games, with a badge on any game you have in progress.
- A Home button in every game takes you back to the menu without ending your game.
- Game Night opens where you left off.
- How to Play explains every game's rules in plain words.

EASY TO SEE, EASY TO PLAY
- Large, clear cards and pieces.
- Built for VoiceOver: cards, bets, moves and tricks are announced in plain words.
- Supports larger text, Reduce Motion and haptics.

PLAYS ANYWHERE
- Works fully offline, and the computer players run on your iPhone.
- No ads, no in-app purchases, no sign-up, no data collected.

Poker Night uses play chips only. There is no real-money gambling, and chips can't be bought, won as prizes or cashed out.

name: Gaplyte
description:
Το Gaplyte είναι αριθμητικό εργαλείο για ηλεκτρόλυση. Συνδέει το διάκενο των πλακών με την ωμική πτώση και την απόδοση ρεύματος κατά Faraday — ώστε να βλέπεις αν το κελί είναι στενό, ανοιχτό ή εντός παραθύρου.

Τι κάνει
Με ρεύμα, επιφάνεια, ειδική αντίσταση, διάκενο, χρόνο και ζυγισμένη μάζα υπολογίζει:
• θεωρητική μάζα Faraday (m_th = I·t·M / n·F)
• απόδοση ρεύματος (η)
• ωμική πτώση (ΔV = I·ρ·d / A)
• ευαισθησία σε mV/mm και προτεινόμενο εύρος διάκενου
• διάγνωση σύζευξης: κίνδυνος γεφύρωσης ή σπατάλη ενέργειας

Πώς το χρησιμοποιείς
1. Αρχική — διάλεξε κράμα (χαλκός, ψευδάργυρος, νικέλιο, άργυρος, υδρογόνο). Φορτώνουν τυπικά μεγέθη και σταθερές Faraday.
2. Διάκενο — έλεγξε ρεύμα, επιφάνεια, ρ και άνοιγμα πλακών. Παίρνεις ΔV και παράθυρο ασφαλείας.
3. Απόδοση — βάλε χρόνο και πραγματική μάζα. Παίρνεις η και βαθμίδα.
4. Ανάλυση — δοκίμασε άλλο διάκενο με τον ολισθητή, διάβασε τη σύσταση και πάτα αποθήκευση.
5. Αρχείο — άνοιξε μια εγγραφή για επεξεργασία, επανυπολογισμό ή νέο κύκλο με τα ίδια νούμερα.

Τα δεδομένα μένουν στη συσκευή. Χωρίς λογαριασμό και χωρίς ιχνηλάτηση. Το Gaplyte είναι βοήθημα λογισμού, όχι σύστημα ελέγχου μονάδας.

name: Gatherlight
description: Gatherlight is a local-first creative studio for light and shadow storytelling. Capture real light spots with the camera, shape flowing tones in the lab, record ambience, and keep short daylight or place notes. Arrange photos, particles, sound, and text on fluid multi-track timelines, then export HD clips, still albums, or photo assets. Free creation and export stay complete offline, with optional unlocks for advanced materials and ultra-HD output. No forced login, no social feed, and your work remains on your device.

name: Gazebeam: Constellation Finder
description:
Point your phone at the sky and Gazebeam shows you what is there: planets, the Moon, bright stars and all 88 constellations, drawn live for where you stand. Everything works offline, so a dark field with no signal is fine.

NAME WHAT YOU SEE
Move your phone and the map follows. Tap any star, planet or constellation to see its name, when it rises, when it is highest and when it sets.

FIND IT FAST
Search for Jupiter or Orion, tap Guide me, and follow the arrow until it sits in the middle of your screen. Tap Found it and the sky is yours.

SKY PASSPORT
Every planet and constellation you find gets a stamp in your own Sky Passport. Watch the dial fill as you learn the sky, one clear night at a time.

TONIGHT
See what is up after dark, when the Moon rises, how bright it is and when the sky gets darkest.

RED NIGHT MODE
Keep your eyes adjusted. Red mode turns the whole app deep red so you can look at your phone and still see faint stars.

EVENTS AND ALERTS
Meteor showers, full Moons and new Moons, with a reminder 30 minutes after sunset on the night. Pro adds the Moon near a planet, planets close together and planets at their brightest.

GAZEBEAM PRO, ONE PURCHASE
Pay once, keep it for good, share it with your family. Pro unlocks any date and time, 110 galaxies, nebulas and clusters, every sky alert and a full year of events. No subscription.

Your location stays on your phone. Gazebeam has no account and no ads.

Questions or ideas: support@sanghuynhxuan.com

name: GCodeLoom
description:
Inspect G-code commands, layers and toolpaths, then create a separate line-range excerpt and analysis reports.

1. Import UTF-8 or ASCII G-code through Files and inspect the import summary.
2. Open the overview, command statistics and layer browser.
3. Inspect XY paths and original issue lines.
4. Choose a continuous line or layer range and review its setup state.
5. Export the excerpt or CSV/PDF report as a new file.

Supports a defined command subset, up to 8 MiB, 250,000 lines and 2,000 layers. This is not a slicer, printer controller or printability guarantee.

name: GDragonMahjongAcademy
description:
What should you discard when two tiles could complete your hand? Dragon Mahjong Academy helps you work through that decision, one table situation at a time.

Study Sichuan Blood Battle and a Guangdong Push-Down variant. Begin with tile groups, the missing-suit rule, and self-draw wins. Then practice calling tiles, choosing discards, comparing waits, and counting unseen tiles from the information on the table.

Each regional course has four levels and eight practice situations. After you make a choice, review your original hand, the tiles used, and the reasoning behind the suggested move. Your review history is saved on your device so you can revisit a decision or resume a session.

The in-game interface is in Simplified Chinese.

name: Gear Mesh
description:
Gear Mesh names the pair whose backlash is under 0.15 mm.

Backlash is the center minus the two pitch radii. Drag the center. If the backlash is under 0.15 mm, the tightest mesh is named. A center that overlaps the pitch circles is not stored. Changing the module does not rewrite the center. The last mesh stays.

A sound stays on the iPhone and does not change the backlash. Share the call when you choose to. There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: GearCall
description:
# GearCall — Equipment & Kit Management

**Promotional Text**

Every piece. Accounted for. Manage equipment, organize production kits, scan QR codes, track checkouts, and document every handoff.

**Description**

GearCall is a professional equipment and kit management app designed for film crews, stagehands, AV technicians, photographers, production companies, and equipment owners.

Whether you're preparing camera packages for a film shoot, organizing lighting equipment for a live event, or tracking valuable gear across productions, GearCall helps you stay organized and accountable.

**EQUIPMENT MANAGEMENT**

Maintain a detailed inventory of your professional equipment, including photographs, serial numbers, asset identification, replacement values, and storage locations.

**PRODUCTION KITS**

Build custom equipment packages for camera, lighting, audio, grip, staging, and other production departments. Verify kit contents before equipment leaves your facility.

**QR CODE IDENTIFICATION**

Generate equipment identification codes and scan them to locate records and verify equipment.

**CHECKOUTS & RETURNS**

Record equipment assignments, recipient information, due dates, and returns. Keep a history of equipment movements and signed handoffs.

**CONDITION DOCUMENTATION**

Record equipment condition, document damage, attach photographs, and maintain inspection history.

**PROFESSIONAL REPORTS**

Generate PDF equipment manifests, checkout records, handoff documents, and condition reports.

**SECURE LOCAL BACKUPS**

Protect your equipment records with password-encrypted backups and restoration tools.

**BUILT FOR PROFESSIONAL WORKFLOWS**

- No required account
- Works offline
- No recurring subscription
- Designed for iPhone and iPad
- Professional equipment accountability

From prep to wrap, GearCall helps you know what you have, where it belongs, and who has it.

**GearCall — Every Piece. Accounted For.**

name: GearSpan: Bike Shift Map
description:
See what happens to your cadence when you shift or change a cassette. Enter your measured wheel rollout and tooth counts, then compare two bicycle drivetrains at the same riding speed. Find which gears land in your target cadence window and inspect the jump between neighboring sprockets.

Open the climb planner to find the lowest available gear at a slower target speed. The cassette ladder shows adjacent ratios and the cadence you would reach at unchanged road speed. Save both setups locally and share the comparison as text. Includes editable example setups.

A gearing planner, not a ride tracker, power estimate, or compatibility check. Works offline without accounts, ads, or subscriptions.

name: Gem Bench
description:
Four stones a day. Read the shell, wash it clean, and hope the light comes out.

Gem Bench is a quiet pixel-art game about rough stones and the light inside them.

Each day the stall opens with three pieces of rough. A tint in the cracks is your only clue. From it you guess the colour and take a gamble on what the shell is hiding — some stones are empty, and the lamp cannot see through a sealed one.

Then the work begins. Brush off the dust, break the shell with the chisel, rinse the mud away, and polish the face until the light comes through. How fast and how clean you work decides the grade, and the grade decides the price. The chisel only marks a bare face: rest it on a cleaned surface and the game warns you first.

A matching order pays better than a loose sale. Keep a stone on the tray and wait for the right buyer, or let it go cheap. When four stones are done the stall closes, rent comes out, and the day's net goes on the board.

• Read the shell — colour, weight and hardness are only hints; dark does not always mean empty
• Four tools, four jobs: dust, shell, mud, polish
• Marks only land on a bare face, and the first one is only a warning
• Seven colours, five cuts, and the rarest one that shows fire
• Seven upgrade paths with four levels each, from a wider brush to a bigger sign
• A day cycle with rent and a ledger, and fame that unlocks better rough and bigger orders
• Two Game Center boards: your best day's net and your best stone
• English and Simplified Chinese, no ads, no in-app purchases, plays offline

A stone takes about a minute. A day takes five. Close the stall, and come back tomorrow.

name: Gemmery: Gem Shop
description:
Your mentor has retired and left you a market stall, a polishing lap and one rough rose quartz. Make it the finest jeweler in town.

Every stone in Gemmery is a real 3D crystal drawn entirely in glowing ASCII characters, and you cut each one yourself. Swipe along the grain to cleave the rough — the cleaner the cleave, the more weight you keep. Then work six facet groups on a sweeping dial: tap on the beat, hold to grind, circle to round a cabochon, line up the rays of a star sapphire. Six Perfects make a Master cut, and a last buff brings it to a mirror finish.

Then run the shop. Open in the morning and the street fills with browsers, tourists, couples, collectors and the odd VIP. They look in your window, study your cases and buy what they love. Some come to the counter with a commission, a haggle, a stone to sell you or a mystery gem to identify. At closing time you count the takings, choose what to study tonight, and sleep.

• 25 kinds of gem in 95 colors and varieties: paraíba tourmaline, padparadscha, imperial jade, alexandrite that turns from green to red under lamplight, opal with a living play of color, star rubies and cat's eyes
• 14 cuts, from the round brilliant to the Asscher, the rose and the cabochon, each with its own rhythm
• Buy rough from local dealers or import whole parcels from nine origins. Prices move every day with the news: choose your stones and your moment
• Five premises from bazaar stall to grand maison: more cases, lights and visitors — and more rent, wages and upkeep
• Hire clerks for the counter, apprentices for spare benches and a buyer for imports; study 23 techniques and trade secrets in the library
• Keep the stones you love in the vault, complete 20 collection sets, lend to the museum's weekly exhibition and fill a codex with lore and gemology
• Daily and weekly goals, 40 honors, and ten regular clients who come to know you
• Play at your own pace: shop time only passes while you are at the front or at the bench
• Your shop and any gold you buy are kept in iCloud and follow you to a new iPhone

No ads, no subscriptions, no random boxes. Gold saves time and adds comfort and good looks; it never buys reputation, and everything it buys can also be earned in play. The optional Master's Charter is a single purchase.

name: GeoStamply
description:
GeoStamply adds location proof to your photos. Take a picture and the app stamps the address, GPS coordinates, date and time, altitude and a small map directly onto the image.

See the stamp live on the camera before you shoot, or pick an existing photo from your gallery. Customise the stamp: put it at the top or bottom, move the map left or right, choose a colour, text size and background opacity, and add your own note.

Stamped photos are saved to your Photos library with GPS metadata and kept in the in-app gallery for easy sharing.

More location tools: detailed location info (decimal and DMS coordinates, altitude, accuracy, speed), a compass, a map with satellite view and one-tap location sharing.

Make it yours with light or dark mode and six accent colours. Available in 12 languages.

name: Getaway Log: Heist Ledger
description:
Log every take, time your cooldowns and see what pays.

An unofficial companion for Grand Theft Auto VI (GTA 6) players.

Getaway Log is the second-screen logbook for a long open-world crime campaign: a cash tracker, cooldown timers, chapter heads-ups and a completion checklist. Keep it next to the controller and it keeps the books for you. Free to start, with no account and no ads, and it works offline.

SEARCHABLE GAME LISTS
Track story missions, vehicles, collectibles, side activities, places and property, gear and easter eggs. Search each list, filter by group and see your own progress. Later story names and hidden discoveries open when you choose. Places are grouped by district or type. Lists work offline.

Game lists are free to read, with 20 ticks per list. Pro adds unlimited ticks, To do and Done filters, and private notes on individual items.

INTEL
Browse dated links to news, videos and community posts. Rumours are labelled and story spoilers stay folded. The latest links are free. Pro adds platform and label filters and older entries. Links open outside the app.

LOG EVERY TAKE IN TWO TAPS
Pick what it was (a store, a hideout, a fence sale, a run), type the amount, done. Spending goes in the same way. Your net, your earnings today and your running totals are always on the first screen.

SEE WHAT PAYS
Pro ranks your earners by the average take each time, from your own entries, and gives an estimated hourly rate based on the times you logged them.

SEE WHAT EACH BUYER PAYS
Add the buyer when you sell. The price book shows the average each buyer has paid you per sale, so you can compare them on your own numbers.

COOLDOWN TIMERS THAT FIND YOU
The game does not put a clock on a spot that has gone cold. Set your own timer, name it, and get an alert when it is worth another visit, even with your phone locked.

HEADS-UPS BEFORE A CHAPTER COSTS YOU
Short warnings collected from player reports in launch week, such as what happens to your cash when a chapter ends. Each one says how well supported it is. Tips that give away a story consequence stay folded until you choose to read them, and chapters you have not reached stay hidden.

COMPLETION CHECKLIST INCLUDED
Counters and checkboxes for the big completion goals, with targets taken from the public achievement list. Goals with no published total simply count up. Add your own notes with Pro.

BUILT FOR THE COUCH
Phone and tablet layouts, a dark screen that will not light up the room, and saved tools and lists work offline. Source links require internet. No account, no ads, no tracking. What you log is kept on your device and is never sent to us.

FREE AND PRO
Free: the whole checklist, every heads-up, 30 ledger entries and 2 timers.
Pro (one-time payment, no subscription): unlimited ledger and timers, earnings ranking, the price book, notes, extra runs and backup.

Unofficial. Not affiliated with, endorsed or sponsored by Rockstar Games or Take-Two Interactive. Grand Theft Auto and GTA are trademarks of Take-Two Interactive. Getaway Log is a fan-made tracker with no game art, audio, maps or screenshots. Heads-ups are player reports and may be wrong or change with patches.

name: GiftBrain: Gift Reminders
description:
GiftBrain remembers the people you love, so you never miss a big day or give the same gift twice.

NEVER MISS A BIG DAY
• Birthdays, anniversaries and holidays in one timeline, with how old they're turning
• Reminders 14, 7 and 3 days before, and on the day
• Mother's Day, Father's Day, Thanksgiving and Easter worked out for you every year
• Import birthdays from your contacts in a tap

KNOW WHAT TO GET
• Save gift ideas the moment someone mentions something they love
• Keep sizes, favourites, interests and a "do not gift" list for each person
• Move every gift from idea to bought to wrapped to given
• One "get ready" screen per occasion: ideas, budget and everything you know about them

NEVER REPEAT A GIFT
• A history of every gift you've given and how it landed
• GiftBrain warns you when a new idea sounds like something you already gave

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Everything lives on your phone. There's no account and no GiftBrain server, and nothing is tracked or sold. Export a backup file any time.

FREE AND PREMIUM
GiftBrain is free for up to three people, with the standard reminders and do-not-gift warnings.
GiftBrain Premium unlocks unlimited people, the gift history and repeat-gift warnings, your own reminder schedule and time, budgets and a monthly digest. Premium is $0.99 a month after a 7-day free trial for new subscribers, and renews automatically until you cancel.

Terms: https://giftbrain.bostechit.com/terms.html
Privacy: https://giftbrain.bostechit.com/privacy.html

name: Glassmith: Stained Glass Logic
description:
Glassmith is a calm logic puzzle made of light and colored glass.
Drag translucent cyan, magenta and yellow panes onto the frame. Where they overlap, they mix like real glass: cyan + yellow makes green, magenta + yellow makes red, all three make deep night.
Read the target window, work out where every pane belongs, and watch the sun shine through your finished stained glass.

HOW IT PLAYS
• Each cell of the target tells you which colors must cover it.
• Order never matters, only where each pane lies.
• Any arrangement that matches the window wins. There is never a "wrong" solution.
• No lives, no move limits, no game over. Time never costs stars.
• Undo, reset, and touch and hold the target to preview it on the board.

DAILY WINDOW
• A new window every day, the same puzzle for every player.
• Difficulty climbs from Monday to Sunday, ending with a large 7×7 cathedral window.
• Build a streak and share a spoiler-free result with friends.

CAMPAIGN
• 96 windows in four chapters: Dawn, Noon, Dusk and Cathedral.
• Each chapter adds one idea: two colors, all three colors, rotating panes, then lead cells and 7×7 frames.
• Every window is checked by a built-in solver, so every puzzle can be solved.

GALLERY
• Every window you solve is kept in your gallery.
• The 24 windows of each chapter fill a rose window.
• Share your windows as images or save them to Photos.

HINTS AND ASSIST
• 3 free hints every day. A hint places one pane in a correct spot.
• Earn bonus hints for finishing a chapter and for every 7 days of your streak.
• Assist marks matching cells (that window then gives at most 2 stars).

MADE FOR EVERYONE
• Colorblind patterns, always free: cyan = horizontal lines, magenta = diagonal lines, yellow = dots. Mixed colors show combined patterns, so every color can be read without seeing it.
• Dynamic Type, Reduce Motion, and VoiceOver labels for menus and every cell of the board.
• Light and dark mode. Synthesized glass sounds and haptics, each with its own switch.
• English and Polish.

FREE TO PLAY, NO ADS
Free: the Daily Window, the Dawn and Noon chapters (48 windows), the gallery, colorblind patterns and 3 hints a day.

Glassmith Pro is a one-time purchase, not a subscription:
• Dusk and Cathedral: 48 more windows, playable right after purchase
• Daily archive: replay every past Daily Window since window #1 (December 1, 2026)
• Workshop: endless newly forged windows, 5×5 to 7×7, in three difficulties
• 5 free hints every day instead of 3
Pro supports Family Sharing. Optional hint packs (10 or 40 hints) are also available.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking, no data collected. Your progress stays on your device and the game plays offline.

name: Glaze Test Tiles
description:
Know exactly what made that glaze. Record every test tile: the clay, each glaze layer in the order you applied it, the coat counts and what came out of the kiln.
Create a whole numbered series in seconds, A01 to A06, with the clay and cone filled in on every tile at once.
Then compare your fired tiles on one screen and star the combinations worth repeating.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Name a test series and choose how many tiles you made. Clay, cone and firing notes are optional.
2. Open a tile and add its layers: glaze name, brush, dip, spray or other, and the number of coats.
3. After firing, add your observations and photos, then open the comparison grid.

A WHOLE SERIES AT ONCE
- Sequential codes like A01–A06 that match the marks on your tiles. Codes are never reused, even after you delete a tile.
- Shared clay, cone and firing notes are copied into every tile when you create the series.
- Change the series later and the app shows which tiles it affects before anything is replaced. Values you set on a single tile stay protected unless you choose to replace them.

EVERY LAYER IN ORDER
- Layers keep their order, first applied first, and you can move them up or down.
- Whole coat counts for each layer, plus notes for thickness or dip timing.
- The cone is kept exactly as you write it, so 06 stays 06 and is never turned into a number or a temperature.

COMPARE YOUR FIRED TILES
- A grid of every tile in a series with its code, photo, glaze shorthand and coat counts.
- Pick two tiles to see their photos and records side by side, with the differences marked.
- Tiles without photos still show their full record.
- Photos are shown as taken. Lighting, camera and screen change how color looks, so the app never presents them as a calibrated color comparison.

FIND YOUR SUCCESSFUL COMBINATIONS
- Star the tiles that worked and find them all in Favorites with their full layer recipe.
- Attach photos from your library or from Files: bisque, glazed, after firing or other. Only the pictures you choose are copied into the app, without location details.

TRY THE SAMPLE FIRST
The app includes an editable sample series of six example tiles, clearly marked "Sample". Change a coat count, open the comparison grid, and remove the whole sample in one tap when you're ready to start your own.

FREE
- Up to two test series and twelve tiles in total
- Comparison grid and side-by-side comparison
- Photos, favorites and the full tile record
- Backup export and import with all records and photos, and Delete All Data

PRO
- Unlimited test series and tiles
- Duplicate a series or reuse a favorite tile as a new test
- Reusable layer combinations
- Formatted PDF test sheet: a paper index of tile codes, layers and notes for your studio records
If Pro ends, nothing is deleted. Your series and tiles stay readable, and the backup export stays free.

YOUR TESTS STAY ON YOUR IPHONE
No account, no ads, no tracking. Your records and photos are stored on your iPhone. Export a backup file whenever you like.

This is a notebook for your own experiments. It doesn't create glaze recipes, give chemical, safety or firing advice, or connect to a kiln. Photos and past results don't establish food safety or a firing schedule. Follow your material and kiln manufacturers' instructions.

SUBSCRIPTION
Pro is optional: weekly with a 3-day free trial for eligible new subscribers, or annual, billed in full once a year. Prices are shown in the app before you buy. Subscriptions renew automatically until cancelled in Settings.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://motleystudio.site/glaze-test-tiles/privacy
Terms: https://motleystudio.site/glaze-test-tiles/terms

name: Gleaned: Sermon Notes
description:
Hear it Sunday. Live it all week.

Gleaned records the sermon, writes the transcript, finds the Bible verses the pastor mentions, and turns the message into a short outline and five daily reflections. All of it happens on your iPhone or iPad. Your audio and notes are never uploaded, and there is no account to create.

RECORD WITHOUT FUSS
- Tap record and put your phone away. Recording continues with the screen locked.
- If recording is interrupted (a phone call, for example), Gleaned tells you so you do not discover a gap on Tuesday.
- Tap "mark this moment" to bookmark a line that struck you, and type your own notes while the sermon plays out.

TRANSCRIPT YOU CAN EDIT
- A live transcript is created on-device while you record.
- Fix a name or a word, and play the audio back with the transcript following along.

SCRIPTURE, FOUND FOR YOU
- When a reference is spoken aloud ("John 3:16", "First Corinthians thirteen, four through seven"), Gleaned finds it and shows the full verse text.
- Scripture text is the Berean Standard Bible, which is in the public domain and is built into the app.

KEEP AND SHARE
- A searchable library of every sermon you have recorded.
- Share notes as plain text.

GLEANED PRO
- Sermon Outline: a title, the big idea, key points and a one-paragraph summary. Your first two outlines are free.
- Week of Reflection: five short daily reflections (a passage, a question and one small step) with an optional daily reminder.
- Small Group guide: discussion questions you can share with your group in one tap.
- PDF export of your notes, outline and scripture.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Audio, transcripts and notes stay on your device. There is no account, no tracking and no analytics service. Purchases are handled by Apple.

APPLE INTELLIGENCE REQUIRED FOR AI FEATURES
The outline, reflections and small group guide are written by Apple's on-device language model and require a device with Apple Intelligence (iPhone 15 Pro or later). On other devices Gleaned tells you so; recording, transcripts, scripture and PDF export still work. Summaries and reflections are machine-generated aids and may contain mistakes. They are not pastoral or theological authority.

Please make sure you have permission to record where you worship.

SUBSCRIPTION
Gleaned Pro is available as a yearly subscription for $29.99 with a 7-day free trial for eligible new subscribers, or monthly for $4.99 (prices may vary by region). Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase, or at the end of the free trial. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel any time in Settings > your name > Subscriptions. Any unused portion of a free trial is forfeited when you subscribe.

Terms of Use: https://gleaned-app.web.app/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://gleaned-app.web.app/privacy/

Gleaned is an independent app and is not affiliated with any church, denomination or Bible publisher.

name: Glovebox: Private Car Log
description:
No ads ever. No data tracking. No account creation.

Glovebox keeps your car's whole story in one place: every fuel-up, service, repair, cost and trip, for as many vehicles as you own. It's built for people who keep records for years, so your history is never locked away from you.

YOUR DATA IS NEVER HELD HOSTAGE
• CSV export, PDF reports and full backup are free, forever. Even if you never pay
• Unlimited vehicles: cars, motorcycles, trucks, vans, anything with an odometer
• Back up everything, photos and documents included, to one file you keep wherever you like
• Before an update changes the database, Glovebox keeps a copy of it

COMING FROM ANOTHER APP?
Import a CSV file and match its columns to Glovebox's fields. Exports from Drivvo and Fuelio are recognized automatically.

REAL FUEL ECONOMY
• Economy worked out between full tanks, so partial fills are handled properly
• mpg, L/100 km, km/L, mi/kWh or kWh/100 km
• More than one fuel per vehicle, like petrol plus E85, or a plug-in hybrid's petrol and electricity, each tracked separately
• Fast entry: last price and station remembered, odometer filled in, and a "Log fuel" Home Screen quick action

SERVICE, COSTS AND INCOME
• Services and repairs with receipt photos from your library or camera
• Reminders by distance or date, whichever comes first: "Due in 300 mi", in plain words
• Totals by month and year, cost per mile or km, and total cost of ownership since purchase
• Log rideshare or delivery income and see net profit by month
• Charts of spending, fuel economy, fuel price and distance

TRIPS AND MILEAGE
• Log trips by odometer or distance, as business, personal or your own purpose
• Business miles per year, for tax and expense claims

OPTIONAL GPS
• GPS trip tracking is optional and off by default
• Location is asked for only when you turn it on, and only while the app is in use
• It runs only during a trip you start, with the location indicator showing, and stops when you end the trip
• Route points are off by default: only the distance and times are kept unless you turn them on
• Optional GPS trips stay on your phone. Glovebox never uploads or shares location
• Turn it off, or delete route points, at any time

DOCUMENTS AND REPORTS
• Keep photos of your insurance card, registration and warranty, with renewal reminders
• Lock the app with Face ID or your passcode, and blur it in the app switcher
• PDF report per vehicle, or a service history for a buyer showing only what you choose

FAIR PRICING
• Free for 7 days with every feature
• Then a single $1.99 in-app purchase unlocks it for good. No subscription, ever
• If you don't buy, you can still see everything, export it as CSV or PDF, and back it up

PRIVACY, PLAINLY
• No account, sign-in or email
• No ads, analytics, crash reporting or tracking SDKs
• No application networking code or developer server. Apple handles the optional purchase
• Your records, photos and documents stay in the app's private storage on your phone. Optional GPS trips stay on your phone too

Made by Southwest Blueprints with AI assistance.

name: Glowbound: Pixel Light Puzzle
description:
Send a spark around the loop. Watch the picture light up.

Glowbound is a glowing pixel puzzle with a twist: every tap counts. A dark pixel picture sits inside a neon loop. Tap a spark and it rides one lap around the picture, firing into every row and column it passes and lighting the outer cells of its own colour. Lit cells let the light through, so the inner colours open up as the outside glows.

THINK BEFORE YOU TAP
• Every tap costs a move, and moves are limited
• Send a colour too early and it can't reach its cells. It wastes a lap and fills your dock
• Fill the dock or run out of moves and the picture stays dark
• Find the right order and light it all with a perfect plan for 3 stars

THREE WAYS TO PLAY
• Easy: smaller pictures and spare moves, perfect for learning
• Medium: more colours, fewer moves, a real brain workout
• Hard: big pictures and no spare moves. Only a full plan wins
• Each mode keeps its own level, so you can switch any time

ENDLESS PICTURES
• Hearts, stars, flowers, moons, little creatures, landscapes and mandalas
• Every picture is checked to be solvable within its moves
• Soft, satisfying light, gentle sounds and haptics

SOMETHING NEW EVERY DAY
• A big Daily picture for everyone, with triple coins
• Three daily missions and a login streak bonus

COMPETE AND COLLECT
• Weekly Game Center leaderboard that resets every Monday
• All-time leaderboard of pictures lit
• 10 glowing colour themes to unlock with coins

PLAY ANYWHERE
• Works offline
• Free to play with ads. Remove the ads between pictures with a single one-time purchase.

Tap. Glow. Plan. Light it all.

name: Go Helen Tutors: 1:1 Lessons
description:
Go Helen Tutors brings personalised 1-to-1 online tutoring for students in Years 7 to 11, all in one easy app.

Every student is matched with their own tutor, and lessons are tailored to how they learn, what they find tricky and the exams they're working towards. 

Once your account is activated, you get an email explaining how to sign up and set your own password! 
You receive an email when a lesson is booked in with your tutor and you receive another email reminding you 30 minutes before your lesson starts! 

Free Trial Lessons are given on the app and you can always send your tutors a message!

WHAT YOU CAN DO IN THE APP:
• Join live lessons – tap "Join Lesson" and you're straight into your session with your tutor.
• See your schedule – view upcoming and completed lessons and add them to your calendar
• Message your tutor – ask questions and stay in touch between lessons
• Download resources – homework, revision notes and lesson slides, ready whenever you need them
• Get notifications – never miss a lesson or new piece of homework

FOR PARENTS
Keep track of your child's lessons and progress, see who their tutor is and message them directly – all from your phone.

SUBJECTS
Maths, English and Science (Biology, Chemistry and Physics), plus more, with support for KS3 and GCSE.

FREE TRIAL LESSON
New to Go Helen Tutors? Book a free trial lesson and see how 1-to-1 tutoring can help. You can book from the app directly! 

Sign in with the account details provided by Go Helen Tutors to get started.

name: Go Viral! Japan: Pixel RPG
description:
Become a brand-new streamer with zero subscribers and travel across Japan in this pixel-art RPG.

In this slightly strange version of today's Japan, towns that nobody searches for slowly lose their color. With the old camcorder you inherited from your grandfather, you set off from a small island in Okinawa.

■ Creatures born from local buzz
When people care about a town's specialties, landmarks and legends, they take shape as creatures called Netamono: a freshly baked local treat, a sweet that holds a lake's sunset, footprints on the dunes, a valley of rice terraces. Film them, team up, and fill your notebook.

■ Battles are collab showdowns
Turn-based command battles where you read your rival's "next episode" preview and pick a plan. Moves come in video genres: food, outdoors, challenges, singing, gameplay and explainers. Fill the Buzz gauge for a legendary episode.

■ Local hosts and collab seals
Every prefecture has a host who streams from that land. Read the tide, race the sunset on a lake, follow the ripples on the dunes. Earn their seal and the town's forgotten story comes back.

■ Between numbers and the real thing
A company that manufactures hype, a rival who crashed after a staged video, a childhood friend anxious about views. A story that doesn't sneer at chasing numbers, but asks what you really want to share.

■ Where you travel
Chapter 1: Okinawa, Kagoshima (Amami), Miyazaki, Kumamoto, Nagasaki, Saga, Fukuoka, Oita and Mt. Sobo.
Chapter 2: across the Kanmon Strait to Yamaguchi, Shimane, Tottori, Okayama, Hiroshima and a deep pool in the Chugoku mountains.

■ One-handed play
Swipe to walk, tap to talk. Play one-handed or with a classic d-pad. English and Japanese.

■ Play with peace of mind
- Plays offline. No account needed.
- No ads, no gacha, no stamina.

■ Free to start, buy a chapter at a time
Okinawa, Kagoshima and Miyazaki are free.
"Chapter 1: Kyushu & Okinawa" unlocks the rest of Kyushu from Kumamoto onward.
"Chapter 2: Chugoku" unlocks Yamaguchi, Shimane, Tottori, Okayama and Hiroshima (available after Chapter 1, as the journey continues from there).
Each is a one-time purchase.

name: GOLD pages
description:
Find beauty and wellness professionals who fit your needs. GOLD pages starts with 1,677 Charlotte-area listings, with source-linked information that helps you choose confidently.

FIND YOUR FIT
Explore hair, barbering, nails, skin care, lashes, brows, waxing, makeup, massage and wellness. Filter by services, clients served, location, setting and published experience. Find natural hair, braids, locs, children's hair services, Korean skincare, Dominican and Brazilian services, and explicitly identified Black-owned businesses. Parents can explore care for Black girls and children with textured hair.

COMPARE WITH CONTEXT
Relevant, source-linked information leads the default results. See dated Google review snapshots where available, public website and social sources, booking links and published service details. Social discoveries are labeled "appears to offer" until confirmed. Sort by nearest area, name, rating or experience.

KEEP YOUR SHORTLIST
Save favorites and add private notes. They stay on your device and are never sent to providers or used for recommendations. No account is required. Discover related providers based on services, location and your favorites.

CONNECT DIRECTLY
Open websites and booking pages, call a public business number, and share provider profiles. Tell them you found them on GOLD pages.

FOR PROFESSIONALS
Request a free business claim, a GILDvision demo, or pricing for a custom SEO page and featured placement through our secure online forms. Claims are reviewed before listing changes. Shassity Styles is currently the only confirmed GILDvision provider. Featured placements are labeled when active and do not boost organic ranking.

The directory is bundled for offline browsing. Internet access is required for external sites, booking and request forms. Confirm services, prices and availability with each provider. GOLD pages does not process bookings or payments. Coverage starts in the Charlotte metro area and is growing.

name: Golden HR
description:
Golden HR is the application of the Human Resources office of Golden Automation Systems (Golden A/S), the marine electrical, automation and navigation systems integrator based in Keratsini, Greece, with branches in Italy and the Netherlands.

An account issued by Golden A/S with the HR role is required. The app is a companion to the Golden A/S portal and is not intended for the general public.

With it the HR manager can:
• see on one page everything that waits for a decision
• approve or reject leave requests, training applications and timesheets
• follow recruiting: candidates by stage, CV reader, evaluations and interviews
• approve job descriptions
• follow the steps of the HR year and what is late
• see contracts, certificates and permits that expire soon
• accept equipment handover lists
• read and answer messages from employees
• see who is away and the leave balances
• In / Out: clock in and clock out with the time and the position at that moment

The app always opens with Face ID or Touch ID and locks after 15 minutes. Decisions are confirmed with an authenticator code. Payroll and other confidential personal data never leave the portal.

name: Golden Pixel: Idle Breaker
description:
Somewhere in the dark, one golden pixel is pulsing. Dig your way to it.

Golden Pixel is a free idle brick breaker drawn entirely on a pixel grid. Every level starts as a small pocket of light inside a buried map. Your balls bounce through the blocks one pixel at a time, every break pushes the light further, and the gold waits somewhere out there.

No ads. No in-app purchases. No accounts. No tracking.

LAUNCH BALLS, WATCH THEM DIG
• Hold an open spot, pull back like a slingshot and let go: the ball flies the other way and never stops bouncing.
• Seven ball types to unlock: Basic, Fast, Heavy, Volt, Bomb, Sniper and Ghost.
• Every block you break pays coins. Spend them on more balls and watch the board fill with color.

READ THE BOARD
• Blocks are one shade of blue, and the shade is how tough they are: deep blue takes many hits, pale blue is one hit from breaking.
• Fog of war: you only see three cells past open space. Dig close and the gold glows faintly through the dark; nearby shards shimmer mint.
• Pinch to zoom out over the whole dig, or in close on the balls.

GROW A SKILL TREE
• Mint shards buried in the rock buy skills: more damage, faster balls, critical hits, more coins.
• Lantern pushes back the dark, Radar boxes in the gold, Sonar pings through the rock.
• Every ball type has its own branch of upgrades and two specializations.

BREAK THE GOLD
• The golden pixel is the level's boss: hundreds of hits, draining as it takes damage.
• Every gold you break is a star for good: more damage and more coins on every level after.
• Seven named levels, then the deep levels keep going.

MADE FOR IPHONE DUO
Built for the big inner screen of iPhone Duo: every pixel lands exactly on the grid, with no blur and no smoothing. It plays on every other iPhone too.

A CALM SOUNDTRACK
A relaxed menu theme and a shuffled playlist of ten tracks that fade into each other while you dig. Switch the music off in Settings anytime.

Your progress is saved on your device only. Golden Pixel collects no data.

name: Golf Up: Mini Golf Trick Shots
description:
One shot. A whole chain of tricks.

Pull back on the ball with one finger and let go. It shoots through a drinking straw, swirls round a colander, rides the dumbwaiter and pops out of the toaster, all from that one shot. Golf Up is mini golf that goes up: 300 levels climbing a pop-up paper house, from the living room to the roof.

TRICK-SHOT CHAINS
- Every room has its own machines: toy Ferris wheels, clear tubes, funnels, trampolines, spiral slides, marble tracks and dumbwaiters, plus fans, conveyor belts and magnets.
- Lay one good shot into the first and the house does the rest. Ride a machine into the cup and it is a TRICK SHOT, with bonus coins.
- Every room ends in its showpiece: a whole chain of machines, set off by a single shot.

ONE FINGER, REAL BOUNCES
- Drag back from the ball like a slingshot. The farther you pull, the harder the shot.
- The view zooms out as you pull, so you can see where you are going. Drag anywhere else to look around.
- No trajectory line: you judge each shot by eye. (The Aim Line booster draws one when you want help.)
- Every ball flies the same way. Nothing you buy changes the physics, apart from a booster you choose for a single shot.

300 LEVELS IN FIFTEEN ROOMS
- Living room: hop over the couch, ride the toy Ferris wheel and roll along the curtain rod.
- Kitchen: slide on icy fridge shelves, ride the toaster's pop, and mind the flour that weakens your next shot.
- Kids' room: bounce off spring cushions and bumpers, jump on the bed and ride the slide off the top bunk.
- Bathroom: float on bath bubbles, drop down a drain and shoot out of the spout.
- Garage: ride a fan's updraft, roll along a conveyor belt, and bend your shot past a magnet.
- Study: press buttons that open gates, topple stacks of books, tip a seesaw and land on paper shelves that tear.
- Then the long climb from the laundry, through the garden, the bedroom, the stairwell, the music room, the sewing room, the attic and the observatory, out onto the roof: every room harder than the last.
Every level is marked Easy, Regular or Hard, so you know what is coming.

SHOTS, STARS AND FLAGS
- Each level gives you a set number of shots. Finish in fewer to earn two or three stars.
- Splash into water and the ball goes back to your last checkpoint flag. The shot still counts.
- Out of shots near the top? Keep your spot with a few extra shots, once per attempt.

BOOSTERS FOR THE HARD BITS
- Rewind: take back a bad shot.
- Aim Line: see the path of your next shot.
- Sticky Ball: stop dead on your next landing.
- Ghost Shot: see where your last shot from this spot went.
Every level can be finished without them.

LOOKS THAT PUT ON A SHOW
Earn coins as you climb and spend them on balls, trails and auras: Eight-Ball, Watermelon, Molten Rock, Galaxy, Comet Tail, Dragon Egg and more. The rarer the look, the more it does: rare ones catch the light, epic ones come alive in flight, and legendary ones glow at rest and put on a show when the ball drops into the cup. Looks only: they never change how the ball plays.

SEASONS AND THE GOLF PASS
Every few weeks a new season brings its own looks. Your wins fill its Golf Pass, 50 tiers deep: coins and hearts on the free track, and on the pass the season's looks, more coins and boosters.

HEARTS
Starting a level costs a heart, and finishing it gives the heart back. Hearts refill over time, and if you allow notifications the game tells you when they are full.

GOOD TO KNOW
- No account, no sign-up.
- Plays offline. Purchases and videos need a connection.
- Sound, vibration and extra effects can each be switched off.
- Golf Up is free to play. It shows ads: videos you choose to watch for a reward, and an ad between some levels. Optional in-app purchases: coins, a Starter Pack, the season's Golf Pass, and the Ad-Free Pack, which turns off the ads between levels for good and adds coins and hearts.

Questions, or a purchase that did not arrive? Write to support@pocketpeakstudio.com.

name: GreenCut
description:
GreenCut makes lawn mower rental straightforward. Tell us about your lawn, see which machines actually fit, and reserve in minutes.

MATCH IN THREE QUESTIONS
Not sure whether you need a push mower, a riding mower or a zero-turn? The Match tool asks three short questions — lawn size, terrain and power preference — then ranks the whole fleet for you. Every result shows a fit score and a plain-English reason, so you know exactly why a machine was recommended.

COMPARE SPECS SIDE BY SIDE
See coverage, torque, quietness, agility and endurance on a clear five-axis radar chart. Compare up to three machines at once and spot the right trade-off before you book.

A FLEET FOR EVERY LAWN
Twelve machine types, including riding, push, self-propelled, zero-turn, robotic, electric, gas, reel, hover, commercial, mulching and lawn tractor. Each listing shows cutting width, cutting height, maximum slope, noise level and power type, plus daily, seven-day and thirty-day rates and the refundable deposit.

CLEAR TERMS, NO SURPRISES
Renters must be 18 or older and present a valid driver license at pickup. An optional damage waiver limits your responsibility for accidental damage, and every machine comes with a safety brief covering eye and ear protection, slope limits and safe operation. Full rental terms and privacy policy are available in the app.

YOUR RENTALS IN ONE PLACE
Bookmark machines you like, keep your reservations together, and review your rental history whenever you need it.

GreenCut Equipment Rental · United States. Payment is collected at pickup; a valid driver license in the renter's name is required.

name: Grounda
description:
Grounda is the simple way for property managers to handle maintenance, from the first tenant report to paying the vendor.

FOR PROPERTY MANAGERS
• Every request in one place. Tenants report problems with photos, so you see the issue before anyone drives out.
• Smart triage. Grounda reads each request and suggests the trade and urgency, so emergencies never sit in the queue.
• Dispatch in seconds. Send the job to your trusted vendors, see who accepts, and track it on a live board.
• Approve and pay. Review the finished work and photos, then pay the vendor online through Stripe.
• Owner approvals and spending limits keep owners in the loop on bigger jobs.
• Reports that answer real questions: cost per unit, time to fix, and vendor scorecards.

FOR TENANTS
• Report a problem in under a minute, with photos and entry notes.
• Track progress and message your property manager in the app.
• Free for tenants.

FOR VENDORS
• Get jobs from the property managers you already work with.
• Upload your license and insurance once.
• Get paid the full job price straight to your bank. Free for vendors.

SIMPLE PRICING
Start free. Property managers pay a small fee per completed job, shown before every payment.

Questions? Visit usegrounda.com/support.

Your all-in-one companion for GTA 6 and GTA V reference content.

name: GUFED
description:
Türkiye Güvercin Federasyonu'nun (GUFED) resmi mobil uygulaması ile yarış sonuçlarınızı, klasmanlarınızı ve federasyon duyurularını cebinizden takip edin.

- Katıldığınız yarışları ve sonuçlarınızı görün
- Bölge, il ve FCI klasmanlarında sıranızı takip edin
- Güvercinlerinizin karnesine ve geçmiş derecelerine ulaşın
- Kümesinizin konumunu kaydedin

name: Hakomaru: 荷物追跡
description:
Hakomaruは、届く荷物をひとつの一覧で確認できる追跡アプリです。番号を貼るだけで運送会社を自動で判定します。アカウントやログインは要りません。

貼るだけ、運送会社を自動判定
追跡番号をコピーして貼る、またはバーコードを読み取ると、運送会社を自動で判定します。判定できないときは候補から選べます。

要対応の荷物がひと目でわかる
不在による持ち戻りなど、対応が必要な荷物は一覧の先頭に表示され、再配達の依頼や公式ページへすぐ進めます。

状況が変わったら通知
配達中になったときや、対応が必要になったときにお知らせします。

アプリ内で状況を読み取る運送会社
日本郵便、ヤマト運輸。お使いのiPhoneが各社の公開された追跡ページを直接確認します。

公式ページを開く運送会社
佐川急便、西濃運輸、Amazonなど。番号は保存され、ボタンから各社の公式ページを開けます。ログインが必要な情報は取得しません。

データは端末の中だけ
追跡番号とニックネームはiPhoneの中にだけ保存されます。分析ツールや広告は使っていません。

無料で5件まで、Pro(買い切り)で拡張
無料で5件まで登録できます。Proにすると、件数の制限なし、ホーム画面ウィジェット、履歴のCSV書き出しが使えます。

・バックグラウンドでの更新のタイミングはiOSが決めるため、通知が遅れて届くことがあります。急ぐときはアプリを開いて下に引っ張って更新してください。
・各社の公式サービスとは関係ありません。運送会社の名称は、対応状況を示すためだけに使用しています。

name: Hangar Jam: Air Base Rescue
description:
The base is jammed and a world leader needs to get out — fast.

You drive the tug. Hitch up fighter jets, cargo lifters and stealth bombers, tow them out of the way, then pull the leader's VIP jet through the hangar doors. Park a plane in the wrong spot and you'll box yourself in!

• 50 hand-checked missions, each one harder than the last
• A new nation every level — from Australia to the United States — flown in its own flag colours
• Fighter jets, transports, cargo lifters, stealth bombers and a giant VIP jumbo
• Beat par for a star on every mission
• Free undo and restart, no timers — think at your own pace
• Hints whenever you're stuck
• Plays fully offline, one-handed, in portrait
• No ads, no sign-up

Got an idea for a new mission, nation or aircraft? Tap "Ideas & feedback" in the game — we read every message. We make games to entertain you!

name: Hanzi Nonograms: Learn Chinese
description:
Hanzi Nonograms is a quiet place to solve logic puzzles and meet Chinese characters, one grid at a time.

Read the numbers beside each row and column, fill the cells they ask for, and leave the rest blank. When the last line is right, the filled cells form a hanzi. The character then turns over like a card, showing its pinyin, its meaning, an example word, and Mandarin audio so you can hear it said.

For puzzle lovers 
• Classic nonogram rules, also known as picture cross, griddlers or hanjie 
• Grids from 10×10 to 25×25. The grid size sets the difficulty: simple characters sit on small grids, and detailed ones need more room 
• Every puzzle solves by line logic alone, with no guessing 
• Ink and Mark modes, drag to fill a run, undo and redo, and pinch to zoom on large grids 
• A hint shows the next logical step and explains why. Check circles any mistakes 
• Your progress saves as you play

For Mandarin learners 
• An HSK path through levels 1, 2 and 3 
• Theme packs: Numbers, Nature, Family and Spring Festival 
• More than 850 characters, each with pinyin, an English meaning and an example word 
• Every character you solve rests in your Collection, ready to revisit or solve again

Today's character A new character every day, free for everyone and hidden until you solve it.

Seals and the garden Each solved puzzle earns a seal, pressed in red: 妙 when you solve it unaided, 好 after a Check, 成 after a hint. Seals are never spent. They open the next pack once you have solved three quarters of the one before it, and at 30 seals they open the Jade Garden palette, alongside Rice Paper, Night Ink and Plum Blossom.

A gentle economy Every pack opens by playing. Hints and checks use ink you earn by solving, and when you run short you can choose to watch a short video. Videos only ever play when you ask for one. There are no banner ads and no ads between puzzles.

Hanzi Nonograms Pro is a single purchase, not a subscription. It opens every pack, now and later, gives unlimited hints and checks, and removes videos. A single pack can also be opened early on its own.

The puzzles live on your device, so you can play without a connection.
Made by Belesse.

name: HayaCam: Hijab & Modest Poses
description:
Pose guides made for hijabi and modest women.

Pick a pose, follow the outline on your camera, and the app takes the photo the moment you match it. No more awkward photos, no more guessing.

POSES FOR EVERY OCCASION
• Eid – family, outfit and festive poses
• Nikah & wedding – bridal and guest poses
• Mehndi – hands, henna and candid poses
• Everyday – hijab selfies, outfit of the day and travel photos

HOW IT WORKS

3. Match the pose – the photo is taken automatically

MADE WITH MODESTY IN MIND
• Every pose is designed for hijab and modest outfits

PREMIUM
Unlock all poses and new collections every season.

name: Haystack: Adventist Dating
description:
Haystack is a marriage-minded dating app for Seventh-day Adventists and those seeking an Adventist partner. Where faith finds love.

Most dating apps are built to keep you swiping. Haystack is built to help you find one person who shares your faith, your Sabbath and your way of life.

A SMALL, THOUGHTFUL DAILY STACK
Every day you get a handful of people, not an endless feed. Each one is ranked by how closely your values line up, and every card shows your alignment score and what you share, like "Both keep Sabbath sundown to sundown" or "Both vegetarian." Take your time, read their profile, then Pass or Add to Stack.

HAYSTACK RESTS ON SABBATH
From Friday sundown to Saturday sundown, stacks and messaging pause for everyone. Sabbath times are calculated for your own location, so the app rests when your Sabbath begins.

PROFILES BUILT AROUND WHAT MATTERS
Share your baptism, Sabbath observance, faith activity, church involvement, views on Ellen White's writings, diet and health habits, alongside your photos and story. You'll know what matters to someone before you say hello.

MUTUAL MATCHES ONLY
You can message someone only when you've both added each other. No unwanted messages from strangers.

SAFE AND RESPECTFUL
• Report or block anyone from their profile; reports are reviewed within 24 hours
• Zero tolerance for harassment, explicit content and scams
• Pause your profile or delete your account any time in Settings
• Your exact location is never stored or shown

Haystack is free. You must be 18 or older to join.

Haystack is an independent app and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the General Conference of Seventh-day Adventists.

Privacy: https://haystack-69308.web.app/privacy

name: Head2Head Cricket
description:
Step up to the crease for fast, one-on-one cricket. Head2Head Cricket puts you against a single rival: you bat, you bowl, you field, and every ball matters.

TIME IT. LOFT IT. CLEAR THE ROPE.
Drive along the ground, loft it over the fielders, pull the short ball or block the danger. Perfect timing sends the ball flying, and the crowd lets you know when you hit a six. Then swap ends: aim your delivery, curve it in the air and knock back the stumps. Dive for catches and throw down the wickets to run your rival out.

CAREER ROAD ACROSS SIX STADIUMS
Start in a narrow gully and play your way through six chapters, each with its own painted ground and a cup to win at the end. Earn stars on every stage and come back to beat your best.

QUICK MATCHES AND DRAFT MATCH
Just want a game? Pick your player, choose Easy, Medium or Hard and play a short match in a couple of minutes. Or draft your own team: pick 7 of the 18 fighters and face a rival team built from the rest.

MINI GAMES AND WEEKLY LEAGUE
Try skill challenges such as Six Hunt, and climb the Weekly League table against computer rivals for a prize at the end of each week.

KITS AND SKILL CARDS, EARNED BY PLAYING
Open Batting Kits and Bowling Kits to collect Skill Cards, then fit them into your Kit Slots to boost timing, power and accuracy. Kits are earned by playing, with coins and rewards you collect in the game. Tap (i) on a kit to see the odds.

DAILY GOALS AND STREAK CALENDAR
Complete Daily Goals to fill your Goal Chest and come back each day to keep your Streak Calendar going.

LEARN WITH THE UMPIRE COACH
New to the game? A friendly umpire coach walks you through a practice match: drive, loft, pull, run, block and leave, then bowling and fielding.

A CAST OF RIVALS
Unlock and level up a squad of colourful cricketers, each with their own style.

Made for landscape play on iPhone and iPad. Contains ads. Players aged 13 and over.

name: Hearth Bellows
description:
Hearth Bellows keeps one breath from the bellows on this iPhone.

The bellows start open. Write the name that belongs on the fire. Point the nozzle toward the grate. Drag the upper board down until the bellows close. The fire is given that one breath, with the time it was closed.

Open the kept fires later to see that fire. Given breaths stay on this iPhone. Nothing is uploaded and nothing is shared.

Hearth Bellows does not light a fire, measure air, or remind you.

name: HEIC to JPG: By Date & Album
description:
Every HEIC already in your Photos, converted at once.

The camera's “Most Compatible” setting only takes new photos as JPG. The HEIC photos you already took stay HEIC. This app finds only the HEIC photos in your library, shows how many there are, and lets you pick them by today, last 7 days, this month, this year or album — then converts them all in one go.

■ How it works
1. Open the app and see how many HEIC photos you have.
2. Choose a date range or album and tap “Select all”.
3. Tap “Convert to JPG” and watch the progress bar.
4. Save to Photos, or share them all at once to Files, Mail or any app.

■ What's different
• Straight from Photos — no need to copy photos into Files first.
• Many photos at once — even free, up to 20 a day in one batch.
• Original dates kept — saved photos land next to the originals in Photos.
• Remove location before sharing — strip GPS from the converted files (PRO). Originals stay untouched.
• Your originals are never changed — the app only creates new files.

■ Free
• Convert up to 20 photos a day to JPG
• No ads

■ PRO (one-time purchase, not a subscription)
• No daily limit
• PNG, and combine many photos into one PDF
• Choose quality (100–60%) and long side (4096–1080 px)
• Remove location (GPS) data

■ Your photos never leave your phone
All conversion happens on your iPhone. Nothing is uploaded and there is no account. Originals stored only in iCloud are downloaded by iOS before converting.

■ Payment and refunds
PRO is a one-time purchase you keep (not a subscription). Payment is charged to your Apple Account. Use “Restore purchase” with the same Apple Account to use PRO on another device. Refunds can be requested from Apple at reportaproblem.apple.com under Apple's policies.

name: Here Done
description:
Ласкаво просимо до Here Done!
• Спільні завдання команди зі статусами, термінами та виконавцями
• Працює без інтернету та синхронізується, коли він з'являється

• Команди з ролями: власник, адмін, учасник. Одна людина може бути в кількох командах з різною роллю в кожній.

name: Hidden Pegs
description:
Crack a hidden four-colour code in ten guesses. Choose four different pegs, check your guess, and use the clues to work out the right order. A black peg marks a correct colour in the right position. A white peg marks a correct colour in a different position.

Play offline at your own pace. Leave and return to your current game, and track your fewest guesses and fastest solve on your iPhone. Hidden Pegs has no ads, accounts or in-app purchases.

name: HN Brief
description:
HN Brief turns the Hacker News front page into short, readable summaries, so you can see what everyone's talking about without opening thirty tabs.

EVERY STORY, SUMMARIZED Each top story gets a one- or two-sentence summary of the article and three key points, so you know what it says before you decide to read it in full.

WHAT THE COMMENTS ARE SAYING The discussion often matters as much as the link. HN Brief sums up the overall reaction, the main threads of debate, and picks out the comments worth reading: first-hand experience, expert insight, strong counterpoints and useful resources.

CATCH UP ON WHAT'S NEW Come back later and jump straight to stories that are new since you last looked, or to discussions that have grown. A map down the side of the feed shows where they are, and an optional badge on the app icon counts new stories.

READ IT YOUR WAY • Fold away stories you're done with. • Open the full article or the original thread whenever you want more. • Your last front page and its summaries stay available offline. • Works with VoiceOver, Voice Control, Larger Text, Dark Mode, Increase Contrast and Reduce Motion.

FREE, WITH OPTIONAL TIPS HN Brief is free, with no ads, no account and no tracking. If you find it useful, you can leave a tip, which unlocks alternate app icons and matching themes: Midnight, Paper, Terminal and Ocean.

Summaries are written by AI and can contain mistakes. Open the article or thread to check anything important.

HN Brief is an independent app and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Hacker News or Y Combinator.

name: Hollowbill
description:
Hollowbill is a portrait puzzle on a cheese cliff. Tap a high lip, then a lower one, and a wooden chute snaps between them. Hold to pour. Barley, pepper, cocoa, and salt seeds roll downhill into the kettles waiting on the ledge.

Every order is fed only when each kettle has what it asked for and the waste stays under the cap. A clean pour is a Brim. A fed order with a little left over is Steady or Drip. A hungry kettle, a frozen pocket, or a pile of waste is a Spill, and the pier sends the slip back.

Four piers hang on the board. Salt Pier teaches the lips. Rind Pier freezes pockets until you plant coal. Split Pier forks one chute toward more than one kettle. Brittle Pier tires the wood after a counted number of seeds. Oak sticks and lasts. Birch is quick enough that a fox blinks and misses. Ironbark reaches farther and gives up sooner.

A rust fox lunges on a beat. Seeds sitting on an open lip can be stolen. Drag Look to orbit the cliff when a deep lip hides behind another. Peek sends a ghost seed down the chutes you built.

Fog Catch is one cliff seeded by the date on this phone. Only your best catch is kept. The Kettle Ledger, Recipe Atlas, and Seed Bestiary stay on the device with the rest of your pier progress.

name: HomeWire US: DIY Wiring & TV
description:
Stop guessing behind your TV, PC, or wall outlet.

HomeWire US is a clean, offline-first pocket reference built specifically for North American homes (120V/240V NEC). Whether you're replacing a GFCI outlet, connecting a 4K TV + Sonos eARC soundbar + PS5, checking a smart thermostat C-wire, or figuring out why a bedroom breaker keeps tripping, HomeWire US walks you through it visually and safely.

WHAT'S INCLUDED
• 11 Verified US Guides with Interactive Diagrams: Replacement 3-prong NEMA 5-15 plugs, GFCI Line vs. Load, ungrounded two-prong outlets (GFCI + “No Equipment Ground” label), 3-Way Light Switches (Common vs. Travelers), Smart Switch Neutral Check, Ceiling Fans, 3- vs. 4-Prong Dryer Cords, Smart Thermostat 24V C-Wires, TV HDMI eARC + NEC In-Wall Power Code, PC GPU/DisplayPort/USB-C, and Modem/Router/MoCA Ethernet.
• 3-Tap "Outlet Not Working?" Troubleshooter: Rapid diagnostic checklist for switched outlets, hidden tripped GFCIs, and half-tripped breakers.
• Visual Cable Builder ("Connect My Gear"): Describe your TV or PC setup in plain English (powered by on-device Apple Intelligence) or tap devices manually to get a color-coded visual cable diagram and exact cable shopping list.
• Multi-Appliance Circuit Load Stacker & Label Scanner: Stack devices onto a shared 15A/20A circuit or scan appliance wattage stickers live with your camera to check NEC 80% continuous-load limits.
• Visual Matchers: Side-by-side vector shapes for US NEMA plugs, color-coded Romex (14/12/10/8/6 AWG — always read the gauge printed on the jacket; a black jacket covers both 8 AWG and 6 AWG), and confusing TV/PC ports (HDMI vs. DisplayPort vs. USB-C vs. Optical vs. RJ45).
• My Home Panel & Port Photo Maps: Map your US 2-column breaker panel, export a print-ready door PDF, pin every port behind your TV, and ask Siri which breaker controls any room.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN — NO SUBSCRIPTION
All AI features run 100% on-device with Apple Intelligence and zero tracking. Core guides and safety tools are free; unlock Pro once for $5.99 with no recurring fees.

name: HONEST ARCADE
description:
兵庫県川西市のカスタムショップ＆ハンバーガー屋「HONEST」が作った、ミニゲーム集です。
レトロなドット絵の3つのゲームが、無料で遊べます。
