name: HookSlate
description:
Dear friend,

Story premises vanish between the bus stop and the desk. HookSlate is a pocket slate for that one-line “what if” — for novelists, screenwriters, and game writers who need to catch a character tension and a conflict direction before the spark cools.

1. Capture a hook in one breath
Write a one-line premise, a tension note that names the pressure, type tags such as mystery or colony, and optional character or world remarks. The premise stays short enough to read at a glance; tags are free text you can reuse later when you search.

2. Move the idea through four stages
Fresh hooks land in Inbox. When you start shaping one, send it to Developing. Park it when it needs distance, or mark Used when the line already earned its place in a draft. Each move can take a short progress note — a sentence like “tried this as an opening” — or you can change stage without writing one.

3. Scan the board and search the library
Board groups Developing, Parked, and Used so you can see what is live versus waiting. Inbox search matches premise, tension, tags, and notes, so a half-remembered word is enough to find the hook again.

4. Browse by type
Types lists the labels you have used, with counts. Open a type to jump straight back into matching hooks instead of scrolling the whole slate.

5. Detail, edit, and clear
Open any hook to edit fields, add another progress note, change stage, or delete. About carries Getting started, Privacy, Support mail to vitalisonditi@icloud.com, and Erase library after two confirmations.

The look is paper-quiet: a soft cream wash, slate-blue actions, and stage chips that read at a glance. Secondary pages tuck the tab bar away so the editor feels like a full page. Everything works offline on this device. No account, no ads, nothing to buy. Your hook library stays on the phone.

Warmly,
HookSlate

name: HourTally: Work Hours & Pay

Paid by the hour? HourTally tracks your hours and shows what you have earned, overtime included, so you can check every paycheck. No ads, no account, no nagging.

TRACK HOURS IN SECONDS
• Tap to clock in and out, or add a shift by hand
• 12h or 24h time, overnight shifts, paid and unpaid breaks
• Automatic break deduction and time rounding (5, 6, 10 or 15 minutes), set per job
• Tips and notes on every shift
• Forgot to clock out? HourTally asks, and you pick the real end time
• Long-press the app icon to clock in or out

SEE YOUR PAY, YOUR WAY
• Totals by day, week and pay period: weekly, every two weeks, twice a month or monthly
• Regular hours, overtime and money, split clearly
• Daily and weekly overtime with your own multipliers (1.5×, 2× and more)
• Night, evening, weekend, Sunday and holiday pay
• Estimated take-home pay with your own deduction % and fixed deductions
• Pay rate history: a raise only changes shifts from the date you choose

TIMESHEETS YOU CAN SEND
• Export timesheets to PDF or CSV and email them from the share sheet
• Simple PDF invoices for freelance clients
• Import shifts from a CSV file when you switch from another app

MULTIPLE JOBS AND CLIENTS
• Each job has its own color, hourly rate and pay rules
• Calendar by day, month and year, with planned shifts and shift templates
• Weekly hours chart and yearly totals

REMINDERS AND BACKUP
• Reminders to clock in and out, plus a forgotten clock-out alert
• Your data stays on your iPhone and is included in your iCloud backup
• Export a backup file anytime and restore it on a new phone
• Available in English, Spanish, Portuguese, German, French, Japanese, Korean and Vietnamese

FREE OR PRO
Free: up to 2 jobs, unlimited shifts, pay totals, basic overtime (one daily or weekly rule at 1.5×), reminders, calendar and manual backup.
HourTally Pro adds unlimited jobs, PDF/CSV timesheet export and email, invoices, custom overtime multipliers and tiers, night, weekend and holiday pay, income stats, pay stub check, copy last week and color themes.
Pro is $19.99/year with a 7-day free trial, or $39.99 once for lifetime access.

Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. The yearly subscription renews automatically unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel it in your App Store account settings.

name: Humspan
description:
Humspan plays colored noise, a binaural beat and a slow boom for any length you choose, from a few minutes to days. Every sample is generated as it plays, so there is no recording and no loop point.

THREE LAYERS
• Noise: white, pink or brown. White is flat, pink is softer at the top, brown is deep and round. Change color mid-session without a seam.
• Binaural beat: two tones, one in each ear, 2 to 10 Hz apart. Labelled by frequency, nothing more. Use headphones for this layer.
• Boom: a low, resonant strike that alternates left and right every 8, 4 or 2 seconds.

Turn on any mix. Each layer has its own level, and every change is smoothed, so nothing clicks. A Mono switch plays the same sound in both ears, for listening with one earbud.

ANY EXACT LENGTH
Drag the dial in 5-minute steps, tap a preset (30m, 1h, 2h, 4h, 8h), or type an exact time such as 1h 37m 15s. Or choose Until I stop. The clock counts played audio, so a session ends when it says it will. A timed session fades out over its final minute and ends in true silence.

SET IT ONCE
• Play fades the sound in over 5 seconds.
• Lock Screen and Control Center controls let you stop without unlocking.
• If headphones or Bluetooth disconnect, the session pauses. Sound never moves to the speaker.
• A call lowers the sound, and the clock keeps time.
• Humspan opens with your last settings, stopped. It never plays on its own.

NO ACCOUNT, NO ADS
No sign-in, no ads and no analytics. Nothing you do in the app leaves your device.

name: Huqooqi: Gratuity Calculator

Calculate (free, works offline)

Formal letters

• Demand for unpaid wages and dues

• Request for an experience certificate
Write what happened and get a formally worded PDF, in Arabic or English.

Why Huqooqi
• Every figure and every answer comes with its article number and the date of the last amendment included in the law text.
• A reminder before your deadline to file a claim runs out.
• No sign-up and no account. Your wage figures stay on your phone.
• Arabic and English.

Free and paid
Calculators are always free, with 3 free questions. Unlimited questions and letters are available with the Huqooqi Pro monthly or yearly subscription, which renews automatically until you cancel it in your account settings, or with a one-time pack of 3 letters.

name: iBaxo
description:
iBaxo — приложение, которое помогает быстро узнать реальную цену вашего iPhone и продать его выгодно.

КАК ЭТО РАБОТАЕТ
1. Оцените. Укажите модель, объём памяти, состояние батареи, состояние экрана и корпуса, тип SIM и комплектацию. Это занимает около минуты.
2. Узнайте цену. Приложение сразу покажет ориентировочную стоимость вашего телефона по текущим ценам рынка.
3. Опубликуйте объявление. Одним нажатием отправьте оценку покупателям.
4. Получайте предложения. Проверенные магазины и покупатели присылают свои цены прямо в приложение.
5. Выберите лучшее. Примите одно предложение — откроется чат с этим покупателем, остальные получат отказ автоматически.
6. Договоритесь и завершите сделку. Обсудите детали в чате и отметьте, что телефон продан.

ПОЧЕМУ iBaxo
• Честная оценка — цена основана на актуальных рыночных ценах.
• Покупатели соревнуются за ваш телефон — вы видите предложения и сами выбираете лучшее.
• Прозрачные условия — вы видите цену заранее, а объявление можно снять в любой момент.
• Удобный чат — обсуждайте детали сделки с покупателем внутри приложения.
• История ваших предложений и чатов всегда под рукой.

ДЛЯ ПРОДАВЦОВ
Не нужно размещать объявления на досках и отвечать на десятки звонков. Один раз заполните данные о телефоне — остальное сделает iBaxo.

ДЛЯ ПОКУПАТЕЛЕЙ
Получайте доступ к оценённым устройствам с понятным описанием состояния и предлагайте свою цену.

Суммы указываются в узбекских сумах (UZS). Итоговая цена зависит от предложений покупателей и может быть выше или ниже ориентировочной оценки.

Есть вопросы? Напишите нам — мы поможем.

name: iBook Manager
description:
BookManager is a beautiful home for the e-books you already own. Point it at your folders, a network share or Google Drive, and it turns them into one cover-first library, then opens every book in a calm, built-in reader that remembers exactly where you stopped. On Mac, iPad and iPhone.

YOUR BOOKS, WHEREVER THEY LIVE
• Local folders, external disks, network (SMB) shares and iCloud Drive folders
• Google Drive folders: paste a shared folder link to read without an account, or sign in to use your own Drive
• No importing and no copying: your files stay where they are, in their folders
• Books on Google Drive download only when you open them, into a cache you control

A LIBRARY THAT LOOKS LIKE ONE
• Covers taken from inside your books (EPUB, PDF, Kindle and DjVu), and from Open Library when a file has none
• Titles, authors, descriptions, subjects and series filled in automatically from Open Library
• Continue Reading at the top, reading marks and progress on every cover
• Collections with their own background pictures, an Authors gallery, sorting, tags and filters
• Fast search across titles, authors and series, accents ignored
• Edit any book's details and cover, rate books in half stars

ONE READER FOR EVERY FORMAT
• EPUB, Kindle (MOBI, AZW3, AZW, PRC), PDF, DjVu, RTF, plain text and Palm books
• A real book page with paper, two pages side by side on wide screens, or continuous scrolling
• Fonts, text size, spacing, margins and alignment in one Aa panel
• Contents, find in the whole book, a position slider, bookmarks and Go Back after a jump
• A tall single page on iPhone and upright iPad, with the controls out of the way
• Join Broken Lines repairs scanned books whose sentences break in the middle

SHARE A LIBRARY FOLDER
• Covers, details and collections are kept in the library folder itself, so everyone and every device using that folder sees them, and nobody has to look them up again
• Folders you can only read are respected and marked with a lock

IMPORT FROM CALIBRE
• Bring a Calibre library into a BookManager folder with its titles, authors, series, tags, ratings and covers
• Copy or move, and choose what happens with books you already have

ACROSS YOUR DEVICES
• Reading positions, bookmarks, reading status, favorites and ratings sync through your own iCloud
• Books are recognised by their content, so a copy in another folder finds its place

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account with us, no ads, no tracking, no data collected
• BookManager opens only the folders you choose
• Your reading data stays in your own iCloud; book details come straight from Open Library, with no server of ours in between

BookManager is available in English, Hungarian, German, Italian, Croatian and French.
BookManager is a manager and reader for books you already have: it doesn't sell books and doesn't remove DRM. Books with DRM can't be opened.

name: iBought.Online
description:
"Which one did you get?" Now you can answer in two taps.

iBought keeps a list of the things you have bought, so you can send the exact item to a friend by text or any app on your phone.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Bring in your purchases. Sign in on Amazon's own page and iBought builds your list from your order history. You can also add a single item by pasting its link, or import the order file from Amazon's "Request Your Data" export.
2. Pick one. Search your list, open the item, and add a line on why you like it.
3. Send it. Text it, or share it through any app. Your friend gets a simple page on ibought.online with the product and a button to view it on Amazon.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
- No account. There is nothing to sign up for.
- Your purchase list is stored only on your phone. iBought keeps no copy on a server.
- You sign in on Amazon's own page. iBought never sees your password.
- A friend sees an item only when you choose to share it.
- "Delete everything" in Settings clears your list, notes and share history.

GOOD TO KNOW
- The Shared tab shows what you have sent and how often.
- You can remove any item from your list. Nothing changes on Amazon.
- iBought earns from qualifying purchases made through the "View on Amazon" button on ibought.online, as an Amazon Associate. The price is the same, and the person who shared the item receives nothing.

Amazon is a trademark of Amazon.com, Inc. or its affiliates. iBought is an independent app and is not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by Amazon.

description:

is an offline project notebook for four-shaft weavers. Plan your warp, develop your draft, and record what happens at the loom and after washing.

Plan your warp and draft
Calculate warp ends and repeats, allow for extra length, and organize your color order. Build threading and lift plans, then preview the front and back drawdowns before weaving.

Keep a record at the loom

Compare cloth samples

name: iFishy
description:
Know what to tie on.

Tap one button. iFishy checks your spot, the weather, and the water temp, then tells you the best lure or live bait to use, plus two backups.

No charts to read and no guessing. Just stand at the water and ask.

HOW IT WORKS
- Tap the fish. Use your GPS spot, or search for a lake if you're planning ahead.
- iFishy reads the water. It pulls the weather, the wind, the pressure trend, and the water temp from the closest USGS gauge.
- Tie it on. You get a top pick with color, size, depth, and how to fish it. Swipe for two backups.

MADE FOR CENTRAL FLORIDA
Version 1 covers freshwater lakes and rivers in Central Florida, roughly from Ocala down to Lake Okeechobee.

THREE FISH
Largemouth bass, black crappie (specks), and bluegill. Pick one, or let iFishy go with whatever is biting this month.

FITS HOW YOU FISH
Tell it if you fish from the bank or a boat, if you want lures or live bait, and if the water is clear or stained. Patterns you can't reach from where you are never show up.

BEST SPOTS NEAR ME
See public boat ramps and Fish Management Areas near you, grouped by lake and ranked using FWC's yearly list of top fishing spots.

SAVE WHAT WORKS
Save your favorite spots and lures, give them a star rating, and add notes. Your ratings help nudge future picks. Everything stays on your phone.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking. Your spot is rounded to about a mile before anything is sent, and nothing about you is saved anywhere but your phone.

Weather data from Apple Weather. Water data from USGS. Ramp and fishing area data from the Florida Fish and Wildlife Conservation Commission.

name: iHandyman.pro

YOUR HANDYMAN CABINET

Share your public profile with My QR code, or save a card image for printing. After its first load, your QR card remains available offline on this iPhone.

CHAT WITH YOUR WORK PARTNERS

Ilmora Guardian is the parent app for online Quran academies that run on Ilmora. Sign in with the account your academy gives you and follow your children's Quran classes from your phone.

- See each child's class schedule and watch their live classes
- Follow lesson progress and read monthly reports from teachers

name: ImmerseBreath: Calm & Sleep
description:
Most breathing apps ask you to count. ImmerseBreath asks you to watch.

A whole world fills your screen and breathes with you: it swells as you breathe in, hangs while you hold, and releases as you breathe out. You never count a second or read a number. You just follow the light, and your breathing follows it.

Twelve worlds, six moods, a calm recorded voice, soft chimes and gentle haptics. No account, no sign-in and nothing to set up. Pick one, press Begin, and the rest takes care of itself.


TWELVE WORLDS THAT BREATHE

• Lumen: a living orb of liquid light
• Bloom: sacred geometry, unfolding petal by petal
• Tide: a moonlit sea that swells with you
• Aurora: northern lights that rise with your breath
• Cosmos: a galaxy expanding in your hands
• Stillwater: rings of light on midnight water
• Eclipse: a corona breathing around the dark
• Fireflies: a drifting field of living lights
• Canopy: sunbeams breathing through the leaves
• Horizon: a sun that rises with every breath
• Incense: a silk ribbon of smoke, rising
• Crystal: a crystal unfolding in perfect symmetry

Every world is drawn live on your device, edge to edge, and moves smoothly at your screen's full refresh rate. Switching worlds never changes the breathing, only the place it happens in.


SIX MOODS

Recolour any world to match how you feel: Serene, Ocean, Dawn, Violet, Forest or Ember.


GUIDED YOUR WAY

• Calm: even five-second waves to steady a busy mind
• Box: four equal sides, in, hold, out, hold
• 4·7·8: the classic long exhale
• A calm recorded voice names each phase, softly and only when you want it
• Soft chimes mark every change of phase
• Gentle haptics follow the breath on iPhone
• Sessions of 1, 2, 3, 5 or 10 minutes, and every one finishes on a whole breath
• Keeps guiding with the screen locked, and makes way for your music and podcasts instead of stopping them


YOUR JOURNEY

Your streak, your best streak, your sessions and your minutes, with the last seven days laid out at a glance and every session listed below. No targets, no badges and no nagging.


PRIVATE BY CONSTRUCTION

No account. No analytics. No servers of ours. Your sessions and settings stay on your device and, if you want, follow you to your own iPhone and iPad through your private iCloud. We couldn't read them if we wanted to.


FREE, AND ONE OPTIONAL UPGRADE

ImmerseBreath is free, with an ad on the home screen and never one during a session. Three worlds, the Serene mood, three patterns, the voice, the chimes and the haptics are all included.

IMMERSEBREATH PRO is a single one-time purchase, with no subscription and nothing to cancel:

• The other nine worlds
• Five more moods
• Four more patterns: Unwind, Deep Flow, Energize and Recover
• Your own rhythms, built from your own timings
• No ads

name: ImPoopingToo
description:
Poop time? Swap the doom scroll for a quick game.

ImPoopingToo turns your bathroom break into ten minutes of quick, silly games against another pooper, so you can put the endless scrolling down and play instead. Pick a game, get matched, and play it again and again until the timer runs out. Whoever wins the most games wins the session.

HOW IT WORKS
- Pick one of eight quick games: Nards & Crosses, Drop Four, Plunger Pairs, Pile of Five, Stall Wars, Flip the Turds, Corn Pit or Sewer Search.
- We match you with someone else who's on right now and you play your game again and again for 10 minutes. Win the most games to win the session.
- Say "good game" with a ready-made reaction, ask for a rematch, log how it went, or get on with your day.
- No one on? A computer pooper joins so you can always play.

PROPERLY ANONYMOUS
- No name, no email, no phone number. The app makes up a silly name for you.
- Nothing to type. No chat, no photos, no links. Just a few fixed messages and pictures to react with.
- Delete your account from inside the app whenever you like.

KEEP TRACK OF YOUR GUT HEALTH (IF YOU WANT TO)
- The games are the point. The poop log is there if you want it: tap the cartoon that looks closest from seven types, check the colour and tick anything worth noting. It takes about ten seconds.
- Spot patterns in your bowel and gut health over time. If something keeps showing up, the app nudges you to mention it to a doctor.
- Private by design: your log stays on your phone and we never see it.

FREE TO PLAY
- Your first session each day is free. After that, each session takes one short video ad.

IMPORTANT
- For ages 16 and over.
- ImPoopingToo is for entertainment and general wellbeing. It is not medical advice and does not diagnose anything. If you are worried about your health, speak to a doctor. In an emergency, call your local emergency number.

Put the scroll down. Play a quick one.

name: Imposter Deck: Spy Party Game
description:
Everyone gets the secret word. Except the imposter. Can your group spot who's faking it before they blend in?

Imposter Deck is a party game for game nights, family visits and holiday get-togethers. Pass one phone around, hold to reveal your card, give a clue and vote. It works fully offline, needs no account and is ready in seconds.

HOW TO PLAY
• Everyone looks at their card in secret. The crew sees the secret word, the imposter only sees the category.
• Take turns giving a short clue about the word.
• Talk it over, then vote for the player you think is faking.
• Reveal: if the crew catches the imposter, the imposter still gets a last chance to guess the word and steal the round.

MODES
• Classic: the imposter gets no word and has to bluff.
• Decoy word: the imposter gets a close but different word and doesn't even know they're the imposter.
• Quick round: shorter rounds when the group wants to keep the energy up.
• More imposters: add extra imposters for bigger groups.
• Last chance: a caught imposter can still win by naming the secret word.

MADE FOR THE TABLE
• Hold to reveal: your card only shows while you hold it, so nobody can peek.
• Saved groups: keep your regular crew together with their score history.
• No repeats: words you've already played are remembered, so they don't come back.
• Night summary: wrap up the evening with a summary card you can share.

DECKS
• Decks written in English, not translated.
• Seasonal decks for Christmas and New Year.
• Your own word list: add inside jokes, nicknames and topics only your group knows.
• Also playable in Spanish, German and French, each with its own decks written in that language for players in Mexico, Argentina, Germany and France.

Playing apart? Open an online room and friends join from their browser with a link or QR code, no app download needed.

FULL DECK
The core game is free to play. Full Deck unlocks every deck and mode, unlimited custom lists and removes ads. It's a one-time purchase, not a subscription.

No account, no sign-up. Grab your friends and start a round.

name: Inaris CRM
description:
Inaris CRM reúne la gestión de contactos, proyectos y seguimientos de INARIS en tu iPhone.

Consulta las fichas de tus contactos, organiza los seguimientos por estado, revisa la agenda y trabaja con las plantillas y documentos disponibles para tu usuario. Accede a las acciones de llamada, WhatsApp, correo y dirección desde cada contacto.

La aplicación incluye herramientas del iPhone para descargar, consultar y compartir documentos, y escanear documentos con la cámara. Los archivos descargados o escaneados se guardan en el dispositivo y puedes adjuntarlos al CRM cuando lo necesites.

Elige el diseño clásico, claro u oscuro. El icono de la aplicación acompaña la versión seleccionada: beige en clásico y claro, azul en oscuro.

La descarga es gratuita. Para acceder a la información del CRM necesitas una cuenta autorizada de INARIS y conexión a internet. Las secciones y operaciones disponibles dependen de los permisos de cada usuario.

name: InfiniCard
description:
Turn your notes, documents, and photos into a presentation you can play or share as a link.

Tell InfiniCard what you want to explain and who will see it. It builds a sequence of animated scenes from your material. Read through the card, ask for edits in the conversation, and play it back with captions or narration.

Explore the sample cards without an account. Sign in to create and save your own cards. Creating and revising cards uses credits, available through in-app purchases.

For support, email support@infinimesh.cn.

name: Infinite Idle Shooter
description:
Hold to fire, break through the wall, and see what’s behind it.

Infinite Idle Shooter is an incremental arcade game built around a simple loop. Keep firing, break through to the next wall, and upgrade your loadout as you go.

Progress saves between sessions, so you can pick up where you left off and see how far you can get.

name: Inkbound Spear
description:
Master the reach of a spear in Inkbound Spear, a wuxia action game drawn in ink wash. Read a windup, deflect at the last moment, and answer with a precisely placed thrust.

Learn the Dragon, Swallow, and Mountain forms. Link launchers, aerial pursuits, and heavy landings. Charge an Ink Wave to strike at range. Land hits and deflect attacks to build Spear Intent, then use a spear art to unleash a faster strike that reaches farther.

Follow The Death Manual through six chapters, then test your build in Jianghu Trials. Pick routes and collect Inscriptions in Jianghu Journey, face three bosses in the Masters' Gauntlet, or see how far you can go in the Endless Trial. Knock the front line into its allies to break formations. When Bell Break appears, lure enemies into range, ring the bronze bell, and get clear before the shockwave.

Practice against different opponents in Training. Play the single-player adventure offline, or face a friend in Local Duel on two devices connected to the same Wi-Fi network.

name: Inkdot: Dot Art Photo Editor
description:
Inkdot turns your photos into dot art: stipple ink prints made of thousands of tiny dots on paper, like a hand-pulled print or a pen-and-ink drawing. From photo to drawing in seconds.

Pick a photo and Inkdot finds the subject, reads the light and the depth, and places every dot for you. Get pointillism, halftone, etching and engraving looks in one tap, then make the print your own.

LOOKS
• 10 built-in looks: Sumi black ink, Prussian blue, Vermilion, Hanko, Night, Haze, Etching, Engraving and two- and three-colour Press prints
• Every look previewed before you pick it

MAKE IT YOURS
• Contrast, number of dots and dot size
• Subject modes: cut the subject out, focus on it, or keep the whole scene
• Ink and paper in any colour, with a full colour wheel
• Depth haze and tap-to-focus for a sense of distance
• Your own seal stamped on the print
• Undo and redo for every change

PRINT IT FOR REAL
• High-resolution PNG for wall art, posters and prints
• Paper sizes and DPI for printing at home or at a print shop
• SVG and PDF for pen plotters, laser engraving and design work
• Colour separations, one plate per ink, for screen printing
• Transparent backgrounds

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Everything runs on your phone. Your photos are never uploaded
• No account and no sign-up

INKDOT PRO
The free version includes every look and the core controls. Inkdot Pro unlocks every control, custom colours, the depth tools, the seal, and every export without the small Inkdot mark. Choose Lifetime (pay once), Annual or Weekly.

Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase, and renewals are charged within 24 hours before the period ends. You can manage or cancel subscriptions in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Use: https://inkdotapp.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://inkdotapp.com/privacy

name: Inkfitter
description:
Inkfitter finds the ink or toner your printer needs. Point the camera at the model label, and get the cartridge numbers in seconds.

HOW IT WORKS
• Scan: point the camera at the model label on your printer. Inkfitter reads it on your device. No label handy? Take a photo, or type the model.
• Popular printers: pick one of 20 common home and office models in one tap, with no waiting.
• Get your numbers: original cartridges, ink bottles, toner, drum units and maintenance boxes for your printer, in standard and XL sizes where they exist, with an approximate page yield.

MORE THAN A PART NUMBER
• Compatibility warnings: for example, printers that only accept original cartridges, starter cartridges that come in the box, and region-locked models.
• XL or standard? Tell Inkfitter how much you print and see how many months each size lasts.
• Reminders: get a local notification when ink may run low. It is an estimate, and notifications are asked only when you turn a reminder on.
• Your shelf: save your printers, label them Home or Office, and reorder in one tap. Saved printers open instantly, even offline.
• Share a list of supply numbers with a friend or a colleague.

FREE AND PRIVATE
• No account, no subscription, no ads.
• Label text, typed models and photos are used only to look up your printer. We do not store them.
• You choose where to buy: each supply opens a regular Amazon search in your browser.

GOOD TO KNOW
• Part numbers suggested by AI should be checked against the number on your old cartridge before buying. Page yields are approximate.
• Looking up a printer outside the popular list uses AI, with a limit of 10 lookups per day. Popular printers and your saved shelf have no limit.
• Works with many HP, Canon, Epson and Brother printers, and some other brands.

Inkfitter is not affiliated with HP, Canon, Epson or Brother. Brand names are used only to identify compatible products.

As an Amazon Associate we earn from qualifying purchases, which keeps the app free.

name: Inner Disc
description:
Inner Disc is a first chart for Russian consonants. Twenty-three consonants are on the primer. Open one and drag the tooth on its ring to the right. Each drag shows a hard syllable in the left window and the soft partner in the right window: А with Я, О with Ё, У with Ю, Э with Е, and Ы with И. When all five pairs have been read, press and hold the center pin. The disc is kept on this iPhone, with how many discs are pinned, how many pairs were read, and how many consonants are still waiting. Open the kept list to see that disc again.

The letters, example words, and Latin readings are in the app. Nothing is downloaded, and there is no account. The result stays on this iPhone for the next time you open it.

name: Inspector Nakamura: Antarctica
description:
A body on the ice. Six guests with secrets. Seven days before the trail goes cold.

Lady Vivienne Carfax has been murdered at a remote Antarctic adventure camp, and the six guests who shared her expedition are all hiding something. One of them is a killer. You are Inspector Nakamura — sharp, patient, and impossible to fool for long. Nobody goes home until you name the murderer, the weapon, and the motive.

Inspector Nakamura in Antarctica is a digital mystery board game. The camp is your board: move across an illustrated map of glass domes, sleeping pods, and frozen trails, track where every guest goes, and choose where to spend each precious hour.

EVERY CASE IS DIFFERENT
Each new game deals a fresh crime. The killer, the weapon, the motive, the alibis, and the web of rumors between guests are generated anew, so you can never just memorize the answer. Every playthrough is a new case to crack.

QUESTION EVERYONE. TRUST NO ONE.
Corner guests on the ice wall, in the rec room, or across the table at dinner. Choose your approach — friendly, suggestive, or aggressive — and watch their trust in you rise or fall. Push too hard and they clam up. Earn their confidence and they’ll tell you where they really were, who they saw, and what they whisper about the others.

But remember: the murderer lies. About everything.

FOLLOW THE EVIDENCE
A pickaxe, a knife, a wrench, a crampon, a shovel — weapons are hidden across thirteen locations, and more than one is stained with blood. Bring them back to your tent and let Dex, your robotic companion, analyze fingerprints and blood, or search online for gossip about the victim’s relationships. But the camp’s internet link is weak, so every search and every analysis costs you time.

THINK LIKE A DETECTIVE
Your journal records every alibi, every witness, every relationship and every rumor you uncover. Cross-check stories. Catch the contradictions. When two honest guests agree on a fact and one suspect says otherwise, you’ll know where to look.

MAKE THE ACCUSATION
Days are split into meals and activities, and the clock never stops. When you’re ready, gather everyone in the dining room and name the murderer, the weapon, and the motive. Accuse the wrong guest and the real killer gets more time. Accuse too many and the case is lost forever.

FEATURES
• A fresh, logically consistent murder mystery generated every game
• Six distinctive suspects with their own voices, secrets, and relationships
• Interrogations shaped by your tone and each guest’s trust in you
• Thirteen locations, from ice climbing and fat biking to the library and the lounge
• Physical evidence, fingerprint and blood analysis, and limited investigation time
• An automatic detective’s journal that keeps your clues organized
• Richly illustrated scenes, an atmospheric soundtrack, and no ads
• Play at your own pace — perfect for fans of whodunits, deduction puzzles, and board games

Pour a hot drink, pull on your coat, and step out into the cold. The truth is out there on the ice — if you’re clever enough to find it.

name: Intag
description:
Intag بيوصّل أصحاب البراندات بمصانع الملابس والمطابع وموردين القماش والاكسسوارات وتجار الملابس الجاهزة بالجملة في مصر.

اكتب طلبك مرة واحدة، وهتوصلك عروض أسعار من اللي بيقدّموا المنتج أو الخدمة. قارن بينهم واختار الأنسب لبراندك.

- تشوف العروض وتقارنها ببلاش، من غير اشتراك ولا عمولة.
- رقمك بيظهر بس للمصنع اللي تختاره.
- تقييمات من أصحاب براندات اشتغلوا مع المصنع.
- أدلة للمبتدئين: اعرف قماشك، اعرف الطباعة، ودليل أسعار التصنيع.

عندك مصنع أو مطبعة أو محل قماش أو اكسسوارات أو مكتب جملة ملابس؟ سجّل نشاطك ببلاش وتوصلك طلبات أصحاب البراندات.

name: InterFreight Solutions
description:
**InterFreight Solutions – Your Cargo, Our Priority.**

Stay connected to your cargo with the official InterFreight Solutions app, your convenient platform for tracking shipments, accessing reports, and staying informed throughout the shipping process.

Designed for businesses and individuals importing goods, our app provides easy access to essential freight information, helping you stay organized to plan ahead.

**KEY FEATURES**

**Shipment Tracking**
Monitor your shipments and follow their progress through different stages of transportation, from origin to destination.

**Shipment Status Updates**
Stay informed with the latest available shipment statuses, including ocean transit, port arrival, inland transportation, and delivery progress.

**Customer Dashboard**
Access your shipments and important freight information in one convenient, easy-to-use dashboard.

**Shipment Reports**
View shipment reports and relevant information to support better planning and logistics coordination.

**Notifications & Announcements**
Receive important shipment updates, notifications, and company announcements.

**Secure Account Access**
Sign in securely to view shipment information associated with your account.

**ABOUT INTERFREIGHT SOLUTIONS**

InterFreight Solutions is a Malawi-based freight clearing and forwarding company providing reliable logistics solutions for businesses and individuals.

Our services include:

- Ocean Freight – Full Container Load (FCL) and Less than Container Load (LCL)
- Road Freight – Regional and cross-border transportation
- Air Freight – Solutions for time-sensitive cargo
- Customs Clearance – Import and export customs services
- Warehousing – Storage and cargo handling solutions
- Weekly Consolidation – Regular shipments from South Africa to Malawi
- Import & Export Consultation – Professional freight and documentation assistance

**YOUR CARGO, OUR PRIORITY.**

At InterFreight Solutions, we believe that staying informed is an essential part of efficient logistics. Our app brings your shipment information together, helping you stay connected to your cargo wherever you are.

Visit us at [www.interfreightsolutions.com](http://www.interfreightsolutions.com)

name: Interserver
description:
Interserver is the Intervalens app for opening the apps we run for our team and our customers.

Sign in once, and Interserver shows every app you have access to:
• Colleagues sign in with their Intervalens Microsoft account.
• Customers sign in with a one-time code sent to their email, and see only the apps shared with them.

Tap an app to open it full screen, and swipe from the left edge to go back to your apps. Face ID, Touch ID or your passcode keeps you signed in.

Interserver is for Intervalens' colleagues and customers: you need an Intervalens account or an invitation from Intervalens to use it.

name: InventWise: Inventory Count
description:
InventWise is the field app of the InventWise inventory counting and audit platform. Counters use it on iPhone to record stock counts in the warehouse or the store, even where there is no network coverage.

Please note: InventWise is a tool for businesses. You need an account created by your company's administrator in the InventWise web console; accounts cannot be created in the app. If your company does not use InventWise, the app has nothing to show you.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• See the counting assignments your supervisor gave you, by warehouse and location.
• Scan barcodes with the camera or with a Bluetooth scanner in keyboard mode, or type a code by hand.
• Read GS1 barcodes, including DataMatrix codes that carry the GTIN, batch number, expiry date and serial number.
• Enter quantities on a large keypad and choose the unit (for example piece, pack or carton); the app converts to the base unit as you type.
• Record the batch, expiry date and serial number when a product requires them.
• Start and finish each location, and see the items of your assignment you have not counted yet.
• Carry out recount assignments for the items your supervisor selects.
• Hear a short tone and feel a vibration on every scan, save or error.

BUILT FOR WORK WITHOUT COVERAGE
• Counts are saved on the device first and sent automatically when the connection returns.
• Nothing is lost if the app closes: unsent counts stay on the device until the server confirms them, and the app reopens at the location where you stopped.
• The "Entries on this device" screen lists every entry that is waiting and why.

BLIND COUNTING
When your company runs a blind count, the app does not show expected quantities, so every count stays independent.

SECURITY
• Sign-in with your e-mail and password, plus two-step verification when your account uses it.
• The database on the device is encrypted, and the sign-in token is kept in the iOS Keychain.
• All communication with the server uses HTTPS.
• Your administrator can block a lost device; its unsent counts stay on the device.

ARABIC AND ENGLISH
The app opens in Arabic with a right-to-left layout; English is one tap away.

PRIVACY
The camera is used only to read barcodes on the device: no photos or videos are saved or sent. The app shows no ads, does not track you and contains no advertising or analytics SDK of its own. Privacy policy: https://inventwise.app/privacy

name: IOU Lite
description: Explain how IOU Lite helps users record debts, set payment reminders, and generate legally binding digital contract agreements (including digital signature support and email verification). Also, mention built-in security features like Firebase integration and secure login.

name: iQ List: Live Cue Monitor
description:
iQ List is the companion app for iQ Pro. It puts your live cue list on a second iPhone or iPad, so the stage manager, the booth or an assistant in the wings can see what's playing and what's next without looking over your shoulder. Allow it in iQ Pro, and it becomes a wireless remote too.

Requires iQ Pro running on another iPhone or iPad on the same Wi-Fi network. iQ List does not work on its own.

SEE THE WHOLE SHOW AT A GLANCE
• Your show's cues in order and numbered, updating live as iQ Pro performs
• The cue that's playing is highlighted, with a progress bar and the time remaining
• The next cue is marked, so everyone knows what's coming
• Delayed and looping cues are marked, and transitions such as Crossfade or Cut sit between the cues they join
• A clock counts down the time left in the show
• The list scrolls itself to follow the current cue

RUN THE SHOW FROM ANOTHER DEVICE
Turn on Allow playback control for a device in iQ Pro, and iQ List shows Pause, Cue and Stop, plus buttons to skip back or forward 15 or 30 seconds. They work exactly like the same buttons in iQ Pro. Turn it off again and the device goes back to watch-only.

WATCH-ONLY UNTIL YOU SAY SO
A newly paired iQ List can only watch. Nobody can change your show unless you allow it on the iQ Pro device, and you can remove a paired device at any time.

PAIR ONCE, NO ACCOUNT
• Connects over your local Wi-Fi network, with no cables, no sign-in and no internet connection needed
• Open iQ List and it finds iQ Pro by itself, with the pairing steps on screen. Pair it once from Paired Devices in iQ Pro's Settings, and give it a name such as "Stage Manager iPad"
• Reconnects by itself if the network drops
• A green or orange Wi-Fi symbol shows whether you're connected

BUILT FOR BACKSTAGE
• A dark screen that won't light up the wings
• Portrait or landscape: turn the device sideways and the controls move beside the list
• Larger cue titles on iPad, ideal as a confidence monitor at the side of the stage
• Pair as many iPhones and iPads as your crew needs

FOR
Theatre and stage managers, event and conference crews, churches, schools and anyone who runs a show in iQ Pro and wants a second pair of eyes on the cue list.

PRIVACY
iQ List sends only your device's name to the iQ Pro device you pair with, over your local network. There's no account, no tracking and no data sent to us.

name: IseseMind
description:
O IseseMind é uma ferramenta de estudo e memorização dos Odu Ifá, feita para quem aprende em uma casa de Ifá e quer manter o estudo em dia entre uma aula e outra.

O app organiza o que você estuda e ajuda a lembrar: mostra o que revisar hoje, o seu progresso e o seu ritmo. Ele ensina técnicas de memorização, mas não ensina Ifá no lugar da sua casa, do seu professor ou do seu sacerdote.

O QUE VOCÊ ENCONTRA NO APP

• Biblioteca de Odu: leia o texto, o verso, o significado e exemplos práticos de cada Odu; busque pelo nome e filtre pela sua situação de estudo (não estudado, estudando ou memorizado).
• Sessões de estudo: flashcards, perguntas de múltipla escolha, completar a frase, arrastar palavras e colocar frases na ordem.
• Revisão espaçada: o app calcula o melhor dia para rever cada Odu, de acordo com o seu desempenho, e avisa quando um conteúdo está para ser esquecido.
• Caminho Ifá e Caminhos de aprendizado: estude em fases e escolha por onde começar.
• Técnicas de memorização: repetição espaçada, flashcards ativos, codificação elaborativa, mnemônicos e Palácio da Memória.
• Palácio da Memória: guarde cada Odu em um lugar imaginado, com anotações visuais suas.
• Notas pessoais e mnemônicos: escreva as suas próprias associações em cada Odu. Também há sugestões de mnemônicos geradas por inteligência artificial, que você escolhe se quer usar.
• Biblioteca Yorùbá: conteúdos do curso organizados por tipo.
• Áudio de pronúncia, quando disponível.
• Painel de progresso: dias seguidos, pontos de estudo, domínio médio, próximas revisões e conquistas.
• Plano e calendário de estudos: informe os seus horários e receba uma sugestão de cronograma feita por inteligência artificial.
• Lembrete diário de estudo no próprio aparelho, no horário que você escolher. É opcional e funciona sem enviar nada para servidores.
• Letra normal ou grande, tema claro ou escuro e painel personalizável.

CONTEÚDO GRATUITO E CONTA

Alguns Odu podem ser estudados gratuitamente, para você conhecer o app. Se você já tem acesso completo ao IseseMind pela sua conta, basta entrar com o mesmo e-mail e a mesma senha para continuar de onde parou. O app não vende nada e não tem anúncios.

SUA PRIVACIDADE

Não usamos anúncios, não rastreamos você entre apps e sites e não usamos ferramentas de análise de publicidade. Você pode excluir a sua conta e os seus dados de estudo dentro do app, no Perfil.

PARA QUEM É

O IseseMind é para adultos (maiores de 18 anos). Os textos tratam de uma tradição religiosa e podem conter temas como morte, violência e relações adultas, apresentados como aparecem na tradição, sem suavizar.

AVISO IMPORTANTE

O IseseMind é um apoio ao estudo e à memorização. Não faz consulta, não faz adivinhação, não promete cura nem resultado e não substitui o ensino da casa (ilé) do aluno. Cada casa e cada linhagem têm as suas próprias formas de ensinar; o app não se apresenta como a única forma correta.

Feito pelo Ilé Àṣẹ Ifátókùn.

name: IT Genesis Insight
description:
IT Genesis Insight helps business teams understand email conversations and keep customer follow-up organized. Sign in with the Insight account provided by your organization to access your workspace on iPhone and iPad.

A CLEARER VIEW OF YOUR MAILBOX

View incoming and sent email activity, reply performance and conversations that need attention. Filter your workspace by mailbox and period.

CONVERSATIONS AND NEXT ACTIONS

Review conversation summaries, reply and task status, suggested next steps and supporting email context. AI analysis is available when configured by your organization and requires data-sharing acceptance. Review AI results before acting.

URGENT MAIL NOTIFICATIONS

Choose mailboxes and keywords for incoming-mail alerts. Manage notification sounds and permissions on your device. Delivery and sound depend on your device settings and connection.

SECURITY REVIEW

Review suspicious email indicators and supporting evidence. Insight supports human review and does not replace email security software.

BUILT FOR BUSINESS WORKSPACES

Insight connects to authorized Microsoft 365 and Google mailboxes. Mailbox connections use read permissions; Insight does not send replies on your behalf. Access and available features depend on your organization’s configuration.

An existing IT Genesis Insight workspace account is required. The interface and AI summaries are currently in English.

name: IT Genesis Manager
description:
IT Genesis Manager gives authorized company managers a cloud workspace for viewing their organization’s devices on iPhone, iPad and Mac.

Find devices by employee name, company or computer name. Access follows your organization’s account and group permissions.

Choose devices, adjust the grid, and save favorite workspaces. Open a screen for a larger view and request Standard or HD quality from compatible agents. Live viewing requires an online remote device and internet connectivity.

Sign in with your existing Endpoint account and configured multifactor authentication. Saved sessions use Apple Keychain. Screens pause when the app leaves the foreground. Screenshot sharing is available only when permitted by your organization.

This is a view-only companion for IT Genesis Endpoint. It does not monitor the iPhone, iPad or Mac on which it is installed. Local network viewing and remote keyboard or mouse control are not included.

An existing Endpoint workspace and authorized account are required for live devices. A clearly labeled fictional demo workspace is available without signing in.

name: Iwigá – Your Aura of the Day
description:
Discover the color of your aura today.

Iwigá reads your pulse with your phone's camera, takes your selfie into account and creates an animated aura with its own color, name and a phrase for your day. In seconds, with no sign-up.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Rest your finger on the camera and measure your pulse in 20 seconds.
2. Take a selfie: the app draws your aura around you.
3. Get your aura: color, name and phrase of the day.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Discover your aura of the day, which changes with you.
• Share your aura as an image with your friends.
• Compare your aura with someone else's and see how compatible you are.
• Follow your readings in the history and keep your daily streak going.
• See how everything works in the "How does it work?" section.

EVERYTHING ON YOUR PHONE
Your pulse and your photo are processed on your device. You don't need to create an account.

IMPORTANT
Iwigá is an entertainment app. It is not a medical device and does not diagnose, treat or prevent any disease. Pulse readings are approximate and do not replace the advice of a health professional. If you have concerns about your health, talk to your doctor.

Download it and find out what color your aura is today.

Free to use: reading, selfie, compatibility and streak with no limits. With the one-time purchase "Iwigá Complete" (single payment, no subscription) you share without the watermark and see your full history.

name: Jabistry
description:
Make time to move with Jabistry, a rhythm boxing game built for quick exercise breaks.

Play a song in your favorite music app, tap along to sync the rhythm, and step back into your stance. Match your punches to the colored targets, duck beneath red bars, and watch your hits raise the sun toward a rainbow over the lake.

YOUR MUSIC, YOUR WORKOUT
Use your own music and tap to set the rhythm. Choose your round length and target frequency for the time you have available.

JAB, UPPERCUT AND DUCK
Your iPhone’s front camera follows your movements. Hit regular targets with inward jabs, reach high targets with uppercuts, and stay low as red bars pass.

MAKE IT YOURS
Choose glove colors and arm appearance. Track your accuracy and best combo, and enjoy optional sun and rainbow rewards over a sunset lakeshore.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Camera frames are processed on your iPhone. Jabistry never displays, records, uploads or logs camera imagery. No microphone or music-library access is required.

TRY IT FREE
Download free and activate a 24-hour trial of all gameplay. After the trial, a one-time in-app purchase is required to continue playing. There is no subscription or automatic charge after the trial.

Developed by Justin Marcus, MD, a board-certified neurologist who wanted a way to get some quick exercise between patients.

You’ll need room to move and a stable upright place for your iPhone. Keep both shoulders, elbows and wrists visible to the front camera. Tracking depends on lighting and positioning.

name: Jadewell: Mahjong Tiles
description:
Jadewell is calm, classic mahjong solitaire on soft, puffy clay tiles. Tap two matching free tiles to clear them, and keep going until the board is empty. Every deal is guaranteed solvable, so you are never stuck with an impossible board.

HAND-BUILT BOARDS
• Start with the Classics: Pyramid, Turtle, Fortress and Bridge
• Unlock Creatures (Crab, Dragon, Butterfly, Cat) and Wonders (Spiral, Temple, Arena, Tower)
• Every layout is shaped by hand, and every deal can be cleared

EARN EVERY STAR
• Clear a board faster than par for all three stars
• Stuck? A gentle hint shows a pair you can match
• Undo any move, or shuffle what is left into a new solvable order

A FRESH DAILY BOARD
• The same deal for every player, every day
• Clear it day after day to grow your streak
• Race your friends on daily, weekly and friends leaderboards

TRACK YOUR PROGRESS
• Games played, boards cleared, tiles matched and your best times
• Your last seven days at a glance

MAKE IT YOURS
• Light or dark theme
• Small, medium or large tile faces
• Haptics, and a reduce-motion setting for a calmer board

PLAY YOUR WAY
• Start instantly as a guest, no sign-up needed
• Sign in with Apple, Google or email to keep your name, friends and leaderboard results
• Free to play with ads. An optional one-time Remove ads purchase turns off the ads between boards; reward videos you choose to watch stay available
• Made for iPhone and iPad

Privacy Policy: https://legal.pranta.dev/jadewell/privacy
Terms of Use: https://legal.pranta.dev/jadewell/terms

name: JalinKata
description: Build Bahasa Malaysia words on a shared board in Jalin Kata. Place letter tiles, connect words, and make the most of premium squares. Play against a computer opponent or share one device with a friend.

name: Jalo for Cleaning Teams
description:
Jalo is the team app for cleaning companies that run on Jalo. Crews, dispatchers and owners use it to get through the day: see the jobs, check in, follow the checklist, take photos and keep every crew on track.

You need a Jalo account from your cleaning company to sign in. Your company adds you, and you sign in with your work email.

FOR CREWS
• Today: every cleaning, time and address for your day, in order.
• Everything for the job: how to get in, notes from the customer, the checklist and who to call.
• Check in and out with one tap. Jalo reads your location only at that moment, so your office knows you arrived. Never in the background.
• Checklist and photos: tick off each task and take before and after photos.
• Door and alarm codes show only while you're checked in, and they're gone from your phone when you check out.
• Next 14 days: see what's coming up.
• Time off: ask for days off and see the answer.

FOR DISPATCHERS AND OWNERS
• Live: see every crew at a glance: on the way, cleaning, done, late or checked in far from the home.
• Schedule: plan the week, move a cleaning, and the crew gets it right away.
• Bookings: find any booking and see its details.
• Approve time off and see who's free.

BUILT FOR CLEANING TEAMS
• In English and Spanish: each person picks their own language.
• Notifications for new jobs, changes and cancellations.
• Sign in with your work email and a code, plus 2-step sign-in to keep your company's data safe.
• Works with a weak signal: check-ins are saved on your phone and sent when you're back online.

Questions? Visit getjalo.com/help or write to support@getjalo.com.

name: Jeb's Mechanic Helper
description:
Jeb's Mechanic is the shop-floor app for the people who maintain aircraft: AMEs in Canada, A&P and IA mechanics in the US, and EASA Part-66 certifying staff. It works offline, keeps your data on your device, and never needs an account.

WORK ORDERS AND TASK CARDS
Open a work order for each aircraft on your floor. Every task card holds the discrepancy, the corrective action, the reference data, parts with P/N, S/N and release document, and labour. Sign off from your profile, record the independent inspection by a second person, and close the work order only when everything is signed. Export a PDF for the customer (Pro).

LOGBOOK ENTRIES THAT HAVE EVERYTHING
Write maintenance, inspection, AD and repair entries with the right elements and wording for the FAA (14 CFR 43.9 and 43.11), Transport Canada (CAR 571.10 maintenance release) or EASA (Part-ML certificate of release to service). A checklist shows what is still missing before you sign. Signed entries lock; corrections are new entries.

APPLE INTELLIGENCE, ON YOUR DEVICE
Type or dictate shop notes and let Apple Intelligence fill the entry fields. Paste an AD's applicability paragraph and get a first read against the aircraft model and serial. Turn a quick note into a discrepancy write-up with ATA chapter and suggested severity. Everything runs on the device; nothing is sent to a server. Every draft is marked for your review, and the certification wording comes from the regulations, not the model. Without Apple Intelligence, built-in rules do the same job.

AD TRACKER
Record applicability, method of compliance and recurring intervals by hours and months, whichever comes first. See what is due soon or overdue, write the compliance entry, and open the AD on the FAA DRS, Transport Canada CAWIS or the EASA Safety Publications Tool.

INSPECTIONS
Run the 14 CFR 43 Appendix D annual and 100-hour checklist, a Canadian maintenance schedule checklist, or a pre-close-up and FOD check. Findings become the discrepancy list and the inspection entry.

CALCULATORS AND REFERENCE
Torque wrench setting with an extension at any angle, unit conversions, bend allowance and setback, rivet sizing, weight and balance after an equipment change with the record text, an FAA Form 337 block 8 helper, and safety wire, cotter pin and self-locking nut practice.

TOOLS, PARTS AND YOUR EXPERIENCE LOG
Track calibration dates for torque wrenches and test equipment, and parts stock with release documents and shelf life. Log every task for your licence experience record by ATA chapter and category, then export CSV or PDF for your AME, Part-66 or FAA application (Pro).

SIRI, SHORTCUTS AND SPOTLIGHT
"Log time on C-GJEB in Jeb's Mechanic." Read data plates and part labels with the camera. Find any aircraft, work order, AD or part from Spotlight.

JEB'S MECHANIC PRO
Unlimited work orders, aircraft, ADs, tools and parts, Apple Intelligence features, and PDF and CSV exports. Monthly, yearly with a 7-day free trial, or lifetime. Free: calculators, references, checklists, the experience log, entry templates and up to 3 open work orders.

Jeb's Mechanic is a record-keeping aid. It does not replace the regulations, the manufacturer's data or your judgement, and it does not approve anything for return to service.

Privacy Policy: https://www.orchaerospace.com/privacy

name: Jewel Grove: Block Puzzle
description: Drop glittering jewel blocks and watch full rows and columns disappear. Unwind in 8×8 or 10×10 Classic, race the clock in Timed, or clear ticking bombs before their moves run out. Play offline and chase a personal best in all four modes.

name: jild
description:
jild is a messenger for small businesses: one place where your team talks to each other and to your customers.

FOR YOUR TEAM
• Create your company in a minute and invite staff with one link. No accounts to set up by hand.
• Group chats for departments and projects, direct messages, and Saved messages for your own notes.
• Send text, photos, videos, files and voice messages. Reply, mention colleagues, edit your messages and delete them for everyone.
• Works on a weak connection: messages you send offline are shown at once and delivered when the network is back.

FOR YOUR CUSTOMERS
• Give a customer a client link and talk to them in a separate client chat. They can join from the app or straight from a web browser.
• A client sees only their own chat with your company, never your internal conversations.

FOR THE OWNER
• See who is in the company, add and remove people, and manage invite links.
• Sign out other devices and control notifications from Settings.
• Delete your account in the app at any time (Settings > Delete account).

GOOD TO KNOW
• You sign in with your phone number and a one-time code.
• The interface is available in English, Uzbek and Russian.
• Messages are encrypted in transit and stored on jild servers so that all your devices stay in sync. They are not end-to-end encrypted.
• No ads and no tracking.

name: jm天堂动漫
description:
jm天堂动漫是一款面向动漫爱好者的轻量工具，集合作品资料浏览、追番进度记录、圣地巡礼和头像创作。无需注册登录，随时整理你的动漫生活。

【作品资料库】
浏览内置动漫资料，通过作品名、题材、工作室或标签搜索，查看作品简介、年份和集数，发现下一部想看的作品。

【专属追番清单】
将喜欢的作品加入清单，记录观看进度。资料库中没有的作品，也可以手动添加，填写名称、题材和总集数，自由管理自己的追番计划。

【观看进度统计】
查看清单中的作品数量、已观看集数和完成数量，让每一次记录都有迹可循。

【本地开播提醒】
为想看的作品设置本地通知提醒，按自己的节奏安排追番时间。

【圣地巡礼】
浏览内置动漫相关地点资料，跳转系统地图查看路线，并在本地标记打卡足迹。

【专属头像创作】
自由组合背景、肤色、发色与配饰，预览生成的头像，并保存到系统相册。

【四季主题】
春日樱花、夏日海风、秋日枫叶、冬日雪夜，四套主题搭配渐变背景，为你的清单换上喜欢的颜色。

【轻量本地记录】
追番清单、观看进度、打卡记录和主题偏好保存在本机，无需账号即可使用。

说明：
本应用提供动漫资料整理与个人记录功能，不提供动漫视频播放、下载或漫画阅读服务。内置资料随应用版本更新，非实时播出信息。地图导航由系统地图提供，可能需要网络；通知提醒及头像保存需获得相应系统权限。

name: Job Salon & Spa
description:
Job Salon & Spa connects beauty and wellness professionals with salons and spas that are hiring. Whether you are a hairstylist, beautician, nail technician, spa therapist, makeup artist or salon owner, find the right opportunity near you.

FOR JOB SEEKERS
- Browse the latest salon and spa jobs by category
- View full job details and requirements
- Apply in minutes with your name, contact details and photo
- Optionally discover people from your phone contacts who are already using Job Salon & Spa

FOR SALON & SPA OWNERS
- Reach qualified beauty and wellness professionals
- Connect with candidates quickly and locally

Job Salon & Spa makes finding work and hiring in the beauty industry simple, fast and local.

The contacts feature is optional. We only access your contacts after you tap to use it and grant permission, and we clearly explain how your contact data is used. You can use the rest of the app without sharing contacts.

name: Jol - Join own Language
description:
Keep your closest friends from around the world in one place. Jol helps you remember who you wanted to message, what you wanted to ask, and what you learned about their language, habits and culture. It is a private space for meaningful connections, with no need for your friends to install anything.

Key features
- Friend cards - save portraits, names, cities, countries, languages and birthday details in one private place.
- Today view - see upcoming birthdays, calls, shared plans and conversation ideas that are ready when you need them.
- Photo galleries - collect shared photos, tag friends, add captions and open every memory from each friend profile.
- Culture Notes - record language, food, humour, traditions and daily life, then keep each answer linked to the friend who shared it.
- Reminders - add local alerts for calls, plans and birthdays so nothing gets forgotten.
- Conversation prompts - save questions and topics you want to bring up later, then mark them as discussed after the chat.

Perfect for
- Keeping in touch with friends who live overseas or across different time zones.
- Remembering stories, photos and follow up questions after a visit, call or trip.
- Building a personal record of languages, customs and shared moments without using a social network.

Why choose us
Jol is designed for real relationships, not public feeds. It combines friend profiles, shared photos, conversation prompts and cultural notes in a simple private app that works offline for your everyday planning. Everything stays local on your iPhone, so you can organise your friendships your way and revisit every detail whenever you need it.

If you have ever thought, who did I want to message, or what did I want to ask them, Jol is for you. Download now and keep your friendships, memories and cultural notes beautifully organised.

name: Josias and the Carbon
description:
Josias lives an ordinary day: a long shower, the car to work, steak for lunch, the TV left on. At night he sits down to play on the computer… and gets swallowed by the game! His house becomes Cubária, a block world where every choice releases CO₂ cubes that rise into the sky.

To get out of Cubária, Josias has to cut his carbon footprint without losing heart.

• A week of quick choices: how to get to work, what to eat, the shower, free time and where the rubbish goes. Each cube is 0.5 kg of CO₂.
• Surprises: rain, a bus strike, a barbecue invitation and Sunday lunch with the family.
• Trips to the petrol station (petrol or ethanol?), the supermarket (where does the beef come from?) and the neighbourhood meeting, where neighbours decide together.
• Seven portals with mini-games: where CO₂ goes, fast and slow carbon, Aunt Nair's land (standing forest or pasture?), the power plant, trips, waste and what each of us can change.
• Upgrade shop: bicycle, composter, solar panels, a tree seedling.
• Debated points are marked with a scales icon, with both sides. The "Sources of the numbers" screen shows where each value comes from.
• In the final balance: the part Josias controls and the part that depends on laws, companies and collective decisions.
• Two worlds: the real house in 3D and Cubária in blocks. In Portuguese, English and Spanish. Works offline.

For middle school, high school and anyone curious about the climate.

Free, no ads, no sign-up and no data collection. Developed by the Educational Technology Laboratory (LTE) of the Institute of Biology at Unicamp (Brazil). Also available in the browser at www.lte.ib.unicamp.br/softwares.

name: Journey: Chapters & Moments
description:
Life keeps unfolding. Give every part of it a place in Journey.

Create chapters for the people, experiences and interests that matter to you. Add moments with writing, voice recordings, photos or video, and let each chapter grow over time.

TELL YOUR STORY
Capture a thought, share a photo collection, record a voice moment or add a video. Save a draft when you want to finish later. Your chapters bring those moments together in chronological order.

CHOOSE YOUR AUDIENCE
Share a chapter publicly, with followers, with selected people or privately. Manage your profile and chapter settings as your story evolves.

CREATE TOGETHER
Invite connections to a shared chapter or request to join someone else’s chapter. Creators choose their teams, and every moment keeps its author’s credit.

DISCOVER AND CONNECT
Explore chapters by other authors, browse topics and follow the people and stories you enjoy. Respond with replies and reactions, save moments to return to, and exchange private messages, photos and voice notes with connected authors.

SHARE A QUICK CHAPTER
Highlight an existing published moment for 24 hours. The quick page expires while the original moment stays in its chapter.

MAKE IT YOURS
Add a profile photo, biography, interests and an optional voice introduction. Manage notification preferences, connections and account settings, and use the Help Center when you need support.

Journey is for adults aged 18 and over. An account is required for creating stories and using social features.

name: jplus2 for iPhone
description:
jplus2 is a fast, private code editor for iPhone, made by one developer. It uses the Scintilla 5 editing engine and Lexilla's syntax colouring, so even large files scroll smoothly.

WRITE IN 95 LANGUAGES
Syntax colouring and code folding for Swift, Objective-C, C and C++, Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, JSON, SQL, Markdown, Shell and many more. Light and dark appearance follow your iPhone.

EDIT FASTER
Tabs that remember your session, even text you have not saved. Open a folder and slide the Explorer over the editor, jump to any file from a few letters. Find and replace with regular expressions, in the current tab or in every open tab. Duplicate, move, join and delete lines, change case, toggle comments, indent, bookmarks, column editing, select the next occurrence, record macros and save them by name, go to a line, symbols with @, and a command palette that finds any command from a few letters. Icon bars you can show or hide, and a light, dark or automatic appearance. Compare two tabs as a diff.

MADE FOR THE IPHONE
Open files from the Files app and edit them where they are. A row of code keys above the keyboard (tab, arrows, braces), a one-line find bar that opens Replace when you need it, and icon bars that fold away in landscape while you type. Keyboard shortcuts with a hardware keyboard, a menu bar, word wrap, line numbers, text size you can change, 16 encodings including UTF-8, UTF-16, Latin, Cyrillic, Greek, Japanese, Chinese and Korean, and Windows, Unix or classic Mac line endings. Print what you are editing.

GITHUB, AI AND MORE
Browse repositories, review pull requests with diffs, comment, approve and merge, and make small commits, with a token kept in the Keychain. Resolve merge conflicts one at a time. Ask an AI agent for help with your own Claude or OpenAI key, or Apple's on-device model: you choose what is sent, and every change is a diff you approve. Preview Markdown, HTML, JSON and YAML, open CSV, Excel and SQLite files as tables and query them with SQL, insert snippets, and get a version history with recoverable deletes. Siri, Shortcuts, widgets and quick actions.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no analytics. jplus2 connects to GitHub or an AI provider only when you add a token or key and choose to use them, and it never sends your code anywhere else.

jplus2 for iPhone is the editing part of jplus2. The jplus2 for Mac adds IntelliSense, running and debugging code, SQL, GitHub and an AI assistant that uses your own key. Learn more at jplus2.com.

name: JunkDrawer: Toss It In
description:
A junk drawer for your phone: toss in whatever you want to keep, and sort it out never.

Paste something, or share it from another app. Images, links, text, PDFs, zip files and more are saved as they are, whatever the type. There is nothing to name and nothing to file. Drop it in and you are done. Open the drawer now and then, browse from the newest, and take out what you need.

PUT THINGS IN WITH NO EFFORT
- Tap the paste button to save what is on your clipboard
- Choose JunkDrawer in any share sheet to save (the app does not even launch)
- Share several images at once and each becomes its own item
- Take photos and videos with the in-app camera, check them, then save (they are not added to your photo library)
- Files over 100 MB ask for confirmation before they are saved

VIEW EACH TYPE PROPERLY
- Images: full screen with pinch zoom (GIF, HEIC, PNG, JPEG, WebP)
- Links: tap to open right away in an in-app browser; title, description and preview image are shown too
- YouTube: play videos right in the app
- Places: map links, addresses and coordinates are shown on a map
- Text: the full text, with selection and copy
- PDFs: page navigation, zoom and search
- Markdown: headings, lists, tables and code rendered nicely, with a switch to the raw text
- Zip files: see the list of files inside with their sizes, without unpacking
- Other files: previewed when the system can, and always available to take out unchanged

TAKE OUT AND DELETE
Copy, share, open in another app, or delete. Select several items to delete them together. Deleted items stay in Recently Deleted for 30 days, so you can bring them back. Settings shows how much storage you use, by type, and can delete everything at once.

MESSY IS FINE
Thumbnails of different kinds and sizes sit together like things in a drawer. Switch the order (newest, oldest, by type, largest) and between tiles and a list, and filter by images, links, videos, places and more. Works on iPhone, iPad and iPhone Duo, in light and dark mode.

PRIVACY
What you save stays on this device. No account is needed, and there is no advertising and no analytics. The clipboard is read only when you paste. The app's own network access is limited to fetching previews (title, description, image) for links you saved, showing maps (Apple Maps) and playing YouTube videos (YouTube's official player).

Note: this version has no folders, tags, search or iCloud sync.

name: Kakareo: Gestión Avícola
description:
Kakareo es la aplicación integral para administrar granjas avícolas de gallinas ponedoras, pollos de engorde y lotes de levante desde el teléfono.

Diseñada para productores, encargados de galpón, veterinarios y distribuidoras agropecuarias que necesitan datos claros en tiempo real.

REGISTRO DIARIO EN SEGUNDOS
• Postura y clasificación de huevos por lote (Tipo A, B, C, sucios y rotos) con cálculo automático de cartones de 30 unidades, cajas de 360 huevos y porcentaje de postura.
• Registro de mortalidad y bajas diarias con su causa para detectar alertas a tiempo.
• Control de alimento entregado y sobrante en comedero, calculando el consumo real en gramos por ave al día y el consumo de agua.

GALPONES, LOTES Y CURVAS DE PRODUCCIÓN
• Organiza tus galpones por capacidad, sistema de alojamiento y propósito (ponedora, levante, engorde o mixto).
• Compara el rendimiento de tus lotes contra la curva estándar de la raza semana a semana.
• Registra pesajes de muestra y uniformidad del lote.

INVENTARIO, SANIDAD Y COSTOS
• Control de stock de sacos de alimento por etapa, vacunas, medicamentos y cartones, con alertas de inventario mínimo y distribución por galpón.
• Plan sanitario completo: vacunaciones programadas y aplicadas, despiques, tratamientos con días de retiro y visitas veterinarias.
• Cálculo del costo real de producción por huevo, por cartón y por caja mes a mes.

VENTAS Y FINANZAS EN DÓLARES Y BOLÍVARES (BCV)
• Facturación de cartones de huevo, aves en pie o alimento al contado y a crédito, con estado de cuenta por cliente.
• Consulta todos tus precios, ingresos y gastos en dólares (USD) y su equivalente automático en bolívares (VES) a la tasa oficial del BCV del día.
• Escaneo OCR de comprobantes bancarios con la cámara y dictado por voz para registrar gastos rápidamente.

Desarrollada por Web Bonding, C.A. · Soporte directo en https://magric-pollera.onrender.com/ayuda

name: Kakhi: Learn Georgian
description:
Learn Georgian, the language of the country Georgia, from over 1,000 short real videos by Georgian creators. Romanization sits over every word and English under every line. Tap any word to see what it means in that sentence and hear Kakhi say it.

Your first minute: pick your level, a short clip from a Georgian creator starts, and every word under it is one tap away from its meaning, its romanization and its dictionary form.

Georgian (kartuli) has its own alphabet and its own language family, written for 1,500 years and still spoken on every street in Tbilisi. Kakhi, your Georgian grandpa, pulls up a chair and helps you learn Georgian the way people really speak it: real, short videos from Georgian creators, with Georgian subtitles, romanization and English.

LEARN GEORGIAN FROM REAL VIDEOS
• Over 1,000 short videos: cooking, markets, travel, family and everyday talk
• Romanization over every Georgian word, English under every line
• Three levels, so beginners start with the easiest videos

TAP ANY WORD
• What it means right here, in this sentence
• Its dictionary form, and what the ending does ("-shi = in")
• Kakhi says it for you, slowly if you like: Georgian pronunciation, word by word
• Search any word, in any of its forms, and see every video that says it

READ THE GEORGIAN ALPHABET
• The Georgian script, Mkhedruli, with romanization (the national system) until you read it on your own
• Never Mtavruli capitals: Georgian as Georgians write it

BUILD YOUR GEORGIAN VOCABULARY
• Every word you tap becomes a flashcard, with the real line you heard it in
• Review brings words and phrases back right before you forget them (Premium)
• Small daily goals, nel-nela (little by little): 5 to 20 minutes a day

MADE FOR IPHONE
• Widgets for your Home Screen and Lock Screen: a Georgian word of the day, a real line, your streak
• Siri: "Quiz me in Kakhi", "Kakhi word of the day", "Save this word in Kakhi", "How do you say something in Kakhi", "My Kakhi words this week" or "Review my words in Kakhi"
• Search your saved words from the Home Screen with Spotlight

WHO KAKHI IS FOR
• Beginners who want the Georgian language as it's really spoken
• Heritage learners reconnecting with family and roots
• Travelers heading to Tbilisi, Batumi or the mountains
• Partners and friends of Georgians

WHY GEORGIAN?
• Its alphabet is its own: Mkhedruli is written for Georgian and its sister languages
• Its family is its own: Kartvelian, with Megrelian, Svan and Laz. Not Indo-European, not Slavic
• Its three scripts are on UNESCO's list of living culture. Gaumarjos!

FREE AND PREMIUM
• Watching is always free
• Free learners get 5 word look-ups a day and 3 videos a day in learning mode (romanization, English and taps). After that, videos keep playing with Georgian subtitles
• Save as many words as you like
• Now and then a short promo from Kakhi itself shows between videos: our own, with no ad network and no tracking. From the limit screen you can watch one of our clips for 5 more look-ups or 3 more learning videos, up to 3 times a day
• Premium: romanization and English on every video, unlimited look-ups, flashcard review and no promos
• Monthly or yearly, each with a 7-day free trial if you haven't had one, or a one-time Lifetime purchase

GOOD TO KNOW
• No account needed. Your words and progress stay on your phone
• See a mistake in a subtitle? "Report a mistake" is one tap away. Kakhi's voice is computer-generated
• Videos play in YouTube's player and belong to their creators. Owners can have a video removed: plyerstudios.com/kakhi/takedown
• The app itself is in English

Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage or cancel them in your Apple ID settings. Terms: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/ Privacy: https://plyerstudios.com/kakhi/privacy

name: Kari: Door & Guest List
description:
Kari is the door tool for bars and clubs that run a guest list. It is made for the venue's team: door staff and managers sign in with the account their venue gave them.

AT THE DOOR
• Scan a guest's pass and get a clear answer: let in, already inside, wrong night or not on the list.
• Find a guest by name, phone or pass code when their phone is dead.
• Let someone in or turn them away in one tap, and undo a mistake.
• Issue a walk-in ticket at the door.

TONIGHT AT A GLANCE
• See how many people are inside, how many places are left and how many were turned away.
• A log of everyone who came to the door tonight, with search and filters.
• A Home Screen and Lock Screen widget with tonight's numbers.

FOR MANAGERS
• Review requests to join, with the guest's photo and details.
• Browse members and guests and open each person's details.
• Invite a guest.

Kari works in English and Georgian, in light and dark.

An account from your venue is required. Guests do not need this app: their pass lives on the web.

name: Kartix
description:
Every tile brings a new move. Every triple opens a new opportunity!

Kartix is a puzzle game where you match three ceramic tiles with the same symbol. Find matching tiles among overlapping layers, uncover the tiles beneath them and manage your limited tray space.

Should you collect an available triple first, or uncover the matching tile you need to defuse a bomb? As you progress, choosing your next move becomes even more important.

DISCOVER KARTIX

• Layered boards
Find matching symbols among partially overlapping tiles. Each choice can open a path to new tiles.

• Bomb challenges
Match bomb tiles before their countdowns reach zero. An exploding bomb locks one of your tray slots.

• Different tile themes
Enjoy matching fruits, jewels and potions.

• Stages to unlock
Start as a Beginner and unlock new stages. Take on increasingly challenging levels and improve your personal best.

• Three helpful tools
Undo your last selection, Shuffle the board to create new opportunities, or use Magnet to bring a matching triple into the tray.

• Lively matches
Enjoy symbol-specific particle effects, animated scores and celebrations when you complete a level.

This version contains no ads or in-app purchases. Undo, Shuffle and Magnet are free and unlimited.

Your progress and personal best are saved on your device. No account is required.

The game uses Turkish when your phone’s primary language is Turkish and English otherwise.

name: Kat Toplantısı: Karar Asistanı
description:
Kat malikleri kurulu kararları en çok çağrı usulsüzlüğü ve yeter sayının sağlanmaması yüzünden iptal edilir. Kat Toplantısı, apartman yöneticilerinin ve kat maliklerinin toplantıyı Kat Mülkiyeti Kanunu'na uygun yürütmesine yardım eder.

BİNANIZI BİR KEZ TANIMLAYIN
Bağımsız bölümleri, malik adlarını ve arsa paylarını girin. Birden fazla dairesi olan malikin oyları kanundaki üçte bir sınırına göre otomatik hesaplanır.

YOKLAMA VE YETER SAYI
Kim katıldı, kim vekâletle temsil edildi işaretleyin. Toplantı yeter sayısı hem kişi sayısı hem arsa payı olarak anında gösterilir. İkinci toplantı kuralları da uygulanır.

KARAR HESABI
Aidat, yönetici seçimi, ısı yalıtımı, ortak yerde değişiklik, yönetim planı değişikliği ve daha fazlası. Her gündem maddesi için gereken çoğunluk kanun maddesiyle gösterilir; oyları işaretleyin, kararın geçip geçmediğini gerekçesiyle görün.

VEKÂLET UYARILARI
Bir kişinin temsil edebileceği malik sayısını aşan vekâletler için uyarı alın.

TUTANAK VE ÇAĞRI METNİ
