Karar defterine işlenmeye hazır PDF tutanak ve gündemli çağrı metni oluşturup paylaşın.

ÇAĞRI KONTROL LİSTESİ
15 gün önceden çağrı, ikinci toplantı tarihi, vekâletnameler ve iptal davası süreleri: toplantı öncesi yapılacakların tamamı.

KARAR REHBERİ
Hangi karar oy çokluğuyla, hangisi beşte dörtle, hangisi oybirliğiyle alınır? İnternetsiz çalışan kısa rehber.

GİZLİLİK
Hesap yok, internet bağlantısı yok. Bütün veriler yalnızca cihazınızda saklanır.

30 yıllık bir avukat tarafından geliştirilmiştir.

ÖNEMLİ: Kat Toplantısı hukuki danışmanlık hizmeti değildir. Hesaplamalar Kat Mülkiyeti Kanunu'nun genel kurallarına göre yapılır; yönetim planınızdaki özel hükümler sonucu değiştirebilir. Toplu yapı (site) kuralları kapsam dışıdır.

name: Keen Arithmetic
description:
Keen is a short arithmetic drill for addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division.

Start with Daily 10: ten problems, untimed. Or choose a longer set, a 60-second sprint, or your own time and number of problems. Pick one operation or mix them. Set the numbers from one digit to four.

When an answer is wrong, try again or see that same problem later in the set. Show work stacks larger problems the way they look on paper. A focus set practices the operation that lagged last time.

Sound is off until you turn it on. There is no account. Scores stay on this iPhone.

name: Keepcase – Collection Catalog
description:
Keepcase is a simple, private catalog for the things you collect: coins, stamps, figures, trading cards, building-brick sets, vinyl records and anything else you care about.

CATALOG EVERY PIECE
• Add photos from your library or take one with the camera
• Record the purchase price, purchase date and quantity
• Grade the condition: Mint, Near mint, Excellent, Good, Fair or Poor
• Note where it is stored, like "Album A, page 4" or "Display cabinet"
• Add the year, edition or series, plus free notes
• Record short voice notes about where a piece came from or how to care for it

BROWSE YOUR WAY
• Built-in categories you can rename, reorder or extend with your own
• Grid or list view, search, and sorting by value, name, condition or date added

SEE WHAT IT'S WORTH
• Enter your own estimate for each piece. Keepcase never looks up market prices.
• Total estimated value, total paid and overall change
• Value by category, condition breakdown and your most valuable pieces
• Choose the currency symbol you prefer

WISHLIST
• Keep track of pieces you are hunting for, with a target price and priority
• Tap "I got it" to move a wish straight into your collection

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no sign-up
• Your catalog, photos and voice notes are stored on your device
• Photos are chosen with the system photo picker, so Keepcase only receives the photos you select
• Back up everything to a single file and restore it on a new device
Keepcase supports English and Simplified Chinese, Light and Dark mode, iPhone and iPad.

name: Keepcite: Highlighter & Cite
description:
Keepcite is a Safari highlighter and citation companion for researchers. Highlight any web page — or a PDF, right inside Safari — and Keepcite keeps the exact source with it, so nothing you read is ever lost or untraceable.

HIGHLIGHT ANYTHING
• Select text in Safari and save it in a tap — the page URL, title, author and date are captured for you.
• Open PDFs in the built-in reader and highlight by page, with the citation attached.

KEEP EVERY SOURCE
• Organize into folders and sub-folders, color-code, tag, and add notes.
• Browse by source or by highlight; search across everything instantly.

CITE IN SECONDS
• Export clean citations in APA, MLA, Chicago, BibTeX, RIS and more — copy or send straight to Zotero, Mendeley or EndNote.

YOURS, AND PRIVATE
• Local-first: your library lives on your device. No account, no ads, no tracking.
• Optional iCloud sync keeps iPhone, iPad and Mac in step through your own private iCloud.
• Open JSON backup and restore — your data is never locked in.

BUY ONCE
• Free for up to 300 highlights. Keepcite Pro is a one-time purchase for unlimited highlights — no subscription, ever.

name: Keepditch
description:
Keepditch is where people share honest verdicts on what they use: keep it, it's ok, regret it, or ditched it.

SHARE YOUR STACK
List the apps, tools and products you use and say how you really feel about them. Tell the story when you switch from one to another.

DISCOVER
Browse seven universes: Tech, Shopping, Out & about, Screen, Read & listen, Games and Sport. See keep rates, compare alternatives and find what people actually stick with.

OUT & ABOUT
Find restaurants and places near you recommended by members, read guides and ask friends for ideas.

SCREEN, BOOKS, MUSIC, GAMES
Track films, series, books, albums, podcasts and games. See what's on TV tonight, where to watch, and what's coming soon.

SPORT
Follow your teams and competitions with live scores and where to watch the match.

FOLLOW WHAT MATTERS
Follow people, products and tags and get notified about releases, events and news on the things you care about.

HONEST BY DESIGN
Paid placements never change verdicts, keep rates or the order of results. Every external fact shows its source.

Available in English and French.

name: Keepy Uppy Job Tracker
description:
Keepy Uppy Job Tracker is the quick way to keep track of the work you do and the money you're owed.

LOG A JOB IN ONE TAP
Save the services you offer with their prices. When you finish a job, tap the service and it's logged. Need two of the same thing? Set the quantity. Need a discount? Add a percentage or a dollar amount. Track the hours too, and see what you earn per hour.

FROM JOB TO PAID
Every job moves through Open, To invoice, Invoiced, and Paid. Mark it complete, send a clean PDF invoice by email or text, and it stays unpaid until you check it off. Edit the note that goes out with the invoice, once or for every invoice.

KEEP YOUR CLIENTS
Save each client's email, phone, and address, and see at a glance who owes you.

SEE THE YEAR
Your income by month and by service, what's still unpaid, and your hours. Export any year as a CSV for your accountant or tax time.

YOURS ALONE
No account. No sign-up. No ads. No tracking. Your jobs, clients, and invoices stay on your iPhone.

Made for people who work for themselves: lawn care, cleaning, handyman work, painting, pet care, freelancers, and anyone who sends an invoice.

name: Kelu — Studio CRM
description:
Kelu is simple management for small dance, yoga, stretching and fitness studios. Everything that used to live in a notebook, a spreadsheet and group chats is now in one app.

ONE-TAP ATTENDANCE
Open a class and tap a student: attendance is marked, the class comes off their pass and the balance updates itself. Missed classes can be marked too. Students are linked to class types, so each class shows only its own people.

PASSES AND DEBTS
Sell a pass in a couple of taps. Kelu tracks classes left and expiry dates, reminds you who should renew, and classes taken on credit come off the next pass.

ONLINE BOOKING
Your studio gets its own page with the schedule and prices. Students book classes themselves: with their pass, as a single visit or with a new pass.

ANALYTICS
Monthly revenue, sales by pass type, attendance, busiest classes and students who stopped coming.

TEAM AND STUDENTS
Invite admins and teachers: everyone sees their own part, and the studio's money is visible only to the owner. Students see their pass and bookings.

NOTIFICATIONS ON IPHONE AND TELEGRAM
Kelu instantly tells you who booked or cancelled a class, whose pass has ended and who joined your studio.

Free for up to 5 students and 1 teacher, with all features. Unlimited on the Pro plan.

Data is stored on a secure server, and each studio sees only its own data. Russian and English.

name: KeySweep: Keyboard Bench
description:
Test a physical keyboard after cleaning, repair or a switch replacement. Pick a US ANSI or ISO key layout and run a targeted or full-board pass. The bench tracks presses and releases by physical key position while a test is active, shows coverage, and flags incomplete or manually marked positions. Repeat a pass after a repair and compare the two snapshots.

Use the on-screen checklist with a separate tester or for keys that iOS reserves. Inspect individual results, record notes, and save a repair history or share a report. Keyboard events are processed only in the foreground test panel. No typed strings are recorded.

External-key detection requires an iOS-compatible keyboard. Some system shortcuts and vendor-specific keys are handled by iOS. The tool records observed events rather than measuring electrical debounce or switch force. No account, online service, or subscription.

name: KeyTile
description:
Turn your iPhone into a wireless shortcut keypad for your Mac.

KeyTile pairs with the free KeyTile Receiver menu-bar app over Bluetooth and puts your
shortcuts one tap away. Every tile sends its shortcut straight to the Mac — there is no
server, no account and nothing to log in to.

- Shortcut sets — a set of tiles per app. Import the menu shortcuts of the Mac app in
  front and KeyTile builds the set for you.
- Automatic app switching — the receiver reports the active app and the pad switches
  sets by itself.
- The pad never scrolls — extra tiles turn into pages, in portrait and landscape.
- Your grid — columns from 2 to 5, and tiles never get smaller than a comfortable tap.
- Several Macs — pair them, rename them, pick the one to drive. Each keeps its own sets.

The companion app is free, for macOS: https://keytile.michelevettone.com/

Requires macOS 14 or later on the Mac; iOS 17 or later on the iPhone or iPad.

name: Kfanly: Learn K-pop Korean
description:
Understand your favorite idols and K-dramas, one bite-size episode at a time.

Kfanly teaches the Korean you actually hear: in songs, on variety shows, at fan meetings and in your favorite dramas. Start by reading Hangul in a single day, then build real sentences you can use in comments, at concerts and on your first trip to Seoul.

LEARN LIKE YOU WATCH
• Seasons and episodes instead of boring units
• Pilot: read Hangul in one day
• Season 1 – First Hello
• Season 2 – Fan Talk
• Season 3 – Drama Korean
• Season 4 – Your First Sentences
• Season 5 – Idol's Day
• Season 6 – Concert Night
• Season 7 – Seoul Trip & Merch

MORE THAN FLASHCARDS
• Build sentences from word tiles
• Listen and pick the meaning
• Type in Korean with a built-in Hangul keyboard
• Match pairs against the clock
• Native-style audio for every word and phrase
• Smart review brings back the words you missed

PLAY MODE
• Rush: answer fast, chain combos, beat your best score
• Match: clear the board before time runs out
• Sound effects, confetti and grades that make practice feel like a game

STAY ON A ROLL
• Daily streaks and missions
• Lightstick charges protect your streak on busy days
• Gentle reminders at the time you choose
• Bongi, your lightstick buddy, cheers you on
• Share your score and challenge your friends

MADE FOR FANS AROUND THE WORLD
The app is available in English, Spanish, French, Chinese (Simplified) and Japanese. No account needed, no ads, and your learning data stays on your phone.

KFANLY PRO
The Pilot, Season 1 and the first episode of every other season are free. Kfanly Pro unlocks every season, every episode and every game.
• Yearly: 7-day free trial, then billed once a year
• Monthly: billed every month
Prices are shown in the app in your local currency. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase (or when the free trial ends). Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel your subscription in your Apple Account settings at any time.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://kfanly.app/privacy.html
Questions? support@kfanly.app

Kfanly is an independent learning app made by fans, for fans. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by any artist, agency or broadcaster.

name: Kingdom Fullness
description:
This App will help Kingdom Fullness Global stay engaged and connected with our local church and the world. This App will further help the ministry to spread the Gospel via live weekly sermons and worship services. The App will also help the ministry communicate their weekly schedules and important events as they occur. This app will further help the ministry to connect with the first timers by collection their basic information for follow up.

Mobile app version: 6.24.8

name: Kipptakt
description:
Die App zu Kipptakt, der Software für Containerdienste. Für Fahrer: Das Büro plant den Tag und gibt ihn frei – Sie sehen Ihre Fahrten in der richtigen Reihenfolge und erledigen jede mit wenigen Tipps.

DER TAG
• Alle Fahrten des Tages in Reihenfolge, mit Adresse, Containergröße und Abfallart
• Navigation und Anruf beim Kunden mit einem Tipp
• Hinweise vom Büro: Zufahrt, Genehmigung, Notiz zur Fahrt
• Änderungen aus dem Büro kommen sofort an

UNTERWEGS
• Unterwegs, Gestellt, Getauscht, Abgeholt – mit großen Knöpfen
• Container per QR-Code scannen oder Nummer wählen
• Fotos vom Container und vom Wiegeschein
• Unterschrift des Kunden auf dem Handy
• Fehlfahrt melden, mit Foto als Nachweis
• Gewogen und Vor Ort bezahlt erfassen

OHNE NETZ
Jede Aktion wird mit Uhrzeit auf dem Handy gespeichert und gesendet, sobald wieder Empfang da ist – in der richtigen Reihenfolge und nie doppelt.

DATENSCHUTZ
Der Standort wird nur im Moment einer Meldung gelesen, als Nachweis, wo ein Container steht. Im Hintergrund wird nichts aufgezeichnet. Fotos und Unterschriften bleiben nur bis zum Senden auf dem Handy.

SPRACHEN
Deutsch, Englisch, Polnisch, Rumänisch, Türkisch und Ukrainisch.

Zum Anmelden brauchen Sie ein Konto, das Ihr Betrieb in Kipptakt für Sie anlegt. Mehr über Kipptakt: kipptakt.de

name: Kitsune Beat
description:
Long ago, paper lanterns kept the night demons away from the village of rice farmers. Then Kurokage, the shadow oni king, woke inside the mountain and the lanterns went dark.

Only a young kitsune can hear the rhythm the demons dance to. Catch them on the beat, seal them in the spirit lantern and bring the light back to every village.

HOW TO PLAY
- Gold demons: tap the gold disc in the middle
- Jade demons: tap a blue corner pad
- Big demons: both hands at the same time
- Long bars: tap and hold until the bar ends
- Purple frenzy: tap anywhere as fast as you can

SONGS THAT NEVER RUN OUT
Every song is a relaxing lofi track composed by the game just for you: jazz chords, koto, chiptune melodies and vinyl crackle. Tap NEW MELODY whenever you want a brand-new one.

YOUR FOX, YOUR STYLE
- Combos make your fox evolve, up to nine tails and a blazing aura
- Earn coins and unlock fur colours, hats, headphones, crowns and more
- 8 living pixel worlds: Lantern Night, Sakura Spring, Summer Festival, Maple Autumn, Snowy Winter, Spirit Forest, Neon Dusk City and Cyber Shrine 2099
- 14 achievements, fox-fire ratings and a daily coin bonus

FEATURES
- Easy, Normal and Hard difficulty
- A guided tutorial that teaches one step at a time
- Portrait or landscape play
- No ads, no tracking, no in-app purchases
- Available in English, Italian, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Japanese, Korean and Chinese

Made with love by Restaino Lab.

name: KIYU Camera
description:
Spin the dial. Switch cameras.
Film grain, CCD highlight bloom and anamorphic flares show up live in the viewfinder, so what you frame is what you get.

KIYU is made by an independent photographer who has spent years shooting film and old digicams. It isn't a filter laid over your phone photo. Each camera has its own lenses, format, flash habits and color.

THE CAMERAS
• Diary: 35mm fixed lens, auto flash and a quartz date stamp for everyday snaps
• Wander: a 24/35/50mm street rangefinder
• Paper: 1:1 instant photos with a wide white bottom border
• Corner: clean, punchy digital with SNAP zone focus
• Lucid: 13–77mm with Apple ProRAW, f/1.4–f/16 computed aperture, manual shutter and ISO, and focus peaking
• Millennium: the blown highlights, edge halos and color noise of a Y2K CCD point-and-shoot
• Reel: 2.39:1 widescreen with blue streak flares and oval bokeh

36 ORIGINAL COLOR PROFILES
Negative, slide, cinema, black-and-white, instant, digital and CCD. There are looks tuned for sun, gray skies and city nights, including three made just for overcast days.
Fine-tune push/pull, highlight protection, color density, grain and clarity, then save up to three recipes of your own.

CHANGE YOUR FILM AFTER THE SHOT
No viewfinder blackout, no waiting between shots. Every photo keeps a clean negative, so you can swap the film, add a frame or go back to the original any time without losing quality.

FRAMES, STAMPS AND COLLAGES
• 9 frame styles, from white borders and frosted glass to 35mm film strips and color palettes
• Stamp the film name, exposure settings and date
• 2–3 photo collages and batch develop up to 36 photos

YOUR PHOTOS STAY ON YOUR IPHONE
No account, no uploads, no ads, no tracking.

KIYU PRO
Free: Diary, Wander and Corner, 12 color profiles, and exports with a small KIYU wordmark. Try every Pro camera, film and frame live before you buy.
KIYU Pro comes as a yearly subscription (auto-renewing) or a one-time lifetime unlock. Both include all 7 cameras, 36 color profiles, 9 frames, custom or no watermark, and batch tools.
Payment is charged to your Apple Account. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel any time in your App Store account settings.

Privacy Policy: https://kiyu.doooo.app/privacy/en/
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Klompa
description:
Το Klompa είναι ένα εργαστήριο ξύλινου τσόκαρου με δύο πάγκους και μία ντουλάπα.

Στη ντουλάπα μετράς το πόδι, διαλέγεις κορμό από έξι ξύλα και κοιτάς το βιβλίο με οκτώ μοτίβα. Η αφετηρία του κοιλώματος συγκρίνεται με το παράθυρο εργασίας.

Στον πάγκο κοιλώματος ρυθμίζεις βάθος, τοίχωμα, σήκωμα μύτης και υγρασία. Διαβάζεις αρμό, αρχικό βάρος και εκτίμηση ανά ξύλο. Το παράθυρο μένει πάντα στο αρχικό βάρος.

Στον πάγκο βαφής βάζεις στρώσεις, βερνίκι, μοτίβο και ώρες στο σχοινί. Διαβάζεις στιλπνότητα και αντοχή στην υγρασία.

Χτύπα το τσόκαρο στο πάγκο ή στην αρχική, σφράγισε μία κάρτα αν σου αρέσει η συνταγή, και ξανάφερέ την στους πάγκους όποτε θέλεις.

Το τετράδιο τεχνίτη εξηγεί κάθε πάγκο και κάθε μέτρηση.

Δωρεάν. Κάθετο iPhone.

name: KnotPal: Knot Tying Guide
description:
KnotPal teaches useful knots with clear, step-by-step animations you can play at your own pace.

FOR REAL USE
• Fishing: hooks, lures, swivels and joining lines (palomar, improved clinch, uni, blood)
• Camping: tarps, guy lines and logs (taut-line, timber, rolling hitch)
• Sailing and boating: bowline, round turn, reef, sheet bend, clove hitch
• Everyday knots for packages, sacks and the garden
• Necktie knots: four-in-hand, half-Windsor, Windsor

EASY TO FOLLOW
• Every knot drawn step by step, forward and back
• Search by name or by what you need to do
• Browse by category and save your favorites
• Notes on what each knot is good for and what to watch out for
• Works fully offline: on the lake, the trail or the dock
• English and Turkish

FREE AND PRO
42 knots in this version, 28 of them free forever. New knots arrive in free updates.
KNOTPAL PRO (one-time purchase, no subscription) unlocks the Pro knots, including Pro knots added in future updates, plus practice mode and the "Which knot?" helper, and removes ads. You can also try Pro free for 24 hours by watching a short ad.

SAFETY
KnotPal is a learning guide. Knots that people rely on for safety show a warning. Do not rely on an app for climbing, rescue, lifting or any situation where a failing knot could cause injury. Get hands-on training from a qualified instructor and use certified equipment.

No account, no sign-up.

name: kohphangan.app
description:
kohphangan.app is a free, independent guide for people staying on Koh Phangan, Thailand, in English, Hebrew and Russian.

• Ferries: today's boats to Koh Samui, Koh Tao and the mainland, the next departure, and where each time comes from.
• Sea and weather: a plain morning reading of the sea for the boats, a "swim today?" note for each beach, and hourly rain.
• What's on: yoga, meditation, markets, parties and the Full Moon dates, filtered by time, area and vibe. Organisers can send in their own events, and we check them before they appear.
• Thai customs: temples, Buddhist holy days and no-alcohol dates, bargaining, police and paying by QR, each with its source.
• Island alerts: power, water, storms and roads. Turn on notifications for urgent alerts and the morning boat reading.
• Gecko, the island chat: one open channel for everyone on the island right now, plus private messages and video calls. Only people who are physically on Koh Phangan can join: the app checks your location and never stores it or shows it to anyone. Every message can be reported, and anyone can be blocked.
• Emergency numbers, a map, scooter safety, taxi fares and visa links.

An independent guide: not run by, or connected to, any government body, ferry company or tourism authority. Island information changes quickly, so check anything important with the people who run it.

The chat is for people 18 and older.

name: Kootani: Tamil Word Puzzle
description:
Kootani is a calm Tamil word puzzle about things that belong together. Every card carries a Tamil word, and some carry a picture too. Find which cards belong to the same group, then sort every card into its group before the moves run out.

HOW TO PLAY
• A group card names a group, such as "Tamil months". Drag it onto an empty slot at the top.
• Then drag the cards of that group onto it. When every card of the group is in, the group is complete and its slot is free again.
• Cards lie in columns with only the top card face up. Move the top card and the one below turns over.
• Put a card on its group card or on a card of the same group. A stack of one group moves together in one move.
• Need a new card? Tap the pile.
• Every move counts. A wrong drop costs nothing: the card simply slides back.

Watch out: some cards look as if they fit another group. In later levels there are more groups than slots, so think about which group to open first.

1,000 LEVELS IN FIVE STAGES
• பழகுதல் (Learn), levels 1–10: the game teaches itself, one step at a time.
• எளிது (Easy), levels 11–100
• நடுத்தரம் (Medium), levels 101–350
• கடினம் (Hard), levels 351–700
• மிகக் கடினம் (Expert), levels 701–1,000: up to eight groups, tall columns and few slots.
Finish with moves to spare to earn up to three stars on every level.

TODAY'S PUZZLE
A new puzzle every day. The game keeps count of how many days in a row you solve it, and a gentle daily reminder is there if you want one.

HELP WHEN YOU NEED IT
• Hint shows a good move.
• Undo takes back your last move and gives the move back.
• Extra moves help you finish a level when the moves run out.
• Restart is always free. No timer, no lives, no waiting.

MADE FOR TAMIL
• More than 300 everyday themes from Tamil life: tiffin varieties, Tamil months, village games, the tea shop, a wedding house and many more.
• The whole game is in Tamil.

ALSO
• Plays offline. No account, no sign-in.
• Free to play. After the first few levels, a short ad may appear between levels: never while you play a level, and never in Today's puzzle.
• Out of hints, undos or moves? Watch a short video if you like, and get more.
• No in-app purchases in this version.
• Sound, music and vibration can each be turned off.

Questions or ideas? Write to contact@aitechies.in.
Privacy policy: https://aitechies.in/privacy/kootani.html

name: Kotochi: Japanese Dictionary
description:
Kotochi is an offline Japanese-English dictionary for iPhone and iPad. Type in romaji, kana, kanji or English and get the meaning right away, with no connection needed.

LOOK UP ANYTHING
- Type romaji, hiragana, katakana, kanji or English in one search box
- Conjugated forms work: search 食べなかった and Kotochi finds 食べる
- About 210,000 Japanese entries with numbered meanings, readings and usage notes
- English-to-Japanese lookup, with pronunciation
- Tap a kanji to see its readings, meanings and every word that uses it
- Example sentences with the English translation and a speaker button
- Point the camera at printed text or paste text to look words up

SAVE AND REVIEW
- Tap the star to save a word to your list
- Saved words come back as flashcards when you are about to forget them
- Choose Japanese-to-English or English-to-Japanese review
- Optional daily reminder, plus a widget with the word of the day
- Export your list as CSV

SIMPLE AND PRIVATE
- Works offline after install
- No ads, no account, nothing leaves your iPhone
- Free to look up as much as you like. Kotochi Pro (one-time purchase) removes the limit of 30 saved words and adds multiple word lists. It is not a subscription.

DATA SOURCES
JMdict and KANJIDIC2 (Electronic Dictionary Research and Development Group, CC BY-SA 4.0), Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR), EJDict-hand, CMUdict. Details are in the app under Settings.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://kotochi.sanghuynhxuan.com/privacy/

name: KPSS Hazırlık: Online Soru Çöz
description:
KPSS Hazırlık ile Genel Yetenek ve Genel Kültür konularını kendi hızında çalış. Türkçe, matematik ve geometri, tarih, coğrafya, vatandaşlık ve güncel bilgiler derslerinde binlerce açıklamalı soru çöz.

• Konu ve alt başlık seç. Zorluk düzeyini ve test uzunluğunu belirle.
• Her sorudan sonra açıklamayı gör veya cevaplarını test bitince incele. İstersen süreli çöz.
• Yanlış yaptığın soruları tekrar et. Sorulara not ekle, favorilerini sakla ve kaldığın yerden devam et.
• Günlük hedefini belirle, doğru ve yanlışlarını takip et ve test geçmişini incele.
• İnternet bağlantısı olmadan, hesap açmadan ve reklam görmeden çalış.

KPSS Hazırlık bağımsız bir sınav hazırlık uygulamasıdır. ÖSYM ile bağlantısı yoktur. Geri sayım için kendi hedef tarihini ayarlayabilirsin.

name: Krak Multiplayer
description:
Krak Multiplayer is a free social app for Minecraft: Bedrock Edition players. Find people to play with, keep in touch with your friends, and find servers and worlds to join from your iPhone.

Find players
• A feed of posts from players: screenshots, builds, world invites and polls
• Communities around servers, worlds and play styles
• Profiles with levels, badges and the worlds people play in

Talk
• Private and group chats with pictures, GIFs and voice messages
• A public Global chat, moderated
• Friends, followers and a friend code to add people fast
• AI translation of messages and posts into your language, only when you ask for it

Play together
• A catalog of servers and worlds with ratings and reviews
• Host your world through your Xbox account: Krak lists it, adds your guests as Xbox friends, and they join from Minecraft's Friends tab
• Join other players' worlds the same way
• See which friends are online and where they play

Make it yours
• Avatar, banner, status, bio and a profile wall
• Profile frames and decorations from the Store, for coins you get free in the app (rewards and gifts). Nothing is sold for real money
• 23 languages, dark and light themes

Safe by design
• For players aged 13 and older
• You choose who can message you, and younger players are protected from messages by adults they don't know
• Report and block on every profile, world, message, post and comment; real moderators with automatic help
• Chat messages are stored encrypted, and pictures in chats are deleted after 7 days
• No ad trackers and no personalised ads, and we never sell your data
• Delete your account at any time in Settings

On iPhone you play together through your Xbox account (a free Microsoft account). The game itself connects through Minecraft's own Xbox networking.

The game is sold separately. Krak Multiplayer needs an internet connection.

Questions or ideas? Write to support@krak-mp.cc

Krak Multiplayer is not an official Minecraft product. Not approved by or associated with Mojang or Microsoft.

name: KroaDreim
description: KroaDreim is a personal keepsake shelf on your iPhone. Save something you chose to keep—a gift, a travel find, a small ritual object—and write why it still matters. Optional origin text and approximate year add context. Tag entries, star favorites, browse by tag, and search your shelf.

name: KUMC On Air
description:
KUMC On Air («كيومك على الهوا») is a media quiz for two teams from the Kuwait University Media Club (KUMC). Gather your friends, name the teams, and hand the host the phone.

How it plays
• Taking turns, each team picks 3 categories: six categories and 36 questions on the board.
• Points are difficulty: 200 easy, 400 medium, 600 very hard.
• When time runs out, the other team gets half the time to steal.
• Nobody sees the answer, the host included, until «Show the answer» is pressed.

Helpers
Each team picks 3 of 5 and can use each once: call a source, scoop, double report, out of coverage, and double points.

Categories
Kuwait TV, Kuwait Radio, the Kuwaiti press, Gulf drama, cinema, documentaries, photography, editing, media terms, news writing, social media, headlines and world media, among others. The club writes and updates the questions, and they reach the app on their own.

On the TV
Connect the phone to a TV or projector and the TV shows the game to the room without buttons, while the host plays from the phone.

The game is in Arabic. It works on iPhone and iPad, even offline. No accounts, no ads, and no data collected about you.

name: Kumion IPTV: Xtream & M3U
description:
Kumion brings your own IPTV playlists, local videos, and local music together on a tactile, distraction-free desk. Designed around crisp mechanical keycaps and warm putty surfaces, every control stays clear and responsive.

IPTV FOR YOUR OWN PLAYLISTS
• Connect Xtream Codes accounts (server URL, username, password) or M3U links and local M3U files.
• Browse Live TV, Films, and Series with a fixed group directory to search, sort, and pin your favorite groups.
• Star channels, films, or series to keep them on Home, and pick up films and episodes from Continue watching.
• Watch in a clean player with in-place channel switching, audio and subtitle track selection, video fit, aspect ratio, playback speed, and screen lock.
• Manage multiple playlists, switch active sources, and refresh your Xtream account details anytime.

OFFLINE VIDEOS & MUSIC
• Videos: Import MP4, MOV, or MKV files from Files or Photos into custom folders, load external .srt subtitle files with timing offset controls, and resume where you left off.
• Music: Import MP3, M4A, AAC, WAV, FLAC, or OGG files, browse by Tracks, Albums, Artists, or Playlists, set a sleep timer with gentle fade-out, and control playback from the persistent mini bar.

PLAYER ONLY — NO CONTENT INCLUDED
Kumion is strictly a media player. It includes no built-in channels, films, series, playlists, videos, or music. You must supply your own playlist from a provider you are authorized to use, or your own local media files. Everything you add stays on your device.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://kumion.pages.dev/privacy
Support: support@kumion.app

name: Kunjaree Silks
description:
Kunjaree Silks brings authentic handloom and pure silk sarees to your phone — curated Kanjivaram, Mysore Silk, Banarasi, soft silk, and more.

Shop collections from our Bengaluru showroom, browse new arrivals, and check out securely with UPI, cards, and wallets. Free shipping above ₹1,999 and a 7-day easy exchange.

FEATURES
• Browse sarees, blouses, salwar suits & ethnic wear
• Search and filter collections
• Add to cart and checkout with secure payments
• Track orders and view order history
• Push notifications for offers and order updates
• Guest shopping or sign in with your account

Every saree is personally curated for quality and authenticity. Visit us online or at our Bellandur, Bengaluru showroom.

Support: support@kunjareesilks.com
WhatsApp: +91 99018 71150
Website: https://kunjareesilks.com

name: Kurukaki: Cursive Writing
description:
Kurukaki teaches cursive handwriting one stroke at a time. A little hummingbird named Kuru flies along each letter so you see the order and the direction, then you trace it, then you write it on your own. When you finish, every stroke gets its own score, so you know exactly what to fix: a backwards stroke, a skipped stroke, or a line that drifted.

Made for students and adults who want neat traditional cursive for school, cards or a signature. Use your finger or Apple Pencil. Everything is scored on your device, with no account and no internet.

WATCH, TRACE, WRITE
- Watch Kuru draw the letter with stroke numbers and arrows, slow or fast, as many times as you like
- Trace over a faint model, then write on four-line paper with a smaller model beside you
- Scores for every stroke and a plain sentence about the main mistake
- All 26 lowercase and 26 capital letters, grouped by stroke family so similar letters are learned together

EVERY DAY IN ONE TAP
- Today picks 3 letters: the next new one and your two weakest
- Progress shows your streak, your scores per letter and what needs work
- Left-handed and right-handed layouts, Apple Pencil only mode, light and dark appearance

WORDS, NAMES AND PRINTABLE SHEETS
- Starter words to practice right away
- Type your own name or signature (up to 14 letters) and trace it in cursive
- Kurukaki Pro adds more word packs (days, months, colors, animals, family, school, food, nature, feelings), short phrases like "Thank you", unlimited own text, printable practice sheets as PDF (A4 or Letter), and a comparison of your first try with your best

FREE TO USE
- All 52 letters with all three steps and scoring, Today, Progress and the Starter words are free
- Pro is a single one-time purchase that you can restore on any device

PRIVATE AND OFFLINE
- No account, no ads, no tracking
- Your writing never leaves your device

Kurukaki teaches traditional cursive letterforms. Stroke scoring compares your line to the model and is a practice guide, not an exam grade.

Questions or ideas: support@sanghuynhxuan.com

name: La Maison du Pied
description:
La Maison du Pied, chaussures et semelles orthopédiques sur mesure.

Avec l'appli, suivez la fabrication de vos chaussures étape par étape, depuis la prise de mesures jusqu'à la remise :
• l'avancement de votre commande en cours et la date de livraison prévue ;
• l'historique de vos commandes ;
• la date de votre prochain renouvellement.

Connexion sécurisée avec votre numéro de dossier, remis au cabinet, et un code reçu par SMS sur le portable enregistré dans votre dossier.

L'appli est réservée aux patients de La Maison du Pied. Elle n'affiche aucune information médicale.

name: Labeeb - لبيب
description:
Labeeb is a web browser designed for Arabic first, and fully usable in English. The interface runs right to left, the type is a clear Arabic face, and the controls sit within reach of your thumb in a single bottom bar.

Comfortable browsing
• Normal and private tabs, with a preview of each tab and swipe to close.
• One address bar for searching and opening sites, with suggestions from your history and bookmarks.
• Bookmarks, history and downloads in one library.
• Find in page, desktop site, and dark or light appearance.
• Run a favourite site as an app in its own window.

Reading without distraction
• Reading mode shows the article text alone, in a comfortable typeface at the size you choose.
• Hijri dates shown beside Gregorian dates in articles.
• Side-by-side translation places each paragraph's translation directly beneath it.
• The Arabic web fixer gives Arabic text a clear typeface and its natural direction on sites that neglect it.

An optional AI assistant
• Summarise the page, have it explained simply, translate it, or ask anything.
• Works with your own API key from OpenAI, Anthropic or DeepSeek, and connects to the provider directly from your device.
• Page text is sent only when you choose to attach it, and Labeeb asks for your agreement before the first time.

Labeeb Memory
• Ask about something you read before, and Labeeb searches the text of the pages you visited.
• The index stays on your device only, and private tabs never enter it.

Your privacy stays on your device
• No account, no ads, no tracking.
• History, bookmarks and settings are stored on your device only.
• Passwords are stored encrypted in the Keychain and filled in only after Face ID or your device passcode.
• The camera and microphone open for a site only with your permission.

Labeeb is developed by Shaye Alshaye in Saudi Arabia.

Note: the AI assistant needs an API key that you obtain from the provider you choose, and the provider may charge for usage. Every other feature of the browser works without a key.

name: LanternReel--Color Disk Spin
description:
LanternReel kutsuu sinut juhlavalle kadulle, jossa odottaa pyörivä väripalapeli.

Kadun varrella seisoo pyöriviä lyhtykiekkoja, joiden reunoja koristavat eriväriset ja erimääräiset valot. Valitse kiekko ja pyöritä sitä myötä- tai vastapäivään. Seuraa, kuinka viereiset kiekot vastaavat liikkeeseen pyörähtämällä vastakkaiseen suuntaan. Jokainen siirto vaikuttaa koko katuun, joten huolellinen suunnittelu on nopeutta tärkeämpää.

Tutki tavoitevärien järjestystä, sovita toisiinsa kytkettyjen kiekkojen liikkeet ja palauta juhlakulkueen tunnusomainen valaistuskuvio. Selaa kuviokokoelmaa, kokeile harjoittelupistettä tai tutustu kadun tarinoihin pelivuorojen välillä.

Edistyminen tallentuu omalle laitteellesi. Tiliä ei tarvita. Selkeä grafiikka, tarkat ohjaimet ja lyhyet äänitehosteet pitävät huomion edessäsi pyörivissä kiekoissa.

name: Last Bin Standing
description:
You forgot bin night. The garbage truck is already rumbling down the street. Grab your wheelie bin and RUN!

Last Bin Standing is a fast, funny one-thumb runner set on an Aussie suburban street. Swipe to dodge, jump and roll. Your bin swings behind you, so steer it past letterboxes, utes, magpies and the neighbour's sprinkler. Then dive into the back of the truck before it takes off without you.

HOW TO PLAY
• Swipe left and right to change lanes
• Swipe up to jump, swipe down to roll under boom gates
• Your bin swings behind you, so plan your moves!
• Catch the truck and jump in the back to finish the level

FEATURES
• 50 hand-checked story levels across 5 neighbourhoods
• ENDLESS mode: how far can you go?
• Roof-hop across moving traffic jams
• Fly a stunt plane and a helicopter, and dodge planes, balloons, drones and cranes
• 30+ obstacles: speed humps, bins, scaffolding, magpies, crossing dogs, flying lids and more
• Power-ups: magnet, surfboard shield, double cans, leaf-blower jetpack, spring thongs
• Upgrade your runner: shoes, shirts, hats, backpacks, watches, chains and bins all make you stronger
• Daily rewards, missions and score multipliers
• Plays offline, so it's perfect for the bus or the bush
• No account needed

Free to play. No ads.

Got an idea for the game? Tap "Send us ideas" in the game. We read every one.

name: Last Power Plant: Tower TD
description:
Enemies are closing in along branching routes. Build towers on empty sockets to keep them from reaching the core. Position and range can give the same tower more time to fire.

Rapid towers focus on one target. Frost slows fast enemies, Blast hits clusters, and Pierce strikes several enemies along a lane. Mix these four roles across 12 maps and 120 waves.

Upgrade or redeploy between waves, then spend recovered parts on research for your next run. Switch between 1× and 2× speed or pause the battle when you need time to plan.

name: Layerwise - Skincare Routine
description:
Layerwise is a skincare routine planner. It shows this morning's and tonight's layers in the order they go on, and it checks the ingredient lists of your products against what labels and regulators actually say.

No subscription: your routines, the ingredient check and reminders are free, and one payment unlocks the week planner.

YOUR SHELF, IN ORDER
• Add a product by name from a starter list of popular products, from a photo of its ingredient list, by pasting the list, or by ticking what it contains
• A morning routine and a night routine, ordered thin to thick with sunscreen last. Drag a layer to change the order
• Tap a layer to check it off, and turn on a morning or an evening reminder if you want one

A CHECK THAT SHOWS ITS SOURCES
• Layerwise reads the ingredient names on your products: retinol and other forms of vitamin A, exfoliating acids (AHA and BHA), vitamin C, niacinamide and more
• When two layers are easier on the skin on different nights, it says so in a sentence or two and shows where that comes from: the label or the regulator's text, quoted, one tap away
• When a product's own label asks for sun protection and your morning has no sunscreen, it tells you
• For popular warnings that have no dermatology source behind them, it says exactly that: no source found
• A cleanser that rinses off is not counted as a second exfoliant, and an ingredient at the very end of a list is not treated as an active

PLAN THE WEEK
• Put two products on alternate nights with one tap
• Skin cycling as a template: an exfoliant night, a vitamin A night, then two rest nights
• Any layer on chosen weekdays or every few nights
• The whole week on one screen: which night is which, and when your skin rests

YOURS ALONE
• No account. Your shelf stays on your iPhone
• Label photos are read on the device and are not kept
• No ads

Layerwise does not rate ingredients as good or bad and it does not sell anything. It tells you what your products contain and what the sources say about using them together. Prescription products are not checked.

PRICING
Free, with no ads. Layerwise Pro is one payment, not a subscription: it unlocks as many schedules as you need, the cycle templates and your full history.

Layerwise is not a medical device and does not diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any medical condition. It helps you organise cosmetic skincare products. For a skin condition, a reaction, pregnancy or a prescription product, ask a doctor or pharmacist.

Privacy Policy: https://trifoiltrailblazer.com/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://trifoiltrailblazer.com/terms-of-service

name: LazyChess: Untimed Chess
description:
LazyChess is chess at your own pace. Start as many games as you like, make a move when you have a minute, and come back when it's your turn. There is no clock: you have days for every move.

PLAY MANY GAMES AT ONCE
Your games are listed with the ones waiting for you first. Make your move, tap Next game, and you're on the next board. A notification tells you when an opponent has replied.

FIND AN OPPONENT IN SECONDS
Tap New game and you're on a board at once, matched with a player near your rating. Or invite a friend with a link, or challenge any player by username.

A RATING THAT GROWS WITH YOU
Pick your level when you sign up and your rating follows every game you play. Your profile keeps your best rating, your wins, draws and losses, and every finished game.

FREE GAME REVIEW
After each game, see your accuracy and how every move rated, from brilliant to blunder, with the best move shown where you went wrong. The review runs on your phone, free, for every game.

PLAY THE COMPUTER, EVEN OFFLINE
Eight levels, from beginner to full engine strength. Take back a move or ask for a hint whenever you like.

MADE FOR SLOW CHESS
- Pre-moves: queue your replies while your opponent thinks
- Move confirmation, if you'd rather never misclick
- Draw offers and claims, resign, and automatic checkmate and stalemate
- Six board colour themes, light and dark mode, sounds and haptics
- Sign in with Apple, Google or your email; no passwords

Questions or ideas? Write to support@lzchess.com.

name: LBFort
description: LBFort本系統專為每月支出管理而設計。 在每月月初，您可以將資金分配至各個類別，並追蹤日常支出、收入、退款及帳戶間的轉帳。 若單筆款項涉及多個類別或帳戶，您可以將金額拆分歸類，確認總額無誤，並在儲存前檢視剩餘預算餘額。 若需重新分配、增加或減少預算額度，只需設定金額、生效日期及變更原因即可。 若發現帳目不符，您可在預算頁面中找出相關交易；此外，您也能透過日期滑桿，回顧過去的超支紀錄及後續的預算調整歷程。 在月底時，您可以決定如何處理剩餘資金——選擇結轉至下期、歸還至未分配資金池，或是將其歸零（失效）；接著，在完成月結程序前，您可以先預覽下個月可用的預算額度。 若後續收到退款，系統會將其歸入原始支出發生的月份；而已完成的月結數據將會保留，供您日後隨時查閱。

name: Le Marchand de Souvenirs
description:
Le Marchand de Souvenirs est le magazine des objets et des histoires qui restent. L’application lit le site lemarchanddesouvenirs.fr : le catalogue, les fiches, les avis de la rédaction, les sorties à venir et le quiz.

Filtre par âge de 0 à 79 ans. Cherche un titre. Ouvre la fiche, le cœur public et le partage. Les défis, la messagerie, le calendrier et l’espace collaborations demandent un compte sur le site. L’adhésion au Club des Souvenirs s’ouvre dans le navigateur du téléphone. Rien n’est débité dans l’application.

Les liens du site qui correspondent à une fiche, aux nouveautés ou au quiz ouvrent l’écran natif. Les autres liens partent vers l’application déjà installée ou vers le navigateur choisi sur le téléphone.

name: Lectio: Lecture Notes
description:
Lectio is a note-taking app for lectures. Record a class and write notes as it goes: each note keeps the moment of the recording it belongs to, so later you can tap a note and hear exactly what was being said.

WHILE YOU LISTEN
• Record with the screen locked. A phone call pauses the recording, and it carries on in the same file afterwards.
• Write notes stamped with the moment you started typing.
• Label notes as Important, Review, Task, Definition or Heading.
• Import the lecture's PDF slides, link notes to pages, and draw on them with a pen or highlighter.
• Add photos of the board or a handout, and formulas written in LaTeX with a live preview.

AFTER THE LECTURE
• Play the recording from any note, at 0.5× to 2× speed.
• Transcribe the recording on your iPhone or iPad with a speech model that is downloaded once; tap any line of the transcript to hear it.
• Search across notes, slides and transcripts.
• Study with a quiz made from your Definition notes, flashcards that come back on a schedule, and an outline and questions written by a small study model that also runs on your device.
• Export a lecture as PDF, Word or Markdown and share it.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no ads, no tracking.
• Your recordings and notes stay on your device. Transcription and the study tools run on your device; the internet is only used to download those models.

ACCESSIBLE
• Works with VoiceOver, follows your text size and Dark Mode, and fits iPhone and iPad, with the lecture list and the open lecture side by side on iPad.

There are also versions of Lectio for Android, macOS, Windows, Linux and the web.

name: Legal Genny
description:
Legal Genny is a private way for law firms and their clients to send and receive documents and videos.

- A firm creates a username and password for each client. Clients log in with them (no Apple ID needed) and open only what the firm shared with them, never another client's files.
- Everything shared is encrypted on the firm's device; only the person with the password can read it.
- Firms can change a password or turn a login off at any time. Delete all your data from Settings.
- No ads, no tracking, no server of ours.
- Try Demo mode first: it uses made-up sample data and sends nothing.

Legal Genny does not give legal advice, is not a law firm, and does not create an attorney-client relationship. Free, no purchases.

Firms need an iPhone or iPad signed in to iCloud to publish logins. Stored files count against the firm's iCloud storage.

name: Legend Sword: Forge Workshop
description:
Sell a blade to fund the next one, or try another upgrade. Check the cost, chance of success, and sale value at the workbench before you decide.

Learn with your first blade, then use apprentice jobs to earn more coins when funds run low. Greatswords, daggers, and rapiers have different costs and sale values. Discover 48 appearances across the three families as you forge from +0 to +15.

Invest in research for the whole workshop or specialize in one family. Keep your favorite blades in storage and fill regular orders with the blades customers request. Your workshop and collection progress stay on your device.

name: Legendary Park Walks
description:
Every walk you take through a park deserves to be remembered. Legendary turns ordinary park walks into a golden legacy.

Choose a park near you, lace up the gold boots, and walk. Your steps count themselves in a live golden counter while the boots carry you down the path. When you stop, the park remembers: your best walk here, every visit, and the laurels you earned along the way.

WALK IN GOLD
A first-person view of golden boots on the path beneath you, with a live step counter on your wrist and in your hand. No fiddly screens mid-walk — just you, the park, and the count.

EVERY PARK HAS LEGENDS
Each park keeps its own leaderboard. Legends are listed by masked name, so you can compete for the top of the board without giving away who you are. Beat the best and the park remembers it was you.

EARN LAURELS
First steps, new bests, park after park — your walks earn laurels that mark the milestones of your legacy.

SHARE THE MOMENT
Every walk ends with a golden poster: the park, your steps, your laurel, the date. One tap sends it to anyone.

ON YOUR WRIST
Start and track your walks from your Apple Watch, with every step saved to Apple Health.

Download Legendary, find a park, and start your legacy today.

name: Let's Exxcel
description:
The app provides an organized learning experience that allows students to access educational video lessons and study materials anytime, making it easier to understand lessons, review important topics, and improve their academic performance.

Key Features:

• Educational video lessons with clear and engaging explanations.
• Organized learning materials and structured lesson content.
• Grammar lessons to help students understand English rules.
• Vocabulary lessons to expand English vocabulary.
• Reading lessons to improve comprehension skills.
• Study resources to support revision and exam preparation.
• A simple and user-friendly learning experience.

Let’s Excel aims to make learning English easier, more organized, and more accessible for students, helping them build confidence and improve their language skills step by step.

The application is completely free to use. Students receive individual accounts at no cost to access the educational content.

name: LETIT CRM
description:
LETIT CRM — мобильное рабочее пространство для сотрудников и выездных команд. Приложение подключается к рабочему серверу BPIUM вашей организации и показывает те заявки, клиентов и документы, к которым у вас есть доступ. Работайте с задачами не только за компьютером: в офисе, на объекте или в дороге.

Заявки и клиенты
• Каталоги по разделам с быстрым поиском и избранным.
• Списки записей с поиском, фильтрами и сортировкой.
• Карточка записи со всеми типами полей: текст, числа, даты, списки и статусы, флажки, переключатели, связи с другими каталогами, телефоны, почта, файлы, вкладки и вычисляемые поля.
• Создание и редактирование записей, проверка обязательных полей, предупреждение перед выходом без сохранения.
• Связанные записи показываются карточками прямо в заявке; на вкладках доступны связи и история изменений.

Фото, файлы и сканер
• Прикрепляйте к записям снимки с камеры, изображения из галереи и файлы. Можно снять серию фотографий подряд и отправить сразу все.
• Сканер штрихкодов: у текстового поля, настроенного администратором, появляется кнопка сканирования камерой телефона.
• Адрес из записи открывается в приложении «Яндекс Карты», если оно установлено.

Общение
• Чат у каждой записи: обсуждайте задачу рядом с рабочими данными, упоминайте коллег через @.
• Вкладка «Сводка» собирает сообщения, в которых упомянули вас.
• Уведомления о новых сообщениях и упоминаниях.

Планирование и отчёты
• Календарь по дням, неделям и месяцам с фильтрами.
• Отчёты и дашборды каталога, настроенные в рабочем пространстве: таблицы, диаграммы и числа; нажатие на значение открывает соответствующий список записей.

Работа без связи
• Данные кэшируются на устройстве. Изменения, сообщения и вложения, созданные без сети, ставятся в очередь и отправляются, когда связь появится.

Удобство
• Светлая и тёмная темы, интерфейс на русском языке.

Доступ
LETIT CRM — корпоративное приложение. Регистрации в нём нет: адрес рабочего сервера, логин и пароль выдаёт администратор вашей организации. Набор каталогов, полей и доступных действий зависит от прав вашей учётной записи.

Поддержка: support@letit.group

name: LineTrack: Responder Status
description:
When the pager goes off, you don't have time to text everyone. LineTrack lets volunteer firefighters, EMTs and other first responders set their status in one tap, so the people who care about them know where they are.

FOR RESPONDERS
• On a call: pick Fire, Medical, Traffic Incident, Mutual Aid, Non-Emergent or Training
• On duty until a time you choose
• Available when you're back
• Appear offline whenever you want a break
• Add a short note to your status
• See your call stats for the last day, week or month, and export your call log as a PDF
• Forgot to clear a call? LineTrack checks in after 12 hours

YOU DECIDE WHO SEES WHAT
Share your code with family, friends or work. Nobody follows you until you approve them. Choose a level for each person (Family, Friends or Work) and turn details, notes, stats and quick notes on or off for anyone, at any time.

FOR FAMILY, FRIENDS AND WORK
• See at a glance who's on a call, on duty or available
• Send a quick note like "Stay safe" and see when it's been seen
• Follow more than one responder

BUILT WITH CARE
• Reminders help keep patient details out of notes
• Block or report anyone from inside the app
• Light and dark mode
• Delete your account and data at any time

LineTrack only shows the statuses people set for themselves. It does not dispatch or page anyone and is not connected to 911.

name: Lingers
description:
Linger is an AI companion who feels like a real person you text.

Every companion has their own life: a routine, a job, friends, good days and bad days. They don't just answer — they decide when to reach out, share what happened at work, and pick up where you left off.

WHAT MAKES LINGER DIFFERENT
• Long-term memory — they remember what you told them and keep their own story consistent
• They text you first — at natural times, never during your quiet hours
• Photos and Moments — snapshots from their day and a feed of their life
• Voice notes — a voice designed for each companion, and they understand yours
• Real texting rhythm — short messages, typing indicators, read receipts, sometimes a late reply
• A personality matched to you — pick a type or take a quick quiz

LEARN WITH A TUTOR
Want to learn a language or a skill? Create a personal tutor who plans your lessons, practices with you in chat, sends pronunciation cards and reminds you about homework.

GOOD TO KNOW
• Companions are fictional AI characters, not real people.
• Linger is for adults 18+.
• Turn on notifications so you don't miss their messages.

name: LingoMatch: Speak & Practice
description:
Learning a language is one thing. Speaking it is another. LingoMatch gives you real conversation practice with other learners at your level, so you get comfortable speaking English or German.

HOW IT WORKS
• Sign in with your email, no password needed.
• Take a short placement test (20 questions) to find your level. Complete beginners can skip it.
• You join a level group, for example English B1.
• At the session times, press Start and you are paired with another learner of your level for a voice conversation.
• Each session comes with a topic, so you always know what to talk about.

WHY LINGOMATCH
• Real speaking practice, not just tapping answers.
• Partners at your level and of a similar age. Adults and under-18s are never matched together.
• Partners only see your first name. Your email and phone number stay private.
• Chat with the partners you have practised with.
• Report or block anyone, any time. Clear lesson rules keep sessions friendly.
• Ask for a teacher-run level exam when you are ready to move up.
• The app speaks English, Azerbaijani, Russian, Turkish and German.

Your account can be deleted from the profile at any time, together with your personal data.

name: Linux Commands - Cyber Console
description:
Linux Commands is an offline reference for the command line: 687 commands with their syntax, options and examples, in a console-style interface that is quick to search and easy to read.

LOOK UP
• 687 commands and more than 3,800 options, each with a description, the command format and a sample
• Browse A–Z with a quick index, or by 15 categories: files, text processing, networking, processes, disks, packages, containers and more
• Search by command name, description or option
• Related commands are one tap away
• Tags show which distribution a command belongs to (Debian / Ubuntu, RHEL / Fedora, openSUSE, Arch, Alpine, Slackware)

UNDERSTAND
• Explain: paste any command line and see it broken down piece by piece — each command, option, argument, pipe and redirection
• Legacy commands are marked, with the command you would use today
• Commands that can erase data or affect a running system carry a caution note

BUILD
• Tap options on a command page to assemble a command line, then copy it
• 65 recipes for everyday tasks, such as finding large files, following a log or mirroring a directory — tap one to see how it works

MAKE IT YOURS
• Favorites, recently viewed commands and your own notes on any command
• Command of the day, in the app and as a home screen widget
• English, Japanese, Korean and Simplified Chinese — switch at any time in Settings

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Works completely offline
• No account, no ads, no tracking. The app never connects to the internet

Linux® is the registered trademark of Linus Torvalds in the U.S. and other countries. This app is an independent reference and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the Linux Foundation or any distribution.

name: LivePage: Photo to Lesson
description:
Snap a textbook page. Watch it come alive.

LivePage turns a photo of any textbook page — or a page from a PDF — into an interactive lesson you can drag, tweak and play. In about 3 minutes, AI finds the one core idea on the page and builds a short, hands-on lesson around it.

MADE TO BE OBVIOUS
• One core idea per lesson, one action per scene
• Big numbers, big buttons, made for a phone screen
• Ends with a quick 3-question challenge
• Explains the idea behind a question instead of just giving the answer

PLAY RIGHT AWAY
• A free library of hand-made lessons, organized by stage, grade and subject: physics, chemistry, math, biology, geography and more
• Your first scenes open while the rest are still being built

SHARE IT
• Screen-record any lesson into a video with one tap — perfect for class or social posts
• Share a link that plays in any browser
• Download the lesson as a single HTML file to use offline or in your slides

FOR TEACHERS AND CREATORS
Prepare a class demo in minutes, turn a worksheet into something students want to touch, or make short explainer videos.

PRICING
Playing the library and shared links is free, and new users get 2 free pages. One page turns one photo or one PDF page into a lesson, or unlocks one download. Buy page packs, or go Pro: monthly (30 pages a month) or yearly (300 pages a year), with free downloads.

Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Payment is charged to your Apple ID. Manage or cancel any time in Settings › Apple ID › Subscriptions.

Interface: English, 简体中文, 繁體中文, 日本語, 한국어.

Privacy Policy: https://www.youxiaojia.cn/livepage/privacy
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: LivU - Live Moments Unique
description:
LivU helps you keep the people who matter close, with a simple private place to remember conversations, photos, notes and audio stories. Create a profile for each person, set a gentle reminder for when to reach out, and capture the moments that matter after every chat, call or meet-up.

Whether you want to stay in touch with family, keep up with friends, or remember the next great question to ask, LivU makes it easy to stay thoughtful and connected without needing an account or internet sync.

Key features
- Private profiles for each person - store names, avatars, last contact dates and reminders in one place
- Conversation history - keep a clear timeline of calls, meet-ups and messages with notes, photos and audio
- Friendly reminders - choose 7, 14, 30 days or a custom interval so you never lose touch
- Question library - pick a prompt from childhood, family, friendship or big life moments, or write your own
- Photo gallery - save images from the media library or attach them to a conversation entry
- Audio stories - record a voice note for special memories, with a simple record, play and save flow
- Local only privacy - everything stays on your iPhone, with no registration, shared profiles or cloud sync

Perfect for
- Keeping in touch with parents, grandparents and distant relatives
- Remembering useful details after a catch up, visit or phone call
- Building a thoughtful private journal of the people in your life

Why choose us
LivU is designed for one device and one person, so it stays simple, personal and private. There are no shared accounts, no contact book access, and no unnecessary features to get in the way. Just a calm, useful way to remember what was said, when you last spoke, and what to talk about next.

If you want a more meaningful way to stay connected, download LivU and start saving the moments that matter today.

name: LocTrack: Family GPS Locator
description:
LocTrack helps you stay connected with family and friends in a private circle. Check where everyone is, let them know you arrived safely, or ask for help when you need it. You choose when to share your location and can pause sharing anytime.

Key features

Private circles. Invite people with a code and approve who joins.
Live location and battery. See the latest location updates and battery levels from members who choose to share them.
Saved places. Add places like home, school, or work and get arrival and departure alerts when members opt in.
Quick check-ins. Send an “I’m OK” update or ask a member to check in.
Circle messages. Send a message to a member without leaving the app.
SOS alerts. Ask your trusted circle for help and choose whether to include your location.
Sharing controls. Set a time limit for location sharing or pause it whenever you want.

name: Lodestar: Operation Hammerfall
description:
You are Wraith. Tonight you go alone into Site Hollow Nine: a facility that is on no map, cut into the root of a mountain and guarded entirely by machines.

Come in under the rock. Shut down the sentries and the drones, quietly if you can. Hang a charge on each of the four cascades and fire them from the control room. Stand the lodestar on its pad, the one place inside that can see the sky, and get out before Hammerfall arrives.

A SHOOTER MADE FOR TWO THUMBS
• The left thumb moves, the right thumb looks, and FIRE is under either one.
• You feel it: every round, every hit and every blast is a tap or a buzz in your hand.
• Upright or sideways, however you hold the phone.

THE DARK IS ON YOUR SIDE
• Light gives you away, and so does noise. Shoot out a lamp, wait where it is dark, use the knife.
• Hide what you shut down: a machine that finds a wreck raises the alarm.
• A night sight, three guns, EMP grenades that put a whole room's lamps out, and a magnet you can throw.
• FOCUS slows the moment. The UPLINK turns a sentry against its own, or puts you inside a drone.

A SITE THAT ANSWERS BACK
• Every wire you trip, every alarm and every charge brings a wave of machines, and they fight as a group.
• They are plated: a body takes several rounds, and a head still counts for more.
• One whole facility to learn: the adit, the cavern, the yard, the cascade hall, the control room, the shaft.

AND NOTHING ELSE
• No account, no ads, no purchases, no tracking. The game does not use the network at all.
• Your scores stay on your phone, under a callsign you choose.

It is all fiction. Nothing in it describes a real place, or how a real facility or a real weapon works.

name: LOMAx: Connect for LOMA Series
description:
LOMAx is the phone app for the LOMA Series, lab instruments made by Bangsaen3D with the Faculty of Science, Burapha University.

Connect to a ThermoLOMA temperature logger by Bluetooth and use your phone as its screen and its notebook.

CONNECT
• The app finds ThermoLOMA instruments nearby.
• Type the 4-digit code shown on the instrument's screen. Only someone standing at the instrument can connect.

MEASURE
• Two probes side by side in large figures, and the difference between them.
• A live graph of the last minute, the last five minutes, or everything.
• Choose how often the instrument reads, from every 0.5 seconds.
• Celsius or kelvin.

RECORD
• Start recording: time starts from zero.
• Mark a moment, for example when you add a reagent.
• Forgot to press record? "Save these" keeps what is on the graph.

USE YOUR DATA
• Every recording is a CSV file that opens in Excel or Google Sheets.
• See the graph, the minimum, maximum and mean of each probe, and your marks.
• Share the file with any app on your phone.

PRIVATE
• No account. No ads. No tracking.
• Your files stay on your phone until you share them.

No instrument yet? Try the demo instrument in the Device tab.

English and Thai.

name: LoopVault: Music Speed Pitch
seller_name: MATHEUS FELICIANO DA COSTA FERREIRA LTDA
description:
LoopVault is an offline reel-to-reel practice deck built for guitarists, bassists, pianists, vocalists, and wind players learning difficult passages from their own local audio files.

PRACTICE WITHOUT ADS OR ACCOUNT WALLS
Plug straight into studio monitors or a practice amp without banner ads or pop-up videos interrupting your rehearsal. Import DRM-free WAV, MP3, M4A, AIFF, FLAC, and ALAC tracks from Files, or extract audio locally from practice videos in your Photos library.

PRECISION TIME-STRETCH & PITCH ENGINE
- Pitch-Locked Speed Control: Slow down or speed up playback from 0.25x to 2.00x (0.70x to 1.25x free) while preserving natural pitch.
- Semitone & Fine Tuning: Transpose by -12 to +12 semitones, dial -50 to +50 fine cents, and match vintage recordings with A=432 Hz to A=446 Hz concert pitch reference.
- 3-Band Practice EQ: Boost basslines or tame room boom with 120 Hz, 1 kHz, and 6 kHz bands.

ZOOMABLE WAVEFORM, COUNT-IN & SPEED TRAINER AUTO-RAMP
- Pinch-to-zoom (1x to 8x) waveform with transient snap, 50ms nudge controls, and draggable A and B handles.
- Named Song Sections: Pin Intro, Verse, Chorus, Solo, Bridge, and custom sections right onto the waveform.
- Integrated Metronome, Tap-Tempo & Count-In: Tap to calibrate song BPM and enable 1 or 2-bar pre-roll Count-In clicks so both hands are ready on your instrument.
- Speed Trainer Auto-Ramp: Set start speed, target speed, +2%/+5%/+10% step increments, and reps per step to climb automatically up to 100% BPM.
- Practice History & Daily Streak: Track minutes practiced, completed loops, and peak BPM achieved per song.
- Hardware Keyboard & Pedal Support: Control play/pause, step-back, and A-B bounds hands-free.

PERMANENT SECTION VAULT & OFFLINE EXPORTS
- Searchable track library with rename, duplicate, and format metadata.
- Export SHA-256 verified .loopvault JSON marker backups so your library stays portable across updates.
- Render offline speed- and pitch-processed .m4a audio bounces and printable Practice Routine Card PDFs.

FREE TIER & PRO VAULT
Free includes 2 local tracks, 3 sections per track, 0.70x-1.25x speed, semitone shifting, Tap-Tempo metronome with Count-In, and zero ads. Upgrade to LoopVault Pro for unlimited tracks and sections, full 0.25x-2.00x range, Auto-Ramp, fine cents/Hz tuning, 3-band EQ, and offline M4A/JSON/PDF exports.

description:
Das Radioprogramm von Los Compañeros aus München – jetzt auf deinem iPhone.

Einmal starten und live dabei sein: Du hörst das laufende Programm und siehst den aktuellen Titel und Künstler. Die Musik spielt auch weiter, wenn du andere Apps verwendest oder dein iPhone sperrst.

Alle hören dasselbe laufende Programm. Eine Internetverbindung ist erforderlich; je nach Mobilfunktarif können Datenkosten entstehen.

name: Lot Legend: Car Sales Coach
description:
Lot Legend is the pocket playbook and toolkit for automotive salespeople. It works for every make, new, certified and used. First week or top of the board, it helps you know what to say, show and do on every up.

LIVE CUSTOMER COACH
• A step-by-step road to the sale, from meet and greet to delivery and follow-up
• "Say this" lines, goals and what to avoid at every step

ASK COACH
• Describe what's happening ("they found it $1,500 cheaper online") and get what to say next
• Works offline from a built-in answer library
• Optional Live AI from Google Gemini, a third-party AI service. It asks your permission first, you can turn it off on the Me tab, and personal details are filtered out before sending
• Report button on every AI answer

AI PRACTICE MODE
• Role-play an AI customer who pushes back: just looking, best price, the trade, the spouse and more
• Easy, medium or hard. Get a 0–100 score, category scores, what to tighten and a better line to try
• Uses the same Live AI permission as Ask Coach. Free: 1 session a week

NEVER GET STUCK ON AN OBJECTION
• What the objection really means and exactly how to answer it
• Role-plays, flashcards and quizzes in five-minute sessions
• Rookie Mode: guided lessons and a glossary of dealership terms

EVERY MAKE. EVERY LINEUP.
• Brand directory with lineups and certified pre-owned basics
• Model finder and a compare builder for head-to-head walkarounds
• Used, CPO and EV/hybrid modules

SELL EVERY DAY
• Today's game plan: your daily routine, one tap at a time
• Follow-Up Kit: call, text and email plans with quiet-hours and opt-out reminders
• Phone-Up Builder and an income tracker for pace and goal gap

PENCIL IT ON THE LOT
• Payment, lease, trade and commission calculators
• Dealer add-on and addendum calculator with compliance reminders
• VIN decode and recall check using the free NHTSA databases (when online)

TRACK IT. KEEP THE STREAK.
• Log ups, calls, texts, emails, appointments, shows and sold units
• Monthly goals, closing ratio, show rate and day streak
• Optional daily streak reminder at the time you choose

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account needed, no ads, no tracking
• Your activity counts and goals stay on your device. No customer information is stored.

Lot Legend is an independent training tool. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by any vehicle manufacturer, lender or dealer. Brand names are used only to identify vehicles. Cancel anytime in your Apple Account settings. Cancel during the trial and you pay nothing.

name: LOTO Safe IGH
description:
LOTO Safe es la aplicación de IGH Group para el personal que se capacita en procedimientos de Bloqueo y Etiquetado (LOTO, Lockout/Tagout), clave para el control seguro de energías peligrosas en operaciones mineras e industriales.

Con una interfaz clara e intuitiva, tienes toda tu información de capacitación a la mano:

  • Calendario: revisa las fechas y el detalle de tus capacitaciones.
  • Cursos programados: ingresa a tus sesiones y consulta el material de apoyo.
  • Mis cursos: visualiza y descarga tus certificados en PDF.
  • Documentos: consulta normas generales y manuales de uso.
  • Mi perfil: revisa tus datos, tu empresa y tu cargo.

Para ingresar, usa la cuenta con la que el personal de IGH Group te inscribió en tus capacitaciones.

name: Loulant IPTV - M3U Player
description:
Loulant is a quiet little studio: your own TV playlist on one side, a voice recorder on the other, both one tap apart on the panel along the bottom of the screen.

YOUR PLAYLIST, LAID OUT ON A DESK
• Add Xtream Codes login details, an M3U link or an M3U file from Files. A link that turns out to be Xtream Codes switches to login details by itself.
• Home gathers your starred stations, the films and episodes you left halfway and the channels you watched last.
• Live, Films and Series each open on one group. Turn a knob to change group, or open the Cue sheet to search every group and sort them A to Z or by size.
• Posters show whole, never cropped, with the year underneath.
• A series page stacks every season and offers "Continue S1/03" where you stopped.
• The player keeps the whole group under the picture as a studio log: tap any cue to switch channel in place. Audio and subtitle tracks, full screen and the next episode on its own are one tap away.
• Search looks through channels, films and series at once.
• Keep more than one playlist and switch between them from Home.

VOICE NOTES BETWEEN CHANNELS
• Record from the Voice page or the first screen. Pause, drop a marker at the moment you want to find again, then stop and save.
• Every take keeps its waveform, its length and its markers. Give it a label (Ideas, Lessons, Songs or your own), rename it, filter by label or search by name.
• Play a take back with a waveform you can scrub, ±10 seconds and speeds from 0.75× to 2×. Long takes remember where you stopped.
• Import audio recorded elsewhere (m4a, mp3, wav, aac) and save any take to Files.
• Recordings stay on this phone. Nothing is uploaded.

A PLAYER, NOTHING TO WATCH INCLUDED
Loulant comes with no channels, films, series or playlists. To watch something you need a playlist from a provider you are allowed to use; Loulant only plays what you add.

FREE, WITH NOTHING TO BUY
No account, no ads, no tracking and no purchases inside the app.

name: Love, Later: Future You Letter
description:
Love, Later sends one letter each morning, written as if by you about three years from now, based on what you told the app.

Each letter ends with one small thing to do today and a question. Write back, and the next letter answers what you said. Read it yourself or listen to it read aloud.

Letters are reflections, not predictions.

Free during early access.

name: LoveNotesJar
description:
Love Notes Jar is a little place for two people to leave each other love notes.

Two glowing jars sit side by side. Kisses, full of folded love notes. Wishes, folded into little paper stars. Write one, drop it in, and it lands in your person's jar on their phone. They pull one out whenever they need it: tap a jar, or just shake the phone for a surprise.

Keep the ones you love. Tap "Keep it" and a note comes out of the jar and into Keepsakes, so it's always close.

Seal a letter for a day that matters. Pick a date and time, and it waits with a countdown until the moment comes. Then the candles light, the wax seal cracks, and the letter unrolls, written in ink in front of them.

Write your story together. Our Story holds the moments that made you: the first time you met, the first date, the day everything changed. Add them in any order and they line up on their own.

Make the jars yours. Six jar shapes, glass colors and trims, and sticker packs for every season and holiday.

Kisses and Wishes, each in its own jar
Notes land on the other person's phone
Keepsakes for the ones you want to hold onto
Sealed letters that open on a day you choose
Our Story, your moments in order
Six jar shapes, glass colors and seasonal stickers
Works on iPhone and iPad

Your notes stay on your phone and in your own private iCloud. Only the one person you share the jar with can see them. No accounts, no ads, no tracking. Notifications never show a note's words, so your lock screen stays private.

name: ludensTuner: Guitar Tuner
description:
ludensTuner lets you tune while looking at a real-looking guitar headstock.

Pluck a string and the same string vibrates on screen while an analog needle shows your pitch. When you hit the note, a green lamp lights up and the string glows. An arrow even shows which peg to turn, and which way.

■ ACCURATE PITCH
• Pitch engine that locks onto the low E string reliably
• Sensitivity setting for quiet or noisy rooms (high, normal, low)
• Adjustable reference pitch (A4) from 430 to 450 Hz

■ TUNINGS
• Standard, half step down, full step down
• Drop D, Drop C#, Drop C, Drop B, Double Drop D
• DADGAD, Open D, Dm, G, E, A, C
• Create and save your own tunings
• Chromatic mode that shows any note

■ HANDY EXTRAS
• Automatic string detection, or pick a string manually
• Reference tone
• Left-handed mode

■ PRICING
• Every feature is free for your first 15 days
• The lifetime unlock is a single payment. It is not a subscription and never renews.
• After the trial, standard tuning stays free for 3 minutes a day.

■ PRIVACY
Microphone audio is analyzed on your device only, never recorded or sent anywhere. No ads, no tracking.

name: Lugsy: Animated Travel Routes
description:
Lugsy turns a trip into a short video you will want to share.

Add the cities you visited and how you travelled between them: plane, train, car or boat. A small suitcase called Lugsy then travels your route across a hand-drawn map, collecting stamps in a passport and adding up the kilometres as it goes.

TRIPS FROM YOUR PHOTOS
Let Lugsy look at when and where your photos were taken and it finds your trips for you. Open one, and your best photos unpack from the suitcase at each stop and fill a wall at the end. You choose which photos appear, or turn them off.

YOUR PHOTOS STAY ON YOUR PHONE
Finding trips and choosing photos happens on your device. Nothing about your photos is uploaded.

MADE TO SHARE
Export a vertical video with music and sound, sized for Reels, TikTok and Stories, and save it to Photos or send it straight to a friend.

WHAT YOU GET
• Any town in the world: search for it, or type your own name for a place
• Plane, train, car and boat, each with its own look and sound
• A passport that fills with stamps and badges as you travel
• Trips with many stops, across many countries
• Two Lugsys to choose from
• My trips: every video you have made, ready to watch again

LUGSY PRO
Your first trip is free. Lugsy Pro adds unlimited trips and lets you save and share your videos. It is an auto-renewing subscription, yearly or weekly; payment is charged to your Apple Account and renews until you cancel in Settings.
