name: Lumen: Maze of Light
description:
A little ball of light rolls through dreamy isometric mazes. Find the way, open the gates, collect the shining shards — and guide the light home to its glowing arch.

Lumen is a calm puzzle game for the whole family. No timers that punish, no lives to lose: a fall simply sends the ball back to the start, so you can explore at your own pace.

EIGHT WORLDS, 48 LEVELS From a pink dawn to a northern aurora — lagoon, dusk, desert, night, garden and snow in between. Every world has its own sky, colours and music.

SOMETHING NEW IN EVERY WORLD • Switches and gates: roll onto a switch and a pulse of light opens its gate • Breathing walls that slowly rise and sink — wait for the moment • Crumbling tiles that hold you only for a second • Shards to collect and a goal time to beat for three stars

16 BALLS TO COLLECT Stars unlock new balls: a beach ball, a watermelon, a ladybug, the Moon, the Earth, gold and more.

PLAY YOUR WAY • Drag a finger anywhere on the screen, tilt the phone, or use a game controller • Plays offline — no internet needed • Phones and tablets, portrait and landscape on tablets • Larger text, high contrast, reduced motion and screen reader labels • Nine languages: English, Ukrainian, German, French, Spanish, Portuguese, Japanese, Chinese and Russian

GENTLE SOUND Every world has its own soft tune, and every bump, gate and shard has its own sound. Separate volume for music and effects.

FAIR AND SIMPLE All levels are free to play. The game shows a short ad between levels now and then (never during a level and never in the first world), and an optional video lets you open the next ball early. Ads are non-personalized and suitable for all ages. A one-time purchase, “No ads”, turns off the ads between levels. No accounts, no chat, no links out.

Made by a small family studio — our own kids were the first players.

Questions or ideas? games@okleo.agency

name: Lumora: Flashlight
description:
Lumora is the most beautiful way to turn on your flashlight.

One screen. One button. Tap to turn the light on, tap again to turn it off.

name: Lumtidy
description:
Lumtidy finds the duplicates, retakes and space-hungry videos on your iPhone – and lets you decide what goes. Nothing is uploaded. Nothing is pushed on you.

HONEST BY DESIGN
• Everything is analysed on your iPhone. No servers, no account, no ads, no tracking.
• Only exact copies are selected for you. Everything else waits for your decision.
• Favorites are never suggested for deletion, and photos in your own albums can be protected.
• No paywall when you open the app, no weekly plans and no hidden trials.

FIND SPACE YOU DIDN'T KNOW YOU HAD
• Exact duplicates – a pixel-level double check, so "duplicate" really means identical. The best copy is always kept.
• Similar shots – bursts and retakes grouped together, with the sharpest one suggested.
• Smart screenshots – tickets, QR codes, receipts and recent screenshots are left alone.
• Large videos and screen recordings – your biggest files, largest first.
• Saved from chats – memes and forwards from WhatsApp, Messenger, Telegram and Snapchat.
• Blurry and failed shots, and photos of receipts and notes.

KEEP WHAT MATTERS – JUST SMALLER
• Shrink videos to sharp 1080p HEVC, often a third of the size. Date, place and albums stay.
• Turn huge ProRAW and 48 MP photos into crisp 24 MP photos.
• Turn Live Photos into stills and drop the video clip you never watch.

RELIVE, NOT JUST DELETE
• Rediscover: photos from this week in earlier years. Keep the best, let the rest go – swipe up to love one, and it becomes a favorite in your Rediscovered album.
• Your trips: Lumtidy spots trips from where your photos were taken – on your iPhone, never looked up online – so you can tidy a whole holiday at once.
• Your garden grows a little every time you tidy, with a new flower for every month you keep it up.
• Home Screen widget: see your garden and how much you can free up at a glance.

MORE
• Swipe through a month: left to delete, right to keep, undo in one tap.
• Files & cloud drives: find big files and true copies in iCloud Drive, Google Drive, Dropbox and OneDrive, straight from the Files app.
• Nothing is final: deleted items stay in Recently Deleted for 30 days, and Lumtidy tells you when the space is actually freed.
• An optional monthly reminder for a one-minute tidy-up.

FREE AND PRO
Scanning, exact duplicates and screenshots are free forever. Lumtidy Pro unlocks everything else, monthly, yearly or as a one-time lifetime purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically and can be cancelled at any time in Settings › Apple Account › Subscriptions.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://lumtidy.app/privacy.html

name: Lumza: M3U & Xtream Player
description:
Lumza is a quiet little music room for the evening: your TV playlist on one key, your own songs on the next, and a recorder ready for the tune that turns up while you watch.

ALONG THE PIANO KEYS
Six keys run along the bottom of the screen: Home, Live, Films, Series, Music and Voice. The key you are on stays pressed, so you always know where you are.

YOUR PLAYLIST
• Add Xtream Codes login details, an M3U link or an M3U file from Files. Every playlist gets a name you choose.
• Groups sit on a staff line: tap a note to open a group, or the clef to search, sort and pin your groups.
• Live channels in clear rows, films and series as posters, every season of a show stacked in order.
• Bravos keep your favourite channels, films and series one tap away. Recent channels and Continue sit on Home.
• Films and episodes start again where you stopped.
• The player keeps a numbered setlist of the channels under the picture: next, previous, pause, ten seconds back or ahead, audio and subtitle tracks.

MUSIC
• Add songs from Files: Lumza copies them in and reads their titles, artists, albums and covers.
• Tracks, albums and artists; your own playlists; Up next you can reorder.
• Shuffle, repeat, playback speed and a sleep timer that fades out gently.
• Keeps playing with the screen locked or in another app, and pauses when a channel or a recording starts.

VOICE
• Tap Record and catch the idea: a live waveform, Pause, and Marker for the moment you want to find again.
• Name your takes, sort them under labels such as Hooks, Verses or Melodies, and search them.
• Scrub the waveform, change the speed, jump to a marker, Save to Files, or import an audio file.

A PLAYER, NOTHING MORE
Lumza comes with no channels, films, series, songs or recordings. To watch TV you need a playlist from a provider you are allowed to use; your songs and takes are your own files. Lumza has no account, no ads, no tracking and nothing to buy. What you add stays on this device.

English.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy policy: https://lumza.pages.dev/privacy
Questions: support@lumza.app

name: LUNASIDE
description:
You have landed on the Moon. Take a look at the sky.

LUNASIDE is a free entertainment app for an imagined lunar stay. Rotate the Moon, choose a landing site, and explore how Earth and the Sun look from that location.

EARTH WATCH
Find Earth's direction, elevation, and illuminated fraction in the lunar sky. Change the UTC time or play through 24 hours to watch Earth's appearance change. See the approximate one-way light time to Earth.

LUNAR SHADOW
See the Sun's position, daylight, and the direction and length of a shadow. Jump to the next approximate sunrise or sunset and explore the changing lunar day.

LUNAR ARC
A flight timer that opens in lunar-range gravity. On Earth, see the device's live acceleration and the locked instrument. After a stationary lunar-range reading, the app can measure the interval between release and contact and estimate peak height. Lunar-surface device testing has not been performed. Never throw the device on Earth.

Choose your lunar location and observation time manually. The views use approximations and omit local terrain and weather. They are for entertainment and are not suitable for navigation or life support.

name: Luxmark: Light Meter
description:
Luxmark turns your iPhone camera into a reflected light meter for film and manual cameras. Point it at the scene and read the exposure.

METER
• Aperture priority or shutter priority, on marked third stops
• ISO from 25 to 25600, with EV and lux shown for every reading
• Hold a reading, then turn the dials to see equal exposures
• Calibration from −3 to +3 EV in thirds, to match your camera or a meter you trust

LUXMARK PRO
• Spot metering: tap a face, a sky or a shadow and meter just that point
• Film stocks: Ilford, Kodak and Fujifilm presets set the box speed and correct long exposures for reciprocity failure
• ND filters: dial in 1 to 20 stops and get the long exposure as a bulb time
• Exposure log: save each frame's settings with a note, and share the roll as CSV
• Try each Pro tool 3 times for free. Pro is a one-time purchase that also covers every Pro tool added later

Phone cameras differ by up to about half a stop, so check Luxmark once against sunny 16 or another meter and set the calibration.

Luxmark collects no data. The camera is used only to read the light; no photo is taken, saved or sent. No account, no ads.

name: M Ballroom Music
description:
M Ballroom Music (Feel the Beat) is a practice music app for ballroom dance teachers, students and competitors.

LIBRARY
- 233 built-in tracks sorted by dance: Latin (Samba, Cha Cha Cha, Rumba, Paso Doble, Jive) and Standard (Waltz, Tango, Viennese Waltz, Foxtrot, Quickstep)
- Tempo (BPM) and length shown for every track
- Import your own music

PRACTICE
- Change the speed from 50% to 130% without changing the pitch
- Real-voice beat count: one switch, counting along with the music in the way each dance is counted
- Downbeat correction: adjust where the "1" falls when the count is off
- Playlists: line up the tracks you want to practise and play them back to back

COMPETITION SIMULATOR
- Design your own schedule: dance order, length of each dance and the break in between
- A competition timer changes tracks for you, following the schedule

EVENTS
- Enter the event code published by the organiser and vote for your top six couples, one ballot per account
- See the popularity board and the judges' results

ACCOUNT
- Sign in with Apple or Google; playlists, tempo and downbeat settings sync across your devices
- Delete your account and cloud data in the app at any time

The app interface is in Traditional Chinese.

name: Machos em Reforma
description:
O Machos em Reforma é o ministério de homens fundado pelo Ap. Ciani, da Igreja do Avivamento Cristão, para ajudar pregadores, pais e maridos a viverem uma fé de verdade dentro de casa, na igreja e no trabalho.

• Um passo por dia: versículo, um conteúdo curto e uma pergunta para pensar
• Cursos com começo, meio e fim, como o "Homens Visionários"
• Temas: pai presente, casamento, liderança, mente e emoções, fé e caráter
• Dinâmicas prontas para grupos de homens
• A Bíblia completa, com envio de versículos pelo WhatsApp
• Áudios que continuam tocando com a tela bloqueada
• Lembrete diário no horário que você escolher
• Letra grande e botões grandes, fácil para qualquer idade

O acesso é exclusivo para assinantes.

name: Madam Studio
description:
Madam Studio is the animation studio's own workspace for the people who make its shows. This app is for creators who work with the studio.

YOU NEED AN APPROVED ACCOUNT
Anyone can make an account, but the app stays empty until the studio connects that account to a creator. If you don't work with Madam Studio, this app has nothing for you beyond the studio's public pages.

STUDIO CHAT
Group chats and threads for each team, private messages, pictures, and a bell for what you missed.

YOUR PAGE
Your deadlines, with hand-ins and notes from the producers. Your board. Your files, and files the studio sent you. What you have been paid and what is still owed.

SIGN IN YOUR WAY
Sign in with Apple, Google, or a username and password.

YOUR ACCOUNT, YOUR CALL
Delete your account from inside the app whenever you want.

FIVE LANGUAGES
English, Filipino, Arabic, Spanish and Japanese.

name: Magnet Master: Candy Puzzle
description:
One tap, a whole flood of candy!

In Magnet Master you tap the magnet on the edge of the board and every candy on the board slides that way at once. Candies that pass through x2 and x3 gates multiply and pour into the jars of their own colour. Fill every jar before you run out of moves to win the level!

It starts easy and gets cleverly harder. Think about which magnet to tap first: the right order doubles, triples or even multiplies your candies by six; the wrong move sends them into a pit.

WHY YOU'LL LOVE IT
• One-tap controls and no timer: think at your own pace.
• Explosive multiplying: chain gates together and watch the jars overflow.
• New ideas arrive one by one: multiplier gates, gate chains, pits, paint gates, one-way paths and magnets with limited uses.
• HARD levels for true puzzle masters, with bonus coins when you beat them.
• Unlimited undo: don't be afraid to make mistakes, try and learn.
• Hints show the next right move whenever you are stuck.
• Boosters: drop a Golden Gate (x2) on any empty tile, or add an Extra Magnet on a free edge.
• Daily reward streak and star chests.
• Leaderboards: global, country and weekly. Add friends with a code and compare your stars.
• A warm wooden toy table, shiny candies, sweet sounds and haptics.
• Play offline, anytime.

Every level is short and smart: one "aha!" moment, then just one more level.

Can you fill every jar within the move limit? Tap a magnet and start the candy flood!

The game is free to play. It contains ads and optional in-app purchases (remove ads, coin packs).

name: MagnoScan: Stud & Metal Finder
description:
MagnoScan turns your phone's magnetic sensor into an honest stud finder, metal detector and level. Scanning is always free: no timers, no paywall in the middle of a job.

FIND STUDS
Drywall is fixed to studs with steel screws and nails. Choose Wall studs mode, slide the phone slowly along the wall and listen: the beep gets faster as you get closer, and the screen says "Screw or nail detected". A vertical row of hits marks a stud.

FREE TOOLS
• Big needle gauge with a plain-language signal (weak, medium, strong)
• Faster beep and vibration as you get closer
• Live 10-second graph
• Set zero and figure-8 calibration guide
• Level tool for shelves and frames
• 3-step intro: case off, where your phone's sensor is, slide slowly
• How-to guide

MAGNOSCAN PRO (one-time purchase, no subscription)
• Stud map: mark the studs you find, see the spacing (16", 24", 40 cm) and where the next stud should be
• X/Y/Z graph with min/avg/max and fine sensitivity
• Offline drilling & anchor guide by load and wall type
• Wall notes saved on your phone
• Beep sound options
• No ads
You can also try Pro free for 24 hours by watching a short ad.

WHAT IT CAN AND CANNOT DO
MagnoScan measures magnetic fields, so it finds iron and steel (screws, nails, rebar near the surface) within a few centimeters. It does not see wood, plastic, copper, aluminum or live wires, and it is not a professional cable or pipe detector. Always check for electrical lines and pipes before drilling. Remove magnetic cases and MagSafe accessories for best results.

name: Mahj Reps: American Mah Jongg
seller_name: Henan Zhentianlei Culture Media Co., Ltd
description:
Five minutes a day to get better at American mah jongg.

Learned to play at Thursday's lesson and forgot it all by next week? Mahj Reps gives you one short puzzle every day, plus focused drills for the parts beginners find hardest: reading the card and choosing what to pass in the Charleston.

FIVE MINUTES A DAY
• A new daily puzzle. Everyone gets the same 13 tiles.
• Step 1: pick the one or two hands worth going for.
• Step 2: choose the three tiles to pass in the first Charleston.
• See the best hand, how many tiles each option still needs, which three tiles to pass, and a plain-English reason why.
• Close to the best answer? It counts, and the app shows you what made the difference.
• Keep your streak going, with an optional daily reminder and a Home Screen widget.

BIG, EASY-TO-READ TILES
• Big tiles, at least 44 points wide on every iPhone, with three sizes to choose from. Bigger still on iPad.
• Two neat rows in portrait, one row in landscape. Works on iPhone and iPad.
• Arabic numerals in the corner of every number tile, so you never have to guess a crak.
• Supports larger system text, Dark Mode and VoiceOver. Tap only, no dragging.
• Left-handed mode puts the main buttons on the left.

SIX DRILLS
• Tiles: name every tile, including Soap, flowers and winds.
• Reading the card: match a line of the card to a real hand.
• Picking a hand: deal after deal of the daily puzzle's first question.
• Charleston: all three passes, including when a blind pass makes sense.
• Jokers: where a joker can and can't go, and when you can swap one.
• Calling: can you call this discard, and what can you still make afterwards?

ONE-TIME PURCHASE. NO SUBSCRIPTION.
• The daily puzzle is free, forever.
• Free players also get 5 drill questions a day, shared across all six drills.
• One purchase of $9.99 unlocks unlimited drills, past daily puzzles and your accuracy stats. Pay once and keep it. No subscription, no trial that turns into a charge.

YOUR OWN PRACTICE CARD
Mahj Reps uses its own original practice card, built around the usual categories (2468, consecutive runs, like numbers, winds and dragons, and more). You can browse every hand in the app. The skills you build here, reading a hand and choosing what to pass, carry over to any card you play with.

No account and no sign-up. Puzzles and drills work offline, on your device.

Mahj Reps is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to any mah jongg league or organization. It uses its own practice card.

name: MajorNote
description:
Sing – die Noten schreiben sich.

MajorNote verwandelt deine Stimme oder dein Instrument in Noten. Tippe auf „Einsingen“, sing zum Metronom – und die Noten erscheinen, während du singst.

SO GEHT'S
• Beginne jede Note mit einem deutlichen „T“: ta – taa – ta. Daran erkennt MajorNote sicher, wo eine Note anfängt.
• Für Flöte, Klavier, Gitarre & Co.: Wisch auf der großen Taste zur Seite zu „Einspielen“.
• Sag Tonart, Tempo, Taktart und Schlüssel einfach an – oder stell sie mit einem Tipp auf die Notenzeile ein.
• Das Metronom tickt den Grundton deiner Tonart, damit du die Tonlage hältst.

NOTEN BEARBEITEN
• Tippe auf eine Note und ändere Tonhöhe, Notenwert, Punktierung, Vorzeichen und Oktave.
• Zieh Noten direkt nach oben oder unten, setze Pausen sowie Halte- und Bindebögen, füge Noten ein oder lösche sie.
• Triolen, Quintolen und andere N-tolen: Gruppe markieren und N-tole wählen.
• Rückgängig und Wiederholen, Transponieren, Takt verschieben, Notenwerte verdoppeln oder halbieren.
• Notennamen unter den Noten einblenden.

WEITERGEBEN
• Als PDF (ganze A4-Seite oder nur die Notenzeilen), als Bild, als MusicXML für MuseScore, Finale & Co. oder als MIDI.
• Drucken, teilen oder als Bild in Notizen und Dokumente einfügen.
• Notengröße, Taktzahlen und Notennamen im Export einstellbar.

MEINE MELODIEN
• Beliebig viele Melodien, jede mit eigenem Tempo, eigener Taktart, Tonart und eigenem Schlüssel. Suchen, duplizieren, löschen.

AUCH AUF DEM IPAD
• Das ganze Notenblatt wie auf dem Ausdruck, Seitenleiste mit allen Melodien, Zoom mit zwei Fingern, Tastaturbefehle, Trackpad und Apple Pencil.

PRIVAT
• Kein Konto, keine Werbung, keine Analyse. Deine Aufnahmen und Melodien bleiben auf deinem Gerät.

EINMALKAUF
• Ansehen, Bearbeiten und Anhören vorhandener Melodien ist immer kostenlos. Einsingen, Einspielen und Weitergeben sind mit einem einmaligen Kauf für 24,99 € freigeschaltet.

Nutzungsbedingungen: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Datenschutz: https://majornote-app.netlify.app/privacy.html

name: MakaKami
description:
Discover what Malaysians are building. MakaKami brings together Malaysian-made websites, mobile apps, desktop software and open-source projects, with daily picks, curated collections and notes from people who use them.

• Browse by category or search for a product that fits what you need.
• Read what people use a product for and visit the maker’s official site or store listing.
• Follow categories you care about. Sign in to carry your follows and saved collections across phones.
• Explore Testers if you’d like to try a Malaysian product and give its maker private feedback.

You can browse and follow categories as a guest. MakaKami is available in English and Bahasa Melayu.

name: Make My Workout
description:
Make a workout that fits your time, equipment and training focus. Make My Workout helps you plan your session, follow it one exercise at a time and see how your recorded performance changes.

BUILD YOUR WORKOUT
Choose a full-body, upper-body, lower-body, conditioning or custom muscle-group focus. Set your available time and experience, then use the equipment you actually have. Save separate setups for home, the gym or travel, including your available weights.

MAKE IT YOURS
Review exercises, sets, reps, weights and rest before starting. Swap an exercise, freshen the selection or save a favorite setup for next time. Optional warm-ups and cooldowns fit within the session budget.

TRAIN ONE SET AT A TIME
Use clear rep and weight controls, timed intervals, rest timers and written exercise instructions. Pause, skip rest, edit targets or finish early. Save and return to an interrupted workout without counting time while the app was closed.

PLAN YOUR WEEK
Choose your workout days and equipment for each day. Review your weekly plan and add optional reminders. Set a weekly goal without filling your schedule with extra tasks.

SEE YOUR PROGRESS
Review completed and partial workouts, correct recorded results, favorite a session and do it again. Charts show training time and exercise-specific weight, reps, sets, volume and recorded work time. A workout calendar highlights completed days.

WORKS WITHOUT A CLOUD ACCOUNT
The local workout builder works offline. Apple’s on-device AI can personalize workouts on compatible devices with Apple Intelligence enabled. Optional OpenAI and Anthropic connections use your own API key, require consent and incur charges from the selected provider. They are not required to use the app.

YOUR RECORDS, YOUR CHOICE
Workout records are stored locally, with manual JSON export and import for backup. Optional Apple Health support can save workouts and display measurements when a compatible source supplies them. Health permission is not required. No Apple Watch app is included.

Requires iOS 26 or later. On-device AI availability depends on your device, language and Apple Intelligence settings. Workout targets and calorie readings are estimates; review your plan and choose appropriate exercises and loads.

name: Mandala Bloom
description:
raw a mandala from a blank canvas or choose one of 100 designs to color. Mandala Bloom brings drawing, coloring, and your saved artwork together in one offline studio.

Draw your own patterns  
Build a mandala ring by ring with 37 built-in shapes. Change the size, spacing, rotation, and number of repeats as you work. Sculpt a custom motif in Shape Garden and use it in future designs.

Color at your own pace  
Explore collections like Sacred Flowers, Wild Garden, and Folk & Mehndi. Color a single shape, its matching repeats, or an entire ring. Pick a palette or mix your own colors, and pinch to zoom in on small details.

Keep your blooms  
Switch between drawing and coloring, undo changes, and pick up where you left off with autosave. Save pieces to My Blooms, then export a high-resolution PNG, a printable SVG outline, or an editable backup you can restore from Files.

Mandala Bloom works offline, with no ads or accounts.

name: mapico: travel map & stats
description:
mapico turns everywhere you've been into a map that's yours.

Tap in the countries and regions you've visited and watch your world fill in. Add trips with every stop along the way, or log a quick visit with a long-press on the map. mapico counts the 195 UN countries, keeps territories apart, and lets you choose whether Taiwan and Kosovo count.

YOUR MAP
• Countries and regions coloured in as you travel
• Your routes drawn on the map, from home and back
• Look back by year or month, or spin the globe to a random country
• Keep a wishlist of places you still want to see

TRIPS
• Build a trip stop by stop, with dates, travel between stops and photos
• Travelled together? Friends get their own copy of a shared trip
• Turn a trip into a short video recap or a photo to share

IMPORT YOUR TRAVELS IN MINUTES
• From your photo library: mapico reads where and when your photos were taken and suggests countries and trips. This happens on your phone; your photos are not uploaded
• From your Google Maps Timeline export
• From other travel map apps

STATS FOR THE CURIOUS
• Countries, regions and share of the world you've seen
• Days abroad, distance travelled, longest trips and favourite months
• Every country's page shows your full history there: visits, days per year and the regions you've seen

TRAVEL WITH FRIENDS
• Follow friends' trips in your feed and clap for them
• See which friends have been where you're going
• Put your map next to a friend's with Versus and share the result

mapico is free. Your travels are private to you and your friends, and you can delete your account and everything in it at any time from Settings.

name: Mapling: Lưu giữ chuyến đi
description:
Mỗi chuyến đi đã nằm sẵn trong thư viện ảnh của bạn. Mapling đọc vị trí trong ảnh rồi vẽ lại cả hành trình trên bản đồ: đi đâu, dừng ở đâu, lúc mấy giờ. Sau đó biến nó thành poster để in treo tường, hoặc video 9:16 để đăng Story.

Miễn phí, không quảng cáo, không cần tài khoản.

VẼ LẠI CHUYẾN ĐI TỪ ẢNH
• Tự tìm các chuyến đi trong thư viện ảnh, hoặc tự chọn ảnh, chọn khoảng ngày.
• Vệt đường theo đường thật, đúng số km. Chặng bay vẽ thành nét cong.
• Tự đặt tên điểm dừng: bảo tàng, bãi biển, đền chùa. Đi food tour thì ra tên quán.
• Ảnh không có GPS được đoán vị trí theo ảnh chụp gần nhất.

POSTER ĐỂ IN, VIDEO ĐỂ ĐĂNG
• 14 kiểu bản đồ: Sương, Giấy dó, Bản đồ cổ, Đất nung, Đêm, Vệ tinh…
• Khổ A4, khổ vuông và khổ Story, 3 kiểu chữ.
• File in PDF khổ A4, A3, 30×30 cm có lề xén, mang thẳng ra tiệm in.
• Video hành trình tự vẽ dần, các con số đếm lên theo vệt đường. Lưu vào Ảnh hoặc mở Instagram Story ngay trong app.

VIỆT NAM CỦA BẠN
• Tô màu 34 tỉnh thành đã đến theo địa giới mới, có Hoàng Sa và Trường Sa.
• Chạm một tỉnh để xem các chuyến đi ở đó. Xuất poster "Việt Nam của tôi".

TỔNG KẾT NĂM
• Gom mọi chuyến trong năm thành một poster và một video: bao nhiêu chuyến, bao nhiêu km, những tỉnh lần đầu đến.

KỶ NIỆM TỰ TÌM ĐẾN BẠN
• Widget "Ngày này năm trước" và "Việt Nam của bạn" trên màn hình chính.
• Đi chơi về, Mapling nhận ra chuyến mới trong thư viện ảnh và nhắc bạn làm poster.
• Đúng ngày tròn một năm sau mỗi chuyến, một lời nhắc xem lại hành trình.

RIÊNG TƯ VÀ MIỄN PHÍ
• Ảnh được đọc ngay trên máy, không tải lên đâu. Chỉ toạ độ các điểm dừng được gửi cho Apple Maps để vẽ bản đồ và tìm đường.
• Mọi tính năng đều miễn phí. Mua trong app chỉ để mời nhà phát triển một que kem, tuỳ ý, không mở khoá gì.
• Dùng trên iPhone và iPad, có tiếng Việt và tiếng Anh.

Có góp ý hay gặp lỗi? Vào Cài đặt › Gửi góp ý, thư nào cũng được đọc.

MUA TRONG APP
Các món ở màn Ủng hộ Mapling là gói mua một lần (tiêu hao), không phải gói đăng ký: không tự gia hạn, không mở khoá tính năng nào, mua hay không là tuỳ bạn. Tiền được trừ vào tài khoản Apple khi bạn xác nhận mua.

Điều khoản sử dụng: https://mapling.pages.dev/terms/
Chính sách quyền riêng tư: https://mapling.pages.dev/privacy/

name: Master Estimate
description:
Master Estimate helps contractors and handymen build a renovation or construction estimate right on site, from a phone.

FEATURES
• Tiling, painting, screed, masonry, drywall, electrical, underfloor heating
• Full room renovation and whole projects room by room
• House building: foundation, block or brick walls, floors, roof, windows — with a 3D view
• Draw a floor plan with your finger: areas, perimeter and corners are calculated for you
• Materials with real consumption and whole packs: how many bags, buckets, sheets to buy
• Your own price list, used in every estimate
• Manual estimate as a table: stages, custom items, material receipts
• Advance payments and balance due
• Estimate in PDF and Excel, certificate of completed works, text for messengers
• Totals in local currency or US dollars at your own rate
• One-file backup, saved to the Files app
• Other contractors' prices (optional): share your labour rates anonymously and see what contractors in your city usually charge

No sign-up, no ads. Estimates, clients and your details stay on your iPhone. Works offline.

MASTER ESTIMATE PRO
Calculating and viewing an estimate is free. Saving, sharing, PDF, Excel and certificates need a Pro subscription: monthly, with the first month free for new subscribers. name: Masters in Pieces: Art Puzzle
description:
Masters in Pieces is a calm puzzle game made from the world's great paintings.

Each painting is cut into regions, and every region is a level. Slide strips up and down, move pieces in every direction, and watch the pieces that belong together join. Finish every level and the whole painting appears, with a few words about the artist and the work.

• 13 paintings, 123 levels, from Renoir's Dance at Bougival to Hokusai's Kirifuri Waterfall
• Gentle difficulty: strips first, then columns, mosaics and finer cuts
• The first painting is free; one purchase unlocks all the others. No ads, no subscriptions
• No timers, no move counter
• Quiet piano and harp music, soft sounds and haptics
• Your progress stays on your device
• English and Turkish

Paintings: Renoir, Monet, Vermeer, Whistler, Beuckelaer, Hiroshige, Bruegel, Van Gogh, Alma-Tadema and Hokusai.

name: Matcha Race
description:
Matcha Race is a bright, fast kart racer starring Matchi, Mochi and their friends from the Honakari family.

Pick a racer, choose a kart and hit the track. Hold a drift through the corner, watch the sparks turn green, pink and gold, then let go for a boost. Grab item boxes, fire a Matcha Rocket, shrug off hits with a Strawberry Shield, or grow huge with the Giant Onigiri.

FIVE WORLDS
• Matcha Fest: a festival in the tea hills with balloons and wooden bridges
• Strawberry Sweetway: icing roads, chocolate bridges and a cream canyon jump
• Honakari Japan City: lantern streets that turn to neon as night falls
• Matcha Starlight Circuit: anti-gravity corkscrews, a full loop and leaps between planets
• Sakura High: the cherry avenue, the school yard and a jump over the pool

WAYS TO PLAY
• Quick race, Single Race and a five-race Grand Prix with trophies
• Time Trial with a ghost of your best lap
• Six Challenges with three stars each
• Practice with a short drift tutorial
• Local Party: up to six players on the same Wi-Fi, no account and no sign-up

MAKE IT YOURS
• 8 racers, each with their own stats and voice
• 15 karts, with paint, wheels and boost trails to collect
• Daily gifts, levels and achievements

BUILT FOR iPHONE
• Simple touch controls with auto-accelerate
• High and Ultra graphics
• Plays offline. No adverts. No account needed.

Matcha Race is free to play. Matcha coins are earned by racing and can also be bought. Seven premium karts are optional one-off purchases. Purchases can be restored from the Shop.

name: MatCue
description:
MatCue is a class planner and cue app for mat Pilates and Yoga, made by a certified Pilates instructor. Use it to teach a class, or to follow your own workout at home or at the gym. Plan on your iPhone, then run it from your Apple Watch or your iPhone. MatCue tells you when to switch and what comes next, so you can focus on moving instead of watching a clock.

PLAN YOUR CLASS OR WORKOUT
• Start from ready-made classes and templates, or build your own
• Choose from a library of beginner, intermediate and advanced moves, including prep moves and stretches
• Group moves into a series and reuse it in any class
• Set a time for each move, drag to reorder, and see the total time as you go
• Add props, or turn them off for the whole class, and pick modifications for each move

CUES THAT FULLY GUIDE YOU, OR STAY DISCREET
• Voice cues say the next move, the warning time and "Class complete"
• Optional halfway cue and final countdown
• A chime with its own volume
• Haptic taps in adjustable strengths, or use taps alone for silent cueing
• Choose Minimal, Standard or Full cue timing, or fine-tune every setting
• Modifications you pick show on the watch and are spoken a few seconds after the move starts, while you are still moving

FOR TEACHING OR YOUR OWN PRACTICE
• Voice cues play only from your watch speaker, not through your phone or the room's speakers, so only you hear them. Your class hears the music, not the cues
• Cues never pause or quiet your music
• Big, easy-to-read move names and countdown on your wrist
• The timer stays on the Always On display when your wrist is down
• Classes and settings sync automatically between your iPhone and Apple Watch

PILATES AND YOGA
Switch between Pilates and Yoga mode. Each mode has its own moves, classes and series. Pilates templates cover both classical and contemporary mat Pilates.

FREE TO TRY
The free version includes 3 starter classes (10, 15 and 20 minutes), every cue option, the watch timer, and 1 class of your own up to 15 minutes.

Unlock everything with one purchase, with no subscription. You get every starter class, all 16 Pilates class templates (30 to 60 minutes), both Pilates and Yoga mode, unlimited classes of any length, saved series, import, export and sharing, and custom class colors.

Whether you teach at a gym or studio or work out in your living room, MatCue keeps your class flowing so you can focus on the movement.

No account and no ads. MatCue does not collect your data.

name: Math Heroes: أبطال الحساب
description:
Help the little wizard defend his castle! The ghosts are coming, and every correct answer fires a magic heart that stops them. Answer fast before they reach the walls!

How to play
- A math question appears: type the answer and tap GO
- Every correct answer defeats a ghost
- You have 3 hearts, and the 20th ghost is a boss!

20 challenges
- Addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, and a cycle of all four
- 2-digit addition and subtraction
- Squares, cubes, square and cube roots
- Mixed add & subtract, mixed multiply & divide
- Percentages, GCD and LCM
- Fruit counting for the youngest
- Time and distance conversions

1 to 4 players
On iPad and tablets, play together on one screen: every player gets their own keypad and ghosts.

Three languages: Arabic, French and English

Safe for kids
No ads, no purchases, no account, no data collected.

name: MCS Code Dealer
description:
MCS Code Dealer is an offline error-code reference for trained fuel-equipment service technicians.

Select a manufacturer and model, then search by code or description.

• Offline lookup with the reference database included
• Favorites for frequently used entries
• Recent searches
• Saved equipment with your own nicknames and model selections
• No account, advertisements, or subscription

Favorites, recent searches, and saved equipment stay on your device. Lookup works without an internet connection after installation.

Coverage is limited to the manufacturers, models, and entries included. The app does not connect to equipment, read live faults, clear codes, or perform repairs.

Confirm the installed equipment and applicable manufacturer procedures before acting. A code match is a reference, not a diagnosis. First launch requires acknowledgment of these responsibilities.

MCS Code Dealer is an independent product from MCS Tank Service. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by the equipment manufacturers listed.

Support: info@mcstank.com

name: MealKlip: Recipe Saver
description:
Turn saved recipes into meals.

That recipe you saved and never made? MealKlip is your recipe organizer, meal planner, and grocery list in one. Save recipes from TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Facebook, Pinterest, and recipe websites, keep them all in one place, and turn them into a week of dinners and one shopping list.

SAVE RECIPES FROM ANYWHERE
- Tap Share in TikTok, Instagram, or your browser and choose MealKlip
- Paste a link to a recipe website or a cooking video
- Get the written recipe from a cooking video, even when it's only in the caption or said out loud
- Scan a cookbook page, recipe card, or handwritten note with up to 6 photos or screenshots
- Paste a caption or type a recipe in
- Every ingredient and step matches the source, and missing amounts are never guessed
- Recipes in other languages are translated into English

COOK
- Change the servings from 1 to 24, and every amount updates
- Switch any recipe between US and metric measurements
- See the nutrition facts when the recipe includes them
- Print any recipe

ORGANIZE
- Keep every recipe in one place, with its photo and a link back to the source
- Sort recipes into your own collections, like Weeknight dinners or Desserts

PLAN AND SHOP WITH PREMIUM
- Plan the week's dinners from your own recipes, or let MealKlip suggest the week
- Get one grocery list for the whole week, grouped by aisle, with matching items added together
- Check items off as you shop, print the list, or send it with the week's dinners
- Save unlimited recipes (the free plan saves up to 10)
- Use Premium in the app and at mealklip.com

MealKlip isn't affiliated with or endorsed by TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Facebook, or Pinterest.

MealKlip Premium is a monthly or yearly auto-renewing subscription, charged to your Apple Account. Both plans start with a 14-day free trial if you've never had Premium. Cancel before it ends and you won't be charged. One free trial per person. Manage or cancel it in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Use: https://mealklip.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://mealklip.com/privacy

name: Memory Plate: Cafe Puzzle
description:
Study a customer's order while it's on the tray. When the tray clears, put every dish back in its original spot and check the result.

Work through 20 menus, from Korean meals and brunch to lunch boxes and desserts. Later trays give you more dishes to remember and less time to study. You can move on as soon as you're ready.

Clear three orders in a menu to unlock the next one. Complete ten to keep playing that menu in endless mode. See which spots you missed and pick up from the progress saved on your device.

name: Mendocles
description:
Mendocles is a flashcard for every word you meet. Heard a new word in a show, read one in a book, saw one on a sign? Add it in seconds, and Mendocles brings it back at the right time until it sticks.

SIMPLE, STEADY REVIEWS
After each card, tap Forgot or Remembered. Each time you remember a word, the wait before you see it again doubles: 1 day, 2, 4, 8 and so on, up to 6 months. Forget it and it starts over. The time under each button tells you exactly when you'll see the word next. Prefer finer control? Switch to Classic for four buttons: Forgot, Hard, Good and Easy.

KNOW IT, THEN SAY IT
Cards show the word and ask for its meaning. Turn on both directions to also practice the other way: see the meaning and come up with the word yourself, by thinking it or typing it. Mendocles is forgiving about accents when you type.

YOUR WORDS, YOUR WAY
• 18 languages, each with an optional set of 30 starter words, plus any language you add yourself
• Add the meaning, an example sentence and its translation, and notes such as gender or irregular forms
• Add a picture from your camera or photos
• Hear each word pronounced with your device's voices
• Import a whole word list from a spreadsheet or text file
• Copy a ready-made prompt to have an AI assistant build a word list on any topic

BROWSE AT YOUR OWN PACE
Flip through your cards without affecting your schedule. Star your favorites, and retire words you know well so they stop coming up but stay in your list.

FITS YOUR DAY
Set how many minutes a day you want to study. Learning several languages? Set each one to Focus, Steady or Maintain, and Mendocles balances them for you.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account and no sign-up. Your words stay on your device, and Mendocles collects no data. Back up your words to a file anytime and restore them on another device.

Also: light and dark mode, and an interface in English, Spanish, Portuguese and German.

Mendocles is free.

Questions or ideas? Write to mendocles@gmail.com.

name: Mental Math: Daily Training
description:
Three minutes a day make you faster with numbers. Mental Math gives you a daily training that adapts to you, with all four operations, quick sprints and tricks that make hard sums easy.

A DAILY TRAINING THAT GROWS WITH YOU
• 20 tasks a day: addition, subtraction, multiplication and division.
• Each operation has its own level. All right and quick, it goes up; too hard, it goes down.
• Six levels, from 7 + 8 to 347 × 6.
• Your days in a row keep you going, with a gentle daily reminder if you want one.

PRACTICE WHAT YOU WANT
• Choose an operation and a level, or mix all four.
• 20 tasks, or a 60-second sprint against your own best.
• A big number pad made for quick thumbs. A right answer counts as soon as you type it.

8 TRICKS TO CALCULATE FASTER
• Add by rounding, subtract from 100, times 9, 11, 5 and 25, squares ending in 5, percent via 10%.
• Each trick worked out step by step, then tasks made for it.

SEE YOUR PROGRESS
• The right answers of the last two weeks, your streak and your longest run.
• For each operation: your level, how often you are right and how fast.
• Wrong answers shown again at the end of each round.

FOR TEENS AND ADULTS
• For school, exams and aptitude tests, for work and shopping, or simply to keep your mind sharp.
• No account, no ads. Your progress stays on your iPhone.

The first month is free. After that, Mental Math is a monthly subscription, charged to your Apple Account. It renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period, and can be managed and cancelled in the App Store settings.

Terms of use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Mental: Solve Your Ex
description:
The breakup is over but your mind is still on them? Mental gives you a daily plan to leave your ex behind step by step, and support when you need it.

Note: the app is currently in Turkish.

NO-CONTACT DAYS
See how many days have passed since your last contact. Days 1, 3, 7, 14, 30, 60 and 90 are milestones. If you text them, you reset honestly and your longest streak is kept.

WHEN THE URGE HITS
Tap "Urge to text them?" A 60-second breathing screen stays with you until the urge passes and tells you what to do in a few short steps. Every urge you resist is counted.

HEALING JOURNEY
3 chapters, 15 steps. One step unlocks each day: make room for the feeling, recognise the urge, remove the reminders, come back to yourself.

SUPPORT
When you want to text them at night or something triggers you, write it out. Mental replies calmly and clearly. The chat stays on your phone.

EVERY DAY
A daily reminder, a mood check, a private note only you can see, and your progress. Optional morning reminder notifications.

PREMIUM
Free: no-contact counter, breathing screen, the first chapter and 1 support message a day. Premium unlocks the full journey and 10 support messages a day, as monthly and yearly auto-renewing subscriptions. Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel in Settings → Apple ID → Subscriptions.

Privacy Policy: https://mental-panel.vercel.app/privacy
Terms of Use: https://mental-panel.vercel.app/terms

Mental does not replace professional help. If you feel very low, reach out to a professional or someone you trust.

name: MERGE BLOOM: Petal Drop
description:
Drop flowers, merge three of a kind, and watch your garden bloom!

MERGE BLOOM is a calm, cheerful merge puzzle made for quick sessions on iPhone. Tap a column to drop the next flower. Connect three or more matching flowers to merge them into the next bloom, and set up chain reactions for big combos: NICE, GREAT, AMAZING… BLOOM!

FEATURES
• 30 handcrafted campaign levels on a winding garden map, with a boss level every five stages and gift chests to open.
• Varied goals: grow rare flowers, reach a target score, crack stones and free flowers wrapped in vines.
• Earn up to 3 stars per level by finishing with moves to spare.
• Daily Challenge: a fresh puzzle every day. Keep your streak going to unlock special skins.
• Flower Album: discover all 8 flowers, from the tiny bud to the golden crown bloom.
• Garden skins: unlock Dawn Petal and Night Bloom with stars and streaks.
• Helpful tools: Undo, Hammer and Shuffle when you get stuck.
• A short interactive tutorial teaches the rules in a minute.
• Satisfying haptic feedback on every drop, merge, combo, clear and fail.
• Gentle sound effects that follow your Silent switch and never interrupt your music.
• Pauses and saves automatically when you leave the app.

PLAY ANYWHERE
Works completely offline (airplane mode too). No account, no ads, no in-app purchases, no tracking. Your progress stays on your iPhone.

name: MesGoal
description:
MesGoal is the sports app for players, teams and venues. Book a court, find people to play with, run a tournament and share the result, all in one place.

BOOK A COURT
• Browse courts near you by sport, city and day
• See prices, opening hours, facilities and photos before you book
• Find courts on a map and get directions
• Get a booking confirmation, a check-in code and an invoice
• Reminders before your game, and your bookings in your calendar

FIND PLAYERS
• Short of players? Post your game and let players come to you
• Join a squad that needs someone at your level
• See people you may know: team-mates, players in your city and your sports

TOURNAMENTS
• Host a tournament or enter your team
• Fixtures, results, tables and knockout rounds, updated as matches finish
• Share fixtures and results as ready-made images

SCORE CARDS
• Make a result, match-day, award or moment card for any sport
• Add team logos and a player photo, pick a theme, and share it or post it
• Football, futsal, cricket, padel, tennis, badminton, basketball, hockey and more

YOUR SPORTS COMMUNITY
• Post photos and videos of your games
• A feed of the players, teams and venues you follow
• Chat one-to-one or in groups, send voice messages, and make voice and video calls
• A profile with your sports, position and level, and a verified badge once you confirm your identity

LIVE SCORES
• Follow live matches and today's fixtures

FOR VENUES
• List your courts with prices, hours and photos
• Accept and manage bookings, including walk-ins and phone bookings
• Check players in by scanning their code
• Offers, staff access and booking reports

You pay the venue directly for your booking; MesGoal does not take card payments.

MesGoal is for players aged 13 and over. Under-18s need a parent or guardian's permission.

Privacy policy: https://www.mesgoal.com/privacy
Terms of service: https://www.mesgoal.com/terms

name: Metronome & Tempo - BeatFocus
seller_name: Suzhou Zhiqiao Information Technology Co., Ltd
description:
Slow a tricky bar down with the BeatFocus metronome. Save the tempo for your next rehearsal, record a take, then listen for the spots where you rush.

FIND YOUR PULSE
Tap along with a song to find its tempo, or set the click anywhere from 1 to 500 BPM with the ruler and buttons. Choose a time signature, set accents for individual beats, and explore subdivisions and custom rhythms.

MAKE PRACTICE YOURS
Save your tempo, meter, and rhythm as presets and organize them into setlists. Explore 48 built-in practice presets, add a count-in, or stop playback after a chosen number of bars or minutes.

LISTEN BACK AND TRACK PROGRESS
Record your playing, listen back, and share recordings. Set a daily goal and see your practice time and streaks. Sessions need at least 30 seconds of playback to count toward your statistics.

PRACTICE ACROSS DEVICES
Start and stop the metronome on Apple Watch, adjust the tempo with the Digital Crown or by tapping, and use presets synced from your iPhone. Add quick practice and daily progress widgets to your iPhone or iPad.

PRO FEATURES
Pro adds automatic tempo changes by time or by bar, more sounds, rhythm patterns and visual effects. It also unlocks practice reminders, the practice calendar, detailed statistics and the option to save custom rhythms as presets. Some widget controls and report ranges also require Pro.

BeatFocus Pro is available through an automatically renewing monthly or annual Apple subscription, or as a one-time purchase for lifetime access. You can manage or cancel your subscription in your Apple Account settings.

description:
Mənim Vətənim — Azərbaycanın coğrafiyasını interaktiv xəritə və əyləncəli viktorina oyunu vasitəsilə öyrədən təhsil tətbiqidir.
