name: Mia Calls
description:
Mia Calls is an internal app for B Platform staff. It shows calls answered by Mia, the company's AI phone assistant: today's calls at a glance, summaries and transcripts, call recordings, and statistics. When an urgent caller asks to be connected, staff can approve the transfer, ask Mia to take a message, or send an instruction she passes on to the caller.

The app works only with the company's private server. A demo mode with made-up calls shows how it works.

name: Midland Brewing Company
description:
Download the Midland Brewing Company app for access to our memberships & special perks!

With the Midland Brewing Company app you will find:

- On Tap
- Notifications
- Loyal Rewards
- Online Ordering
- Memberships
- Perks & Promos
- Punch Cards
- Locations

Stay connected to Midland Brewing Company! Check out what we have on tap, be a part of our loyalty program, join one of our memberships,and receive exclusive offers & special perks all in one place!

name: Milava
description:
Find a meaningful connection with Milava, a marriage and rishta matchmaking app designed for people seeking a life partner.

Share what matters to you
Create a profile that reflects your personality, interests, background, and plans for marriage. Share your preferences around lifestyle, family involvement, relocation, and more.

Discover compatible people
Explore profiles and refine your preferences by age, location, and other qualities that matter to you. Learn about someone through their photos, interests, and profile before expressing interest.

Connect through mutual interest
Express interest, see your matches, and start conversations as you get to know each other.

Manage your privacy
Choose your photo visibility, manage contact exclusions, block accounts, and pause your profile when you need a break.

Compare your profile photo
Take a camera selfie for comparison with your primary profile photo. Photo matching helps connect the photos on a profile with the person using the account.

Stay in control
Update your profile and preferences, manage your photos, access reporting and help tools, or delete your account from within the app.

Milava is for adults aged 18 and over who are looking for a meaningful relationship with marriage in mind.

Your story starts here.

name: Mileage Log: Trips & Reports
description:
Keep a mileage log on your device. The app is available in English and Slovak and follows your device language. You can enter and view distances in miles or kilometers. When the device language is Slovak, you enter your own rate in euros per kilometer; without a rate the app shows only the distance, with no amounts. In Slovak, PDF and CSV reports give distances in kilometers and add an Amount (EUR) column only when you entered a rate; in English the app uses rates per mile and the CSV uses miles.

Enter a trip manually, or tap Start recording before a trip and Stop recording when you finish. Location permission is requested only when you start a GPS trip. Manual trips need no location access. The app does not detect drives automatically or start recording by itself after a restart.

• Organize trips by vehicle and purpose.
• Review estimated distance, GPS gaps and any corrections.
• Use the included US mileage rates or a custom rate. Estimates are not tax advice or a guarantee that an expense qualifies.
• Keep your history and complete backups without a purchase.

Trip logging, vehicles, rates and full backups are free. Try a PDF Preview of the first three selected trips, marked Preview. One optional purchase unlocks full CSV and PDF reports. No subscription or per-vehicle charge. Your store shows the price before purchase. Use Restore purchases with the same App Store account to recover a previous unlock; a backup does not restore a purchase or transfer it between stores.

Records and raw location points are stored in the app on your device. Device backups (iCloud or computer) may include app data depending on your device settings; you select the destination when saving or sharing reports and backups. The app does not automatically upload your trips to our servers. There is no app account or advertising. At launch, Mileage Log contacts the store to check prices and purchase status, even if you buy nothing. The store's billing service may receive technical data on your device, the app and your connection; this is distinct from the trip records you enter. Your device's location services may use network connections according to your device settings. Complete backups include location points and edit history and are not encrypted. Save a backup outside this device: losing it or clearing its storage can remove your only copy.

GPS can be inaccurate or incomplete. Review your records before using a report. The app does not provide a route map or automatic drive tracking.

name: Milliybiz Map
description:
Карта Ташкента — объёмная карта города с 3D-зданиями, достопримечательностями, телебашней, Tashkent City и аэропортом.

Что внутри:
• 49 станций метро и более 6 000 мест: кафе, рестораны, аптеки, клиники, банки, АЗС, отели, мечети, вокзалы
• Поиск по названию и адресу, фильтр по районам
• Маршруты на машине, пешком и на велосипеде
• 12 стилей карты: Бордо, Графит, Полночь, Моно, Олива, Неон, Чертёж, Акварель, Золото, Изумруд, Бумага, Изразец
• Ночной режим «Свет в городе» — окна и магистрали светятся
• Режимы 3D и 2D
• Русский, английский и узбекский языки; названия на латинице и кириллице
• «Мои адреса» — сохраните дом, работу и любимые места

Карта работает без регистрации. Аккаунт нужен только для своих адресов — вход по номеру телефона с кодом из Telegram, без пароля.

name: MindRush: Brain Battles
description:
MindRush: Brain Battles is a fast-paced brain game packed with puzzles, challenges, and competitive battles.

Sharpen your focus, test your memory, and challenge your problem-solving skills through different ways to play.

Game Modes
- Journey: Progress through levels, earn stars, and unlock new challenges.
- Quick Play: Jump into fast brain challenges whenever you want.
- Daily Rush: Take on daily challenges and compete for your best score.
- Arena: Face other players in competitive brain battles.

More Ways to Play
- Explore puzzles involving logic, memory, math, shapes, and visual focus.
- Challenge friends and climb the leaderboards.
- Replay levels to improve your results.
- Save your progress with an account or enjoy solo play as a guest.

Ready to put your brain to the test?

Download MindRush: Brain Battles and start your journey!

name: mindsweep
description:
mindsweep keeps a ledger of your commitments: what you promised someone, and what someone promised you. It finds them in your email, Slack and meeting notes, and keeps each line with the words it came from. It proposes; you decide.

Your move. Home opens on what is yours: overdue first, then what is due today, then what you are waiting on from others. Each line says who it is with, when it is due, and the sentence where it was said.

Sweep. One line at a time, one decision each: done, today or tomorrow. Undo is one tap away.

Review. Anything mindsweep is unsure of is pencilled in until you accept it or dismiss it.

Capture. Type or dictate a note, "I told Priya I'd send the board deck Friday", and mindsweep reads the lines in it: who, what and when. Or send text to mindsweep from any app's share sheet.

People. Everything open with one person, both ways, before you talk to them. Search finds a person or a line by any word in it.

On your Home Screen and Lock Screen. A widget shows how many lines are yours and the one to start with.

mindsweep is in private beta: you need an invitation to make an account. You connect your mail, Slack and meeting notes on the web at mindsweep.si, and the iPhone app signs in to the same account.

name: Mini Paint Recipes
description:
Open the app and see the exact step you stopped on: "Layer the raised plates, Deep Teal 3 : Bone White 1." No more guessing which mix went on the armor last week.
Write each area of a miniature as ordered steps with the paints you used, as relative parts. A 2 : 1 mix stays 2 : 1, with the share of each paint shown as 66.7% and 33.3%.
No account and no setup. Try the editable sample miniature or start your own, and tick off your first step within a minute.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Add a miniature, with a photo if you like.
2. Add areas such as Armor, Cloak or Base, and list their steps in order.
3. For each step, type the technique and the paints. Add a second paint to record a mix in parts.
4. Open Painting Mode: one step at a time, big Done and Back buttons, and progress for the area.

REMEMBER EVERY STEP
- Steps keep their order and their done marks, even when you reorder them.
- Painting Mode reopens on the exact step after you close the app or restart your phone.
- An area is only marked finished when you finish it, never by editing its recipe.

SAVE YOUR EXACT PAINT MIX
- Parts are your own consistent measure: drops, brush loads or pumps.
- Percentages show each paint's share of the mix. They are not a prediction of the mixed color.
- A step can use a single paint without any mix.

KEEP RECIPES WITH YOUR MINIATURES
- Pin each area on a photo of the model.
- Photos are copied into the app without their location data. Only the pictures you pick are used.
- If a photo goes missing, the recipe text is still there.

REPEAT YOUR BEST COLOR SCHEME (PRO)
- Duplicate a miniature for the next squad member: same recipe, fresh progress.
- Save an area as a reusable recipe and add it to any area as a fresh copy.
- Share a formatted recipe card image.

FREE
- Up to three miniatures with all their areas, steps and mixes
- Painting Mode and progress tracking
- Backup export and import (one file with your photos), Delete All Data

PRO
- Unlimited miniatures and one-tap duplication
- Reusable area recipes
- Formatted recipe cards
If Pro ends, nothing is deleted. Every miniature stays readable and is included in your backup.

STORED ON YOUR IPHONE
No account, no ads, no tracking. Your miniatures, recipes and photos are stored on your iPhone (and in your device backups, depending on your settings). Export a backup file any time, for free.

Paint names, ratios and techniques are what you enter. The app doesn't give color predictions or advice on paint compatibility; follow each paint's instructions. Not affiliated with any paint or miniature maker.

SUBSCRIPTION
Pro is optional: weekly with a 3-day free trial for eligible new subscribers, or annual, billed in full once a year. Prices are shown in the app before you buy. Subscriptions renew automatically until cancelled in Settings.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://motleystudio.site/mini-paint-recipes/privacy
Terms: https://motleystudio.site/mini-paint-recipes/terms

name: MOBVENDER
seller_name: JOSE FRANCISCO LOPES DO NASCIMENTO TECH LTDA
description:
MOBVENDER is the consignment and direct sales app for sales reps, resellers and field representatives. Leave the goods with the customer, settle on the next visit and get paid on the spot, online or offline.

COMPLETE CONSIGNMENT
• Consignment (sample case) per customer, with stock always up to date
• Settlement with returns per item and automatic calculation of what was sold
• Customer commission by % sold or by value tiers
• Multiple payment methods, installments and open balance

DIRECT SALES AND PRE-SALES
• Quick sales to consumers and pre-sales
• Price lists, discounts, promotions, kits and free gifts
• Barcode scanner using the camera

WORKS OFFLINE
• Sell, settle, receive and print offline
• Sync with the web platform when you have signal, with backup

CUSTOMERS AND ROUTES
• Customer records with location, territories and visit routes
• Navigate to the customer with Waze or Google Maps
• Customer financial status at the time of sale: open and overdue bills

PRINTING AND CATALOG
• Receipts on 58 or 80 mm Bluetooth thermal printers, or as PDF
• Customer signature on screen
• Product catalog in PDF with photos

REPORTS
• Revenue, average ticket, commissions, collections and slow-moving stock
• Sales by stage and due dates by day range

Available in Portuguese, Spanish and English, with light and dark themes.

To get started, sign in with your company account or sign up right in the app.

name: Mochi: Cute Habits & Themes
description:
Mochi is a cute habit tracker with a virtual pet, a mood journal, aesthetic widgets and a custom keyboard in one app. Tick off small habits, jot down your mood, focus for a while, and watch your pet perk up, level up and decorate its room. Pick a theme pack and the app, your widgets and your keyboard all change with it.

A PET THAT GROWS WITH YOU
• Build a routine from tiny habits: drink water, stretch, read ten pages
• Weekdays or a goal like "3 times a week", with gentle reminders
• Streaks that forgive: every 7-day streak earns a freeze that covers a missed day
• Your pet earns XP and sprinkles, levels up, wears outfits and furnishes its room
• On a quiet day it simply naps. It never gets sick, sad or lost.

MOOD DIARY AND CALM
• One-tap mood check-in with five faces, tags and a note
• 80 gentle journal prompts and a gratitude jar of paper stars
• A month in colours, a year in pixels, and patterns between habits and mood
• Guided breathing and a 5-4-3-2-1 grounding walkthrough
• Diary lock with Face ID, Touch ID or a PIN

FOCUS TIMER
• 15, 25 or 45 minutes, or your own length
• Your pet reads or naps beside you; the countdown shows on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island
• Six gentle 7-day Paths: sleep better, softer mornings, a tidy mind and more

THEME STUDIO
• 15 theme packs: puffy pastel, hand-drawn doodle, liquid glass, midnight, aesthetic and seasonal looks
• Wallpapers for your Home Screen and Lock Screen, saved to Photos
• Make your own wallpaper from a photo, stickers and text
• Widgets in three sizes: habits you can tick in place, pet, mood, water, quote, countdown, days together, clocks, calendar, photo, to-do and note
• Icon studio: a matching icon set for your Home Screen, with a step-by-step guide

MOCHI KEYBOARD
• Themes that match the rest of your phone, or your own photo behind the keys
• 18 fancy text styles, 160+ kaomoji, text art and quick phrases
• English suggestions and autocorrect, Vietnamese Telex
• A mascot that hops as you type
• Works without Full Access. The optional clipboard shelf and stickers ask for it and explain why.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no ads, no tracking
• The app and its keyboard make no network requests: your habits, diary and what you type stay on your iPhone
• Export a backup file and import it on another phone

FREE AND PREMIUM
Free: four theme packs, up to five habits, the mood diary, focus timer, breathing, one Path at a time, the basic shop, core widgets and five fonts.
Mochi Premium adds every theme pack, unlimited habits, all Paths at once, the full wardrobe, shop and room, a year of insights, every widget and all fonts.

Premium is an auto-renewing subscription, yearly (with a 2-week free trial for new subscribers) or monthly. The price for your region is shown in the app before you subscribe. Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel it in your App Store account settings. If you stop subscribing, nothing you made or earned is taken away.

Mochi is a gentle companion, not therapy, and it gives no medical advice. If you are struggling, please reach out to someone you trust or a local helpline.

Terms of use: https://fighttech.vn/terms
Privacy policy: https://liquid-launcher-os27.web.app/privacy/mochi

name: moijoy
description:
What should you prepare before coming to Korea? Where can you ask about course registration or life in halls?

moijoy helps international students in Korea prepare for arrival, enrolment and campus life. Use checklists to organise your preparations, find information and connect with students at your university.

■ Prepare for arrival and enrolment
Explore tasks to complete before departure and after arrival. Mark your progress and find campus notices and practical guidance.

■ Find answers to common questions
Explore information about everyday life, from phone plans to accommodation and university life.

■ Ask other students
Post questions, read answers and share your own experiences with students who are navigating life in Korea.

■ Connect with your campus community
Share local recommendations, practical tips and everyday stories with other students.

For international students at Chungbuk National University, Korea National University of Transportation and Korea National University of Education.

name: Mojeeb - AI Assistant
description:
Requires a Mojeeb business account.

Mojeeb is your AI assistant for customer messages. It replies to your customers on WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook and your website, day and night, and this app lets you and your team follow everything from your phone.

Chats
• All your chats from every channel in one place
• See how Mojeeb replied, and take over the chat whenever you want
• Send messages, photos and voice notes

Sales
• New leads are saved from your chats automatically
• Track each lead until they buy

Customer support
• Customer requests and complaints are logged and tracked to the end
• Assign requests to your team

Agent setup
• Teach Mojeeb your business: prices, offers, shipping and opening hours
• Try Mojeeb yourself before it answers your customers

Start your account at mojeeb.app

name: Monarch Block
description:
Slide every gem out through the gate that shares its colour... before the sands run out.

Monarch Block is a relaxing-but-tense sliding puzzle with a royal twist. Each board is full of jewel-coloured blocks and glowing gates set into a golden frame. Drag a block across the board, line it up with a gate of the same colour, and watch it sweep out in a shower of sparks. Clear the board before the timer ends to claim your coins and move on to the next chamber.

HOW IT WORKS
• Drag blocks along the board; they glide until they hit a wall or another block.
• A block leaves only through a gate of its own colour that is wide enough and clear.
• Empty the board before time is up. Plan your moves: the order is the whole puzzle.

SPECIAL BLOCKS
• Locked-axis blocks that only slide one way.
• Layered blocks that shed one colour each time they pass a gate.
• Sealed blocks that stay frozen until enough other blocks have left.

ROYAL POWER-UPS
• Scepter: remove a block that is in your way.
• Hourglass: freeze the clock for a few precious seconds.
• Royal Decree: sweep away every block of one colour.

A KINGDOM TO CROSS
• 400 levels across twenty royal realms, each with its own look.
• Hard levels to test you, with a flourish on the map.
• Win streaks that reward you with free power-ups.
• A daily gift that grows over seven days.
• Colour-blind friendly symbols on every block and gate.

FREE TO PLAY, FAIR TO PLAY
Monarch Block is free. It shows ads, and you can watch an optional video for extra rewards. A one-time purchase removes ads for good. Coin packs and a starter bundle are optional; every level can be won without spending anything.

No account. No sign-in. Your progress stays on your device.

Ready to take the throne? Slide your first block.

name: Monasba
description: Monasaba is an event planning application that helps users organize weddings and other occasions from start to finish. It supports event planning for families and businesses, with tools for booking venues, photographers, videographers, audio and lighting services, décor, catering, entertainment, and more. The app streamlines communication with service providers, manages budgets and schedules, and keeps all event details in one easy-to-use platform, making the entire planning process simpler, more organized, and convenient for every type of event and special occasion.

name: Monster Burrow: Dig & Defend
description:
Dig rocks and grow a nest of underground creatures in this ecosystem defense game.

■ You only dig. The creatures live on their own
The color of a rock's specks decides which creature comes out.
You can't command them. They walk, eat, multiply and die by themselves.
Haulers carry nutrients, Hunters eat the Haulers, and something bigger eats the Hunters. A food chain forms inside your nest.

■ A cornered species changes
No food. Eaten again and again.
An "omen" comes to such a species, and its next breeding gives birth to a mutant.
Put a mutant on "trial" in front of its predators, and an even stranger "aberrant" form may follow.

■ Protect the Queen from the mining crew
Miners search your nest. When they find the Queen, they bind her and carry her away.
Defeat the carrier before it reaches the mine entrance and she is yours again.
Deeper layers bring the Shieldbearer, Surveyor, Medic and Blaster.

■ Descend through 5 layers
Leftover Digs (how many times you can dig) carry over to the next layer.
Mutations from a layer you won come along for that descent.

■ The Queen grows while you are away
She grows while the app is closed and each time you defend a layer.
Rank her up to evolve into one of three forms: Sovereign, Commoner or Ancestor. At Rank 10 she can reincarnate and choose again.
Every form has a gain and a cost. She doesn't simply get stronger; the way you play changes.

■ Also
- Auto: let the game dig, place the Queen and start the defense (free)
- Codex: every creature you've met, and who eats whom
- Dig Cards: "Twins" and "Venom", one per layer (also earned by playing)

■ Price
Free to play to the end. Ads appear when you descend a layer, and as an optional video to retry a lost layer.
- Time-Saver Pack (one-time): 2x speed, no ads, 2x idle cap
- Dig Cards x5 / x20
Digs themselves are not for sale.

name: Monthlet: Baby Milestone Photo
description:
Monthlet counts the days with you. Open it and see "Day 100" and "3 months 7 days" at the top, the next special day underneath, and three buttons: make a monthly card, add a first, add height and weight.

MONTHLY MILESTONE CARDS
• 12 original templates in 6 styles: airy, journal, red and gold, magazine, instant photo and month board
• Three sizes for sharing: 3:4, 1:1 and 9:16, each laid out on its own
• Pick a photo and the title fills itself in from the photo date: "1 week", "3 months", "100 days", "First birthday"; change it to anything you like
• Move and zoom the photo, add the name, the date and a short line, and optionally height and weight
• Share or save to Photos; every card you make is kept in the app
• A small "Made with Monthlet" line can be turned off in Settings
• 4 templates are free. All Templates, a one-time in-app purchase, adds the other 8 and every template added later. Everything else in the app is free

DAYS, AGE AND SPECIAL DAYS
• Day 1 is the day your baby was born; age in months follows the calendar, including babies born on the 31st or on 29 February
• Special days: 1 week, each month, 100 days, the half birthday, birthdays, 500 and 1,000 days
• Optional reminders the day before and on the day

FIRSTS AND TIMELINE
• About 40 ready-made firsts to tick off (first smile, rolled over, first bath, first trip) or write your own
• Add a photo and a line; the timeline groups everything by age and shows the day number of each moment
• "On this day last year" on the home screen

HEIGHT AND WEIGHT
• Height, weight and head size, in cm and kg or in inches and pounds
• Simple lines of your own numbers. The app only keeps records and gives no medical advice

FOOTPRINTS
• Put the cities you visit together on a globe and count cities and countries
• A footprint poster in 3:4 or 9:16

WIDGETS
• Home Screen: small and medium, with the day number, age and next special day
• Lock Screen: inline, circular and rectangular
• Several children? Choose which one each widget shows

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No sign-up and no account
• No ads and no analytics
• Photos and records are saved only on your iPhone. There is no server
• Apart from the App Store when you buy or restore All Templates, the only time the app goes online is when you search for a city in Footprints, using Apple Maps
• Export a backup file at any time, restore it, or delete everything

Monthlet is for parents and guardians. Your child's information is entered by you and kept on your device.

name: Moon Race Relay
description:
River ahead? Send in Dragon.

Rat slips through tunnels. Ox breaks walls. Tiger leaps gaps. Dragon soars over rivers. Your team runs; you read the obstacles and tap to switch. Three hearts, four teammates, one moonlit relay.

Collect mooncakes, build combos, and charge Relay Burst to clear the next three obstacles automatically.

Chase 2,000 meters in Classic, try a date-based Daily course, or pick 2–4 runners and one of three paces in Custom. Earn 10 in-game trophies and create an achievement card when you finish a course or set a new best distance.

Play offline. No account needed. The moon is waiting. Who takes the next turn?

name: MoonlitCourtyard
description:
Turn a mirror to bend a moonbeam. Light every pearl and reach every marked window as you make your way through a Chinese garden after dark.

Explore 30 puzzles across five chapters, from a round moon gate to a waterside pavilion. Follow the light around rocks, split one beam into two, and solve each puzzle at your own pace. Undo a move, start again, or ask for a hint whenever you need one.

In the final chapter, step along a covered gallery to frame a distant pagoda, a mountain ridge, or the moon. Find the right viewpoint and keep the composition in your journal.

Each puzzle has its own painting. Solve any puzzle in a chapter to open its illustrated journal entry and discover an example from the real gardens of Suzhou. Return to a moonlit lotus pond for a daily puzzle.

Play offline in English or Simplified Chinese. All puzzles are included. No account, ads, or in-app purchases.

name: Mortise Chop
description:
Mortise Chop keeps each mortise on this iPhone.

A chip leaves only when the chisel is between the two knife lines and the bevel faces the waste. On a knife line the chip springs back. Facing the cheek crushes the cheek and the chip springs back. A chip already at the knife depth stays there.

When all four chips are at that depth and the cheek is intact, the sentence says Chopped. Otherwise it names the first chip that is still in.

Name a mortise, rename it, find one, delete one, and share the sentence.

Mortises stay on this iPhone. There is no account and nothing to buy. This does not chop the wood for you.

name: MosqueScan
description:
MosqueScan affiche les horaires de prière de TA mosquée, pas des horaires calculés.

Prends en photo l'horaire publié par ta mosquée (ou importe-le en PDF) : l'app le lit directement sur ton iPhone, te laisse vérifier chaque jour, puis affiche la prochaine prière avec le temps restant.

• Lecture de l'horaire sur le téléphone : gratuite, sans internet, sans compte
• Heures de l'adhan et de l'iqama, quand l'horaire les donne
• Prochaine prière et compte à rebours
• Rappels sur mesure pour chaque prière : à l'heure, ou 5, 10, 15 minutes… avant l'adhan ou l'iqama
• Adhan à l'heure de la prière, avec le fichier audio de ton choix
• Rappel du Jumu'ah le vendredi
• Widget pour l'écran d'accueil et l'écran verrouillé
• Date hégirienne
• Aucune publicité, aucune donnée collectée : tout reste sur ton iPhone

Les heures doivent être écrites en chiffres occidentaux (0-9). Après chaque scan, tu peux corriger une heure en touchant le jour.

name: Musento
description:
Musento is a diary for museum visits.

Log a visit: the museum, the date you went, a rating from 0.5 to 5 stars if you want one, and a few lines on what you thought. Add the temporary exhibitions you saw and the artworks that stayed with you. Went back? Log it again. Every visit is its own entry.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Search museums, artworks and exhibitions from around the world, with or without accents.
• Log, edit and delete your own visits.
• Keep a Want to visit list.
• Read your diary back by date.
• Share your diary. It lives at musento.app/u/your-username.

name: Music Key Finder: Song Key
description:
Hear a song you want to play along with, a beat you want to sing over, or a melody stuck in your head? Music Key Finder tells you its key in seconds.

LISTEN AND GET THE KEY
• Tap Listen and hold your phone near the speaker, the TV or the band. Music can keep playing from another app on the same phone.
• The key settles as the app hears more, and the app says how sure it is.
• When it isn't sure, it names the other likely key, so you can check both by ear.
• See the relative major or minor too, so A minor and C major never get mixed up.

THE CIRCLE OF FIFTHS
• Every result lights up on the circle of fifths: the key, its relative key and, when unsure, the runner-up.
• Tap any key on the wheel to hear its chord.
• Play the key's scale or chord on a keyboard, loud enough to hear across the room.

FOR PRODUCERS AND DJS
• Camelot code next to every key, for harmonic mixing.
• BPM alongside the key.
• Open an audio file from Files, or share one from another app.

FOR SINGERS
• Sing or hum a line and get the key that fits it, with the notes you sang.

TRAIN YOUR EAR
• Quiz: the app plays a short phrase in a random key, you tap its key on the wheel.
• Streak, best streak and score. Starts with common keys and widens as you get better.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account and no sign-up.
• Sound is analysed on your phone and never recorded or uploaded.

KEEP A LIST
• Every result is saved with the time, so the key of last night's rehearsal song is still there.
• Rename a result to the song's title, and search your list.

name: Muslim Travel
description:
Muslim Travel объединяет карту мест для путешествий и повседневные инструменты для молитвы.

ИССЛЕДУЙТЕ МЕСТА
Ищите города, мечети, рестораны, достопримечательности и аэропорты в мировом каталоге. Перемещайте карту, выбирайте категорию, открывайте список объектов в видимой области и сохраняйте интересные места. В карточках указаны доступные адреса, часы работы и источники сведений.

ПЛАНИРУЙТЕ ВРЕМЯ МОЛИТВЫ
Расписание рассчитывается на устройстве по выбранному городу, его часовому поясу и дате. Выберите метод расчёта, правило для Асра и высоких широт. Локальные напоминания iOS доступны после разрешения уведомлений. Очередь напоминаний пополняется при открытии приложения.

НАЙДИТЕ НАПРАВЛЕНИЕ КИБЛЫ
Посмотрите направление от истинного севера для выбранного города или включите геопозицию и компас. При недостоверных показаниях приложение показывает схему направления; точность зависит от устройства и окружающих условий.

СЛУШАЙТЕ И ПОВТОРЯЙТЕ
В приложении есть записи сур «Аль-Фатиха» и «Аль-Каусар». Настройте повторы и паузы, выделите фрагмент A/B или добавьте одну личную аудиозапись с устройства. Полный обучающий курс намаза и библиотека лекций не входят в текущий набор.

Сведения о заведениях получены из открытых и официальных источников. Отметка сообщества, заявление заведения и запись реестра показаны отдельно. Каталог неполон; сведения и часы могут изменяться. Проверяйте важные условия непосредственно у заведения. Расчёт молитв не является официальным местным расписанием или временем джамаата. Для подложки карты нужен интернет. Бронирование и оплата в текущей версии не предоставляются.

name: Mux Cloud
description:
REQUIRES MUX ON YOUR COMPUTER
This app does not run an AI agent on your phone. It is a remote for mux, the open-source AI coding agent, and it only works with a Mac, Windows, or Linux computer that has mux installed, is signed in to Mux Cloud, and is turned on. Without that computer the app has nothing to show. Install mux first: https://github.com/jchristn/Mux

HOW TO START
1. Install mux on your computer (https://github.com/jchristn/Mux).
2. Create a free Mux Cloud account at app.usemux.ai or in this app.
3. On the computer, run "mux cloud login" (or use Connect to Mux Cloud in the desktop app, dashboard, or VS Code).
4. Open this app and sign in with the same account. Your computer appears within seconds.

mux runs on your own computers, with the models you choose. Mux Cloud connects those computers to your account so you can keep working from anywhere. This app is the phone and tablet side of it.

PICK UP WHERE YOU LEFT OFF
- See all your machines and which are online, busy, or waiting on you.
- Open any conversation and keep going, or start a new one in any folder.
- Watch replies stream in live, including runs you started on another device.

STAY IN CONTROL
- Approve or deny the commands and file edits mux wants to make, from anywhere.
- Answer the questions mux asks while it works.
- Undo a turn's file changes, stop a run, or switch models mid-conversation.
- Get a notification when a run needs you or finishes.

EVERYTHING YOU HAVE AT YOUR DESK
- Endpoints and models, MCP servers, prompts, subagents, hooks, commands, and skills.
- Memory, worktrees, processes, and project trust.
- Usage and cost dashboards with filters, percentiles, and exports.
- Plan mode, slash commands, @file mentions, and conversation stats.

YOUR CODE STAYS ON YOUR MACHINES
Mux Cloud relays your conversations between this app and your computer. It does not store your code or your conversations. Each machine decides whether tools can be approved remotely, and you can turn that off on the machine at any time.

Also included: Face ID or Touch ID lock, light and dark themes, tablet split view, and 12 languages.

Mux Cloud is made by Lattice AI, LLC. mux is open source under the MIT license.

name: My Service Story
description:
MY SERVICE STORY Every veteran has a story worth remembering. My Service Story gives veterans a simple, meaningful place to preserve the story of their life and military service—and gives family members a way to learn, remember, and share it for generations to come. Whether you served decades ago or recently returned home, your experiences, memories, accomplishments, friendships, and sacrifices are part of a story that deserves to be known.

TELL YOUR STORY
Use My Service Story to share the moments and memories that made you who you are. Create your personal story by answering thoughtful questions about your life, your military service, your experiences, and the people and places that have meant the most to you.

PRESERVE THE MEMORIES 
Add photos to bring your story to life. Save meaningful memories, important moments, family traditions, favorite things, and the experiences you never want forgotten.

SHARE WITH FAMILY
Your story can become something your children, grandchildren, and future generations can treasure. Help your family understand not only where you served, but who you were, what shaped you, and the life you lived beyond your military service.

KEEP YOUR SERVICE STORY ALIVE
Military service is an important chapter in a veteran's life, but it is only part of the person behind the uniform. My Service Story helps capture the whole person—their journey, memories, relationships, experiences, and the moments that made their life meaningful.

Answer a set of questions, add photos and descriptions of them and personalize your own printable QR code card. People can scan the card and learn all about your service story. 

My Service Story is great to give to family members or share at a Veterans event or organization. Two veterans accounts are included with the option to purchase more Veterans accounts.

name: MyLoop Audio
description:
MyLoop는 내가 가진 음원 파일을 앨범으로 묶어 끝없이 반복 재생하는 오프라인 플레이어입니다. 어학 쉐도잉, 오디오북, 강의·설교 녹음, 아이 재울 때 듣는 음악처럼 "같은 것을 계속 듣는" 용도에 맞췄습니다.

■ 이런 일을 합니다
• 앨범 무한 반복 — 앨범 전체, 한 곡, 순서대로, 랜덤
• 앞뒤 스킵 — 곡마다 앞·뒤 몇 초를 건너뛰게 지정(인트로·광고 멘트·박수 소리 제거)

• 완전한 오프라인 — 한 번 넣은 파일은 기기에 저장되어 비행기 모드에서도 재생
• 이어 듣기 — 앱을 닫아도 듣던 곡과 위치 기억
• 표지·가사·가사 싱크 — 앨범 표지를 바꾸고, 곡마다 가사나 메모를 넣고, 재생 시간에 맞춰 줄이 따라가게
• 녹음해서 추가 — 마이크로 녹음해 바로 곡으로

■ 내 파일은 내 기기에만

• 광고 없음, 추적 없음, 회원가입 없음.

무료로 앨범 1개와 저장 10곡까지 쓸 수 있습니다. Pro(한 번 구입, 구독 아님)에서는 앨범·저장 무제한, 무음 자동 건너뛰기, 재생 속도, 기기 간 앨범 동기화(Google Drive), 암호화 백업, 가사 찾기·음성 받아쓰기가 열립니다.

■ 알아 두세요

MySchoolPal – Your School. Your Companion.

name: Nap Raise
description: Six panels stay flat until the brush follows the lie. Brush against the lie and the panel stays down. Brush a panel that is already raised and it stays raised. Turn a flat panel to change its lie, then brush with it. When every panel is raised, the sentence says Raised. Steam lays them flat again. Names and panels stay on this iPhone.

name: NeatFlow - 服务器运维助手
description:
把服务器装进手机里。

晚上十一点，你自己发现网站打不开了。你在家、在地铁上、在出差的高铁上，手边没有电脑。
NeatFlow 让你掏出一部手机就开工：说一句「网站打不开了」，它去看 nginx 错误日志、查进程、算内存水位，把原因和改法摆在你面前，你点头它才动手。

它不是又一个通用 AI 聊天框。
每台机器在跑什么、端口怎么开、哪些目录绝对不能碰，你写进「环境知识」一次，之后它每次判断都按你这套环境来，而不是从网上抄一段通用建议。

给手上有几台云服务器、没有专职运维的开发和小团队负责人做的：不用背命令，也不用打开电脑。填上你自己的服务器和模型 API Key，就能开始。

【核心功能】

对话即运维
- 用自然语言下指令：查状态、看日志、改配置、重启服务，不用记命令
- 每一步工具调用都摊在对话里：执行了什么、返回了什么，看得见
- 消息里直接渲染表格和图表，内存构成、进程排名一眼看完

主机与服务，一屏看清
- 主机：别名、地址、端口、登录用户、在线状态、延迟、备注
- 服务：域名、端口、所属主机、容器名、在线或离线，支持一键探测
- 支持密码与密钥两种登录方式

环境知识，越用越准
- 把每台机器的用途、跑过什么、端口、禁区写成条目
- 助手回答时会把相关知识带进上下文，答案针对你这台机器

工具与技能，可以自己攒
- 把常用操作存成工具，写明参数和用途，下次一句话就能跑
- 技能是一份操作手册，助手执行前先读它
- 也可以直接让助手照着你的机器新建工具或技能，建完就进清单

内置 SSH 终端
- 真的终端，不只是看输出：Tab 补全、方向键翻历史、Ctrl-C 中断都在
- 手机上专门做了一排编辑键，不用去够 Vim
- 想让助手跑，还是自己动手，都行

不用怕它乱来
- 只读操作直接执行：查看状态、读日志、探端口
- 变更操作弹出确认，写清要执行的命令和影响范围
- 可以选只允许这一次，也可以本会话内都允许，也可以直接拒绝
- 每一步都进操作记录，事后能翻

模型自己选
- 支持 OpenAI 兼容接口，Base URL、模型名、Key 都自己填
- 可以配多个模型，在对话里随时切换
- 配置里带连接测试，先测通再用

【安全与隐私】
- 主机、服务、知识、对话全部存在本机，不上传我们的服务器
- 登录密码存在系统钥匙串，不进明文数据库
- 对话内容只发送给你自己配置的模型服务商
- 无需注册账号；换手机时导入一份配置文件即可继续

【免费版与 Pro】
免费版对主机、服务、知识、工具、技能和 AI代执行的数量有上限，适合小规模使用。
对话、终端、Docker、历史记录、服务探测、导入导出，免费版同样不限。
Pro 解锁这些数量上限，其余功能完全一样。Pro 提供自动续期订阅与一次性买断，具体可选方案与价格以 App Store 页面显示为准；订阅会自动续期，可随时在 App Store 账户设置中取消。

使用条款：https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
隐私政策：https://neatflow.hensora.cn/privacy

name: Neon Rail
description:
You are running a neon rail through a city that never stops moving. Four large buttons sit in the two bottom corners, the way your thumbs already rest: left and right to change lanes, up to jump the rubble, down to roll under the gantries.

The rail speeds up in tiers, and the opening is tuned so the first obstacle is on screen inside five seconds. Your best run is kept on the device.

- Four big buttons, laid out for two thumbs
- Speed tiers that keep climbing
- No ads, no accounts, no purchases, no network
- Landscape, and it works either way up

Made by LeMaNg LLC.

name: Nepal Driving License Exam
description:
Unofficial app: it is not affiliated with and does not represent the Department of Transport Management (DoTM), the Ministry of Physical Infrastructure and Transport or any other body of the Government of Nepal. The questions come from the class B written test question bank for 2082/83 published by the Department of Transport Management: https://dotm.gov.np/content/111/-b--written-examination-questions-for-class-2082-83/

Prepare for the written test (likhit pariksha) for a class B driving licence — car, jeep, delivery van — with the department's own question bank. The questions and the app are in Nepali.

ALL 500 QUESTIONS OF THE BANK
• 500 questions with correct answers
• 85 traffic signs with pictures
• 6 topics, as in the bank: driving, traffic law and rules, vehicle mechanics, environment and pollution, accident awareness, traffic signs

MOCK TEST LIKE THE REAL ONE
• 25 questions taken from the 6 topics in the department's proportions
• 4 marks per question, 60 marks (15 correct answers) to pass, 30 minutes
• Skip a question and come back to it
• Review your mistakes right after the test

LEARN WITHOUT STRESS
• Questions you get wrong come back until they stick
• "Hard for you" — the questions you mix up most
• Search — find a question by a word or number and see the answer at once

WORKS OFFLINE
• Everything is on your phone, no internet needed

Free: 10 questions in every topic and one mock test a day, with ads. Ads can be removed with a one-time purchase. Full access to all questions is a one-time purchase (7 days, 30 days or forever), no subscription.

The app is for self-study and does not replace a driving school or official materials.

name: Netwarden New
description:
Netwarden brings professional infrastructure monitoring to your mobile device, giving you complete visibility into your servers, websites, and critical systems from anywhere in the world.

Whether you're a DevOps engineer, system administrator, or business owner, Netwarden ensures you're always connected to what matters most - your infrastructure's health and performance.

KEY FEATURES

- Real-Time Monitoring
- Live CPU, memory, disk, and network metrics
- Monitor Linux, Windows, macOS, and Synology servers
- Track system load, processes, and resource usage
- Visual charts and performance graphs

Instant Alerts
- Push notifications for critical issues
- Customizable alert thresholds
- Quick alert acknowledgment and management
- Stay informed about outages and anomalies

Multi-Host Management
- Monitor unlimited servers from one dashboard
- Organize hosts by location, role, or environment
- Quick switching between different hosts
- Comprehensive host health overview

Professional Features
- Agent-based monitoring with minimal overhead
- Secure communication with your infrastructure
- Historical metrics and trend analysis
- Integration with Netwarden Cloud platform

Perfect For
- DevOps engineers managing production systems
- System administrators monitoring server fleets
- IT teams requiring mobile incident response
- Anyone running critical infrastructure

Why Netwarden?
- Lightweight agent (less than 10MB) with minimal CPU impact
- Industry-standard security practices
- Real-time data synchronization
- Professional-grade monitoring accessible to everyone

name: NexoCMD
description:
NexoCMD brings your Linux and Windows servers together in one native app for Mac, iPhone and iPad.

SSH TERMINAL
• Full screen, tabs, themes and keyboard shortcuts.
• Password or Ed25519, ECDSA and RSA keys, with passphrase.
• Server identity verification, with a warning if it changes.
• One-click reconnect without losing the history.
• Copy on select, right-click to paste and save the terminal text to a file.

SFTP FILES NEXT TO THE TERMINAL
• The panel follows the terminal's folder when you cd.
• Upload by dragging, download, rename, delete and create folders.
• Background transfers that never block the terminal.

SERVER STATUS
• CPU, memory, disk, load, network and uptime at a glance (Linux servers).

REMOTE DESKTOP (RDP)
• Connect to Windows computers with keyboard, mouse and trackpad.
• Shared clipboard, resolution that fits the window and screenshots.
• Server certificate warning and fingerprint, remembered for next time.

ICLOUD SYNC
• Your connections on Mac, iPhone and iPad, end-to-end encrypted.
• Passwords and keys in iCloud Keychain, if you turn it on.

ORGANIZATION
• Folders and subfolders, tags, favorites, recents and search.
• Drag connections and folders to arrange them.
• Import connections from Remote Desktop Manager.
• Export and import your settings as a backup.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No accounts, no ads, no analytics.
• Passwords and keys in your device's keychain or, if you turn it on, in iCloud Keychain.
• Connections go straight from your device to your servers.

name: Nexoniq Companion
description:
Nexoniq Companion does not scan your network. It shows the results from Nexoniq for Mac, and it needs the Mac app to work.

The Mac is the sensor: it scans the network, keeps the history and decides when something needs your attention. This app shows what the Mac sees, so you can check on things from the couch, from work or from another country.

WHAT YOU SEE
The same view as on the Mac: how many devices are online, the network address map, and every device and service in the same groups you set up on the Mac. Tap a device to see a 24-hour activity strip, seven days of hourly uptime history, open ports, notes and its other details.

ALERTS
When a device you've set an alert on goes offline, your iPhone gets the same notification as your Mac. You can acknowledge it straight from the notification or from the device in the app, and the Mac takes care of the rest.

MORE THAN ONE MAC
Have Nexoniq on a Mac at home and another at the office? Both show up here. Pick one from the list to see its network. You can also mute alerts from a single Mac.

A LAPTOP MOVES AROUND
The app always shows the network the Mac is currently connected to. When your MacBook moves from home to the office, the view follows it.

IS THE MAC STILL RUNNING?
Each Mac checks in regularly. The app tells you whether a Mac is running or asleep, whether Nexoniq has stopped, or whether the Mac has stopped responding, so you know whether the data is current.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your data goes from your Mac to your own private iCloud database and from there to your iPhone. There's no Nexoniq server and no account to create.

GETTING STARTED
1. Install Nexoniq on your Mac (macOS 15 or later) and subscribe there.
2. On the Mac, turn on Settings → iPhone.
3. Open this app on an iPhone signed in to the same Apple Account.

No Mac yet? The app opens with a demo network so you can look around first.

The iPhone app is free. Monitoring runs on the Mac and requires an active Nexoniq subscription there.

name: NEXT – Chat & Video Meetings
description:
NEXT brings your organization's instant messaging, calls and video meetings together in one app.

Chats
- Direct and group chats, with mentions, reactions, reply threads and pinned messages.
- Send photos and files.
- Real-time typing indicator, read receipts and unread badges.
- Presence and status: online, away, busy, with a custom message.
- Search your chats and your company directory.
- Report a message or block a person at any time.

Calls and meetings
- Audio and video calls in one tap from a chat, ringing on your colleagues' devices.
- Video meetings: start, join with a code or link, schedule.
- Permanent rooms, waiting room, your organization's recordings.
- Microphone, camera, speaker and front/back camera during the call.

Activity and files
- Mentions and shared files gathered in the Activity tab.
- All exchanged files, sorted by chat.

Sign in
- With your email address and password, or by scanning the pairing code shown on your computer.
- Light and dark mode, iPhone and iPad.
- In English, French and Italian.

NEXT requires an account on a NEXT server provided by your organization. The app contains no ads and no tracking.

name: NibbleKeysStore
description: Rent keyboards and mice by the day across the UK. Browse boards, mice and bundles, pick your dates, then collect at a nearby hub or pay cash on delivery. A refundable deposit is held with your rental and returned after a successful check-in. Track orders, extend a hire, or manage addresses in one place—simple short-term gear when you need it.

name: Night Shift: Reactor 4
description:
Chernobyl, Unit 4. The night of 25 April 1986. A safety test is planned for tonight, and you know how it ended.

You are the reactor operator on the night shift. The grid wants power, your boss wants the test finished before morning, and the reactor is quietly working against you. Can you get through the night differently?

ONE ROOM, ONE NIGHT
A first-person recreation of the Unit 4 control room. Walk between the desks, lean in to read the gauges, and work every control yourself: the power setpoint, the regulator switch, 211 control rods, the pumps, the phones, the test key and, under its cover, AZ-5.

A REACTOR THAT FIGHTS BACK
A small reactor model drives everything you see. Xenon poisoning drags the power down for hours; steam pushes it up. Every rod you pull to hold power drains a safety margin you cannot see on any gauge: the plant computer prints it on paper, minutes after you ask.

FIVE ENDINGS
History is the default, not the only outcome. Hold the power and the margin, scram too early, catch a surge in time, or refuse to turn the key. The best ending is the quietest one, and every ending closes on what really happened that night.

ALSO
- A tutorial with a spoken instructor that teaches every control, one lesson at a time
- A voiced night crew, the dispatcher in Kyiv and the deputy chief engineer
- Touch controls made for iPhone and iPad; papers you can pick up, zoom into and read, with translations
- Night shift, alarm and archive-film looks; a calm room that turns red in the final minute

The night follows the IAEA's INSAG-7 report. Every character is fictional, placed in a real role; the game puts no words in the mouths of the people who worked that night. It is tense, not gory: there are no deaths on screen.

name: NightSounds: Snore Tracker
description:
NightSounds tells you whether you snored, coughed or talked in your sleep last night — all analysed on your phone.

Put the phone beside your bed, tap Start and go to sleep. In the morning you get a clear summary:
• How many minutes you snored, and when
• How often you coughed or talked in your sleep
• A full-night timeline with the key moments
• Weekly, monthly and yearly trends

White noise
Pick rain, fan, white, pink or brown noise and set a timer. While it plays the app pauses listening; when it stops, tracking carries on.

Safety Shield
Turn it on to be alerted when there is screaming during the night, with a quick call button when you need it.

Private by design
• Sound is analysed on the phone and never uploaded
• No account, no ads, no tracking
• Short clips are saved only if you allow it, and can be deleted any time

Please note: NightSounds is not a medical device and does not diagnose any condition. Sound labels are estimates made by AI on your phone and can be wrong. If you are worried about your sleep or health, talk to a doctor. Safety Shield does not replace emergency services.

name: Nihongo Tree
description:
Nihongo Tree is Japanese vocabulary organised like a tree, for learners who are past the beginner stage. 6,587 words are grouped into 116 branches under limbs such as people, home, food, town, work, nature and society, and each branch splits into small twigs of related words. Words for the same situation are learned together, which is how they stick.

Every word has its kanji with furigana, romaji, an English meaning, its JLPT level where it has one (N5 to N1), an example sentence with a translation, and audio for both the word and the sentence. Mark the words you already know, hide the ones you don't need, filter by JLPT level and turn furigana on or off.

FLASH CARDS
Study any twig or branch with flash cards: Japanese to English or English to Japanese. Verb decks add a conjugation drill.

GRAMMAR
The Grammar limb covers 80 Japanese particles in 7 families, 147 uses in all. Each use has example sentences with furigana, English and audio, and cards that blank out the particle so you can practise choosing it.

DAILY CONVERSATION
Every morning there is a new two-minute conversation between Kenta and Misaki, two old friends from Sapporo, built around the words of one branch. Read the transcript with furigana and English, play it all, or replay one line at a time. If you like, the app can remind you once a day, around the time you usually open the app (6:30 am Mountain Time until it has learned that), and never before the new conversation is out. The reminder is off until you turn it on from the Daily page.

ABOUT THE AUDIO
All of the audio is AI-generated with Google's Gemini text-to-speech. Kenta and Misaki are fictional characters, and their conversations are written and voiced with AI tools.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no sign-in, no ads and no tracking. Your progress stays on your device. The app counts how it is used with Google Analytics, without your phone's advertising ID; in Europe only if you agree, and you can turn it off at any time.

GOOD TO KNOW
The tree, search, flash cards and your progress work offline. Word audio and the Daily conversations stream from nihongotree.com, so they need a connection. New words and grammar arrive with app updates; a new Daily conversation arrives every morning without one. Anki decks for JLPT N3, N2 and the most common words are free to download at nihongotree.com.

Nihongo Tree is made by Anthem Technology.

name: Nile Tiles
description:
Fit pieces on an 8 × 8 board. Complete a row or column to make space for the next tray. Place a piece at just the right intersection and you can clear both at once.

Choose your round
• Classic — take your time and try to beat your best score.
• 12 moves — score 50 for bronze, 85 for silver or 125 for gold. Start a fresh round with one tap.
• Daily puzzle — everyone starts with the same board and piece sequence. Meet the daily line goal on consecutive days to build a streak.

Listen for a different sound when a piece lands or a line clears. Switch on the optional background melody, adjust the volume or play quietly. Play in English or Arabic, offline, and pick up your saved round where you left off.

name: Nimbu Chat
description:
Nimbu Chat is a private messenger with no account, no phone number and no company in the middle. Messages travel straight from your phone to the other person's phone, end-to-end encrypted.

("Nimbu" is Hindi for lemon. Simple and fresh.)

HOW IT WORKS
• Open the app and pick a name. That's the whole sign-up.
• Show your code, or scan a friend's. One scan connects you both.
• Chat. Only the two of you can read your messages.

WHAT MAKES IT DIFFERENT
• No account. No email, no phone number, no contact list upload.
• No central server storing your chats. Your messages live on your phone.
• End-to-end encrypted. Relays that help deliver a message only ever see scrambled data.
• No ads, no tracking, no analytics.

GOOD TO KNOW
• Messages are sent and received while the app is open. If your friend's app is closed, your message waits and arrives when they open it.
• One tick: waiting for them. Two ticks: delivered to their phone. Coloured ticks: read.
• Text messages only in this version.
• Deleting the app's data removes your chats for good. There is no cloud backup.

SAFETY
• Block anyone from the chat menu. A blocked person can't message you, even if they scan your code again.
• Report abuse from the same menu. Reports are reviewed within 24 hours.

TRY IT ALONE
Tap "Try a demo chat" to talk to the built-in demo contact, which replies to every message.

name: Níscalo: Mushroom Identifier
description:
Found a mushroom? Snap a photo and Níscalo suggests which species it may be, how confident it is and what it can be confused with. Save your spots on a 3D satellite map and, if you turn it on, get an alert the day before when rain and temperature favor saffron milk caps in your area.

IMPORTANT: Níscalo does not replace an expert mycologist. AI identification is a guide only and can be wrong. Never eat a mushroom just because an app says so: if you have the slightest doubt, don't eat it, and ask an expert or a local mycological society.

IDENTIFY FROM A PHOTO
• Use the camera or your library; show the cap, gills and stem for a better result.
• The most likely species, with common and scientific name and a confidence percentage. When it's low, the app tells you not to rely on it.
• An edibility guide, always shown with the safety warning, and the species it can be confused with, including dangerous lookalikes.

A SIMPLE MUSHROOM FORECAST
• Turn on alerts in the app's Settings to get "Saffron milk caps may be out tomorrow" the day before, when enough rain has fallen and temperatures are right, during the fall season in your hemisphere.
• Built for the saffron milk cap (Lactarius deliciosus), the mushroom of pine woods. It's an estimate from weather data, not a guarantee: no alert with frost or heavy rain due tomorrow, and never more than one every 3 days. It only uses an approximate area of about 10 km around your latest spot or last position.

A MAP MADE FOR THE WOODS
• Apple satellite imagery with 3D terrain: tilt the map and read slopes, ravines and forest edges.
• Five layers: Pine forests, Towns and roads, Trails and tracks, Streams and springs, and Contour lines (NASA SRTM data), which show elevation, slope and sun or shade under the crosshair.
• The "Pine forests" layer shades conifers in orange from Copernicus satellite data (European Union, 2018). It covers Europe only; elsewhere this layer has no data.
• Press and hold any point to open its card: save a spot there or get directions. The app reopens on the last tab you used.

YOUR SPOTS STAY PRIVATE
• Save them with GPS or at the exact point on the map, with a name and a note, and share only if you want: with friends, on the wall or in a message.
• "Go" screen: a line to your spot and a compass with bearing and distance. "Directions by car" opens the route in your maps app.

FINDS AND FRIENDS
• See what's nearby and the latest finds from other foragers, and post yours with a photo and location, choosing who sees where: only you, your friends or everyone.
• Add friends with a code and see their finds and the spots they share with you.

NO EMAIL, NO PASSWORD
A name is all you need. The app needs internet to identify, load the map, share and receive alerts. On iPhone, iPad and Mac with Apple silicon; the Mac has no compass and, without a camera, you identify from a photo in your library.

FREE AND PRO
• Free to download, with ads: a banner and a short full-screen video before each photo analysis.
• Níscalo Pro removes the banner and the videos, billed monthly or yearly; the price in your currency is shown in the App Store before you subscribe. Includes a 7-day free trial if you haven't tried it before.

Download Níscalo and take it on your next forage.

name: Nitestays
description:
NITESTAYS is the easy way to book hotels, flights and cars, and plan the whole trip with NIA, your AI travel assistant.

TELL NIA WHERE YOU WANT TO GO
Ask in plain words, like "a beach hotel in Goa for the long weekend under ₹8,000". NIA searches live prices, compares rooms and builds a day-by-day plan you can book in a few taps.

HOTELS EVERYWHERE
• Thousands of hotels, resorts and homestays with real-time prices and availability
• Clear room choices, with taxes and fees shown before you pay
• Real guest reviews, photos and maps
• Free-cancellation rooms clearly marked

FLIGHTS AND CARS
• Search one-way and round-trip flights and choose your fare
• Pick your seats on a simple seat map
• Rent a car, with one-way drop-off when you need it

YOUR TRIP, ALWAYS WITH YOU
• Your price is held while you check out, with a live countdown on the Dynamic Island and Lock Screen
• Booking passes and Apple Wallet cards for every stay
• Invoices and receipts in one place
• Price alerts: we tell you when a hotel gets cheaper
• Share a stay board with friends and plan together

SAFE AND SIMPLE
• Secure card payments
• Sign in with Apple or your email
• Delete your account any time from Account → Delete account

Questions? Reach our support team or ask NIA right from the app.

name: NL Growth
description:
NL Growth is de app voor klanten van NorthernLights Solutions. Je Instagram-groei staat erin zoals je hem kent van je dashboard, maar dan in je zak.

EEN KEER KOPPELEN
Je plakt je dashboardlink een keer. Daarna open je de app en ben je er meteen in, ook na een herstart of een update. Geen wachtwoord, geen inlogscherm.

WAT JE ZIET
Je volgers, je groei deze week en hoeveel procent er terugvolgt. Een grafiek van je volgersgroei, over 30 dagen of sinds de start. Wat je agents vandaag deden, van minuut tot minuut. Welke doelgroepen het meeste opleveren, zodat je weet waar je op moet inzetten. En hoeveel ruimte er deze week nog is binnen de veilige grenzen.

JE TEAM
Je agents hebben namen en gezichten. Sanne volgt nieuwe mensen uit je doelgroep, Lotte ruimt op wie niet terugvolgt, Romario verwelkomt nieuwe volgers. Je zet ze met een schakelaar aan en uit, en ziet wanneer ze weer aan de beurt zijn.

ALLES ZELF INSTELLEN
Doelgroepen, hashtags, je toon, je propositie en je welkomstbericht pas je aan in de app. Wat je opslaat gaat direct naar je agents.

MELDINGEN DIE ERGENS OVER GAAN
Je kunt een bericht krijgen als er iets gebeurt dat je wilt weten: nieuwe terugvolgers, een week die af is, of een verbinding die aandacht vraagt. Geen reclame, geen dagelijkse ruis. Je bepaalt zelf of je ze aanzet.

NL Growth werkt alleen als je klant bent bij NorthernLights Solutions en een dashboardlink van ons hebt gekregen.

name: NL Wholesale
description:
NL Wholesale is the private ordering app for New Level Creations wholesale buyers.

Request access, get approved by the New Level team, and see your own personalized shopping list for MOTION, BKFC and Centyx products. Review items, make your picks, and send your order requests straight to us.

Features:
- Simple account request and approval
- Your own private shopping list, built for you
- Pick the items you want and keep track of your choices
- Delete your account anytime from inside the app

NL Wholesale is for approved wholesale buyers of New Level Creations.

name: No-Source Universe
description:
Discover the world of The No-Source Project.

No-Source Universe brings Book 1 to your phone in English and Spanish, with a reading experience connected to your account.

• Read Book 1 in English or Spanish.
• Continue reading where you left off.
• Save bookmarks and adjust zoom.
• Sync your reading progress between the app and website.

Sign in with your No-Source Universe account to access the digital book linked to your account. Full-book access requires a separately purchased license. Purchases are not available inside the app.
