name: Noctyrasur
description:
Through chromatic phase-shifting collisions. Instead of predictable brick breaking or standard pool bounces, every rebound in this dark-neon arena dynamically alters your striker orb's spectral frequency. Line up precision slingshot trajectories, cycle your initial phase tint, and pierce matching Prism Gates to accelerate through barriers without losing momentum while stacking high-voltage chain multipliers.

Master three escalating resonance tiers—Cadet Drift, Kinetic Vortex, and Quantum Abyss—each introducing shifting bumper walls, mobile targets, and gravity-draining Void Singularities that punish careless angles. Track your highest chain combos in the telemetry vault, export custom Victory Cards directly to your photo library, or submit annotated with camera. Built for crisp tactile precision, App delivers deep strategic ricochet puzzles wrapped in a sleek, eye-friendly obsidian aesthetic.

name: NoiseDog
description:
NoiseDog shows how loud it is around you, keeps a log of noisy moments with where they happened, and keeps watch for you: it sounds an alarm when it gets too loud or when someone moves your iPhone.

A CLEAR SOUND METER
• A big decibel reading, a gauge and a moving signal, with min, average and max.
• Plain comparisons you can picture: as loud as a library, city traffic, a motorcycle or an ambulance siren.
• dB(A), dB(C) or unweighted, and calibration against a real meter.

SESSIONS WITH A MAP
• Tap record to keep the sound and its level every second.
• See the average, loudest and quietest moments, the background level and how long it was over 85 dB.
• Every session remembers where it was recorded. Search, filter by loudness, sort by loudest or quietest, and see them all on a map.
• Rename a session, add notes, and share its audio, a summary picture or a table of levels.

DOG WATCH
• Set a limit and NoiseDog sounds an alarm when it gets louder than that. Useful for a sleeping baby, an empty flat or a noisy neighbour.
• Run it until you stop it, for a number of hours, or on a schedule on chosen days.
• Ignore short bangs: decide how long the noise must last.
• Nothing is recorded.

MOTION SENSOR
• Lay your iPhone on a bag, a door handle or a laptop. If it is moved, picked up or tilted, the alarm goes off.
• A 3D iPhone and live charts show every movement as it happens.
• Its own sensitivity, schedule and alarm.

YOUR ALARM, YOUR WAY
• Siren, bark, beeper, whoop or a soft chime, at the loudness you choose. You hear it as you slide.
• Red, police lights, strobe, glow or a calm screen, with your own message.
• Flashlight, vibration and a Lock Screen notification.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Recordings, sound levels, motion readings and places stay on your iPhone.
• No account. Sharing anonymous usage statistics is your choice.
• 14 languages, light and dark.

NoiseDog gives an estimate. An iPhone is not a certified sound level meter.

name: Noor Daily (bfbd49)
description:
Start each day with a verse-rooted affirmation, and end it with a heart at rest.

Noor Daily is a calm, ad-free companion for a 60-day journey of faith, gratitude and peace. Every morning, afternoon and evening you receive one short affirmation, and every affirmation is tied to a real reference from the Quran or authentic hadith, so you always know where its meaning comes from.

THREE MOMENTS, EVERY DAY
A morning intention, an afternoon reset and an evening reflection. Switch between them on the Today screen and see the source, the quote and its verified reference at a glance.

LISTEN AND REFLECT
Press play to hear each affirmation read aloud in a gentle voice, then answer a short gratitude prompt in a single line. Save your reflection privately, or share a beautiful image of the affirmation with someone you love.

WATCH YOUR JOURNEY GROW
A 60-day map shows every day you have completed, along with your streak, your saved affirmations for hard days, and every reflection you have written.

GENTLE REMINDERS
Choose a time for morning, afternoon and evening, and Noor Daily will nudge you softly when it is time to pause. You can even start the narration right from the reminder.

YOUR JOURNEY, KEPT SAFE
Noor Daily works fully without an account. If you want, sign in with Apple or Google to back up your progress and continue on another device.

NOTHING ELSE
No ads, no feeds, no clutter. Just one meaningful moment, three times a day.

NOOR+
Noor+ is an optional subscription, available monthly or yearly with a 7-day free trial, or as a one-time lifetime purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and can be managed in your App Store account settings.

Begin day one today, and let a little light into every part of your day.

Terms of Use: https://noor-daily-brfhyf9.rork.app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://noor-daily-brfhyf9.rork.app/privacy

name: Nopamine: Short Video Blocker
description:
See the video you came for, then leave.

Nopamine is a Safari extension that hides YouTube Shorts and endless recommendation feeds in Safari. Turn it on once, and "just one video" stops turning into an hour.

■ What it hides
• Shorts: Shorts shelves and tabs on the home page, in search results and on channels
• Home feed: the endless grid of recommendations on the start page
• Suggested videos: what to watch next, beside and below the video
• Comments
• Autoplay of the next video

Shorts links open as regular videos instead.

■ All at once, or one by one
"Turn Off All Dopamine" switches everything on or off in one tap. Prefer to choose? Toggle each feature separately.

■ Set up in a minute
Just turn on the Safari extension in Settings. Not sure where to tap? Real screenshots of the Settings app walk you through every step.

■ Your privacy stays yours
Nopamine never records the pages you visit or what you search for. It only collects anonymous usage statistics and crash reports to improve the app.

Nopamine works inside Safari, so it works best when you watch YouTube in Safari instead of the app.

Privacy Policy: https://nopamine-zerone-20261120.web.app/privacy/
Contact: musk@zeronestudio.xyz

YouTube is a trademark of Google LLC. Nopamine is not affiliated with Google.

name: Norua Manager
description:
Norua Manager is the mobile management console for restaurant owners and authorized managers using Norua POS.

With Norua Manager you can:
• Track live sales, open checks, refunds, voids, and daily close-out summaries across one or multiple stores.
• Review multi-store reports, payroll/tip summaries, settlement records, and export CSV or PDF reports directly from your phone.
• Monitor real-time operational alerts, customer feedback, and waitlist status on the go.
• Manage menu items, pricing, store hours, staff permissions, promotions, and inventory.
• Chat with the built-in AI operations assistant and reach Norua technical support directly inside the app.

This app is designed for restaurant owners and authorized staff with an existing Norua POS account. Account creation is managed by your restaurant administrator; register PINs and device pairing codes are not used to sign in here.

Website: https://norua.ai
Support: ran@norua.ai

name: norua Team
description:
norua Team is the dedicated mobile collaboration workspace for norua teams and operations staff.

Key features:
• Team Channels & Direct Messages: Coordinate store support, operations, and internal threads in real time with instant push notifications.
• Live Voice & Video Calls: Start or join team voice calls with reliable background audio continuity so conversations never drop when you switch apps or lock your screen.
• Instant Camera & Media Capture: Snap and share photos, videos, or voice notes directly from the workspace without repetitive permission prompts.
• Tasks, Knowledge & Support Context: Follow up on assigned tasks, review knowledge docs, and jump straight from notifications into the exact conversation or item.

Note: norua Team is an internal enterprise workspace. Sign-in requires an active company staff account provisioned by your workspace administrator.

name: Nova Breach: Blockade
description:
Break the blockade.

The Null Armada has sealed the space lanes. Fly the last free deflector ship, bounce the ball, smash the blocks and take the sectors back one by one.

Nova Breach is a fast, modern brick breaker built for short runs and big comebacks.

WHAT'S INSIDE
• 20 sectors, four of them dreadnought boss fights with three attack phases each
• 12 boosts to catch: Squadron, Plasma Lance, Ion Storm, Wingmen, Gravity Well, Time Dilation and more
• Charge the Nova Pulse with your hits and clear the field in one blast
• Three stars to earn in every sector
• A new Daily Challenge every day: the same three sectors for every pilot, with its own leaderboard
• Hangar: earn credits by playing and spend them on permanent upgrades and new ships
• Missions that pay out as you play
• Boss Rush, and The Deep: an endless run
• Short story films between the acts
• Plays offline. Leaderboards need a connection.

FAIR PLAY
No ads. No timers. No loot boxes. Credits are earned by playing and cannot be bought.
Sectors 1 to 5 and the Daily Challenge are free. One purchase unlocks the full game for good.

Made by Rubik Solutions.

name: Nowpin: Do what you save
description:
Saved a reel, then never did the thing?
Nowpin turns each one into something you can do.
Share a reel to Nowpin and it is saved and read for you: a summary, a checklist or steps, and a reminder when you want one.

SHARE A REEL. NOWPIN READS IT.
Open a reel in Instagram, tap the paper plane, choose Share to, then pick Nowpin. You can also paste one link or many at once. Nowpin watches the reel and writes up what is in it. It usually takes under a minute, and you can leave the screen while it works.

If a reel is private and cannot be read, paste its caption and Nowpin saves it as a note.

WHAT YOU GET FOR EACH SAVE
- A short title and summary
- A checklist, steps or key takeaways, depending on the reel
- Links to what the reel is about, when there is one
- A transcript of what was said in the reel, when one is available
- A type that says what you might do with it: Watch, Cook, Visit, Go, Buy, Read, Move, Try or Feel
- Films and shows: a link to where you can watch
- Places: a Must visit tag and a link for directions
- Events: add them to your calendar
AI can make mistakes. You can edit any title, summary or note, change the type, or ask for a fresh read.

FOLDERS AND THE PLAN TAB
Group saves that belong together in folders, like a trip, a recipe list or a project. Add a checklist or watch list to your to-dos, then tick items off on the Plan tab as you go. Nothing lands on that list unless you add it. When you finish something, mark it done.

FIND IT FAST
See your saves as Open, Planned or Done. Filter by type, by what it is (places, events, recipes, films and more), by folder, or by Must visit places. Sort by newest, oldest, coming up first or A to Z. Search by title, account name, caption, summary, tags or what was said in the reel. Switch between cards and a compact list.

Bored? Tap Surprise me and Nowpin picks one of your saved ideas.

REMINDERS AT THE RIGHT MOMENT
Tap Plan it on any save and pick when: tonight, tomorrow evening, this weekend, next week, or a date and time you choose. Nowpin reminds you then, and the save shows on your Plan tab. When an event post gives a date, Nowpin sets a reminder for it. For films and shows, Nowpin can send a gentle nudge in the evening. Choose daily, weekly or off in the You tab. Reminders arrive as notifications, and Nowpin asks before it sends any.

PRIVATE TO YOU
Your saves are private to you. Nothing is posted anywhere. AI reads the reel you share to write your summary and checklist. Delete a save, or your whole account, any time in the You tab. You can also export your data there.

SIGN IN
Sign in with Apple or Google. There is no new password to make.

Nowpin works with reels and posts you share from Instagram. Nowpin is not affiliated with, endorsed or sponsored by Instagram or Meta.

name: OB Golf
description:
The course never stops scrolling. Swing while the ball rolls, bounces or flies, and keep up, or you're OUT OF BOUNDS.

ENDLESS GOLF
Pull back and release to swing. Clear water, ravines and houses. Bounce off cart paths, launch off golf cart roofs, and get popped up by sprinklers. Dodge birds and geese. Sink it in a cup for +50 yards.

DAILY RACE
Everyone plays the same course each day. You get 3 tries and your best one counts. Other players show up as ghost balls while you play, then SEE THE RACE replays everyone at once, with a winner and a leaderboard. Post the results and tag your friends.

COINS
Grab coins floating over the fairway and high over the water. Use them for an extra Daily Race run when your 3 tries are gone.

SKINS, TRAILS & COURSES
Spend coins on ball skins like Lava, 8 Ball, Gold and Rainbow, trails like Fire, Smoke and Gold Dust, and whole new course looks: Night, Desert, Snow and Links.

RACE FLAIR
Name colors and badges that everyone sees on your ghost ball in the Daily Race.

KEEP GOING
Died in Endless? Spend coins to continue right where you were.

- One-thumb controls
- Short runs, perfect for a quick break
- Pick your Instagram handle as your username to get tagged

name: OBD Sage – OBD2 Car Scanner
description:
Understand what your car is telling you. OBD Sage turns a simple ELM327 OBD2 adapter into a clear, modern car scanner – for every car with an OBD2 port (petrol from 2001, diesel from 2004 in the EU, all cars from 1996 in the US).

FREE
• Read and clear trouble codes (stored, pending, permanent) with plain-language descriptions
• Check engine light status, freeze frame and emissions readiness monitors
• Vehicle info: VIN, calibration ID, OBD standard
• 4 live values at a time, last 3 scans in history
• Adapter check: detects fake “v2.1” clones, measures speed and command support
• Fuel log with real consumption and cost per 100 km
• Backup & transfer to a new phone
• Demo mode – try everything without a car

OBD SAGE PRO – one-time purchase, no subscription
• Causes, checks and rough repair costs for every code – plus known weak spots of your make
• Used car check: detects recently cleared codes and hidden problems, PDF report
• Readiness assistant: guides you through the drive until all emissions monitors are ready
• Battery & alternator test with a clear verdict
• Misfires per cylinder and ECU test results (Mode 06)
• Manufacturer values (Mode 22) and custom PIDs with formula editor
• Unlimited live data, gauges, charts, warnings, HUD for the windshield
• GPS trip log – automatic with the adapter, CSV/PDF export
• Guided tests: vacuum leak, oxygen sensors & catalyst, 0–100 timing, trip computer
• Garage with multiple vehicles, service log, unlimited history and statistics

ADAPTERS
Works with ELM327-compatible Bluetooth LE adapters (e.g. Vgate iCar Pro BLE, OBDLink CX, Veepeak BLE+) and Wi-Fi adapters. Adapters with an STN chip (OBDLink, vLinker) give the best results. Classic Bluetooth adapters cannot be used on iPhone (iOS restriction). Closed systems such as BlueDriver, Carista or FIXD are not supported.

PRIVACY
No account, no ads, no tracking. Your data stays on your phone.

NOTE
OBD2 covers emission-related control units (engine, often transmission). Airbag, ABS and comfort systems need a manufacturer tool. Clearing codes does not fix the cause. Do not operate the app while driving.

name: OBEN OS
description:
OBEN OS es el sistema de punto de venta para tiendas y restaurantes. Cobra, controla tu inventario y revisa cómo va tu negocio, todo en un solo lugar.

TIENDAS Y FERRETERÍAS
• Cobra rápido: busca o escanea el producto y listo.
• Imprime el ticket en tu impresora térmica Bluetooth.
• Inventario con existencias, pasillo y aviso cuando algo se acaba.
• Clientes con crédito, abonos y cotizaciones.
• Proveedores y compras.

RESTAURANTES Y CAFETERÍAS
• Mesas en el salón, para llevar y reservaciones.
• Comandas a cocina y cuenta por mesa.
• Menú con fotos y precios.
• Avisos en tu iPhone cuando llega un pedido.

PARA EL DUEÑO
• Corte de caja por turno y por día.
• Reportes de venta, utilidad y lo más vendido.
• Empleados con su propio PIN y permisos.
• Funciona con varias cajas al mismo tiempo, en la tienda o desde tu casa.

Sigue vendiendo aunque se vaya el internet: cuando regresa, todo se sube solo.

Prueba gratis 21 días. Crea tu cuenta en obenos.com.

name: Objection Desk: Courtroom Sim
description:
You are a defence attorney, and your client is innocent. Every witness has told one lie. Find it, and prove it.

STUDY THE CASE FILE
Read the charge, meet your client and examine every piece of evidence: receipts, logs, photos, weather records, timetables.

CROSS-EXAMINE
Step through each witness's testimony. Press them for more detail. When a statement does not add up, shout OBJECTION! and present the evidence that proves it wrong.

WATCH THE JUDGE
A wrong objection tries the judge's patience. Run out, and you lose the case.

ENDLESS CASES
New cases are written for you on demand, on any topic from shop thefts to art forgeries and insurance fraud. Fifteen hand-crafted classic cases are built in and work completely offline.

THREE DIFFICULTY LEVELS
Easy: one witness and free hints. Normal: two witnesses and paid hints. Hard: three witnesses, red-herring evidence and no hints.

BUILD YOUR CAREER
Earn fees and reputation, keep your win streak alive and rise from Intern to Legend of the Bar.

Designed by a practising attorney with 30 years in court.

All cases, names and events are fictional. Objection Desk is a game and does not give legal advice.

name: Ốc Nhớ: Lịch & Nhắc việc
description:
Ốc Nhớ là cuốn sổ nhỏ cho mỗi ngày: xem lịch, ghi việc cần làm, chép ghi chú, và để bé Ốc nhắc bạn đúng giờ.

HÔM NAY
• Tờ lịch bóc có ngày âm lịch, năm can chi, mùng một và rằm.
• Lịch và việc của hôm nay trên cùng một trang.
• Mỗi ngày một câu thương dễ thương, chạm để đổi câu khác.

LỊCH
• Xem theo ngày, 3 ngày, tuần hoặc tháng, có ngày âm lịch trên từng ô.
• Sự kiện lặp lại, cả ngày, nhiều màu để phân biệt.
• Nhắc trước 5 phút đến 1 tuần, chọn giờ tới từng phút.

VIỆC CẦN LÀM
• Gõ nhanh kiểu "họp nhóm 9h sáng mai", Ốc tự hiểu ngày giờ.
• Danh sách riêng, cờ ưu tiên, việc lặp lại, nhắc sớm.
• Bấm "Xong" hoặc "Nhắc lại sau 10 phút" ngay trên thông báo, không cần mở app.
• Đính kèm đường link, ảnh hoặc tài liệu quét.
• Tìm việc nhanh, gõ không dấu cũng được.

GHI CHÚ
• Chữ đậm, nghiêng, gạch ngang, tiêu đề, danh sách, checklist.
• Chèn ảnh, tài liệu quét, hình vẽ tay và bản ghi âm ngay giữa đoạn chữ.
• Ghim ghi chú quan trọng, chia thư mục, đổi màu giấy.
• Gửi qua Zalo, Messenger, hoặc xuất PDF và Markdown.
• Xoá nhầm vẫn lấy lại được trong "Đã xoá gần đây".

RIÊNG TƯ
Mọi thứ chỉ lưu trên iPhone của bạn. Không cần tài khoản, không quảng cáo, không thu thập dữ liệu. Sao lưu cả sổ ra một file để cất giữ hoặc chuyển sang máy mới.

Ốc nhỏ, nhớ thật nhiều.

name: OffGuide
description:
OffGuide shows you the real-world risks in the places you visit, so you can enjoy them safely.

Open the app and OffGuide finds the city you're in or nearest to, then shows its risks that are known by many or known be few. Each risk comes with a severity level that adjusts with the season, plus practical guidance on how to stay safe.

FEATURES
• Nearby risks – Automatically see hazards for the city you're in or closest to.
• Seasonal severity – Risk levels change with spring, summer, autumn, and winter.
• Safety guidance – Clear tips for every hazard.
• Explore – Browse every supported city and its risks.
• Community feed – Post updates about what's happening in a city, and like or comment on posts from locals.
• Suggest new risks – Submit hazards for your home city. The community votes on them, and approved submissions become official city risks.
• Arrival alerts – Get a heads-up about local risks when you spend time in a new city.

SAFE COMMUNITY
OffGuide has zero tolerance for abusive content. You can report any post, comment, or submission, or block users you don't want to see. Reports are reviewed within 24 hours.

PRIVACY
Your location is used only on your device to find nearby cities. It's never sent to our servers. You can delete your account and all your content at any time from your Profile.

OffGuide currently covers cities across Michigan, with more on the way.

name: OL Office Survivor Blue Monday
description:
Monday morning, 8:59.
The weekend just ended, and the moment Mari walks into the office, the gossips, the quota-obsessed sales reps, the angry clients, HR and the lecturing seniors all swarm her at once.

Hold it in? Not today.

OL Office Survivor: Blue Monday is a landscape survivor-like action game. You just move — slaps and high-heel kicks fire automatically. How many waves can you survive as the crowd gets bigger and faster?

[ JUST MOVE ]
- Drag anywhere to walk; playable with one hand
- Slap, high kick, stomp, side kick: a four-hit combo, fully automatic
- Cornered? Dash Kick sends everyone in your path flying. You're invincible while dashing, and the landing blasts a ring around you

[ CHANGE OUTFITS, CHANGE ULTIMATES ]
- Level up and pick one of six outfits: qipao, karaoke, evening gown, ice-bucket bikini, teacher and pool party
- Tap an outfit button to unleash its ultimate, then transform: even your normal attacks change
- Each outfit levels up to 5. Low on health? Grab a black coffee

[ ENDLESS WAVES, ENDLESS BOSSES ]
- Every wave lasts 30 seconds. Enemies get denser, faster and tougher, and surround you in full rings
- Every 5 waves a boss shows up in person: the Department Manager, the Bully Director and the Chairman
- Fight from the lobby through the open office, meeting room, pantry, copy room and the boss's office, all the way into overtime at night
- Enemies shout classic Japanese office lines as they come at you

[ ITEMS ]
- Coffee, delivery bento, energy drinks, ID badges, time cards and more, each with its own effect
- Bosses always drop an item

[ ALSO ]
- English, Traditional Chinese, Japanese and Korean text; Mari speaks Japanese
- 1x / 1.5x / 2x speed
- Top-5 local high scores


Pay once. No ads, no in-app purchases.
Survive this Monday and you're the last one standing in the office.

name: Ollo Flow
description:
Make a little more room for what matters. Ollo Flow brings your tasks, reminders, and focus sessions together in one place.

Plan your day
Add work and personal tasks, put the important ones first, and see your progress as you check them off.

Remember what’s due
Set reminders for timesheets and other routines. Choose specific days and a time, then repeat every week, every two weeks, or once.

Make time to focus
Choose a session length, play optional ambient sounds, and keep track of your timer with Live Activities on supported iPhones.

Pick your buddy
Choose Sphere, Cloud, or Pebble to keep you company. Ollo Flow works on your device without an account.

name: Ombo: English Words A to Z
description:
Ombo is an English vocabulary game built around the alphabet. Every letter has a clue — you type the word before the clock runs out. No multiple choice, no guessing from four options: you recall the word yourself, which is exactly how it sticks.

CLASSIC A–Z
26 letters, 26 clues, 3 minutes. Pass a letter and it comes back at the end of the round.

YOUR LEVEL, MEASURED
A short placement test sets your level — A1, A2, B1, B2 or C1, based on the Oxford word lists — and your answers keep moving it as you improve.

SPACED REPETITION
The words you miss come back tomorrow, then in three days, then in a week, until you know them for good.

18 THEMES
Food, animals, travel, sport, nature, health, work, science, culture and more — thousands of words, grouped the way you use them.

DAILY CHALLENGE & SURVIVAL
The same words for everyone each day, with a leaderboard. In Survival, every right answer buys you more time.

HEAR EVERY WORD
Tap a word to hear it, and see its meaning and an example sentence after each round.

STREAKS, BADGES, LEADERBOARDS
Keep your daily streak, earn badges and see where you rank today, this week and of all time.

PLAYS OFFLINE
Every mode works without a connection.

Free to play with optional ads between rounds. Remove ads with a single purchase, or get Ombo Premium for every theme, unlimited hints, detailed stats and streak protection.

name: ON14 Body Engineering
description:
ON14 is a companion record tool for the practices described in the book OPERATIONAL NIHILISM by Naoto Fujie.

Log what you practised and how it felt:
• Choose the situation (standing, walking, running, sitting) and the duration.
• Mark which of the fourteen items you intended.
• Rate comfort, perceived effort and fatigue in your own words and numbers.
• Record safety: whether you stopped or modified the practice, and any pain, dizziness or breathing difficulty.
• Optionally record the knee-flexion drill with your own estimate of the actual angle and the support you used.
• For running, tag each run as R0 (ordinary running), R1 (running with the fourteen items) or R2 (a later task with reminders reduced) if you want to compare your own runs.

Read the fourteen items and the running-training description as the published edition defines them (short English renderings), with what each item does not ask.

What this app does not do:
• It does not score achievement, give advice, or claim that any practice works. The book itself states that its practices carry no guarantee, and that the running-training comparison has not been executed.
• It is not medical advice. Talk to a qualified health professional before starting any physical practice.

Your data stays on your device. There is no account, no network access, no analytics and no tracking. You can export your records as CSV or JSON and delete everything at any time.

name: ONE GAME
description:
ONE GAME on kymmenen keilan keilailun tuloskortti 1–4 pelaajalle. Kirjaa heitto pikanäppäimillä tai valitse kaatuneet keilat kuvasta. Sovellus laskee ruutujen pisteet kaatoineen, paikkoineen ja kymmenennen ruudun lisäheittoineen. Pisteet lasketaan ilman tasoituksia.

Pelaaja voi vaihtua automaattisesti ruudun jälkeen, tai voit vaihtaa pelaajaa itse. Viimeisen heiton voi perua. Jos haluat korjata aiemman ruudun, voit vahvistaa muutoksen ja syöttää sen sekä sitä seuraavat heitot uudelleen. Keskeneräinen sarja tallentuu laitteelle, joten voit jatkaa sitä myöhemmin.

Valmiit sarjat näkyvät historiassa. Voit suodattaa listan pelaajan mukaan ja tarkastella keskiarvoa, parasta sarjaa sekä kaatojen ja paikkojen osuuksia. Tuloskorttiin voi liittää keilahallin nimen ja muistiinpanon.

Oppaassa on 18 artikkelia säännöistä, termeistä, tekniikasta ja harjoittelusta. Esimerkkisarjasta näet, miten 180 pisteen tulos kertyy ruutu ruudulta. Asetuksissa voit säätää automaattista vuoronvaihtoa ja viedä sarjat JSON-varmuuskopiona.

Sovellus toimii ilman verkkoyhteyttä ja käyttäjätiliä. Tulokset ja asetukset säilyvät laitteella. Käyttöliittymä ja opas ovat englanniksi ja yksinkertaistetuksi kiinaksi.

name: One Good Scroll
description:
Trade one scroll for a good one.

The average adult online will spend over 2½ hours today scrolling social media and video apps (GWI data, DataReportal Digital 2026). Make one of those scrolls a good one: about five minutes in the Bible, then you're done.

Open the app and swipe through today's reading like a feed, one King James verse at a time. Answer a quick question about what you just read, sit with one key verse, and take a moment to reflect. Then you see a done screen and put your phone down having finished something good. No endless feed. It ends.

TODAY'S SCROLL IS ALWAYS FREE
Every day, free:
• A short King James passage, one verse card at a time
• A quick question or two that keeps you in the passage
• One key verse from the reading
• A short reflection, with an optional private note
• A done screen, your streak, and a green check for each day you finish

Also free:
• Three guided paths: Sermon on the Mount (7 days), Life of Jesus (30 days), and Start Here: Bible Basics (14 days)
• The whole King James Bible in the Library. Search for a book, chapter, or word, and open verse study with cross-references and word notes
• Save and highlight verses
• A daily reminder at the time you pick, an optional evening reminder, and a gentle nudge if today's reading is still open

PREMIUM, IF YOU WANT MORE
Premium adds 33 more guided paths: 20 topic paths, such as Anxiety, Hope, Grief, and Marriage, and 13 longer book paths, such as the Gospel of John, the Gospel of Mark, Romans, Acts, and Genesis. With Premium you can open any day of those paths on its own, to read ahead or go back.

Today's Scroll, your streak, reminders, the three free paths, and the whole Bible library stay free without Premium.

YOUR READING STAYS YOURS
There's no account to create and there are no ads. Your streak, notes, and highlights are kept on your phone.

SUBSCRIPTION DETAILS
One Good Scroll Premium is an optional auto-renewing subscription:
• Premium Yearly: $34.99 per year, with a 1-week free trial for new subscribers
• Premium Monthly: $3.99 per month, no free trial

Prices are in US dollars and may vary by country. Payment is charged to your Apple ID when you confirm the purchase, or when the free trial ends. The subscription renews automatically at the same price unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and your account is charged for the renewal within 24 hours before the period ends. You can manage or cancel your subscription anytime in your Apple ID settings. If you subscribe during a free trial, any unused part of the trial ends. Restore purchases is on the Premium screen and in Profile.

Terms of Use: https://kehholdings.com/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://kehholdings.com/privacy/one-good-scroll/

One Good Scroll is made by Bluestem Studio, a DBA of KEH Holdings LLC. Scripture is the King James Version, public domain in the United States.

Questions or ideas: hello@onegoodscroll.com

name: One Line Delivery: Path Puzzle
description:
Link the food shops and waiting customers in one continuous line. Pick up each order, reach the right home, and send the scooter down the route you drew.

Solve 100 puzzles with changing rules. Some neighborhoods ask you to cover every open tile. Others require pickups in a particular order. Try visiting the shops in a different sequence when the route gets tight.

Undo a step or redraw the whole route. Take your time planning, then watch the scooter make the deliveries.

name: ONE SECOND: Reaction Game
description:
ONE SECOND is a calm, quick timing game.

A dot circles the ring. Tap the moment it meets the glowing arc.
• PERFECT or GOOD keeps your combo alive.
• Every 5 hits the level goes up: the dot gets faster and the arc gets smaller.
• Three misses and the run is over. One more try?

Made to play in seconds:
• One-tap controls, portrait, one hand.
• Plays fully offline – nothing to download, no account.
• Gentle haptics on every hit, level up and game over.
• Soft sound effects that follow your Ring/Silent switch and never stop your music.
• Auto-pause when you leave the app.
• Your best score stays on your device.

No ads. No in-app purchases. No tracking. No data collected.

name: Onlinechat
description:
Onlinechat je AI asistent na webe vašej firmy. Odpovedá zákazníkom vo dne v noci a z rozhovorov pripraví objednávky, rezervácie a dopyty. Táto aplikácia je pre majiteľov a ich kolegov, aby mali všetko po ruke aj mimo počítača.

Čo v aplikácii nájdete:

1. Upozornenie hneď, keď príde nová objednávka, rezervácia alebo dopyt, alebo keď zákazník chce hovoriť s človekom.
2. Požiadavky so všetkými údajmi zákazníka. Zavoláte alebo napíšete jedným ťuknutím a označíte ich ako vybavené.
3. Kalendár rezervácií: potvrdenie alebo zrušenie termínu, zákazníkovi príde e-mail.
4. Rozhovory zákazníkov s asistentom a odpoveď priamo z mobilu, keď zákazník chce človeka.
5. Otázky, na ktoré asistent nevedel odpovedať, a doplnenie odpovede, aby nabudúce vedel.
6. Prehľad: rozhovory, požiadavky a hodnotenia za deň, týždeň a mesiac.
7. Predplatné, faktúry a ľudia z firmy na jednom mieste.
8. Widget na ploche, zamknutá obrazovka, Live Activity pri čakajúcom zákazníkovi a Apple Watch alebo Wear OS hodinky.

Aplikácia je určená existujúcim klientom služby Onlinechat. Prihlásite sa rovnakým e-mailom a heslom ako do účtu na onlinechat.sk. Nastavenie chatu, vzhľadu a znalostí asistenta robíte vo webovom účte.

name: Opposite Tooth
description:
Saw Set keeps each saw on this iPhone.

A tooth stays bent only when it goes the opposite way from the previous kept tooth, and only one step. The same way springs back. Two steps spring back past the plate. A tooth that is already kept is held.

When all eight alternate and none pass the plate, the saw is Set. Otherwise the sentence names the first tooth that is still straight.

Name a saw, rename it, find one, delete one, and share the sentence.

Saws stay on this iPhone. There is no account and nothing to buy. This does not set the saw for you.

name: OptiCAD
description:
OptiCAD, mobilya ve ahşap atölyeleri için çevrimdışı kesim optimizasyon uygulamasıdır. Plakalarınızı ve parçalarınızı girin; uygulama testere payını, kenar temizlemeyi ve kenar bantlarını dikkate alarak en az fireyle kesim planınızı çıkarır.

ÖNE ÇIKANLAR

• Excel benzeri hızlı parça tablosu: ad, boy, en, adet ve dört kenar bandını tek ekranda düzenleyin
• Kenar bandı: 0,40 mm ve 0,80 mm, her kenar için ayrı seçim (varsayılan bantsız)
• Türk piyasası plaka ölçüleri: 2100×2800, 1830×3660, 1220×2440 mm ve özel ölçü
• Desen kilidi: desenli plakalarda parçalar döndürülmez
• Otomatik kesim sırası ve kullanılabilir artık (offcut) ölçüleri
• Maliyet dökümü: plaka, kesim, 0,40/0,80 mm bant metresi ve KDV
• A4 PDF kesim raporu: kesim şeması, parça ve bant listesi
• Geçmiş: her optimizasyon otomatik kaydedilir, yeniden açılabilir
• Açık ve koyu tema, cm/mm birim seçimi

GİZLİLİK

Hesap gerekmez, internet bağlantısı gerekmez. Projeleriniz ve fiyat bilgileriniz yalnızca cihazınızda saklanır; hiçbir veri sunucuya gönderilmez.

name: ORfind
description:
ORfind tells authorized operating room staff where a supply or a piece of equipment is kept: the room, the rack and the shelf, with a photo.

Type a name, a nickname, a size or a product code. ORfind answers as you type and shows the location first and biggest, so it can be read at arm's length. Open an item to see its photo, zoom in with a pinch or the big + and - buttons, and check the manufacturer, REF, barcode and size.

- Search supplies, equipment, or everything at once
- List everything in a location, or every machine
- Spelling help when a word is mistyped
- Large, clear text that follows your iPhone's text size, in light and dark
- Your sign-in is kept in the iPhone Keychain, on this phone only

Accounts are issued by your team's educator. New staff sign up with the one-time link their educator sends, or ask for access from the sign-in screen. Anyone can press "Try the demo" to see the whole app with sample data; the demo needs no account and no network.

ORfind is an independent reference tool by BaldEducator. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or operated for any hospital or health system. It is not a medical device and does not replace required clinical, safety or inventory processes. Always verify the correct item, expiration date, package integrity and any sterility indicators before use.

No ads. No tracking. No analytics.

name: OriginalPAY
description:
オリジナルPAYは、店舗向けのポイント・電子マネー管理アプリです。

会員証のQRコードやバーコードを読み取り、会員情報の確認、ポイントの加算・利用、取引履歴の確認などを行えます。

POINTQUICと連携し、店舗での会員サービスをスムーズに運用できます。

name: Otter Splash: Bubble Pop
description:
Join Ollie the otter by the sea and pop your way across three worlds of colorful bead pictures.

AIM, BOUNCE, POP
Drag to aim, bounce your shot off the side rails and hit beads of your own color to pop them. Cut the thin neck that holds up a piece and the whole chunk drops at once. Keep popping shot after shot for a growing combo.

POUR THE TREASURE
Clear the picture and every shot you have left raises the multiplier. Then watch the treasure pour down the table.

THREE WORLDS, EACH WITH ITS OWN RULES
- Coast Workshop: water balloons on the beach, the pier, the dunes and at sunset.
- Tidal Bay: clear bubbles full of sea life. Sort the fish, shrimp and shells into the right baskets, push back the rising tide, and watch out for ink that hides the colors.
- Volcano: gems in rock shells. Land them in the moving mine carts, keep them out of the lava, and pop the embers before they hit zero.

BOSSES AND FRIENDS
Face Captain Pinch the crab, Puff the pufferfish and Digger the mole. Pinch grabs your boosters, Puff blows in a new row of bubbles and Digger plugs the gaps with stones.
Ollie's net scoops up a whole fan of beads. Rescue Inky the octopus and Sizzle the salamander and they join the team with skills of their own: Inky's Water Can washes off ink, cools the lava and puts out embers, and Sizzle's Warm Stove melts the beads around it. Any of the three can take a turn as the shooter.

MORE TO PLAY WITH
- 62 levels with hanging pieces, stone beads and chained beads
- Boosters: Flying Fish, Bomb, Rainbow and +5 Shots
- Reward jars that fill up as you play and pay out coins and boosters
- A winding level map for every world
- A daily gift

Otter Splash is free to play. It shows ads, including optional rewarded ads you can choose to watch for extra rewards. It also offers optional in-app purchases; Remove Ads turns off the ads between levels. You can turn off in-app purchases in your device settings.

name: OurHours
description:
デートの帰りに、今日は何時間一緒にいたかを確認できます。OurHoursは、ペア設定した2台のiPhoneが近くにいる時間をBluetoothで自動記録するアプリです。

■ 会っている時間をホームで確認
一緒にいる間はタイマーが進み、ふたりのシャボン玉が少しずつ大きくなります。記念日を登録すると、付き合って何日目かもわかります。

■ カレンダーで日ごとに振り返る
カレンダーには日ごとの合計時間と、記念日や誕生日のマークが並びます。日付をタップすると、会っていた時間帯を24時間のタイムラインで確認できます。開始・終了時刻は1分単位で編集でき、記録の追加や結合もできます。ひとことメモには、一緒に行った場所や観た映画などを書いて共有できます。

■ ふたりの記録を暗号化して同期
QRコードでペアを設定すると、時間の記録とメモを端末で暗号化し、iCloud経由で相手と同期します。位置情報による記録補完は任意です。地図や座標の表示、現在地のリアルタイム共有はありません。広告や第三者によるトラッキングもありません。

name: Outfog: Fog of War Walk Map
description:
Outfog turns an ordinary walk into a game. The map of your city is covered with fog, and you are the lantern: wherever you walk, the fog parts and never comes back.

HOW IT WORKS
• Go on foot and a strip around you opens. In transport the fog stays: only your feet count.
• Beacons call you to places you have not been. Reach one and the fog around it clears in a flash.
• Landmarks, treasures and hidden caches wait under the fog.

WHAT IS INSIDE
• Percent of the city, district and block you have uncovered.
• Three quests every day and one for the week, streaks, levels and ranks from Passer-by to City legend.
• Map records: the largest area without gaps and the largest square. The game shows where one walk joins two of your areas.
• Whole streets: walk a street from end to end and tick it off.
• Collections of places: museums, temples, fortresses, parks. Each place has a short note and a postcard to send.
• History: watch your map grow day by day, with a summary of the month and the year.
• A Lock Screen counter with today's progress and metres to the beacon.

WITH FRIENDS
• City and district rankings for the week, the season and all time.
• Duels: who uncovers more in seven days.
• Shared goals: uncover the city together.
• Put a beacon on the map for a friend. If they get there, you both get a treasure.

PRIVACY
The map and your routes are stored on your iPhone and in your iCloud. Your route is never sent to the game server: the ranking gets only a nickname and the number of opened cells. No ads, no third-party analytics.

PRICE
One access opens the whole game: the first week is free, then a yearly or monthly subscription, or a one-time "forever" purchase. No separate paid features. The subscription renews automatically until cancelled in Apple ID settings at least a day before the period ends.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://fogwalk.169.58.38.196.sslip.io/privacy

The game uses data © OpenStreetMap contributors and Wikidata.

name: Oxbot
description:
oxbot gives your family a team of AI helpers that run on your own Mac at home. This app is how everyone in the family uses them from their phone.

PLAN TOGETHER
• Meal Plan: the week's dinners planned automatically around everyone's tastes, with what's missing added to Groceries.
• Groceries: one shared list, added straight to the cart at your favourite store.
• Calendar: one family calendar. Bots add school dates, appointments and bookings, with reminders for the right people.
• Records: bills, receipts and family records, filed by year and topic. Photos of health and insurance cards, ready to show.

BOTS FOR EVERYTHING ELSE
Make a bot in a sentence: School, Insurance Claims, Car Insurance quotes, Pet Care, a Europe trip planner, Movie Night. Bots use the web through their own browser, signed in by you, so they work with the services you already use: Google, Apple, Outlook and more.

YOU STAY IN CHARGE
• Reading and searching happen on their own. Sending, booking and buying wait for your OK. Paying is always yours to do.
• When a site needs a sign-in, you do it yourself. Bots never see your passwords.
• Kid accounts: kids can ask curious questions. Their messages are checked first, and anything a parent should see waits for an OK.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Your family's data stays on your Mac. This app talks only to your own Mac, paired with a QR code.
• No ads, no analytics, no tracking. No oxbot account.
• Your AI, your choice: oxbot uses your own OpenRouter account, with free models to start, and you pick the models each bot uses.

REQUIRES
oxbot running on a Mac at home (free download for Apple chip and Intel Macs). The family's phones pair with it by scanning a QR code.

name: Oxbridge ClassFinder
description:
Unofficial. Oxbridge ClassFinder is an independent app and is not affiliated with or endorsed by any university or college.

Find your lectures, papers and modules, and plan a week that fits, for the University of Cambridge, the University of Oxford, Imperial College London and colleges of the University of London.

CATALOGUE
Search lecture courses, Tripos papers and modules by title, code, lecturer, department or Part. Filter by term, year or Part, level, time of day and the days you want free. Each entry shows the lecturer or convenor, terms taught, credits where the university uses them, assessment and prerequisites where published, and a link to the university's own page.

WEEK
Add lectures to a weekly plan for Michaelmas, Lent and Easter (Cambridge) or Michaelmas, Hilary and Trinity (Oxford). Clashes are explained in plain words and laid side by side. Lectures that only run in some weeks show their teaching weeks.

ASK
Describe what you want, such as "Part IB lectures in the morning" or "15 credit postgraduate module", and Ask Oxbridge turns it into a search on your device. Nothing you type is sent anywhere.

GROUNDS
Libraries, lecture theatres, colleges and halls on an open map, from OpenStreetMap.

OXBRIDGE PRO
Free: browsing, filters, saved courses, one plan per term with clash warnings, maps and 3 Ask searches a day.
Pro: unlimited Ask, alternate plans (Plan A, B, C), one-tap Fix clashes and Add to Calendar.
Monthly, yearly (with a 7-day free trial for new subscribers) or a one-time lifetime purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period in your Apple Account settings.

WHERE THE DATA COMES FROM
Only public pages: the Cambridge University Timetable, Oxford departmental lecture lists and course pages, and the public module catalogues of the London universities. Nothing behind a university login is used. Times and rooms change during the year, so always check with your faculty, department or college.

No account, no tracking, no ads. Your plans stay on your device.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Painting Widget - Masterpieces
description:
A masterpiece on your Home Screen.

Painting Widget brings famous Western and Japanese paintings — by Van Gogh, Monet, Vermeer, Hokusai, Hiroshige and others — to your Home Screen. As the seasons and hours change, the widget hangs a painting that suits the moment. It doesn't just change once a day: every hour, it chooses from 174 real paintings to match the season and the time. No ads and no subscription (Premium is a one-time purchase), and no account needed.

CHANGES WITH THE SEASON AND TIME
• In Auto mode, the widget picks a painting that fits the season and time of day, every hour
• Blossoms in spring, water lilies and summer rain in summer, snow in winter, and night scenes at night
• Follows the 24 traditional seasons of the Japanese calendar

DISPLAY SETS
• Create sets in the app and choose the paintings for each
• Keep one painting on display, switch to the next one in order or shuffled, or let Auto pick by season and time
• Auto (All Paintings) can be shuffled too
• Small, medium and large sizes. Add as many widgets as you like, and choose Auto, Favorite Masterpieces or one of your sets for each

CHOOSE WHICH PART TO SHOW
• Auto crops each painting so its highlight stays in the frame
• Or choose top, center, bottom, left or right, or show the whole painting with margins
• In a set, drag and pinch to choose the part and size for each painting and each widget size
• Fill the margins with a blur or a solid color

PREMIUM (PAY ONCE, USE FOREVER)
• Create as many sets as you like (one set for free)
• Put as many paintings in a set as you like (5 per set for free)
• Also switch every 1, 3, 6, 9 or 12 hours, or every 2 days (every day for free)
• Tap the widget to show the next painting
• Add a gold, wood, black or white frame to your widgets
• Back up your records and settings to your own iCloud automatically
• You can also buy "+1 Set", "+5 Paintings per Set", "Frames", "Tap for Next" and "Switch Interval" one at a time
• No subscription. All paintings and texts are free to view and read

A GALLERY IN THE APP
• 174 masterpieces displayed in five rooms: Spring, Summer, Autumn, Winter and Anytime
• For each painting, read a short introduction, highlights, a longer guide, the year and the museum
• Open a painting full screen and pinch to zoom into the details
• Save the ones you love to Favorites

ARTISTS AND MOVEMENTS
• Find artists and movements in the sixth room of the gallery, the Artists' Room
• 33 artists, grouped into 12 movements such as the Renaissance, Ukiyo-e and Impressionism, roughly in chronological order
• Each artist's profile also tells you what period Japan was in at the time
• Learn when each movement began and what to look for in its paintings

MY PAINTINGS (A RECORD OF PAINTINGS YOU SAW)
• Keep a record of paintings you saw at museums and exhibitions, or ones you painted yourself, with the title, artist, place, date and notes
• Add them to a set to show them in a widget

SIMPLE AND PRIVATE
• No account needed
• No ads
• Favorites, your painting records and settings stay on your device, and also in your own iCloud only if you turn on iCloud backup (Premium)
• All paintings are old works whose copyright has expired. The images come from Wikimedia Commons, in the public domain or under CC0. Sources are listed in the app

name: Paper Atlas: Travel History
description:
Your camera roll already knows every trip you've taken. Paper Atlas turns it into your travel map.

FIND YOUR TRIPS IN YOUR PHOTOS
Paper Atlas reads only when and where your photos were taken, never the pictures themselves, and suggests the trips you took. You confirm how you travelled (flight, car or train) and any day it couldn't be sure about. Years of travel, on the map in minutes.

SEE WHERE YOU'VE BEEN
• A hand-drawn world map with every route and every country you've visited
• Countries, cities, flights and days away, counted for you
• Passport stamps for each country
• Play your whole journey as an animation
• A diary with photos for every trip

SHARE IT
• Travel Wrapped: your year on one card, sized for Stories and for the feed
• Journey video: your routes drawn across the map, ready for Reels
• A card for any single trip

YOUR TRAVEL HISTORY, WHEN A FORM ASKS FOR IT
Citizenship, visa and tax forms ask for every trip abroad: the day you left, the day you came back, where you went. Paper Atlas lists them with days abroad per trip, per year and per country, and exports a clean PDF and CSV. You choose how travel days are counted, and the report says which rule it used. The report is based on your photos and entries; it is not legal advice, so check it against official records.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account and no sign-up
• No analytics, no ads, no tracking
• Your trips stay on your iPhone unless you export or share them
• Maps are drawn with Apple Maps
• Back up everything to a single file you keep wherever you like

FREE WHILE IT'S NEW
Everything in Paper Atlas is free for now. A later update will add a one-time purchase, and the free version will then hold fewer trips. Trips you've saved stay yours either way. No subscription, ever.

name: Parcel Crossing: Traffic
description:
A bus is passing and a fast car is approaching from the other side. Pick a gap that stays open until your van clears the last lane. Get enough vans through to unlock the next crossing.

Play 48 stages across one-way streets, curves, merges, roundabouts, and wide roads. Watch how long buses, fast cars, and bicycles move before choosing when to go.

Use half speed to study the gap, then try double speed when you're ready for a quicker decision. Replay crossings to find a safer gap.

name: ParkNWash
description:
ParkNWash — AVM Kapalı Otopark VIP Oto Yıkama ve Abonelik Platformu

ParkNWash ile AVM otoparklarında aracınızı sıra beklemeden, güvenle yıkatın! Siz Zorlu Center, Cevahir AVM ve anlaşmalı alışveriş merkezlerinde alışverişinizi yaparken, yemeğinizi yerken ya da sinemadayken; aracınız kapalı otoparktaki VIP yıkama peronumuzda profesyonelce temizlenir.

name: ParLens
description:
ParLens is a private way for your child's school to share everyday moments with the family.

For parents
• See photos from your child's day, organised by day and activity
• Only your own child - photos are never public
• Save your favourites and download photos to your phone
• Get a gentle notification when new moments or school updates arrive
• Join in a minute with the invite your school sends

For schools
• Upload photos from the day; ParLens recognises children on your phone - no paid AI service
• Confident matches are filed automatically; uncertain ones are confirmed by you in one tap
• Invite each family with a personal single-use link
• Post updates and events to all parents
• Full control: correct, move or remove photos at any time

Privacy first: no ads, no tracking, no selling data. Parents join only by school invite, schools are isolated from each other, and you can delete your account at any time in the app.

ParLens is made by Genius Kids.

name: PartyStartr
description:
Put on a song, tap Start the Party, and your Hue lights move with it. Color shifts with every beat, the room gets brighter when the music does, and you get back to your friends.

PartyStartr listens through your iPhone's microphone, so it works with anything playing in the room: Spotify, Apple Music, AirPlay, a turntable, or a live band.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Allow the microphone, so PartyStartr can hear your music.
2. Connect your Hue Bridge by pressing its round button once.
3. Tap Start the Party, in the app or on the Home Screen widget.

PARTY ON YOUR TERMS
- Color schemes: Disco, Sunset, Cozy, or your own colors, including warm whites
- How fast the colors change, and how bright or dim the lights go
- Mic sensitivity, for a quiet dinner or a loud living room
- Aftercare: when the party ends, your lights settle into warm candlelight, go back to how they were, or stay as they are

IT KEEPS GOING
Take a call or switch to another app, and the party carries on. A Live Activity shows it on your Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island, with a button to stop. You can also start it with Siri or a Shortcut.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
PartyStartr hears how loud the room is and when the beat hits, then lets the sound go. Nothing is recorded, saved, or sent anywhere. No account, no ads, no in-app analytics. The app talks to your Hue Bridge over your own Wi-Fi.

FREE FOR 30 DAYS, THEN YOURS
Every party is free for 30 days from your first one, with no sign-up and nothing to cancel. After that, PartyStartr Forever is a one-time $9.99 purchase. No subscription.

WHAT YOU NEED
- An iPhone with iOS 26 or later
- A Philips Hue Bridge on the same Wi-Fi
- Color-capable Hue lights (up to 10 per party)

PartyStartr is made by Isaac Consultants LLC. It is not made or endorsed by Signify or Philips. Philips Hue is a trademark of Signify.

name: PasteMan: Clipboard Manager
description:
PasteMan brings the clipboard history from your Mac to your iPhone and iPad, and keeps what you save there too. Tap anything to copy it again.

YOUR MAC’S HISTORY, ON THE GO
• Everything PasteMan keeps on your Mac shows up here through your own iCloud.
• On the same network, sync directly with your Mac while the app is open, end-to-end encrypted.

SAVE FROM ANYWHERE
• Save the clipboard with the Paste button, from the share sheet in any app, or with the “Save to PasteMan” shortcut.
• Or let PasteMan save the clipboard each time you open it.

FIND ANYTHING
• Search copied text, words in screenshots, link titles and QR codes.
• Filter as you type: @app, #image, .pdf, /collection.

COPY IT YOUR WAY
• Copy as plain text, change case, trim, URL- or Base64-encode, format JSON.
• Copy a link as Markdown, the text in an image, or what a QR code says.

KEEP WHAT MATTERS (PRO)
• Collections keep items for as long as you like, with colors, icons or emoji.
• Smart collections are saved searches that fill themselves.
• Snippet macros fill in the date, the clipboard and your own values when you copy.

WIDGETS AND SHORTCUTS
• See recent items on your Home Screen and tap one to copy it.
• Save, search and copy with the Shortcuts app.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Your history stays on your devices and in your own iCloud, never on our servers.
• PasteMan never reads the clipboard in the background.
• No account, no analytics, no ads, no tracking.

PASTEMAN PRO
Collections, smart collections and snippet macros come with PasteMan Pro, a one-time in-app purchase shared by your iPhone, iPad and Mac. Everything else is free.

Available in English, Simplified and Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean, German, French and Spanish.

name: PATAN - Fold & Loop Puzzle
description:
Paint the cells of a net, pinch a face, and fold.
Colors that looked scattered close up into a single loop on the finished solid — PATAN!

■ How to play
• Place colors from the palette on the cells of the net
• When every cell is painted, pinch the faces to fold
• If each color makes exactly one loop on the closed solid, it's solved
• Cells far apart on the net become neighbors when folded — that's the puzzle
• No timers. When you're close, the game tells you "So close"

■ What's inside
• 1,000 stages, from the cube to tetrahedra, octahedra, prisms, and pyramids
• A Daily puzzle — the same one for everyone — with a leaderboard
• A Weekly Challenge
• A Streak that grows when you clear one stage a day
• Stamps for careful solves, and paper patterns they unlock
• A collection of solids in random materials
• Shareable result cards

■ Also
• This app shows ads. The one-time "Remove Ads" purchase removes the ads between stages and on the play screen, and gives hints without ads
• Get hints by watching a video or as Streak rewards

name: Pattern Scale & Print
description:
Print a pattern at its real size on ordinary paper. Type the finished width, say 450 mm, and see at once how many sheets it takes: 9 A4 pages, 3 × 3.
Import an image or one page of a PDF, set the exact finished dimensions and preview every sheet before you print. Each sheet is labeled A1, A2, B1… and carries a 50 mm ruler, so you can check the scale before you cut.
No account and no setup. A clearly labeled sample is built in, so your first result takes seconds.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Import a photo, an image or a PDF page from Files, or open the labeled sample.
2. Type the finished width or height in millimeters or inches. The aspect ratio stays locked unless you unlock it.
3. Choose paper (A4, A3, US Letter, US Legal, Tabloid), portrait or landscape, margins and overlap.
4. Preview the tiles, then print or share the PDF.

EXACT SIZE, CLEAR SHEETS
- Sizes are stored in millimeters and drawn at 72 points per inch, so 50 mm in the app is exactly 50 mm in the PDF.
- The sheet count updates as you type, with rows, columns and the finished size in both mm and inches.
- Every sheet shows its assembly ID, its neighbors, the printable-area frame and dashed overlap lines for taping.
- A calibration page with a 50 × 50 mm square comes first (on by default). Print at 100% or "Actual Size" and measure it.
- The preview shows the actual PDF that will be printed or shared.

MADE FOR PATTERNS
- PDF pages keep their vector lines. The page's crop box and rotation are respected.
- Multi-page PDFs: choose the one page you need; the app tells you the rest isn't imported.
- Crop away borders without changing the scale.
- Images get a low-resolution warning when they would print soft at the size you chose.

FREE
- Image or single PDF-page import, finished-size entry, full size and tile preview
- Single-sheet PDF export and printing: the whole pattern when it fits one sheet, otherwise test sheet A1 to check your printer
- One saved project, plus the labeled sample
- Free data backup export and import, Delete All Data

PRO
- Tiled multi-sheet PDF export with assembly IDs
- Scale from a known line: mark two points, type the real distance, and the whole pattern scales evenly
- Mirroring (artwork only; labels and rulers stay readable)
- Unlimited projects and reusable page-layout presets
If Pro ends, nothing is deleted. Your projects stay readable and your backup export stays free.

YOUR FILES STAY ON YOUR IPHONE
No account, no ads, no tracking. Only the photo or file you choose is copied into the app, and nothing is uploaded. PDFs go only where you print or share them.

Printers and print settings can still change the scale, so always measure the calibration square before cutting. The app prepares PDFs; it doesn't certify measurements for engineering or safety-critical work. Import only material you have the right to use.

SUBSCRIPTION
Pro is optional: weekly with a 3-day free trial for eligible new subscribers, or annual, billed in full once a year. Prices are shown in the app before you buy. Subscriptions renew automatically until cancelled in Settings.

Terms: https://motleystudio.site/pattern-scale-print/terms

name: Paw Parade
description:
Welcome to a cozy pet apartment where every door hides a surprise. Study the hint, spot the matching door by color and geometric shape, then open it to reveal a puppy waiting inside.

Watch each dog peek out, step into the hallway, and join your walking crew. Clear the level to start Walk Time—a short parade of your newly found friends.

How to play

Read the top hint carefully
Compare door colors, shapes, and markings
Tap the correct door
Enjoy the open → peek → walk-out sequence
Collect every target dog to begin the parade
Features

120 handcrafted levels across 4 apartment chapters
Pattern puzzles that grow from simple color matches to multi-condition clues
Layered door-opening animations and real puppy entrance moments
A growing walk parade as your pack gets bigger
Dog collection, trophies, and local progress saving
Soft cozy visuals made for relaxed play
Whether you are hunting a red circle door or solving later geometry challenges, every correct open feels like welcoming a new friend home.

Find the door. Walk the dogs.

name: Paw Pillow Fight: Animal Brawl
description:
Paw Pillow Fight is a pillow fighting game. Eight animals in pajamas find out who fights best with pillows.

• A real fighting game: strikes, grabs, shield, dodges, swipe special moves and a super move with a cinematic camera. Snatch your opponent's pillow or throw your own.
• Combo strings: every fighter has their own chains — flips, kicks, sweeps, a launcher and air follow-ups.
• Eight fighters with their own moves and traits: Tiger, the quick Fox, Gorilla, the grumpy Manul, the relentless Doberman, the sleepy Panda, the sneaky Raccoon with traps, and Lion.
• A unique "Tuck them in!" finisher for every fighter.
• Eight pillows — down, feather, orthopedic, bolster, buckwheat, water, squeaky and seat shield, each with its own strikes.
• Twenty arenas: a nursery, an attic, a royal bedroom, an igloo, a space station, a beach, a circus, a forest camp and more.
• A five-fight tournament with the Lion boss in the final.
• Online play: a ranked quick match or a private room with a friend by code.
• Wardrobe: ten pajamas for every fighter, pillowcases, feathers, victory dances and titles.
• Twenty levels, and each one makes your fighter stronger. Pick your first fighter and unlock the rest with keys earned by leveling up.
• A daily reward and three new daily quests every day.
• A two-minute tutorial and simple phone controls.

No ads, no purchases, no sign-up. 11 languages: English, Spanish, Portuguese, German, French, Italian, Turkish, Japanese, Korean, Chinese and Russian.

name: PawPure: Pet Food Scanner AI
description:
Know what is really inside your pet's food or skincare products before you buy. Point your camera at any ingredient label for an instant 0-100 safety score and red/yellow/green additive breakdown.

- Dedicated modes for Dog Food, Cat Food, and Skincare
- Instant toxic & filler ingredient alerts
- Plain-English explanations and scan history.

Subscriptions auto-renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage anytime in Apple Account Settings.
Terms of Use: https://lumespec.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://lumespec.com/privacy

name: PeakBar: Altimeter
description:
PeakBar shows how high you are, and tells you how sure it is.

ALTITUDE YOU CAN TRUST
• Barometer for smooth climbs and descents, GPS for height above sea level
• Accuracy (±) and the source are always on screen, and the reading does not jump around
• Calibrate with GPS, with a known altitude (such as a summit sign) or with the sea-level pressure (QNH) from a nearby airport
• Meters or feet

WHERE YOU ARE
• Coordinates in decimal, DMS or UTM, copied with one tap
• Air pressure in hPa or inHg
• The temperature at which water boils at your altitude

SAVED PLACES
Save your camp, a spring or the summit. PeakBar shows each place's height and distance from where you stand. Up to 5 places are free.

BAROMETER
Pressure, sea-level pressure and a 3-hour trend. Falling pressure often comes before a change in the weather. See the last 24 hours free.

SHARE
Share a clean altitude card with your height and coordinates.

PEAKBAR PRO (one-time purchase, no subscription)
• Altitude logs with a profile: ascent, descent, highest, lowest, distance, time
• Export logs as GPX or CSV
• Alerts every 10 to 100 m (50 to 500 ft) of altitude change
• Altitude-stamped photos
• Unlimited places and 7 days of pressure history
• No ads

GOOD TO KNOW
Barometric altitude changes with the weather, so recalibrate on longer trips. If your phone has no barometer, PeakBar uses GPS only. Logging runs while the app is open, and the screen stays on during a log. Your location and photos stay on your device. Not for aviation or safety-critical navigation.

name: PeakyTrails
description:
PeakyTrails – Discover. Explore. Track.

Explore the great outdoors, discover new routes and track your mountain adventures with PeakyTrails, your companion for exploring and recording your achievements.

Whether you're taking your first steps into hillwalking or you're an experienced walker working towards completing a collection, PeakyTrails makes it easy to discover new places, plan your next adventure and celebrate every summit.

DISCOVER YOUR NEXT ADVENTURE

Explore a growing collection of hills, fells and mountains, starting with the iconic 214 Wainwright fells in England's Lake District.

- Browse detailed information about each fell, including elevation, difficulty and location.
- Search, sort and filter to find your next challenge.
- Discover walking routes with interactive maps and elevation profiles.
- Find routes that suit your experience and interests.

EXPLORE WITH INTERACTIVE MAPS

Bring your adventures to life with detailed mapping features.

- Explore fell locations on an interactive map.
- View walking routes and their elevation profiles.
- See route information to help plan your walks.
- Discover nearby fells and explore the surrounding landscape.

TRACK YOUR PROGRESS

Keep a personal record of your achievements and see how far you've come.

- Mark fells as bagged as you complete them.
- Record the date of each ascent and add personal notes.
- Track your progress towards completing the Wainwrights.
- View your walking achievements and activity over time.
- See which fells you've completed and which adventures are still ahead.

YOUR ADVENTURES, YOUR COLLECTIONS

PeakyTrails helps you stay organised as you work towards your walking goals. Whether you're aiming to complete all 214 Wainwrights or simply enjoying discovering new places, every achievement counts.

EXPLORE FREELY

Browse fells, discover routes and explore maps without creating an account. Sign up for free when you're ready to start recording your progress and building your personal walking history.

BUILT FOR WALKERS

Designed with a clean, straightforward interface, PeakyTrails puts the information you need at your fingertips, so you can spend less time searching and more time exploring.

Your next adventure starts here.

name: Pearly: Brush Tracker
description:
Meet Pearly, your tooth. Brush, and Pearly sparkles. Skip, and Pearly gets grumpy.

Pearly is a bright, friendly way to keep the simplest health habit there is: brushing your teeth. For you, your children, your partner, or a friend who asked you to keep them honest.

YOUR TOOTH, TODAY
• One tap to log a brushing, or let the guided timer do it
• Choose how many times a day, from 1 to 4, and a time for each
• A ring of toothpaste fills up with every brushing
• Clean days build your streak. See how long you can keep it

TWO MINUTES, GUIDED
• A toothbrush shows you where to brush, tooth by tooth
• Four parts of the mouth, with a tap you can feel when it's time to move on
• 1, 2 or 3 minutes, set for each person

THE WHOLE FAMILY, ONE CUP
• Add as many people as you like, each with their own toothbrush colour, goal and reminders
• Log for a child in one tap
• See who is ahead this week

REMINDERS THAT DON'T NAG
• A reminder at the times you choose
• One more nudge only if the brushing still hasn't been logged
• Answer "Brushed" right on the notification
• A reminder to change your brush head, and one before the dentist

WIDGETS AND SHORTCUTS
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets with a real Brushed button
• "Log a brushing" works with Siri, Shortcuts, the Action button or an NFC sticker by the sink

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account. No ads. No tracking. Your brushing stays on your iPhone.

PEARLY PLUS
Pearly is free to download. To use it you need Pearly Plus, a monthly or yearly subscription that unlocks everything for everyone on the iPhone. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. It renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it in Settings > Apple Account > Subscriptions.
Bought Pearly before Pearly Plus? Everything stays yours, no subscription needed. If it doesn't unlock by itself, tap Restore purchases.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://borhen68.github.io/pearly/privacy/

Pearly helps you keep a brushing habit. It does not give medical or dental advice.

name: Peck - Smart Screenshot Sort
seller_name: Hangzhou Xinshengji Cultural Communication Co., Ltd
description:
Took a screenshot so you wouldn't forget—then couldn't find it when you actually needed it?

Peck fixes that. It's ready the moment you install: no account to create, no internet needed, and your screenshots never leave your iPhone.

EVERY SCREENSHOT, TIDIED UP FOR YOU
• Clear Titles & Key Takeaways: Get an instant summary with the important names, dates, prices, and details intact—no more squinting at tiny thumbnails.
• Clean, Readable Full Text: Chats, articles, and cards are neatly arranged with menus, buttons, and status-bar clutter stripped away. Tap any highlighted date or fact in a summary to jump straight to that exact spot on the original screenshot.
• One-Tap Actions That Actually Help: Copy pickup codes, tracking numbers, and verification codes straight from home; turn confirmed plans into ready-to-review calendar drafts (nothing is added until you confirm); open links, phone numbers, addresses, or save reminders in a tap.
• Find It Even If You Remember Two Words: Search by a shop name, friend's name, address, or half-remembered line—even across line breaks. Filter by source, topic, or browse All, Saved, and Actions.

FAST, CALM, AND OUT OF YOUR WAY
• Switch smoothly between an easy-to-scan list and a two-column gallery grid whenever you like.
• To keep things fast and kind to your battery, Peck automatically organizes screenshots from the last 30 days. Older screenshots stay right in your timeline—just tap any one to organize it on the spot, or use "+" anytime to pick long screenshots, regular photos, or paste from your clipboard.
• Localized in English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, and Korean.

YOUR SCREENSHOTS STAY ON YOUR PHONE
• Everything happens right on your iPhone—it even works in Airplane Mode.
• No account, no ads, and zero data collection or tracking.
• Lock your library with Face ID, Touch ID, or passcode (with automatic privacy cover when you switch apps). Local data uses iOS file protection, stays out of backups, and can be cleared in one tap anytime without touching your Photos library.

DEVICE NOTE
• iPhones with 8 GB RAM or more (such as iPhone 15 Pro, iPhone 16 series, and newer) run full automatic summaries and smart organizing.
• iPhones with under 8 GB RAM automatically switch to Local Text Mode—text reading, full-text search, original highlighting, sharing, and quick actions all work right on your phone without internet.

name: PeepThat
description:
PeepThat helps you spot the signs of a healthy relationship and the signs of a harmful one, and shows you what to do next.

WHAT IS INSIDE
Get Advice. Send a question anonymously. Choose to share it so others can learn, or keep it private. Only Christina and approved moderators answer, and a shared question is posted only after Christina has checked it and approved it herself. A private question needs an email address, and the answer is sent to that email. Private questions are never posted, and nothing about a private question is saved on your device.

My Safety Plan. Build a plan that is ready before you ever need it, with your trusted person and your emergency contacts one tap away inside it. The app does not save your plan. Once it is filled out, use Send a copy to yourself to text it or email it to yourself. Text opens your Messages app with the plan typed in. Email sends it from the PeepThat support address.

Local Resources and Help. Enter any ZIP code in the United States and show local resources near you, powered by findhelp.org. The nine category links sit together in one colored box: All resources, Domestic Violence, Sexual Assault, Food, Housing, Legal, Mental Health, Elder Abuse, and Disability. The screen ends with a list of national hotlines.

Types of Abuse. A full guide to the types of abuse: physical, emotional and verbal, sexual, financial, digital, neglect, and isolation and control. This section has no calls and no outside links. Each card ends with one Ask a question link that takes you to Get Advice.

Practice and Learn. Practice comes first: Red Flag or Green Flag, a practice game with four levels, from Easy to Extreme, that turns everyday moments into practice for trusting your gut. The moments reach beyond romantic partners to family, friends, roommates, work, and caregivers, and to scams by text, social media, and phone. Below it, under Remember, are short lessons framed as important reminders to come back to. No lectures, just clear signs and real examples, and no completion button to press.

BUILT FOR REAL LIFE
No account and no real name needed.
A Safe Exit button on every screen.
An Accessibility link on every screen opens large print choices and Listen read aloud for the whole page.
Works with VoiceOver and other accessibility tools.
No ads. No tracking. Nothing you do in the app is sold or shared.

If you are in danger right now, call 911. For a crisis any time, call or text 988. For the National Domestic Violence Hotline any time, call 1 800 799 7233. For the National Sexual Assault Hotline any time, call 1 800 656 4673.

name: Pépin · Number Garden
description:
A basket to fill, a puzzle to assemble, water to channel to the vegetable patch: with Pépin, numbers come to life in a garden.

TWO PATHS TO GROW
• Ages 3–6: discover numbers, count, recognize quantities, and manipulate shapes.
• Ages 6–9: play with arithmetic, number sequences, and money lessons in euros.

436 ACTIVITIES ACROSS 40 DISCOVERIES
Move harvest crops, rebuild numerals, prepare a salad, or open a small canal: the actions and scenery vary. Every completed activity brings a reward for the garden. Digging, planting, then watering lets children watch their garden grow.

A CALM ENVIRONMENT
Spoken instructions, large touchable elements, with no music and no ads. Games and voices work offline after installation. A protected parent area lets you adjust voices, hints, and animations.

TRY, THEN UNLOCK
The first three discoveries of each path are available for free. A single purchase in the parent area unlocks all included games and all languages, with no subscription. The price is displayed in your store before purchase. Apple and Google purchases remain specific to their platform.

14 LANGUAGES
English, French, Turkish, Arabic, German, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, Dutch, Norwegian Bokmål, Swedish, Danish, Japanese, and Korean. The device language is selected automatically and can be changed in the parent area. The money games teach the euro in all languages.

Progress stays on the device. Up to four local profiles, with no child account creation.

Created by AIGEN Solutions. Support: contact@aigen-solutions.fr

name: Pesticide Log: Spray Records
description:
Writing spray records on the tailgate at the end of a long day is how details get lost.
Paper sheets get wet, EPA numbers get guessed, and the office asks for records you can't find.
Pesticide Log puts every application on your phone the moment you finish the job.

• Log a job in about 30 seconds: customer, address, target pest, product, amount, method, area
