Made by the team behind PestShift

name: Petoo: Cozy Cat Home
description:
A quiet moment with cats.

Petoo is a cozy cat game for taking a short break from work and unwinding after a stressful day. Settle into a little home of your own and enjoy the comfort of gentle company. Choose from 17 cat styles and make them feel like yours.

A LITTLE EVERYDAY COMPANY
Watch your cats wander, groom, loaf and curl up for naps. Offer a pat for a purr, feed virtual snacks, or bring out a feather wand, yarn ball or red-dot pen for a playful chase and jump.

YOUR COZY SPACE
Swipe between a sunny yard, warm bedroom and sunroom. Rename your home and keep happiness and fullness in view.

REMINDERS AND WIDGETS
Set optional recurring feeding reminders for each cat, with a cat image preview and meow sound. Add a petoo cats widget for cat poses and stats. Widget refresh timing is controlled by iOS.

START WITH A GIFT
New players receive 1,000 gift coins. Optional 100-coin packs are available through Apple in-app purchase at the displayed price. Coins buy virtual snacks, have no cash value and do not expire.

No ads. No petoo account. Pet profiles and coin balances are stored on your device; balances and completed consumable purchases do not transfer or restore after reinstalling.

Petoo does not connect to physical feeders. Feeding reminders depend on your iPhone notification and Focus settings.

name: PhoneFic: SMAU & Chat Maker
description:
Tell your story the way fandom reads it.

PhoneFic is the fake-phone story maker for SMAU, chat fic and OC creators. Stack realistic messages, lock screens, notes, search history, social posts and music cards into one gorgeous long image — or auto-split it into clean carousel pages for TikTok and X. No more juggling five screenshot websites and a design app.

BUILD YOUR CAST ONCE
Create characters with avatars, names and @handles, then reuse them across every chapter. Set the phone owner and their texts land on the right — switch owners to retell the scene from another perspective.

SEVEN STORY BLOCKS
• Messages — group chats, read receipts, typing dots, deleted texts, photo attachments
• Lock Screen — wallpapers, a big clock and stacked push notifications
• Notes — drafts with highlights and strikethrough for inner monologue
• Search History — the curious, the denial, the clue
• Social Post — photos, likes, reposts and a top-comment section
• Now Playing — album art, progress and one highlighted lyric
• Divider — time jumps and narration

MAKE IT FEEL REAL
Light, Dark and Cream themes. Custom status bar time, signal and battery (yes, the 3% red battery). Solid, gradient or blurred-photo backgrounds.

EXPORT FOR EVERY PLATFORM
One tap renders a 3x ultra-HD long image. Pro auto-splits your story into 9:16, 4:5 or 3:4 carousel pages that break at block boundaries — a bubble or a line of text is never cut in half.

START FROM A TEMPLATE
Three ready-made stories — a 2 AM wrong-number text, a chaotic band groupchat, a 3%-battery goodbye. Every character is an original fictional OC.

FREE VS PRO
Free: 3 stories, 3 characters, Messages / Lock Screen / Divider, standard export with a small credit line.
Pro: all seven blocks, unlimited stories and characters, 3x HD, no watermark, carousel split, gradient and photo backgrounds, Cream theme.

PhoneFic Pro: $2.99/month (3-day free trial), $19.99/year (save 44%), or $34.99 lifetime. Students: $24.99 lifetime, no verification. Subscription renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the period ends; manage in Settings.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account. No servers. No ads. No analytics. Your stories stay on your device.

For fictional storytelling only — don't impersonate real people or fabricate evidence.

Terms: https://www.sun-apps.com/phonefic/terms.html
Privacy: https://www.sun-apps.com/phonefic/privacy.html

name: PhonePad: Trackpad & Keyboard
description:
PhonePad turns your iPhone into a precise multi-touch trackpad and a full keyboard for your Mac — over your own Wi‑Fi, with no cables, accounts or cloud.

TRACKPAD THAT FEELS NATIVE
• Move, tap to click and two-finger tap to right-click
• Momentum scrolling and pinch to zoom
• Long-press or tap-then-drag to drag windows and files
• Three-finger swipes for Spaces and Mission Control
• Adjustable pointer speed and natural scrolling

A REAL MAC KEYBOARD, IN YOUR LAYOUT
• Mirrors the input source selected on your Mac — English, Arabic, French and more
• Modifier keys, shortcuts, function keys and arrows
• Switch to the iPhone keyboard to swipe-type or dictate straight into any Mac app

EVERY MAC ON YOUR DESK
• Pair with as many Macs as you like and stay connected to all of them
• Switch with one tap, or push the pointer past a screen edge to jump to the next Mac

PRIVATE AND SECURE
• Works directly over your local network — nothing passes through a server
• Each Mac is paired once with a 6-digit code
• No accounts, no analytics, no tracking

HOW IT WORKS
Install the free PhonePad companion app on your Mac from phonepad.hookreplay.dev, grant it Accessibility permission, then open PhonePad on your iPhone and pick your Mac.

PRICING
Download free and try every feature for 7 days. After that, unlock PhonePad forever with a single in-app purchase — no subscription, and you are never charged automatically.

Requires a Mac running macOS 14 Sonoma or later, on the same Wi‑Fi network.

name: Phonics House: Learn to Read
description:
Phonics House turns learning to read into a visit to a cozy clay dollhouse. Every room opens a new set of letters and sounds, and Finn the Fox is there for each step, from the first letter sound to reading a whole story.

LEARN TO READ, STEP BY STEP
• All 26 letters, taught in a phonics-first order (S, A, T, N…) so children blend real words like "sat" and "tan" early on
• Pure letter sounds that blend smoothly into words
• Short vowels, CVC words, first sentences and short stories
• Uppercase and lowercase for every letter

Made for ages from 3 to 7 with two modes: 
• Preschool (3–4).
• Early School (5–7).

GAMES FOR EVERY LETTER
Every letter has 7 games in Preschool mode and 8 in Early School mode.
• Pop Bubbles: spot the matching letter
• Trace & Write: letter tracing on handwriting lines
• Listen & Find: hear a word, tap the picture (ages 3–4)
• Letter Hunt: find every matching letter shape (ages 5–7)
• Build a Word: snap sounds together to spell
• Read & Match: match the word to its picture
• Feed Finn: sort short-vowel sounds for a hungry fox
• Color Studio: paint the letter and its friend, with coloring that stays inside the lines
• Story Time: a three-scene reading adventure (ages 5–7)

MORE TO EXPLORE
• ABC Song: all 26 letters light up from A to Z in time with the music
• Numbers 1–10: count, trace and pop
• Colors: sort, mix and paint

A CALM PLACE TO LEARN
• Soft clay-style rooms and gentle music
• No ads
• Plays offline, so it works in the car and on flights
• No microphone and no account to create
• Purchases and outside links sit behind a parent gate

FREE TO START
Download free and play the first letters. Unlock the whole house, with all six rooms and all 26 letters, with Phonics House Premium.

PHONICS HOUSE PREMIUM
• Choose a monthly plan, a yearly plan with a 1-week free trial, or a one-time lifetime unlock
• The lifetime unlock works with Family Sharing

Privacy Policy: https://barqawiz.github.io/kids-learning/privacy.html
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: PhotoMode: Album Camera
description:
PhotoMode is a camera with one dial. Each position is an album you name. 
Turn it to Family, Food, Travel or Receipts, tap the knob, and shoot. 
Every photo and video goes straight into that album, sorted the moment you take it.

- Name your own albums and pick an emoji for each
- Photo and video, with flash, zoom and tap to focus
- Saved in your own Photos library, in albums with the same names
- Wrong album? Move a picture in one tap
- Open from the Lock Screen, Action Button or Siri

No account. No ads. No tracking.

name: Piano Instruments: Handpan
description:
Piano Instruments puts six ways to play into one instrument. You don't need to read music: pick a key and the notes of the scale light up, so you can see which ones belong together.

SIX WAYS TO PLAY, ONE KEY
Piano: a sampled grand piano with full-size keys. Drag the bar below to move up and down the keyboard.
Handpan: seven real handpan scales, or the scale you picked, with 9 or 15 notes and a 25-note double ring on iPad. Shift the whole pan up or down an octave.
Chords: one finger, one chord. Major, minor and seventh chords are laid out for the key you're in.
Hex grid: up-right is a fifth, right is a major third. Draw a shape and you're playing harmony.
Dots: a tidy grid of notes with the scale lit up. Slide across for a run of notes.
Ribbon: a continuous string that snaps to the scale. Hold a little longer to glide freely.

25 SOUNDS
Grand piano, electric piano, organ, harpsichord, nylon guitar, guzheng, kalimba, music box, vibraphone, steel pan, singing bowl, marimba, bell, flute, harmonica, brass, strings, choir, pad, bass, clavinet, 8-bit and more. Each way to play has its own set to choose from, and the Ribbon adds six synth waves.

MUSIC YOU CAN SEE
Notes leave trails of light as you play, and the chord or interval you're holding is named on screen, so you pick up harmony as you go.

MADE FOR FINGERS
Multi-touch, glides, sustain and a performance lock. On iPhone, keys and pads answer with a subtle tap you can feel. Play along with your own music in the background; the silent switch won't mute you.

ANYWHERE
No internet, no account, no ads, and no data collected. Plays in portrait or landscape on iPhone and iPad.

name: PickNote
description:
No time for that one-hour interview or 30-minute tutorial? PickNote turns it into one page of key notes you can read in minutes, and one tap takes you back to the exact second in the original.

TURN ANYTHING INTO TEXT
• Web articles and YouTube videos with captions: just paste the link
• Listen & Transcribe: play a video in any app (YouTube, TikTok, Douyin, WeChat Channels…) and PickNote records only that app's sound, then turns it into text. No screen recording, no microphone, no video download
• Import your own videos, recordings, PDFs (scans too), images, Word, Excel and PowerPoint files
• Speech-to-text runs on your iPhone and tells speakers apart

NOTES THAT READ FAST
• One-line gist, key points, data and examples, chapters, lessons learned, things to try, terms explained
• Key words are highlighted; tap one to jump to where it was said
• Foreign-language content is translated sentence by sentence, side by side with the original

SUMMARIES BY THE AI YOU CHOOSE
• Apple Intelligence (free and on-device on supported iPhones)
• Or sign in with your own ChatGPT, or add an API key for OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek and more
• PickNote asks before sending anything to a third-party AI

A KNOWLEDGE BASE THAT GROWS WITH YOU
• Automatic categories and tags, filters and search
• Ask: question everything you have saved and get answers with sources
• Connect AI assistants: via MCP, Claude, Cursor, Gemini, Codex and others can read your notes to help you decide, find product ideas and write

PRIVACY
No account, no server, no analytics. Your notes stay on your iPhone and in the folder you choose.

name: PickupLoom
description:
Can you have 48 vada pav packed by 6 PM? Pickup Loom helps takeaway shops, cafés and caterers answer that question before promising a pickup time. Enter the order and see when the first batch needs to start, when the last one will finish, and how much time you have set aside for packing.

Plan around your kitchen

Choose the station that will prepare the order. Enter the number of pieces it can handle at once, the minutes each batch takes, and the packing time you need before pickup. Pickup Loom works backward from the deadline to give every batch a quantity and a start time.

See what one extra piece changes

Suppose your fryer holds 12 pieces and each batch takes six minutes. For 48 pieces due at 6 PM, with four minutes for packing, your first batch starts at 5:32 PM. The fourth batch finishes at 5:56 PM, just as packing begins. If the customer adds one more piece, you need a fifth fryer cycle. Change the quantity to 49 and the first start moves to 5:26 PM.

Check which orders can share a station

Two orders with different pickup times can still need the same fryer at the same moment. Pickup Loom flags overlapping prep times so you can see the clash. Try a different pickup time and check the revised plan while the customer is still at the counter.

Follow the order through service

Keep the Service Board open as you cook. See which batch comes next, how many pieces to prepare and how many are left. Mark a batch complete as it comes off the station, or undo a tap if you marked it too soon. Planned start times and actual completion times stay separate, so you can compare the schedule with what happened in the kitchen.

Pickup Loom works offline and saves your orders and progress on your iPhone. Start with the editable Evening Pickup example or plan your next bulk order using your own station capacity and timings.

name: Pilotzyn
description:
Pilotzyn puts the cockpit tools general aviation pilots use every flight on your iPhone and iPad, built to read at a glance and to keep working with no signal in the air.

MOVING MAP
- Your position on the map with route, airspace, TFRs, SIGMETs and nearby airports
- Tap anything on the map to see what it is: airspace hours, TFR times, airport info
- Approach plates and procedure fixes on the map; direct-to from a tap
- Taxiway overlay at the airport

PLAN AND BRIEF
- Build a route and see weather along every leg, with the age of each report
- METARs, TAFs, PIREPs, SIGMETs, G-AIRMETs, winds aloft and radar replay
- Approach entry suggestions from your route
- Weight and balance and checklists for your aircraft

IN FLIGHT
- Download charts, airport data and your route weather before you go; Pilotzyn opens and works offline
- Whenever any data link is up, small automatic checks flag new weather, TFRs and NOTAMs along the rest of your route
- Low-data mode for in-flight Wi-Fi and Low Data networks
- The screen stays on while Pilotzyn is open, for kneeboard use

LOGBOOK THAT FILLS ITSELF
- Turn on automatic flight recording and Pilotzyn detects taxi, takeoff and landing, saves your track and drafts the logbook entry for you to check
- Replay recorded flights

BUILT FOR iPHONE AND iPAD
One app for both: quick, large controls on the phone; more map and split views on the iPad, in portrait or landscape.

Pilotzyn is for members. Sign in with your Pilotzyn account.

Pilotzyn is a supplemental tool. It is not certified for navigation: fly current charts, your approved avionics and ATC instructions. Continued use of GPS running in the background can decrease battery life.

name: Pip’s Word Search
description:
Where are the five hidden words? Explore a grid of letters with Pip. Swipe from the first letter to the last, or tap the first and last letters.

Choose how you play:
• Practice: short words, across and down.
• Easy: find backwards words too.
• Challenging: discover diagonal words.
• Expert: longer words in every direction.

Found all five? Play another round with a new puzzle.

Your own sticker book has 12 stickers with clear goals. Tap a sticker to see your progress and what there is still to discover.

• Dutch, English and German word lists.
• Follows your supported iOS language preference; no in-game language selector.
• Works offline.
• Progress stays locally in this app.
• No ads, accounts or in-app purchases.

name: Pipchute
description:
A cherry sends your marble over the high bar. At the fork, an orange sends it right and a lime sends it left. The cup is just ahead. Did you leave enough room to brake?

In Pipchute, each of the six fruits gives the marble a different instruction. Turn the wheel to line up a fruit for each rail, then pull the red lever and watch your plan play out. Overshot the cup? Check where the marble picked up speed, swap a fruit and try again.

Play 15 handcrafted courses across three venues. Landing in the cup earns a star. For more stars, aim for the speed marked on each gold ring just as the marble passes through.

Three Show Tickets each come with an optional encore. Take the fork you skipped on your first run. Land with the melon still in your basket. Then see if one fruit lineup can land the marble twice, first at pace 2 and again at pace 5.

Build a course of your own in the Workshop. Piece together two to four rails, set the starting speed and check whether your layout has a solution. Take it for a test run, save it under a name and duplicate it when you want to try a different idea.

Play offline. Your progress and saved tracks stay on your device.

name: Pivot Broach
description:
Pivot Broach keeps each plate on this iPhone.

A quarter turn seats the hole or opens the shake only after that hole's shake has been read. An unread turn springs back and the hole stays. A hole that is already seated, with the shake still at zero, opens the shake to one and locks. Another turn would oval the hole and springs back.

When all four holes are seated and each shake is one, the sentence says Broached. Otherwise it names the first hole that is still proud, or says that hole is tight.

Name a plate, find one, delete one, and share the sentence.

Plates stay on this iPhone. There is no account and nothing to buy. This does not broach the plate for you.

name: Pixel Pilot: Endless Flight
description:
**Fly. Fight. Survive.**

Take to the skies in Pixel Pilot: Endless Flight, a retro-inspired arcade shooter that brings the excitement of classic 16-bit gaming to your iPhone and iPad.

Inspired by the legendary vertical-scrolling shooters of the 1980s and 1990s, Pixel Pilot delivers fast-paced aerial combat, colorful pixel-art graphics, and an endless challenge that gets tougher the longer you survive.

**CLASSIC ARCADE ACTION**

Pilot your fighter through an endless battlefield filled with enemy aircraft, ground defenses, incoming missiles, and relentless attacks. Dodge enemy fire, destroy everything in your path, and see how long you can survive.

**SIMPLE CONTROLS. SERIOUS CHALLENGE.**

Just drag your finger to fly. Your weapons fire automatically, leaving you free to focus on dodging, attacking, and staying alive.

Easy to learn. Difficult to master.

**POWER UP YOUR AIRCRAFT**

Collect upgrades to improve your weapons, repair your aircraft, and earn bonus points. The longer you survive, the more dangerous the skies become.

**A LOVE LETTER TO 16-BIT GAMING**

Enjoy colorful Sega Genesis-inspired pixel art, original retro-style music, arcade sound effects, and familiar gameplay designed for modern touchscreens.

**FEATURES**

- Endless vertical-scrolling arcade action
- Responsive, intuitive touch controls
- Automatic shooting and weapon upgrades
- Diverse enemy aircraft and ground defenses
- Challenging enemy formations and attack patterns
- Multiple scrolling battlefield environments
- Collectible power-ups and health repairs
- Increasing difficulty as you survive
- Local high scores to beat
- Original retro-inspired music and sound effects
- Playable offline on iPhone and iPad

**ONE MORE RUN. ONE MORE HIGH SCORE.**

No complicated controls. No lengthy tutorials. Just you, your aircraft, and an endless sky full of enemies.

How long can you survive?

**Pixel Pilot: Endless Flight**

Fly. Fight. Survive.

name: Plain JSON
description:
Plain JSON is a simple, read-only viewer for structured data files on iPhone and iPad. Open a file, browse its nested values, and see exactly what it contains without changing anything.

BROWSE
• Expand objects and arrays in a clear tree
• See each value's key, type, and contents
• Large collections load 200 entries at a time
• On iPad, the tree and the text sit side by side

INSPECT
• Switch between the original source and the selected value
• See an exact path for every value
• Numbers keep their original spelling and precision
• Comments stay visible in the source view of JSONC files
• Readable error messages show where a file went wrong

SEARCH AND COPY
• Search the displayed text
• Copy any path or value

JSON LINES TOOLS
• Go to any record by its number
• Filter records by text across the whole file
• See which fields your records have, and how often

TRY IT
• Open Sample shows an example JSON, JSON with Comments, or JSON Lines file

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your files stay on your device. Plain JSON never edits them, needs no account, has no ads or analytics, and makes no network connections of its own. It saves no data of its own, so device backups hold nothing from it.

FREE AND FULL ACCESS
JSON and JSON with Comments files up to 20 MiB are free. JSON Lines files show their first 50 records for free, with the same tools.

A one-time In-App Purchase opens JSON Lines files in full, at any size, and removes the 20 MiB limit for other files. There is no subscription, and your purchase stays with your Apple Account.

name: Plain RSS
description:
Plain RSS brings updates from the websites you choose into one quiet reader.

Add an RSS or Atom feed by its address, or enter a website address and let the app find the feed. Refresh to download new articles, then read them in a clean view of text and basic formatting.

FEATURES
• Browse all, unread or starred articles
• Search article titles and summaries
• Organize feeds into folders
• Import and export your subscriptions as OPML
• Read downloaded articles offline
• Choose how many articles to keep for each feed
• Light and dark appearance that follows your device
• Works on iPhone and iPad

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
There is no account, no advertising and no analytics. Your feed list and articles are stored on your device, and are included in iCloud and computer backups if you have those turned on. The app contacts only the servers that host your feeds, and nothing is sent to Plain Text Office. Scripts, frames and remote images are blocked in the reader, and images load only when you choose for the article you are viewing.

Plain RSS is free.

name: Plain RTF
description:
Plain RTF is a lightweight editor for quick notes with formatting and images. Your notes stay in a documented plain-text format, saved wherever you choose in Files.

• Format text with bold, italic, underline, font sizes and colors
• Make bulleted and numbered lists
• Paste images into a note; they are saved inside it
• Open and save notes in Files, iCloud Drive or another storage provider you use
• Unsaved changes are kept in a recovery draft on your iPhone until you save or discard them
• No account, ads or analytics, and the app does not connect to the internet

SAME FILES ON EVERY DEVICE
Plain RTF for iPhone reads and writes the same files as Plain RTF for Android and Windows, so a note keeps its fonts, colors, lists, tables and images as it moves between them. Formatting the iPhone toolbar does not offer, such as strikethrough, highlights or other fonts, is kept when you save.

ABOUT THE FORMAT
Plain RTF uses its own UTF-8 Plain Text RTF format. These files usually end in .rtf, but they are not Microsoft RTF files, so documents from Word or TextEdit do not open in Plain RTF.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Plain RTF sends nothing anywhere. Your notes go only where you save them. Send Feedback opens a draft in your own email app, and nothing is sent unless you send it. Recovery drafts are stored in the app and are included in your iPhone's backups.

name: Plain Text Math
description:
Build confidence with mental arithmetic, one problem at a time. Text Math generates short practice workouts and shows two ways to reach each answer, so you can explore number relationships and compare approaches.

PRACTICE AT YOUR PACE
• Workouts of 3, 5, or 10 problems covering addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, and fractions
• Up to three attempts at each problem, with a hint whenever you need one
• Two solution methods after every problem, whether you solved it or the answer was revealed
• Division problems with remainders take both a quotient and a remainder

EXPLORE DIFFERENT METHODS
Practice strategies such as regrouping, rounding and compensating, splitting numbers by place value, applying the distributive property, and connecting multiplication with division. Every answer is a whole number, and fractions are shown in lowest terms.

TRAIN YOUR FOCUS
• Optional solve timer, with your total time at the end of the workout
• Blind entry shows a dot for each digit, so you commit to the whole answer
• Hide the problem after 3, 5, 8, or 12 seconds to hold the numbers in your head

RATE AND EXPORT PROBLEMS
Rate problems Good or Bad and keep your 200 most recent ratings on your device. Problems you have rated are skipped in later workouts. Copy your ratings as plain text, or share them as a JSON file to a destination you choose.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Problems are generated on your device, and the app works offline. There is no account, advertising, analytics, or AI service. Settings and ratings stay in the app unless you export them, and they are included in your iCloud or computer backup. Send Feedback opens a draft in your email app with only the app version, iOS version, and device model; nothing is sent unless you send it.

Text Math is designed for teens and adults who want to practice mental arithmetic and build number sense.

name: Planforce Simulator
description:
Run a planning desk for a month. Make the Decisions. See the impact.

Planforce Simulator is a free game about the decisions behind every full shelf. Pick a company and one of six planning roles, then work through a short month of real trade-offs: forecasts, factory capacity, safety stock, promotions, prices and cash. Bot colleagues play the other desks, and every choice you make ripples through theirs.

HOW IT PLAYS
• Choose a mission and a desk: Demand Planner, Supply Planner, Inventory Planner, Pricing Manager, Finance Manager or S&OP Lead.
• Make four big decisions using data cards and messages from colleagues. Stuck? Ask a colleague for a hint.
• Handle twists as they land: a surprise promotion, a late supplier, a snow warning.
• Close the month at the S&OP meeting with an honest story about your plan.
• See your score, star rating and a ripple map of how every other desk fared, plus a planning lesson.
• Replay with new hidden conditions and different colleague styles.

TWO MISSIONS TO START
• Heatwave Ahead, at Hopscotch Brewing Co.: a heatwave is coming. How much does the country need, and can the brewery keep up?
• Winter Is Coming, at Cocoa Comet: eight weeks to Christmas, Black Friday, snow on the roads and a cocoa price swing.
New companies and missions arrive regularly.

WHY PLAY
• Students: see how forecasting, inventory and S&OP really work.
• New planners: practise without real stakes.
• Experienced teams: walk in a colleague's shoes and see what your decisions do to theirs.

ALSO
• Create your own planner avatar.
• Your best stars are saved for every mission and desk.
• Free for individuals, with no ads and no in-app purchases.

For ages 16 and over. An account is needed to save your progress.
Support: planforce.ai/simulator-support.html
Privacy: planforce.ai/simulator-privacy.html

name: PlantAxiom Engineering Tools
description:
PlantAxiom Engineering Tools is an offline engineering calculator for plant maintenance, electrical technicians and engineers: 230 calculators for iPhone, iPad and Mac that work in a basement MCC room, on a roof or anywhere in the plant with no signal. Every calculator is built into the app and checks its inputs.

GET THE NUMBER AT THE MACHINE
• Size a motor feed on the spot: motor current, then cable cross-section from voltage drop, then the voltage drop on the cable you chose. For an 80 m run that takes about a minute, with no walk back to the office.
• Answers update as you type. There is no calculate button.

WHAT THE ENGINEERING CALCULATOR COVERS
• Electrical design: voltage drop, cable size, motor current, transformer sizing, short-circuit current, power factor correction, busbar losses and more
• Circuit fundamentals: Ohm's law, resistor colour code, series and parallel circuits, RC and RL time constants
• Motors and drives: torque, efficiency, starting voltage dip, thermal protection setting, VFD savings
• Mechanical: bolt torque, shaft stress, bearing life, belt drives, acceleration torque
• Fluid flow, pumps and hydraulics: pipe velocity, pressure drop, NPSH, pump affinity laws, valve Kv/Cv
• Heat transfer, steam, refrigeration and HVAC: heat exchangers, steam demand and pipe sizing, insulation, cooling loads
• Instrumentation and control: PT100, 4–20 mA scaling and loop budget, dew point, orifice flow, tank level and volume
• Process, dairy and CIP: mass balances, membrane flux, holding tubes, CIP detergent make-up
• Reliability, cost and project management: OEE, availability from MTBF, payback, three-point estimates

HOW IT WORKS
• Inputs keep their units and permitted ranges, and a value out of range is marked with a plain message.
• Search by name, task, unit or formula, or browse 26 work areas.
• Star the calculators you use; your recent ones are one tap away.
• Copy or share a result with its inputs, ready for an e-mail or a site report.
• Every calculator shows its formula and its limits, and links to its page on plantaxiom.com with the method and a worked example.
• Light and dark themes, and quick tips under About.
• On the Mac: the same app in a resizable window, with Esc or ⌘[ to go back and the Mac share menu for results.
• In your language: the app follows your device language (57 languages); change it any time under About, or in Settings › PlantAxiom Tools › Language.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no analytics. The app makes no network connections: your inputs, saved calculators and history stay on your device, and you can clear them under About › Your data. A short privacy notice on first start links the privacy policy and the terms.

WHO IT IS FOR
Maintenance and electrical technicians who need a quick, reliable number on the shop floor, plant and process engineers, and engineering students and junior engineers who want an engineering calculator to check their hand calculations.

Use with care: the results support engineering judgement; they do not replace it. Check them against the standards, codes and manufacturer data that apply to your plant.

name: PlantAxiom Maintenance Toolkit
description:
PlantAxiom Maintenance Toolkit (Field Kit) is a maintenance toolkit for the shop floor: 27 tools that use your iPhone's own sensors, and AI tools that think a problem through with you. Built for maintenance technicians, electricians and plant engineers. No account, no ads.

AI TROUBLESHOOTING
• Fault codes: pick the drive, servo, PLC, HMI, CNC, robot or compressor, type the brand, series and code, and get the meaning for that series, the likely causes in order and the first checks.
• Night breakdown coach: talk a breakdown through step by step, by voice or text.
• Spare part finder: bearing, belt, seal, fuse and contactor markings decoded, with equivalents.
• Root cause analysis (5W1H and 5 Whys), P&ID and drawing review, photo inspection, hygienic design check, workplace safety check, slow-motion jam hunter and motor sound check.
• Voice work order: talk for a minute and get a clean work order, shift handover or manager brief.

YOUR IPHONE AS A MEASURING TOOL
• Air leak finder with a yearly cost estimate.
• Belt tension by sound, bump test, vibration (mm/s RMS with an indicative ISO 20816 zone), sound level in dB(A), RPM from sound or vibration, stroboscopic hazard check.
• Lux meter, spirit level and inclinometer, distance and height, and lengths measured on a photo.

RECORD THE WORK
• LOTO photo proof, NFC machine passport, guard opening check (ISO 13857 Table 4), micro-stop and cycle counter, lubrication route.

EASY TO FIND, EASY TO TRUST
• Search the tool list by name, in your language or in English.
• Every tool shows how it works, with a short animation, before you start.
• 57 languages: the app and its AI answers follow your device's language, or the one you pick in About. Light and dark themes.
• On iPad and Mac the tools sit in two or three columns. Tools that need a sensor the device does not have (motion sensors, NFC) say so.

PRIVATE AND HONEST
• Sounds are processed on the device and never uploaded. The AI tools send only what you enter, and only when you press Send.
• Device sensors are not calibrated instruments, so readings are indicative. An AI answer is not an inspection or a diagnosis. Always follow your site's safety and lockout/tagout rules.

name: PlantSun: Plant Light Meter
description:
PlantSun shows how much light a spot really gets, so you can pick the right place for each plant.

MEASURING IS ALWAYS FREE
No timers, no subscription, no "battery" to refill. Sunlight and LED measuring are free too.

WHAT YOU GET FOR FREE
• Light in lux or foot-candles, with min / avg / max and hold
• A plain answer: low, medium, bright indirect or direct sun, with what that looks like in a home
• PPFD and DLI for sunlight, white LED, fluorescent, metal halide, HPS and incandescent
• A guide to 150+ houseplants: which ones thrive or survive in the light you measured
• Calibration against a real light meter
• A guide to measuring, plus recommended light for each room

HOW IT MEASURES
• Android: your phone's light sensor.
• iPhone: iPhone has no light sensor for apps, so PlantSun estimates light from the front camera. Cover the camera with plain white paper and point the screen at the light. No photos are taken or saved.

PLANTSUN PRO (one-time purchase)
• Saved spots around your home, ranked from brightest to darkest
• All-day light log (DLI) while the app is open
• My plants: each plant linked to its spot
• CSV export and calibration profiles
• No ads

GOOD TO KNOW
PlantSun estimates light. It is close enough to choose the right spot for a plant, but it is not a lab instrument. The accuracy for your phone is explained in the app. For exact PAR values, use a quantum sensor. Red/blue "purple" grow lights can't be measured with lux.

name: PlanWise (5108c5)
description:
PlanWise is the planner built for students. Keep every assignment, test and class in one place, and let PlanWise do the organizing for you.

SCAN IT, DON'T TYPE IT
Point your camera at a syllabus, class schedule or assignment sheet, or pick a photo, and PlanWise reads it for you. Due dates, tests and events are pulled out automatically so you can review them and add them to your calendar in one tap.

SYNC YOUR CLASSES
Connect the learning platform your school uses and bring in your courses and assignments automatically. PlanWise works with Canvas, Google Classroom, Schoology, Blackboard, Brightspace, Moodle and PowerSchool.

EVERYTHING DUE, AT A GLANCE
• Home dashboard showing what's due today and what's coming up
• Assignments list with due dates, courses and completion status
• Tests & Quizzes tracker so you always know when to start studying
• Courses view that keeps each class organized
• Calendar with your whole school year, month by month

A DAILY CHECKLIST THAT KEEPS YOU MOVING
PlanWise builds a checklist for each day from your upcoming work. Add your own tasks, check things off and watch your week come together.

REMINDERS THAT ACTUALLY HELP
Get notified before assignments and tests are due, so nothing sneaks up on you.

MAKE IT YOURS
Light and dark mode plus color themes to match your style.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No PlanWise account required. Your planner data stays on your device.

Whether you're in high school or college, PlanWise helps you stay on top of your work and stress less about deadlines.

Canvas, Google Classroom, Schoology, Blackboard, Brightspace, Moodle and PowerSchool are trademarks of their respective owners. PlanWise is not affiliated with or endorsed by them.

name: Platform: Subway Games
description:
Platform, Anonymous Subway Games.

Head-to-head, phone to phone, with whoever's nearby. No signal, no names, no small talk.

The ride is boring and a little awkward. Platform lightens the mood: challenge anyone nearby to chess, pool, Four Stops and more, with no cell service and no idea who's who.

HOW IT WORKS
• Tap "Open to play." Nearby players can invite you. It switches itself off after 15 minutes.
• See who's nearby, not who they are. Players show up as a random name like "Velvet Falcon." No photos, no location, no distance.
• Send an invite. They tap Play or Not now.
• Play with no signal. Phones connect directly over Bluetooth and Wi-Fi, underground or mid-tunnel.
• Keep using your phone while you wait. Subway ambience (on by default, can be turned off) keeps Platform running in the background, so you can listen to music, use other apps or lock your screen and still get invites.
• Dropped connection? The game pauses and picks up where you left off if you're back within a minute.

THE LINES
• Crosstown: tic-tac-toe, over in one stop
• Four Stops: four in a row
• Grand Central: chess for the long haul
• 8 Ball Express: pool with real physics
• Next Stop: a five-letter word race. Same word, first to solve wins

OPTIONAL STATION ALERTS
• Off by default. Get a quiet reminder when you arrive at one of NYC's 20 busiest subway stations. Your location is checked on your phone and never sent anywhere.

BUILT FOR COMFORT
• No names, no faces, no accounts
• No chat with strangers, just quick reactions like "gg"
• Say no and the invite quietly expires. Nobody sees a rejection
• Block anyone, anytime, without either of you learning who the other is
• "Played 3 times before" is remembered privately on your phone only
• Someone's stop came first? The game saves on both phones. Resume it next time you ride together

No one else has the app yet? Host a game over your Personal Hotspot and AirDrop them a link to play in Safari.

No ads. No accounts. No servers. Games happen phone to phone.

name: Plieno
description:
Plieno turns paper into a clean PDF and puts it where you need it.

Scan a document, review the pages, tap Done. The PDF is created on your phone, then saved straight into a folder on your Mac — no cables, no extra taps. Or share it anywhere with one tap.

SCAN
• Automatic edge detection and perspective correction
• Single or multi-page documents
• Crop, rotate, reorder, delete and add pages
• Rename before you save

DELIVER
• Pair your Mac once by scanning a code
• New scans are saved into the folder you chose, automatically
• Transfers are encrypted and go directly over your Wi-Fi — they never pass through our servers
• Mac asleep? Scans wait and send when it's back
• Share or email any PDF from the app

DEPENDABLE
• Every PDF is saved on your phone first
• Interrupted transfers resume where they stopped
• "Saved to MacBook" appears only after your Mac confirms the file is saved

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account needed
• No ads, no tracking, no analytics

Laptop delivery uses the free Plieno app for Mac, available at gafree.com/plieno. Scanning, PDFs and sharing work on their own.

name: Pocket Portals
description:
Pocket Portals is a single-player 2D puzzle platformer where changing a door’s destination can open a new route through a level.

Run and jump through compact rooms, look for matching door symbols, and use the room map to see where each route leads. A console can switch a shared door between two destinations while fixed doors stay connected. On levels with a locked exit, find and step on a pressure plate before working your way back to the exit.

Play offline and explore at your own pace. If you fall, you return to a safe spot with your door settings and any exit unlock preserved.

name: Pocket Prowler
description:
Pip the red panda has a museum to explore and a pocket full of plans. Study the patrols, collect every treasure, and slip back to the exit. Guards move when you do, so you can take your time deciding whether to step forward or wait.

Play through 100 hand-built puzzles across five chapters. Duck behind cover, find keys, and use decoys to turn a guard away. Later rooms add timed lasers, ringing floor tiles, smoke capsules, and laser jammers. Short practice rooms let you try each new trick before using it on a mission.

Undo a move, ask for a hint, or replay a favorite room to earn more stars. All missions work offline, and your progress is saved on your device. No account, ads, or in-app purchases.

name: PocketDiagram
description:
PocketDiagram opens Microsoft Visio drawings (.vsdx) and draw.io diagrams (.drawio) for reading on iPhone and iPad. Check what a drawing contains even when Visio or draw.io isn't at hand.

OPEN DRAWINGS AS YOU RECEIVE THEM
- Touch and hold a drawing in Mail or the Files app, tap Share, and choose this app
- Or tap Open File in the app to pick drawings from iCloud Drive and other locations
- Supported: .vsdx / .vsdm (Visio 2013 or later), .vstx / .vssx (templates and stencils), .drawio
- Opened drawings are kept in the app, so you can reopen them from the list later

ZOOM IN TO READ
- View every page and zoom or pan with your fingers. Lines and text stay sharp as you zoom
- Switch pages using the list at the bottom of the screen or on the left on wide displays
- Show or hide each layer

LOOK UP SHAPE DATA
- Tap a shape to see its text and shape data, such as IP address, model and location. Copy the contents with one tap
- Search text and shape data across all pages

SEE WHAT MAY LOOK DIFFERENT
- About This Drawing lists elements that were approximated or couldn't be read
- Damaged files, password-protected files and the older .vsd format show why they can't be opened

YOUR DRAWINGS STAY ON YOUR DEVICE
- Everything is read and displayed on the device. No account is needed

The older .vsd format (Visio 2010 or earlier) and drawings protected by a password or a sensitivity label are not supported.
Fonts are replaced with ones available on the device, so line breaks may differ slightly from the original. Effects such as shadows and 3D are not shown.
Icons from external draw.io shape libraries (such as cloud icons) are shown as colored tiles with the shape name.
The app is available in English and Japanese.
Visio is a trademark of Microsoft Corporation. draw.io is a registered trademark of draw.io Ltd. This app is not made or endorsed by Microsoft or draw.io Ltd, and is not affiliated with either company.

For step-by-step instructions, open Settings > How to Use.

Viewing is free. The app contains no ads or in-app purchases.

name: Polaris TMS
description:
Polaris TMS to system do zarządzania firmą transportową. Aplikacja mobilna łączy kierowców z biurem: kierowca ma w trasie wszystko w jednym miejscu, a spedytor widzi to na bieżąco w panelu polaristms.eu.

Zlecenia
• aktualne zlecenie z adresami załadunków i rozładunków, kodami i terminami
• potwierdzanie przybycia, załadunku i rozładunku jednym stuknięciem
• notatki od biura do każdego miejsca

Czas pracy
• ile jazdy zostało dziś i kiedy trzeba zrobić pauzę, liczone z danych tachografu
• podsumowanie tygodnia, limity 56 h i 90 h, odpoczynki
• lista naruszeń z wyjaśnieniem

Mapa floty
• pozycje aut na żywo z GPS, adres i prędkość
• wyszukiwanie po rejestracji lub kierowcy, grupowanie aut stojących obok siebie
• nawigacja do wybranego auta jednym przyciskiem

Dokumenty i zgłoszenia
• dokumenty przewozowe: zdjęcie, PDF albo skan prosto z kabiny
• protokół naczepy, zgłoszenie uszkodzenia lub awarii, zapotrzebowanie

Pojazd i eco-driving
• terminy przeglądu, OC, tachografu i wymiany oleju
• spalanie na tle normy i ranking kierowców

Pobudki i powiadomienia
• budzik od biura, który dzwoni jak alarm w zegarze
• powiadomienia o nowych zleceniach i decyzjach biura

Konta zakłada administrator firmy w panelu Polaris TMS. Firmę można założyć i przetestować na polaristms.eu.

name: Pomelune--Tilt Funnel Sorting
description:
Pomelune kutsuu sinut aurinkoiseen hedelmäpajaan, jossa omenat, appelsiinit ja päärynät putoavat rajallisen tilavuuden omaaviin läpinäkyviin putkiin.

Kallista yläosan suppiloa valitaksesi syöttöaukon ja vapauta se, jotta seuraava hedelmä putoaa putkeen. Nosta pehmeää sulkua ja kaada koko putken sisältö vastaavaan koriin. Jokainen sallittu toiminto vie aikaa yhden vuoron, joten hedelmien ohjaaminen ja kaataminen vaativat molemmat huolellista suunnittelua.

Seuraa vapaita paikkoja, pidä jokaisessa putkessa vain yhtä hedelmälajia ja täytä kaikki korit saadaksesi tilauksen valmiiksi. Edessäsi on 24 huolella suunniteltua haastetta neljän pajaikkunan takana. Kerää lehtimerkkejä, tutustu hedelmätietokirjaan ja nauti rauhallisista, lyhyistä äänitehosteista lajitellessasi hedelmiä niiden matkalla putkien läpi.

name: Pomi: Period & Cycle Food
description:
Pomi tells you what to eat today, for where you are in your cycle.

Tell it when your last period started, how long your cycle runs and what bothers you most: cramps, bloating, cravings, mood swings, breakouts, low energy, headaches or poor sleep. Each morning you get a plate of nine foods for your phase and those symptoms.

TODAY'S PLATE
• Nine foods picked for your phase: menstrual, follicular, ovulation or luteal
• Tap any food to see why it can help, in one line
• A short list of what to go easy on today
• Shuffle for new ideas

GROCERIES
• One list for the next seven plates, so you shop once a week

LOG
• Log how you feel in two taps, and the next plate takes it into account
• Tap "My period started today" and every phase moves with you

REMINDERS
• Your plate at the time you choose
• A heads-up two days before your period is due

Pomi leaves out foods that break your rules: vegetarian, vegan, dairy-free or gluten-free. No account and no ads. Your answers stay on your iPhone.

Pomi gives general food ideas, not medical advice. Talk to a doctor about pain or symptoms that worry you.

POMI PREMIUM
Pomi needs a subscription. Start with 3 days free, then $39.99 a year, or choose $6.99 a week. We send a reminder before the trial ends.

Pomi Premium is an auto-renewing subscription. Payment is charged to your Apple ID when you confirm the purchase, or when the free trial ends. The subscription renews automatically unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the period ends. Manage or cancel in Settings › your name › Subscriptions.

Terms of use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: PoolChalker
description:
PoolChalker is the home of your pool league - every fixture, every frame, every table, right in your pocket.

Whether you're a captain, a player or a die-hard follower of your local league, PoolChalker keeps you on top of the action all season long.

KEEP UP WITH RESULTS
See league and cup results as they come in. No more waiting for the noticeboard or chasing group chats - scores are there the moment they're entered.

NEVER MISS A FIXTURE
Check who you're playing, when and where. Your full league and cup schedule is always up to date.

LIVE LEAGUE TABLES
Watch the table move as results land. See exactly where your team stands and what you need to climb.

CUP COMPETITIONS
Follow cup draws and knockout rounds from the first round to the final.

ENTER SCORES IN SECONDS
Chalk up match scores straight from the table with a quick, simple score entry built for match night.

BUILT FOR LEAGUES
PoolChalker is made for the people who run and play in pool leagues - fast, clear and free of clutter.

Rack 'em up. Chalk it with PoolChalker.

name: Popcorn Rush: Color Tango
description:
Popcorn Rush is a calm color match puzzle: tap a numbered scoop and it rides over the popcorn, taking every top piece of its color. No timers, no lives: a cozy popcorn puzzle at your own pace.

A pot full of color popcorn, with columns of numbered scoops below it. Fill the scoops and clear the pot before the next row pushes a stack past the lid. It is a color match and color sort puzzle at heart: plan two moves ahead, use the three scoop places well, and watch a full scoop leave.

In this popcorn game every puzzle is a show. Win a show and its poster goes up on your poster wall; fill a hall of ten and open the next one. 40 shows, every one checked by a solver, so every show can be won. New pieces join as you go: pop kernels that shake the stacks, wild pops, big kernels, mystery kernels and sticky caramel.

• Play this popcorn puzzle offline, anywhere.
• All 40 shows are free. After a loss you can watch a short ad to continue, if you like.
• No timers, no lives, no energy. Pause any time: there is no clock.
• Hold a scoop to preview its ride before you tap.
• 2x speed is free. Sound and vibration each have their own switch; the "Colour symbols" switch helps when colors are hard to tell apart.

Every show is free. A short ad can show between shows now and then; one payment, "Remove ads", turns every ad off for life and makes Continue free — no subscription. Restore is always in Settings.

Optional play statistics help us improve the game; you choose at first launch.

A relaxing, satisfying popcorn game of brain and logic for anyone who likes a color match puzzle, color sort and cozy cinema nights.

name: Postpicnic: Auto Cross Post
description:
Postpicnic shares your videos between Instagram and TikTok, in either direction.

Choose a source. Eligible new videos publish to the other platform with the original video and caption.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Share from Instagram to TikTok, or from TikTok to Instagram
• Keep the original video and caption
• Start and pause discovery in your workspace
• Sign in with your email

MEMBERSHIP
Subscribe in the app to a monthly or yearly plan. The yearly plan includes a 7-day trial. Both directions share 150 source videos per month. If you already subscribed on the website, sign in with that email.

PRIVACY
Privacy Policy: https://postpicnic.com/privacy
Support: support@postpicnic.com

name: PowerNap – Wake Guard
description:
A power nap that can't turn into a three-hour sleep.

PowerNap uses your Apple Watch to notice when you actually fall asleep, then starts your nap timer from that moment. When it's time, your wrist taps you awake, gently at first, then stronger, and it doesn't stop until you stand up and take a few steps. If you sleep through it, your iPhone rings too, even in Silent mode or a Focus.

WHY IT WORKS
• Sleep detection: your heart rate and a still wrist tell PowerNap when you've drifted off, so a 20-minute nap is 20 minutes of sleep.
• Stand up to stop: no snoozing back to sleep. Take a few steps and the alarm ends.
• iPhone backup: a real system alarm that rings through Silent mode and Focus if you don't get up.
• Still awake? If you haven't fallen asleep after 15 minutes, PowerNap wakes you anyway, so a nap never eats your afternoon.

SEE YOUR NAPS
• A nap report after every nap: how long it took to fall asleep, how long you slept, and your heart rate.
• A moon-calendar Journal: each moon shows how you felt, and its ring shows how much of your nap you slept.
• Live Activity on your Lock Screen while you nap.
• A living night sky: drifting stars, the odd shooting star, and, if you like, your local weather (rain, snow, clouds) on the Nap screen.

POWERNAP PLUS
• Trends: find the nap length that leaves you sharpest and see how much afternoon you get back.
• Full history: every nap, forever. Free shows the last 7 days.
• Custom wake-ups: gentle or strong haptics.
The wake guard (sleep detection, stand-up-to-stop and the iPhone backup) is always free.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your heart rate and naps stay on your devices and in your own iCloud. No account, no ads, and health data never leaves your devices.

PowerNap Plus is $2.99 a month or $14.99 a year (prices vary by country), with a 7-day free trial on the yearly plan. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage or cancel in Settings › [your name] › Subscriptions.

Terms of Use: https://powernap.appsinfoway.com/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://powernap.appsinfoway.com/privacy/

PowerNap is not a medical device and does not diagnose or treat any condition.

name: PowerShell Practice
description:
PowerShell Practice is a pocket reference and quiz app for people who are new to PowerShell or want to refresh the commands they use every day.

LEARN 38 COMMON CMDLETS
• Seven categories: getting help, the file system, the pipeline, processes and services, output and formatting, variables and content, and networking
• Search by cmdlet name, alias, or task
• Each cmdlet has a summary, its syntax, its aliases, worked examples, and tips
• Copy any command to the clipboard
• Mark cmdlets as learned

PRACTICE WITH QUIZZES
• Multiple choice, or type the command yourself (aliases count)
• 5 to 30 questions per quiz
• Quiz on every cmdlet, the ones you have not learned, the ones that need review, or a single category
• See the right answer and an example after each question
• Finish with your score and a list of the cmdlets you missed

PRACTICE PIPELINES
• Pick the Pipeline: choose the pipeline that does a task
• Build the Pipeline: tap cmdlets into order, with one decoy to leave out
• 14 pipeline tasks, 10 per round, with an explanation after each answer

TRACK YOUR PROGRESS
• Cmdlets learned, overall and by category
• Quiz accuracy and a Needs Review list of the cmdlets you miss most
• Reset all progress when you want to start over

LOCAL AND SIMPLE
No account, advertising, or analytics. The app does not connect to the internet and asks for no permissions. Answers are checked on your device; the app does not run PowerShell commands or connect to a computer. Works on iPhone and iPad.

Your learned cmdlets and quiz history stay on your device. They can be included in iCloud Backup or a computer backup, if you have backups turned on.

Found a bug or want a feature? Send feedback from the envelope button on the Learn tab.

PowerShell Practice is free, with no in-app purchases.

PowerShell is a trademark of Microsoft Corporation. This app is an independent study aid and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Microsoft.

name: Precision Connect Community
description:
Precision Connect is the Precision community for people who enjoy cars and electric mobility.

Share experiences, ask questions and join conversations about the cars that are part of your everyday life.

• Publish text, photos, GIFs and video links.
• Reply to posts, leave likes and repost what you want to share.
• Follow other members and browse the community feed or the people you follow.
• Search for posts, profiles and topics.
• Join forum discussions and create polls to hear from the community.
• Share moments in Stories and personalize your profile.
• Save posts to bookmarks and keep up with replies and mentions.

Community tools let you report content and block profiles. Sign in with your Precision account, Google or Apple. Account deletion can be requested in the app settings.

A community by Precision Autotechnik AG.

name: Premier Copacabana Hotel
description:
App oficial do Premier Copacabana Hotel para os hóspedes.

Durante a estadia, use o app para:
• Ver as mensagens da recepção e os avisos do hotel
• Consultar informações do hotel, cardápios e horários
• Agendar serviços e acompanhar seus agendamentos
• Fazer solicitações e registrar ocorrências no apartamento
• Programar o despertador
• Ver a previsão do tempo, os voos dos aeroportos e dicas de turismo no Rio de Janeiro
• Falar com a recepção por ligação dentro do app

Para entrar, informe o número do apartamento e o nome do hóspede registrado na reserva. Sem entrar, você ainda consulta as informações gerais do hotel.

name: PrintWIMP: Where's My Print?
description:
Where's my print? Right here.

PrintWIMP connects you to your print, sign or apparel shop. If your shop runs on PrintWIMP, this app is where you see everything about your orders.

APPROVE PROOFS IN A TAP
When your artwork is ready, it lands in the app. Check the spelling, the colors and the size, then approve it or ask for changes with a note. Production starts the moment you approve.

FOLLOW EVERY ORDER
See where each job stands: design, in production, ready for pickup, or shipped with live carrier tracking. Turn on notifications and hear the moment your order is ready.

QUOTES AND REORDERS
Approve or decline quotes from your phone. Reorder a past job in two taps, exactly as last time, or tell the shop what to change and they'll send a new quote.

CHAT WITH YOUR SHOP
A real conversation with the people making your job: messages, photos and voice notes. Messages can be translated, so you and your shop can each write in your own language.

ORDER FROM YOUR SHOP'S CATALOG
When your shop turns it on, order from their catalog, request a quote, or check out by card through Stripe's secure page.

CONNECTING TO YOUR SHOP
Your shop gives you a connect code. Enter it when you create your account and your quotes, orders and proofs link up. No code yet? Ask your shop if they're on PrintWIMP. You can connect to more than one shop with the same login.

On iPad, the app spreads out to use the big screen, upright or sideways.

PrintWIMP is made for the customers of independent print and sign shops: banners, signs, vehicle wraps, shirts, business cards and everything else they make.

name: Prism Gambit
description:
Every turn changes the whole window.

Prism Gambit is a thoughtful spatial card puzzle set in a luminous stained-glass workshop. Rotate five card bands, mirror their geometry, and align vertical poker hands. Cast the marked apertures to bring a new window to life.

- Explore 24 progressive windows across four atmospheric chapters.
- Solve a fresh daily arrangement and discover unlimited atelier puzzles.
- Balance sealed bands, limited turns and precious refraction lenses.
- Inspect real poker hands before you commit each cast.
- Learn with legal reference hints and a complete hand-ranking guide.
- Collect four original glass emblems and track chapter stars.
- Review your actual casts in a persistent local journal.
- Resume your current puzzle automatically.

No account. Just you, the geometry, and the light.

name: Privault Password Vault
description:
Privault is a fully offline password manager. Your passwords are stored only in the device sandbox, encrypted with AES-256-GCM and never uploaded to any server — the app requests no network access at all.

KEY FEATURES
• Password vault: accounts, passwords, URLs and notes in one place, with custom groups and archiving
• Authenticator (TOTP): built-in one-time password engine — login password and 6-digit code side by side with live countdown; scan a QR code to add
• Password generator: custom length and character rules, strong random passwords in one tap
• Security audit: automatic checks for weak, reused and stale passwords
• Master password: optional, PBKDF2 with 210,000 iterations; fully encrypted export and backup
• iCloud backup: app-level encrypted backups, keeps the latest 5 versions
• Quick identities: preset emails and usernames for fast entry
• Brand icons: 3,400+ brand icons matched automatically

PRIVACY PROMISE
Zero network, zero tracking, zero collection. Face ID / passcode unlock is local verification only — biometric data never leaves your device.

Available on iPhone, iPad and Mac with dark mode and 11 languages.

Your data belongs to you. Privault — your private vault.

name: Proceeds - Store Analytics
description:
Proceeds shows your App Store numbers at a glance: proceeds, sales, downloads, in-app purchases and subscriptions for all your apps, with widgets for the Home Screen and the Lock Screen.

YOUR KEY STAYS ON YOUR IPHONE
Connect with your own App Store Connect API key. Proceeds stores it in your iPhone's Keychain and talks directly to Apple. There is no account, no server and no tracking. We never see your sales.

EVERYTHING THAT MATTERS
- Proceeds and sales converted to your currency, with daily, 7-day, 30-day, 90-day and 1-year views
- Change against the previous period at a glance
- Top apps and top countries
- Per-app detail: in-app purchases, subscriptions, updates and redownloads
- Subscriptions: MRR, active subscribers, trials and churn
- Every app across several developer accounts

WIDGETS
Small, medium and large Home Screen widgets and three Lock Screen widgets. Pick the account, the app and the metric. Widgets refresh by themselves when Apple publishes a new report.

TRY IT FIRST
Explore every feature with demo data before you connect anything.

PROCEEDS PRO
The free version covers one account, the last 30 days and the small widgets. Proceeds Pro unlocks unlimited accounts, a full year of history, every widget with any metric, and complete lists. Pro is a yearly subscription with a 7-day free trial.

Good to know: Apple publishes daily reports the following day, so Proceeds always shows the latest day Apple has released. Currency totals are estimates based on daily exchange rates.

Terms of use: https://sensorevolve.github.io/proceeds-legal/terms/
Privacy policy: https://sensorevolve.github.io/proceeds-legal/privacy/

Proceeds is not affiliated with or endorsed by Apple.

name: Proseproof: Writing Review
description:
```
Proseproof helps you review your own writing before you hand it in. Paste a draft, import a document or scan a printed page, then choose the review you need. Every writing tool runs on your iPhone: your text is never uploaded.

FIVE FREE REVIEW TOOLS

Meaning Guard
Compare an original with a rewrite and see the details that changed: numbers, names, quotations and careful words like "may" or "not". Catch the edits that quietly change what you meant.

Feedback Tracker
Keep each teacher or peer comment next to the passage it refers to. Tick comments off as you revise and see what is still open.

Citation Audit
Check author–year citations against your reference list. Spot entries that may be missing or unused.

Structure Scan
See paragraphs that run long or short and openings that repeat, so your draft reads smoothly.

Read-Aloud Review
Listen to your draft and tap the sentences you want to fix. Hearing your writing is the fastest way to find awkward lines.

MORE TOOLS

Similarity compares your draft with the readings, notes and past work you add to your own library. It does not search the internet.

Summarizer turns long readings into a short summary, key points or study notes.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN

- Your drafts, results and library stay on your iPhone.
- The five review tools work offline.
- No account, no sign-up and no ads.
- Usage analytics are off unless you turn them on.

FREE AND PRO

The five review tools are free. The free plan also includes 5 Similarity or Summarizer runs a day, up to 500 words each. Proseproof Pro adds unlimited runs, documents up to 15,000 words, every summary format, an unlimited library, full history and PDF reports.

Proseproof helps you check and improve your own work. Review notes are suggestions, not a judgment of authorship or accuracy. Follow your school's rules on sources and AI tools.

THROW REAL PUNCHES

name: Python Coding for AI: Pyrolo
description:
Python Coding for AI is a beginner-friendly course that teaches you to write Python by building the small programs that sit underneath AI: cleaning data, drawing a chart, finding the nearest example, and teaching a model by adjusting one number.

HOW IT WORKS
- Read a short idea, run it, and step through it line by line while boxes show every variable changing.
- See the real situation first (a pizza shared by friends, a cashier's till, a lost bus stop), play with a simulation, and then see the equation that describes what you just watched.
- Write your own programs in a built-in code editor. Every program is checked by tests that run right on your phone, with clear messages when something is off.
- Finish with short, optional checks. Wrong answers come back once with an explanation, never a penalty.

WHAT YOU BUILD
- Programs with variables, loops, lists and dictionaries
- A playlist sorter, a quiz scorer and a nearest-bus-stop finder
- A data cleaner that reads CSV files and handles missing values honestly
- Bar, line and scatter charts drawn from your own lists
- A nearest-neighbour classifier and a one-knob learning loop
- A mini project that predicts rain from tiny weather data

9 UNITS, 31 CODING TASKS, 166 QUESTIONS
Variables and types, conditionals and loops, lists and dictionaries, functions and testing, reading and cleaning data, plotting, a first classifier, learning by adjusting a number, and a mini project with good habits.

MADE FOR LEARNING
- Runs offline. No account, no chat window, nothing sent anywhere.
- Own Python-subset interpreter inside the app; every output and answer is computed by running the code.
- Text size from 85% to 200%, VoiceOver and TalkBack labels, and icons plus words so colour is never the only clue.
- Sources from university courses and the official Python tutorial open in an in-app window.

FREE WITH ADS
Pyrolo is free with ads shown only at natural breaks, never while you are coding or answering. An optional monthly subscription removes ads (7-day free trial, cancel anytime in your account settings; cancellation takes effect at the next billing cycle). If you are under 18, ads are non-personalised and teen-appropriate.

Not expert reviewed. Content as of 2026-11-17. Python is a trademark of the Python Software Foundation; this app is not affiliated with or endorsed by it.

name: QRGenny
description:
QRGenny makes QR codes, reads them and puts them on business cards. All of it happens on your iPhone. There is no account and no sign-in, and QRGenny sends nothing you type anywhere.

YOUR QR CODE
The first screen is your code. Tap it to set it up, and Save or Share it with the two buttons right under it. Give it a name so you know which one it is.

CREATE
Make a QR code for:
• a website
• an email address, or an email with the subject and message already written
• a phone number
• an iMessage
• a Wi-Fi network, so guests can join by scanning instead of typing the password
• any plain text

SCAN
Point the camera at a QR code to read it. QRGenny also reads Aztec, Data Matrix, PDF417, EAN-13 and Code 128 codes. Open a scanned link, email address or phone number with one tap, or join a scanned Wi-Fi network.

SCAN DOCUMENTS
Switch the scanner to Documents to photograph paper pages. They are saved as a PDF on your iPhone.

STYLE
Choose colours, shapes, eye styles and a frame, and put the QRGenny G in the centre if you like. QRGenny checks whether the styled code still scans.

BUSINESS CARDS
Put your name, title, company, phone, email and website on a card with a QR code that adds you to a contact list in one scan. Choose from 12 card styles and add your logo from Photos.

BATCH FROM CSV
Pick a spreadsheet saved as CSV. QRGenny makes one code per row, up to hundreds at a time, and gives them to you as PNG images.

TICKETS
When a code you scan looks like a ticket, such as a boarding pass, QRGenny also files it under Tickets. You can add a picture of a ticket from Photos too.

YOUR STUFF
Codes, cards, tickets and documents are kept in one place with search. History can be switched off, and you can clear it at any time.

SAVE AND SHARE
Save codes and cards to Photos, share them, copy them, or export them to Files at 1024, 2048 or 4096 pixels.

FREE AND PRO
Scanning is free, and so is making codes on screen. Saving, sharing, copying and exporting are free for your first QR code and your first business card. QRGenny Pro removes those limits and adds Batch from CSV export.

QRGenny Pro is a one-time purchase: $2.99 in the United States (the price varies by country). You pay once. Nothing renews. Restore Purchases brings Pro back on another iPhone that uses the same Apple Account.

name: QueryDeck
description:
QUERYDECK — YOUR DATA, YOUR ANSWERS, YOUR DEVICE

QueryDeck turns any SQLite database or CSV file into clear answers, entirely on your iPhone or iPad. Import a file, explore its tables, write SQL, and turn results into charts — all offline. No account, no cloud, no data collection. Your files never leave your device.

WHAT YOU CAN DO

• Import with ease
Bring in .sqlite, .db, .sqlite3, or .csv files from the Files app, Mail, or AirDrop. QueryDeck detects CSV delimiters, quotes, encodings, and column types automatically.

• Explore any database
Browse every table and view with row counts at a glance. Sort by column, filter by keyword, page through rows, inspect columns, indexes, foreign keys, and view definitions.

• Write real SQL, comfortably
A syntax-highlighted editor with multi-statement support, result grids, affected-row counts, and elapsed time. Save your favorite queries into folders and run them again in a tap. Destructive statements ask for confirmation.

• See your data
Build bar, line, pie, and scatter charts from any query result by picking a category and a value column. Export charts as PNG, or export results as CSV, JSON, or SQL.

• Ask in plain English
On supported devices, describe what you want and QueryDeck turns it into SQL using on-device Foundation Models. Nothing is sent off-device. On older systems it falls back gracefully to manual SQL.

• Keep it private
Protect files with Face ID / Touch ID. QueryDeck has no network access, no analytics, no ads, and no in-app purchases.

BUILT FOR

Data explorers, developers and testers inspecting app databases, analysts reviewing datasets on iPad, and students learning SQL.

PRIVACY FIRST

QueryDeck works 100% offline. There are no servers, no accounts, and no third-party SDKs. Your databases and queries stay in your app's sandbox. The App Store privacy label is "Data Not Collected."

SUPPORT

Questions or feedback? Email tiansuqun@outlook.com

name: QueryReef - SQLite Read Desk
description:
Explore a SQLite backup from your iPhone. QueryReef imports a separate local copy, opens it read-only and helps you understand its tables, views and query results.

Browse tables in pages of 50 rows, choose an ascending sort column and open a row to inspect each value. NULL, empty text, integers, real numbers and BLOB previews are shown distinctly. Inspect declared columns, primary keys and indexes, or export a PDF schema summary.

Write one read-only SQL statement, including a SELECT or read-only CTE. Save named queries for reuse without executing them automatically. Write operations, attachments, unsafe PRAGMAs and extension-loading calls are blocked. A bounded execution budget stops overly expensive statements.

View up to 500 result rows, with a clear truncation notice. Export the displayed rows as CSV, including headers for empty results. Spreadsheet formula-like values receive a protective text prefix; BLOB exports contain the displayed preview, not the complete binary object.

Accepts standalone checkpointed SQLite 3 backups up to 40 MiB. Encrypted databases and WAL sidecars are not imported. SQL is limited to 20,000 bytes, result columns to 64 and individual values to 1 MiB. A labeled sample database is included. No app account, advertising SDK or analytics SDK.

name: Quietext: Spam Text Blocker
description:
Spam and scam texts from strangers, sorted out of sight.

Quietext uses the message filter built into iOS to sort texts from unknown senders into Junk, Promotions and Transactions. Your contacts always get through. There is no account to create and no phone number to verify.

NOT SURE ABOUT A TEXT? RUN A SCAM CHECK
Paste or share any message, link or phone number, or a screenshot of one. Quietext gives you a clear answer (looks safe, be careful, or likely scam) and lists the red flags it found, such as a fake delivery fee, an unpaid toll, a prize you never entered, a look-alike link or someone asking for your code. It works for messages the filter can't see too: texts from people you know, chat apps, email and links from anywhere. On devices with Apple Intelligence (iOS 26 or later), it also explains the answer in plain words.

YOUR RULES, IN PLAIN WORDS
• Block or allow by keyword or sender
• Built-in rule packs, free and on from install: delivery and toll scams, prize and gift card scams, crypto and investment, loans, betting and casino, and US political fundraising (off until you turn it on)
• A rule tester that shows which folder a sample message lands in and which rule caught it
• An allow list, so your bank, doctor and deliveries always reach you

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Messages are checked on your device. The filter has no network connection, so your messages never reach us. Scam Check runs on your device too; our server only counts your free checks. No sign-up, and Quietext never asks for your contacts.

WHAT IOS LETS A FILTER DO
• iOS only passes SMS and MMS messages from senders who aren't in your contacts to filter apps. Your contacts are never filtered.
• Only one filter app can be on at a time.
• iOS doesn't tell apps how many messages were filtered, so Quietext shows no counts. Use the rule tester to see where a message would go.

EXTRAS
• Share sheet: check a message from any app without copying it
• Home Screen widgets for your filter status and your last check
• Siri and Shortcuts: start a Scam Check by voice

SET UP IN A MINUTE
iOS 26: open Messages, tap Filters, then Manage Filtering, then Text Message Filter, and turn on Quietext.
iOS 18: open Settings, then Apps, Messages, Unknown & Spam, and choose Quietext.
The app walks you through it.

FREE AND PRO
Free, for good: the filter with every built-in rule pack, 1 Scam Check a week and 1 custom rule.
Quietext Pro: unlimited Scam Checks, unlimited custom rules and allow list, rules by language, and the extended spam list with extra patterns.

name: Quiz des Départements
description:
Quiz des Départements français — Métropole & Outre-mer

Connaissez-vous vraiment les 101 départements de France ? Numéros, noms, préfectures, position sur la carte… Mettez vos connaissances à l'épreuve avec un quiz complet, pensé aussi bien pour réviser tranquillement que pour se lancer des défis.

RÉVISER À VOTRE RYTHME
• La liste complète des départements : numéro, nom et préfecture (Métropole et Outre-mer).
• Une carte interactive : touchez un département pour retrouver aussitôt son nom, son numéro et sa préfecture. Les départements d'Outre-mer (Guadeloupe, Martinique, Guyane, La Réunion, Mayotte) sont intégrés directement sur la carte.

LE PARCOURS D'ENTRAÎNEMENT
Dix étapes, de la plus visuelle à la plus exigeante, chacune sur un exercice différent, notamment :
- Localiser le département sur la carte (avec ou sans propositions),
- Retrouver le département à partir de son numéro (avec ou sans propositions), - Retrouver le numéro à partir du nom du département (avec ou sans propositions),
- Retrouver la préfecture à partir du département (avec ou sans propositions),
- Retrouver le département à partir de la préfecture (avec ou sans propositions).
Chaque étape compte 10 questions. Rejouez-la autant de fois que vous le souhaitez pour la porter à 100 % et progresser sur le parcours.

À VOUS DE JOUER
Des manches de 15 questions mélangeant les catégories, en trois niveaux :
• Débutant — questions guidées, toujours avec des propositions.
• Intermédiaire — un mélange de propositions et de repérage sur la carte.
• Expert — sans propositions : à vous de tout retrouver, à l'écrit ou sur la carte.
Votre meilleur score est conservé pour chaque niveau et se partage sur les réseaux sociaux.

LE DÉFI ULTIME
Un mode sans fin : enchaînez le plus de bonnes réponses possibles, toutes catégories confondues. À la première erreur, la série s'arrête et vous perdez un point d'énergie (vous en avez 5). L'énergie se recharge entièrement au bout de 2 h, ou tout de suite en regardant une courte vidéo.
Votre meilleure série est mémorisée — saurez-vous la battre ?

PENSÉ POUR TOUT LE MONDE
• Entièrement en français, sans compte ni inscription.
• Fautes de frappe tolérées sur les réponses écrites.
• Thème clair ou sombre et grande police pour l'accessibilité.
• Fonctionne hors connexion : tout le contenu est embarqué.
• Réglages de confidentialité accessibles à tout moment.

Que vous soyez élève, étudiant, passionné de géographie ou simplement curieux, Quiz des Départements est le compagnon idéal pour (re)découvrir la carte de France en s'amusant.

Bonne chance, et à vous de jouer !

name: Quiz des vaches
description:
Savez-vous reconnaître une Charolaise d'une Limousine, une Montbéliarde d'une Simmental ?

Quiz des vaches est un jeu d'entraînement pour apprendre, photo après photo, à identifier 20 races de vaches françaises : laitières, à viande et mixtes.

COMMENT ÇA MARCHE
• Une photo, quatre races proposées. Les mauvaises réponses sont souvent des races qui se ressemblent : c'est voulu, c'est comme ça qu'on apprend.
• Après chaque réponse, un indice explique ce qui distingue la race : robe, cornes, silhouette, muqueuses…
• Les races ratées reviennent plus tard dans la série, jusqu'à ce que vous les reconnaissiez.
• Séries de 10 questions, à refaire autant de fois que vous voulez.
• Une loupe pour regarder les détails de la photo.
• Une progression par race pour voir ce que vous maîtrisez et ce qu'il reste à apprendre.

20 RACES FRANÇAISES
Prim'Holstein, Montbéliarde, Charolaise, Limousine, Blonde d'Aquitaine, Salers, Aubrac et bien d'autres : chaque fiche donne la robe, le berceau de la race, quelques repères d'élevage et une anecdote.

DES PHOTOS RÉELLES, DES AUTEURS CRÉDITÉS
Les 322 photos proviennent de Wikimedia Commons et d'autres sources sous licence libre (Creative Commons BY, BY-SA, CC0 ou domaine public). L'auteur et la licence de chaque photo sont indiqués dans l'écran Crédits photos.

SIMPLE ET DISCRET
• Fonctionne entièrement hors ligne.
• Aucun compte à créer.
• Aucune publicité, aucun achat intégré.
• Aucune donnée collectée : votre progression reste sur votre iPhone, et vous pouvez l'effacer à tout moment depuis l'application.

Pour les curieux de la campagne, les promeneurs, les familles, les élèves en filière agricole ou tous ceux qui, devant un pré, aimeraient pouvoir dire le nom des vaches qu'ils voient.

name: Qult Pop: Culture Crossword
description:
James Cameron's ocean liner, boy wizard with glasses, queen of pop: how many letters?

Qult Pop is a pop culture crossword app. Cult movies, binge-worthy shows, hit songs, masterpieces, comic book heroes, memes and video games: everything we share, in puzzles.

180 PUZZLES, THREE LEVELS
• Easy, medium or hard, played side by side.
• Six themes: movies, TV shows, music, art and comics, the internet, video games. The first puzzle of every theme is open from the start: begin with your favorite.
• Never the same answer twice within a level.
• Every finished puzzle raises your Level.

ONE LOOK PER THEME

• Art and comics: pop art and halftone dots.

MADE TO FEEL GOOD

FREE, OR PREMIUM
The free version shows ads and gives 5 letters and 2 words to reveal per puzzle; a video refills them. Qult Premium, a one-time purchase with no subscription, removes all ads and makes hints unlimited.

ALSO FROM QULT
Qult Gaming: the video game crossword, from 80s arcades to 2026.

Qult Pop is not affiliated with any of the studios, labels, platforms, artists or brands mentioned in the puzzles.
