name: QuoinSpace
description:
Prepare the right physical spacers for every line of a letterpress page.

QuoinSpace helps print studios, independent printers and typography classes turn measured stock into a practical preparation plan. It checks individual spaces and allocates shared inventory across the whole page.

A CLEAR WORKSHOP FLOW

1. Register your materials
Record each spacer's measured width, quantity, name, notes and compatible group. Keep physically different groups separate, and group materials together only when you know they can be mixed.

2. Measure your page
Create a project and page, set the column width, and enter the measured width of the fixed text and materials for each line. Exclude the adjustable spacers you are planning. Identification text labels a line; your measurements determine its length.

3. Define every adjustable space
Add spaces between fixed sections or at the end of a line. Give each its own minimum, maximum and optional preferred width. Inspect combinations such as 3 mm x 2 or 2 mm x 3, with the actual piece counts recorded at each position.

4. Allocate the whole page
Search for combinations that satisfy line widths, space ranges, compatibility rules and shared stock. Reserved materials on other pages are accounted for. The default comparison order prioritizes spacing preferences, then fewer pieces. Review a candidate before applying it. Searches can be cancelled; feasible candidates stay distinct from verified optimal results.

5. Protect finished work
Lock an individual space or an entire line to retain its exact materials. Adjust the column width with the tray's sliding stop, numeric entry or step buttons. Width changes identify affected lines and conflicts with locked work.

6. Compare and prepare
Use the picking matrix and demand-versus-stock chart to check quantities. Compare saved plans with their original stock and rule snapshots. Try hypothetical extra stock separately from physical inventory. Results distinguish widths that cannot combine, insufficient stock, lock conflicts and an unfinished search.

7. Take the plan to the bench
Preview and share a line-by-line PDF or CSV picking list, including space combinations, line totals, locks and unresolved items. A material summary helps with collecting pieces. Import measured rows from CSV, search and duplicate projects, archive work, and export or restore a full backup.

BUILT FOR THE WORKSHOP

- A proportional composing tray shows fixed material, adjustable spaces and physical spacer pieces.
- Exact decimal millimetres support up to six decimal places. Alignment tolerance starts at zero.
- An interactive teaching example demonstrates the trade-offs of shared inventory without changing your working stock.
- Core calculation and local saving work offline. No account is required.
- Feedback drafts are saved locally and shared only when you choose.
- English and Simplified Chinese interfaces are included.

name: Quotes-Up
description:
Quotes-Up is the companion app for Florida Mail & Print customers. Every mailing we send for you carries a QR code. When someone scans it, Quotes-Up shows you who it was, which mailing brought them in, and what they want, so you can follow up while they are still interested.

YOUR DASHBOARD
Every widget is live. See this month's scans, new conversations, upcoming appointments and where your latest mailing stands at a glance. Make it yours: move and resize widgets, gather them into folders, and choose your colors and backgrounds.

QR CODE ACTIVITY
See each scan with the person, the time, the mailing and the QR code they used, as a list or on a map. Open a person to see what they chose on their QR page, how they prefer to be contacted, and their earlier responses, then call, text, email or save them to your contacts in a tap.

PROSPECT CHAT
Visitors can start a conversation right from their QR page. The assistant can answer the first questions for you, and you can take over at any time to reply yourself, even right from the notification. With Apple Intelligence, each chat gets a one-line summary and a suggested reply, and visitors' messages can be translated, all on your device.

APPOINTMENTS
Set your hours once. Visitors ask for a time that suits you, and you confirm or change it in a tap. Confirmed appointments can go straight onto your calendar, and the next one counts down on your Lock Screen.

MAILINGS
Every mailing from Florida Mail & Print's own records shows where it stands and the scans it brought in.

PEOPLE ON YOUR ACCOUNT
Add the people in your office and choose what each person can see and do. Replies and changes show who made them.

WIDGETS, SIRI AND APPLE WATCH
Put your figures on your Home Screen, Lock Screen, StandBy and Control Center, ask Siri "How many scans in Quotes-Up?", find people in Spotlight, and check everything on Apple Watch. Your Dashboard's look follows you to your iPad and Mac through iCloud.

SECURE AND SIMPLE
You stay signed in until you sign out. To sign back in, use Face ID or Touch ID, a passkey, or Sign in with Apple. Each person chooses whether we email them news and offers.

Quotes-Up needs a Florida Mail & Print customer account. Not a customer yet? Tap "Explore with sample data" to try every screen with invented data.

name: Radar Certificate Study Guide
description:
Radar Certificate Study Guide is an unofficial, independent study aid for leisure and small-craft skippers who want to understand marine radar and use it well.

LEARN
Short, illustrated lessons in plain English, in seven modules:
• How radar works: pulses, range and bearing, beamwidth, discrimination and the radar horizon
• Controls and set-up: gain, sea and rain clutter, tuning, range scales, EBL and VRM
• Plotting and collision avoidance: relative and true motion, the plotting triangle, CPA and TCPA, and checking your avoiding action
• Interpretation and false echoes: what shows well and what doesn't, shadow sectors, side lobes, multiple, indirect and second-trace echoes
• Radar pilotage: head-up, north-up and course-up displays, fixing by radar ranges, clearing ranges and parallel indexing
• The collision regulations in restricted visibility: lookout, safe speed, risk of collision, conduct and sound signals, summarised in plain English
• A short overview of AIS and target tracking, and why neither replaces a proper lookout or your own plotting

Diagrams are drawn for each topic, and the app remembers where you left off.

PLOT
A relative-motion plotting trainer generates a new exercise each time: your course and speed, and two radar observations of another vessel. Work out the closest point of approach and when it happens, then check your answer. The app draws the full plotting triangle, the relative track and the CPA, and gives the other vessel's true course and speed. Hints take you through the method step by step, and you can tap the display to see it full screen. Choose easy, standard or hard exercises, a 6 or 12 minute interval, and a 6 or 12 mile range scale.

QUIZ
Multiple-choice questions for every module, plus mixed exam practice drawn from all of them. Every answer is explained, with a link back to the lesson, and your results are kept so you can see how you are improving.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account or sign-in
• No analytics, tracking or advertising
• No network connections: everything works offline
• Your progress stays on your device

OPEN SOURCE
The source code and all the study content are public, so anyone can check how the app works or suggest a correction.

Accessible: supports VoiceOver and the largest text sizes.

IMPORTANT
Radar Certificate Study Guide (Unofficial) is an independent study aid. It is not affiliated with, endorsed, sponsored or approved by, or otherwise associated with any training provider, certifying body, government agency or maritime organisation. It is not a course, does not lead to any qualification or certificate, and is not a substitute for approved training. Not for use in navigation.

name: Radar Era: Minimap
description:
Your real streets, drawn as the radar from the open-world games you grew up with. Pick an era, put it on your lock screen, and every drive feels like a mission.

Radar Era turns the map around you into a game-style minimap: the corner radar from the classic open-world crime games, rebuilt from real map data so it shows YOUR city, your block, your route home. The arrow turns as you turn. The streets scroll as you drive. Set a destination and the route lights up just like the GPS line in the games.

SIX RADAR ERAS
• Rust City: the gritty round radar where it all started
• Miami Glow: pastel neon from the beach-city era
• West Coast: the sun-baked west coast look
• Steel Borough: the grey, gritty big-city radar

ON YOUR LOCK SCREEN
The radar lives where you actually look. Tap LOCK and Radar Era runs as a Live Activity on your lock screen and Dynamic Island, so you see the streets, the arrow and your next turn without unlocking your phone. Add the widgets to your home screen too.

REAL DIRECTIONS, GAME LOOK
Search any place, or save Home and Work for one-tap routes. Radar Era plans the route, re-routes if you miss a turn, shows the distance to your next turn and plays an era sound when you set a destination and when you arrive.

BUILT FOR DRIVING
• Big, readable radar that works at a glance
• Speed and heading on screen
• Miles or kilometres
• Sounds on or off
• Recent places and saved Home / Work
• Real OpenStreetMap streets, parks, water and coastlines

Perfect for road trips, night drives, your daily commute, filming driving content, or just making the city feel like a game.

RADAR ERA PRO
Sun State is free forever. Radar Era PRO unlocks every era.

name: Radio Calabria
description:
Radio Calabria International is the radio of Calabria for the whole world. Wherever you are, at any hour, take the music of home with you.

name: RailSweep: Curve Clearance
description:
Plan clearance around a curved section of model railway before installing platforms, tunnels, or scenery. Measure a car's body and truck pivot spacing, select the curve radius and track gauge, and see how the inner side and outer corners sweep past the track centerline. Enter your actual obstruction offsets to check both sides. Apply a margin, compare a proposed radius with the current curve, or save several cars and curves to your local bench. Share a measurement card with the values needed for an on-layout check.

Designed for model railways. Estimates assume a rigid rectangular body, symmetric pivot placement and a constant-radius curve. Confirm physical clearance on your layout, especially at turnouts and transitions. Works offline. One paid download with all features included.

name: Randomizer: Pick and Group
description:
Randomizer is a calm, fair set of classroom tools: pick a student, make groups and keep time. It's made by a teacher, for teachers.

Presets or a custom time, with a chime and a tap when time's up.

LIGHT, DARK AND CALM
Light and dark mode, and a quiet wallpaper behind it all.

name: Real Organ 2027

PRO

name: Red Card: Betting SMS Blocker
description:
Tired of daily texts offering bonuses, free spins and "new login addresses"? Red Card recognises betting and casino adverts and quietly moves them to Spam. No notification, a clean inbox.

HOW IT WORKS
Red Card checks texts from numbers that aren't in your contacts, using Apple's SMS filtering system. It looks for betting words, betting site names and links, and bonus amounts, and sees through the tricks spammers use: dots between letters (B.O.N.U.S), digits instead of letters (fr3esp1n), invisible characters and look-alike letters from other alphabets.

A small AI model, trained on thousands of real betting and normal texts, gives a second opinion and recognises new betting site names and wordings too. The model runs on your iPhone; nothing is sent.

Bank, delivery and verification-code messages are left alone.

PRIVACY
Everything happens on your iPhone. The filter has no internet access and can't store anything. No account, no ads, no tracking. Unless you report a message yourself, your messages never leave your phone, and even then your number is never sent.

FEATURES
• Works as soon as it's switched on
• An on-device AI model that also catches new betting texts
• Try a message: paste any text and see what the filter would do, and why
• Your rules: words and numbers to always or never filter
• Three strictness levels: Relaxed, Balanced, Strict
• A guide to clearing old betting texts quickly
• Rules are updated regularly against new tricks
• Report a missed betting text from Messages in one tap, so the filter learns for everyone
• English and Turkish, light and dark mode

Completely free, with no in-app purchases.

Note: iOS never sends messages from your contacts or iMessages to filters. Filters can't delete messages; filtered messages stay in Spam.

name: Reef Rescue: Match & Save
description:
A baby sea turtle is trying to reach open water — and only you can clear the way!

Swap colourful shells to make matches of three or more. Every match next to seaweed, nets or rocks breaks the blockage, and your little friend swims a bit closer to freedom. Spot the clever move, watch the channel open, and see them dart out into the open reef.

50 HAND-MADE LEVELS ACROSS 5 AUSTRALIAN-INSPIRED REEFS
• Turtle Lagoon – learn the ropes with baby sea turtles
• Clownfish Cove – untie knotted fishing nets and sticky barnacles
• Ray Bay – crack rocks and beat the ticking pufferfish

POWER-UPS AND COMBOS
• Match 4 for a Wave Shell that clears a whole row or column

• Swap two power-ups together for huge reef-clearing blasts

FRIENDLY HELPERS
Earn Whale Splash, Dolphin Dive and Octopus Swap boosters from milestones and treasure chests — they never cost a move.

PLAY ANYWHERE
• Works fully offline — perfect for flights and road trips
• Progress saves after every move: close the app and carry on exactly where you left off
• Free retries and unlimited lives

Got an idea for a new reef or sea creature? Tap Settings → Send us ideas. We love to entertain!

Made in Queensland, Australia by Dopamine Hits.

name: RegexCove
description:
Keep immutable pattern versions, inspect captures, save representative cases and compare regression outcomes.

1. Create a workspace and enter an Apple NSRegularExpression pattern.
2. Choose supported options, save a version and open Live Test.
3. Inspect numbered and named capture groups.
4. Save matching and nonmatching examples with explicit expectations.
5. Run selected cases, compare versions and export CSV/PDF reports.

Apple ICU/NSRegularExpression syntax can differ from other regex dialects. Patterns are limited to 20,000 characters, text to 1 MiB and workspaces to 500 cases. Timeout, cancellation and resource limits are reported.

name: Remora: Universal TV Remote
description:
Your iPhone is the universal TV remote for every TV in your home. Press, type or just say what you want.

THE REMOTE

OUTSIDE THE APP

REEF

Unlock, a one-time purchase: every TV in your home, unlimited voice and search, all widgets, Control Center, Apple Watch, themes and app icons, and unlimited Reef. Family Sharing included. No subscription.

WORKS WITH
TVs and streaming players running Samsung Tizen, LG webOS, Roku, Google TV and Android TV, Amazon Fire TV (Fire OS), Apple TV, Vizio SmartCast and Sony Bravia. Your iPhone and TV need to be on the same Wi-Fi. Remora is not affiliated with or endorsed by Samsung, LG, Roku, Google, Amazon, Apple, Vizio, Sony or the streaming services named here. Search support varies by TV and app.

PRIVACY
No account, no ads, no tracking. Your TVs and settings stay on your iPhone. Voice is recognized on the device wherever Apple supports it, and never sent to us.

name: Remote FCC
description:
Remote FCC convierte tu iPhone en el mando de tu puerta.

DESLIZA PARA ABRIR
Un gesto deliberado evita aperturas accidentales. Verás al momento si el dispositivo ha confirmado la orden.

APERTURA AUTOMÁTICA AL LLEGAR
Define una o varias zonas en el mapa y la puerta se abrirá sola cuando llegues, incluso con la app cerrada.

SEGURA
• Se desbloquea con Face ID o con el código del iPhone.

• Sin cuentas, sin publicidad y sin seguimiento.

SIEMPRE INFORMADO
Estado del dispositivo en tiempo real e historial de aperturas manuales y automáticas.

REQUISITOS
Remote FCC funciona con un servidor MQTT propio (por ejemplo, Mosquitto) y un dispositivo receptor que acciona la puerta. La app no incluye ni el servidor ni el hardware.

name: Remote-IO: TV Remote Control
description:
Remote-IO turns your iPhone into a fast, beautiful remote for your smart TV — and your air conditioner and lights too.
Every button is free. No ads. No weekly subscriptions.

WORKS WITH YOUR TV OVER WI-FI
• Roku TVs and streaming players
• Samsung smart TVs (Tizen)
• LG smart TVs (webOS)
• Google TV and smart TVs with Google TV (Sony, TCL, Hisense, Philips, Xiaomi and more)
• Fire TV (beta)
Your iPhone and TV just need to be on the same Wi-Fi. Remote-IO finds your TV automatically, or add it by IP address.

A REMOTE THAT FEELS REAL
• Round glass D-pad with a tap for every press — or swipe in touchpad mode
• Volume, mute, channels, power, home, back and media keys
• Number pad and keyboard: type searches and passwords on your iPhone
• App shortcuts: open Netflix, YouTube, Prime Video and more in one tap on Roku, Samsung, LG and Google TV — each TV keeps its own pinned apps. Roku, LG and Samsung show the apps installed on that TV
• Several TVs? See each one by its own name and switch in one tap
• Reconnects by itself when you open the app, and finds your TV again if its network address changed

CONTROL WITHOUT OPENING THE APP
• Control Center buttons: volume, mute, play/pause, power
• Mini remote on the Lock Screen
• Home Screen widget and Siri shortcuts

ON YOUR APPLE WATCH
• D-pad, OK, back, home, mute, play/pause and power on your wrist
• Turn the Digital Crown to change the volume; hold a button to repeat it
• Double tap to play or pause
• Switch between your TVs by name
• Open it from your watch face or the Smart Stack
The watch remote works through Remote-IO on your iPhone, so keep your iPhone nearby.

TV ROOM: AC, LIGHTS AND SCENES
• Control the air conditioner, lights, fans, plugs and blinds from your Apple Home, right next to your TV remote
• Set the AC temperature on a big dial; change mode, fan speed and swing
• Run scenes, or create a one-tap Movie mode
• Room scenes like Movie night: your TV and Home devices in one tap (TV steps depend on what your TV supports)
• Works right away with Wi-Fi lights and plugs: Philips Hue (with the Hue Bridge), Shelly, Nanoleaf, WLED, Elgato lights, WiZ, Yeelight, LIFX and Govee (with LAN Control on) — no account needed. Add several at once and sort them into rooms
• Have Home Assistant at home? Connect it with your own access token and its lights, switches, ACs, blinds, locks and scenes appear too
• Works with accessories in Apple Home (HomeKit and Matter), and adds new ones with Apple's setup screen. An AC that only has a handheld remote needs a smart hub that adds it to Apple Home.

HELP WHEN YOU NEED IT
• Step-by-step pairing guides for each TV brand
• Clear fixes when a TV doesn't answer
• Try everything first with the built-in demo TV and demo home

SET UP ONCE
• Your TVs, pairings and room scenes sync to your other iPhone and iPad through your own iCloud — we can't see them
• Turn sync off any time in Settings

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no ads, no tracking — Remote-IO collects no data
• Talks only to your TV and devices on your home network

Remote-IO is not affiliated with Roku, Samsung, LG, Google, Amazon, Signify (Philips Hue), Shelly, Nanoleaf, Elgato, WiZ, Yeelight, LIFX, Govee, Home Assistant or any TV or device maker. All trademarks belong to their owners and are used only to describe compatibility.

name: Rent Tower: Building Manager
description:
Your first tenants have paid the rent. Build another floor, or renovate the café downstairs. Homes, cafés, offices, shops, studios, and labs bring in different rents and need different levels of service.

Check power and elevator capacity before signing a tenant. Rent pauses in the room you're renovating while other floors keep earning. See the furniture, lighting, and residents change as you improve each room.

Build toward 100 rental floors and watch the view rise from street level to the clouds. When you return, collect up to eight hours of in-game rent from time spent away.

name: Rentam BA
description:
Rentam.BA je aplikacija za iznajmljivanje stvari u Bosni i Hercegovini. Pronađi alat, opremu za proslave, fotoopremu, vozila i druge artikle koje možeš iznajmiti kad ti zatrebaju.

Pregledaj oglase po kategorijama, pogledaj fotografije i cijene, sačuvaj zanimljive artikle i podijeli ih s drugima. Kad pronađeš ono što tražiš, odaberi termin u kalendaru i pošalji upit vlasniku da potvrdi dostupnost i dogovori uslove najma.

Imaš stvari koje rijetko koristiš? Objavi oglas, dodaj fotografije, opiši artikal i odredi cijenu najma. Na upite odgovaraš direktno u aplikaciji.

name: ReRide Dash
description:
ReRide Dash is the companion app for the ReRideCo Dash, a round handlebar display for e-motos, dirt bikes and motorcycles. Your phone stays in your pocket while the dash shows what you need at a glance.

ON YOUR DASH
• True GPS speed in mph or km/h
• A map that turns with you, with a compass ring
• Turn-by-turn directions: search for a place in the app, or share one from Apple Maps
• Clock, phone battery and dash battery
• A trip page with distance, ride time and top speed
• Night dimming, and auto sleep when you stop for a while

RIDE WITH FRIENDS
• Add friends with your own friend code or a share link
• See friends who are riding on your map and on the dash ring
• Make ride groups, drop a meet-up pin and send everyone there
• Get a regroup alert when someone in your group stops or falls far behind

YOUR RIDES
• Record rides and look back at the route, distance, time and top speed

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Your location is only shared with friends and groups you choose, and only while sharing is on
• Turn sharing off any time, and delete your account from Settings

SETUP
Scan the QR code on your dash to pair it to your phone. Only your phone can use your dash. Dash updates are installed through the app.

No dash yet? Use Phone Rider mode to see the map, add friends and share your friend code.

Sign in with Apple, Google or email.

name: Reza
description:
Reza يحوّل محلك إلى برنامج ولاء كامل بدون بطاقات ورقية.

يسجّل الزبون بمسح رمز في المحل، فتصله بطاقة باسمه في محفظة هاتفه. وفي كل زيارة يمسح الموظف بطاقته من التطبيق فيضيف ختماً أو نقاطاً، وتتحدث البطاقة في هاتف الزبون فوراً.

ما يمكنك فعله من التطبيق:
• ماسح سريع: ختم أو نقاط أو صرف مكافأة بلمسة واحدة
• بطاقات متنوعة: أختام، نقاط، عضوية، كوبون، بطاقة هدية، فعالية
• العروض والإشعارات: أرسل عرضاً لكل الزبائن أو لشريحة مختارة
• زبائن غابوا: تذكير بمن لم يزرك منذ مدة
• تقارير واضحة: الزيارات، الزبائن الجدد، المكافآت، أوقات الذروة
• فريق العمل: حسابات للموظفين بصلاحيات تحددها أنت
• آراء الزبائن: التقييمات والاقتراحات تصلك مباشرة
• إشعارات فورية على هاتفك لكل جديد

يدعم العربية والكوردية والإنجليزية، والوضع الفاتح والداكن.

التطبيق مخصص لأصحاب المحلات وموظفيهم الذين لديهم حساب في Reza.

name: Rhyme Rung
description:
Rhyme Rung is a first table for Taiwanese, in the same spirit as a Japanese syllabary chart. The columns are initials. The rows are the tones that can sit on the rhyme you are reading. Each open cell already shows the Tâi-lô spelling. Stop-tone cells that cannot stand on that rhyme stay shut.

Drag an initial down its own column and let go on a spelling. That cell turns vermilion and keeps a beginner word with it. Tone 6 is shown as merged, the way the mainstream Taiwan accent treats it, and it is not a row you can seat. Open Seated to see what this iPhone has kept, including when it was seated.

Everything you read is on the device. There is no account, no network, and no voice download. The chart, the tone notes, and the beginner words stay in the app. What you seat stays on this iPhone until you remove it.

name: Ridgeline Off-Road
description:
Pick a truck, pick a mountain and find your way to the top.

Ridgeline is an off-road driving game made as homebrew for a classic home console, now on iPhone and iPad. There's no race and no clock. Just four big areas to climb, from the valley floor to the summit, with mud, rock ledges, river crossings and sand dunes in the way.

FOUR AREAS
• Cascade Ridge: a Pacific Northwest mountain in autumn, from the meadow to the fire lookout on the summit
• Mesa Grande: red rock canyon country, up sandstone fins and slickrock to an overlook above the river
• Moses Lake: a field of sand dunes, from a camp on the lake shore to the crest of the king dune
• Loch Lowland: a Highland pass, from the bothy by the loch up a corrie to the mast above the cloud

Each has three ways up, and an extreme trail marked with two black diamonds for when the rest has got easy.

EIGHT TRUCKS
Two old pickups to start with. Earn the rest out on the trails: a short 4x4 with the top off, a modern two-door on 35 inch tyres, a sport side-by-side, a classic British station wagon, a double-cab pickup and a full-size desert runner. Switch between 2WD, 4WD and low range with the diffs locked.

A LIVING MOUNTAIN
A whole day goes by as you drive, from sunrise mist to a starry night, with headlights for when it gets dark. Deer graze in the meadows, birds scatter from the rocks and cloud sits on the summit in the morning.

FILL IN THE TRAIL LOG
Every way up has three stamps to earn: reach the top, do it clean and do it after dark. Find the viewpoints, beat your best times, and turn on damage if you want every knock to count.

ONLINE LOBBIES
Drop into a lobby of up to four and explore together. Everyone's name floats over their truck, horns carry, and reaching the summit puts a trophy by your name.

BUILT FOR TOUCH
A floating steering stick, big throttle and brake pedals, and a D-pad for drive modes, horn and lights. Tilt steering is optional, and game controllers work too.

name: Riff: AI Keyboard
description:
Know what you want to say, but not quite how to say it?

Riff helps you turn a recent message, chat screenshot, or rough idea into words you can actually send. Start with your own conversation. Add a request if you want. Read, edit, and choose what feels like you.

FOR THE MOMENT YOU ARE IN
Keep a dating conversation going, show interest, or suggest meeting up. Find a warm reply to a friend, explain something at work, join a group conversation, or put a thought into words for your partner. Riff works with the context you provide; it does not know your whole relationship or promise how someone will respond.

TEXT OR SCREENSHOT
Paste a recent exchange or select conversation images. You choose what to share and when to generate. Riff does not automatically read other apps' chats.

YOUR INTENT, YOUR TONE
Keep it natural, add humor, be sincere, or say it more directly. Optional controls let you specify the relationship, your purpose, and tone. Add a short instruction when a preset is not enough.

RIGHT WHERE YOU TYPE
Enable the Riff keyboard to draft and insert a reply in supported text fields. Keyboard AI needs Allow Full Access, an internet connection, and your separate AI-sharing permission. Basic typing works without AI access. Some secure fields and apps use the system keyboard instead.

MAKE IT YOURS
Review and edit suggestions before you copy or insert them. Your recent list is stored on your device and can be cleared in Settings. Riff does not build cross-conversation memory.

THREE LANGUAGES
Use English, Simplified Chinese, or Traditional Chinese (Taiwan) for the interface and generated text.

TRY IT FIRST
Start with 5 free generations. No subscription, payment method, or auto-renewal agreement is required for this allowance. In-app purchases are not available in this release.

FOR ADULTS 18+
AI can misunderstand context or get things wrong. You decide what to send. Riff is a writing assistant, not a matchmaking service or a virtual romantic partner.

AI processing: with your permission, selected content is sent through the Openlux gateway to OpenAI. See the privacy policy for details.
Privacy: https://riff.cookii.ai/privacy/
Terms: https://riff.cookii.ai/terms/

name: RINOYA Academy
description:
RINOYA Academy adalah sekolah bermain untuk anak usia PAUD sampai SD kelas 6. Anak belajar Matematika, Sains, dan Coding lewat permainan pendek yang dibacakan, jadi anak yang belum lancar membaca pun bisa ikut.

YANG BISA DILAKUKAN ANAK
• Menghitung, mengenal bilangan, uang, jam, pecahan, sampai soal cerita
• Mengenal tubuh, hewan, tumbuhan, cuaca, benda, dan percobaan sederhana
• Berpikir runtut lewat teka-teki robot, urutan langkah, dan pola
• Naik jenjang dari Tunas (PAUD) sampai SD 6, misi demi misi
• Mengumpulkan bintang, stiker, dan piagam di setiap modul

UNTUK ORANG TUA
• Satu akun untuk seluruh keluarga, tiap anak punya profil dan PIN sendiri
• Ruang Orang Tua: rapor, kompetensi yang sudah dikuasai, ujian, dan sertifikat
• Tes penempatan 10 soal untuk menentukan jenjang awal anak
• Tanpa iklan

Kurikulum disusun mengikuti tahapan belajar anak dan acuan internasional (Cambridge Primary, EYFS), dengan bahasa Indonesia yang ramah anak.

name: RookTalk
description:
RookTalk is voice chat for you and your friends: open a room, share the invite code, talk. There is no server to set up and no account needed to start, and nobody in between can listen.

WHY ROOKTALK
• End-to-end encrypted: voice, video and chat are encrypted on your iPhone with a key that comes from the room's invite. Our servers only pass on encrypted packets and never hold the key.
• Invite-only rooms: a room exists only for the people who have its invite code. No public lobbies, no strangers.
• Start in seconds: pick a nickname and join as a guest, or create an account to keep your rooms and friends.
• Same account everywhere: use RookTalk on your iPhone and on your computer with one account. Your rooms and friends follow you.

FEATURES
• Voice rooms with text chat
• Friends list with online status
• End-to-end encrypted private messages, voice messages and calls
• Room games while you talk: Batak, Okey, chess, backgammon, battleship and more
• Room owner and admin roles: mute, remove and ban
• Report a message or block a person at any time
• Light and dark themes, Turkish and English

PRIVACY
RookTalk does not sell data and shows no ads. We keep only what the service needs: your account details, the rooms you own and encrypted messages we cannot read. You can delete your account and its data inside the app at any time.

Questions or problems? support@rooktalk.com

name: ROUMA PDKS
seller_name: SERBAY YAZILIM VE DANISMANLIK TICARET LIMITED SIRKETI
description:
ROUMA PDKS, işletmelerin personel devam kontrol süreçlerini dijital ortamda yönetmesini sağlayan profesyonel bir personel takip uygulamasıdır.

QR kod tabanlı giriş ve çıkış işlemleri sayesinde çalışanların mesai hareketleri hızlı ve kolay şekilde kayıt altına alınır.

Öne Çıkan Özellikler:

• QR kod ile personel giriş ve çıkış işlemleri
• Konum doğrulama desteği
• Personelin vardiya bilgilerini görüntüleme
• Giriş ve çıkış saatlerini takip etme
• Web tabanlı ROUMA PDKS sistemiyle entegre çalışma
• İşletme bazlı güvenli kullanıcı erişimi

ROUMA PDKS, işletmelerin personel yönetimini kolaylaştırmak ve çalışma süreçlerini daha verimli hale getirmek için geliştirilmiştir.

Uygulamanın kullanılabilmesi için işletmenizin ROUMA PDKS sisteminde tanımlı olması gerekir.

name: Rover Bastion
description:
Hold your ground against growing zombie hordes in Rover Bastion. Your squad fires automatically while you choose allies, upgrades and the right moment to use your Pulse.

BUILD YOUR SQUAD
Level up during each run and choose from three upgrade options. Add support weapons and allies to shape your defense. Push back nearby enemies with the rechargeable Pulse skill.

UPGRADE AS YOU PLAY
Use Repair Kits, Shield Cells and Pulse Batteries when you need them. Stack Rapid Fire, Multishot and Firepower up to level 10 each during a run. Switch between 1x, 2x and 3x battle speed.

EARN REWARDS AND CUSTOMIZE
Earn coins and crystals by playing. Visit the Supply Post for supplies and cosmetic items, then equip your favorite looks in My Squad. Tactical Rerolls cost earned coins, and field supply crates have fixed contents.

EXTRACT OR KEEP FIGHTING
Pause and choose Extract & Collect to end your run and save its rewards, or keep fighting to beat your best. Progress, currency and inventory are saved on your device.

Play without ads or an account. Optional in-app purchases offer crystals through the App Store. Progress and purchased currency may be lost if you erase app data or switch devices.

name: Row Counter: Crochet & Knit
description:
Never lose your place again. Row Counter counts the rows of your knitting and crochet projects, and it does not need your hands to do it.

TAP ANYWHERE
A big ball of yarn shows the row you are working on. Tap it, or tap anywhere on the screen, with a fingertip, a knuckle or the end of your hook, and the next row is counted. Every tap can be felt, and the screen stays on while you count.

COUNT HANDS-FREE
Turn on voice control and say “next” or “yes” for the next row and “back” to take one back. Your needles stay where they are. Speech is recognised on your iPhone; nothing you say is sent anywhere.

COUNTS ALOUD
If you like, the app says the new row out loud, together with what is due in it.

REPEATS AND REMINDERS
• Set the number of rows, and a bar shows how far you are: “Row 22 of 120”
• Rows per pattern repeat: “Repeat 4 · row 4 of 6”
• Reminders for the rows that matter: “From row 4, every 6: Increase 1 stitch”
• Up to three more counters for increases, decreases or anything else
• Notes for needle size, yarn and pattern

ALL YOUR PROJECTS
Sweater, blanket, socks: every project has its own count, its own yarn colour and its own notes. The one you used last is always on top. When the last row is done, the ball shows a tick.

EASY TO USE
• Large numbers that you can read from your lap
• “One row back” for when you counted too fast
• English, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Dutch and Portuguese

PRIVATE
Your projects stay on your iPhone. No account, no ads, no tracking.

SUBSCRIPTION
The first month is free. After that the subscription costs the price shown in the app per month and renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. You can cancel it at any time in the App Store settings.

Terms of use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: RSVP Buddy
description:
You said yes to the parents' evening. Or was it maybe? And when did football training move?

Your calendar knows who invited you, but it makes you open every event to see what you answered — and it forgets what an event looked like before somebody changed it. RSVP Buddy reads your calendar and puts the answers on one screen.

THREE TABS, THREE QUESTIONS

• Agenda — what's on? Everything in your calendar, day by day, with your reply shown on every invitation. Scroll back to see what has already happened, or jump to any date.

• Going — what did I commit to? Invitations you accepted and events you added yourself, for the next 12 months. The newest is at the top, so the last thing you said yes to is the first thing you see.

• Invitations — who is still waiting for me? Invitations with no reply or only a Maybe, the ones you declined, and the ones that went by without a yes.

IT REMEMBERS WHAT YOUR CALENDAR FORGETS

• When you accepted — "Accepted 12 Nov", right on the event.
• What changed — rescheduled, moved to another place or renamed, with the old value next to the new one.
• What disappeared — a cancelled or deleted event stays in the list, crossed out, instead of silently vanishing.

RSVP Buddy works this out by comparing your calendar with what it saw the last time you opened the app, so the history starts on the day you install it.

EVERY DETAIL, ONE TAP AWAY

Tap an event to see the time, the place, the notes, who else is invited and what they answered, and everything that changed.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN

• Read-only: RSVP Buddy can't change, create or delete anything in your calendar.
• No account, no sign-up, no tracking.
• Nothing leaves your iPhone. There is no server.

WORKS WITH THE CALENDARS YOU ALREADY HAVE

RSVP Buddy shows the calendars set up on your iPhone — iCloud, Google, Exchange and others — the same ones you see in the Calendar app. To answer an invitation, use Calendar as usual; RSVP Buddy shows the result.

Made for busy, forgetful people — parents most of all.

name: Rust Admin Console
description:
Manage your Rust game servers from your iPhone or iPad. Rust Admin Console brings server monitoring, remote administration and moderation into one compact interface.

SERVER DASHBOARD
See your connected servers, online players, performance metrics and recent moderation activity. Open a server to inspect its status and charts.

LIVE CONSOLE AND CHAT
Read recent console output with syntax highlighting, send server commands and use the in-game chat.

PLAYERS AND MODERATION
Search players and open profiles with statistics, recent kills, combat logs, bans, mutes and player checks. Player actions open in a convenient bottom sheet.

PLUGINS AND FILES
See plugins that need an update, manage installed plugins and edit their configuration. Access server files and scheduled commands when your permissions allow it.

MAP AND TEAM ACCESS
View the game map, manage server settings and use the access granted to your account by the project owner. The map shows the Rust game world, not your phone's location.

NOTIFICATIONS
Plugin update notifications are enabled by default, with repeated notices for the same update suppressed. Other notification categories are optional and can be changed in settings. Device permission is required.

MADE FOR EVERYDAY ADMINISTRATION
• Sign in with Apple, Steam or email.
• Russian and English, with an in-app language switch.
• Persistent sessions and a bounded cache for faster loading.
• A backup API route when the primary service cannot be reached.
• Account deletion directly in settings.

A Rust Admin service account and permission to administer a connected game server are required. Connecting your own server requires the Rust Admin server plugin. Available features depend on your existing service plan and permissions. Payments are not available in the iOS app.

This is an independent administration companion. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Facepunch Studios or Valve. Rust and Steam belong to their respective owners.

name: S Crest Tray
description: S Crest Tray は、重ねた紋章を皿へ入れて三枚揃える静かなパズルです。上層の紋だけを選び、七つの枠が埋まる前に同じ紋を消します。色分けの輪で報酬を受け取り、欠けた絵を戻し、厚い牌山で星を集め、四つの盤から次の地面へ進みます。残した三連は記録に残り、路線の次の錠と図鑑の封印が少しずつ開きます。通信がなくても皿の一局は続きます。

name: S Motif Circuit
description: 黄昏の工芸盤で同色の釉片を三枚そろえると、回路が点灯し、歩数が残ります。条件が揃わないときは釉片が散ります。手順を見てから盤を開き、落下、釉架、増幅、区間録、暮色盤を巡ります。記録は端末の中だけに残ります。

name: S&K Support
description:
S&K Support is the internal IT help-desk app for S&K Supermarché staff.

- Raise a ticket in seconds: pick a category, describe the problem, add photos or files.
- Follow every ticket: see who is working on it, reply, and rate the support when it is fixed.
- Get notified: instant alerts when your ticket is assigned, updated or resolved.
- For IT staff: your work queue, urgent P1 alerts, transfers and reports on the go.
- Announcements: maintenance and outage messages from the IT team.

Sign in with your S&K Microsoft work account. This app is only for S&K employees and has no use without an S&K account.

S&K Support est l'application interne du service informatique de S&K Supermarché, réservée au personnel. Créez un ticket, suivez-le et soyez notifié.

name: SagZero: MTB Shock & Fork Sag
description:
SagZero is a dedicated single-screen suspension telemetry HUD built for mountain bikers, enduro racers, and home mechanics who want to dial in rear air shock and front fork sag at the trailhead without carrying paper charts or Bluetooth dongles.

Most riders measure their rubber stanchion O-ring with a ruler at the trailhead and then guess how many PSI to add or bleed, or how many clicks of Low-Speed Rebound (LSR) to adjust after changing air pressure. SagZero turns that trailhead workflow into an instant tactile hardware instrument.

KEY CAPABILITIES:
* Interactive Kashima Stanchion & O-Ring Gauge: Step your measured O-ring displacement in 0.5mm or 1.0mm increments and watch your live Sag % and reserve stroke update against your target riding bracket.
* Dual-Channel Rear Shock & Front Fork Telemetry: Switch seamlessly between Rear Shock stroke (45mm to 65mm) and Front Fork travel (120mm to 180mm) while monitoring front-to-rear chassis pitch balance.
* Air Spring PSI & Leverage Ratio Solver: Calculates exact target air pressure adjustments (+PSI to pump or -PSI to bleed) based on your equipped rider weight, frame linkage leverage ratio, and measured sag percentage.
* Rebound (LSR) & Volume Spacer Guidance: Recommends Low-Speed Rebound clicks out from fully closed matched to your air spring pressure, plus volume token recommendations when bottom-out risk or mid-stroke harshness is detected.
* Riding Discipline Brackets: Switch between XC / Climb (24% Shock / 17.5% Fork), Trail All-Mountain (28% Shock / 20% Fork), and Enduro / Steep (31% Shock / 22.5% Fork) target windows.
* Printable Trailhead Telemetry Card & 50-Hour Seal Tracker: Export a complete Fork + Shock setup card or log trail ride hours toward your next 50-hour lower-leg bath oil service.
* 100% Offline & On-Device: Zero accounts, zero cellular signal required at remote trailheads, and zero data tracking.

name: SailNav
description:
SailNav is a chartplotter for sailors and boaters on iPhone, iPad and Mac. It shows official electronic charts, warns you of ships on a collision course, watches your anchor and checks the charts ahead for shallow water, all on your device and without an account.

CHARTS
• Official S-57 vector charts (ENCs), such as NOAA's free US charts: import the zip download or a folder, and updates are applied automatically
• S-100: S-101 charts, S-102 high-resolution bathymetry, S-104 water levels and S-111 currents
• Raster charts (BSB/KAP), such as New Zealand's free LINZ set
• CM93 (edition 2) chart folders you already have
• Day and night colours, adjustable text size, and a world base map where you have no charts

WATCHKEEPING
• AIS collision warnings: closest approach and time to it for every ship; dangerous ships flash red; tap a ship for its details
• Anchor watch: drop the anchor and set a radius; the alarm sounds if you drag or lose position, even with the phone locked and the silent switch on
• Shallow water ahead: checks the charts along your course over ground for water shallower than your safety depth, rocks, wrecks and land
• Depth alarm from your echo sounder, and arrival and off-course alarms when following a route

BOAT NETWORK AND INSTRUMENTS
• Position, AIS and instruments from gpsd or any NMEA 0183 server over Wi-Fi (TCP or UDP); Find looks for gpsd on your network
• The iPhone's or iPad's own GPS when there's no boat network
• Speed and course over ground, depth, speed through the water, apparent and true wind
AIS and instruments need an AIS receiver and instruments connected to your boat's network.

ROUTES AND TRACKS
• Plan routes by tapping the chart, and follow them with bearing, distance, cross-track error and ETA
• Record tracks, detailed in harbours or sparse on passages, with a reminder when you've stopped
• GPX import and export

WEATHER
• GFS wind, pressure, waves and rain from NOAA, downloaded for the screen or for a route
• GRIB files from other apps, such as PocketGrib, Mail or Files
• Ocean currents from Copernicus Marine, with your own free account
• The forecast along your passage at your planned speed

PRIVATE
No account, no ads, no analytics, no tracking. Your position never leaves your device: a weather download sends only the area you choose.

ONE PURCHASE
iPhone, iPad and Mac, with no subscription.

Encrypted charts (S-63 and encrypted S-100) aren't available yet: SailNav's application to the International Hydrographic Organization is in progress, and an update will turn them on.

SailNav is an aid to navigation, not a certified ECDIS. Use it with official charts, a proper lookout and good seamanship.

name: Santa Call: Message from Santa
description:
Make Christmas magical with a personalized voice message and a surprise phone call from Santa. You type your child's name, age, a good deed and what's on their wish list, and Santa says it all in his warm, jolly voice, with sleigh bells, a big "Ho, ho, ho!" and on-screen captions.

Santa Call is made for parents. Set everything up in 30 seconds, then hand over the phone and watch their face light up.

A PERSONAL MESSAGE FROM SANTA
• Santa says your child's name and age
• He mentions the good deed you choose ("I heard you helped your little sister!")
• He confirms their wish ("You asked for a red bike…")
• Add your own secret line for Santa to read (Santa Magic Pack)
• Warm sleigh-bell music, a jolly "Ho, ho, ho!" and captions that follow along
• Gentle, slower voice option for bedtime and little ones

A CALL FROM SANTA
• A realistic incoming call screen that rings like the real thing
• Choose when it rings: now, in 10 seconds, 30 seconds, 1 minute or 5 minutes
• Your child answers and Santa talks right to them, with captions

NICE LIST CERTIFICATE
• Official Nice List, Gold Star Award, or a funny "Naughty List… just kidding!" prank version
• Add their name and the reason, then share or print it

SANTA TRACKER & CHRISTMAS COUNTDOWN
• Live countdown to Santa's take-off on Christmas Eve
• A new "today at the workshop" story every day, read by Santa
• On Christmas Eve, follow Santa's sleigh from the Pacific islands all the way around the world, with a gift counter

SHARE THE MAGIC
• Send the message to grandparents, family or friends on WhatsApp, Messages, email and more
• Save every message in My Messages and play it again any time

6 SANTA MESSAGES
• Classic Christmas Hello (free)
• Santa Is So Proud
• Bedtime From the North Pole
• Gentle Nice List Nudge (a kind reminder to listen, share or go to bed on time)
• It's Christmas Eve!
• Your Letter Arrived

FREE TO START
Your first Classic message, your first Santa call and two certificates are free. The one-time Santa Magic Pack unlocks all six messages, your own words, unlimited calls and certificates, and removes ads. No subscription.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No sign-up, no account
• Names and wishes you type stay on your phone
• Santa's voice is created on your device
• Ads appear only on parent screens, never during the message or the call

Santa Call is an entertainment app for parents and families. Santa's voice is an original, computer-generated character voice and does not imitate any real person. The Christmas Eve route is a make-believe story for fun.

name: SAREP Servicio Tecnico
description:
SAREP (Sistema de Administración de Reparaciones) es la plataforma moderna diseñada específicamente para talleres de servicio técnico de telefonía celular, computación, electrónica y soporte especializado.

Digitalice y controle de punta a punta todo el flujo operativo de su taller:

• Recepción Inteligente de Equipos: Registro detallado del cliente, marca, modelo, serial/IMEI, patrón de desbloqueo gráfico, checklist físico de entrada y firma digital en pantalla.
• Tablero Kanban en Tiempo Real: Visualice y mueva sus órdenes de servicio a través de cada etapa (Recibido, En Revisión, Esperando Repuesto, Reparado y Entregado) con indicadores visuales claros.
• Catálogo e Inventario de Repuestos: Control de costos, existencias y asignación directa de repuestos y mano de obra a cada orden de trabajo.
• Presupuestos e Informes Técnicos en PDF: Generación instantánea de comprobantes de recepción, presupuestos y actas de entrega con garantía en formato Carta o Ticket térmico de 80mm, listos para imprimir o compartir por WhatsApp.
• Dashboard Gerencial y Métricas: Monitoreo de ingresos, comisiones de técnicos, órdenes completadas y productividad del taller.
• Sincronización en la Nube: Operación segura multi-usuario y multi-dispositivo en tiempo real.

name: Sash Notch
description:
Sash Notch keeps one cold-frame sash on this iPhone.

The sash starts down, and the glass is still off the pane. Write the name that belongs on the frame. Drag the glass onto the pane. Drag the sash up until it stays on a notch: a crack, half open, or fully open. The frame is left that way, with the time it was propped.

Open Left open later to see that sash. Sashes left open stay on this iPhone. Nothing is uploaded and nothing is shared.

Sash Notch does not open a real sash, read the temperature, or say what to plant.

name: Save Miemie
description:
A cute cat. A tiny basket. A seriously tricky tile puzzle.

Save Miemie is a triple tile-matching cat rescue: one gentle introduction, then one deep challenge.

Match three identical pet treasures, make room in your six-slot basket, and help Miemie find her way home.

START SMALL
A guided first level shows you how to play. Tap uncovered tiles and collect three identical treasures to clear them. A triple clears before a full basket ends your attempt.

DIG DEEP
Level 2 is one continuous cat-shaped stack with 153 layers and 6,426 treasures. The first three layers ease you in; the deeper layers mix twelve treasure types and demand careful planning. Clearing a local stack reveals the cards beneath it while other upper cards remain. There are only two levels, and every new board has a valid solution.

A LITTLE HELPING PAW
Choose a rewarded ad for Undo pick, Show a hint or a revival. A hint highlights a playable tile; it does not promise a winning move. After three ad presentations in an attempt, your next loss offers a free restart or Unlimited Revivals. Ads need an internet connection and may not always be available.

THREE SPACES TO TRY AGAIN
Reviving moves the oldest three basket cards to a temporary area, freeing exactly three spaces. The remaining cards stay in your basket. Tap a parked treasure to return it when you are ready to make a match.

KEEP YOUR RESCUE GOING
The optional one-time Unlimited Revivals purchase grants unlimited revivals in both levels. The same three-space revival rule applies. It is not a subscription and does not remove ads for Undo pick or Show a hint. Restore purchases with the same Apple Account. Restarting is always free.

Original cat artwork, pastel pet treasures and a playful soundtrack accompany a gentle introduction and a demanding second level. Progress saves on this device. No account required.

Can you bring Miemie home?

name: Scenely by Pixlane
description:
The photo you wish you’d taken may already be in your camera roll. Open a vacation video in Scenely. Its on-device AI suggests stills from each scene, so you can find the laugh you missed, save it as a photo and share it as a post.

Bring out details in a dim photo, restore color to a faded clip, or enlarge an image for a closer look. Upscale can export up to 4K, depending on the source. For handheld footage, use Stabilize Video to smooth camera shake.

Color, low-light, upscaling, and stabilization tools work with standard dynamic range (SDR) video. Scenely processes your media on your iPhone. No account is required. Save the result to Photos or share it when you’re ready.

name: ScentCompass
description:
Explore fragrances by name, brand, note or scent family. Open a fragrance to see its note breakdown and related scents, or compare bottles side by side.

Take the scent consultation to find fragrances that fit your taste. Ask the in-app advisor for catalog recommendations and follow up to narrow your choices. Sign in to sync your saved collection.

Use your iPhone camera or an existing photo to read bottle labels and batch codes. Batch estimates depend on the available evidence for each brand.

name: ScreenRide Player
description:
ScreenRide turns your iPhone into the remote control and video source for your car's big screen.

Modern trucks and cars ship with tall, portrait infotainment displays. ScreenRide is built for them: everything is framed portrait-first, at the panel's native 1080 x 1920, instead of squeezing your phone into a small landscape box. Play video on the phone, send it to the car display over AirPlay, and drive the whole experience from the phone in your hand.

STREAMS
Add any direct stream URL (HLS or MP4) and play it in a fast native player tuned for the car: full-quality playback, a Fill mode that uses the whole vertical panel (or Fit, if you prefer), an AirPlay button right where you need it, and automatic recovery that reconnects on its own if a stream stalls.

YOUR VIDEOS, ON YOUR PHONE
Import videos from Photos or Files and they live in the same list, badged "On iPhone." No uploads, no servers: your videos never leave your device. Recently Watched keeps your last ten plays one tap away, and playback resumes where you left off.

BROWSER, BUILT FOR THE BIG SCREEN
A full web browser with one-tap Quick Links to the streaming sites you already use: YouTube, YouTube TV, Netflix, Prime Video, Hulu, Disney+, Max, Paramount+, Peacock, ESPN, Plex, Apple TV, Fox Nation, Angel, Tubi, Facebook Watch, Twitch, and Pluto TV. Save your own shortcuts, and flip on Desktop mode for sites that try to funnel your phone to an app.

Your phone is the trackpad and the keyboard. In Trackpad mode, drag on the phone to move a cursor on the car display, tap to click, scroll with two fingers, and when you tap a text field on the big screen, the keyboard rises on your phone automatically, just like typing for a TV.

MIRROR
Mirror your entire iPhone screen to the car display over AirPlay. The mirror feed is encoded portrait-first, so your phone fills the vertical panel edge to edge instead of floating in a letterbox.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account. No sign-up. No ads. No analytics, no tracking, nothing collected. Your streams, shortcuts, and history are stored only on your device.

HONEST NOTES
ScreenRide provides no content of its own. Everything you watch comes from your own stream URLs, your own video files, and your own accounts on the websites you open. Whether a given service's website plays video in a browser depends on that service's own policies, and some services may restrict browser playback. ScreenRide is not affiliated with or endorsed by any streaming service; all service names are trademarks of their respective owners.

SAFETY
Video is for passengers and for use while parked only. Never watch video while driving. Always keep your attention on the road and obey local laws.

name: Screenshot & Photo Cleaner
description:
Your camera roll fills up with screenshots you needed once, ten near-identical shots of the same moment, and videos you forgot you recorded. Screenshot & Photo Cleaner helps you find them and decide what to keep — quickly, honestly, and privately.

SCREENSHOTS
• See every screenshot in one place
• Swipe to keep or remove, or select many at once

DUPLICATES & SIMILAR PHOTOS
• Near-identical photos are grouped into sets
• The app suggests the best shot to keep in each set; you always make the final call

LARGE VIDEOS & SCREEN RECORDINGS
• Videos sorted by estimated size, largest first

SOFT & BLURRY PHOTOS
• Find photos that look out of focus

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• All analysis runs on your device. Photos are never uploaded
• No account, no ads, no tracking
• Works with Full or Limited photo access

SAFE DELETION
• Nothing is removed without the standard iOS confirmation
• Removed items go to Recently Deleted, where you can recover them for 30 days

FREE TIER & PHOTO CLEANER PRO
• Free: remove up to 30 items per day, with every feature included
• Photo Cleaner Pro: unlimited removals for US$0.99 per month, with a 1-week free trial for new subscribers
• Payment is charged to your Apple Account. The subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period; manage or cancel it in your App Store account settings

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://photo-cleaner.shiftnotes.workers.dev/privacy

name: Screw: No Ads!
description:
Rotate a 3D object and find the screws holding it together. Tap a screw to remove it, then send it to the matching color box.

Look behind the model for hidden screws. As you take it apart, pieces fall away and reveal new places to look. Choose your next move carefully before the spare slots fill up.

Rotate, unscrew, and sort at your own pace. Play without ads.

name: Script Creation Community
description: An on-device creative community for film & short-drama makers: screenwriting, color/aspect tools, an on-device draft assistant, and a report/block-enabled creator feed. No online video playback.

name: Scroll+: PDF & Ebook Reader
description:
Scroll+ lets you read a PDF on your iPhone the way you read a book. No more pinching and dragging sideways across tiny pages: the text fits your screen and you choose the text size. Your EPUB books sit in the same library.

THREE WAYS TO OPEN A PDF
• Scroll Local opens it right away on your phone. The text reflows and can be enlarged, and it all works offline.
• Scroll Lens turns scanned and messy PDFs into clean text. Headings, paragraphs and footnotes come out as tidy as an EPUB, tables stay tables, and page numbers are left out. A free use opens the first 10% of a book, and the whole book comes with Scroll+.
• Original PDF shows the pages as they are, with the empty margins cropped.

EASY ON YOUR EYES
Light and dark themes, eye comfort modes (Soft 4000K, Warm 2700K, Parchment, E-Ink) and your own font, size, color and spacing. Turn pages like a book, or scroll.

LISTEN TO YOUR BOOK
Tap Listen and your iPhone reads the book in its own voices. The sentence being read lights up on the page, and it keeps going with the screen locked. Read aloud is free.

NOTES AND DRAWING
Highlight in four colors, add notes and bookmarks, and turn a sentence into a quote card to share. Draw on the page with your finger. Drawings stay on the same words when you change the text size.

READ A LITTLE EVERY DAY
Every minute you read earns Nova, and your companion Loomy grows with it. Keep your day streak, climb the weekly rankings, chat with readers around the world and play Word Duel, a live one-on-one word game in English, Turkish or Russian. Free classics are ready on your first day.

FREE AND SCROLL+
Scroll+ is free to download, and the free version shows ads. You sign in with Apple or Google.
• Ad-free: a one-time purchase that removes ads for good
• Scroll+ monthly or yearly: whole books with Scroll Lens, ad-free reading and extra drawing tools
• Ink packs: Ink reveals letters in Word Duel

PRIVACY
Scroll Local books and EPUB files stay on your iPhone. For Scroll Lens, the PDF you choose is uploaded over HTTPS. The original file is deleted after processing, and the finished book once your phone has saved it. After a free use, the whole book stays on our server for your account only, for up to 30 days.

SUBSCRIPTION
Scroll+ is an auto-renewing subscription, monthly or yearly. The yearly plan has a lower price for the first year and then renews at the regular yearly price. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless you cancel it at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel it on your iPhone in Settings > your name > Subscriptions.

Terms of Use: https://scroll.pics/en/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://scroll.pics/en/privacy/

name: Scythe Peen
description:
Scythe Peen keeps each blade on this iPhone.

Four stations sit along the edge. The first line has to be drawn before the second. A strike on the back springs back. A strike on a line that is already drawn springs back. A second line before the first springs back.

When every station is peened, the sentence is Peened. Otherwise it names the first station that still needs a line.

Name a blade, rename it, delete one, and share that one sentence.

Blades stay on this iPhone. There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: Sea Battle: Online
description:
The classic Battleship game with a modern look. Place your fleet, find the enemy ships and be the first to sink the whole squadron.

PLAY YOUR WAY
• Against the computer: three difficulty levels, no internet or sign-up needed.
• Online with a random opponent: quick matchmaking; if nobody is around, a bot keeps you company.
• With friends: add them by ID, invite them to a game, play a rematch.

CLASSIC RULES
• 10×10 grid and a fleet of 10 ships: one of four cells, two of three, three of two and four of one.
• Ships may not touch each other.
• Hit a ship and you shoot again.

NICE TO PLAY
• Place ships by dragging or tap "Random".
• Turn timer, explosion and splash animations, sounds and haptics.
• Statistics: wins, accuracy, streaks.
• For iPhone and iPad, in English and Russian.

FAIR AND SAFE
• The server decides the result of every shot, so no cheating.
• Minimal data: a nickname, an avatar and an anonymous ID. You can delete your account in Settings.
• Report and block other players.

name: SeatRelay: Rowing Lineups
description:
Prepare a seat card before rowing practice or race day. Build a local roster with sweep sides, sculling and cox roles. Assign seats from bow to stroke, see unfilled positions and side conflicts, and keep a second lineup for changes on the dock. Move an existing athlete by swapping seats or replace them with a reserve in a few taps.

Compare plans seat by seat, including cox. Save lineups in a local log and share a plain-text card through the system share sheet. Supports sculling doubles and quads, coxless fours, and coxed eights. Includes a fictional crew you can use immediately.

A crew-planning and communication tool. Confirm entries and safety with your coach and event organizers. No login, ads, subscription, or cloud service.

name: Secret Drawing Missions
description:
Everyone draws the same secret word. One player only knows the category.
Pass one phone around, add one stroke each, then vote in private for the artist who's only bluffing.
Try the 20-second sample, then play your first game with friends right away.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Everyone peeks at their secret in private. Artists see the word; one random odd artist sees only the category.
2. Pass the phone. Each player adds one stroke to the shared drawing, for two full rounds.
3. Talk it over, then everyone votes in private (never for themselves).
4. A clear top vote accuses one player. A tie lets the odd artist escape.
5. Caught? The odd artist gets one final guess at the word. Name it and they still win.

MADE FOR ONE PHONE
- An opaque pass-the-phone screen between turns, so nobody sees the last player's secret
- Secrets hide again if the app goes to the background, also in the app switcher
- Undo only your own stroke, before you tap Done
- Optional turn timer with a ring and gentle haptics; nobody's turn is ever skipped
- Each player has their own color and shape, so color is never the only cue
- Quit mid-game and pick up at the same player's turn

THE REVEAL
Watch the whole drawing redraw itself stroke by stroke, then see who drew what. Share the result as an image; player names are left out unless you turn them on.

FREE
Unlimited classic games for 3 to 6 players with the 48-word starter pack, the replay of your last game, image sharing and a free backup file.

PRO
- Mission Mode: every player, the odd artist too, gets a private drawing twist like "Straight Lines Only" or "Stay Out of the Middle"
- 6 more original word packs: Under the Sea, Kitchen Chaos, Camp Out, Fairy Tale, Busy Town and Game Day
- Your own private word packs
- Games with 7 to 10 players
- Saved replay history

If Pro ends, nothing is deleted. Saved replays and your packs stay readable and exportable.

JUST FOR FUN
Every word and mission was written for this app and checked to be family friendly. There are no points, prizes or online play, and nothing judges how well anyone draws.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking. Nicknames, drawings, votes and packs are stored on your iPhone. The app asks for no permissions.

SUBSCRIPTION
Pro is optional: weekly with a 3-day free trial for eligible new subscribers, or annual, billed in full once a year. Prices are shown in the app before you buy. Subscriptions renew automatically until cancelled in Settings.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://motleystudio.site/secret-drawing-missions/privacy
Terms: https://motleystudio.site/secret-drawing-missions/terms

name: Secret Photo Vault: Quantum
description:
Some things are just for you. Quantum locks your private photos, videos and files in a vault no one in the world can open. Except you.

It hides in plain sight as a working calculator, hands snoops a decoy vault, and photographs anyone who gets your passcode wrong. No account. No cloud. No ads.

THE WORLD'S STRONGEST ENCRYPTION
• Every photo, video and file is sealed with AES-256, the encryption trusted for Top Secret files
• 10⁷⁷ possible keys. 10⁵¹ years to crack. 0 times cracked.
• No backdoor. No master key. No government, spy agency or hacker can break in
• No quantum computer can crack it: post-quantum protection is built in
• Every file gets a key of its own. Names, folders and thumbnails are encrypted too

HIDES IN PLAIN SIGHT
• Opens as a real, working calculator. Type your passcode, press =, and step inside
• Prefer a notebook, a weather app or a unit converter? It can be any of them
• Cover icons for your Home Screen, so your vault never looks like a vault

A DECOY FOR NOSY PEOPLE
• A second passcode opens a harmless decoy vault
• Hand over your phone and smile: the real vault stays invisible
• Nothing on your device reveals how many vaults you have

CATCHES SNOOPS RED-HANDED
• Wrong passcode? Smile. Quantum takes a photo of whoever is guessing
• See every break-in attempt and exactly when it happened
• Want the last word? Set your vault to erase itself after 10 wrong tries

EVERYTHING PRIVATE, IN ONE PLACE
• Photos, videos, documents, PDFs and private notes
• Private camera and document scanner: shots go straight into your vault, never into Photos
• Videos play instantly from encrypted storage, with scrubbing and speed control
• Folders, favorites, search and sort keep thousands of items tidy
• Move photos in and Quantum offers to remove the originals from your Photos library
• Locks the moment you leave, or when you flip your phone face-down
• At home on iPhone and iPad

NEVER LOCKED IN
• Export your original files whenever you like: to Files, to Photos or anywhere you share
• Originals are kept untouched, in full quality

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no sign-up, no email address
• No cloud and no servers: your vault never leaves your device
• No ads, no tracking, nothing collected
• Works without an internet connection

One promise we can never break: there is no reset and no backdoor. If you forget your passcode, nobody can open your vault. Not even us. That is the whole point.

QUANTUM PRO
Quantum requires Quantum Pro. Start with a 7-day free trial on the monthly plan, or unlock everything forever with a one-time Lifetime purchase. The monthly subscription renews automatically until it is cancelled, and you can cancel any time in your Apple Account settings. The free trial is for new subscribers.

Terms of Use: https://salmanahmad09.github.io/SalmanApps/terms.html
Privacy Policy: https://salmanahmad09.github.io/SalmanApps/privacy.html#quantum

name: Secure It Fresh Partners
description:
Secure It Fresh Partners is a business partnership platform designed to connect with businesses and help them grow. We aim to build strong partnerships, create new opportunities, improve business reach, and achieve success together.

Join Secure It Fresh Partners and grow with confidence!

name: Seedspire
description:
Above the clouds lies a farm that is all yours.

Seedspire is a cozy farming game drawn entirely in living characters. Hold a seed and drag it across your beds to sow, swipe to harvest when the crops ripen, and watch the floating isles around the windmill fill up, field by field.

• 256 crops to grow and collect: vegetables, grains, fruit, flowers, herbs, mushrooms, and wonders that glow
• Plant neighbours side by side to discover hybrids and rare mutations
• Wake five sky isles: orchards, rice terraces, a cloud ranch and a moonlit isle
• Raise chickens, bees, ducks, sheep, cows and goats, with a shiba and a cloud cat for company
• Little puzzles every day: lead water through channels, plough in a single furrow, reveal harvest pictures
• Friends: pick a little from their ripe crops, help with the chores, grow a Friendship Garden together and keep your daily spark alive
• Ripe crops keep for a day or more, so the farm fits around your day
• Plays fully offline. No ads, no tracking.

Friends are optional and need an internet connection. Seedspire is free to play and offers optional in-app purchases.

name: SeeName Bird
description:
Meet the birds around you with SeeName Bird, a simple educational field companion for curious explorers, students, families, gardeners and nature enthusiasts.

Take a photo or choose one from your library to receive an identification suggestion. Explore clear guide entries, learn useful facts and keep memorable sightings together in your private notebook.

KEY FEATURES

• Identify a bird from a camera or photo-library image
• Recognition covering 707 bird categories
• Browse a compact educational field guide
• Save discoveries and favourite guide entries on your device
• Use the app in English, French or Arabic
• No account, advertising, subscription or advertising tracking

PRIVACY BY DESIGN

Your selected photo is sent over HTTPS to the recognition service only after your confirmation. Saved discoveries and settings are stored in the app’s private space on your device and can be removed at any time.

IMPORTANT

Identification results are suggestions and may be inaccurate or identify only a broader group. Do not rely on the app for safety, wildlife handling, rescue, conservation or professional decisions.

An Internet connection is required for photo identification. The guide, settings and previously saved notebook entries remain available locally.

name: SeeName Plant
description:
Discover the plants around you with SeeName Plant.

Take a photo or choose one from your photo library to receive a plant identification suggestion. Explore useful botanical information and save your discoveries in a private notebook stored on your device.

MAIN FEATURES

• Identify plants from a photo
• Recognition across more than 1,000 plant species
• Take a photo or select one from your library
• View the suggested common and scientific names
• Discover useful educational information
• Save discoveries in your private botanical notebook
• Available in English, French and Arabic
• No account, advertising or subscription required

PRIVACY BY DESIGN

Your selected photo is sent securely over HTTPS to the recognition service only after your confirmation. The photo is used to process the identification request and is not used for model training or retained after processing.

Your notebook, saved discoveries and settings remain stored locally on your device.

IMPORTANT INFORMATION

Identification results are suggestions and may be inaccurate. Never use SeeName Plant to determine whether a plant is edible, medicinal, toxic or safe to touch. The app does not provide medical, health or safety advice. When safety matters, consult a qualified professional.

An Internet connection is required for photo identification.

name: Selman Watch: Saat Tamiri
description:
Selman Watch, saatinizin tamirini, bakımını ve alışverişini tek uygulamada toplar. Saatinizi ekleyin; servis durumu, garanti belgesi ve modelinize uyan parçalar hep elinizin altında olsun.

TAMİR VE BAKIM
• Markanızı ve yapılacak işlemi seçin, ön fiyat aralığını talep oluşturmadan görün.
• Saatinizi SMS ile gelen Yurtiçi Kargo koduyla gönderin ya da randevuyla atölyeye getirin.
• Saatiniz atölyeye ulaştığında fotoğraflı teslim tutanağı tutulur.
• Ekspertiz ücretsizdir. Kalem kalem yazılı teklif uygulamaya gelir; onaylamadığınız iş yapılmaz, isteğe bağlı kalemleri çıkarabilirsiniz.
• Ödemeyi güvenle yapın, işin hangi aşamada olduğunu adım adım izleyin.
• Teslimde verilen dijital garanti belgesi QR kodla her an doğrulanır.

PREMIUM İKİNCİ EL SAATLER
• Her saat atölyemizde orijinallik kontrolünden geçer, kondisyonu derecelendirilir; set durumu ve garanti süresi ilanda yazar.
• Markaya, fiyata, kondisyona ve kasa çapına göre süzün; fiyatları dilediğiniz para biriminde görün.
• Aradığınız saat gelince haber alın.
• Saatinizi satmak isterseniz ön değerini öğrenin, konsinye başvurusunu uygulamadan yapın.

AKSESUAR VE YEDEK PARÇA
• Modelinizi seçin; yalnız ona uyan kordon, pil ve camları görün.
• Kartla ödeme, Yurtiçi Kargo ile teslimat, 14 gün iade.

HESABINIZ
• Cep telefonunuza gelen kodla giriş; parola gerekmez.
• Servisleriniz, siparişleriniz, saat alımlarınız, konsinye dosyalarınız ve garanti belgeleriniz tek yerde.
• Sorularınız için asistan.
• Türkçe ve İngilizce.

Ön fiyat aralıkları bağlayıcı değildir; kesin fiyat, saatiniz incelendikten sonra yazılı teklifle verilir. Teklifi kabul etmezseniz yalnız kargo bedeli ödersiniz.

name: ServeHop
description:
ServeHop is the field app for process servers who work with Hidden Truth Investigations and Bonnie & Clyde Process Servers in Oklahoma. Accounts are set up by our office; there is no public sign-up.

With ServeHop you can:
- See the jobs assigned to you, with the address, due date, case number, instructions and your fee
- Get directions and Street View for each address, and see past visits to the same address
- Log each service attempt, served or not served, with notes
- Record the GPS location of the attempt automatically, as proof for the court and the client
- Take or attach photos and videos of the attempt
- Save an attempt as a draft and finish it later
- Review and sign your affidavits of service, and print or share the PDF
- See the payments you have received

ServeHop asks for your location only while you are using the app, to stamp where each attempt was made.

name: Serves 20
description:
Hosting should feel like a party, not a project. Serves 20 turns "how many people are coming?" into a menu, a shopping list and a cooking plan, so the big day goes smoothly.

HOW IT WORKS
• Tell Serves 20 how many adults and kids are coming and what time you're eating.
• Pick dishes from the menu. Serves 20 suggests how many of each kind you need and scales every recipe to your guest count.
• Get one combined shopping list, sorted by aisle, with everything you need from every dish. Check things off as you shop.
• Follow a cooking plan for the days before and a countdown for the big day, so everything lands on the table together.

LET GUESTS HELP
• Share a link and guests can sign up to bring a dish, drinks or paper plates. No account needed for them.
• See who is bringing what at a glance, and take anyone off the list if plans change. Dishes others bring come off your shopping list.

MADE FOR REAL KITCHENS
• Thanksgiving mode and a more casual party mode, for any gathering.
• Add your own recipes by typing them in or taking a photo of a recipe card.
• Notes for every event, so next year you remember what worked.
• Works offline, so the plan is there even when the kitchen Wi-Fi isn't.
• Sign in with just your email (no password) to keep your plans on every device.

ONE PRICE
Serves 20 is a one-time purchase. No subscription, no ads, no tracking.

Questions? We'd love to hear from you at support@serves20.com.

name: SesliSınav: YKS KPSS LGS YDS
description:
Ekrana bağlı kalmadan, kulaklığınla sınava hazırlan. SesliSınav; YKS (TYT-AYT), KPSS, LGS, DGS, ALES, YDS/YDT ve TUS adayları için geliştirilmiş sesli konu anlatımı, akıllı ders notları ve aktif tekrar uygulamasıdır.

Yolda, toplu taşımada veya günlük molalarında derslerini dinle; ardından görsel notlar, bilgi kartları ve çözümlü tarama testleriyle öğrendiklerini kalıcı hâle getir.

SESLİ KONU ANLATIMI VE AKILLI OYNATICI
• Konuların özünü ve kritik sınav noktalarını öne çıkaran net sesli üniteler
• 1.0x, 1.25x, 1.5x ve 2.0x oynatma hızı seçenekleri
• 15 saniye geri / ileri sarma ve 15 / 30 dakikalık uyku zamanlayıcısı
• Ekran kapalıyken arka planda kesintisiz dinleme
• Kaldığın yerden devam et: Aktif ünite, saniye konumu, hız ve slayt bilgisi hesabında korunur

AKILLI DERS SLAYTLARI VE GÖRSEL NOTLAR
• Ünite akışıyla uyumlu, kaydırılabilir özet slaytları ve temel kavramlar
• Okunaklı matematiksel ifade ve formül düzeni
• PRO üyeler için tam ekranda 4 kata kadar yakınlaştırılabilir infografikler ve etkileşimli zihin haritaları

ÖSYM TUZAKLI BİLGİ KARTLARI (LEITNER SİSTEMİ)
• Ön yüzde kavram veya soru, arka yüzde sade açıklama ve sık kurulan sınav tuzakları
• "Zor • Tekrar", "Orta • 2 Gün" ve "Kolay • Öğrenildi" seçimleriyle zorlandığın kartları aynı çalışma turunda tekrar etme
• Önemli kartları favorilerine kaydetme

ÜNİTE SONU TARAMA TESTLERİ
• Dinlediğin ünitenin hemen ardından çoktan seçmeli tarama testiyle kendini ölç
• Her sorunun doğru yanıtını, detaylı çözüm açıklamasını ve test skorunu anında gör

KAPSADIĞI SINAVLAR VE İLERLEME TAKİBİ
• YKS (TYT / AYT / YDT), KPSS, LGS, DGS, ALES, YDS ve TUS sınav aileleri
• Tarih, Coğrafya, Türkçe, Matematik, Biyoloji, Fizik, Kimya, Edebiyat ve daha fazlası
• Profil ekranında Ses, Kart ve Test adımlarına göre genel ve hedef sınav ilerleme yüzdesi

ÜCRETSİZ DENEME VE SESLİSINAV PRO
• Açık ünitelerle ücretsiz başlayabilirsin (ücretsiz planda günde en fazla 1 geçiş reklamı gösterilir).
• SesliSınav PRO (Aylık veya Yıllık): Tüm kilitli PRO üniteler, yüksek çözünürlüklü infografikler, zihin haritaları ve reklamsız çalışma deneyimi.

Abonelik Koşulları: SesliSınav PRO abonelik ödemesi, satın alma onayında Apple Kimliği hesabınıza yansıtılır. Aboneliğiniz, mevcut dönem sona ermeden en az 24 saat önce iptal edilmediği sürece otomatik olarak yenilenir. Yenileme ücreti, dönem bitiminden önceki 24 saat içinde hesabınızdan tahsil edilir. Satın alma sonrasında Apple Kimliği Hesap Ayarları üzerinden aboneliğinizi yönetebilir veya iptal edebilirsiniz.

Kullanım Koşulları (Apple Standart EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

Kulaklığını tak; dinle, öğren, tekrar et!

name: Set Point Pulse
description:
Set Point Pulse brings Italian volleyball leagues to your phone, point by point.

When a club keeps score with Set Point Pulse, the score reaches the app while the match is being played: the current set, the points, who is serving, the scores of the sets already played. For every other match you get the official fixtures and results of the leagues, updated all the time. And during live matches the score can be updated by fans too: with a free account you enter the points while the match is played, and everyone sees them straight away.

WHAT YOU GET
• Today's matches and those of the days around it, grouped by league, with live matches highlighted.
• A page for every match: box score, point-by-point history, head to head, league table and "In brief", with the closest set, the longest run and the biggest comeback.
