• National and regional leagues: overview, results, fixtures, standings with promotion and relegation zones, and the archive.
• A page for every team and every club, with the latest result and the next match.
• League news: the story of each round and of the teams that win.
• Near me: upcoming matches in the gyms around you, with directions.

NOTIFICATIONS
• Turn on notifications and we let you know about the matches of the teams you follow and of your favourites: when they are about to start, when they start, at the end of every set and at the end of the match, with the score.
• You also get the news of the teams you follow.

YOUR TEAMS
• Tap the star to save a match to your favourites.
• Follow teams and leagues to find them first every time you open the app.
• With an account, favourites and followed teams stay the same on your phone and on setpointpulse.com.

WHO IT IS FOR
For players, for families following the matches from the stands or from home, for coaches and club staff, for everyone who supports their local team.

Spotted a wrong result? Report it from the match page: we check it and fix it.

Set Point Pulse is free for fans.

name: Shack Messenger
description:
Shack is team chat and calling for organizations that need a real answer to "where is our data?" Your workspace runs on your organization's own server, or on a private, isolated server we host for you, so your conversations stay with you.

Shack needs a workspace from your organization. Ask your administrator for an invitation, then sign in with your work email.

CHAT THAT KEEPS WORK MOVING
• Channels for teams and topics, plus direct and group messages
• Threads, reactions, mentions and saved messages
• Voice notes, photos and files
• Search across your conversations

CALLS
• Voice and video calls, end-to-end encrypted between the people on the call
• Start a call from any conversation, or join a meeting with its ID

PLAN TOGETHER
• Create events right in a conversation, with RSVPs, reminders and a call link
• Add events to your own calendar

STAY ON TOP OF IT
• Notifications for messages, mentions and calls
• Quiet hours, so after-hours messages wait until morning while urgent ones still come through
• Tasks and reminders

BUILT FOR REGULATED TEAMS
• Two-factor sign-in and single sign-on
• Your administrators decide who has access
• An access log records who opened what, and when
• HTTPS on every connection, and attachments encrypted at rest
• No ads, no tracking, and your conversations are never used to train AI

name: Shaka: Zulu Warrior King
description:
Become Shaka, the young warrior who forged the Zulu nation.

Fight across the open savanna with the iklwa stabbing spear and the isihlangu war shield. Lead your regiment into battle and command the legendary "bull's horns": send the chest to hold the enemy while the left and right horns close around them.

- Five story chapters, from exile to the rise of the Zulu: the Mthethwa alliance, the first battle of the horns, the Highland Stone and the Red Ochre host.
- Close spear-and-shield combat: light and heavy stabs, shield blocks, barges and shield hooks.
- Command your regiment: chest, left horn, right horn and loins.
- Duel arena: face rival clan champions one on one.
- Upgrade your iklwa, isihlangu and regiments, and fight in changing weather.
- Touch controls built for iPhone and iPad. Plays fully offline.
- No ads, no tracking, no accounts.

Chapter 1 and one duel rival are free to try. One purchase unlocks every chapter, rival, weather and upgrade forever.

name: Shed.work
description:
Shed is archive storage for agencies and studios. This app puts your shed in your pocket.

See what your shed holds at a glance: how much, what kind, and where the weight is. Find a file or folder by name, or browse to it. See its size, date and where it lives before you fetch anything.

Send a share link in a couple of taps, choose who can open it and when it runs out, see who has opened it, and turn it off whenever you like.

Download a file and it carries on in the background, then stays on your device behind Face ID to open without a connection. Add photos, videos, scans and files to any folder you are allowed to change.

The app never renames, moves, replaces or deletes anything in your shed, so your archive is safe in your pocket.

You need a Shed account from your studio to sign in. Shed is invitation-only: ask whoever looks after your shed.

name: Shedtag
description:
Shedtag hangs a parts tag on every machine in your shed.

Scan the model label on your lawn mower, riding mower, string trimmer, chainsaw, leaf blower, snow blower, pressure washer or generator. Shedtag reads the label with the camera, then builds a tag for that machine: spark plug and compatible alternatives, air filter, oil type and capacity, blades, belts, trimmer line, chain size, and a short safety note. No label handy? Pick one of 20 popular machines or type the model.

A TAG FOR EVERY MACHINE
• Scan up to three labels per machine: the equipment, the engine and the chainsaw bar.
• Take a photo or type the model if the camera can't read it.
• Specs that matter: oil and capacity, spark plug gap, deck size, bar length, line diameter.
• One button for the tune-up kit: the parts you need for a yearly service in one search.
• Every part opens an Amazon search for your exact model, so you choose the product.

CHAIN DECODER
• Type or scan the stamp on a chainsaw bar, like 3/8 LP .050 56DL. Shedtag decodes pitch, gauge and drive links on your phone and searches for the right chain.

SEASON CHECKLISTS
• Spring tune-up, summer blades and line, fall winterizing, winter snow prep and generator checks.
• One shopping list for the whole garage: the same item is listed once, even if three machines need it.
• Tick items off as you go and turn on a reminder for the start of the next season.

WHY SHEDTAG
• Free: no account, no subscription, no ads.
• Private: tags stay on your phone and open offline. Label photos are not stored.
• Rename tags, share a plain-text parts list with a friend, come back every season.

Part numbers and specs can be suggested by AI, so check them against your owner's manual before you buy. Safety notes are general reminders, not repair instructions. Shedtag is not affiliated with any equipment or engine manufacturer; brand names are used only to identify compatible parts. As an Amazon Associate we earn from qualifying purchases, which keeps the app free.

name: Shift Planner - Rota Maker
description:
Shift Planner builds fair monthly or weekly rotas for nurses and other shift-based teams — entirely on your device.

Define your shifts (08:00–16:00, 24-hour on-call, nights…), add your team, and tap Create plan. The planner fills on-call shifts first, balances hours and on-calls across people, and respects every rule you set:

• Rest after on-call (e.g. 2 days off)
• Maximum on-calls per person per month
• Minimum and maximum working hours
• Fixed shifts and weekly required days (e.g. prenatal classes every Tuesday and Thursday)
• People who shouldn't share a shift
• Annual leave (weekends don't count against it) and sick leave
• Day-off requests

When the rota can't work without bending a rule, Shift Planner never decides for you: it suggests the change that bends the fewest rules, explains why, and waits for your approval.

Tap any day to set someone OFF or move them to another shift — the record is saved to their profile and kept every time you regenerate. Re-plan mid-month without losing past days.

Private by design: no account, no internet, no tracking. Your data stays on your phone.

Available in English and Turkish.

name: ShiftFence Time Clock
description:
ShiftFence is the GPS time clock for teams that work on site: construction, parking and valet, security, staffing, cleaning and restaurants. Workers clock in only when they're actually at the job, and every punch is stamped with the official time.

Your company signs you up. Open the app, enter your company's ShiftFence address and sign in with the login your manager gave you.

FOR WORKERS
• One-tap clock in, clock out and breaks with instant geofence check
• See upcoming shifts, site addresses and manager instructions
• Pick up open shifts and request swaps
• Request time off or fix a missed punch for manager approval
• See your weekly hours, daily breakdown and estimated overtime
• Sign off on safety rules and company policies right in the app
• Get notified when schedules are published, before shifts start and when time off is approved

BUILT FOR CONSTRUCTION AND ROVING CREWS
• Start the day anywhere (supply runs, lumber pickups, sub-sites) and stay clocked in while driving between sites
• Arrive at any active job site and the punch is assigned to that project automatically
• Snap time-stamped, location-tagged job photos to document daily progress
• Photograph material and fuel receipts and add the store and total
• Check off daily task and safety checklists as you go
• Log mid-day moves from one job to another
• Add a quick note at clock-out about what you worked on
• No signal in a basement or rural site? Punches, photos and checklists save on the phone and sync when you're back online

FOR MANAGERS AND SUPERVISORS
• Live board and map of who's on the clock and where
• Build day, week and multi-week schedules with templates, then publish them all at once
• Automatic alerts for late arrivals, no-shows and missed clock-outs
• Optionally release a no-show's shift to the team as an open shift
• Approve, edit or dispute punches and requests with a full audit history
• Crew board with task progress, photo counts and site moves
• Review job receipts by date, crew member and project
• Live labor cost estimate with regular and overtime hours
• Export payroll-ready reports for QuickBooks, ADP and other payroll systems

PRIVACY AND TRUST
• Location is checked when you punch or take a job photo. Optional on-shift check-ins only run while the app is open. No background tracking, never off the clock
• GPS coordinates are purged automatically on a schedule while pay records stay intact
• Every punch is stamped with the official server time and kept as a tamper-evident record

A ShiftFence company account is required. Companies can learn more at shiftfence.com.

name: Shoalwater Bay: Language Quest
description:
Language Quest is an adventure game from the Shoalwater Bay Indian Tribe that makes learning our words fun for all ages.

Travel trails through real places around Willapa Bay, from the forest and shoreline to the water. Along the way, discover words, meet the animals of our homelands, and build your knowledge one trail at a time.

FEATURES
• Real places – trails based on the land and waters around Shoalwater Bay
• Learn as you play – find new words and review ones you've already learned
• A trail companion – feed your animal friend at camp and it helps you gather sparks on the next trail
• Earn and unlock – spend fire points on hats and accessories inspired by Coast Salish traditions, plus upgrades that help you on your journey
• Living weather – sunny days, rain, clouds, and king tide storms with crashing waves
• Canoe journey finale – bring everything you've learned together on the water
• Easy for everyone – simple tap or drag controls designed for both youth and elders
• Teacher view – helps educators follow along with learners

Language Quest was created with care to share Shoalwater history, culture, and language accurately and respectfully. More words and features will be added in future updates.

name: Shot Tracker: Club Distances
description:
Find out how far you really hit each club, on the course, in real conditions.

Shot Tracker measures the shots you choose. Mark where you hit from, hit, walk to your ball and mark where it stopped. The app saves the distance with the club, the elevation change and the weather. Over time it builds a typical range for every club in your bag.

MEASURE A SHOT
• Tap Mark Start where you hit from and Mark Ball where the ball stopped
• GPS is averaged for a few seconds at each mark for a steadier reading
• Or tap the satellite map to place a pin
• See the distance in yards with a shot arc between the pins
• Your shot in progress is kept even if the app closes on the walk to your ball

ELEVATION AND WEATHER
• The barometer measures how much higher or lower your ball finished
• Temperature, wind and conditions from Apple Weather are saved with each shot
• No signal? Weather is filled in later from Apple Weather's history

YOUR NUMBERS
• Average distance for every club
• A typical range (the middle half of your shots) once a club has 5 measurements
• A full shot list with elevation, weather and date
• Delete a bad shot or change its club at any time

YOUR BAG
• Start with a standard set of clubs, from Driver to Lob Wedge
• Turn clubs on or off, add your own, rename them and drag them into bag order

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account and no sign-up
• Your shots stay on your iPhone

Shot Tracker measures the straight-line distance from where you hit to where the ball stopped (total distance, not carry). Accuracy depends on GPS conditions; with a clear view of the sky it is typically within a few yards. Best for full shots with woods, hybrids and irons.

name: Sidestep: ADHD Task Starter
description:
Stuck on a task you keep putting off? Sidestep breaks it into one small next step, so you can start instead of staring at the whole thing.

Tell it what you’re working on, and it suggests your next move. Finish that one, then take the next.

WHAT YOU GET

One small, concrete step at a time, not a plan to manage
A timer that keeps you moving
Sessions saved on your iPhone, so you can pick up where you left off
Action Button and Control Center shortcuts to start a session fast
Pro: Phone-down mode shows your current move and timer on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island
Pro: Learns the step size that works for you
Pro: Export your sessions

PRIVATE BY DESIGN

No account and no sign-up
Your goals, moves, voice and photos stay on your iPhone
Moves are written by Apple’s on-device model, not a cloud AI
Works offline, even in airplane mode
Anonymous usage counts are off by default, and they never include what you write

PRO
Choose a monthly or yearly subscription, or buy Pro once for life. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the period ends. Restore your purchase on any device signed in with the same Apple ID.

REQUIREMENTS
iPhone 15 Pro or newer with Apple Intelligence turned on, running iOS 27 or later.

Sidestep is a productivity tool. It is not a medical device and does not diagnose or treat ADHD or any condition.

Terms: https://dustindoan315.github.io/sidestep-site/terms.html
Privacy: https://dustindoan315.github.io/sidestep-site/privacy.html

name: SignOn Ready: Seafarer Docs
description:
Be ready before you join the ship.

SignOn Ready is a private document locker and readiness checklist for seafarers. Keep your certificates and records in one place, know what is expiring, and walk into joining day and port inspections prepared.

There is no account and no advertising. Your documents stay on your phone.

JOINING JOURNEY
Enter the ship, port and date. The app lists the documents that ship needs, your visa and joining papers, countdown reminders and a Travel pack that works offline.

DOCUMENTS AND SCANNER
Scan with the camera or add a file you already have. Dates and numbers are read on the phone. Check them, then save.

READY-TO-JOIN DASHBOARD
Your papers are checked against the rules for your rank, nationality and ship type, including STCW, MLC and national requirements. See what is missing or expiring, and get a reminder on your phone before a date passes.

DRILLS AND TESTS
Enter when each drill or test was last done on your ship. The app shows what is due and reminds you.

REST HOURS
Tap or drag across the half-hours you worked. The app checks the STCW and MLC limits as you go and flags any period that breaks a rule.

PORT STATE CONTROL
A checklist built from what inspectors really write up, with focus by port and area.

RULES FINDER AND COLREGS
Type a question in plain words. The app answers from the library built into it, with the regulation it comes from. It works without internet, and what you type never leaves the phone. The COLREGs include lights and shapes, sound signals and tests.

NAVIGATION TOOLS
ETA calculator, gyro error from a celestial azimuth with automatic magnetic variation, sight reduction, true wind, a port finder, and a Route Planner with waypoints, avoid options (Suez, Panama, Malacca, Red Sea, Cape), emission control areas and a voyage schedule. Planning aids only: they do not replace official charts, ECDIS or your company's procedures.

RECORD BOOKS, HELP AT SEA, CAREER GUIDE AND EXAM PRACTICE
Plain guidance for the books ships keep, helpline contacts for your country (India first), the next-rank path for India and the Philippines, and multiple-choice practice with the regulation beside every answer.

FREE AND PRO
TRY PRO FREE FOR 7 DAYS
New subscribers get a 7-day free trial of Pro, one per Apple Account. Cancel at least 24 hours before it ends and you pay nothing. Your documents and all the free features stay.

Free for everyone: unlimited documents, the scanner with Auto-read, your rank-based checklist, expiry reminders, encrypted backups, the sea time log and a sample of the rule cards.

Pro adds all rule cards, sea service reports, the joining pack PDF, CV and ZIP export, unlimited exam practice and mocks, PSC focus by port, and senior-rank handover checklists. A six-month Student Pass covers exam practice only. Route Planner exports are included while Pro is active, stay unlocked for good once a yearly Pro's first paid year starts, or can be unlocked once on their own.

Pro is an auto-renewing subscription (monthly or yearly). Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase, and the subscription renews unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it in your Apple Account settings. The Student Pass and Route Planner unlock are one-time purchases. Purchases are for people aged 18 or over, or a parent or guardian buying for a student.

Privacy policy: https://signonready-ask.charlesjoseraj-cjr.workers.dev/privacy
Terms of use: https://signonready-ask.charlesjoseraj-cjr.workers.dev/terms

SignOn Ready is not affiliated with any government, flag State, port State control regime or classification society. Always confirm requirements with your flag State, company and manning agent.

name: Sillgrow
description:
Sillgrow helps you keep houseplants thriving with a quiet, visual windowsill built around your own collection.

Add each plant in seconds with its name, optional species, photo, spot in your home, pot size, and watering interval. Every plant settles onto an illustrated windowsill that shifts with your local sky from dawn to moonlight. Hydrated plants stand tall, while thirsty plants gently droop so you can see who needs water at a glance.

Key features:
- Quick plant setup: pick a spot (Window, Balcony, Shelf, Desk, or your own custom spot), pot size, and watering interval (3, 7, 10, 14 days, or custom). Edit, duplicate, archive, or remove plants anytime.
- Today watering list: overdue plants appear first. Log watering in one tap with an optional amount, snooze by one day, or skip a cycle while tracking your watering streak and history.
- Calm reminders: choose one daily summary time for thirsty plants, plus optional reminders for individual care tasks.
- Growth photo timeline: save dated photos with optional height notes and compare your first and latest photo with a slider.
- Recurring care tasks and notes: schedule fertilizing, repotting, rotating, misting, pruning, and leaf cleaning alongside free-text care notes.
- Approximate light meter: use your camera preview to estimate ambient light for a spot (Low, Medium, Bright, or Direct sun) with plain-language plant suitability notes. Light readings are approximate estimates only and never store images.
- Private by design: all plants, schedules, notes, and photos stay on your device. No account, no tracking, and no internet connection required. Export your data anytime as JSON or CSV, or delete everything in one step.

name: Simple Nutrition AI Log
description:
SNAIL is a simple iPhone diary for food and drinks. Describe a meal or snap a photo, review its estimated nutrition, and save it. See your daily calories, protein, carbs, and fat at a glance.

• Log food from text or a photo, or enter nutrition manually.
• Review foods and adjust portions before saving.
• Use drink presets for water and coffee, and choose beer, wine, hard seltzer, or cocktails.
• Browse past days and edit or delete entries.
• Sync confirmed nutrition with Apple Health when you grant permission.

Estimates depend on the food and portion information you provide. Review values before you save.

name: Simple Spice Tracker
description: A simple way to keep track of what spices you have and how much.

name: Sippo: Alcohol Moderation
description:
Cut back on drinking at your own pace with Sippo, your panda companion in a calm bamboo sanctuary. No harsh streak resets, no lectures, and no account required.

Sippo makes alcohol moderation feel light and doable. Set a realistic weekly drink goal, take 10 seconds each day to log your drinks or mark a dry day, and try the daily reward draw to earn Bamboo, panda accessories, and sanctuary upgrades.

HOW SIPPO HELPS YOU DRINK LESS
- Weekly Drink Budget: Track Budget, Sipped, and Left over drinks each week instead of starting over after one slip.
- Fast Drink Counter: Log Beer, Wine, Spirits, Cocktails (2 standard units), or a Dry Day in seconds.
- Personalized 6-Week Plan: Pick a Gentle, Steady, Brisk, or Right away pace and watch your weekly target step down over 6 weeks.
- Daily Intention: Press and hold to set today's drink limit before a night out or weekend gathering.

DAILY REWARDS THAT KEEP YOU CHECKING IN
- Daily Reward Draw: Every daily check-in unlocks a free reward draw for Bamboo, fun panda hats and accessories, and animal companions.
- Build Your Bamboo Sanctuary: Upgrade Sippo's teahouse, stone lantern, koi pond, and tea mat as you build healthier habits.
- Panda Accessories: Dress Sippo up and celebrate your dry days together.

GENTLE SUPPORT AND REAL INSIGHTS
- Panda Companion Chat: Talk through cravings, social pressure, or tough evenings with calm, judgment-free reflection prompts.
- Savings and Health Estimates: See estimated drinks avoided, money saved, calories skipped, and dry-day streaks based on your baseline.
- Thoughtful Reminders: Optional daily check-in reminders; if notifications are on, a friendly heads-up 2 days before your free trial ends.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
- No sign-up, no phone number, and no ads.
- Your detailed drink logs, goals, reflections, and chats stay in your private device storage and, if iCloud is enabled, your own private iCloud. We send limited aggregate usage events to analytics; we do not send your drink counts, reflections or chat messages.

SIPPO PRO SUBSCRIPTION
Sippo offers auto-renewable subscriptions to unlock full access to Sippo Pro:
- Yearly Plan: $39.99/year (includes a 7-day free trial for eligible new subscribers)
- Monthly Plan: $6.99/month

Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase (or after the 7-day free trial ends, if eligible). Subscriptions automatically renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel anytime in your Apple Account Settings.

IMPORTANT NOTE
Sippo is for adults 18 and over. It is a lifestyle and habit-tracking companion for mindful drinking, not a medical or addiction treatment device. If you experience severe alcohol dependency or withdrawal symptoms, seek immediate medical help. Never drink and drive.

Terms of Service: https://qiyunranyue.com/apps/sippo/terms
Apple Standard EULA: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://qiyunranyue.com/apps/sippo/privacy
Support: https://qiyunranyue.com/apps/sippo/support

name: Siren Grid: Dispatch City
description:
A small city is growing, and you run its emergency services.
Lay the roads and choose where the stations go.
Then trace every ambulance, engine and patrol car to the call.

BUILD THE ROADS
• Drag across the ground to lay road. Corners curve on their own.
• Houses, shops and towers keep appearing. Connect them before they need help.
• Swipe a house to turn its driveway.
• Earn bridges, roundabouts, expressways and emergency lanes as the city grows.

TRACE THE ROUTE
• When a call rings, drag from a station or a moving unit to the call, through the streets you pick.
• Drop on a busy unit to queue its next job.
• Medical calls need an ambulance. Fires need an engine. Break-ins need a patrol car.
• A tower fire takes two engines and a patrol car at once.

CHOOSE WHAT COMES NEXT
• Every Sunday, pick one offer: more road, a new unit, a new station or a helipad.
• Stations stay where you put them, so every choice shapes the city.
• Standing orders let a service answer nearby calls on its own.

CATCH THE PRANKSTER
• A harmless troublemaker sets off false alarms, opens hydrants and goes joyriding.
• Tap him to send a patrol car after him. Connect the jail to keep him there.

THREE CITIES
• Harbourtown, on the water.
• Northvale, a snowy town. Opens at 50 people helped.
• Sunset Mesa, split by a canyon. Opens at 100.

A NEW CHALLENGE EVERY DAY AND WEEK
• Daily: one city for the day, one scored attempt, then practice runs.
• Weekly: a changed rule, such as No Bridges, Double Tiles Half Units, or the Night Shift.
• Game Center leaderboards and achievements.

MADE FOR TOUCH
• Haptics and sound made in the app.
• VoiceOver labels, plus a list of open calls that sends the nearest unit without tracing.
• Reduce Motion, plus day and night themes.
• iPhone and iPad.

PRIVATE
• No account. No ads. No tracking. No data collected.
• Game Center is optional.

One price. No in-app purchases.

Siren Grid is a game set in a fictional city. It is not emergency training or advice.

name: SiteFlow – Field Operations
description:
SiteFlow is the field app for construction companies. Site teams use it to record their work from the project, and managers follow it from the SiteFlow web dashboard.

Attendance
• Check in and out at the project, with a location check against the site boundary
• Supervisors can check in their crew
• Day and night shifts, with overtime counted on the same workday

Equipment
• Log operating hours and work for each machine
• Report breakdowns and follow maintenance

Daily reports
• Write the daily report from the site, with photos
• Raise issues and safety observations

Requests and approvals
• Request leave and follow up on your requests
• Managers approve or reject requests from their inbox

Works in Arabic and English, and keeps working when the connection is weak.

SiteFlow accounts are created by your company from the SiteFlow dashboard. You can't sign up from the app. You sign in with a code sent to your email.

name: SkatingClock
description:
SkatingClock shows where a speed skating competition day stands, on your Apple Watch.

Pick an event on your iPhone or directly on the watch. Events from the current week are listed first.

ON APPLE WATCH
• A digital clock with seconds, and with minutes only when your wrist is down
• A countdown to the next competition start
• With a full time schedule: a countdown to the end of the current competition
• The full schedule of the event, opened at what is happening now

ON YOUR WATCH FACE
Two complications bring the countdown to a normal watch face. "Countdown" shows the end of the current competition and the next start. "Following" lists what comes after, optionally including ceremonies. Modular Duo fits both.

ON IPHONE
• Choose the event and how to count down
• Switch between competition start times and the full time schedule
• Tips for setting up a matching watch face

Schedule data comes from the public ISU Results API. Competition start times are available to everyone. The full time schedule, which adds end times, requires an API token from the results service. SkatingClock is an independent app and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the International Skating Union.

name: Skychord
description:
You probably know your Sun sign. Your Moon and Rising sign say just as much: about what you feel and how you come across. Skychord calculates all three and shows how they sound together.

PRECISELY CALCULATED
Skychord calculates astronomically, just like professional astrology software. Results have been tested against the Swiss Ephemeris and differ by less than one arcminute. The app knows the historical time zones and daylight saving rules of your birthplace, including the distant past.

YOUR THREE SIGNS
• Sun: who you are at heart and what gives you energy.
• Moon: what you need to feel safe and at home.
• Rising: how you enter a room and how others see you first.

HOW THEY WORK TOGETHER
Skychord describes how your Sun, Moon and Rising sign relate: where they reinforce each other, where there is friction, and what that means for you. See which elements and which rhythm dominate your three, and a chart wheel shows the signs as they stood in the sky when you were born.

NOT SURE OF YOUR BIRTH TIME?
Without a time you see your Sun and Moon. If the Moon changed sign that day, you see both possibilities and the exact time of the change. If your Rising sign is close to a sign boundary, the app tells you.

PRIVATE AND OFFLINE
No account, no tracking, no ads. Your birth details stay on your phone. Over 26,000 places work without internet.

ALSO
• Read what each sign means for your Sun, Moon or Rising.
• A clear guide to the principle behind astrology.
• English and Dutch.

EXTENSIONS
One-time purchases, no subscription:
• Unlimited people: save the three signs of your partner, family and friends.
• Deeper reading: your decans, plus what your Sun says about work and calling, your Moon about love and your Rising sign about your style and body language.
• Partner and dynamics: put two chords side by side and read where you strengthen each other and where there is friction.
• Or everything together, for less.

Skychord is meant for inspiration and reflection, not as advice.

name: SkyRdstr
description:
Fire the thrusters and jump the gaps. SkyRdstr is a fast, simple space racer: one car, roads floating in space, and the clock.

THREE MODES
• Classic: floating roads in space. Time your jumps, ride the boost pads, and don't drop short.
• Rocket: loops, corkscrews and upside-down roads. Launch off the rocket pad and clear the lineup.
• Circuit: 23 real race circuits rebuilt in the sky. One lap against the clock, with rear thrusters for the straights.

BEAT THE BEST TIMES
Every stage has a worldwide leaderboard. Pick a driver name, set a time, and see where you rank. New stages open five at a time as you finish them.

MADE FOR TOUCH
Steer with your left thumb and fire the thrusters with your right. On iPhone you feel every thrust, every landing and every crash.

PLAYS OFFLINE
The whole game is inside the app, so it runs without a connection. Times you set offline are posted when you're back online.

No ads, no in-app purchases and no sign-up: just a driver name, which you can change or delete at any time.

name: SkyTrix
description:
SkyTrix – Airplane Escape is a portrait arcade run through a three-lane storm corridor. Your propeller craft flies forward on its own. You do not drag it around the screen. Tap the left side to move one lane left, tap the right side to move one lane right, and hold the shield when an electric cloud or gate closes in.

Orange pylons always cost a life. Purple electric hazards can be deflected while shield energy remains. Glowing crystals refill that energy. You start each corridor with three lives and a short invulnerability beat after a hit. Survive the mission clock, then enter the lit escape portal. The wrong lane ends the run.

Thirty corridors are built in three bands:

• Easy, missions 1–10: slower pylons, wider gaps, and more crystals.
• Medium, missions 11–20: faster traffic, moving electric bars, and tighter patterns.
• Hard, missions 21–30: high speed, rapid lane changes, scarce shield energy, and a harder portal.

Every wave leaves at least one open lane, so a prepared switch can always find a way through. Clearing a corridor unlocks the next one. Best scores and star ratings stay on the device. One star means you escaped. Two and three stars ask for cleaner dodges, more crystals, and lives still in hand.

Pilot Command keeps the real log: flights, clears, best score, survival time, obstacles avoided, crystals, the highest corridor opened, and stars earned. Score progression, campaign completion, and difficulty performance are drawn on the device. Achievements mark the first escape, long survival, crystal and shield milestones, a perfect clear, and the full set of thirty.

SkyTrix is a complete offline game. There are no accounts, no ads, and no network services. Progress is stored locally and can be reset from Pilot Command.

name: Slasham App
description:
Welcome to Slasham — your premier destination for the Slasham Discount Festival and unbeatable everyday shopping deals! Experience a vibrant shopping celebration designed to bring you the best discounts, verified vendors, and unmatched festival vibes.

Whether you're shopping for the latest tech, home essentials, trendy fashion, or everyday groceries, Slasham connects you directly to top merchants with exclusive savings up to 70% off.

KEY FEATURES:
• Massive Festival Discounts: Unlock limited-time price drops and exclusive deals across our largest shopping festival.
• Curated Categories: Explore Phones & Gadgets, Home & Living, Fashion, Beauty & Personal Care, and Electronics.
• Verified Festival Vendors: Shop with confidence from accredited, trusted local and national merchants.
• Seamless Order Collection: Enjoy fast, contactless in-person order pick-up with instant digital collection passes.
• Win Exciting Prizes: Enter festival raffles, giveaways, and grand prize draws right from the app.
• Safe & Simple Shopping: Browse curated catalogs, save your favourite items, and enjoy smooth checkout.

Join thousands of shoppers enjoying deals, beats, and vibes at the Slasham Discount Festival in Abuja, Nigeria. Download Slasham today and discover a smarter way to save!

name: Slatepath
description:
Slatepath is an intuitive visual workbench built specifically for film directors, cinematographers, indie filmmakers, and storyboard artists to orchestrate shot blocking and scene coverage with precision.

KEY FEATURES:
• INTERACTIVE SHOT BLOCKING CANVAS
Arrange scene actors, set elements, and camera placements on a flexible multi-touch drafting canvas. Adjust viewing angles, optical perspective cones, and camera coverage areas seamlessly.

• CINEMATIC STORYBOARD BEATS
Organize your project into sequential scene beats. Sketch composition framing, write scene actions, and balance visual rhythm from master shots to close-ups.

• TIMELINE & COVERAGE MANAGEMENT
Maintain complete oversight over dialogue angles, reverse shots, and coverage continuity directly inside a unified workspace.

• SOVEREIGN OFFLINE WORKBENCH
No forced accounts, no cloud sync lag, and no unexpected network delays. All projects and canvas sketches are saved strictly to your local iOS sandboxed vault.

• LOCAL EXPORT
Export polished storyboard panels and shot breakdown sheets to standard image files via the native iOS share sheet.

• OPTIONAL SLATEPATH PRO EXTENSION
An optional one-time purchase unlocks batch shot editing, camera setup grouping with grouped CSV export, and frame arrangement presets. Core drafting canvas, revisions, and standard exports remain completely free.

Bring your cinematic vision from imagination to the physical set with Slatepath.

name: SleighFlyer
description:
Naiki kereta luncur Santa dan terbang merentasi malam Krismas yang penuh keajaiban!

Ketik untuk terbang tinggi, elakkan batang gula-gula gergasi, dan kumpulkan hadiah-hadiah yang terapung di langit bersalji. Setiap penerbangan merupakan satu pengembaraan baharu. Mampukah anda menghantar semua hadiah dan sampai ke Kutub Utara?

CIRI-CIRI
• Kawalan satu ketikan yang ringkas—mudah dipelajari dan pasti membuatkan anda leka bermain
• 8 peringkat yang direka khas, daripada 'Snowy Start' hingga 'North Pole Express'
• Mod Tanpa Had (Endless Mode): terbang sejauh mungkin dan pecahkan rekod skor terbaik anda
• Dapatkan sehingga 3 bintang pada setiap peringkat
• Kumpul hadiah dan buka pencapaian bertema perayaan
• Batang gula-gula yang bergerak serta kelajuan yang semakin meningkat menjadikan setiap peringkat sentiasa terasa baharu
• Salji yang turun, bintang yang berkelip, dan jejak cahaya yang berkilauan
• Muzik perayaan yang ceria serta kesan bunyi yang menarik
• Boleh dimainkan di luar talian, tanpa iklan dan tanpa perlu log masuk

Sesuai untuk seisi keluarga pada musim perayaan ini. Muat turun sekarang dan sebarkan kegembiraan Krismas!

name: Slub Draft
description:
Slub Draft keeps each sliver on this iPhone.

Six places sit on the sliver. A thick place can be drafted only before the twist runs into it. A place that is already even stays even. A place the twist has locked stays thick.

When every place is even, the sentence is Even. Otherwise it names the first place that is still thick.

Name a sliver, rename it, delete one, and share that one sentence.

Slivers stay on this iPhone. There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: Smart Reply by Lumi Ai
description:
Smart Reply by LUMI AI brings your business WhatsApp to the whole team, in one simple app.

TEAM INBOX
• Every WhatsApp chat in one place, with an owner for each customer
• Unread, Mine and Team queue filters so nothing is missed
• Internal notes your customers never see

WHATSAPP, JUST LIKE IT
• Chat screen that looks and works like WhatsApp
• Send photos, documents and voice messages
• Swipe to reply, quick replies and approved templates

WHATSAPP CALLS
• Answer business WhatsApp calls on your phone
• Calls ring even when the app is closed
• Missed-call follow-up messages

AI BOT
• The AI answers chats and calls when your team is away
• It leaves a note in the chat: what it did and what you should do next
• Managers turn the chat bot and voice agent on or off in one tap

FOR MANAGERS
• Today's dashboard, live team status and assigning chats
• Light and dark mode

Smart Reply needs a company account. Ask your manager for your login, or contact LUMI AI to set up your business.

name: SMARTWeight: Barbell Loader
description:
How much goes on each side? SMARTWeight tells you in a second.

Pick your 1RM, slide the percentage and the app builds the load with the plates your gym actually has. You see it on a 3D barbell, just the way you'll load it.

FIGURE OUT THE LOAD
• Pick a base weight (one of your 1RMs or any number) and a percentage.
• See which plates go on each side and the exact load you can build.
• When the number doesn't match your plates, you get the option just above and just below.
• Going from one percentage to the next, it tells you what to take off and what to add, without touching the inner plates.

YOUR BARBELL IN 3D
• View it from the side, up close or head-on.
• Weight mode: tap plates to load them and see what your bar weighs.

YOUR RMs
• Log your lifts by movement, named however you like.
• Did it for more than one rep? The app estimates your 1RM with the Epley formula.
• Track your progress on a chart and in each movement's history.

LIKE YOUR GYM
• Plates in pounds, kilos or mixed, or choose them one by one.
• Colored or black bumpers.
• 45 or 35 lb bar, or 20 or 15 kg.
• Count your collars if you want: plastic or competition.

NO ACCOUNT, NO ADS
SMARTWeight is free and has no ads. No sign-up needed: your lifts stay on your phone.

For weightlifting, functional fitness, powerlifting or today's WOD.

Made by Rainbow Tech, a small independent studio. If it helps you, you can buy us a coffee from Settings.

name: Smarty
description:
Smarty je digitalna kartica vjernosti za kupovinu kod Smarty partnera. U aplikaciji možeš pratiti stanje bodova, pregledati dostupne nagrade i pronaći Smarty partnere.

Pri kupovini otvori Moja kartica i pokaži QR kod za skeniranje ili svoj članski broj.

name: SmashKing - מאמן הפאדל שלך
description:
מאמן פאדל בכף היד.

אנחנו מלמדים אתכם לקבל החלטות טובות יותר על המגרש, נקודה אחרי נקודה. נכנסים למגרש, בוחרים, ורואים מה קורה. ראלי, המחבט המאמן, מסביר כל בחירה.

איך זה עובד
- בכל נקודה 3 החלטות: איפה לעמוד, לאן לחבוט ואיזו חבטה.
- בוחרים ישר על המגרש, בלחיצה על סמל.
- ראלי מסביר למה הבחירה עבדה או מה היה מסוכן בה, ונותן כלל אחד לזכור.
- בסוף הנקודה מקבלים כוכבים, סיכום ותרגיל למגרש האמיתי.

מה מחכה לכם
- מסלול למידה של 6 יחידות, מהיסודות ועד יחידה שלמה על משחק עם הזכוכית.
- תרגול חכם שחוזר לנקודות שבהן התקשיתם.
- ניתוח וידאו: מעלים קטע של עד דקה מהמשחק שלכם, וראלי מחזיר משוב, רגעים לצפייה חוזרת ותרגיל. הניתוח הראשון בחינם לכל חשבון.
- שאלו את ראלי: צ׳אט קצר על טקטיקה, חבטות ותנועה בזוג.
- רצף יומי עם מגני רצף, ליגה שבועית ודירוג אישי שעולה איתכם.
- 3 כדורים ביום בחינם. כל החלטה על המגרש עולה כדור.

מתחילים בלי הרשמה
משחקים מיד, בלי חשבון. כדי לשמור את ההתקדמות ולנתח סרטון, מתחברים עם Google או Apple.

Smash Pro
- כדורים ללא הגבלה
- כל היחידות פתוחות מיד
- ניתוחי וידאו נוספים

Smash Pro הוא מנוי חודשי או שנתי שמתחדש אוטומטית. המחיר מוצג באפליקציה לפני הרכישה. התשלום מחויב בחשבון ה-Apple ID עם אישור הרכישה. המנוי מתחדש אוטומטית, אלא אם מבטלים אותו לפחות 24 שעות לפני סוף התקופה הנוכחית. ניהול וביטול בהגדרות החשבון ב-App Store.

תנאי שימוש: https://smashking.vercel.app/terms
מדיניות פרטיות: https://smashking.vercel.app/privacy

name: Smolga - Redact Files
description:
Share a file while keeping personal details private. Smolga helps you decide what stays visible.

- Blur, pixelate or cover faces in photos and videos.
- Black out names, addresses and bank details in PDFs, Office documents and text files.
- Strip metadata such as GPS location from the copy you share.

Open a file, review the suggested areas and choose what to hide. Compare the redacted copy with the original before sharing. Your source file stays intact.

Processing happens on your iPhone, iPhone Duo or iPad. It works offline, with no account, processing server or tracking. Buy once with no subscription. Available in 15 languages.

name: SMX Fantasy League
description:
SMX Fantasy League by NELMGERIAN MX is a free fantasy game for supercross and motocross fans. Start a league with your riding buddies, draft your riders, set your lineup every race weekend and talk trash in the forum.

TWO WAYS TO PLAY
- Team Owner: run a snake draft with your friends. Draft 3 riders in 450 and 3 in 250, start 2 in each class every race and keep 1 on your bench. Make trades, add and drop free agents, and use waivers all season.
- Top 10 Match: no draft needed. Pick the Top 10 in each class every race weekend and score points for every rider you place, with bonus points for the exact spot.

NATIONAL TOP 10 RANKINGS
Your Top 10 picks also count toward national rankings, with no league needed. Pick for 450 & 250, WMX, SMX Next and KTM Junior and see how you stack up against everyone.

EVERYTHING FOR RACE WEEKEND
- Countdown to the next lock, so you never miss a deadline
- Race center with the full schedule and results
- Live draft room with a draft queue
- Standings, team logos and weekly movement
- Pick reminders and draft, trade and forum alerts

BRING YOUR CREW
Invite friends with a link, a QR code or by email. Public leagues are open if you want to play against new people.

FREE TO PLAY
No purchases, no betting and no cash prizes. Just bragging rights.

The same account works on the website at fantasy.nelmgerian.com.

SMX Fantasy League is an independent fan game made by Nelmgerian MX LLC. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by Feld Entertainment, SuperMotocross, AMA Supercross, the Pro Motocross Championship or any team or rider.

name: Snaps Hrvatska
description:
Snaps Hrvatska je potpuno offline pomoćnik i vježbalica za hrvatski lokalni Šnaps (66), namijenjen domaćim igračima, gostima i svima koji žele mirno preigrati ruku prije pravog stola.

IGRAJTE I VJEŽBAJTE
• Automatska podjela ili ručno slaganje karata, aduta i špila.
• Vidite protivnikovu ruku kada želite simulirati obje strane.
• Provjera dopuštenih poteza prema pravilima pratnje boje i aduta.
• Brak, adutski brak, zamjena aduta, zatvaranje igre i vučenje karata.
• Poništavanje posljednjeg poteza i pregled svakog štiha.

BODOVI I PRAVILA
• Automatsko bodovanje: A=11, 10=10, K=4, Q=3, J=2.
• Brak 20 bodova, adutski brak 40 bodova.
• Zatvor, šnaps i detaljan izvor svakog boda.
• Dvije bazne varijante: hrvatska obala i austrijski original.
• Vlastita pravila s nazivom, spremanjem, uređivanjem i izvozom snapshota.
• Brzi vodič, potpuna pravila, pojmovnik hrvatsko-engleski i zbirka čestih grešaka.

ARHIV I REPLAY
• Snimite partiju u bilo kojem trenutku.
• Bilješke, oznake, preimenovanje i brisanje snimaka.
• Reprodukcija poteza s pauzom, korakom naprijed/natrag i skokom na kraj.
• Izvoz zapisnika i slike stola za razgovor s prijateljima.

TRI TEME
Jadranski dan, Noćna luka i Konoba — odaberite ugođaj koji vam odgovara.

Napomena: aplikacija je pomoćnik za učenje i vlastito preigravanje. Nije službeni turnirski softver i ne zamjenjuje dogovor igrača za stolom.

name: SnowDesk – Christmas Snow
description:
SnowDesk turns your iPhone and iPad into a cosy winter scene.

• Snow your way: amount, fall speed, wind and flake size
• Tap the snow and the snowman, or shake your device to knock the snowdrift away
• Visitors: a little orange snowplow, Santa with his sack, a cheeky green Yeti and the Angry Snowman chasing Santa, a well-fed Santa with his reindeer, Santa coming down the chimney and Santa's sleigh
• 27 original wallpapers: Christmas, fairy-tale ones for kids, modern ones and 2 for New Year's Eve
• New Year's Eve mode with fireworks and a countdown to midnight
• Save a Lock Screen wallpaper (photo or Live Photo) with step-by-step instructions
• Widgets: days until Christmas Eve, a snowman-and-tree scene, New Year countdown
• Live Activity and Dynamic Island countdown to Christmas Eve or midnight
• 12 original music loops (off by default)
• One purchase, all your Apple devices: SnowDesk for iPhone, iPad and Mac

SnowDesk doesn't collect any data.

name: SoialWindOne
description: SoialWindOneDesigned for those who need to manage both daily income/expenses and personal charitable contributions. You can record income, expenditures, and inter-account transfers; locate original transactions by amount; and then break down each entry into charitable donations, additional fees, and personal expenses. A dedicated "pledge" section tracks fulfilled amounts versus remaining commitments, allowing you to adjust goals and review the history of any changes. For matching-gift programs, you can manage calculations (within a shared cap), track sponsor confirmations and actual disbursements, log batches by project, and separately record individual refunds or the withdrawal of matching funds. Monthly reviews summarize expenses by payment date and verify the amounts actually received by beneficiaries based on delivery dates. A shopping log allows you to browse purchase history by category (using illustrations), estimate costs for planned purchases, track actual payments and returns/refunds, and compare these against your monthly budget.

name: Solivara
description:
Solivara is an offline island-rescue puzzle game about smart route planning on the open sea.

You command a rescue ship across tropical waters filled with survivors, islands, reefs, storms, shallow areas, and fuel stations. Study the map, plan an efficient route, pick up survivors, and deliver them safely to the correct islands before your fuel runs out.

Features:
• Strategic route planning instead of twitch controls
• 40 handcrafted rescue missions with rising difficulty
• Manage fuel, passenger capacity, and travel time
• Avoid reefs, storms, and dangerous waters
• Upgrade your ship in the Shipyard
• Unlock achievements and track your progress
• Fully offline — no ads, no account, no internet required

Every mission is a puzzle. Chart the safest path, save every survivor, and become the master of Solivara’s seas.

name: Sollinea
description:
Sollinea is a calm offline composition reference studio for photographers, designers, and anyone who cares about framing. Import a photo, align it with classic guides, preview crop ratios, and export a new image—without filters, without touching your originals.

What you can do

• Eight composition templates — Rule of thirds, golden spiral, golden triangle, center cross, diagonal lines, leading lines, frame-in-frame, and negative space.

• See guides on your photo — Pan, pinch, and zoom to align your subject; use Compare to hide overlays and check the shot underneath.

• Aspect ratio preview — Toggle an independent crop frame; composition guides adapt inside the frame when both are on.

• Line style you control — Color presets, opacity, and line width—readable on bright or dark images.

• Export two ways
— With guides — Save a reference image with lines (and crop frame if enabled).
— Clean — Full-resolution photo with no guides.
Exports are added to your library only; your originals stay unchanged.

• Notes — Jot shooting ideas on the canvas; pick up again from Photo Notes when you open the same photo.

• Drafts — Tap Save Draft to keep a local copy with your guides, ratio, line style, and notes—reopen from Drafts even if the library original is gone.

• Favorites — Star the templates you use most; switch between All and Favorites on the home screen.

• Offline & private — No sign-in, no upload. Notes, drafts, and favorites stay on your device.

Sollinea is not a filter or retouching app. It does not browse your photo library or sync to the cloud—only photos you choose are imported, and only when you export or save a draft.

name: Solpylon Ring
description:
One ring blocks another. Which one can you free first? Solpylon Ring is a spatial puzzle game with 50 levels set in an ancient Egyptian temple. Every ring you release makes room for the next move.

HOW TO PLAY
Touch and drag a ring to rotate it. Watch how its opening lines up with the pieces around it. When the ring has room to slip free, it drops away. If it gets stuck halfway through a turn, look for the piece that's blocking it and see if you can release that one first. Clearing a crowded board takes both the right angle and the right order.

CHALLENGES IN THE TEMPLE
• Start with simpler ring arrangements, then tackle boards where several pieces block one another.
• Work around chains and blockers. On levels with ticking bombs, clear the puzzle before the countdown runs out.
• Solve rescue puzzles by untangling the rings that hold a cat captive.
• Earn coins by releasing rings. If you're stuck, spend coins on a hint to remove a ring and give yourself room to continue.

Unlock levels as you go. Your progress is saved between sessions, so you can pick up where you left off or revisit a cleared level and try a different first move.

name: Soltar: desahógate y suelta
description:
Algunas cosas pesan menos cuando las sacas de tu cabeza. Soltar es un espacio para escribir lo que sientes, sin filtro y sin que nadie lo lea, y dejarlo ir.

CÓMO FUNCIONA
Abres la app y ya puedes escribir. Cuando termines, elige cómo soltarlo:
• Papel: la hoja se arruga hasta hacerse una bola y rebota fuera de la pantalla.
• Fuego: el papel se quema desde una esquina hasta no dejar nada.
• Humo: la hoja se deshace en pedacitos que suben y se disipan.
Después de soltar, no queda nada.

PRIVACIDAD, DE VERDAD
• Lo que escribes no se guarda en ningún lugar. Existe solo mientras la app está abierta.
• No hay cuentas, registro, anuncios ni analíticas.
• Nada de lo que escribes sale de tu dispositivo.

PENSADA PARA LA NOCHE
Modo oscuro automático, un diseño sereno y una vibración suave al soltar.

PARA CUANDO EL DÍA SE TE QUEDA ATRAVESADO
Una discusión, una preocupación, algo que no puedes decirle a nadie. A veces basta con escribirlo y verlo desaparecer.

IMPORTANTE
Soltar es un espacio para desahogarte y no sustituye la atención de un profesional de salud mental. Si estás pasando por un momento muy difícil o piensas en hacerte daño, busca ayuda de inmediato: la app incluye un acceso para encontrar líneas de ayuda en tu país.

name: SOME Cyber Security
description:
Not all of cyber security. Just some.

SOME Cyber Security is the phone-first front door to the cybersecurity field — built for two people: the total novice who knows nothing about it, and the practitioner who needs to brush up.

TWO TRACKS
Pick Novice ("I don't know anything about it") or Aficionado ("brush me up"). Switch any time — your progress stays, stored only on your device.

WHAT IT IS
What cybersecurity actually is, the fields inside it — defense (blue team), offense (red team), the SOC, GRC, forensics, cloud security — and what the work looks like day to day.

GET INVOLVED
The real doors in: help desk to security, certifications, labs, a home lab, degrees, apprenticeships — and what employers actually ask for.

FOUNDATIONS
Seven short lessons that everything else stands on: networking (TCP/IP, DNS, ports), how the web works, Linux basics, the CIA triad, threats/vulnerabilities/risk, passwords & MFA, and phishing — each with key points, plus a five-question concept check with your best score saved.

PENETRATION TESTING, IN FULL
What a pentest is, phase by phase — rules of engagement and scope, recon, scanning, exploitation, post-exploitation, reporting — and the five kinds of tests. The profession's first rule is taught first: you only test systems you own or have written permission to test.

THE TOOLBOX
The famous tools made plain, one card each: Kali Linux, Metasploit, Wireshark, Nmap, Burp Suite, and the home lab — what each is, what it is for, and how professionals learn it.

CAREERS & CERTS
The honest sequence — Google Cybersecurity Certificate, CompTIA Security+, PenTest+/CEH, OSCP — plus the practice platforms (TryHackMe, Hack The Box, OverTheWire) that serve as the gym.

FOR ORGANIZATIONS
Cybersecurity firms, municipalities, and governments: awareness seats for staff, workforce-pipeline cohorts, and a plain-language briefing layer — $1 per person per month, $99/month minimum, arranged directly with our team.

Plain language. Phone-first. Disciplined, legal, and in demand — that's the field, and that's this app.

PREMIUM SUBSCRIPTION
Premium ($4.99/month or $49/year) unlocks both full tracks, all Foundations lessons, Penetration Testing In Full, concept checks with saved scores, and the full Careers & Certs roadmap. Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period; your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the period ends. Manage or cancel anytime in your App Store account settings.

name: Sori: Korean Pronunciation
description:
You know the Hangul letters. Then you see 학교, and the second syllable sounds like 꾜. Sori shows the written word, the spoken form and the rule that connects them.

Start with eight words to find your place. Practice with a set of ten and see each change after you answer. Miss a word and it comes back in a short review three hours later. Track the days you practice and see how you’re doing across six pronunciation rules.

The daily set, reviews and practice in the first two chapters are free. Sori Full is a one-time purchase for unlimited daily sets, full lessons and practice in every chapter. Progress stays on your device. Optional reminders and a Home Screen widget bring you a word a day.

name: Sort Orchard : Puzzle logic
description:
Drag matching fruit together and fill colorful bowls in Sort Orchard, a relaxing logic puzzle with 500 levels.

Move a single fruit or a group of matching fruit. Use the white bowl to make room, then plan your moves to fill each fruit’s matching bowl.

Start with simple boards and work your way up to mystery fruit, frozen branches, and new branches that appear as you collect bowls. Reveal hidden fruit at the tip of a branch and fill a bowl to unlock frozen branches.

• Play 500 levels at your own pace.
• Use hints or undo a move when you get stuck.
• Earn coins as you clear levels for the first time.
• Play offline and pick up where you left off.

name: Sortd: Eisenhower Matrix
description:
Sortd is the Eisenhower matrix as four program windows on a 1998 desktop. Every task goes where it belongs, so you always know what to do next.

DO IT NOW · urgent and important
PLAN IT · important, not urgent
PASS IT · urgent, not important
RECYCLE BIN · neither. let it go

TYPE IT LIKE A TEXT
"pay rent tmrw 6pm !! #red every month" lands in do it now, due tomorrow at 6pm, tagged red, repeating monthly. "!" means important, "urgent" means urgent, "meh" sends it to the bin.

EVERYTHING A TASK NEEDS
Due dates and times, reminders, repeating tasks, subtasks, colour tags, notes, and tasks or calendar-only events. Drag tasks between windows when priorities change.

STAY LOCKED IN
A 25-minute focus timer with a Live Activity on your Lock Screen and Dynamic Island. Insights show your streak, focus minutes and a weekly "how sortd were you" score.

WIDGETS EVERYWHERE
The matrix on your Home Screen with tickable checkboxes, a single-window checklist, year progress, streak and Lock Screen widgets, plus a quick-add control for Control Center and the Action button.

WORKS WITH APPLE APPS
Import your Apple Reminders, see Apple Calendar events next to your tasks, and add tasks with Siri and Shortcuts.

ON IPHONE, IPAD AND MAC
One purchase, synced through your own iCloud. Designed for iPhone, iPad and Mac, with a full desktop layout on bigger screens.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No accounts, no ads, no tracking. Your tasks live on your devices and in your private iCloud.

SORTD PRO
Free gives you up to 20 open tasks with the full matrix, quick add, reminders and widgets. Pro unlocks unlimited tasks, repeating tasks, subtasks, the focus timer, the calendar view and insights.
• Monthly: $3.99
• Yearly: $19.99 with a 7-day free trial
• Lifetime: $39.99 one-time
Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage them in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://www.dashovia.com/apps/sortd/privacy/

name: Sotto Messenger
description:
Sotto is a private messenger for a small circle of people who know each other.

There is no phone number, no email address and no contact upload. You pick a username, and you are let in by an admin or with an invitation code.

Everything you send is encrypted on your iPhone and can only be read by the people you send it to. The server passes along scrambled data and deletes each message once it is delivered.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Message one person or a group, with replies, reactions, editing and disappearing messages
• Send photos, files and voice messages
• Make voice and video calls that never reveal your internet address
• Lock a chat so it disappears from the list until you type a secret code
• Share your travel schedule, or say it out loud and let Sotto fill it in on the phone
• Plan a dinner, a coffee or a game of tennis, with a place and replies
• Share your live location for fifteen minutes, an hour, or until you stop
• Add someone in person with a code, or by holding two phones together

HOW IT IS KEPT PRIVATE
• Your keys are made on your iPhone and never leave it
• Compare a safety number to be sure nobody is in between
• Sotto never reads or writes your Contacts
• No ads, no analytics, no tracking

You need an invitation to join.

name: SoundFix: Speaker Cleaner
description:
Got your iPhone wet? Speaker sounding muffled? SoundFix plays carefully tuned low-frequency tones that make your speaker's membrane move, pushing water and dust out of the grille.

SPEAKER CLEANER
• Water Eject: 165 Hz pulses push water out of the speaker
• Dust Clean: sweeping tones shake dust loose
• Deep Clean: a 60-second combined program (Pro)
• Custom: choose your own cleaning frequency (Pro)
• Optional vibration while cleaning

DECIBEL METER
• Live sound level in dB with min, average and max
• Dominant frequency in Hz
• 15-second history chart

SPEAKER TEST
• Left, right and stereo channel tests
• Bass, treble and full 20 Hz – 20 kHz sweeps
• Tone generator with sine, square, triangle and saw waves

For the best result, turn the volume all the way up and place your phone face down. Repeat 2–3 times if the sound is still muffled.

FREE OR PRO
Free cleanings start after a short rewarded video. SoundFix Pro removes the videos and unlocks Deep Clean, custom frequencies and every waveform.

SoundFix Pro is offered as an auto-renewing subscription (weekly with a free trial, or yearly). Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel in your Apple ID account settings. Any unused portion of a free trial is forfeited when you purchase a subscription.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://soundfix-app.vercel.app/privacy

SoundFix's decibel readings are estimates from the iPhone microphone, not a calibrated instrument. SoundFix cannot repair hardware damage.

name: Spade Room: Spades Card Game
description:
Spade Room is the classic four-player partnership card game. You and your partner sit across from two computer opponents who play real Spades: they count cards, protect a partner who bid nil, and will set you if you overbid.

Pick your table:
Easy: a relaxed game while you learn.
Normal: solid players who make their bids.
Hard: sharks who read every card that falls.

FEATURES
- Classic rules: nil, blind nil, bags with a 100-point penalty at 10, play to 300 or 500
- A coach that suggests a bid and shows which cards look like winners
- A hint button when you are stuck on a play
- Clear scoring after every hand, so you always know where the points came from
- Save and resume, stats, and a how-to-play guide
- Smooth animations, haptics and gentle sound

No ads. No accounts. No data collected. Plays completely offline.

name: SparesYard: JCB Spare Parts
description:
SparesYard is a marketplace for JCB spare parts from Indian sellers. Search for the part you need, see what different sellers offer, and send one quote request.

SEARCH YOUR WAY
- Search by part number, part name, machine model or seller.
- Browse by category or by machine (for example 3CX and 4CX backhoe loaders).
- Search by voice, or send a photo of a part and the SparesYard team will help identify it.

COMPARE SELLERS
- See every seller's offer on a part in one place: price, quantity price breaks, minimum order quantity, stock and condition (genuine or aftermarket).
- View seller stores and their ratings.

PRICES IN YOUR CURRENCY
- Prices are shown in your own currency using daily exchange rates. They are approximate; the final price is confirmed in the quote.
- Set your delivery country so quotes are prepared for shipping to you.

ONE QUOTE REQUEST
- Add parts to your quote list and send a single request. SparesYard passes it to the relevant sellers, who reply with their price and shipping.
- Chat with the SparesYard team inside the app.

YOUR LANGUAGE
- Available in English, Arabic (right to left), Spanish, French, Portuguese and Russian.

PLEASE NOTE
SparesYard is in an early pilot. Buying is by quote: you agree payment, invoice and delivery directly with the seller. Online payment and order tracking are not available yet. Check part numbers and your machine's serial number before ordering.
SparesYard is an independent marketplace and is not affiliated with J C Bamford Excavators Ltd. JCB is a trademark of its owner and is used only to describe compatibility.

A product by Intellivane.com.

name: SparkysStudio
description:
Sparky's Studio is a little gallery where every painting paints itself in front of you.

Tap a painting and watch it come together from a blank canvas. First the shapes go down, then thousands of brushstrokes follow the light, then the glow comes in last. You can watch it live or scrub back and forth through every stroke.

Every painting comes with its story. Where it came from, what it's about, and what went wrong on the way, because the mistakes are half the fun. A figure with no head, trees like lollipops, a moon that came out as a lightsaber. How I Made It shows you the bones, the brushes and the light, step by step.

Wander the gallery or browse the albums, from quiet places to night skies to water and light. Open the Live Window to see a quiet yard under your own sky, right now. The sun, the moon in its real phase, and the stars sit where they really are over you, and if you share a rough location, your weather comes in too, rain, fog and all.

When you're ready, it's your turn. Pick a scene and five colors, remix one of the paintings, or bring a photo of your own and watch the same brushes paint it, keeping its colors or remapping them. Turn on Looser for bigger strokes and more paint, with the finest brush saved for faces.

Then come sit on the porch. A porch at night paints itself, there's a line waiting for you on the step, and you can leave whatever's on your mind. It stays on your device. Every night you come out, a light comes on along the rail.

Keep anything you love at full size. Every painting is painted again, crisp, as wallpaper for iPhone, iPad or Mac, filled to the edges or floating over a soft blur. Or export every painting in every size into a folder in one go.

Sparky's Studio runs on iPhone, iPad and Mac.

Everything here was made from nothing. No accounts, no tracking, no ads. Your paintings, your photos and what you leave on the porch stay on your device. The only thing that ever goes out is a rounded location to ask for your weather, if you choose to share it.

name: Speaker Rescue: Remove Water
description:
Speaker sounding muffled after a swim, a spill or a rainy day? Speaker Rescue pushes trapped water out of your phone's speaker with sound, then checks with your microphone that your audio is really back.

Most speaker cleaners play a tone and hope for the best. Speaker Rescue shows you the result.

HOW IT WORKS
A low-frequency tone makes your speaker vibrate and pushes water out through the grille. Turn your volume up, hold the phone with the speaker facing down, and tap Eject water.

CHECK IT WORKED
• Clarity check: a quick sweep of tones, measured with your mic, shows whether your sound is muffled
• Before and after: see your speaker's sound compared before and after cleaning
• Honest results: if there's too much background noise to tell, the app says so instead of guessing

AUTO CLEAN
Cleans, checks, and repeats, then stops as soon as your speaker sounds normal. No need to guess how long to run it.

CLEAN BETTER
• Three tone patterns: steady, sweep and pulse
• Clean the bottom speaker, the earpiece, or each stereo speaker separately
• Vibration boost shakes the phone along with the tone
• Dust mode helps loosen dust and debris
• Quick, Normal and Deep intensities

TONE GENERATOR
Play any tone from 20 to 1000 Hz, with presets for water, dust and testing.

GOOD TO KNOW
• Don't charge your phone while it's wet
• Skip the rice: let it air-dry with the speaker facing down
• Water resistance isn't the same as waterproof
• If sound is still off after cleaning, your speaker may need a repair rather than more cleaning

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
The microphone is only used during a clarity check. Nothing is recorded, saved or uploaded. No accounts and no tracking.

PAY ONCE
No ads. No subscription. No in-app purchases. Every feature is included.

Speaker Rescue helps with water and dust in your speaker grille. It can't fix hardware damage.

name: Spectrum VJ: Music Visualizer
description:
Spectrum VJ turns your music into a living light show. Every bass hit, snare and melody drives real-time GPU visuals, from neon spectrum bars to swirling galaxies, liquid chrome and 3D tunnels.

Completely free. No ads. No subscriptions. No in-app purchases. No account.

YOUR MUSIC, THE MIC, OR A BUILT-IN BEAT
• Playlist: import songs from Files or DRM-free songs from your Music library, with shuffle, repeat, background playback and lock-screen controls
• Microphone: visualize live sound, a speaker in the room, a band, or music playing from another app
• Simulation: a built-in electronic beat, so the visuals come alive with no song needed

50+ AUDIO-REACTIVE SCENES
Spectrum bars, radial album-cover spectrum, oscilloscope, pulsar ridges, 3D audio terrain, neon tunnel, laser show, prism, magic rings, galaxy, aurora, electric storm, ferrofluid, liquid ether, synthwave, CRT warp and many more. Each one follows the music through bass, mids, treble and a live beat detector that also shows the song's BPM.

60+ PRESETS, OR BUILD YOUR OWN LOOK
• 18 color palettes, or colors pulled automatically from the album art
• Milkdrop-style trails, kaleidoscope, mirror, RGB split, pixelate, bloom glow, beat flash and shake
• LED edge light: an ambient glow around the screen edges that pulses with the music
• Save your looks and share them with friends as preset codes

MAKE IT PERSONAL
Shape Waves fills the screen with your own shape: pick a symbol, type your name, or upload a photo. The background is removed automatically so just the subject waves and pulses to the beat.

AUTOPILOT VJ MODE
Go hands-free. Autopilot switches presets in time with the music, every 32 beats or whatever you choose. Great for parties, streams, studios and chill nights.

RECORD AND SHARE
Record clean videos with audio, with no buttons or overlays in the shot, and save stunning snapshots straight to Photos.

MORE
• Beat haptics and an optional flashlight strobe
• Smooth 60 or 120 fps on ProMotion displays
• Built for iPhone and iPad, including the foldable iPhone Duo, with layouts that keep controls clear of the fold
• Simple gestures: swipe for the next preset, double-tap to remix the effects

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
All audio is analyzed on your device. Nothing is recorded or sent anywhere unless you choose to save a video or snapshot.

Note: Spectrum VJ shows bright, fast-moving and flashing visuals. If you are sensitive to flashing lights, lower the Beat Flash setting and keep the flashlight strobe off.

Privacy policy: Privacy Policy: https://digitalhole.github.io/DHPrivacy.html
Standard Apple Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Speed Ex Cargo
description:
Con la app de Speed Ex Cargo sabes en todo momento dónde está tu mercancía rumbo a Cuba.

RASTREA TU ENVÍO
• Busca con el número HBL de tu recibo, la guía aérea o el C.I. del destinatario.
• Mira el estado actual y la línea de tiempo completa: pedido en sistema, recibido en almacén, preparación para despacho, embarque en contenedor, tránsito marítimo, arribo al puerto de destino, proceso de aduana y camino a provincia.
• Consulta el historial de estados con sus fechas.
• Si un número tiene varios destinatarios, cambia entre ellos con un toque.

RECIBE AVISOS AL INSTANTE
• Toca "Avisarme cuando cambie" y te enviamos una notificación cada vez que tu envío avanza o presenta una demora.
• Sigue todos tus envíos desde "Mis envíos".

HABLA CON NOSOTROS
• Escríbenos por el chat de la app y te respondemos ahí mismo; la respuesta te llega como notificación.
• Acceso directo a WhatsApp y llamada.

Sin contraseñas: para rastrear solo necesitas tu número de envío. Para el chat te pedimos tu nombre, correo y teléfono, así sabemos quién eres y atendemos mejor tus envíos.

name: Spindlewell
description:
Spindlewell is a portrait glass puzzle you turn in three dimensions.

A well of rings hangs in the dark. Drag a ring sideways and it clicks one notch. Drag the round dial, or the empty glass, to orbit the well. Each filament — Tide, Ember, or Coral — has to fall from its own gem, through the beads, and down to its own lantern.

Four halls sit on the bench. Glassmouth is shallow and straight. Copperturn adds elbows that jump a filament from one pillar to another. Ratchet Reach only turns onward. Frostdeep hides a ring until you orbit to its clear side. A seam pin stays shut until the light above it is true. Thin glass fogs if the wrong lantern catches a spark, and the tongs rewind that one notch.

Match the par with a bare eye and the seal is Keen. Carry a lens if you want a ghost of the true beads, one helpful notch, or a turn toward the frost. Any spent lens caps the seal at True. Ingots and Keen streaks stay on this device. The Dawn Commission is mixed from today's date, and only your own best is kept.

name: Spirit Quest Way of the Saints
description:
# Spirit Quest: Way of the Saints

**Discover the Saints. Explore the World. Grow in Faith.**

What if every walk could become an adventure of faith?

Welcome to **Spirit Quest: Way of the Saints**, a one-of-a-kind Catholic adventure game that brings the inspiring lives of the saints into the world around you!

Combining real-world exploration, augmented reality (AR), and beautifully illustrated characters, Spirit Quest invites players of all ages to embark on a journey of discovery, learning, and spiritual inspiration.

**EXPLORE THE WORLD AROUND YOU**

Turn everyday walks, neighborhood adventures, and visits to local parks into exciting journeys of faith!

Using GPS technology and the beautifully illustrated Adventure Atlas map, discover saint markers hidden throughout your surroundings. When you get close enough, the markers turn blue, signaling that a new saint encounter is ready.

**FIND SAINTS THROUGH AUGMENTED REALITY**

Bring the adventure to life with your iPhone camera!

Search your surroundings using augmented reality to discover beautifully illustrated Catholic saints. Follow the on-screen prompts, locate the hidden saint, and tap their character to collect a piece of their inspiring story.

**COLLECT SAINTS AND DISCOVER THEIR STORIES**

Every saint has a story worth discovering!

Explore a collection of **225 Catholic saints**, each featuring four unique illustrated historical fact cards.

Discover fascinating details about their lives, including their calling, journeys of faith, remarkable acts of courage, and lasting spiritual legacies.

Complete all four chapters of a saint's story to unlock a special biography scroll and discover even more about their extraordinary life.

**DISCOVER DAILY GRACE**

New adventures await with Grace Near Me!

Discover 25 daily saint encounters in a nearby search area. Explore, find saints, collect Grace, and uncover new stories as you continue your journey.

**EXPLORE PARKS AND COMPLETE QUESTS**

Take your adventure beyond your neighborhood!

Discover parks, embark on special saint quests, and enjoy faith-filled exploration in the great outdoors.

Whether you're walking through your favorite park or discovering somewhere new, every journey becomes an opportunity to learn about the saints.

**EARN SPIRITUAL REWARDS**

Your discoveries lead to exciting rewards!

- Collect Grace through saint encounters.
- Unlock beautifully illustrated spiritual treasures.
- Advance through Catholic-inspired pilgrim ranks.
- Complete saint collections and earn special achievements.
- Reveal hidden rewards as you progress.

**MAKE THE ADVENTURE YOUR OWN**

Create your own explorer profile, choose your favorite saint as your character portrait, and personalize your username.

Track your Grace, view your saint collection, follow your progress, and celebrate every discovery along the way.

**A CATHOLIC ADVENTURE FOR ALL AGES**

Spirit Quest: Way of the Saints brings together faith, history, education, and outdoor exploration in a colorful, family-friendly experience.

Whether you're a parent introducing your children to the saints, a young adventurer discovering Catholic history, or someone looking to deepen your faith, there's always another inspiring story waiting to be found.

**THE JOURNEY TO HOLINESS IS AN ADVENTURE!**

Every saint began as an ordinary person who answered an extraordinary call.

Explore their stories. Discover their courage. Be inspired by their faith.

**Download Spirit Quest: Way of the Saints and start your adventure today!**

name: Splinter Kick
description:
Splinter Kick is a martial-arts brawler where every fighter is a jointed ragdoll and every blow lands exactly where it hits.

SURVIVE THE ARENA
Fight round after round of tougher opponents. Clear a round and pick one of three perks: knuckle rings, pauldrons, wisps and more show up on your fighter as gear. Elites, champions and spike beds wait further in.

GRAB A WEAPON
Knives, swords and staffs lie in the arena. Swing them, parry with them, or throw them across the yard and watch them stick.

REAL PHYSICS
Strikes connect with the limb that throws them. Fighters stagger, limp, fold up and go down as ragdolls, and every bruise and scuff stays on their gi.

DRESS YOUR FIGHTER
Earn tokens in every fight and spend them on hats, outfits, capes, hit sparks and knockout finishers.

- Touch controls made for phones and tablets
- Game Center leaderboard for your best round
- Plays offline
- Free to play, with optional token packs

name: Splitdibs
description:
Planning is something you can split too.

A weekend away, a holiday, New Year's Eve with friends: create your project, drop the link in your group chat, and everyone pitches in, their own way.

How it works
• Create your project: pick what you're planning and Splitdibs suggests the usual tasks.
• Share the link: your friends see straight away what's still up for grabs.
• Everyone pitches in, their own way: tap "I'll take it", then "It's done". Everyone can see where things stand.

Every task has a name next to it. Nobody has to hand out jobs, and nobody has to chase people to find out what's done.

Keep WhatsApp for chatting and Tricount for the money. Splitdibs does one thing: who does what.

Free, no ads.

name: SpoolFill: Reel Backing Plan
description:
Plan a mixed-line fishing reel fill before winding. Enter a published or measured reference capacity, the diameters of the two lines, and the length of the main line you want to keep. SpoolFill estimates the backing length that occupies the remaining capacity and flags a main line that will not fit.

Compare two backing diameters, add a reserve, and check the capacity diagram before buying line. Save named setups to a local rack and share a winding card. Switch between meters and yards without changing the physical lengths.

This is a nominal estimate assuming comparable packing. Actual capacity varies with line shape, tension, and the spool; check in practice. Works offline without an account, advertising, or subscription.

name: Spoolhand: Pipefitter Calc
description:
Calculate pipe cut lengths. Check fitting dimensions. Share PDF cut sheets.
Built for pipefitters, steamfitters and pipe welders, with every step shown and the catalog sources for each dimension.
One purchase. No subscription, no ads, no account. Works offline.
