Offsets and rolling offsets, takeouts, fittings and flange bolting, in feet, inches and sixteenths or in millimeters. All calculations and tables work with no signal.

EVERY NUMBER SHOWS ITS WORK
• Reference dimensions agree in at least two published manufacturer or distributor catalogs, and each one says which.
• A value worked out from a formula says so and shows the formula.
• Every layout answer shows its steps: travel, run, takeouts, gaps and the cut.

LAYOUT TOOLS
Each one starts from your pipe: size, schedule, fitting (butt-weld long or short radius, socket-weld, threaded) and gap.
• Simple offset and fixed-dimension offset
• Rolling offset
• Parallel offsets
• Odd angle from a 90, with the cut marks
• Back-to-back fittings
• Tee branch offset
• Miter elbow, with the wrap template
• Fishmouth & saddle, with templates
• Lateral
• Dummy leg
• Flange 2-holing

REFERENCE TABLES
Pipe (OD, wall, ID, weight), butt-weld elbows, tees, reducing tees, reducers, caps and stub ends, forged socket-weld and threaded fittings, malleable-iron fittings, NPT threads, and flanges with their bolting and tightening order. Fractions or decimals, inches or millimeters.

JOBS AND CUT SHEETS
Save calculations to a job, reopen and change them, and share a PDF cut sheet with the drawing and every step, letter or A4.

TRADE CALCULATOR
Feet, inches and sixteenths with a paper tape. Send any layout result straight to it.

BUILT FOR THE JOB SITE
Large keys (at least 56 points), high contrast, light and dark, landscape, and a side-by-side layout on iPad.

Found a number that doesn't match? Use Report a wrong number on any calculation or table row. We check it against the catalogs and fix confirmed errors.

Verify critical dimensions against the current standard before fabrication.

name: SpoonFlipper
description:
Pick your favorite spoon and play SpoonFlipper the Stress-free Fidget game.

Give your spoon a spin and see how far it can go. Collect coins, discover new spoons, and choose a background that fits your mood. Whether you love shiny silver, colorful designs, or something a little unexpected, there’s a spoon waiting for you.

Make each spin your own:

• Collect a growing variety of spoons, from classic silver to wonderfully quirky designs.
• Pick a setting for your spoon, from cozy scenes to faraway worlds.
• Earn coins and unlock upgrades to add speed and keep the spins going.
• Choose effects and discover little surprises along the way.
• Come back for daily rewards and see what you can unlock next.
• Seasonal Rewards now available!

SpoonFlipper is a playful little fidget game for anyone who appreciates the joy of a really good spoon.

Which spoon will you choose?

name: Spring Meadows CoC
description:
This app will help you stay connected with the day-to-day life of our Spring Meadows. With this app you can: read and listen to the Bible; share prayer requests; stay updated with notifications; and more.

Mobile app version: 6.24.8

name: SpringBrookMarine
description:
Spring Brook Marine Group's app puts your boat experience in one place.

For clients:
- Submit service tickets with photos and videos and follow their progress
- Review and sign contracts electronically
- Review and update your boat build sheet with your salesperson
- Browse our inventory and meet our sales team
- See upcoming events
- Request an MBN charter on an available date
- Ask us to buy or take your boat in trade
- Get notified when something changes

Create a free client account in the app. Team members receive their accounts from Spring Brook Marine Group.

name: Sprinttrain Cyclocross
description:
sprinttrain cyclocross is a bike racing game. You start in a field of twenty, hop the barriers, run up the steep banks and look for the one line through the sand that still rides.

THE RACE
Hit the button in the green box: with enough power you jump the planks, otherwise you get off and run. Steer into a rut in the sand and keep pedalling. On the cobbled climb only the smooth gutter at the edge rides easy. Brake before a sand drop, or you go over the bars. Save some power for the tarmac to the line, sit on a wheel and sprint.

FOURTEEN COURSES
A city park, floodlit woods, coastal dunes, castle grounds, a stone quarry, a muddy polder, a stadium course, a forest ridge, a wooded hollow, a racecourse at night, a ski slope in the snow, a cobbled hill, a sand pit you ride through twice a lap and a beach where the tide comes in every lap. Rain, mud, frost and snow change how each course rides.

CAREER
Start in the club races and work your way up to the Elite Cup. Six races a season, the top three move up. Win prize money, sign sponsors, buy better bikes and train.

DAILY CUP AND LIVE CUP
One course a day, the same for everyone: race the ghosts of other players and win medals and points for the week. In the Live Cup you race real riders in real time.

MORE
Winter Series with fourteen rounds. A practice lap for your first time on a cross bike. One-thumb touch control. Four difficulty levels, from Easy to Extreme.

No account, no ads, no in-app purchases. Races work offline, the Daily Cup and the Live Cup need a connection.

All names, places and races are made up.

name: Stage Crashers
description:
You are the band. The crowd is coming down the aisle, and you have to keep them off the stage.

Every tower is an instrument, and every instrument fires on the beat. Put down a drum kit and you hear the kick and snare. Add a bass amp and a synth and you have a groove. The more you build, the fuller the song gets.

WHAT YOU DO
• Place drums, bass, synth, cymbals, lead guitar, trumpet and cowbell along the aisle.
• Put a singer, a DJ or a spotlight on the stage itself. They reach the whole room.
• Collect the strings, tubes and drum skins the crowd drops, and use them to make an instrument louder, reach further or play a busier part.
• Swing crowd barriers to send people the long way round, or lay the rope line yourself before the show.
• Bend the spotlight's beam with mirrors and split it with a mirror ball.
• Stack amps for more power, and keep them away from the bouncers, who knock tall stacks over.

HOW MUCH THERE IS
• 11 hand-made levels that teach the game one idea at a time.
• After that the set list never ends. Every venue has its own layout, and some nights have a twist.
• A daily gig: the same level for everyone, once a day, with a score and a streak.

NO ADS. EVER.
The game is free and has no ads of any kind. You earn gold by playing and spend it on starting kits, lasting upgrades for your band and new looks for the venue. You can buy gold if you want to, and you never have to.

name: StampPitch: Perforation Gauge
description:
Tell apart look-alike stamps with different perforations. With a ruler or caliper, measure between the centers of two clearly visible holes and count the intervals between them. Enter the readings from both edges. StampPitch converts their spacing to perforations per 20 mm and displays the compound reading with horizontal first.

Set a measurement tolerance and compare candidate gauges against both edges. When multiple readings fit, see the ambiguity instead of getting a false match. Save labeled measurements in a local notebook, reopen and compare them, and share a measurement note. A diagram explains which points to measure.

Works without photography, a catalog, an account, or internet. It does not identify or value a stamp. The examples are synthetic and require no hardware to try.

name: Stand Strong: Level Up Life
description:
Stand Strong turns your life into a game. You get 5 quests every day. Every minute you put in is XP. Your level goes up, your rank goes up, and the character on your screen changes with you.

Stand Strong needs a subscription. You see the price in the app before you pay.

HOW YOU START

• Accept. Your life is the game now.
• Set your main quest. Finish 1 sentence in your own words: "I am going to ___." Retire my mom. Make a game the whole world plays. Become the man I needed when I was a kid. Or your own.
• See where you stand. You start at Zero, Level 1. The Hero waits at Level 100.
• Get your daily quest. The same 5 quests, every day.
• Type your vow. "I will not stop until I ___." You type it letter by letter and sign it with your name.

THE 5 DAILY QUESTS

• Wake. Set your alarm and turn it off within 15 minutes of your time.
• Workout. Pick the body you are building: Lean at home, Athletic or Big at the gym. The app gives you today's session, and each set shows what you lifted last time.
• Deep work. 50 minutes on your main quest, then 10 minutes of rest. Run as many blocks as you want.
• Reading. 20 minutes.
• Meditation. 10 minutes.

WHAT YOU GET

• XP for real effort. 1 minute is 1 XP. No gifts, no loot boxes. Your level is the minutes you put in.
• A level with no top. Each level costs a little more than the last.
• 6 ranks: Zero, Player, Hunter, Knight, Commander, Hero. At each rank your character and the world behind him change. Hero takes about 1,000 full days.
• 5 stats: Vitality, Strength, Focus, Intelligence and Mind. Each quest grows its own stat.
• A moment for every win. Clear a quest, finish the day, level up, rank up. Each one plays on your screen.
• Misses cost a little. Each quest you skip costs 5 XP at midnight, 25 a day at most. Miss enough and your rank goes back too.
• No streak to lose. The wall shows every day you played.
• Your progress stays with you. Sign in with your email, and your rank and every minute you log are saved to your account.

THE SUBSCRIPTION

Stand Strong has a yearly plan and a monthly plan. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm. Your plan renews by itself unless you turn it off at least 24 hours before the end of the period. You can manage or cancel it in your Apple Account settings. Deleting the app does not cancel it.

Questions? Email hi@standstrong.fit

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://standstrong.fit/privacy

name: StateCue
description:
StateCue shows the latest status you record on your iPhone Lock Screen. Try it for a reading session, a desk light, or another routine you track.

• Record On, Off, or Unknown in the app and preview the date-row display before you save.
• Add an inline or circular Lock Screen widget and choose a text badge or checkmark. On shows the badge. Off and Unknown hide it.
• Use the Update Lock Screen Display shortcut to control the badge and date-row text separately. Keep, show, or hide the badge, and keep, replace, or clear the text.
• On iOS 27 or later, configure the circular widget to run a shortcut you choose when the badge is visible. Any confirmation comes from that shortcut.
• Enable a Live Activity to show all three states on the Lock Screen or Dynamic Island on supported devices.
• Review local history with timestamps and record sources.

StateCue saves the values you provide. Your records stay on your device. No account, ads, or analytics are required.

name: Steady75 - 75 Day Challenge
description:
A calm, private tracker for your 75 day challenge. Pick your rules, tick off each day, and watch your grid fill up.

SET UP IN A MINUTE, FREE
Choose Strict, Medium or Soft rules, add a task of your own, pick a start date and a reminder. No account, no sign-up, and set-up and day 1 are always free.

ONE CHECKLIST A DAY
• Workouts, water, reading pages, diet and a progress photo
• Counters for glasses of water and pages read
• A note for the day
• Yesterday stays open until the end of today, for things ticked after midnight

RULES THAT WORK
• Miss a day: start again from day 1, or mark it missed and carry on. You choose.
• The app tells you when a day was missed and never restarts by itself.
• Put a past day right if you did it and forgot to tick it.
• Pause for travel or illness: paused days don't count and can't be missed.
• Start again whenever you like; your earlier run is kept.

SEE HOW FAR YOU'VE COME
• The 75-day grid: every day done, still open or missed
• Progress photos, kept only on your device

PRO
• Your own rules and as many tasks as you like, including counted ones
• Progress photo timeline and side-by-side compare
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets with your day number and today's ring
• A second reminder, and an evening nudge only on days you haven't finished
• Share cards of your progress (no photo unless you add one)
• The history of every challenge you finish

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your days and photos stay on your device. No account, no ads, no tracking.

IN 8 LANGUAGES
English, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Polish, Brazilian Portuguese and Turkish.

Pro is available as a weekly or yearly subscription, or a one-time lifetime purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and can be managed in your Apple Account settings.

Terms of use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy: https://xxlegendplayzzxx.github.io/steady75/privacy/

Steady75 is an independent app and is not affiliated with, endorsed by or connected to any other 75-day challenge program or its owners.

name: StepByPhone: Phone Help
description:
StepByPhone helps older people use their phone – calmly, step by step, in big letters.

• Guides for iPhone and iPad: bigger text, louder ringtone, quiet nights, contacts, Wi-Fi, emergency SOS and more.
• Every step says where to tap AND what it does, so nobody is afraid of breaking something.
• Ask your own question in your own words. The answer comes back to the app, usually within minutes, and is added for everyone.
• Is this text message a scam? Paste it and see at once – checked only on your phone, nothing is sent anywhere.
• Read aloud: the phone reads every guide slowly, with pauses.
• 41 languages. No account, no ads, no tracking.

Made by one person who wants parents and grandparents to feel safe with their phone.

name: Sternlight: Rules of the Road
description:
Study the Navigation Rules for the USCG captain license exam with 199 original questions, a 50-question practice exam, and drills that show you the lights and play the sound signals. Sternlight is an independent study app. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by the U.S. Coast Guard.

TONIGHT'S WATCH
- Three short drills picked for you every day, plus the questions you missed that are due for review.
- Night Watch: see the lights of a vessel at night from your own heading, then name her. Switch to Day to learn the shapes.
- Fog Horn: hear the sound signal, then say who is sounding it.
- Crossing Plot: a bearing and a heading on a compass. Who gives way?

INLAND AND INTERNATIONAL, SIDE BY SIDE
- Every rule in full, searchable, with a Differences view that marks where Inland and International part ways.
- Each question is labeled for International, Inland, or both, so you never mix them up.

PRACTICE EXAM
- 50 questions in the format of the Rules of the Road module, with a 90 percent pass mark.
- Every answer is explained, and one tap opens the rule it comes from.
- Review your mistakes after each exam, grouped by topic.

KEEP A STEADY WATCH
- Missed questions come back after 1, 3 and 7 days.
- Set your exam date and see the days left. A daily reminder at the hour you choose, and a home screen widget.
- Meet Bosun the gull, who moves up six levels as you really study.

WORKS OFFLINE
All rules and questions are on your phone, so you can study at the dock or at anchor. No account, no ads.

FREE AND PRO
Free: 20 questions per topic, 1 practice exam, 10 scenes a day in each drill, and every rule in full. Sternlight Pro is a one-time purchase that unlocks all 199 questions, unlimited practice exams and unlimited drills. No subscription.

Sources: the U.S. Coast Guard Navigation Rules and Regulations Handbook (October 2022) and 33 CFR Part 83. All questions are written by us. They are not real exam questions, and passing the practice exam does not guarantee a pass on the official exam. Sternlight is a study aid and is not for navigation. Always check current rules before you sit the exam.

name: Sternline: Fishing Guide Log
description:
Every client you take out should go home with more than a few blurry phone pictures. Sternline turns your day on the water into a clean trip recap you can send from the dock, with your name and booking link on it.

LOG ON THE WATER, SIGNAL OR NOT
Tap Log a Catch when a fish hits the net. Snap the photo, pick the species, size, lure and who caught it. The time, GPS position and air pressure are stamped for you. Everything works on the phone itself, so dead zones, open water and backcountry rivers are no problem.

SEND A RECAP FROM THE DOCK
• A photo card sized for texting, with the biggest fish, the count and your business name
• A full PDF: every catch with time, size, lure and photo, a numbered map of where they came from, sky, wind, water temperature and the day's pressure line
• Your personal note at the top and a Book Your Next Trip line at the bottom
• Email it straight to the client or share it any way you like

BUILT FOR GUIDES
• Client names and who caught each fish
• Species and lure quick picks that learn what you use
• Pressure readings from your iPhone's barometer, with the trend through the day
• Season history of every trip and every fish

PRO
Your first 3 recaps are included. Pro unlocks unlimited recaps, your logo on every recap, and CSV export of all your catches for your records.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no social feed, no ads. Trips, catches, photos and locations stay on your device.

name: still.boom
description:
still.boom turns Apple Music into a boombox.

Pick an album and it goes into the deck as a cassette, with the cover on the J-card. Press the piano keys. The reels turn, the VU meters move, and between songs you hear the tape: a soft hiss, then the next track.

TAPE MODE
Albums play whole, the way they were made. An EP fits on one side. An LP is split into side A and side B. When a side ends, the deck clicks off. Swipe the cassette to flip it: the door opens, the tape turns over, and side B starts. FF and REW wind the tape while you hold them.

FREE MODE
For everyday listening. Skip songs with a swipe or the arrows, open an album and start from any track.

RADIO
Slide the switch to RADIO and turn the dial. Four stations hide between 87 and 108. Static fades into music as you tune in.

MIXTAPES
Record a mixtape for someone: pick a cassette, name it, add a note, and fill side A, then side B with songs from Apple Music. Send it as a short link. It opens in still.boom in your cassette design, with the track list in your handwriting.

DETAILS
• Speakers that pump to the beat. Tap a speaker in time to set the tempo.
• A small boombox on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island.
• Auto reverse and a sleep timer.
• Import your own audio files and play them as a tape.
• Eleven extra bodies, from Synthwave, Gold and Silver to Clear Smoke, Sticker Bomb and the seasonal Snowfall, Holiday and Valentine. Each is a one-time purchase and comes with its own cassette.

still.boom needs an Apple Music subscription to play albums and radio. No accounts, no ads, no tracking.

name: StillHop
description:
Trim a video, choose its cover, and play the finished Live Photo before saving it to Photos. You can also make a Live Photo from a sequence of still images, preview wallpapers with a Lock Screen clock, and export a separate crop for each iPhone Duo display.

CREATE LIVE PHOTOS YOU CAN PLAY
Import a video from Photos or Files, or pick an existing Live Photo. Trim the clip, reposition the frame, and pick a cover. Keep a clip edit as a draft to finish later. In Animate Photos, arrange 2–10 still images and choose one as the cover. Play the finished Live Photo in the preview and save a new copy to Photos.

COMPOSE FOR YOUR LOCK SCREEN
See how your wallpaper sits behind a Lock Screen clock before you save it. Browse curated still wallpapers and motion clips, or work with your own photos. Wallpaper Set (iOS 16 or later) lets you zoom all images together and fine-tune each one.

MAKE A WALLPAPER PAIR FOR IPHONE DUO
Browse paired artwork for the outer and expanded displays. In Duo Wallpaper Pair (iOS 27 or later), frame the same photo separately for each display and save both crops to Photos.

FIND WHAT YOU WANT TO KEEP
Browse the photos you allow StillHop to see by grid, day, or month. Reopen drafts, saved projects, and favorites in Library. StillHop widgets surface your collection, and the Apple Watch companion can queue a wallpaper or shared draft for your paired iPhone.

Your personal media is processed on your device, and exports are saved as new copies. StillHop is free, with no account, ads, in-app purchases, or subscriptions. Catalog downloads require internet access.

Set wallpapers in iOS after saving. Animated Lock Screen playback requires a compatible iPhone, iOS 17 or later, and a Live Photo accepted by iOS.

name: StillProof
description:
StillProof is the proofing and gauging bench in your pocket. It works the numbers the way the TTB Gauging Manual does, shows its work, and keeps your readings on your phone.

ALWAYS FREE
• True proof: hydrometer reading and temperature to true proof at 60°F, from TTB Table 1 with the cells and interpolation spelled out. °F or °C.
• Proof down by volume: the water to reach a target proof, and how much of it you won't see on the sight glass, because ethanol and water shrink when they mix.
• International strength: alcoholmeter reading at the liquid's temperature to real strength at 20 °C (OIML R 22), dilution in litres.
• Conversions: ABV and proof, gallons and litres, pounds and kilograms, °F and °C.
• A log of your latest ten results, each with its inputs and the table cells it used.
• The Bench: your last reading on a proof scale, the next planned cut, and each tool's last result at a glance.
• Ten color themes, dark and light, or let StillProof follow your iPhone.

STILLPROOF PRO (one purchase, no subscription)
• Proof down and gauge by weight, with Table 4 and Table 5.
• Gauge by volume with the Table 7 temperature correction, proof gallons, weight and an excise estimate.
• Bottle fill weights: open and capped targets and the 27 CFR 19.356(b) fill band. Weigh bottles one by one on a needle gauge and watch each land on the run's chart.
• Blend lots to one proof, worked by weight so contraction is real.
• Slow-proof planner: step a cut over days, with reminders, a Live Activity on your Lock Screen and widgets.
• Your whole log, with PDF and CSV export for your records.
• iCloud sync: your log and plans on every device signed in to your Apple ID, through your own private iCloud.
• Volume at 20 °C, litres of pure alcohol and mass, for international gauging.

BUILT ON THE PUBLISHED TABLES
StillProof's Table 1 is its own transcription of TTB's official scan, every cell checked three ways. Tables 4, 5 and 7 and the fill limits follow 27 CFR Part 30 and 19.356. The math is tested against thousands of worked answers.

YOUR DATA STAYS YOURS
No account, no sign-in, no tracking. StillProof makes no network calls of its own: purchases go through the App Store, and Pro's iCloud sync goes through your own private iCloud, which only you can read.

Works on iPhone, iPad and iPhone Duo.

StillProof's results are aids for your own gauging. You keep responsibility for your records. StillProof is not approved or endorsed by TTB.

name: StitchDeck - Row Counter & PDF
description:
StitchDeck is a purpose-built PDF pattern reader and row counter designed specifically for knitters and crocheters.

"What row was I on again?"
"Which line of the lace chart am I supposed to read?"

StitchDeck solves these everyday crafting headaches in one elegant, distraction-free tool.

[KEY FEATURES]

[1. Row-Highlighting Pattern Ruler]
- Import any PDF pattern from Ravelry, Etsy, or your files.
- Place the magnetic-like highlight ruler over the exact row you are working on.
- Use Focus Masking to dim the surrounding pattern and highlight only your active row.
- Fully adjust ruler height and colors to match your personal chart style.

[2. Tap +1, Ruler Advances Automatically]
- Tap the generous "+1" button at the bottom of the screen when you finish a row.
- The highlight ruler automatically steps down to the next row with smooth precision.
- Made a mistake? Tap Undo to step backward instantly.

[3. Non-Destructive PencilKit Drawing & Pin Notes]
- Write notes, circle repeats, or mark yarn changes with Apple Pencil or your finger.
- Your original PDF is never permanently altered—drawings live safely in a dedicated layer.
- Drop sticky pin notes anywhere on the page for repeat counts, gauge reminders, or shaping alerts.

[4. iPad Split View & Keyboard Shortcuts]
- View your pattern and multiple counters side-by-side in iPad landscape.
- Supports external keyboards and Bluetooth foot pedals: hit Space for +1, Hyphen for -1, and Cmd+Z for Undo.

[5. Live Activities & Siri Voice Commands]
- Hands busy holding yarn? Simply say: "Hey Siri, knit next row with StitchDeck."
- Check your current row right from your iPhone Lock Screen and Dynamic Island.

[6. Tactile Haptics & Keep Screen Awake]
- Enjoy crisp physical haptic clicks with every stitch counted.
- Keep-awake mode ensures your screen never goes dark while you are in the middle of a row.

[OUR PHILOSOPHY]

- No Subscriptions: One fair, lifetime purchase unlocks StitchDeck Pro forever. Family Sharing enabled.
- 100% Private & Offline: No user accounts, no ads, no trackers, and zero network calls. Your patterns and notes stay safely on your device.

name: Stone Grain
description: A stone has grits 80, 220, and 400. A pass adds one to the grit you are on, up to 4. Finer opens the next grit only after this one is full. If you ask for finer too soon, the count stays. When 400 is full, the sentence says the stone is grained. Names stay on this iPhone.

name: Strafewind
description:
Take to the skies in Strafewind, fast arcade air combat built for your phone.

Fly a fleet of 21 aircraft, from propeller fighters of the 1940s to modern stealth jets, and fight across islands, open seas, deserts, red canyons and frozen glaciers.

GAME MODES
• Story: a campaign of missions with escorts, convoys and ace pilots to bring down.
• Arena: survive wave after wave of enemy fighters, pick a power-up card between waves and push your record.
• Online: jump into rooms and dogfight real pilots. Climb the ranks with every kill.
• Parkour: race through rings across canyons and coastlines and earn up to three stars per course.
• Training: free flight with target drones to sharpen your aim.

FEATURES
• Responsive touch controls with aim assist, missile lock and boost.
• Upgrade speed, turning, armour, firepower and missiles for every aircraft.
• Paint schemes, trails, explosion effects, flags and pilot badges to make your plane yours.
• Daily gift box with a 7-day streak.
• Play story, parkour and training offline.

Strafewind is free to play. Optional in-app purchases are available for gems.

name: Structlane
description:
Make structure make sense.

Structlane is a native JSON fixture workspace for iPhone. Explore typed objects and arrays, edit a value or the full source, then share your JSON with the next tool in your workflow.

YOUR EVERYDAY WORKSPACE — FREE
Browse and edit typed JSON trees. Search keys, values and paths. Edit source text with parsing feedback. Keep local documents, choose original starter fixtures, undo and redo changes, share JSON and view basic structure statistics. Revision indicators help you find changed paths.

A CONSIDERED UPGRADE — STRUCTLANE PRO
One optional non-consumable purchase unlocks full revision comparisons with before-and-after details, manual named checkpoints and restoration, Base64 copying and complete structure report export as a text file.

ONE PURCHASE, NO SUBSCRIPTION
Pro has no recurring charge. The app displays your App Store's localized price before purchase. Restore Purchases is available from the Pro page using the same App Store account. Successful unlocks remain available after restarting the app. An internet connection is required for purchase and restore; native editing and unlocked native features work offline.

Your saved fixtures remain available in the free workspace when you close the purchase page. No additional app account is required to unlock the native Pro features.

Numbers use double precision. Store exact long identifiers as strings.

name: StudioHero
description:
StudioHero Tablet is the front-desk app for studios that use StudioHero. It runs on an iPad at your reception.

Sign up new members
• New members enter their name, contact details, address and birthday themselves
• Five short steps, with a final review of everything
• Members accept the privacy notice and terms themselves
• No paper, no retyping: the details go straight into StudioHero

Sign contracts
• Create the contract on your computer, send it to the tablet, scan the code
• The member reads the contract, the withdrawal information and the SEPA mandate
• They sign with a finger and get a copy by email

German and English
Everyone can switch the language at the top. Afterwards the app goes back to the device language.

Made for the front desk
• Big fields and buttons, easy to use standing up
• After a short pause without input the app starts over, so nobody sees someone else's details
• With Guided Access the iPad stays in the app

Getting started
In StudioHero on your computer, open “Einstellungen › Tablets › Tablet verbinden” and scan the QR code with the iPad.

To be honest
The app only works with a StudioHero account. Without one you can't use it.

name: StudyCraft
description:
StudyCraft macht aus deinen Markdown-Dateien Lernkarten. Du schreibst sie am Mac oder direkt in der App, StudyCraft plant die Wiederholungen so, dass du Karten genau dann siehst, wenn du sie fast vergessen hast. Und wenn du nichts schreiben willst: Im Tab „Entdecken“ findest du fertige Decks.

ENTDECKEN
• Fertige Decks mit Vorschaubild, laden mit einem Tipp, mit Suche und Sprachfilter.
• Capitals of the World: alle 194 Länder und ihre Hauptstädte, nach Kontinenten.
• Countries on the Map: eine leere Karte, ein Land ist markiert. Nenne den Namen.
• Schweiz – Allgemeinwissen: Kantone auf der Karte und am Wappen, Hauptorte, Einwohner, Geschichte, Politik, Geografie, Persönlichkeiten, Brauchtum, Essen und Rekorde.
• Famous Persons: erkenne berühmte Gesichter aus Wissenschaft, Geschichte, Kunst und Sport.
• 100 Computer Science Questions: von leicht bis schwer.
• Geladene Decks sind ganz normale Ordner in deinem Lernordner. Du kannst sie bearbeiten, ergänzen oder löschen.

DEINE DATEIEN, DEINE KONTROLLE
• Wähle einen Ordner in iCloud Drive oder Dateien. Jeder Unterordner ist ein Deck, verschachtelte Ordner sind Unterdecks.
• Änderungen am Mac, etwa neue, bearbeitete oder gelöschte Dateien, erkennt die App automatisch.
• Es gibt kein Konto und keine Cloud von uns: Deine Karten bleiben normale .md-Dateien, die du mit jedem Editor öffnen kannst.

EINFACHES KARTENFORMAT
• Erste Zeile @studyCraft (eine Karte) oder @studyCraft_List (viele Karten).
• „---" trennt Vorder- und Rückseite, „===" trennt Karten.
• Überschriften, fett und kursiv, Listen, Tabellen, Code-Blöcke und Bilder aus demselben Ordner.

LERNEN, DAS SICH GUT ANFÜHLT
• Bewerte Karten per Wischen: nach rechts für „Gut", Finger halten für „Einfach" – mit Vibration und Animation. Nach links für „Schwer" oder „Nochmal".
• Die klassischen vier Buttons mit der Anzeige, wann die Karte wiederkommt, gibt es auch.
• Letzte Antwort mit einem Tipp zurücknehmen.
• Reihenfolge wählbar: Mischen, der Reihe nach oder nur neue Karten.
• Die Sitzung wird gespeichert: Wer ein Deck schließt, macht später genau dort weiter.
• Optional: der Ultra-Dopamin-Modus. Beim Halten lädt sich eine Glühbirne mit Vibration und Ton auf und blitzt bei „Einfach“ mit Sternen und Konfetti auf, dazu eine Serie „in Folge“.
• Bewährte Wiederholungsplanung (SM-2) mit Lernschritten, Leichtigkeit und Intervallen.
• Hell- und Dunkelmodus, ablenkungsfreie Lernansicht mit Fortschrittsbalken.

DIREKT IN DER APP BEARBEITEN
• Neue Decks und Karten anlegen, bearbeiten, ausblenden oder löschen. StudyCraft schreibt die Änderungen in deine Markdown-Dateien.
• Bilder aus deinen Fotos einfügen.

FORTSCHRITT UND STATISTIK
• Dein Lernstand wird im Lernordner gespeichert und über iCloud Drive mit deinen anderen Geräten synchronisiert.
• Übersicht mit heute gelernten Karten, Lernserie, den letzten 14 Tagen und deiner Behaltensrate.

DATENSCHUTZ
StudyCraft sammelt keine Daten, enthält keine Werbung und keine Tracker.

name: Sudoku: Endless & Explained
description:
Sudoku: Endless & Explained makes a new puzzle whenever you want one, at the level you choose. When you get stuck, its hints teach you the move instead of just giving away a digit.

ENDLESS PUZZLES
• Every puzzle is created and graded on your iPhone or iPad, so you never run out
• Six levels: Easy, Medium, Hard, Very Hard, Expert and Legend
• Levels are set by the techniques a puzzle needs, not by how many clues it shows
• Every puzzle has exactly one solution, reachable by logic alone

HINTS THAT TEACH
• A hint names the technique first: Naked Pair, X-Wing, XY-Wing, Unique Rectangle and more
• Ask again to see where it applies, then read why it works
• The cells it talks about are colored on the board to match the explanation
• Apply it with one tap, or make the move yourself

LEARN EVERY TECHNIQUE
• Over 30 lessons, from Hidden Single to Swordfish, Skyscraper and forcing chains
• Each lesson hands you a fresh board where that technique is the next move, and tells you when you've found it
• Short guides cover the basics: how to play, reading the grid and using marks

A BOARD THAT FEELS RIGHT
• Three kinds of marks: Candidate, Pair and Block
• Drag across cells to mark many at once
• Optional auto-candidates, a smart number pad and box autocomplete
• Rows, columns and boxes light up as you complete them
• Undo whenever you change your mind
• Themes built from a single color, plus night mode

BRING YOUR OWN PUZZLE
• Point the camera at a sudoku in a book or newspaper to scan its clues
• Or type one in, and the app checks it has one solution, rates it and gives hints while you play

NOTHING IN THE WAY
• No ads, no account, no tracking
• Works offline
• Statistics count the puzzles you've completed at each level
• Optional tips if you'd like to support development

name: Sugar Draw 2
description:
Sugar Draw 2 is a relaxing physics puzzle with a twist: you don't move the sugar, you draw the way for it.

Sugar pours from the top of the screen. Draw lines with your finger to build ramps, funnels and bridges, and steer every grain into the right cup. Watch the counter on each cup: when it hits zero, the level is solved.

It sounds simple until the cups want different colours. Some want plain white sugar, others want red, green or blue. Send the sugar through the right colour filters first, and keep the colours from getting mixed up!

FEATURES
• 30 hand-made levels that get trickier and trickier
• Colour filters that turn white sugar red, green, blue and more
• Upside-down cups that catch sugar from below
• Gravity buttons that flip the direction the sugar falls
• Levels where the sugar wraps around the screen
• Your best time is kept for every level: can you beat it?
• Simple one-finger controls, made for iPhone and iPad
• Available in 8 languages

FREE TO PLAY
Sugar Draw 2 is free, with ads. You get a number of replays every day and can watch an ad for more. A one-time Pro purchase removes all ads and gives you unlimited replays.

name: SUMINAGASHI: Ink on Water
description:
Drop ink onto still water and it opens into a ring. Drop more and each new ring pushes the others outward. Draw a finger through them or pull a comb across, and they stretch into feathers, waves and flames. This is suminagashi, "floating ink", a Japanese art practised for centuries. This app brings it to your iPhone and iPad and lets you keep what you make as a wallpaper.

What you can do

- Drop: tap the water and ink spreads gently from that point, pushing the rings around it aside. Press and hold for a larger drop.
- Trace: drag a finger and the pattern stretches along your path.
- Comb: swipe once across the screen, top to bottom or side to side, to pull a seven-tooth comb through the whole surface.
- Ink and Color: Ink mode gives you three shades of black ink plus clear water. Color mode adds six muted traditional colors: indigo, crimson, yellow ochre, blue-green, young-leaf green and purple.
- Undo: step back up to ten actions, or clear the water and begin again.
- Save as wallpaper: save your pattern to Photos as a PNG at your device's own screen resolution, with no watermark.
- Watch mode: press play and the water marbles itself, dropping ink, swirling and combing, then slowly fading back to blank paper and starting over. The toolbar and ads stay hidden and the screen stays on, so it can play quietly on a desk or in a waiting room.
- iPhone and iPad: on iPad it works in every orientation.

Calculated, not painted

The ink is not a prepared picture. Each ring is a shape computed from the mathematics of marbling, and wallpapers are redrawn from that shape at full resolution, so the edges stay clean and smooth.

Free, with one optional purchase

Every feature is free, including saving wallpapers. A small banner ad appears at the bottom of the creation screen only. "Remove Ads" is a single one-time purchase ($0.99 in the U.S.), not a subscription, and it can be restored at any time.

Good to know

- No account required
- Ads are provided by Google AdMob. Depending on your region, the app may ask for your consent for ads, and iOS asks whether to allow tracking. Whatever you choose, every feature works the same. You can change your ad choices later in the app's settings.
- Photo access is used only to add the wallpapers you save
- "Send Feedback" in the settings opens your own mail app. The app itself collects nothing and sends nothing
- Available in 33 languages

Drop a little ink and see where the water takes it.

name: sundial - 원형 시간표
description:
하루를 그려 두면, 고민이 사라진다.

sundial은 요일마다 반복되는 하루를 24시간 원(해시계)에 그리는 시간표 앱입니다.
0시가 맨 위, 시계방향으로 하루가 흐르고, 지금 시간대의 칸은 은은하게 빛나 지금 무엇을 할 차례인지 바로 보여 줍니다.

■ 원 위를 손가락으로 끌어 칸 만들기
 30분 단위로 쓱 끌고, 잠깐 멈추면 5분 단위로 정밀하게.
■ 요일별 시간표
 월~일 탭을 누르면 그 요일 시간표. 앱을 열면 오늘 요일이 저절로 열립니다.
■ 템플릿
 자주 쓰는 시간표는 자물쇠로 잠가 두고, 여러 요일에 함께 씁니다.
■ 달력으로 특별한 날
 시험·여행처럼 그날만 다른 하루는 달력에서 날짜를 골라 따로 그립니다.
■ 공유
 내 원형 시간표를 사진으로 보내거나, 친구가 그대로 가져다 쓸 수 있게 템플릿으로 공유하세요.
■ 홈 화면 위젯
 지금 칸과 다음 일정을 홈 화면에서 바로 확인하세요.
■ 지우개·되돌리기
 칠판 지우개로 문질러 지우고, 잘못 눌렀으면 되돌리기.

일정은 모두 내 폰 안에만 저장됩니다. 가입도, 광고도 없습니다.

name: Sunicode Academy: IT va AI
description:
Sunicode Academy — IT va sun'iy intellekt kurslari o'quvchilari uchun rasmiy ilova. Darslar, uy vazifalari, ustoz va jadval — barchasi bitta joyda.

ILOVADA NIMALAR BOR
• Video darslar va taqdimotlar — o'z tezligingizda, istalgan joyda o'qing
• Uy vazifalari — topshiriqni ilovadan yuboring, ball va ustoz izohini ko'ring
• Ustoz bilan chat — dars yoki vazifa bo'yicha savol bering, javob kelishi bilan xabar olasiz
• Push-bildirishnomalar — dars eslatmasi, yangi vazifa, baho va to'lov haqida darhol xabar
• Dars jadvali — keyingi dars vaqti, xona va ustoz
• Davomat va natijalar — har bir dars va har bir ball ko'z oldingizda
• Balans va to'lovlar — kurs to'lovi holati bir qarashda

KURSLAR
• AI Praktikum — tadbirkorlar uchun sun'iy intellekt: ChatGPT, Gemini, ERP va avtomatika, lokal AI agentlar
• Prompt injiniring — ChatGPT, Gemini va Claude bilan ishlash, rasm va video generatsiya, AI loyihalar
• Vibe coding — Claude Code va Cursor bilan noldan veb, backend va mobil ilova

KIMLAR UCHUN
Sunicode Academy o'quvchilari uchun. Hali o'quvchi bo'lmasangiz — ilovada kurslar bilan tanishing va bepul konsultatsiyaga yoziling.

Sunicode Academy — amaliyotga yo'naltirilgan IT va AI ta'limi, Toshkent.

name: Sunnook: Study with a Cat
description:
A small cat dozes in a sunny room while you work or study. Start a focus session and it stays with you, a quiet body double for homework, reading or deep work.

FOCUS YOUR WAY
• Pomodoro from 5 to 240 minutes, with breaks and cycles
• A stopwatch with no time limit
• Lock your phone: the session keeps going. Switch apps, restart, update: it is never lost
• Pause and +5 minutes are right on the screen

GIFTS FOR FOCUSING
• Every session of 10 minutes or more brings a parcel to the door
• Earn glow by focusing (1 minute = 1 glow) and spend it in the shop on cozy things for your collection
• Glow is never sold for money, and the chances of every item are shown in the app
• Nothing you collect ever disappears; repeats turn into glow

HONEST STATS
• Day, week, month and year, with every session on a timeline
• Tags for what you worked on
• Your full history is free forever, and you can download it as CSV or JSON

KIND BY DESIGN
• Leaving early never takes anything away
• No ads, no account, no tracking. Everything stays on your phone
• English, Russian and Kazakh

name: SunPeak Devices
description:
SunPeak Devices is the field app for SunPeak wireless sensors and displays. Hold your phone to a device for a second or two: you see its status, change its settings and open its quality passport. No cables, no laptop, no opening the case.

READ A DEVICE WITH ONE TAP
Model, firmware version, serial number, network connection, battery level and signal quality — read straight from the device over NFC.

CHANGE SETTINGS SAFELY
Measurement and transmission intervals, thresholds and network options are shown in plain language, with the allowed range for every field. Before writing, the app shows exactly what will change and writes only those values. Security keys stay hidden in the settings and are never overwritten.

KNOW THE BATTERY LIFE BEFORE YOU WRITE
For every change you see the expected battery life — "about N years, was M" — based on the measured energy values of each model.

SP LEVEL: SEE WHAT THE SENSOR SEES
A live 8×8 view helps you aim SP Level at the shelf during installation.

SP SCREEN: LAYOUTS FROM SMARTCLOUD
Sign in to SunPeak SmartCloud and upload display layouts to SP Screen over NFC. After that, live values reach the display wirelessly.

A QUALITY PASSPORT FOR EVERY DEVICE
Open the passport of any SunPeak device by its serial number, by scanning the QR code on the label or with an NFC tap: manufacturing date, measurement ranges and accuracy, quality control results and documents.

INSTALLATION LISTS
Walk the site, scan device QR codes one after another and add a place, a note and photos to each device. One tap sends a package to the commissioning engineer: a report that opens in any browser, a spreadsheet and all photos. Works offline.

DEVICE CATALOGUE
Descriptions, specifications, use cases and documents for every SunPeak model — always up to date from sunpeaki.com.

DEMO MODE
Try the main functions on a simulated device — no hardware needed. Ideal for training.

Good to know
• Setting up a device needs a SunPeak device with an NFC tag.
• The camera is used only to scan QR codes and take installation photos.
• Available in English, Turkish, German and Spanish.

More about SunPeak devices: www.sunpeaki.com

name: Super Nupur
description:
Super Nupur is a small superhero who keeps you on your plan, one block at a time.

Plan your week once: deep work, classes, workouts, family time. Super Nupur shows what's happening now and what's next, then checks in when a block ends: done, partial or skipped. Skipping is fine. She'll just ask what you did instead.

• Today: the block you're in, how much time is left, and what's up next
• Week: your whole week at a glance, including every-other-week blocks
• Check-ins: hours done for the project you care about most
• Talk to Super Nupur: say "I'm doing a walk instead" or "move Deep work to 4 PM" and she updates your plan (uses Apple Intelligence)
• Widgets for your Home Screen and Lock Screen
• Calendar overlaps: she tells you when a meeting lands on a planned block (read-only)

Private by design: no account, no ads, no tracking. Your plan and check-ins stay on your iPhone.

name: Sus2
description:
Sus2 turns sustaining drones into something you can actually play with—in any key.

Built-in warm pads and voices are ready out of the box. Import your own SoundFont (.sf2) files to use your pads, choirs, and tones as drones. Choose a musical key, layer sounds, and let the app hold the atmosphere while you lead, practice, or unwind.

Made for worship teams, ambient listening, and musicians who want a simple tonal center—not a full DAW.

FEATURES
• Sustaining drones in any musical key
• Built-in pad sounds (warm pad, voices, choir, sweep, and more)
• Import your own .sf2 SoundFonts and play presets as pads
• Setlists for planning songs or flows
• Performance controls tuned for live use
• Background audio—keep playing with the screen off
• Works on iPhone and iPad

BUILT-IN SOUNDS
Sus2 ships with built-in SoundFont pads. You may use them in live performance, recordings, streams, and releases when played through the app. See our End User License Agreement for full terms on built-in and imported sounds.

YOUR SOUNDFONTS
SoundFonts you import stay on your device. You are responsible for having the right to use any .sf2 or other files you import.

—
Privacy Policy: https://sustwo.vercel.app/privacy.html
End User License Agreement: https://sustwo.vercel.app/eula.html
Terms & Conditions: https://sustwo.vercel.app/terms.html

name: Suspecto: The Odd Word
description:
Mira says, “You rest your head on it.” Jules says, “Mine came with the sofa.” Both sound reasonable. Only one of them saw the word “pillow.”

Suspecto turns one iPhone or iPad into a party game for 3–20 people. Pass it around so everyone can peek at a private card. Once the clues begin, look at your friends, not the screen.

Civilians share a word. The Undercover sees a different but related word and has to blend in. Take turns giving clues, compare stories and vote. Want a tougher round? Add Mr. White. He starts without a word and gets one last guess if the group votes him out.

Start with 1,000 everyday words in the Common collection, explore 12 more categories or make pairs from your own inside jokes. Save your usual group, keep score and add special roles whenever you want a change.

New to the table? Watch the quick tutorial or skip straight to play. The game works offline, with no accounts, ads or in-app purchases. Every collection and role is unlocked.

LEGAL:

Privacy Policy: https://suspecto-party-site.vercel.app/privacy
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Swingprintv2
description:
Swingprint records and reviews your golf swing entirely on your iPhone. No account, no uploads: your swings never leave your phone.

HANDS-FREE RANGE SESSIONS
• Put your iPhone on a tripod and start a session. A quick checklist makes sure you are fully in the picture, at the right distance, with the phone level.
• Then just swing. Swingprint watches for each swing and listens for the strike of the ball, so real shots are kept and practice swings are skipped.
• Every shot is saved as a short 240 fps clip and replayed in slow motion straight away, with spoken cues so you never have to walk back to the phone.

SWING REVIEW
• Slow-motion playback from ⅛× to full speed, with frame-by-frame steps.
• Your skeleton and hand path drawn over the video.
• The eight key positions, from address and takeaway to the top, impact and finish, one tap away in a filmstrip.
• Tempo: your backswing and downswing times and their ratio.
• Face-on or down-the-line, detected automatically.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Video, sound and analysis stay on your iPhone. Swingprint has no account, no analytics and no ads.

Best results: film in good light, phone at hand height, two to four metres away, whole body and club in view.

name: SYE English community
description:
The official app of SYE English community for its trainees. Everything about your training, in one place.

TODAY
• Your next lecture, with a Join button when it's live
• What's due soon, and your attendance and progress
• Reminders before each lecture and before deadlines

SCHEDULE
• Your lectures by week or month, online and in class

TASKS
• Assignments: write your answer, attach photos, files or a voice note, and hand it in
• Quizzes and tests: take them in the app, and see your results
• Your work is kept on your phone until it's sent, even offline

COURSES
• Each course's lectures, tasks, content, files and videos
• Your ongoing assessment

ALSO
• Notifications and announcements from SYE English community
• Payments: your balance and invoices, and paying online
• Certificates, course requests and placement tests
• Your attendance card
• Course discussions, and feedback surveys

In English and Arabic. Sign in with the account SYE English community gave you.

name: SymChamps
description:
SymChamps est une application de physique pour étudier les champs électrostatique et magnétostatique, et surtout leurs symétries.

Construisez une distribution de charges ponctuelles ou de fils parcourus par des courants perpendiculaires à la figure, cherchez ses plans de symétrie et d’antisymétrie, puis observez le champ qu’elle crée. Un outil idéal pour comprendre l’utilisation des symétries pour déterminer la direction d’un champ.

ÉLECTROSTATIQUE
• Charges ponctuelles positives et négatives réglables.
• Lignes de champ tracées avec précision.
• Équipotentielles.
• Charges-test mobiles : lâchez-les au repos ou avec une vitesse initiale, et suivez leur trajectoire avec les vecteurs force et vitesse.

MAGNÉTOSTATIQUE
• Fils rectilignes infinis parcourus par des courants sortants ou entrants.
• Lignes de champ exactes et fermées, dont la densité traduit l’intensité du champ.

Détection automatique des plans de symétrie et d’antisymétrie de la distribution, pour un nombre quelconque de sources.

Bibliothèque d’exemples : dipôle, quadripôle, condensateur plan, spire, solénoïde…

name: Symmetry Driver
description: The Symmetry Driver app allows you to easily complete your legally required walk-around inspections for vehicles and/or assets that you are driving. As a driver, you are completely in charge of your account and share no unnecessary details with your employer.

name: SyncDrop – File Transfer
description:
**SyncDrop — Share nearby. Simply.**

Send photos, videos, files and text directly between your devices — even when they aren't connected to the same Wi-Fi network.

SyncDrop makes sharing between iPhone, Android, Mac and Windows simple, private and secure.

**SHARE ACROSS PLATFORMS**

No more emailing files to yourself, uploading them to cloud storage or searching for a USB cable.

SyncDrop lets you transfer files between different operating systems using a direct, encrypted connection.

**NO SHARED WI-FI REQUIRED**

SyncDrop can connect nearby devices even without a shared Wi-Fi router.

Whether you're at home, at work or somewhere without a shared network, you can transfer files directly between supported devices.

**SEND PHOTOS, VIDEOS AND FILES**

Choose what you want to share, connect to another device and send your files.

The receiving device must explicitly accept each transfer.

**QUICK SHARE**

Need to share a short message instead of a file?

Quick Share lets you exchange text directly with another connected SyncDrop device.

Copy, delete or report received messages.

**PRIVACY FIRST**

- No account or registration required.
- No cloud uploads or storage.
- No advertising or tracking.
- Direct, encrypted device-to-device transfers.
- Explicit approval before receiving files.
- Block unwanted devices.
- Report inappropriate content.
- On-device content protection where supported.

**SIMPLE CONNECTIONS**

Connect using QR codes or discover compatible devices nearby when supported.

SyncDrop works with Wi-Fi enabled, even when devices aren't connected to the same router.

**ONE APP. DIFFERENT DEVICES.**

Available for iPhone, Android, Mac and Windows, subject to platform release availability.

Both devices need SyncDrop installed to exchange files or messages.

**SyncDrop — Share nearby. Simply.**

Developed by Caemso Nexus, Netherlands.

Learn more: https://synced.life

name: SynergiaFlow
description:
SynergiaFlow is the approvals app for teams that already use SynergiaFlow to run purchasing and cost control on their projects.

Everything waiting for you is in one inbox, most urgent first. Open a document to see what you're being asked to approve: the line items, the money summary, the budget it draws on, related documents, earlier revisions and the discussion. A short "Check first" list points out what deserves a second look before you decide.

Approve, reject or send back in two taps. Changed your mind? Undo within a few seconds. Your company can ask for Face ID or Touch ID before an approval counts, so a signed approval is really yours.

Not ready to decide? Ask a question, or set a reminder for later. Subscribe your calendar to "My approvals due" so deadlines sit next to your meetings.

- Inbox of approvals, sorted by what's due first
- Full document view: line items, totals, budget, related documents, revisions and notes
- Approve, reject or send back, with Undo
- Face ID or Touch ID approval, and an app lock
- Reminders and a calendar feed of approvals due
- Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets
- Follow a document you sent on the Lock Screen with a Live Activity
- Offline reading of your recent documents
- Links in SynergiaFlow emails open straight in the app
- iPhone and iPad
- English, French and Spanish

You need a SynergiaFlow account to use the app. Your company's SynergiaFlow administrator sends you an invitation; there is nothing to buy in the app.

name: TabelaFute
description:
TabelaFute é o jeito simples de acompanhar o futebol: jogos por rodada, classificação, artilharia, notícias e muito mais, tudo em português.

• Jogos por rodada, com placar, horário e estádio
• Classificação completa, com zonas de Libertadores e rebaixamento
• Detalhe do jogo: gols, cartões, substituições, escalação em campo e público
• Confrontos diretos entre os clubes e o painel Duelos, com histórico desde 2006
• Maiores campeões do Brasileirão
• Artilharia do campeonato
• Simulador: preencha placares, sorteie a rodada ou o campeonato inteiro e veja a classificação mudar
• Vários campeonatos e temporadas: nacionais, copas, estaduais e ligas internacionais
• Time favorito em destaque
• Compartilhe tabelas, jogos, escalações e duelos como imagem, inclusive pelo WhatsApp

Sem cadastro, sem anúncios e sem coletar seus dados.

Aviso: app independente, sem vínculo com a CBF, com clubes ou com os campeonatos. Nomes e escudos pertencem aos respectivos donos.

name: Tabkhatak
description:
Turn any cooking video into a tidy recipe.

Saw a recipe on TikTok, Instagram or YouTube? Share the video with Tabkhatak, or paste its link. Tabkhatak reads it and gives you the ingredients, amounts and steps in a tidy recipe you can cook from straight away. Cooking websites, photos, screenshots, cookbook pages and your own text work too.

When the cook doesn't give an amount, Tabkhatak suggests the usual one and marks it with a small , so you always know what the cook said and what Tabkhatak suggested.

• Save from the share menu without leaving the video
• Quick save from Control Center
• Ingredients, amounts and steps, each in its place
• Change the number of people and every amount updates
• A shopping list that combines the same item from several recipes
• Cooking mode, step by step, with a timer
• Collections to keep your recipes in order
• Search, sort and edit any recipe
• Arabic and English
• No account and no login: your recipes stay on your iPhone, even offline

Every recipe shows where it came from and, when given, the cook's name.

Free: 3 imports every 7 days, counted from your first import. A long video counts as one import for every 5 minutes. Everything else is free: your saved recipes, amounts for any number of people, the shopping list and cooking mode.

Tabkhatak Premium, monthly or yearly: 100 imports every 30 days, counted from your first import, and the cooking tools: several timers at once, extra-large text, and tap anywhere for the next step. The App Store shows the price for your country before you pay. Premium renews automatically at the end of each month or year until you cancel, and you can cancel any time in your Apple account settings.

Terms of Use: https://tabkhatak.tabkhatak.workers.dev/terms?lang=en
Privacy Policy: https://tabkhatak.tabkhatak.workers.dev/privacy?lang=en

name: Tafuta - Travel & Rides
description:
Welcome to Tafuta — your all-in-one travel discovery and mobility platform across Tanzania and Zanzibar. Whether you need a quick ride across town or want to plan your dream safari and beach getaway, Tafuta connects you with verified local providers and clear upfront pricing.

ON-DEMAND RIDES
• Fast, reliable rides tailored to your journey: choose from Boda (motorcycle), Bajaji (tuk-tuk), standard Car, or spacious XL.
• Upfront, transparent fares in Tanzanian Shillings with no surprise charges.
• Live vehicle tracking and direct in-app driver communication.

STAYS, TOURS & EXPERIENCES
• Stays & Beach Resorts: Discover boutique hotels, coastal lodges, and beachside retreats in Zanzibar, Dar es Salaam, Arusha, and beyond.
• Safari & Day Tours: Book wildlife adventures to the Serengeti, Ngorongoro Crater, Mikumi, and cultural day trips.
• Activities & Dining: Explore local culinary hotspots, water sports, and guided island excursions.
• Vehicle & Equipment Rentals: Rent 4x4s, safari vehicles, and private transfers directly from trusted local operators.

SMART EXPLORE MAP & AI ASSISTANT
• Interactive Map: Browse curated hotspots, verified landmarks, and popular attractions near you.
• Ask Tafuta Assistant: Get instant, smart travel recommendations, itinerary ideas, and local tips powered by intelligent search.

SAFE, DIRECT & TRANSPARENT
• Verified local drivers, guides, and hospitality providers.
• Detailed host ratings, genuine traveller reviews, and instant confirmations.
• Full support and simple account management.

Experience Tanzania with confidence. Download Tafuta and start your journey today!

name: TaktTime: Speaker Timer
description:
A presentation timer for many speakers sharing one time slot, such as 15 talks in a 90-minute class.

- Each speaker's time is the time left until the end divided by the speakers left, recalculated at every handover.
- An overrun is spread over every speaker after, so the session still ends on time.
- Set an end time or a length, and the number of speakers.
- Shows this speaker's countdown, the time left in the session, and what the next speaker will get.
- Works with presentation remotes and keyboards: Page Down or → for the next speaker, Page Up or ← to undo.
- Keeps the screen on while speakers talk.
- Continues where it was after a relaunch.
- No accounts or ads.

name: Talfahrt by Atinote
description:
Talfahrt shows when the last lift goes down to the valley according to the timetable, and how much time you have until then. For everyone out on foot in the Swiss mountains. Free and without ads.

The last ride
Tap a station and Talfahrt shows today's last ride down in large type, and the time you have left. With location on, the nearest station comes first. A switch shows the last ride up instead.

Over 700 stations
Gondolas, cable cars, rack railways, funiculars and chairlifts in the Swiss mountains. Just under 400 stations have a ride down to the valley. The others are valley stations, where you see the last ride up. Only lifts that are in the public timetable and go up to at least 700 m are included. Ski lifts are not included.

If a lift runs in several sections, Talfahrt shows the last ride that still gets you all the way down according to the timetable. Time to change is not included.

Another day
Choose a date to see the first and the last ride on that day. If a lift is not running, Talfahrt says from when it runs again according to the timetable.

Interruptions
If an operator reports an interruption, Talfahrt shows the operator's notice in large type. The time from the timetable then only appears in small print. This needs a network. Most operators do not report disruptions in a way Talfahrt can show. No notice does not mean the lift is running.

Swiss national map, also offline
The map is the national map of swisstopo. For days without a signal, download the area you need beforehand. The times are part of the app and need no network.

Where the times come from
The times come from Switzerland's public timetable (opentransportdata.swiss), as of 18 November 2026, without guarantee. For many gondolas, cable cars and chairlifts the timetable only gives general operating hours. Especially between seasons, the last ride sometimes leaves earlier. In our latest sample, the timetable showed a later last ride down than the operator for 4 of 30 lifts. What we find this way, we correct from the operator's information. A corrected time is marked “Time from the operator” with the date we read it. All other times are not checked one by one. In a storm, during maintenance or on a special timetable a lift can also run differently. If your way down depends on the last lift, check the time with the operator. Almost every lift has a button to the operator's website.

If a lift does not run on a day according to the timetable, Talfahrt says “Not running”. On days with a special timetable this can be wrong. If timetable and operator disagree, Talfahrt says “Times unknown”. It never guesses a time.

The times run until 11 December 2027. New times come with an app update, not by themselves. If a time is wrong, you can report it in the app.

Your data
No account, no ads. The app sends your coordinates to no one. Everything else is in the privacy policy.

Tip
Every feature is free. If you like, you can buy the developer a coffee in Settings. It unlocks nothing. Settings also lists two other apps by Atinote.

In German and English. Map data © swisstopo.

WhatsApp calls

name: Telltale: Hidden Camera Check
description:
Telltale walks you through checking a hotel room, rental or holiday home for hidden cameras and trackers, in about ten minutes, with only your iPhone.

It never says "camera found" or "all clear". It shows you what it saw and where to go and look, and it's honest about what it can't see.

Telltale is free. No ads, no subscription, no in-app purchases, and every check works the moment you open it.

THE CHECKS
• Lens glint scan: the flashlight pulses while you sweep the room slowly. A camera lens bounces light straight back as a tiny point, and Telltale rings the points that light up only with the flash. A strip shows which directions around you you've swept. Steady light is there if flashing bothers anyone.
• Infrared check: many cameras light the room with infrared at night. Your eyes can't see it, but an iPhone camera often can. A TV remote test tells you which of your phone's cameras sees it.
• Lights-off test: prop the phone up and switch the light off. Night-vision cameras switch their infrared lights on within seconds, and Telltale rings what came on.
• Network check: listens to what the devices on the Wi-Fi say about themselves and points out the ones that announce themselves as cameras. It only listens; it never connects to anyone's devices.
• Tracker check: listens for Bluetooth item trackers, like Tile, Samsung SmartTag and Find Hub tags, that stay close to you, as one slipped into a bag would.
• Look by hand: a short list of the usual hiding places, such as smoke alarms, clocks, chargers and vents.

THE RESULTS
One list of what to look at, most urgent first, with a snapshot of each spot. Mark each one once you've looked. Every check says how far it got: one that was stopped early or couldn't run says so, and only a check that ran all the way can come back with nothing flagged. Save a PDF report with the time, what was checked and what was flagged, to keep or to send to the host or the booking platform.

WHAT IT CAN'T DO
No app can promise a room has no cameras. Know the limits before you rely on it:
• The lens scan only catches a lens you're roughly in front of, within 2 to 3 metres, with the lights off. A pinhole behind dark glass can be missed.
• Some iPhone cameras filter infrared out. The TV remote test shows which of yours can see it; with one that can't, the infrared check can't say much.
• The network check only hears the Wi-Fi you've joined, and only devices that announce themselves. Many cameras don't. A camera on another network, on cellular, recording to a memory card or switched off won't show up there.
• The tracker check can't hear AirTags (iOS keeps those to itself and warns you about an unknown AirTag on its own), and it only listens while it's open, never in the background.
Telltale lowers the odds and tells you where to look. Looking is still up to you, and the Limits screen in the app explains what each check can miss.

FREE. NO ADS, EVER.
No account, no analytics, no tracking. Everything runs on your iPhone and nothing is uploaded, so there's no server and nothing to charge you for.

 Real-time word & character count

name: The Last Moonwolf
description:
The Moon has broken into seven pieces. A lone wolf sets out across the desert to bring them back, and the only road is the one you draw in the sky.

Drag from star to star to draw a line. Every line spends some of the Moon's light. When you are ready, howl: the wolf runs along your lines, drops where a line ends, and slides down the ones that are too steep. Reach the shard and the level is done.

There is no timer and nothing to lose. If the wolf falls, your lines stay where they are and you try again.

SEVEN REGIONS, SEVEN RULES
- Violet Mountains: learn to climb, drop and slide.
- Red Canyon: rock blocks your lines, but the wolf can land on it.
- Fading Stars: a line on an ember star burns away after one crossing.
- Wandering Stars: move a star and its lines stretch with it.
- Twin Stars: every line is mirrored for free, wanted or not.
- Upturned Sky: the wolf falls upward.
- The Crater: everything together.

70 LEVELS
Each level gives you exactly the moonlight it needs and not one line more. Find the path that fits.

name: The Quran Scroll

• The full Quran, one ayah per screen
• Arabic, English, or both side by side

SOMETHING NEW EVERY DAY

READINGS FOR YOUR DAY

SIMPLE AND PRIVATE
