name: The Tenth Mirror
description:
Venice, in the last hours of a November storm.

A workshop on Murano has burned, and with it an eighteenth-century mirror insured for two million euros — and the man who was studying it. You are Iris Calder, loss adjuster for Harrow & Vane of London. Your job is to decide whether they pay.

By dawn you will have crossed the lagoon four times, read a dead man's cipher, robbed a stone lion, and learned what the Council of Ten hid on the night the Republic died.

THE TENTH MIRROR is a point-and-click adventure made for the phone in your hand: one night, four chapters, no timers and no dead ends.

• LOOK, TAKE, TALK. Tap anything in the scene. Ask people about everything, and show them what you are carrying: a water-taxi pilot who listens to the police radio under his Puccini, a captain of the art police who is not pleased to see you, a cemetery custodian stuck on eleven across.

• SIX HANDS-ON PUZZLES. Sweep a UV lamp over broken glass. Piece a torn letter back together. Turn a brass cipher wheel. Throw the light of a magic mirror onto a chapel wall. Each one is something you do with your fingers, and each one belongs to the story.

• A STORY WITH AN ENDING. A prologue in 1797, four chapters across one night, an epilogue at first light. About an hour, and it finishes what it starts.

• PAINTED AND SCORED BY CODE. Every background was drawn by a program — layered, lit and fogged — and the score, for glass harmonica, felt piano and rain, was synthesised from nothing. Rain falls, water moves, the camera travels.

• HINTS WHEN YOU WANT THEM. Telephone your superior in London. Each call is blunter than the last.

• TRUE, AND INVENTED. The Council of Ten, the lions' mouths and Giovanni Soro, Secretary of the Ciphers, are history. The Tenth Mirror, and everyone you meet, are not.

No ads. No purchases. No account. Nothing leaves your device.

Best with headphones.

name: Three Kingdoms: Demon Lu Bu
description:
They hanged him at the White Gate Tower.
It didn't take.

Lu Bu opens his eyes on a battlefield with no horizon, and now something demonic burns in his veins. Zhao Yun and Zhang Fei have been dragged here too. And from every direction, the Nanman, Wei, Shu and Wu armies come pouring in, so many that they start cutting each other down just to reach you.

Good. More for the halberd.

Three Kingdoms: Demon Lu Bu is a landscape survivor-like hack-and-slash. You steer; your general swings. How many waves can one warrior hold against ten thousand?

WHAT YOU WON'T FIND ANYWHERE ELSE
- A four-way war: Nanman, Wei, Shu and Wu armies flood the field together and slaughter each other as much as you. Ride the chaos, let them thin each other out
- Mount up and transform: fill your rage, unleash a full-screen ultimate, then leap onto your warhorse. Faster, harder-hitting, trampling every soldier in your path
- Summon divine beasts: Lu Bu calls the Fire Phoenix, Zhao Yun the Azure Dragon, Zhang Fei the White Tiger, and your martial arts bring the Qilin, the Spirit Serpent and the Black Tortoise crashing onto the battlefield

[ PICK YOUR LEGEND ]
- Demon Lu Bu: a wall of health and raw power; one halberd sweep clears a crowd. Heavy on his feet
- Zhao Yun: lightning-fast, long reach, the quickest dash on the field. Fragile if you're careless
- Zhang Fei: his serpent spear launches enemies farther than anyone. Slower to dash, impossible to stop

[ JUST MOVE ]
- Drag anywhere to walk. One thumb is enough
- Sweep, back sweep, cleave, thrust: a four-hit combo that never stops
- Walled in? Dash straight through and bowl over the entire line

[ MARTIAL ARTS, RAGE AND WARHORSES ]
- Level up and learn one of six martial arts: Whirlwind, Cloud Arrow, Thunder, Frost Array, Dart Volley and Sword Guard. Up to level 5 each
- Tap a skill to unleash it, then keep channeling it as the enemy breaks
- Every hit you land, every hit you take, fuels your rage. Let it explode: your general's divine beast sweeps the whole screen, then you ride your warhorse straight through the ranks

[ A FOUR-WAY THREE KINGDOMS BRAWL ]
- Twenty kinds of soldiers: swordsmen, spearmen, archers, shield walls and cavalry from the Nanman, Wei, Shu and Wu armies
- Nanman Shield troops hide behind rattan shields, Wu Fire Archers rain down fire arrows, and cavalry charge straight at you
- Four armies, one battlefield, zero loyalty: they fight you and they fight each other. It's chaos, and you're in the middle of it

[ ENDLESS WAVES. LEGENDARY GENERALS. ]
- Every 30 seconds a new wave: more soldiers, faster, tougher
- Every 5 waves a famous general rides out to stop you: Hua Xiong, Zhang Jue, Dong Zhuo, Dian Wei, Xu Chu, Cao Cao, and yes, Lu Bu himself
- Soldiers yell threats, beg for reinforcements, and brawl with rival armies around you

[ TURN THE TIDE ]
- Qi Pill, Golden Elixir, Gale Pearl, Imperial Seal, Binding Ring, Art of War and Jade Disc: grab them off the battlefield, each one a lifeline

[ ALSO ]
- English, Traditional Chinese and Korean text and voice acting
- 1x / 1.5x / 2x speed
- Top-5 local high scores

No ads. No in-app purchases.
The whole world wants him dead again. Let them try.

name: TickCalc
description:
TickCalc turns maths practice into a game kids want to play. It's a bright, friendly calculator and a quick maths race in one, with chunky buttons in fun shapes that little fingers can tap easily.

A SAFE SPACE TO LEARN
• No ads and no in-app purchases
• No sign-up, no passwords and no internet connection needed
• No data collected: players, scores and history stay on your device
• No links out of the app, no chat and no sharing
• Made for young learners, from first sums to times tables

THE MATHS RACE
Set up a challenge in seconds:
• Choose how many questions: 5, 10, 15 or 20
• Choose the biggest number: 5, 10, 12, 20, 50 or 100
• Pick the sums to practise: plus, minus, times and divide
A 5-second countdown gets everyone ready, then it's one question at a time with a ticking timer. Kids type their answer on a big number pad and see straight away if they got it right.

Questions are made for children: take-aways never go below zero and divisions always come out whole, so every question can be solved.

RACE A FRIEND IN VS MODE
Two to four players take turns at the same questions on one device. Most right answers wins, the quickest time breaks a tie, and the winner gets a cup trophy sticker.

LEARN FROM EVERY GAME
At the end, kids see their score, their average time per answer and their fastest answer. Every question is listed, and any wrong answer shows the right one next to it, so mistakes become a chance to learn.

WIN FUNNY STICKERS
Every game of 10 or more questions earns a sticker with a silly face:
• Keep going! for every brave try
• Getting better! for half or more right
• Very good! for three quarters or more right
• Excellent! for a perfect score
Win a sticker again and it adds to the collection, so there's always a reason for one more round. Winning a VS game earns the Champion! cup.

A PLAYER FOR EVERY CHILD
Brothers, sisters and classmates can each have their own player with a name and a colour. No passwords needed. The Players page shows everyone's best score, average speed and sticker collection, so kids can cheer each other on and see who's improving.

A REAL CALCULATOR TOO
• Add, subtract, multiply, divide and percent
• Memory keys: MC, MR, M+ and M−
• History of the last 20 sums: tap one to use the answer again
• Exact decimal maths, so 0.1 + 0.2 really equals 0.3
• Big, clear numbers that are easy to read

FOR PARENTS
TickCalc is a calm, ad-free way to build number confidence at home. Short games fit into a few spare minutes, the timer builds speed without pressure, and the sticker collection celebrates effort as well as perfect scores.

FOR TEACHERS
Use TickCalc on classroom tablets for warm-ups, maths centres or quick fluency checks. Choose exactly which operations and number ranges to practise, add a player for each child, and compare progress on the Players page. Nothing to set up online and no student accounts to manage.

WORKS EVERYWHERE
TickCalc works on iPhone and iPad, in portrait or side by side on a bigger iPad screen. It works fully offline, so it's ready in the car, on holiday or in the classroom.

Have an idea or found a problem? Contact us using the email address on this page. We'd love to hear from families and teachers.

name: Tickory
description:
Tickory keeps your tasks the way you think about them: what you're doing now, what's for tomorrow, and what can wait. Each list is a small board of pages you swipe between, and you decide what goes where.

SWIPE BETWEEN PAGES
Every list has four pages: Completed, Now, Tomorrow and Long term. Swipe left and right to move between them, and up and down to move between your lists: Tasks, Shopping, Work, or any you make. The list's colour tints its pages, so you always know where you are.

YOU DECIDE WHAT'S NEXT
Pages never change on their own. A task due today stays in Long term until you move it, so nothing piles up behind your back. Move a task with a swipe on its row, by dragging it, or from its menu. Due dates show as badges, and overdue ones stand out.

EVERYTHING A TASK NEEDS
- Notes and a checklist, with progress shown on the row
- Priority, shown as a flag
- Tags, shared across your lists
- Due date and time, and a reminder
- Repeats: daily, weekly on the days you choose, monthly, yearly, or every few days or weeks

DONE, AND KEPT
Tap the circle to complete a task, and undo if you didn't mean it. Completed tasks are grouped by day and kept for as long as you like, searchable, and can be reopened. A repeating task puts its next one in Long term, ready when you are.

ALL YOUR LISTS AT ONCE
Turn on Merge lists to see every list as one board. Each task shows its list's name, and typing "Shopping: milk" files it in the right list.

WIDGETS AND CONTROL CENTRE
Put a list's Now page on your Home Screen or Lock Screen, in three sizes, or every list at once. Tap a circle on the widget to complete a task without opening the app. The Add task button in Control Centre, or on the Action button, opens a new task straight away.

SIRI AND SHORTCUTS
"Add to Shopping in Tickory", "Add a task in Tickory for tomorrow", "What's on Work in Tickory". Every action is in the Shortcuts app too: add, complete, reopen and move tasks, and show a list.

FROM ANY APP
Share text or a web page to Tickory from the share sheet, choose the list and page, and it's a task.

SYNC WITH YOUR OWN NEXTCLOUD
If you have a Nextcloud server, at home or with a provider, sign in and Tickory keeps your lists in step with it, over a secure connection. Each list is a task calendar there, so the Nextcloud Tasks app and other CalDAV apps see the same tasks, and changes made there come back to Tickory. Work offline and it catches up when you're back. Sync is optional: Tickory is complete without it.

SHARED LISTS
Share a list's calendar with someone on your Nextcloud, a family shopping list say, and it syncs to both of you. Read-only shares show as read-only lists.

MAKE IT YOURS
Add, rename, reorder and hide lists, with thirteen colours and a choice of icons. Choose your default list.

YOUR DATA, YOURS
No account with us, no ads, no analytics and no tracking. Your tasks live on your iPhone and, if you choose, on your own Nextcloud; we never see them. Export everything as JSON to keep a backup and import it again, or as CSV for a spreadsheet.

name: Tidecut: Dive Video Maker
description:
Give Tidecut your dive videos and a song. It finds the best moments and cuts them to the music, in the order of your story.

You came up with an hour of footage. Maybe a minute of it is worth keeping. Tidecut watches every second of every video for you and looks for what makes a shot good: sharpness, steadiness, motion, colour, divers, faces, rock formations and marine life. Dark cave and cenote footage counts too.

FROM THE BOAT TO YOUR ALBUM
• Tap +, pick your dive videos from Photos or Files, in the order of your story.
• Choose a song from the built-in music library, or use your own. Tidecut finds its beats.
• Tidecut cuts: a moment for every stretch between beats, the weakest videos left out when the song is short.
• Export one video with your music and transitions, to a Photos album, to Files, or to any app with Share.

EVERY CUT IS YOURS TO CHANGE
• Swap a shot: tap Replace and pick from the best other moments, from that video or elsewhere in your list.
• Pin a video to keep it in, or leave a moment out.
• Portrait or landscape: a tall video for the phone or a wide one for big screens. Tidecut frames each clip on what stands out, and you can move the frame.
• Stack your shots: landscape videos stack in a portrait video; three portrait videos sit side by side in a landscape one.
• Transitions from the music: dissolves in calm parts, pushes and flashes on strong beats.
• Split and trim the song on the timeline. Undo and redo everything.

MUSIC YOU CAN PUBLISH
A built-in library of royalty-free songs by genre, with the best 15, 30 and 60 seconds marked. Free for everyone.

BUILT FOR IPHONE AND IPAD
• Keep going while you do something else: videos keep analysing and exports keep running in the background, with progress on the Lock Screen.
• Videos stored in iCloud download on Wi-Fi; Tidecut asks before it uses cellular data.
• On iPad: a three-column editor, keyboard shortcuts, the pointer, Apple Pencil scrubbing, and drag and drop from Files and Photos.
• Export in HDR from iPhone HDR videos.

YOUR FOOTAGE STAYS ON YOUR DEVICE
Everything runs on your iPhone or iPad. There's no account, no analytics and no cloud. Tidecut downloads music; nothing about you or your videos leaves your device.

TIDECUT PRO
Tidecut is free. Pro is one purchase, with no subscription, and adds:
• Export in 4K at 60 frames a second.
• Animations: stacks that step in, push-ins, punch-ins on the beat, pulses, slow motion and freeze frames.
• Choose your transitions: pick from 22 transitions for each cut, or none.
• More than one song: several songs or sounds, each on its own lane, with crossfades.
• No mark: turn off the small "Made with Tidecut" mark.
Family Sharing is supported.

Tidecut on the Mac is a separate app, with the Scoring Lab: teach it what you like, then bring the model to your iPhone or iPad.

name: Tidehop: Boat Puzzle
description:
Tidehop is a boat parking puzzle where the tide changes everything. Every few moves the sea in a sunny Mediterranean harbor rises or falls: at low tide sandbars block the way, high water opens new paths. Send toy boats to the pier at the right moment, board passengers onto boats of their own color and clear the harbor!

HOW TO PLAY
• Tap a boat and it sails the way its bow points.
• If the way is clear it leaves the basin and docks at a free berth. If something is in the way, it bumps and comes back.
• The passenger at the front of the line boards a boat of their color; a full boat sails out to sea.
• If all five berths fill with boats nobody can board, the harbor is jammed. Plan your moves!

THE TIDE
Every few moves the tide turns. Low tide uncovers sandbars that block the way; high tide covers them again. Read the tide and send the right boat at the right time.

FEATURES
• 60 levels from easy to tricky, every one verified solvable
• Dinghies, tugboats and ferries: different lengths, different seat counts
• Hidden boats: their color stays under a cover until a neighbor leaves
• Undo, +2 Berths, Hold the Tide and Hint boosters
• Spend the coins you earn to bring the town back to life: lighthouse lamp, flowers, market stall, harbor café, string lights
• Every color has its own emblem, so colors are easy to tell apart
• Plays offline
• English and Turkish

Tidehop is free to play. It contains ads and offers optional in-app purchases.

name: Tile Tally: Word Puzzle Game
description:
Every tile has a number. Find the words and count it down.

Tile Tally is a cosy word puzzle game with a twist you can see. Each letter tile shows its tally: how many hidden words still use it. Trace a word across neighbouring tiles and every tile you used counts down. When a tile reaches zero, it pops off the board. Find every word to clear the board.

No time limits, no lives and no rush. Just you, the letters and that satisfying pop.

A GRAND TOUR OF WORD PUZZLES
• 2,500 levels across 50 worlds, each one a journey along its own map
• Every chapter is a new stop with its own landmark, postcards and a passport stamp
• A Hard Level every 10 levels, with a suitcase of rewards after it and a World Trunk every 50
• Small boards that are quick to play and hard to put down

FRESH TWISTS ALONG THE WAY
• Golden levels: every letter of every hidden word you find pays a coin for 90 seconds
• Locked tiles that open when you find hidden words next to them
• Mystery tiles that keep their letter secret until a hidden word reveals it
• Bonus words fill your Bonus Jar with extra coins

A NEW DAILY PUZZLE EVERY DAY
• A bigger board than most levels, every day, the same for everyone
• Collect the moving gem, keep your streak going and open a Streak Gift every 7 days
• Share your result without spoiling the words

THE TALLY CUP
• A 24-hour race up the standings: every board you clear scores points
• Finish in the top 3 for prizes and a Cup frame

HELP WHEN YOU WANT IT
• Pick-a-tile reveals the letter you choose; Burst reveals five
• Stuck for a while? A gentle nudge shows you where to start
• Earn coins from Lucky Tiles, the Daily Spin, suitcases and bonus words

COLLECT AS YOU TRAVEL
• Trophies, passport stamps and postcards from every stop
• Avatars and frames to make your profile your own

MADE TO BE EASY ON THE EYES
• Clear numbers and big letters, with Large letters, High contrast, Tap mode, a left-handed layout and Reduce Motion support
• Play offline: levels need no Wi-Fi
• An optional sign-in backs up your progress and brings it to a new device

TALLY CLUB
Tally Club is an optional subscription: no ad breaks or banners, 100 coins and a Pick-a-tile every day, and double coins from Lucky Tiles. Bonus videos stay available and play only when you tap them. Choose monthly or yearly; new subscribers get a 7-day free trial.

Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase, or when the free trial ends. The subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it anytime in your Apple Account settings.

Tile Tally is free to play, with ads and optional in-app purchases. Your first purchase of each coin pack and bundle gives double.

Terms of Use: https://frostbyteentertainment.com/terms-of-service_tiletally
Privacy Policy: https://frostbyteentertainment.com/privacy-policy_tiletally
Questions or ideas? Write to support@frostbyteentertainment.com. We read every message.

name: TimeFlow HQ
description:
TimeFlow HQ is simple time tracking for freelancers and small teams. Track time in one tap, keep your week in order and see what each project really earns.

TRACK TIME YOUR WAY
• Start and stop a timer in one tap, with a project, task, tags and a description
• Pick up an earlier piece of work again with its play button
• Add time you forgot afterwards, with a start and end time

YOUR WEEK AT A GLANCE
• A weekly timesheet: type 1.5, 1:30 or 90m straight into a day
• A calendar showing what you worked on and the gaps you didn't track
• Tap to add time, or press and hold to drag an entry to a new time

PROJECTS AND RATES
• Bill by the hour, by the day or at a fixed price, or mark work as non-billable
• Give each project a client and a colour, and set a default project
• Break projects down into tasks, and label time with tags

REPORTS
• Total time and the billable amount for any dates
• A breakdown by project, filtered by project, task or tag

WORKS OFFLINE
Everything is kept on your device, so TimeFlow HQ works on a train or a plane. Changes sync as soon as you're back online.

ONE ACCOUNT, EVERYWHERE
Use the same TimeFlow HQ account on your iPhone, your iPad, in your browser and in the desktop apps for Windows and Mac. Your time stays in sync between them all.

You'll need a TimeFlow HQ account to sign in. Create one free at timeflowhq.com.

name: Times Tables Check – Year 4
description:
Get ready for the Year 4 Multiplication Tables Check.

In June, every Year 4 child in England answers 25 times tables questions on an iPad or laptop, with just 6 seconds for each one. Times Tables Check helps your child practise for it, a few minutes at a time, so they can recall the facts quickly instead of counting up.

MOCK CHECKS
• 25 questions from the 2 to 12 times tables, with more of the trickier 6, 7, 8, 9 and 12 times tables
• 6 seconds per question with a 3-second pause, answered on a number pad, just like the real check
• Scored at the end, with the facts to practise and the average answer time

PRACTICE
• Smart practice picks the facts your child finds hardest or hasn't tried yet
• Tricky tables: a mix of the 6, 7, 8, 9 and 12 times tables
• Practise any table from 2 to 12, with or without the timer, with the right answer shown after each question
• 1-minute challenge: how many facts can you answer in a minute?
• Chant a table: read along or listen to it read aloud, then hide the answers and test yourself

PROGRESS
• A 2 to 12 grid coloured by how well each fact is known
• The trickiest facts, mock check scores over time and a daily streak
• A countdown to the check and a tip of the day

FOR PARENTS
Behind a parent code:
• A guide to the check: what it involves, what to practise and how to help at home
• Optional results emails: after each practice you get a short summary with the score, the change since last time, answer speed and the facts to work on. You confirm your email address first, and every email has an unsubscribe link.

PRIVATE BY DEFAULT
No account, no ads, no analytics. Progress stays on the device. Results only leave it if a parent turns on results emails.

Works on iPhone and iPad, with keyboard support on iPad.

Times Tables Check is an independent practice app. It isn't made by or affiliated with the Department for Education or the Standards and Testing Agency.

name: Tingsnytt
description:
Tingsnytt visar förhandlingarna i Sveriges tingsrätter och hovrätter, dag för dag och domstol för domstol.

VAD APPEN GÖR
• Dagens förhandlingar i ditt län: tid, sal, målnummer, typ av förhandling och vad saken gäller.
• Bevaka ett mål, en domstol eller ett brott och få en notis när en ny förhandlingsdag kommer, när tid eller sal ändras, eller kvällen före en förhandling.
• Sök på brott, domstol, län eller målnummer.
• Läs vad ett brott innebär och vilken straffskala lagen anger.
• Rättsnyheter från domstolarna, Åklagarmyndigheten och polisen.
• Tingsnytts veckopodd.
• De listor du senast hämtade går att läsa utan nät.

VARIFRÅN UPPGIFTERNA KOMMER
Uppgifterna hämtas från domstolarnas egna offentliga förhandlingslistor. Tiderna är preliminära: förhandlingar kan ställas in med kort varsel och andra kan tillkomma. Kontakta domstolen för aktuell information.

INGA PERSONNAMN
Appen visar inga namn på parter, tilltalade eller målsägande. Ett mål visas med målnummer, domstol, tid, sal och vad saken gäller. Den som är misstänkt eller åtalad är inte dömd.

INGET KONTO
Appen kräver ingen inloggning och ingen e-postadress. Ditt län och det du bevakar sparas i telefonen. Slår du på notiser sparas ett slumpat id för telefonen, ditt län och din bevakningslista hos Tingsnytt, så att notiserna kan skickas. Uppgifterna kopplas inte till dig som person och säljs inte.

PODDEN ÄR AI-GENERERAD
Veckopodden skrivs av en AI utifrån domstolarnas listor och nyheter och läses av syntetiska röster. Den är märkt som AI-genererad.

Tingsnytt är en fristående tjänst och är inte en del av Sveriges Domstolar.

name: Tintfolio
description:
Dear friend,

Good colors vanish from memory the moment you leave the shop or close the tab. Tintfolio is a pocket notebook for those colors — for designers, illustrators, and anyone who wants to keep a hue note, a mood word, and where they saw it before the feeling fades.

1. Log a swatch in plain language
Give it a title up to 120 characters, a required primary hue note up to 200 characters (a name, a hex hint, or a short description such as “Warm coral #E87461 over oatmeal”), an optional accent hue note up to 200 characters, a mood tag up to 40 characters, and an optional source remark up to 200 characters. You are writing what you noticed, not sampling from the camera.

2. Keep what matters, shelve the rest
Swatches you are still using stay on Keep. When a palette is ready to park, Shelve it. From detail you can flip Keep / Shelve and attach an optional board note up to 500 characters — a one-line “pair with soft serif headings” reminder — or leave the note empty.

3. Search and filter the full library
Library holds every swatch. Type into search to match title, hue notes, mood, source, or board note. Flip All / Keep / Shelve only to narrow the shelf. Open any card to reread, edit, or delete.

4. Browse by mood tag
Moods lists every emotional tag with a swatch count. Open a tag to jump straight back into the matching cards, then search again inside that mood if you like.

5. Detail, edit, and clear
Open a swatch to see the full notes, change placement, edit the board note, or delete. About carries a short walkthrough, Privacy, Support mail to vitalisonditi@icloud.com, and Erase library after two confirmations.

The look is calm: a soft wash behind white inset cards, teal actions, and Keep / Shelve that read at a glance. Landscape keeps the same notebook flow with room to scroll. Everything works offline on this device. No account, no ads, nothing to buy. Your swatch library stays on the phone.

Warmly,
Tintfolio

name: TinyPrint: Memory Printer
description:
Some things are too small for a photo album, and too lovely to forget.

The coffee that tasted just right. A note from someone you love. A little win on a very ordinary day.

TinyPrint turns those moments into beautiful thermal-style receipts. Add a photograph, a few words, a date, and a feeling. Choose your paper, press the orange button, and watch your memory roll out.

A TINY PRINTER, FULL OF FEELING

Enjoy a tactile paper-feed animation, gentle haptics, and original mechanical printer sounds. Pull your print to tear it off, or use the Tear button. Your memory is saved as soon as printing starts.

The printer starts with a short blank paper edge. Load a memory when you are ready; its ticket appears when you press PRINT. You can check your draft with Preview your print in the editor.

THREE WAYS TO KEEP A MOMENT

Capture an everyday moment, write a little note, or celebrate your small wins. Choose cream, blush, or sage paper. Selected photos get a soft black-and-white thermal finish.

YOUR OWN LITTLE COLLECTION

Browse, search, favourite, and revisit your prints. Your draft is kept between visits, so you can finish when the words arrive.

MADE TO BE SHARED

Share a full-length, high-resolution image of your print with the system share sheet. Send a note to someone, save an image to Photos, or keep it just for yourself.

AT HOME ON IPHONE DUO

TinyPrint adapts its paper and printer controls to the larger inner display and the fold. Your memory stays with you as the available space changes. It also works on other supported iPhones and iPad.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN

No account. No advertising. No tracking or analytics. Your memories stay in the app on your device unless you choose to share them.

Keep the little things.

name: TipTop Words
description:
Mit TipTop Words lernen Kleinkinder ihre ersten Wörter ganz von selbst – mit schönen Bildern, einer freundlichen Stimme und kleinen Rate-Spielen.

SO FUNKTIONIERT ES
• Tippen: Das Kind tippt auf ein Bild und hört sofort das Wort, zum Beispiel „Das Auto“. Der Name erscheint dazu groß auf dem Bildschirm.
• Entdecken: In jeder Welt gibt es viele Bilder zum Anschauen und Antippen, in aller Ruhe und ohne Zeitdruck.
• Raten: Eine Stimme fragt „Wo ist der Bus?“ – das Kind wählt das richtige Bild. Wer es gefunden hat, bekommt einen Stern und Konfetti. Ein falscher Tipp ist nicht schlimm: Die Stimme ermutigt, es noch einmal zu versuchen.
• Wörter erraten: Ein gemischtes Spiel mit 5, 10, 15, 20, 25 oder 30 Bildern. Kein Wort kommt in einem Spiel zweimal dran.

750+ WÖRTER IN 68 WELTEN
Tiere (Bauernhof, Wald, Savanne, Meer, Dinos und viele mehr), Fahrzeuge, Spielzeug, Kleidung, Kinderzimmer, Schlafzimmer, Küche, Badezimmer, Obst und Gemüse, Essen und Trinken, Körper, Familie, Berufe, Wetter, Natur, Musik, Sport und vieles mehr.

DAS MACHT TIPTOP WORDS BESONDERS
• Alle Wörter werden von einer freundlichen deutschen Stimme gesprochen, langsam und deutlich.
• Liebevoll gezeichnete Bilder, extra für kleine Kinder.
• Sanfte Hintergrundmusik, die sich der Welt anpasst. Sie lässt sich jederzeit ausschalten.
• Beim Raten kommen nicht immer dieselben Wörter dran: Die App merkt sich, was zuletzt gefragt wurde.
• Funktioniert ohne Internet.
• Keine Werbung. Kein Abo. Keine Datensammlung.

FÜR ELTERN
Ein paar Welten sind gratis zum Ausprobieren. Weitere Welten gibt es als einmalige Pakete (kein Abo), oder alles zusammen zu einem günstigeren Preis. Käufe sind durch eine Elternabfrage geschützt. Die App sammelt keine persönlichen Daten.

Hinweis: Die Bilder und die Stimme der App wurden mit Hilfe von künstlicher Intelligenz erstellt.

name: Tishkbase
description:
Tishkbase is an all-in-one Point of Sale (POS) and business management system designed for shops, wholesalers, and distribution teams.

Key Features:
• Fast POS sales, invoicing, and receipt printing
• Real-time inventory, stock, and expiry tracking
• Customer and supplier debt/loan management
• Sales representative tracking, visits, and daily targets
• Multi-currency support and detailed financial reports
• Responsive design built for both iPhone and iPad

name: Tochi: Pixel Cat
description:
Tochi is a small pixel cat who lives in your widgets, and in a little room inside the app.

His energy follows yours. After a short night he is slow and says so. After a good one he is up and perky. When you have been out walking, he perks up too. In the evening he winds down, and at night he sleeps.

You do not have to open the app. Put Tochi on your Home Screen or Lock Screen and glance at him now and then. He has a small energy bar and one short line, like "rough night. me too."

Open the app to visit his room. The window follows the real sunrise and sunset for your part of the world, and shows cloud, rain or snow when there is some. A strip along the bottom shows his day. Stroke him to pet him. Give him a treat: a strawberry, a cookie, then a dumpling, each eaten its own way. If you have just been out walking, he trots on his rug.

Tochi shows today's step count in the app and on the large widget. At 5,000 steps he wiggles, and a small souvenir turns up in his room. At 10,000 he claps. There are no sleep numbers anywhere, no goals, and no streaks.

To know how you are doing, Tochi reads your sleep and steps from Apple Health. It is read only, and your health data stays on your phone. There is no account, no sign-in, no analytics and no ads. If you would rather not share anything, Tochi still works. He just goes by the time of day.

No sleep tracker? Tochi can guess your night from your steps. Each morning he can also ask "how did we sleep?" and you answer with one tap. Both stay on your phone.

What you get:
- Tochi on the Home Screen (small, medium and large) and the Lock Screen (round and rectangular)
- His room in the app, with a window that matches the sky and the weather
- Petting, three treats, a trot after a walk and a souvenir after a good day
- A free lilac Tochi, with every widget and every behaviour included
- Tochi+, a one-time purchase that unlocks 14 more colours: Honey, Custard, Drizzle, Inverse Honey, Taro Tummy, Sage, Petal, Plum, Berry, Ochre, Latte, Maple, Chai and Toast

Tochi is a companion, not a health app. He does not give advice. Low energy is just cosy.

Works on iPhone alone. Steps come from your iPhone and from any wearable that writes to Apple Health. Sleep comes from a wearable or from a Sleep schedule on your iPhone.

The weather in his window comes from Apple Weather, for the city your phone's time zone is named after. Tochi never asks for your location.

name: Today Experience: Life Journal
description:
Keep a private journal of real experiences, with photos, personal ratings, costs, and notes you can use next time.

Today Experience is a life journal for anything you have actually tried. Record how it felt, compare your own experiences, and keep track of what you would do again. Core journaling features work offline after download and purchase validation. Buy once, with no account, ads, or subscription.

Record a meal, trip, show, exhibition, class, product, service, or any moment that mattered, then find it later by date, category, or keyword.

CAPTURE THE MOMENT
• Create a record with a name, date, and category.
• Add photos, a place, cost, rating, and a short note when you want.
• Save first and add details later.
• Import a photo from your library; confirm its date before using it.

FIND IT LATER
• Search by part of an experience name, place, or note.
• Browse your timeline, calendar, and categories.
• Keep a personal note about what you felt and whether you would do it again.
• Compare two experiences side by side by rating, cost, category, and revisit intent.
• See yearly insights by category, rating, spending, and what you would do again.
• Keep a revisit list and set a local reminder for a future experience.

USE IT NEXT TIME
• Save what to remember for next time, including what you liked and what to watch for.
• Use your own history to make a more informed personal choice.

PRIVATE AND OFFLINE
• Records stay in the app on your device. No account, ads, subscription, or social feed.
• After download and purchase validation, create, edit, browse, search, and export offline.
• The app does not provide its own cloud sync or public posting.
• iOS device backups may include app data according to your Apple settings.

YOUR DATA
• Export and import your archive, with an optional encrypted backup.
• Manage photos and recently deleted records on device.

One-time purchase. No subscription. Your records are not locked behind extra purchases. Backups include record photos and recently deleted records, with no fixed file-size cap; actual export capacity depends on free device storage and available memory.

Today Experience helps you compare your own past experiences. It does not collect future ideas, recommend activities, book services, or publish reviews.

name: Together: Color Connections
description:
Every color needs a path. You get to make it.

In Together, drag your finger to connect shapes with matching colors and symbols. Plan paths that do not cross, and connect every pair to complete the puzzle. Each generated puzzle is checked for a valid solution before play.

PLAY AT YOUR OWN PACE
Start with three colors and work through progressively larger, more varied boards. Undo a move, use a hint, or find a cleaner solution to collect more stars. You do not need to fill every board cell to win.

A FRESH DAILY CHALLENGE
Return for a new daily puzzle, or try Speed Challenge with three difficulty settings. Regular play has no timer; in Speed Challenge, every second counts.

REWARDS THAT HELP YOU PLAY
Complete missions, earn coins, and exchange them for boosters and visual themes. Extra Time, Time Freeze, and Auto Connect can help in Speed Challenge. Coins and boosters are earned in the game, with no real-money purchases.

A COLORFUL COMPANION
Celebrate with stars, original sound effects, and a friendly companion that reacts to your progress. Adjust sounds, haptics, and celebrations in Settings.

MADE FOR IPHONE AND IPAD
• Arabic and English interfaces.
• Symbols that help distinguish colors.
• Automatic progress saving on your device.
• Offline play with no account, ads, or in-app purchases.

Draw your next path. Bring the colors together.

name: Tolk: Offline Translator
description:
Tolk turns your iPhone into a live interpreter that works anywhere — on a plane, abroad without roaming, or in a market with no signal.

Put the phone on the table between you and the person you're talking to. You speak, and Tolk says it out loud in their language. They answer, and Tolk says it in yours. Each of you gets your own half of the screen, written in your own language.

COMPLETELY OFFLINE
• Speech recognition, translation and voices all run on your iPhone
• Download the language packs once on Wi-Fi, then use Tolk in flight mode
• No account, no sign-up, no ads, no tracking

TWO WAYS TO TALK
• Automatic: Tolk hears both languages and translates whoever is speaking, hands-free
• Hold to speak: each person holds their button while talking. Made for noisy cafés, markets and taxis

MADE FOR REAL CONVERSATIONS
• Translations are spoken through the loudspeaker, even with AirPods connected
• Natural Premium and Enhanced voices, at the speed you choose
• Questions sound like questions
• Travel vocabulary for restaurants, hotels, taxis and shops
• Tap any translation to hear it again

20 LANGUAGES
Arabic, Chinese (Simplified and Traditional), Dutch, English, French, German, Hindi, Indonesian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish, Thai, Turkish, Ukrainian and Vietnamese — plus a Jamaican Patois phrasebook.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
What you say never leaves your iPhone. Tolk has no servers and collects no data.

name: Tong Shu: Chinese Almanac
description:
Tong Shu brings the traditional Chinese almanac to your iPhone, in clear English, with the original Chinese alongside.

Every day from 1950 to 2100 shows:
• The lunar date and the day rating: Good, Fair or Avoid
• What the almanac favours today and what it advises against: weddings, moving, travel, opening a business, building, burials and dozens more
• The year, month and day pillars (for example, Fire Horse)
• The day officer and a short reading of the day
• The clash animal, sha direction, mansion, day god and Na Yin
• Auspicious hours across the day
• The solar term, the five-day pentad and the exact moon phase
• The spirits of the day

HOME AND LOCK SCREEN WIDGETS
See today at a glance: the lunar date, the day rating and the top things to do and avoid. Small, medium and Lock Screen sizes.

CALENDAR
Browse any month with lunar days, solar terms and a colour dot for each day rating. Tap a day to read it in full.

FAITHFUL TO THE CLASSICAL ALMANAC
The good and avoid lists follow the Qing imperial almanac, the Xieji Bianfang Shu (1739), and are checked against the book's own printed month tables. Lunar dates are checked against the Hong Kong Observatory tables.

YOUR WAY
English first, or switch to Chinese. Traditional or Simplified characters, with Pinyin or Jyutping.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No accounts, no ads, no tracking. The whole almanac lives in the app and works offline.

Traditional almanac guidance, shared as cultural heritage. It is not medical, legal or financial advice.

Support: https://compo-cf.github.io/tongshu-almanac/
Privacy: https://compo-cf.github.io/tongshu-almanac/privacy.html

name: TordenKamp
description:
Nordisk taktisk kortspil med kapitler, kortfrigjøring og kampbalje

SPIL TIL DEN, DER VIL TÆNKE FØR

Tordenkamp er et singleplayer kortspil med dyb taktisk lag. Du spiller mod en modstander, der tænker, og mod din evne til at læse en marke.

Det er ikke held der gør det ud. Det er rækkefølge, skjold, timing og overvejelser.

FEM KAPITLER, 25 BANER

Rejsen går gennem fem kapitler og 25 baner. Hvert kapitel har sit eget maleri, sin egen fortælling og egne modstandere.

Kapitel I, Tårnets Vågen, handler om en gammel port der endnu holder. Kapitel II, Moseens Tåge, fører dig ud i tåge og forsvundne veje. Kapitel III, Den Røde Port, møder du en bygning der engang åndede. Kapitel IV, Smeltedigens Stjerne, venter en stjerne under glasklokke. Og i Kapitel V, Tordenkamp, møder du marken mellem port og tårn.

Mellem banerne læser du historien. Den fortæller, hvad der skete mens du var væk.

SÅDAN SPILLER DU

Hver tur får du et nyt ATP-loft. ATP er den eneste ressource, og den afgør hvad du kan sætte i spil.

Du trækker kort fra din hånd til din marke. Kort koster ATP. Et væsen med angrebsevne kan angribe i en kommende tur. Skjoldvætter skal nedlægges, før resten af din marke kan angribes. En Storm angriber samme tur. En Helsebrydning ignorerer skjold på sit mål. En Træk henter et kort fra din hånd. En Hvirvelvind rammer alle fjender. En Velsignet får ekstra ATK og HELSE.

Vælg en modstander, vælg et angreb, se følgerne.

Du har også en heldoevne. TORNESLAG koster 2 ATP, giver 1 skade direkte på modstanderens helbred og kan bruges én gang hver tur. Det er ofte den genvej, der afgør en tæt kamp.

MÅLE STYRKEN

En styrkemåler viser live, hvordan din marke og modstanderens står til hinanden. Den fortæller, hvornår du er forude, og hvornår du har fordelen.

DU FÅR KORT, DU BEHOLDER DEM

Hver gang du vinder en bane, frigøres nye kort til din samling. De bliver en del af dit dæks grundlag, så samlingen vokser og bliver stærkere gennem spillet.

En bane er låst indtil den forrige er vundet. En bane i et nyt kapitel åbnes, når hele forrige kapitel er gennemført. Fremskridt, stjerner og kort gemmes på enheden.

DU VED DET, HVAD DU HAR SPILLET

Hver bane kan give op til tre stjerner. Du får flere, hvis du vinder med meget helbred tilbage, og hvis du gennemfører banen inden for et bestemt antal ture. Stjernerne viser, at du har spillet med omtanke.

FEM OG TYVE HANDKÆRTE KORT

Hvert kort er håndtegnet i sit eget motiv og har sin egen evne, værdi og beskrivelse. Væsener, værer, støtter og formler. Almindelige, særlige og unikke kort. Se dem i din samling.

MODSTANDERE DER TÆNKER

Der er 25 modstandere med forskellige helbred, ATP-lofter, startdæk og dygtighed. Nogle bygger forsvar, andre fylder marken. Deres beslutninger tager hensyn til din marke.

DET ER DET HELE

Spillet kræver ingen konto. Intet købes. Der er ingen ventetid og ingen tidsbegrænsede events. Du åbner spillet, spiller, og går videre når du vil.

name: TrainingLoop
description:
TrainingLoop is a strength training log for iPhone. Plan workout templates or improvise as you go. At the gym, simply tick off your sets. Save finished workouts and add the ones you forgot to log. Follow the progress of your workouts and of every exercise with charts and records, update your templates and share your workouts with anyone.

TEMPLATES
• Arrange exercises in the order you want.
• Supersets: neighbouring exercises are done in rounds.
• Pyramids and warm-up sets are simply separate rows.
• Or train without a plan in a free workout.
• Ready-made examples to get you started.

DURING THE WORKOUT
• Next to every set you see last time's result; the fields fill in by themselves.
• Tick off a set and the rest begins, with sounds, voice cues and vibration.
• Rest and the current set on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island.
• A new record is marked right next to the set.

HISTORY AND PROGRESS
• Personal records: heaviest weight, best weight for 1, 3, 5, 8 and 10 reps, reps, time and volume.
• A chart for every exercise: best weight, volume, reps or time over a week, a month, three months, a year or all time.
• Weekly, monthly and yearly summaries: workouts, time, volume, sets by muscle group and your week streak.
• Forgot to log a workout? Add it afterwards or correct a past one — records and charts are recalculated.
• Share your workouts with anyone as text.

EXERCISES AND SETTINGS
• 126 built-in exercises in English and Russian, plus your own.
• Search and filters by muscle group and equipment.
• Kilograms or pounds, light and dark theme.

Free, no limits: every feature is available right away — no subscriptions, paid extras, ads or sign-up. Your workouts stay on your iPhone.

Questions and suggestions: t.me/setnewloop

name: Tranz ERP
description:
Tranz ERP connects employees to their organization's ERPNext workspace.

• Record check-in and check-out with your current location.
• View attendance history and your attendance calendar.
• Submit leave, attendance and compensatory leave requests and follow their status.
• View assigned tasks and project progress.
• Access salary statements and workplace notifications.

An existing employee account with a participating organization is required. Available features depend on your organization's configuration and account permissions. Location permission is required when recording attendance.

name: Treadmill Virtual Run
description:
Same belt. New road. Treadmill Virtual Run turns your indoor run into a 3D run along real roads, so you watch the sea and the city go by instead of a wall.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Pick a route.
2. Set the speed and incline to match your treadmill.
3. Hit Start. Your runner and the road move at your pace, step for step.

RUN THE SEASIDE
Start with Beach Road in Pattaya, Thailand: 3 km with the sea on one side, palm trees, shophouses and traffic on the other. More routes are on the way.

EVERY STAT, LIVE
See your distance, time, pace and estimated calories as you run, plus a mini map that shows where you are on the route. Change speed and incline mid-run whenever your treadmill does.

YOUR VIEW, YOUR WAY
Run behind your runner or switch to first-person and see the road through your own eyes. Turn your phone sideways for a wider view, or hide the controls for just the scenery.

EARN POINTS EVERY KM
Get 10 points for every full kilometre you run. Spend them on new outfits for your female or male runner.

SHARE YOUR RUN
Finish a run and share a card with your distance, time, pace and calories, sized for stories.

YOUR ACCOUNT
Running is free and needs no account. Sign in with Apple to keep your points and outfits, so they stay with you if you change phones. You can delete your account and its data at any time from the app.

POINT PACKS
Want more outfits sooner? Point packs are optional in-app purchases.

PRIVACY
Your sex and body weight stay on your iPhone and are used only to pick your runner and estimate calories. Privacy policy: https://treadmill-virtual-run-monitor.vercel.app/privacy

GOOD TO KNOW
Treadmill Virtual Run doesn't connect to your treadmill: set the speed and incline in the app to match the machine. Calories are an estimate.

name: TrendKind: Weight Tracker
description:
TrendKind brings weight tracking and personal reflection together. Log readings in pounds or kilograms and see your trend over time. Add notes, look back through Logbook, and choose a goal or maintenance range that fits your routine.

Keep a journal and a separate private photo timeline. You can start without entering a weight, and you can use the tracker without an account.

Apple Health is optional. Review Weight access first, then choose when to import. Saving weigh-ins you enter in TrendKind to Apple Health is a separate setting.

Use the optional privacy lock, local reminders, and Home Screen widgets at your own pace. Export and check a tracker backup in Files. Photo archives are exported separately.

name: TrickNight
description:
Trick Night is a card table in your pocket for the classic trick-taking games, with no ads, no accounts and no tracking. Pick a game, pick Easy, Normal or Hard, and deal. Your computer partner sits across the table, and the opponents are drawn from twelve regulars, from Lulu, who plays whatever's closest, to Rex, who counts every card.

FIVE GAMES
- Spades: partners bid their tricks. Nil and Blind Nil, bags, and first to 500.
- Hearts: every player for themselves. Pass three cards, dodge the Queen of Spades, or shoot the moon. Low score wins at 100.
- Euchre: five-card hands, right and left bowers, going alone and stick the dealer. First team to 10.
- Pinochle: four players in partnerships with a single deck. Bid, name trump, pass four cards with your partner, show your meld and take the counters. First to 1500.
- Two-Handed Pinochle: just you and one opponent. Meld after each trick you win, draw from the stock, then play out the last twelve tricks. First to 1000.

TWELVE PLAYERS, THREE LEVELS
- Easy players make beginner mistakes. Good for learning a new game.
- Normal players play solid cards and keep track of what's out.
- Hard players think through how the rest of the hand could go before every card.
- Players are seated at random each game, so the table is a little different every time.

HELP WHEN YOU WANT IT
- How to Play explains every game: bidding, passing, trump, meld and scoring.
- Suggested Spades bids, a Suggest button for passing and burying cards, and your meld for each trump suit while you bid in Pinochle.
- Cards you can't play are dimmed, and the table tells you why: follow suit, hearts not broken, must trump.
- Tap a card to raise it, tap again to play it, so a slip of the finger doesn't cost you a trick.
- The last trick stays on the table so you can see who took it.

EASY TO SEE, EASY TO PLAY
- Large, clear cards with red and black suits.
- Built for VoiceOver: every card, bid and trick is announced in plain words.
- Supports larger text, Reduce Motion and haptics.

PLAYS ANYWHERE
- Works fully offline, and the computer players run on your iPhone.
- Your game saves automatically, so you can stop and pick up mid-hand.
- No ads, no in-app purchases, no sign-up, no data collected.

name: Trittakt
description:
Trittakt displays your bicycle or spinning bike cadence on your iPhone. Connect an additional Bluetooth chest strap to see your pulse at the same time: revolutions per minute in rpm and heart rate in bpm.

Both readings use equally sized numbers in cards with a light gray background. Each card has a bicycle or heart icon and a label above the number, with the unit beside it. The cards stack in portrait and sit side by side in landscape. The screen stays awake while a sensor is connected.

Heart rate is optional. You can use a compatible Bluetooth heart rate sensor, such as a Polar chest strap that supports the standard Bluetooth Heart Rate profile. Without a saved chest strap, Trittakt shows cadence only.

Connect the chest strap separately in Settings. Both sensors are saved, reconnected and reset independently. Missing skin contact, a zero reading or five seconds without new heart rate data replaces the old pulse with a dash.

After the first valid cadence measurement, Trittakt remembers your sensor. When you reopen the app or the connection drops, it automatically tries to reconnect to that sensor. Reset the saved sensor in Settings to connect a different one.

Trittakt is free, with no ads, subscriptions or in-app purchases. No account is required. The app does not send measurements or sensor information to a server. Your saved sensor stays on your iPhone.

Requirements and limitations

A separate Bluetooth Low Energy cadence sensor supporting the standard Cycling Speed and Cadence service (CSC) is required. ANT+-only sensors are not compatible. Proprietary fitness bike protocols are not supported.

Mount the sensor on the crank and select cadence mode. A sensor on the flywheel or in speed mode does not measure your pedal cadence.

The optional pulse display requires a sensor supporting the standard Bluetooth Heart Rate service. ANT+-only or GymLink-only chest straps are not compatible. The display is for training, not medical diagnosis.

The display changes to 0 rpm after four seconds without a detected revolution. Missing data while Bluetooth remains connected can also look like a stop. The app disconnects in the background and reconnects when you return.

Trittakt displays current cadence and optional heart rate. It does not record workout history, write data to HealthKit or calculate speed, distance or calories.

Requires an iPhone with iOS 16.0 or later. Sensor and bicycle are not included.

Available in English and German. The interface follows your iPhone's preferred app language.

name: True Profile: Verified ID
description:
True Profile gives you one verified long-form profile to link from your dating app bio, a text, or a DM. Anyone you send it to can open it and read your words with no account and no sign up needed.

Every profile carries three badges that back up who you really are: Identity Verified, Photo Verified, and Human Entered. Human Entered is backed by the TrueType Authentication System, which checks that your words were typed by you in real time, never pasted in and never written by AI.

In your own words. True Profile is a place to show who you are, not another place to meet someone. There is no matching, no swiping, no messaging, no search, no likes, no followers, and nothing writes your profile for you.

What you get:
- One verified long-form profile you write yourself
- Identity Verified badge
- Photo Verified badge
- Human Entered badge, confirmed by the TrueType Authentication System
- A private link you can share anywhere, including a dating app bio
- Readers open your profile with no account required
- No matching, swiping, messaging, search, likes, followers, or AI writing

name: Tubeist Scorer
description:
Keep score from the sideline and put a live scoreboard on your Tubeist stream or recording. Tubeist Scorer runs on an iPhone or iPad and sends the overlay directly over Bluetooth to a second device running Tubeist 2.4.0 or later.

• Score 21 sports, including volleyball, basketball, soccer, tennis, ice hockey, baseball, and T20 cricket. Each sport has its own scoring controls.
• Set team names and colors, choose from six scoreboard themes, and adjust the size in the live preview.
• Pair with the six-digit code shown in Tubeist. The scoreboard updates as you score.
• Keep score and preview the overlay offline. Scorer works as a standalone scorekeeper, too.

name: Tuki: To-Do List for Mac
description:
Tuki helps you stop keeping tasks in your head — and wondering where you wrote them down.

Thought of something away from your Mac? Add it from your iPhone, iPad or Apple Watch. It syncs through iCloud and shows up on your Mac within seconds.

When your Mac wakes from sleep, when you unlock it, or when you come back after a long break, Tuki briefly shows your current tasks in the menu bar. No need to remember to open the app and check what’s left to do.

CATCH IT BEFORE YOU FORGET

Add a task the moment it comes to mind, wherever you are.

On Apple Watch, tap the Tuki icon and dictate your task. On iPhone and iPad, use Siri, the widget, or the Control Center button. On Mac, you can quickly add a task without interrupting what you’re doing.

Everything syncs through your iCloud. No sign-up or separate account needed.

YOUR LIST SHOWS UP AT THE RIGHT MOMENT

Most to-do lists only work if you remember to open them.

Tuki takes care of that. When you sit back down at your Mac, your list appears in the menu bar and shows what still needs your attention. A few seconds later, it quietly hides again.

It won’t pop up during a call or while you’re using a full-screen app. You can also set work hours, so Tuki stays out of the way once your workday is over.

ONE TASK AT A TIME

Start the focus timer and a little caterpillar begins eating a tomato while you work.

You can see time passing at a glance without watching the clock.

When the session ends, Tuki reminds you to take a break and suggests a quick stretch.

Finish a task and the caterpillar eats that too. A small reward for getting one more thing done.

REMINDERS WITHOUT THE SETUP

Just write what you need in plain language.

“Remind me at 5 pm to join the team call.” Tuki takes care of the timing.

Unfinished tasks don’t disappear. Move them to tomorrow, next week or next month when they no longer need your attention today.

Closed something by mistake? Bring it straight back.

MAKE TIME FOR MORE THAN WORK

In “Time for yourself”, you can set aside time for up to three regular activities — drawing, learning a language, reading, or anything else you want to protect time for.

When it’s time, the focus timer pauses automatically.

CALENDAR AND REMINDERS — IF YOU WANT THEM

Calendar events and tasks from Apple Reminders can appear alongside your Tuki tasks.

It’s off by default, so your list stays as simple as you want it.

YOUR TASKS STAY YOURS

Tuki doesn’t require an account or store your tasks on its own servers.

Your tasks are stored and synced through your iCloud.

Tuki only collects anonymous usage statistics, such as which features are used and on which devices. Your tasks and personal data are never shared.

Catch a thought when it appears. See it again when you sit down at your Mac. Then get on with your day.

name: TuScan
description:
TuScan turns your iPhone into a scanner for everything you have on paper and film.

DOCUMENTS
• A4 sheet recognition: the camera looks only for a real A4 sheet and checks its shape and size in 3D (21 × 29.7 cm), ignoring receipts, envelopes, books and anything that isn't A4
• The frame stays locked to the sheet even when you move the phone, and the page is cropped straight to exact A4 proportions, even when shot at an angle
• One tap switches to free shape for cards, receipts and other paper sizes, with real-world size in centimeters and paper size recognition (A5, Letter…)
• Multi-page PDFs with searchable, copyable text (OCR)
• File name taken from the document's barcode

PRINTED PHOTOS
• Automatic cropping and straightening
• Date and place taken written to the EXIF and GPS data, so photos land in the right spot in your Photos library

LARGE SHEETS
• Posters, maps and drawings photographed in parts and merged into one image or PDF
• While shooting, the last photo stays as an overlay so you know how far to move
• Adjustable seams and an editor to fix the merge by hand

SLIDES AND NEGATIVES
• On a white light, with lens selection and tap to focus
• Correction of color casts and fading on slides
• Color negative inversion with orange mask removal, plus black & white

SAVING
• Files, iCloud Drive, SMB servers on your home or office network, Photos library, Share

Everything happens on your phone: no account, no data sent to external servers.

name: TuVoto
description:
TuVoto reúne los programas electorales de las elecciones generales del 29 de noviembre de 2026 para que puedas comparar qué propone cada partido sin leerte cientos de páginas.

COMPARA POR TEMAS
Vivienda, empleo, sanidad, educación, impuestos, pensiones, inmigración, medio ambiente, juventud, igualdad, modelo territorial y política exterior. Cada propuesta lleva la página del programa de donde sale, para que puedas comprobarla en el documento original.

CARA A CARA
Elige dos partidos y mira sus propuestas lado a lado, tema a tema.

TEST DE AFINIDAD
Responde frases sobre medidas concretas y mira con qué programas coincides más. Hay una versión corta (25 frases) y una completa (48). Cada postura de los partidos sale de su programa, con su página. Tus respuestas no se guardan ni se envían.

TU PAPELETA
Elige tu provincia y verás primero los partidos que se presentan donde votas, según las candidaturas publicadas en el BOE.

CÓMO VOTAR
Fechas clave, guía del voto por correo y avisos opcionales en el móvil para no olvidar los plazos.

Los programas completos se pueden abrir y descargar en PDF desde la propia app.

NO ES UNA APP OFICIAL
TuVoto es un proyecto independiente. No pertenece a ningún partido político ni a ningún organismo público, ni representa a ninguno de ellos. Los resúmenes son neutrales y se basan en los programas electorales que publica cada partido. Para información oficial sobre las elecciones, consulta la web de la Junta Electoral Central y del Ministerio del Interior.

Sin registro, sin publicidad y sin recoger datos personales.

name: TV Remote Control: Universal!
description:
TV Remote Control: Universal turns your iPhone into a remote for Roku, Samsung, LG, Sony, and Android TV.

Power, volume, mute, channels, and playback are on one screen, with arrows, Back, Home, and a number pad. The touchpad is for the rest: drag to move around the TV, then tap to select.

Open Netflix, YouTube, and the other apps installed on that TV. When a screen asks for text, type it on the phone.

Setup takes a minute. Turn the TV on, join its Wi-Fi, and allow local network access. Some TVs ask you to confirm the remote on the screen. Pair once, and it is ready the next time. There is no account to create.

Light, dark, or match the room. Haptics can be switched off in Settings.

Commands go straight to the TV on your network.

name: Two Bars
description:
Your phone is out of data, and the cafe across the road has WiFi behind a password nobody will just tell you. So you look around.

Two Bars is a detective game where the mystery is always the same: what is the WiFi password? Nothing in the room spells it out. A chalkboard, a framed licence and a barista who has to like you first each give you part of the picture, and you put it together yourself.

- Tap anything that glows to take a closer look, and keep the words that matter
- Talk to people. Being nice works better than demanding
- Build a theory from the words you kept, and check whether it adds up
- Find two bars of signal, then type the password yourself
- A wrong guess gets a reply that tells you where your thinking went wrong
- Eight networks, each with its own trick: a cafe, a hotel, an airport, the in-laws, the DMV, a cruise ship, a smart home that lies, and a tower with three locks
- Free hints in three steps, from a nudge to the answer
- Story mode, three text sizes, reduced motion and colour-blind marks
- No account, no ads, no in-app purchases, and it works offline

This is a puzzle game. It cannot see, join or change any real network.

name: TWTM by Lynea
description:
Inside the TWTM by Lynea app, you can:

Access all of your videos in one easy to use app
Receive push notifications with the latest news and updates
Access to all of your videos without having to remember your password
Save your favorite posts so you can quickly find them later

name: TxtView - Text File Reader
description:
TxtView is a simple, offline reader for plain text files. Choose a TXT file from Files and start reading without an account or network connection.

• Adjust text size, font, line spacing, margins, and color theme
• Choose White, Sepia, or Dark appearance
• Search the text and jump between matches
• Resume each file from your saved reading position
• Read UTF-8, UTF-16, Shift_JIS, and EUC-JP files, with manual encoding selection
• Use the interface in English or Japanese

Files are processed on your device for reading. TxtView does not modify the original file. The maximum file size is 32 MB.

name: Tzuri
description:
Most prayer apps help you talk. Tzuri helps you listen.

Tzuri ("my Rock," from Psalm 19:14) is a guided listening prayer app. Each morning it leads you through one unhurried session, Hearing from God, in a real human voice:

1. Truth telling — give God the false thing you've been believing
2. Repentance — the changing of your mind
3. Asking — bring Him your questions
4. Listening — the longest part, with room to actually hear
5. Writing it down — keep what you heard in your own journal

Set your time with the dial, from 5 to 60 minutes. A daily verse on freedom in Christ waits at the top of the home screen. Everything you write stays in the app's What I Heard journal, on your device.

No accounts. No noise. Just space to hear.

"Let the words of my mouth, and the meditation of my heart, be acceptable in thy sight, O LORD, my strength, and redeemer." — Psalm 19:14 (KJV)

Tzuri, My Rock

name: Unclasp: Untangle the Rings
description:
A tray of bangles, linked by gold clasps. Turn one until its opening comes round to the clasp, and it slips free. Clear the tray.

A bangle that is holding another cannot turn, so the order matters. Bangles are solid, so sometimes the way round is blocked and you go the other way, or move what is in the way first. That is the whole game, and it takes a moment to learn.

NO DEAD ENDS

Every turn can be turned back, so a tray you could clear when it was dealt can still be cleared whatever you have done to it since. There is nothing to restart out of, and no timer. Every tray was solved by the game's own solver before it went in.

WHAT IS IN IT

• 300 levels, from two bangles to seventeen.
• A daily tray, new at midnight, and a streak for coming back.
• One to three stars for clearing a tray in few moves.
• Five trays to play on, unlocked with stars.
• Hints when you want one, earned by playing.
• Closed rings, double clasps, loose arms and fixed studs as the levels go on.
• Sound and vibration you can turn off.

WHAT IT LEAVES OUT

• No ads.
• No account and no sign-up.
• No tracking. Unclasp collects nothing and never connects to the internet, so it plays the same on a plane as it does at home.
• Nothing to buy inside the app.

Made by Tiltyard Games.

name: Undermeadow: Rabbit Burrow
description:
Undermeadow is a cozy dig-and-forage game about a family of rabbits. Run out into the field, gather carrots, dig your own tunnels and bring the haul home to grow your warren.

Underground it's dark. Thump to light up the soil around you for a moment, and to find buried turnips, acorns and the golden turnip that clears each field. But anything close enough to hear it comes to look.

• Dig anywhere: soft soil, clay, sand that collapses behind you, roots, rock and water that floods your tunnels.
• Read the hunters: the fox runs to your thump, the hawk marks where it will dive, the badger charges at digging it can hear.
• Tunnels stay dug while you keep coming back to a field.
• Spend carrots on rooms: a Pantry to carry more, a Lookout, a Garden that grows carrots while you're away.
• Field challenges, twenty achievements and a new Daily dig every day.
• Nobody gets hurt: a caught rabbit drops what it carried and rests for a run.
• Left-handed controls, adjustable control size, button labels and reduce motion.
• No ads, no timers for sale, no account.

The Meadow is free: four fields and four rooms. One purchase opens the whole warren: eight more fields on the Farm and the Woodland edge, six more rooms, a family of four rabbits, the Daily dig and every field challenge.

name: UnlockSandboxGrid
description:
UnlockSandboxGrid is an offline, single-player puzzle game centered on mechanical transmission. Each level presents an empty grid, a fixed "anchor" drive gear, and a collection of additional gears that can be dragged onto the board. Players decide which gears to use and where to place them. Gears mesh based on their radii, and any two meshed gears will always rotate in opposite directions. A level is cleared when all placed gears rotate in sync with the anchor gear without any mechanical jams.

The game is designed to accommodate two distinct styles of play:

- Casual experimentation: Gears can be dragged onto or off the board, and moves can be undone. Even if you exit the game and return later, the gears remain exactly where you left them.
- Systematic configuration: Players can run a simulation to check for conflicts (indicated by red markers) before verifying the solution. Once a level is cleared, the configuration is saved to an in-game mechanical gallery.

The game features three grid sizes—6×6, 8×8, and 10×10—and three gear sizes: small, medium, and large. On the home screen, there is a single medium-sized widget that allows players to jump directly to the next level.

name: Untangle: Neon Arrow Puzzle
description:
Tap a strand. Watch it slide away. Clear the board.

Untangle is a calm but tricky arrow puzzle. Neon strands lie tangled on a grid, each with an arrow head. Tap one and it slides the way its arrow points, following its own bends, and leaves the board. But if another strand is in the way, it bumps back and you lose a heart. Find the right order and untangle them all.

EASY TO LEARN, HARD TO MASTER
• One tap per move, no timers
• Every level is built to be solvable, and none are random dead ends
• Frozen strands only thaw after other strands leave
• Chain quick clears for combo bonus coins
• Earn up to 3 stars per level by playing without mistakes

THREE WAYS TO PLAY
• Easy: small boards and 5 hearts, a relaxing break
• Medium: bigger boards, ice from level 12
• Hard: packed boards, long winding strands, lots of ice and only 2 hearts
• Each mode keeps its own level, so you can switch any time

SOMETHING NEW EVERY DAY
• A new Daily puzzle for everyone, with triple coins
• Three daily missions
• Login streak bonus, up to 140 coins a day

COMPETE AND COLLECT
• Weekly Game Center leaderboard that resets every Monday
• All-time leaderboard of levels solved
• 10 neon color themes to unlock with coins

PLAY ANYWHERE
• Works offline
• Satisfying sounds and haptics
• Free to play with ads. Remove the ads between levels with a single one-time purchase.

Tap. Slide. Untangle.

name: UP Brain Quest
description:
Think smarter. Explore new perspectives. Challenge yourself every day.
UP Brain Quest combines fun IQ challenges, logic puzzles, memory games, and everyday EQ scenarios into one engaging brain game. Enjoy quick sessions designed to challenge your thinking and explore different ways to respond to real-life situations.

CHALLENGE YOUR MIND
- IQ Challenge: Solve logic questions, number patterns, memory exercises, and reasoning puzzles.
- EQ Challenge: Explore everyday social situations and discover thoughtful ways to respond.
- Quick Quest: Enjoy a mix of IQ, EQ, and puzzle challenges in short sessions.
- Daily Challenge: Take on a new daily selection and build your streak.

TRACK YOUR PROGRESS
- Explore 330 questions, puzzles, and scenarios.
- Review your answers and learn from explanations.
- Earn achievements and complete daily challenges.
- Track your scores, completed sessions, and personal progress.

PLAY ANYTIME, ANYWHERE
- Fully offline gameplay.
- No account or registration required.
- Simple, intuitive interface.
- Available in English and Vietnamese.
- All progress is saved locally on your device.

Whether you enjoy brain teasers, logical thinking, memory challenges, or exploring emotional intelligence, UP Brain Quest offers a fun way to keep your mind engaged.
Start your brain quest today!
Note: IQ and EQ scores are intended for entertainment and practice only. They are not standardized intelligence tests or clinical assessments.

name: Upstar: Trending Repos
description:
See what developers are starring on GitHub right now. Upstar ranks today's, this week's and this month's trending repositories by the stars they gained, so you can spot breakout projects early.

WHAT YOU GET
• Three lists, today, this week and this month, refreshed twice a day
• Topic filters: AI & LLMs, Agents & MCP, AI Coding & Skills, Dev Tools, Web & UI, Mobile & Apple, Data, Self-hosted & Infra, Security and Learning
• Language filters: Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, Go, Rust, Java, C++, C#, Swift and Kotlin
• Search by name, owner or topic, and sort by stars gained, total stars or newest
• A compact list or roomy cards
• A page for every repo: stars gained per day, week and month, language, license, topics and its trending record
• A star-growth chart for 30 days, 90 days or all time. Touch and hold to read exact counts.
• A Top 10 poster of any list, ready to share
• Works offline with the last list you loaded
• Light and dark mode

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no analytics and no tracking. Upstar doesn't collect personal data.

Upstar is an independent app and isn't affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by GitHub, Inc. GitHub is a trademark of GitHub, Inc.
