name: Urvexqilo
seller_name: PIANO SUNSHINE MUSIC CENTER COMPANY LIMITED
description:
Meet Urvexqilo, the universal TV remote that lives in your pocket. Control the smart TVs on your Wi-Fi, play your photos, videos and music on the big screen and mirror your iPhone, all from one beautiful app. No batteries, no lost remotes, no fuss.

  Core Features:
- Finds Your TV Automatically: Urvexqilo listens on your Wi-Fi and lists every compatible TV that answers. Tap a TV to connect and it is remembered, so next time you are back in control right away. Pull down to scan again whenever you like.
- Complete Remote: A big cross-shaped navigation pad with a glowing OK button, plus Power, Input, Info, Mute, Back, Home and Menu keys, volume and channel bars, and Rewind, Play, Pause and Fast-forward controls.
- Three Remote Layouts: Switch between Keys, Touch and Digits with a single tap to match what you are doing.
- Touch Area: Drag to move through menus, tap for OK, tap with two fingers to go back and hold for Menu.
- Channel Keypad: Dial a channel number and each digit is sent as you press it, with Delete and Enter keys close at hand.
- Type on TV: Open a search or text box on your TV and type with your iPhone keyboard. Letters appear on the TV as you type, and Send Enter confirms in one tap.
- Cast Photos, Videos & Audio: Browse your library in a neat grid, preview any item and play it on your TV. Pick songs and recordings from the Files app too. Everything streams straight from your iPhone over your home Wi-Fi.
- Screen Mirroring: Show your whole iPhone screen on AirPlay-compatible TVs and streaming boxes using the built-in AirPlay picker.
- Haptic Feedback: A light tick on every key press so the remote feels real. Switch it off any time in Settings.
- Make It Yours: Choose from five accent colours (Nebula, Ocean, Sunset, Lagoon and Orchid) and the whole app recolours instantly.

  Works With:
- Smart TVs and streaming players on your Wi-Fi network that accept network remote control.
- DLNA / UPnP compatible TVs and media renderers for casting photos, videos and audio.
- AirPlay-compatible TVs and receivers for screen mirroring.
Some TVs ask you to allow Urvexqilo the first time you connect. Available buttons, typing and casting depend on your TV model and firmware.

  Why Urvexqilo?
- Private by Design: No account, no sign-up and no personal data collection. Urvexqilo talks only to the TVs on your own Wi-Fi network, your media never leaves your home and pairing keys stay safely in your iPhone's Keychain.
- Aurora Design: A deep night-sky look with soft colour glows, frosted-glass panels and bright, chunky buttons that are easy to hit even in a dark room.
- Everything in One Place: Remote, Devices, Cast Media, Screen Mirror and Settings sit together in one slide-out menu, so you never have to hunt for a feature.

Note: Your iPhone and TV must be connected to the same Wi-Fi network, and Local Network access must be allowed for Urvexqilo. Urvexqilo is an independent app and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by any TV manufacturer or streaming platform.

Every TV. One pocket remote. Download Urvexqilo and take charge of your living room today!

name: UzCaption
description:
UzCaption turns your video into accurate Uzbek subtitles in minutes.

Record or pick a video, and UzCaption writes the captions for you — then style them, fix any word, and export the video with burned-in captions or an SRT file.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Accurate subtitles for Uzbek, Russian, English, Tajik and Karakalpak speech
• Translate subtitles into Uzbek (Latin and Cyrillic), Russian, English, Tajik and Karakalpak
• 30+ caption styles for Reels, TikTok and YouTube Shorts
• Edit every word and its timing right on your phone
• Export up to 4K video with captions, or an SRT file for any editor
• Cut pauses automatically

PLANS
Every account gets free minutes each month. Mini, Pro, Max 5× and Max 20× plans add more minutes and features. Plans can be bought in the app as a monthly auto-renewing subscription or as a one-time purchase for 1, 3 or 6 months.

Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Payment is charged to your Apple ID. Manage or cancel in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Use: https://caption.uz/oferta
Privacy Policy: https://caption.uz/privacy

UzCaption is made by Jilo AI LLC, Uzbekistan.

name: Valley Hour
description:
Find happy hours across the Phoenix Valley. See which restaurants offer a weekend lunch, a late-night menu, or specials throughout the day. Look up a drink or dish and see the price, service hours and source together.

- Explore the map or narrow the list by city, cuisine, venue type and time.
- Compare the published prices for a frozen margarita, espresso martini or an order of wings. Check the details for seating restrictions and special dates.
- Browse the saved directory and Valley reference map offline. Open a restaurant’s online menu inside the app when connected.
- On supported devices with Apple Intelligence available, ask Valley Chat for a specific dish, time or budget. Voice conversation also requires on-device speech recognition for your language.

Prices and menus can change. Each listing shows the information available for that location.

name: Vaslola Valida
description:
Vaslola Valida permite controlar el ingreso a eventos. Está dirigida a empresas, productoras, organizaciones y personas que organizan eventos y contratan el servicio Vaslola a través de JPH.

Los operadores autorizados pueden escanear códigos QR de entradas, cortesías o abonos, buscar accesos por documento y consultar el resultado de cada validación. La aplicación también permite seleccionar el evento, la función y el sector del puesto de control, según la configuración disponible.

Funciones principales:
- Escaneo de códigos QR mediante la cámara del dispositivo.
- Búsqueda manual de accesos por documento (DNI).
- Visualización del resultado: acceso autorizado o rechazado, incluyendo entradas ya utilizadas.
- Registro de la ubicación asociada a la validación, con los permisos correspondientes.
- Consulta del historial de validaciones y de las ubicaciones registradas en el mapa.
- Inicio de sesión con email y contraseña, con opción de acceso biométrico en dispositivos compatibles.
Acceso al servicio:

Vaslola se ofrece a distintos clientes, tanto personas como empresas y organizaciones. La contratación se realiza directamente con JPH, fuera de la aplicación. Una vez contratado el servicio, el administrador habilita las cuentas de los operadores y proporciona sus credenciales.

La aplicación requiere una cuenta habilitada y no permite registrarse ni contratar el servicio desde su interfaz.

name: VehicleVault: Car Care Log
description:
VehicleVault is a private maintenance ledger for the car you actually drive.

• Garage — see every car with its next-due countdown (days and miles)
• Due engine — each service item tracks both a mileage interval and a time interval, whichever comes first
• Log in seconds — service, fuel, repair or other; odometer, cost, vendor, photos
• Status colors — overdue, urgent, due, ok, so nothing quietly slips
• Reminders — local notifications 30 / 14 / 0 days before each due date
• Export — CSV for spreadsheets, PDF for the glovebox or the next owner
• Optional AI fill — bring your own OpenAI / Anthropic / Gemini key to prefill fields from a dashboard or receipt photo; results are always editable. Without a key everything still works by hand.

Everything lives in a local SQLite database on your device. No account, no sync, no analytics, no ads, no subscription.

name: Velvet Pair
description:
Velvet Pair brings a refined jewel-themed finish to classic mahjong solitaire. Open a fresh daily layout, find matching pairs among the free tiles, and clear the board one considered move at a time.

The rules are simple, but every layered arrangement invites a new approach. Look carefully, choose accessible pairs, and reveal more possibilities as the layout opens.

FEATURES

Match jewel-marked tiles and clear complete layouts

Return for daily puzzles and build an ongoing streak

Use Hint to reveal a possible pair

Highlight available tiles with Torch

Rearrange remaining tiles with Shuffle

Reconsider your previous move with Undo

Track your longest streak as you progress

Thoughtful, polished, and easy to revisit, Velvet Pair offers a satisfying tile-matching ritual for any part of the day.

name: Vennex
description:
Vennex, otomat ve self-servis satış noktalarındaki POS cihazlarınızı tek uygulamadan yönetmenizi sağlar. İşletmenizin satışlarını, cihazlarını ve stoklarını anlık olarak takip edin.

GENEL BAKIŞ
• Seçtiğiniz konum ve döneme göre toplam ciro, işlem sayısı ve başarı oranı
• Saatlik ve günlük satış grafiği, önceki dönemle karşılaştırma
• En çok satan cihazlar, ödeme tipi dağılımı ve başarısızlık nedenleri
• Son işlemler

POS CİHAZLARI
• Tüm cihazlarınızın çevrimiçi / çevrimdışı durumu ve son satış zamanı
• Cihaz bazında bugün, dün, bu ay ve geçen ay cirosu
• Satış listesi, dijital fiş görüntüleme ve paylaşma
• İstatistikler: ödeme tipine ve ürüne göre satışlar
• Cihaz ayarları, çalışma saatleri ve uzaktan cihaz komutları (yetkiye göre)

STOK VE DOLUM
• Slot bazında stok ve doluluk takibi
• Depo ve araçlardan tek dokunuşla ya da toplu dolum
• Ürün şablonları ve stok hareketleri

DİĞER
• Personel kartları ve bakiye yönetimi
• Raporlar ve Excel dışa aktarma
• Anlık bildirimler
• Kullanıcı ve teknisyen yetkilendirme

Vennex hesabınızla giriş yapın; gördüğünüz bilgiler ve yapabileceğiniz işlemler hesabınıza tanımlı yetkilere göre belirlenir.

name: VerseMap2D
description: We spend so much time on our devices. Shouldn't we take more time to read God's word, ponder, and pray? This app is designed to help us with that as it makes exploring the scriptures unique by not only providing a chronological reader but also a similarity option where a map made with text embeddings to identify similar scriptures are plotted. It also keeps track of the most read scriptures in the community and the total time for groups with anonymous stats. No login to use the app. The iOS and Android apps use Firebase Anonymous Authentication to assign a random anonymous identifier (uid) so your device can sync reading totals securely.

name: Vetness
description:
Vetness keeps your pet's care in one app: find a vet clinic, a groomer or a pet hotel, book online and keep the medical record.

SEARCH NEARBY
• Vet clinics, grooming and pet hotels — as a list or on the map
• One field for a name, an address or a city; the nearest first
• Filters by species, service and date
• A place's page: photos, services and prices, specialists, reviews, route, call, chat

BOOK ONLINE
• A service, your pet, a specialist, a free time — and you're booked
• Prepay by card when the service asks for it
• Book without an account: a code from the e-mail confirms the booking
• Hotels: rooms for your dates, your pet's passport against the hotel's requirements, a stay with a deposit

VISITS
• Upcoming and past appointments and stays
• Cancel, reschedule, leave a review
• The diary of a hotel stay

PETS
• Passport, vaccinations and treatments with their next dates
• Weight chart, medical record with files, notes
• Several owners of one pet
• Your pet's passport in Apple Wallet

CHATS
• Messages with places, photos
• Notifications about your bookings and messages

SECURITY
• Sign in with a passkey, two-step sign-in
• Lock the app with Face ID

Vetness is an information platform: the services are provided by the places themselves, who are responsible for their prices and the information about them.

name: VEYL: Black Ledger
description:
One morning, they took everything.

In a raid on the Aurelion Reserve, Erdi's wife Kübra is kidnapped and their cat Müjgan disappears. All he has left is a fictional device he found in the vault: NOX-9. He will follow the trail, hide, fight back when he has to, and uncover the Black Ledger that keeps an entire city in debt.

VEYL: Black Ledger is a single-player, mature crime thriller set in Vespera, a neo-gothic city where the rain never stops.

MOVE THROUGH THE DARK
• Read guards' vision cones, stay out of the light, take enemies down silently.
• Trip an alarm and it isn't over. The plan just changes.

NOX-9
• Mark enemies behind walls with ECHO sonar.
• Strike from a distance with the SPARROW drone.
• Müjgan, your stealth scout: she slips where you look and marks enemies.
• New modes unlock as the story unfolds: vanish with VEIL, blind cameras and armour with ARC, grapple across rooftops with TETHER, stop bullets with AEGIS.

TAIL AND FIGHT
• Follow the kidnappers' convoy through rain-soaked streets without getting made, or cut it off.
• Fight your way through dockside warehouses and face Vahit in a three-phase showdown.

EVIDENCE BOARD
• Pin every clue to your board and connect it with orange thread. Solve the conspiracy yourself.
• Your choices stick: who you spare and who you take in changes the story.
• A prologue, five acts and a finale, with three endings shaped by your choices.
• In one chapter you play as Kübra, without NOX-9.

MAKE IT YOURS
• Four difficulty levels, three graphics levels.
• Touch controls or a compatible game controller.
• Subtitle size and background, screen-shake toggle, colour-blind indicator.
• Three save slots and automatic checkpoints.
• English and Turkish.

No ads. No in-app purchases. No account. No data collected; the game runs fully offline.

Contains violence and mature themes.

name: VibeRecord
description: Record the problem. Get the fix. Typing out what's broken is slow. VibeRecord lets you record your screen and talk through what's wrong — then it does the write-up for you. Record any app on your iPhone Tap Record, start Apple's broadcast, switch to the app you're testing and talk. The red indicator shows the whole time. Stop, come back, and the recording is already in your project. We find each problem VibeRecord listens to what you said and splits it into separate findings — "this button does nothing", "the total should include tax" — each one timestamped. We grab the screenshot Every finding gets the frame from the exact moment it went wrong. We write the prompt Each problem becomes a clear, ready-to-paste fix prompt for your AI builder or your developer. Share a project with your team as editors or viewers. Private by default Only people you invite can see recordings. Links expire quickly. App audio is never captured — only your voice. Recordings delete automatically after 90 days (or 30 if you choose), and you can export or delete everything from Settings at any time. Never trains AI Your recordings are used only to find your problems — nothing else. Built for people shipping apps with AI.

name: ViceVersa - Your Life in Games
description:
Your life in games.

The places you've explored. The people you've met. The moments you'll never forget.

Some of your best experiences happen in worlds that aren't real. But the memories, friendships, and stories you make in them are.

Welcome to ViceVersa — a social network for your digital life.

ViceVersa is a new way to share, discover, and connect through the experiences you have inside video games and virtual worlds.

Not just what you're playing. What you're living.

SHARE YOUR EXPERIENCES

Capture the moments that make your digital life yours.

Post screenshots, share stories, show off your character, document your adventures, or simply share something that caught your attention.

From extraordinary discoveries to ordinary moments worth remembering, ViceVersa gives your experiences a place to live beyond the game.

DISCOVER WHAT OTHERS ARE EXPERIENCING

Every world is filled with stories you haven't seen.

Explore places, browse experiences, discover new activities, and see familiar environments through the eyes of other players.

Find posts about the things that interest you, discover related experiences, and uncover moments you might never have encountered on your own.

CONNECT THROUGH YOUR DIGITAL LIFE

The best connections often begin with something shared.

Follow interesting people, make friends, join communities, exchange messages, and interact through posts and conversations.

Find people who appreciate the same places, activities, and experiences you do.

BUILD YOUR IDENTITY

Your digital life is uniquely yours.

Create your ViceVersa profile, choose your username, share your interests, and build a collection of experiences that reflects who you are across virtual worlds.

Your profile is more than a list of games. It's a window into the life you live inside them.

A NEW SOCIAL WORLD BEGINS

ViceVersa launches with Leonida as its first world, bringing players together around exploration, virtual photography, lifestyle, activities, and shared discoveries.

And the vision goes far beyond any one game.

Different games offer different kinds of lives. ViceVersa is built around a simple idea: those lives deserve a social home of their own.

Your world. Your experiences. Your ViceVersa.

name: VintaCams·Retro Camera
description:
VintaCams · Retro Camera

Capture time. Every frame feels like a secret pulled from an old photo album.

About VintaCams

Some moments deserve a gentler touch. VintaCams is more than a camera — it's a time machine. It reinvents photography through the soul of vintage: the instant you press the shutter, grain, noise, and that warm amber glow come rushing in, as if you've stepped back into a slow, sunlit afternoon.

With 9 hand-crafted camera skins and 6 style-defining film filters, every shot you take comes with a story built in.

Highlights

9 Camera Skins, 9 Moods
From the leather-wrapped mechanics of the '70s to the candy-colored Y2K point-and-shoots, every skin is a trip through time. Switch the skin, switch the vibe — every snap feels like a ritual.

Skin Vibe

Classic Leather Nostalgic, warm

Y2K Candy Playful, bold

Noir Mono Noir, cinematic

…9 in total Switch freely

6 Filters, One Tap to Perfection
No color-grading skills, no post-editing required. Six retro filters span warm film, faded Polaroid, crisp Japanese daylight, neon-lit nights and more. Press shutter, get the shot — no more overthinking your next post.

Fast Is an Attitude
True to its name — VintaCams. Launch and shoot, shoot and save. Never miss a spark of inspiration. A vintage soul, powered by modern speed.

Made for you, if you…

• Love taking photos — and love the "vibe" even more

• Want everyday moments to feel like little rituals

- Are tired of flawless, cookie-cutter filters and crave the beauty of imperfection

VintaCams — Retro camera, one tap through time. 9 skins, 6 filters. Every photo, a love letter to the past.

User Agreement ：https://www.vintacams.site/terms.html

name: VinylShelf
description:
VinylShelf is a catalog for your vinyl collection. Photograph the cover, scan the barcode or search by artist and title, and the app finds the album and the pressing, with the tracks, the credits and information about the album and the artist.

ADD A RECORD IN SECONDS
• A photo of the cover (and of the back, if you like) is enough: the app reads what’s printed on it and looks the record up.
• Or scan the barcode, or search by artist and title.
• The cover comes from Apple Music or the Cover Art Archive; when there isn’t one online, your photo stays.

YOUR EXACT PRESSING
• An album often has dozens of vinyl pressings. See them all and pick yours by catalog number, country or year.
• Note the condition of the record and the sleeve, on the scale collectors use, where you bought it, when and for how much, your rating and a comment.

EVERYTHING ABOUT THE ALBUM
• The tracks by side with their durations, the credits and the story of the album.
• Buttons that open the album in Apple Music, Spotify or Tidal.
• Artist pages with the biography and the studio albums you don’t have yet.

WITH FRIENDS
• Mark records “For trade” or “To lend”, and keep track of who has a record of yours and since when.
• Share your shelf with a link: friends see it in a browser, or in the app if they have it. Your prices, ratings, comments and the names of the people who borrowed your records never leave your phone.

YOUR COLLECTION IS YOURS
• No account: your collection lives in your own iCloud and shows up on every device with the same Apple ID.
• Export it anytime as a CSV file.
• Photos of your records are sent to Claude, Anthropic’s AI model, only to find the record. Our server deletes them right away, and Anthropic doesn’t use them for training. No ads, no tracking.

Album data comes from Discogs, MusicBrainz and Wikipedia. This application uses Discogs’ API but is not affiliated with, sponsored or endorsed by Discogs. ‘Discogs’ is a trademark of Zink Media, LLC.

name: Virtual Microscope: Slides
description:
A microscope in your pocket, with real slides. Seven boxes and 96 slides photographed under the microscope by teachers and researchers at the University of Campinas (Unicamp, Brazil):

• Animal cells: blood, epithelia, gametes, muscles, spinal cord, liver.
• Cell organelles: endoplasmic reticulum, Golgi apparatus, mitochondria, lysosomes, chloroplasts.
• Supporting and covering tissues: skin, intestine, trachea, kidney, aorta, muscle and bone.
• Plant cell types and plant tissues and organs: meristems, parenchyma, xylem, phloem, root, stem and leaf.
• Prokaryotic cells: bacteria of different shapes and stains.
• Karyotype: human and animal chromosomes, with banding, Down syndrome and Turner syndrome.

At the microscope:
• Switch objectives (100x, 400x, 1000x…): each is a new photo with more detail.
• Adjust focus and light as in a real microscope. Turn on manual focus if you like.
• Drag the slide and zoom with two fingers.
• Tap the labels to read about each structure.
• "Where it comes from": illustrations show which part of the organism the material came from.
• Box challenge: without labels, find the structures asked for. The app keeps your best score.

For secondary school, university and anyone curious. In Portuguese, English and Spanish. Works offline.

Free, no ads, no sign-up and no data collection. Content from the EMBRIÃO Project (Unicamp, funded by FNDE, MCT and MEC), rebuilt by the Educational Technology Laboratory (LTE), Institute of Biology, Unicamp. Also available in the browser at www.lte.ib.unicamp.br/softwares.

name: VocalTrace
description:
내 MP3 한 곡으로 노래를 부르고, 기타를 치고, 멜로디를 확인하세요. VocalTrace는 PC에서 분석한 곡에 가사와 코드, 음정 그래프를 함께 표시합니다.

• 노래방에서 원곡 보컬의 볼륨을 조절하세요. 보컬을 줄이고 반주에 맞춰 부르거나 연습할 가사를 눌러 그 부분을 다시 들을 수 있습니다.

• 코드악보의 마디와 가사를 보며 기타를 연주하세요. 코드를 누르면 기타 운지표를 볼 수 있고, 카포 위치에 맞춰 표시되는 코드를 바꿀 수 있습니다.

• 재생화면의 피아노 롤에서 멜로디의 높낮이와 음의 길이를 확인하세요. 확대하면 음정과 코드를 더 자세히 볼 수 있습니다.

• 가로 공간이 넓은 iPad와 iPhone Duo에서는 재생 화면 옆에서 재생목록을 확인할 수 있습니다.

처음에는 앱의 ‘데모곡 체험’으로 시작할 수 있습니다. 내 곡을 쓰려면 PC의 VocalTrace 웹에서 MP3를 분석하세요. PC와 기기를 같은 네트워크에 연결하고 두 곳에서 같은 계정으로 로그인한 뒤, 앱에서 전송 QR을 스캔하세요. 곡을 가져온 뒤에는 기기에서 재생할 수 있습니다.

name: Vokabel Global
description:
Practise vocabulary between any two of 17 languages: English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Russian,
Arabic, Farsi, Hebrew, Mandarin, Japanese, Korean, Tagalog, Hindi, Punjabi, Urdu and Thai.

• Over 90 tests: everyday topics, verbs in every tense, and new words from the news every week
• Pick any pair: learn Japanese from Spanish, or Arabic from German
• Type answers in Latin letters (romaji, pinyin…) or in the language's own script
• See the pronunciation of every word in its own script
• Listen mode reads words and answers aloud, even with the screen locked, in the car or with headphones
• Speak mode: answer out loud and hear if you're right
• Create a Test: type in or paste your own word lists
• No account, no ads, no tracking

name: VoteSecure
description:
VoteSecure is election management and results software for electoral bodies, their officials, party agents, observers and the public. Every result is checked, signed and traceable from the polling station to the final declaration.

FOR PRESIDING OFFICERS
• Open, count and close your polling station step by step
• Enter counts with built-in reconciliation that catches mistakes before you submit
• Photograph the signed result sheet and attach it to every submission
• Keep working without signal: submissions wait on your device and send when you're back online

FOR RETURNING OFFICERS
• Follow collation station by station
• Check each signed sheet beside the submitted numbers, then verify or dispute it
• See exactly what is left before you declare, and confirm the declaration with Face ID

FOR PARTY AGENTS
• Compare your agents' tallies with the official record, line by line
• File disputes and follow them to resolution
• Track your party's vote share, rank and collation progress

FOR OBSERVERS
• Log observations, incidents and fraud reports from the field

FOR ADMINISTRATORS
• Set up elections, geography, parties, candidates and polling stations with a readiness checklist
• Approve accounts, assign roles and require two-person approval for sensitive actions
• Statistical anomaly checks, incident tracking, audit logs and official reports

FOR CITIZENS
• Follow live results, including a Live Activity on your Lock Screen
• Explore the electoral map region by region
• Find your polling station and check your registration
• Check declarations in the transparency ledger, where every declaration is signed and chained

Designed for iPhone, iPhone Duo and iPad.

Accounts for election officials, agents and observers are issued by the electoral body running the election. Anyone can follow public results without an account.

name: VoxPrompt: Voice Prompter Pro
description:
VoxPrompt is the teleprompter that listens to you. Paste your script, press record and just talk: the text scrolls at the pace of your voice, word by word. Pause, improvise, skip a sentence — VoxPrompt finds your place.

STUDIO-QUALITY VIDEO
• 1080p captured in 4K and downscaled for crisp detail
• Live temporal denoise: clean skin and backgrounds, no flickering grain
• High-bitrate HEVC, SDR Rec.709 colors ready for editing, or HDR
• 0.5×, 1× and 2× zoom, front or back camera, 24 to 60 fps
• External microphones detected automatically

BUILT FOR CREATORS
• Automatic .srt subtitles generated from your script
• Floating prompter over other apps (Picture in Picture)
• Movable, resizable script window
• Works in dozens of languages
• Voice, sound-activated or constant scrolling
• One-tap spoken formatting of your text

PRO
3 free recordings, then VoxPrompt Pro: monthly, yearly or lifetime. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period; manage them in your App Store account settings.
Terms: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy: https://manifestwithtom.com/voxprompt-confidentialite/

name: Voz en Orden
description:
Convertí conversaciones en notas que podés volver a escuchar y revisar. Grabá desde el iPhone, desde el Apple Watch enlazado o con ambos micrófonos en una misma nota. Podés pausar, continuar y marcar un momento sin crear otra nota.

En reuniones largas, la app guarda el audio en tramos de veinte minutos. Si la organización con IA se interrumpe, podés leer lo procesado y retomar los bloques pendientes.

La transcripción en español, la agrupación de voces y los resúmenes se procesan en el dispositivo. Podés revisar las voces sugeridas y asignarles nombres dentro de cada reunión. Consultá los acuerdos y el texto que los respalda antes de compartir tu nota en Markdown.

La compra incluye el complemento para Apple Watch. Para generar resúmenes necesitás un iPhone compatible con Apple Intelligence, la función activada y los recursos de idioma disponibles. La separación de voces y la transcripción pueden equivocarse, especialmente si varias personas hablan a la vez. Grabá con autorización de quienes participan.

name: Vruissoek
description: Vruissoek is your book of important days on iPhone. You choose which dates stay close—your own turning points and the birthdays, anniversaries, and once-only moments tied to people in your story. Each entry can hold a note about why the day matters.

name: VSD Diagram Viewer & PDF
seller_name: HADRIAN TECHNOLOGIES SOLE SHAREHOLDER CO. P.C.
description:
Open Microsoft Visio drawings (.vsdx) on your iPhone, iPad and Mac, without Microsoft Visio.

Every page of the drawing has its own tab, in the same order as in Visio. Pinch or double-tap to zoom: the drawing stays sharp at every size.

The file is read on your device. It is never changed, never uploaded, and no copy is kept. No account, no sign-in, no ads.

Viewing is free. One purchase, PDF and Printing, lets you export the drawing to PDF and print it, on all your devices with the same Apple Account. Every page becomes one PDF page, at its own size.

Opens drawings saved as .vsdx and .vsdm. Drawings in the older .vsd format cannot be opened yet. It does not edit drawings.

Microsoft and Visio are trademarks of the Microsoft group of companies. VSD Diagram Viewer is not made, sponsored or approved by Microsoft.

name: VsTV - IPTV Player
description:
VsTV is a player for your own IPTV playlists. It does not provide any content: add your playlist (M3U or TXT) and start watching.

Why VsTV
• Fast channel changes, with a playback engine tuned for live TV
• A simple interface: what you use most is right at hand
• Works on iPhone, iPad and Mac, with a layout made for each screen

Playback
• M3U and TXT playlists, XMLTV programme guides
• HLS, TS, FLV and other common formats, 4K and HDR
• Automatic deinterlacing for interlaced broadcasts
• Audio Vivid and surround sound output
• Two playback engines; if one can’t play a channel, the other takes over

Thoughtful details
• Programme guide: see what’s on now and next at a glance
• Favourites and groups to find channels quickly
• Swipe to adjust brightness and volume in full screen
• Finds playlist servers on your home network automatically
• Ask for help: a friend can send you a playlist with a 4-digit code, and you can help others the same way

VsTV Pro (one-time purchase)
Everything is unlocked for the first 7 days. After that the basics stay free, and these need Pro:
• AI subtitles: live translation of foreign-language programmes (requires your own translation service)
• Catch-up: go back to programmes you missed (requires playlist support)
• Picture in Picture
• More than 2 playlists
• Send playlists to and fetch them from VsTV on your TV
• Orange theme and icon

Pro is a one-time purchase with no subscription, shared across iPhone, iPad and Mac on the same Apple Account.

Note
VsTV does not include or provide any playlists or content. Only add content you have the right to watch.

name: VTOOLS HAIR
description:
VTOOLS HAIR là hệ thống quản lý salon tóc và barbershop dành cho chủ tiệm, quản lý, lễ tân và thợ. Toàn bộ vận hành hằng ngày — lịch hẹn, bán hàng, kho, hoa hồng, lương và khách hàng — nằm trong một ứng dụng duy nhất.

LỊCH HẸN & CA LÀM
• Xem lịch hẹn theo ngày, theo thợ và theo chi nhánh
• Tạo lịch hẹn cho khách quen hoặc khách vãng lai
• Chuyển trạng thái: chờ, xác nhận, đã đến, đang phục vụ, hoàn tất
• Xếp ca làm việc cho từng nhân viên
• Tự phát hiện trùng lịch, không thể đặt trùng giờ của cùng một thợ

BÁN HÀNG & HOÁ ĐƠN (POS)
• Tạo phiếu dịch vụ từ lịch hẹn hoặc khách vãng lai
• Lên hoá đơn, áp giảm giá, thuế, voucher và điểm tích luỹ
• Thu tiền nhiều lần, hoàn tiền, in biên lai
• Hoá đơn đã phát hành không sửa được — an toàn cho sổ sách

KHO & SẢN PHẨM
• Quản lý sản phẩm bán lẻ, giá vốn, mã SKU
• Nhập kho, điều chỉnh kho, xem lịch sử biến động
• Bán sản phẩm tự trừ tồn kho khi xuất hoá đơn

HOA HỒNG & BẢNG LƯƠNG
• Quy tắc hoa hồng theo % hoặc số tiền, theo dịch vụ, nhóm dịch vụ hoặc chức danh
• Hoa hồng tự sinh khi xuất hoá đơn, chia theo thợ thực hiện
• Thợ tự xem hoa hồng của mình
• Chốt bảng lương tháng: lương cứng + hoa hồng

KHÁCH HÀNG & MARKETING
• Hồ sơ khách hàng, tìm theo tên hoặc số điện thoại
• Voucher, tích điểm, chiến dịch chăm sóc khách (sinh nhật, khách lâu không quay lại)
• Trang đặt lịch online để khách tự đặt

BÁO CÁO
• Doanh thu theo ngày, chi nhánh, dịch vụ và sản phẩm
• Báo cáo hoa hồng theo nhân viên và trạng thái

QUẢN TRỊ
• Nhiều chi nhánh, nhiều nhân viên, phân quyền theo vai trò
• Nhật ký thao tác, quản lý thiết bị đăng nhập
• Dữ liệu của từng salon được tách biệt tuyệt đối

VTOOLS HAIR phù hợp từ salon một chi nhánh đến chuỗi nhiều chi nhánh. Ứng dụng cần tài khoản salon do quản trị viên cấp; khách hàng có thể đặt lịch online mà không cần tài khoản.

name: Wadili
description:
وديلي للطلبات هو التطبيق المخصص للعملاء لطلب الطعام والبقالة من المطاعم والمتاجر المتاحة عبر منصة وديلي.

يساعدك التطبيق على تصفح المتاجر والمطاعم، اختيار المنتجات، وإتمام الطلب بسهولة مع متابعة حالته خطوة بخطوة حتى التوصيل.

من خلال التطبيق يمكنك:

• تصفح المطاعم والمتاجر والتصنيفات والعروض المتاحة. • البحث عن المنتجات أو المتاجر. • عرض تفاصيل المنتجات وإضافتها إلى السلة وإتمام الطلب. • إدارة عناوين التوصيل واختيار العنوان المناسب. • اختيار وسيلة الدفع المتاحة وإتمام عملية الشراء. • متابعة حالة الطلب والاطلاع على تفاصيله الحالية والسابقة. • إعادة طلب الطلبات السابقة بسهولة. • التواصل مع الدعم عند الحاجة وإدارة حسابك الشخصي.

يهدف تطبيق وديلي للطلبات إلى توفير تجربة طلب سهلة وسريعة تساعدك على الوصول إلى احتياجاتك اليومية بكفاءة.

يتطلب استخدام بعض مزايا التطبيق إنشاء حساب وتسجيل الدخول.

name: WaitCam: 12h Film Camera
description:
Shoot tonight, reveal tomorrow. WaitCam brings back the authentic magic of a 35mm disposable party camera—100% offline with zero watermarks.

• Real 12-Hour Darkroom Lock: No peeking! Watch your film roll develop live on your Dynamic Island & Lock Screen, or enable the 30-second Demo Mode anytime in Lab Settings.
• 4 Cinema Film Stocks: Free 2AM Party Flash (zero watermarks), plus 800T Neon Halation, Chrome 100 Gold & Club 400 Mono.
• 1-Tap 35mm Film Reels & Contact Sheets: Export developed rolls into authentic sprocket-hole MP4 Reels or high-res contact sheets offline.
• 100% Private AES-256 Local Vault: Every frame stays encrypted on your iPhone or iPad with zero servers or tracking.

SUBSCRIPTION & UNLOCK OPTIONS (GUIDELINE 3.1.2):
• WaitCam Pro Annual ($14.99/year): Includes a transparent 3-day $0 free trial plus an optional Day-2 local notification reminder 24 hours before billing, and auto-renews yearly unless canceled in iOS Settings at least 24 hours before the period ends.
• WaitCam Pro Lifetime ($9.99 one-time Black Friday offer) & Darkroom Plus ($2.99 one-time): Permanent non-consumable unlocks with Family Sharing.

name: Wakeroo: Alarm Clock & Wake Up
description:
Snoozed through another alarm? Wakeroo is an alarm clock for heavy sleepers that makes going back to sleep hard. Your alarm rings, then you finish a short mission to prove you're up.

A REAL IPHONE ALARM
• Built on Apple's AlarmKit, so your alarm rings through Silent mode and Focus and shows on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island, like the iPhone's own Clock app.
• No need to keep the app open overnight. Wakeroo doesn't run in the background to keep your alarm alive, so it won't drain your battery while you sleep.

WAKE-UP MISSIONS
Pick the mission that works on you:
• Math: solve a few problems, from easy sums to tougher ones.
• Shake: shake your phone until the counter hits zero.
• Photo: take a picture of a spot you registered the night before, like your sink or coffee machine.
• Barcode or QR code: scan an item in another room.
• Steps: walk a set number of steps.
• Squats: do a few squats, counted with the camera on your iPhone.
• Memory: repeat a pattern on a grid.
• Typing: type a short phrase without mistakes.

HONEST ABOUT HOW IT WORKS
iOS always shows a Stop button on alarms, and we don't hide it. With Pro, if you stop the alarm without finishing your mission, a wake-up check rings again a minute later, then every couple of minutes until you do. Finish the mission and the morning is done. If a mission isn't working for you, a simpler math fallback appears after a few tries, so you're never stuck, and the Stop button is always there in an emergency.

YOUR MORNING BRIEF
Once you're up, Wakeroo greets you with a short brief: today's weather and your first event, read aloud if you like. On iPhones with Apple Intelligence it's written on your device. Other iPhones get a simple version.

MORE
• Streaks and wake stats: on-time mornings, snoozes and wake-up checks, week by week.
• Nap timer and quick alarms: type "weekdays 6:40" in plain words.
• Siri, Shortcuts, widgets and Control Center: set a nap, skip tomorrow's alarm or see your next alarm at a glance.

FREE, WITH NO ADS
Wakeroo never shows ads, and you can set an alarm before you ever see an offer. Your first day includes every Pro feature for free, with no card needed. After that, Free keeps unlimited basic alarms, one mission alarm with easy math, standard sounds and your streak. Wakeroo Pro adds every other mission, unlimited mission alarms, wake-up checks, the morning brief, more alarm sounds and your full wake history.

Wakeroo Pro is a monthly auto-renewing subscription. The price for your country is shown in the app before you buy. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. It renews automatically unless you turn off auto-renew at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel any time in your Apple Account settings.

Terms of Use: https://wakeroo.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://wakeroo.com/privacy

name: WanderPing: Offline City Guide
description:
Walk a city with your iPhone in your pocket. Tick the sights you want to see, tap Start exploring, and WanderPing sends you a notification when one of them is within 500 m (about a third of a mile). No fixed route, no staring at a map.

1,596 destinations in 169 countries · 48,780 sights · an offline map for every destination · no account, no ads, no tracking.

HOW IT WORKS
• Choose a city and tick the places you care about, in the List or on the Map
• Tap Start exploring and walk wherever you like
• Near one of your places? A notification with Directions, Later and Not interested
• Several places close by? One notification lists them, nearest first
• Missing a place? Search for it, or long-press the map to add your own

BUILT NOT TO NAG
• A place alerts you again only after you have walked more than 650 m away
• At most one notification a minute
• Later pauses a place for 30 minutes; Not interested turns it off

FOR THE WHOLE TRIP
• 1,295 cities, 276 resorts and 25 villages
• Places of worship, museums, buildings and monuments, parks and nature, experiences
• Descriptions from Wikipedia and Wikivoyage, in the app's six languages
• Offline map: download it for any destination and the map works without internet
• No connection? Directions switches to a compass that points straight at the place
• Nearby trips: castles, nature parks and historic sites best reached by car
• Travel journal: places visited, walks with their time and distance on foot, ready to share

ALERTS WITH THE APP CLOSED
Allow location "Always" and notifications keep coming with the app closed. WanderPing lets iOS watch the places nearest to you instead of running GPS nonstop, and checks less often when you are far from your places, to save battery. Precise Location and notifications need to be on.

YOUR LOCATION STAYS ON YOUR IPHONE
No account, no ads, no analytics or tracking, and no WanderPing server. Your location is used on your iPhone, to show the nearest city, note the countries you visit and alert you while exploring, and it is never sent to us. Export a backup of your profile, journal and places to a file whenever you like.

5 FREE NOTIFICATIONS IN EVERY CITY
A repeat alert for the same place doesn't count again. For more, pick a pass for your trip:
• City Pass: one city, 7 days
• Multi-City: up to 3 cities, 14 days
• World Trip: every city, 30 days
• Lifetime: every city, forever, plus Countries visited (your countries on a world map) and Photo memories (your own photos on the places you visited)
Passes are one-time purchases, not subscriptions. Buying the same pass again extends it from its current end date.

Map data © OpenStreetMap contributors. Descriptions from Wikipedia and Wikivoyage (CC BY-SA 4.0).

Privacy policy:
https://boogdan.com/apps/wanderping/privacy/

name: Warp Tie
description:
Warp Tie keeps each loom on this iPhone.

Six old ends sit on the loom. A new end stays only on an open end of the same color. A different color springs back. An end that is already tied springs back too.

When every end is tied, the sentence is Tied on. Otherwise it names the first end that is still open.

Name a loom, rename it, delete one, and share that one sentence.

Looms stay on this iPhone. There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: WarpShed--Swap spools
description:
WarpShed kutsuu sinut puisen kangaspuun ääreen, jossa värikkäät lankarullat ja risteävät langat muodostavat kankaan.

Avaa työpajanäkymästä haluamasi taso ja tutustu tavoitekuvioon: tarkista tarvittava värijärjestys sekä se, minkä langan tulee kulkea päällimmäisenä kussakin risteyskohdassa. Voit vaihtaa vierekkäisten lankarullien paikkoja napauttamalla Swap-painiketta. Risteyskohdissa voit puolestaan vaihtaa lankojen kulkusuuntaa napauttamalla Left↑- tai Right↑-painiketta tai suoraan X-merkkiä. Paksumpi viiva osoittaa päällimmäisen langan, ja keltaiset reunat ilmaisevat kohdat, jotka eivät vielä vastaa tavoitetta.

Ratkaise kuusitoista haastetta, joiden vaikeustaso kasvaa kolmesta lankarullasta kuuteen lankaan ja useisiin riveihin. Kun saat kuvion valmiiksi, avaat sen mallikirjaan. Practice Frame -harjoittelutilassa voit kokeilla lankojen vaihtamista ja risteysten järjestämistä ilman voittotarkistusta. Yarn Catalog puolestaan kertoo lisää eri värien värjäyksestä.

Ei ajastimia eikä taisteluita – vain rauhallista järjestelyä ja huolellista lankojen asettelua, kunnes kangas vastaa tavoitekuviota.

name: Watt Wise: Battery Runtime
description:
Watt Wise answers one question: how long will this battery run my devices?

Enter your battery's capacity, set its charge, add the devices you plan to power, and get an instant runtime estimate in hours and minutes. Change a wattage, a quantity, or how often a device runs, and the estimate updates as you type. There's no Calculate button.

PLAN WITH A FEW NUMBERS
• Enter capacity in watt-hours, or in amp-hours and volts
• Drag the charge bar to set state of charge, or type an exact percentage
• Set a reserve you don't want to dip below; it's drawn right on the charge bar
• Add devices with their watts, quantity, and duty cycle, the share of time each one actually draws power
• Mark each device as AC (through the inverter) or DC (direct), and switch devices on or off to compare scenarios

SEE WHERE THE POWER GOES
A single stacked bar breaks total battery-side demand into direct DC loads, AC loads including inverter losses, and inverter idle draw. Enter your inverter's efficiency and idle draw, and Watt Wise applies them only where they belong: efficiency to AC loads, idle draw once for the whole setup.

HONEST ESTIMATES
Runtime is usable energy divided by average battery-side demand, and the app shows its working. When there's no usable charge or no active load, it tells you so instead of showing a misleading number. Charge is a scenario value you set, not a live reading, and it never drains or recharges on its own. Real runtime varies with temperature, battery age, discharge rate, and how your devices actually behave.

SAVE YOUR SETUPS
Keep separate setups for a camping power station, a van battery, or home backup. Rename, duplicate, and delete them, and reorder devices however you like. Watt Wise reopens the setup you used last. Start from a ready-made example (1,000 Wh at 80% charge running a 100 W load), pick from illustrative devices like a laptop, LED lamp, or 12 V cooler, then edit every value to match your own gear.

PRIVATE AND OFFLINE
No account, no internet connection, no tracking, and no Bluetooth. Watt Wise never connects to your battery or any equipment, and everything stays on your iPhone.

MADE FOR EVERY IPHONE
Dark Mode, Dynamic Type, VoiceOver with an adjustable charge control, Reduce Motion support, and layouts that adapt to every iPhone screen.

name: Wattle: Citizenship Test Prep
description:
Wattle helps you get ready for the Australian citizenship test.

It has 258 practice questions, short study notes and timed practice tests. Everything is based on the testable part of the Department of Home Affairs booklet "Australian Citizenship: Our Common Bond".

LEARN THE FOUR PARTS
• Part 1: Australia and its people
• Part 2: Democratic beliefs, rights and liberties
• Part 3: Government and the law
• Part 4: Australian values

Practise in rounds of 10 questions. After each answer, Wattle tells you if you were right and explains why. Questions you get wrong come back in a review list until you answer them correctly.

READ THE STUDY NOTES
28 topics in plain English cover what the booklet says you need to know. From any topic you can go straight to its questions.

SIT A PRACTICE TEST
Practice tests follow the rules of the real test:
• 20 questions
• 45 minutes
• 75% to pass
• all 5 Australian values questions must be right

Questions are picked at random each time. Wattle keeps your results and counts how many practice tests you have passed in a row.

PLAN FOR YOUR TEST DAY
Enter your test date and Wattle shows how many days are left and how many new questions to learn each day. You can turn on a daily reminder.

LISTEN
Every question, answer and study note can be read aloud in English.

PRIVATE
There is no account and no sign-up. Wattle collects no data. Your progress stays on your iPhone, and the app works without an internet connection.

FREE AND FULL VERSION
Part 1 and one practice test are free. A one-off in-app purchase unlocks Parts 2, 3 and 4, every study note and unlimited practice tests. It is not a subscription.

PLEASE NOTE
Wattle is an independent study aid. It is not made, approved or endorsed by the Australian Government or the Department of Home Affairs. The questions were written for this app. They are not the real test questions, which are not published. Wattle cannot promise that you will pass. Please read the Our Common Bond booklet as well. It is free at immi.homeaffairs.gov.au.

Source material: Australian Government Department of Home Affairs, used and adapted under the Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Australia licence.

name: Wavio-Sketch Together
description:
Wavio is a creative community for artists. Share your paintings and hand-drawn artwork, discover inspiring work from creators, and connect with fellow artists.

Share your art: Upload images or videos with captions and tags such as watercolor, sketch, illustration, or digital painting.
Get inspired: Browse popular posts, like and comment, and follow artists.
Artist chatrooms: Join rooms to discuss techniques and share tips, or create your own.
Messages & video calls: Chat privately or start a video call to talk about art.
Safety: Report and block features, and in-app account deletion.

name: Weather Log: Past & Forecast
description:
Weather for 917 places in Japan only — see last year's weather and the forecast for your trip, side by side in one monthly calendar.

Wondering what Kyoto was like last November, or whether you'll need an umbrella in Tokyo next week? Just flip through the calendar. Past weather comes from observation data by the Japan Meteorological Agency (JMA).

MONTHLY CALENDAR
- Past days show what actually happened: sun, rain or snow, high and low temperatures, and rainfall
- Upcoming days show the forecast
- Both sit in the same calendar, so you can compare the past and the days ahead at a glance

TODAY
- Today and tomorrow, an hourly forecast, and the days ahead
- A short hint such as "No umbrella needed" or "Bring a folding umbrella"
- Swipe left or right to switch between your places

LAST YEAR, SAME DAY
- Tap a day to compare it with the same day last year
- See monthly and yearly summaries of temperatures and rainy days

FIND A PLACE
- Search all 917 stations by name in English (Tokyo, Kyoto, Sapporo, Naha...)
- In Japan, the app can switch to the station nearest to you

BOOKMARKS
- Mark birthdays, anniversaries or trip days and look back at their weather
- Set a bookmark to repeat yearly and see that date's weather year after year

ALSO
- Back up to iCloud and restore on a new iPhone
- Available in English and Japanese

FREE
- This year's and last year's weather
- The forecast
- Up to 3 places and 3 bookmarks

ONE-TIME PURCHASES (no subscription)
- Full history: weather from before last year (currently back to 2021)
- Past hourly charts
- More places, more bookmarks
- Remove ads
- All-in: everything above in one purchase

ABOUT THE DATA
- Past weather is processed from JMA observation data
- Forecasts use Apple Weather (WeatherKit) and JMA forecasts
- Stations are in Japan only. Outside Japan, search for the place you're visiting.
- Not affiliated with JMA.

Send feedback anytime from Settings > Send Feedback.

name: Wedge Rise
description: A strip has six patches. Develop adds one to every patch still under 6. A patch at 6 stays. The sentence names the lightest patch that is still open. When all six are at 6, the sentence says the wedge is held. You cannot develop one patch by itself. Names stay on this iPhone.

name: WeekInPix - Photomontage
description:
Your week, in six pictures.

Week in Pix turns the photos already on your phone into a beautiful weekly photo journal. Pick six moments, or let the app pick for you, and get a striking black collage with film-style timestamps and your week stamped along the edge: MY WEEK IN PICTURES WK 51.

Make one every Sunday and watch your year come together, one week at a time.

EFFORTLESS 
• Opens on this week's photos, grouped by day 
• Auto-pick fills the collage with your favourites first, spread across the whole week 
• Tap auto-pick again for a fresh mix

MAKE IT YOURS 
• Drag a photo onto another frame to swap them 
• Tap a photo, then drag and pinch to frame it just right, even panoramas 
• Four layouts: six frames, three frames, three wide strips or four squares 
• Rotate the layout: big pictures on the right, top, left or bottom, for portraits or variety 
• Your favourites are marked with a heart so they're easy to spot 
• Light, dark or automatic: the app looks the way you like

FIND THE MOMENT 
• Search your week for "food", "dogs", "flowers", "beach", "people" and more 
• Recognised right on your device, with nothing uploaded

NEVER MISS A WEEK 
• An optional weekly reminder on the day and time that suits you 
• Or let Shortcuts do it: the Make Collage action builds this week's collage automatically, every Sunday if you like

CLEAN BY DEFAULT 
• Only your photos are shown, no screenshots or memes cluttering your week 
• Collages you've already saved stay out of the way too 
• Want them? Turn on screenshots, animated images or saved collages in Settings

SHARE IT 
• Export a crisp, high-resolution image 
• Save to Photos, share to anywhere, or save to Files

PRIVATE 
• Everything happens on your device 
• No account, no uploads, no tracking 
• Free, with no ads, subscriptions or in-app purchases

MORE THAN A WEEK 
• My Month in Pictures: whole calendar months, or the last 30 days 
• My Quarter in Pictures: the last 90 days in six photos 
• Last 7 Days: a rolling week that ends today 
• Event in Pix: any single day or run of days, perfect for weddings, holidays, birthdays and road trips 
• Browse your whole library: add photos from any album, collection or date 
• Your own title: replace "My Week in Pictures" with anything: "Sam & Alex's Wedding", "Japan 2026", "Baby's First Month" 
• Your own colour: pick any colour for the title and timestamps to match the occasion 
• White frames: a clean, bright look with black text

EVERYWHERE YOUR PHOTOS ARE 
• iPhone, iPad and Mac, with your photos in a sidebar beside the collage on larger screens 
• On Mac, open several windows to work on more than one collage at a time

Weeks start on your region's first day, Monday or Sunday.

name: Weft Beat
description:
Weft Beat keeps one woven pick on this iPhone.

The shuttle starts in the box. Write the name that belongs on the cloth. Drag the shuttle to the right until it stays. Drag the beater down until that one pick locks. The cloth is woven that way, with the time it was beaten.

Open the beam later to see that cloth. Woven cloth stays on this iPhone. Nothing is uploaded and nothing is shared.

Weft Beat does not weave real cloth, sell a shuttle, or send the pick count to anyone.

name: WhisperWho
description:
WhisperWHO! is a live social dictionary where everyone whispers at the same time. Words fly away, writing stays, they say. Here, whispers fly away and stay in your ear.

Everything you whisper drops onto everyone’s screen as a bubble that stays for a few seconds. Whispers that many people hear echo back into the flow. You don’t need to follow anyone to see what people are talking about. Just listen.

LIVE STAGE
Whispers appear the moment they’re written, stay for a few seconds, then make room for the next. You choose the reading speed.

TRENDING
The most used words of the last half hour rise and fall on live bars. Tap a word to see what people are saying about it.

SWIPE
The most heard whispers on full-screen cards, one swipe at a time. Double-tap to say "heard it", or listen to whispers read aloud.

DICTIONARY
Popular whispers land on the page of their word. See each word’s 30-day wave, leave a lasting entry, and underline the entries you like.

HEAR, REPLY, SHARE
Say "heard it" to a whisper you like, reply to it, or pass it on. Hide your nickname and whisper masked; take the mask off when enough people get curious.

MESSAGES AND NOTIFICATIONS
Send private messages to your friends: text, photos, videos or voice. Get notified when someone hears your whisper, replies, or messages you. Notifications are optional and can be turned off anytime in your phone’s settings.

LISTEN TO THE BUZZ
An audio summary of the day’s top 10 whispers and a new "Question of the day" every day.

DARK AND LIGHT, TURKISH AND ENGLISH
The app follows your phone’s theme, or pick the look you like. Translate whispers written in other languages.

YOU’RE IN CONTROL
Mute words you don’t want to see, hide spoilers, and block people. Every whisper and reply can be reported. There is zero tolerance for objectionable content and abusive users: reports are reviewed within 24 hours and accounts that break the rules are closed.

PRIVACY
No ads, no tracking, your data is never sold. Download a copy of your data anytime and delete your account from inside the app.

You must be 18 or older to join.

Terms of Use: https://whisperwho.com/kosullar
Community Guidelines: https://whisperwho.com/kurallar
Privacy: https://whisperwho.com/gizlilik

name: Wi-Fi Signal Strength Analyzer
description:
Check how your Wi-Fi connection performs around your home. Watch latency to your router in milliseconds, then save a reading with a room name so you can revisit it later.

• Router latency shows the latest response time and recent history. Start a recording, move to another spot, and stop when you are done.
• Speed Test measures download speed, upload speed and internet latency using Cloudflare.
• Ping and Router help you check for replies, response times and packet loss.
• DNS Lookup shows the IP addresses returned by your Wi-Fi network's DNS resolver.
• Network Check shows devices that respond on your local Wi-Fi network and names when they are available.
• Logs keeps saved readings and their room labels on your device.

Router latency measures response time in milliseconds. On iPhone and iPad, this app does not measure Wi-Fi signal power in dBm.

name: WiFi Island: Taiwan Free Wi-Fi
description:
Find free Wi-Fi in Taiwan without needing a connection first.

WiFi Island keeps 16,000+ free Wi-Fi hotspots across Taiwan on your phone. Just landed, out of mobile data, or underground with no signal? Open the app and see where the nearest Wi-Fi is.

WORKS OFFLINE
• Hotspot data is built into the app and updates automatically when you are online
• Nearby hotspots sorted by distance, with clear categories: stations, libraries, cafes, government buildings and more
• Color-coded map shows at a glance where you can get online

CONNECT IN ONE TAP
• Network name, password and login method at a glance
• Join the network with one tap, no typing passwords
• Login method shown for each hotspot, with a filter for no-login spots

KEPT UP TO DATE BY THE COMMUNITY
• Found a new hotspot? Add it on the spot; scan its QR code to fill in the name and password
• Confirm details on site, or rate speed and stability, to make the data more reliable
• Report wrong or inappropriate content; we handle reports within 24 hours

BECOME A HOTSPOT HUNTER
• Earn XP for adding and confirming hotspots, and level up from C to Legend
• Collect hexagon medals in bronze, silver and gold for visiting Taiwan's 22 cities and counties and for contribution streaks
• Weekly quests: rescue hotspots awaiting confirmation and recheck ones nobody has confirmed in a while
• Explored map: the places you have been light up on the map, and this map stays only on your phone

PRIVACY FIRST
• Search and connect without signing in; Sign in with Apple is only needed to add or rate, and we never ask for your name or email
• Upload anonymously, and delete your account at any time

Free with ads. Remove ads with a one-time purchase, or buy the developer a coffee to support the app.

Hotspot data comes from Taiwan government open data (Open Government Data License, version 1.0) and from users. Actual availability may vary on site.

name: Windsprite
description:
Windsprite for iPhone is the pocket half of Windsprite for Mac. Your Mac listens to your meetings, writes the transcript, sums them up and keeps track of what you said you’d do. Your iPhone takes that with you, and records the meetings your Mac can’t hear.

RECORD THE ROOM
Put your iPhone on the table and tap Record. It keeps going with the screen locked; the Lock Screen and the Dynamic Island show it’s running, and you can stop it right there. Back with your Mac, the recording goes over and becomes a meeting like any other: transcript, speakers, summary and to-dos. Your iPhone deletes its copy once your Mac is done with it.

LOOK IT UP
Your meetings with their summaries and transcripts, the people you meet and the organizations they work for, and the to-dos you owe: all on your iPhone, brought up to date whenever your Mac is near. Tick off a to-do on the way, and your Mac knows.

ONLY BETWEEN YOUR DEVICES
Your iPhone talks to one place: your own Mac, directly, over your Wi-Fi or from device to device. No cloud, no account, no server of ours in between. Pairing takes a QR code and six digits, and the connection is encrypted and tied to your two devices. If you like, Face ID locks the app.

WHAT YOU NEED
A Mac with Windsprite, free from windsprite.app. Pair in Windsprite’s Settings › iPhone.

Windsprite is free, with no ads and no in-app purchases.

name: WinkDuel
description:
WinkDuel is a rally you play on a single phone, held flat. Bring a friend, or play vs the computer. Cyan takes the bottom. Magenta takes the top and reads every label turned around.

On iPhone Duo, fold the phone into a tent or a book. Each half is one player, the crease stays empty, and the match continues when you open or close it. Menus, the score, and the pause sheet sit on neon-tinted Liquid Glass. The court stays sharp: white paddles, a dark ring on the ball, and the arena underneath.

Against the computer, pick Easy, Medium, Hard, or Insane. Easy is slow and misses. Hard and Insane track the most dangerous ball, including fire, chaos, walls, and Night Mask, without teleporting the paddle. A tournament ladder is eight of those opponents on different arenas, first to 3. A local cup seats 4, 6, or 8 names you type, and the bracket stays on the phone. Ten original arenas and a random pick are in the menu. The last mode, difficulty, arena, and favorite character stay on the device. The game is in English and Russian, and the language switch is in the settings.

Drag in your half. Both fingers work at once. The ball starts calm and keeps getting faster. It has a white core, a dark ring, and a short trail, so it stays visible on every arena and at every fire level. Paddles are a solid white bar with a dark outline. That bar is the whole hit zone. A cartoon sits on it: a grin, a gasp, a cat, a duck, a sausage, a jelly, a robot, or a slice of pizza. It winks on a hit and looks shocked when a goal is scored against it. You can pin a favorite, leave it on surprise, or pick up a funny-face power. Power-ups belong to whoever touched the ball last, and that paddle blinks so you both know.

Speed is the common pickup. Each one feeds the fire, up to five levels, until the ball is nearly a fireball. You can also widen your paddle, shrink the other one, raise a wall for ten seconds, curl a rainbow arc, or roll Chaos, which turns the ball ninety degrees between two and eight times. Night Mask, an original comic hero, leans in and fires extra balls at the other player.

A goal counts only when the field is empty and the last ball has left. Every thirty seconds, obstacles drift through the center.

A Daily Challenge picks one arena and one twist for the UTC day: a giant ball, mirrored controls, a ghost paddle, or a faster rally. Streaks stay on the phone. Match XP unlocks extra arenas and characters. There is no purchase. Tent Duel gives each player a half when iPhone Duo is folded into a tent. Flex Table keeps both halves readable from one side when the phone is only half folded. The crease stays empty and the rally does not restart.

Records keep tournament wins, the best Insane streak, and the daily score on the device. A signed build can send those to Game Center after you sign in. Play with a friend on this phone is a local match. SharePlay is not connected in this version, and the screen says exactly what is still missing. It will not pretend a friend joined.

Sound is a set of original synth stings. It follows the mute switch, and you can silence it in the game. Haptics follow the in-app switch. A color-blind palette and one-handed buttons against the computer are in the settings. There is no account.

name: Winning Souls for Jesus
description:
Winning Souls For Jesus

Grow in Faith. Find Hope. Experience the Power of God's Word.

Winning Souls For Jesus is a Christian ministry app dedicated to spreading the Gospel of Jesus Christ, strengthening believers, and inspiring people around the world through biblical teaching, prayer, worship, and Christian fellowship.

Whether you're beginning your journey with Christ or seeking to deepen your relationship with God, Winning Souls For Jesus provides meaningful spiritual resources to encourage you every day.

EXPLORE THE HOLY BIBLE

Read and study the Old and New Testaments with the King James Version (KJV) in English and Reina-Valera 1909 in Spanish. Explore Scripture, follow Bible reading plans, and grow in your understanding of God's Word.

DAILY PRAYERS AND SCRIPTURE

Start your day with powerful Christian prayers, daily Bible verses, inspirational quotes, and spiritual encouragement centered on Jesus Christ as Lord, God, and Savior.

SERMONS, PODCASTS, AND CHRISTIAN MEDIA

Discover uplifting sermons, Christian podcasts, Gospel music, worship recordings, and motivational messages designed to strengthen your faith and bring encouragement throughout your day.

SPIRITUAL GROWTH AND DISCIPLESHIP

Build consistent spiritual habits through Bible reading, devotionals, prayer journals, biblical knowledge activities, and the 30-Day Discipleship Journey.

PRAYER AND CHRISTIAN COMMUNITY

Connect with a community of believers, share testimonies, submit prayer requests, and encourage others through faith-centered conversations.

STAY INSPIRED

Explore Christian news, ministry updates, and resources that help you remain connected to the Christian faith.

OUR MISSION

Winning Souls For Jesus exists to proclaim the Gospel, share the love of Jesus Christ, encourage spiritual growth, and help people develop a closer relationship with God.

"For God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son, that whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have everlasting life." — John 3:16 (KJV)

Download Winning Souls for Jesus and begin your journey of faith, prayer, worship, and spiritual growth today.

Reaching Souls. Transforming Lives. Sharing Jesus.

name: Wise Edu
seller_name: WISE EDU YURTDISI EGITIM DANISMANLIK TICARET LIMITED SIRKETI

• Danışmanının paylaştığı güncellemeleri ve notları anında oku

BELGELER
